narrative_text: B777-200 (Aircraft X) is parked at base with an IDG fault that triggered an ELEC GEN OFF EICAS advisory; MEL 24-XX-X was applied by maintenance to release the aircraft for service. Logbook entries and supporting MEL documentation were not fully completed before release, so incoming techs need to verify the paperwork and confirm troubleshooting steps taken so far. Please coordinate with flight crew on the deferred item status before next departure.
summary: IDG fault with ELEC GEN OFF advisory on B777-200 was MEL'd but requires follow-up on incomplete documentation and crew coordination.

narrative_text: Ndege ya B777-200 (Aircraft X) imesimama hapa base ikiwa na hitilafu ya IDG iliyosababisha ujumbe wa tahadhari wa ELEC GEN OFF kwenye EICAS; wafanyakazi wa matengenezo walitumia MEL 24-XX-X ili kuiruhusu ndege iendelee kutumika. Hata hivyo, nyaraka za logbook na uthibitisho wa MEL hazikukamilika kabla ya kuiruhusu ndege hiyo, hivyo timu ya zamu inayofuata inahitajika kuhakiki makaratasi hayo na kufuatilia hatua za uchunguzi zilizofanyika. Tafadhali wasiliana na wafanyakazi wa ndege kuhusu hali ya kipengele hiki kilichoahirishwa kabla ya safari inayofuata.
summary: Hitilafu ya IDG kwenye B777-200 ilitumiwa MEL lakini bado inahitaji ufuatiliaji wa nyaraka zisizokamilika na mawasiliano na wafanyakazi wa ndege.

entities.text: ujumbe wa tahadhari wa ELEC GEN OFF

narrative_text: Aircraft X, hii B777-200, iko parked hapa base na ina IDG fault ambayo imetrigger ile ELEC GEN OFF advisory kwa EICAS. Maintenance wame-apply MEL 24-XX-X kuiclear ndege iende for service, lakini logbook entries na hiyo MEL documentation hazija-completeka fully, so next shift inafaa i-verify hizo paperwork na kucheck ile troubleshooting iliyofanywa. Pia mkumbuke ku-coordinate na flight crew kuhusu status ya hio deferred item kabla ya next departure.
summary: IDG fault na ELEC GEN OFF advisory kwa B777-200 zime-MEL lakini documentation bado haijakamilika, so next shift ihakikishe follow-up na flight crew.

narrative_text: During the tech stop at ZZZ1, water was found pouring from the CAC door area on the B747-400 (Reg X); Maintenance Control was notified and instructed to deactivate the water system, defer the item, and keep the aircraft moving to ZZZ. On arrival at ZZZ, the Maintenance Manager directed staff not to investigate further and logged the leak as 'not found,' then released the aircraft into service despite the known leak draining into the compartment housing the IRUs and computers. Next shift needs to verify the deferred item is properly documented in the logbook and confirm whether the water system deactivation and compartment inspection were actually completed before further dispatch.
summary: A known water leak into the IRU/computer compartment on a B747-400 was deferred and effectively written off without proper inspection before release to service.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kituo cha kiufundi ZZZ1, maji yaligundulika yakitiririka kutoka eneo la mlango wa CAC kwenye ndege ya B747-400 (Reg X); Udhibiti wa Uhandisi ulijulishwa na kuagiza mfumo wa maji uzimwe, kasoro hiyo iahirishwe, na ndege iendelee safari hadi ZZZ. Ilipofika ZZZ, Meneja wa Uhandisi aliagiza wafanyakazi wasiendelee kuchunguza na akaandika kwamba uvujaji 'haukupatikana,' kisha akairuhusu ndege kutumika licha ya uvujaji huo kuelekea kwenye chumba chenye kompyuta na vifaa vya IRU. Zamu inayofuata inahitaji kuthibitisha kama kasoro hiyo imeandikwa vizuri kwenye logbook na kama ukaguzi wa chumba na uzimaji wa mfumo wa maji ulifanyika kikamilifu kabla ya safari nyingine.
summary: Uvujaji wa maji ulioelekea kwenye chumba cha kompyuta na IRU kwenye ndege ya B747-400 uliahirishwa na kuandikwa kuwa haukupatikana bila ukaguzi wa kutosha kabla ya kuruhusiwa kutumika.

narrative_text: Wakati wa tech stop pale ZZZ1, tuligundua maji yanatoka kwa CAC door area kwenye B747-400 (Reg X); Maintenance Control walijulishwa na wakasema tu-deactivate ile water system, tu-defer item, na ndege iendelee kwenda ZZZ. Ikifika ZZZ, Maintenance Manager aliambia team wasiguse chochote na aka-log ile leak kama 'not found,' halafu aka-release aircraft into service ijapokuwa leak ile inaenda kwenye compartment yenye IRUs na computers. Next shift lazima tu-verify kama ile deferred item imeandikwa properly kwenye logbook, na kama water system deactivation na compartment inspection zilifanyika kabla ya dispatch nyingine.
summary: Kuna known leak ya maji inayoenda kwenye compartment ya IRU/computers kwenye B747-400 ambayo iliahirishwa na kuandikwa 'not found' bila proper inspection kabla ya kurelease aircraft.

narrative_text: Responded to a gate call on the MAX 8 for a #2 thrust reverser fault on the MFD; two junior technicians with limited 737 experience handled it and were directed by the lead mechanic to defer the item rather than troubleshoot via BITE test. Inboard TR lock and safety wire were installed on #2 engine to restrict forward movement, and maintenance control was consulted by phone to confirm the deferral procedure before downgrading the aircraft to CAT 1. Note the crew faced pressure from gate agents and cabin crew to expedite; recommend follow-up review of deferral paperwork and additional MFD/thrust reverser training for junior staff.
summary: A #2 thrust reverser fault on a MAX 8 was deferred by inexperienced technicians under time pressure, requiring MC verification and CAT 1 downgrade.

narrative_text: Tulipokea wito wa kwenda geti kwa ndege ya MAX 8 kutokana na hitilafu ya thrust reverser namba 2 iliyoonekana kwenye MFD; mafundi wawili wapya wenye uzoefu mdogo wa 737 walishughulikia tatizo hilo na kuelekezwa na fundi mkuu kuahirisha ukarabati badala ya kufanya majaribio ya BITE. Walifunga inboard TR lock na waya wa usalama kwenye injini namba 2 ili kuzuia msogeo wa mbele, kisha wakawasiliana na maintenance control kwa simu kuthibitisha taratibu kabla ya kushusha hadhi ya ndege hadi CAT 1. Kulikuwa na msukumo wa haraka kutoka kwa wafanyakazi wa geti na wahudumu wa ndani; inashauriwa kufanyike ufuatiliaji wa nyaraka za uahirishaji pamoja na mafunzo zaidi kwa mafundi kuhusu MFD na thrust reverser.
summary: Hitilafu ya thrust reverser namba 2 kwenye ndege ya MAX 8 iliahirishwa na mafundi wasio na uzoefu wa kutosha chini ya msukumo wa muda, jambo lililohitaji uthibitisho wa maintenance control na kushushwa hadhi hadi CAT 1.

narrative_text: Tulipata gate call kwa hii MAX 8 kwa sababu ya #2 thrust reverser fault iliyoonekana kwa MFD; two probationary mechanics wenye 737 experience ndogo ndio waliattend, wakielekezwa na lead mechanic kuipeleka #2 TR kwa deferral badala ya kufanya BITE test kwanza. Tuliweka inboard TR lock na safety wire kwa engine namba 2 ku-restrict forward movement, kisha tukapiga simu kwa maintenance control ku-confirm procedures kabla ya ku-downgrade aircraft hadi CAT 1. Kulikuwa na pressure kutoka kwa gate agents na flight attendant wakiuliza itachukua muda gani; tunahitaji ku-follow up na paperwork ya deferral pamoja na additional training kwa junior mechanics kuhusu MFD na thrust reverser.
summary: #2 thrust reverser fault kwa MAX 8 ili-deferred na mechanics wasio na experience ya kutosha chini ya time pressure, na ikahitaji maintenance control verification pamoja na CAT 1 downgrade.

narrative_text: During the Aileron Servo Controls job card, a technician in the flight deck noticed the snap wire on the guarded switch for the cargo compartment fire extinguisher agent discharge appeared broken. While checking the switch, the guard was pulled and the No. 1 fire extinguisher bottle discharged into the forward pit. Maintenance should pull the associated circuit breaker before handling this guarded switch in future, and the discharged bottle needs replacement/recharge and logbook entry before next flight.
summary: A guarded fire extinguisher switch was inadvertently activated during inspection, discharging the No. 1 bottle into the forward pit, requiring bottle replacement and procedural correction.

entities.text: guarded switch for the cargo compartment fire extinguisher agent discharge

narrative_text: Wakati wa kazi ya ukaguzi wa Aileron Servo Controls, fundi aliyekuwa kwenye chumba cha marubani aligundua waya ya kinga kwenye swichi ya kutolea dawa ya kuzimia moto ya sehemu ya mizigo ilionekana imekatika. Alipojaribu kuangalia swichi hiyo, chupa ya kwanza ya kuzimia moto ilitolewa bila kukusudia hadi kwenye sehemu ya mbele ya ndege. Ni muhimu zamu inayofuata ihakikishe breaker husika imetolewa kabla ya kugusa swichi hiyo tena, na chupa iliyotumika ibadilishwe na kuandikwa kwenye logbook kabla ya safari ijayo.
summary: Swichi ya kinga ya kuzimia moto iliguswa kimakosa wakati wa ukaguzi na kusababisha chupa ya kwanza kutoa dawa, hivyo inahitajika ubadilishaji na marekebisho ya taratibu.

chupa ya kwanza ya kuzimia moto

narrative_text: Wakati wa job card ya Aileron Servo Controls, technician alikuwa flight deck akiangalia guarded switch ya cargo fire extinguisher discharge, akaona snap wire imekatika. Alipopull guard ku-check, No. 1 fire extinguisher bottle iki-discharge bila kukusudia hadi forward pit. Next shift wahakikishe wanapull circuit breaker kabla ya kugusa switch hiyo, na bottle iliyodischarge ireplace na logbook entry ifanywe before next flight.
summary: Guarded switch ya fire extinguisher iliguswa kimakosa wakati wa inspection na kusababisha No. 1 bottle kudischarge, hivyo inahitaji replacement na procedure correction.

narrative_text: The BeechJet 400XP main cabin door air-stairs received for installation had a part number not listed as effective for this aircraft serial number per the manufacturer's IPC. Maintenance control instructed the technician to install anyway, citing past practice, but could produce no manufacturer documentation supporting cross-applicability, and the manufacturer confirmed no such approval exists. Stairs remain uninstalled pending correct-effectivity parts or written manufacturer authorization; next shift please do not release aircraft with these stairs fitted until documentation is resolved.
summary: Incorrect-effectivity air-stairs for a BeechJet 400XP were held back after maintenance control pressured installation without manufacturer documentation.

entities.text: correct-effectivity parts or written manufacturer authorization

narrative_text: Ngazi za mlango wa kabati kuu za BeechJet 400XP zilizoletwa kwa ufungaji zilikuwa na namba ya sehemu isiyoendana na serial number ya ndege hii kulingana na IPC ya mtengenezaji. Maintenance control walimwambia fundi afunge tu akitoa sababu kwamba hivyo ndivyo walivyokuwa wakifanya siku zote, lakini hawakuwa na hati yoyote kutoka kwa mtengenezaji inayothibitisha hilo, na mtengenezaji mwenyewe alithibitisha kutokuwepo kwa idhini kama hiyo. Ngazi hazijafungwa hadi sehemu sahihi au kibali cha maandishi kutoka kwa mtengenezaji kipatikane; zamu inayofuata isiruhusu ufungaji wa ngazi hizi kabla ya suala hili kutatuliwa.
summary: Ngazi za mlango zenye namba ya sehemu isiyofaa kwa BeechJet 400XP zilizuiliwa baada ya maintenance control kujaribu kushinikiza ufungaji bila hati za mtengenezaji.

entities.text: Ngazi za mlango wa kabati kuu
kibali cha maandishi kutoka kwa mtengenezaji

narrative_text: Zile air-stairs za main cabin door za BeechJet 400XP zilikuja na part number ambayo haiko effective kwa serial number ya hii aircraft, kwa mujibu wa IPC ya manufacturer. Maintenance control walimwambia technician a-install tu wakisema 'we've been doing it like that for years,' lakini hawakuwa na documentation yoyote kutoka manufacturer inayo-support hilo, na manufacturer wenyewe walithibitisha hakuna approval kama hiyo. Stairs bado hazijafungwa mpaka correct-effectivity parts au written authorization ipatikane -- zamu inayofuata please usi-release aircraft na hizi stairs mpaka issue hii i-clear.
summary: Air-stairs zenye wrong part number kwa BeechJet 400XP zime-hold baada ya maintenance control kujaribu kupressure installation bila manufacturer documentation.

narrative_text: On the B737, after full replacement of the LEAP-1B fuel nozzles, the idle leak check came back clean for fuel but showed an oil leak. During the follow-up 70% part power run using the bag method at the drain lines, a significant fuel leak developed in the hot section. Current EA does not require a nitrogen leak check with test solution before power runs, and this needs to be escalated since a similar hot section fire was reported weeks ago. Next shift: follow up on request to revise EA to require either a high power run or proper nitrogen leak-check tooling, and check status of ordered leak detector liquid.
summary: Fuel nozzle replacement on a B737 revealed a hot-section fuel leak during power run testing, prompting a request to revise engineering authorization for stricter leak checks.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya B737, baada ya kubadilisha fuel nozzles zote za injini ya LEAP-1B, ukaguzi wa uvujaji wa idle ulionyesha hakuna mvujo wa mafuta ya ndege lakini kulikuwa na mvujo wa oil. Wakati wa jaribio la pili la 70% power kwa kutumia njia ya bag kwenye drain lines, mvujo mkubwa wa mafuta ulionekana kwenye hot section. Utaratibu wa sasa wa EA hauhitaji ukaguzi wa uvujaji kwa nitrogen kabla ya majaribio hayo, jambo ambalo linahitaji kufuatiliwa haraka kwani tukio kama hili la moto kwenye hot section liliripotiwa wiki chache zilizopita. Zamu inayofuata ifuatilie ombi la kurekebisha EA ili kudai jaribio la high power au vifaa sahihi vya ukaguzi wa nitrogen, na iangalie hali ya maji ya kugundua uvujaji yaliyoagizwa.
summary: Ubadilishaji wa fuel nozzles kwenye ndege ya B737 ulisababisha mvujo wa mafuta kwenye hot section wakati wa jaribio la power, hivyo kuhitajika marekebisho ya haraka ya taratibu za ukaguzi.

narrative_text: Kwenye B737, baada ya kufanya replacement ya fuel nozzles zote za LEAP-1B, ile idle leak check ilikuwa clean kwa fuel lakini ikaonyesha oil leak. Wakati wa 70% part power run tukitumia bag method kwenye drain lines, kuka-develop fuel leak kubwa kwenye hot section. Sasa hivi EA haitaki nitrogen leak check na test solution kabla ya power run, na hii inafaa iangaliwe haraka kwa sababu kuna report ya hot section fire ya wiki chache zilizopita. Shift inayofuata i-follow up ombi la ku-revise EA ili idai high power run au proper nitrogen tooling, na icheck status ya leak detector liquid iliyo-order.
summary: Fuel nozzle replacement kwenye B737 ilisababisha fuel leak kwenye hot section wakati wa power run, hivyo kunahitajika EA revision haraka.

narrative_text: During today's cycle count in the hazmat storage area, a dangerous goods discrepancy was found for part XX-XXXX-X-XXX; it was packed inside the same box as XX-XXXX-X-XXY and was not identified as hazmat at the time of counting. The item was counted without recognizing its hazmat status, likely due to workload and time pressure on shift. Next shift please verify hazmat labeling on all boxed items in that bin and re-confirm the cycle count records before releasing the discrepancy report.
summary: A hazmat item was miscounted during cycle count because it was co-boxed with another part and not flagged as dangerous goods, requiring follow-up verification.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kufanya hesabu ya mzunguko (cycle count) leo, kulibainika tofauti ya bidhaa hatari kwa sehemu XX-XXXX-X-XXX, ambayo ilikuwa imewekwa kwenye sanduku moja na XX-XXXX-X-XXY na haikutambuliwa kama hazmat wakati wa kuhesabu. Kipengele hiki kilihesabiwa bila kujua kuwa ni bidhaa hatari, huenda kutokana na mzigo mkubwa wa kazi na muda mfupi wa zamu. Zamu inayofuata tafadhali kaguni lebo za hazmat kwenye masanduku yote eneo hilo na muhakikishe rekodi za hesabu kabla ya kuwasilisha ripoti ya tofauti hiyo.
summary: Bidhaa hatari haikutambuliwa wakati wa hesabu ya mzunguko kwa sababu ilikuwa imewekwa pamoja na sehemu nyingine kwenye sanduku moja, hivyo inahitaji ukaguzi zaidi.

narrative_text: Leo wakati wa cycle count, kulikuwa na dangerous goods discrepancy kwa part XX-XXXX-X-XXX, ilikuwa imewekwa ndani ya box moja na XX-XXXX-X-XXY na hakuna aliyejua ni hazmat wakati wa kuhesabu. Item ilicount bila kutambua status yake ya hazmat, labda ni kwa sababu ya workload na time pressure ya hiyo shift. Next shift please mkague hazmat labels kwa boxes zote pale storage area na muconfirm cycle count records kabla ya kusubmit hiyo discrepancy report.
summary: Part ya hazmat ilikosewa kutambuliwa during cycle count kwa sababu ilikuwa imewekwa pamoja na part nyingine kwenye box moja, hivyo inahitaji follow-up verification.

narrative_text: An AWB for a 14-piece bicycle shipment with 2 dangerous goods batteries was rebooked onto a new flight after a gate change caused the original cart to be refused and returned to the warehouse. During replanning the NOTOC screen displayed NO DG instead of showing the hidden DG window, so the shipment was manifested and dispatched without a dangerous goods declaration to destination. Please flag this AWB and cart for review, and follow up with the duty manager on urgent NOTOC/DG rebooking training, since this was missed during onboarding.
summary: A DG shipment was replanned onto a new flight without a proper NOTOC declaration because the system defaulted to showing NO DG, requiring urgent review and staff training follow-up.

narrative_text: Shehena ya baiskeli vipande 14 pamoja na betri mbili za kemikali hatari (DG) ilibidi ipangiwe ndege nyingine baada ya lango kubadilika na gari la mizigo kukataliwa, kisha kurudishwa ghalani. Wakati wa kupanga upya safari, mfumo ulionyesha HAKUNA DG badala ya kufungua dirisha maalum la taarifa za mizigo hatari, hivyo mzigo ukasafirishwa nje ya nchi bila taarifa sahihi ya NOTOC. Tafadhali fuatilia hati hii ya usafirishaji na uhakikishe menejimenti inatoa mafunzo ya haraka kuhusu upangaji upya wa mizigo hatari, kwani jambo hili halikufundishwa awali.
summary: Mzigo wenye vitu hatari ulipangiwa ndege nyingine bila taarifa sahihi ya NOTOC kwa sababu mfumo ulionyesha hakuna DG, hivyo inahitajika ufuatiliaji wa haraka na mafunzo kwa wafanyakazi.

narrative_text: Ile AWB ya bicycle 14 pieces na 2 DG batteries ilibidi i-replan kwa flight mpya baada ya gate kubadilika na cart ikarefuse, ikarudi warehouse. Nikienda replan kwenye system, screen ya NOTOC ikaonyesha NO DG badala ya kuopen ile hidden window ya DG details, so nikaenda ahead ni-manifest flight bila declaration sahihi mpaka destination ya international. Tafadhali fuatilia hii AWB na cart, halafu tuongee na duty manager kuhusu training ya DG rebooking kwa sababu hii process haikufundishwa during onboarding.
summary: AWB ya DG shipment iliishia kupangwa flight bila proper NOTOC declaration kwa sababu system ilishow NO DG, so tunahitaji follow-up na training ya haraka.

narrative_text: During the fuel drain valve task on the A320 (parked, gate maintenance), the three technicians assigned were unfamiliar with the job and had limited AMM guidance on defueling before starting; power was on and tank showed 3000 lbs when the valve was worked loose. While loosening the valve counterclockwise, the keeper lock fell into the drip bucket and the valve assembly gave way, releasing fuel with the cover dropping into the bucket, though the valve was partially locked back before help was requested. Next shift needs to verify tank fuel state, confirm valve/keeper lock integrity and secure installation, and review AMM procedure adequacy for defuel-before-removal steps.
summary: Technicians unfamiliar with the task lost control of a fuel drain valve on a parked A320 due to unclear AMM guidance, requiring follow-up on valve integrity and fuel state.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kazi ya kuondoa mafuta kwenye valve ya ndege ya A320 iliyokuwa imesimama, mafundi watatu waliopewa kazi hawakuwa na uzoefu na kazi hiyo, na maelezo ya AMM hayakuwa wazi kuhusu kuhamisha mafuta kabla ya kuanza; nguvu ilikuwa imewashwa na tanki lilionyesha uzito wa mafuta wa 3000 wakati valve ilipolegezwa. Wakati wa kulegeza valve kinyume cha saa, kifungo cha kushikilia (keeper lock) kilianguka kwenye ndoo na sehemu ya valve ikatoka ghafla, ikimwaga mafuta na kifuniko kikaanguka ndani ya ndoo, ingawa walifanikiwa kurudisha valve kwa sehemu kabla ya kuomba msaada. Zamu inayofuata inahitaji kuthibitisha kiwango cha mafuta kwenye tanki, kuangalia uimara wa valve na keeper lock, na kupitia upya taratibu za AMM kuhusu kuhamisha mafuta kabla ya kuondoa sehemu hiyo.
summary: Mafundi wasio na uzoefu walipoteza udhibiti wa valve ya mafuta kwenye A320 iliyosimama kutokana na maelekezo yasiyo wazi ya AMM, hivyo linahitajika ufuatiliaji wa hali ya valve na mafuta.

narrative_text: Kwa hii job ya fuel drain valve kwenye A320 iliyo parked, technicians watatu walioassignwa hawakuwa na experience na job hii, na AMM haikuwa na details za ku-defuel kabla ya kuanza kazi; power ilikuwa on na tank ilionyesha 3000 lbs wakati wakianza kulegeza valve. Tuli-turn valve counterclockwise, keeper lock ikaanguka kwa bucket na assembly ikatoka ghafla, mafuta yakamwagika na cover ikaanguka ndani ya bucket, lakini tuliweza ku-lock valve back kwa partial before tukaita Lead for help. Next shift wanahitaji kucheck fuel state ya tank, kuconfirm valve na keeper lock ziko sawa, na kureview AMM procedure kwa hizi defuel steps kabla ya removal.
summary: Technicians wasio na experience walipoteza control ya fuel drain valve kwenye A320 parked kwa sababu ya AMM isiyo clear, hivyo follow-up inahitajika kwa valve integrity na fuel status.

narrative_text: For A320 thrust reverser C-Duct harness work, note that the IPC currently shows a straight backshell for Connector 905P (left and right sides), but the correct installation per engineering requires a 90-degree backshell to give proper wire bend radius. This connector feeds the thrust reverser stow and lock proximity sensor, which is critical flight crew indication, so installing the wrong backshell risks wire stress and possible sensor malfunction. An engineering request has been filed to revise the work order and IPC illustrations/parts lists — next shift please confirm status of that revision with Engineering before releasing any further harness installs.
summary: IPC incorrectly specifies straight backshells for thrust reverser Connector 905P harnesses on both C-Ducts; engineering revision to correct to 90-degree backshells is in progress and needs follow-up before next installation.

entities.text: thrust reverser stow and lock proximity sensor
revise the work order and IPC illustrations/parts lists

narrative_text: Kwa kazi ya waya za thrust reverser C-Duct za ndege ya A320, kitabu cha IPC bado kinaonyesha backshell ya moja kwa moja (straight) kwa Connector 905P, upande wa kushoto na kulia, lakini kulingana na maelekezo sahihi ya uhandisi inatakiwa iwe backshell ya pembe ya digrii 90 ili kuepusha waya kuinama vibaya. Connector hii inaunganisha na proximity sensor ya thrust reverser inayotoa taarifa muhimu kwa marubani, hivyo kutumia backshell isiyo sahihi kunaweza kusababisha waya kubanwa na sensor kushindwa kufanya kazi vizuri. Ombi la kurekebisha work order na michoro ya IPC limeshapelekwa kwa idara ya uhandisi; zamu inayofuata iangalie maendeleo ya marekebisho hayo kabla ya kuendelea na ufungaji mwingine wa waya.
summary: IPC inaonyesha backshell isiyo sahihi kwa Connector 905P ya thrust reverser katika ndege za A320, na marekebisho ya kiuhandisi yanasubiriwa kufuatiliwa na zamu inayofuata.

entities.text: kurekebisha work order na michoro ya IPC

narrative_text: Kwa hii A320 thrust reverser C-Duct harness job, IPC bado imeandika straight backshell kwa Connector 905P, both left na right side, lakini per engineering ni lazima iwe 90-degree backshell ndio wire bend radius iwe sawa. Connector hii inaenda kwa thrust reverser stow and lock proximity sensor, ambayo ni critical indication kwa flight crew, so ukiweka wrong backshell utaleta wire stress na sensor inaweza ku-malfunction. Engineering wameshafanya request ya ku-revise hiyo work order na IPC illustrations/parts list, kwa hivyo next shift wa-confirm status ya revision hiyo na Engineering kabla ya kuendelea na installation nyingine.
summary: IPC ina wrong backshell part number kwa Connector 905P thrust reverser harness on A320, Engineering wanafanya revision na next shift wanapaswa ku-follow up kabla ya installation.

entities.text: thrust reverser stow and lock proximity sensor
ku-revise hiyo work order na IPC illustrations/parts list

narrative_text: During the Day 0 shift, we completed reinstallation of the vertical stabilizer tip (4) aft fairing on Aircraft X. It was later found on Day 1 that the aircraft had flown several legs with two circuit breakers left open, as the AMM step to pull C/Bs for the aft portion of the tip was not carried out since I assumed it did not apply to that section without VOR antennas. Next shift needs to confirm the affected C/Bs have been closed and verify the AMM steps for this task are re-reviewed before any further tip fairing work is signed off.
summary: Two circuit breakers were left open after a vertical stabilizer tip fairing reinstallation on Aircraft X due to a missed AMM step, requiring verification and review before further sign-off.

narrative_text: Wakati wa zamu ya Siku ya 0, tulikamilisha kazi ya kurudisha aft fairing ya ncha ya vertical stabilizer (4) kwenye Ndege X. Ilibainika Siku ya 1 kuwa ndege ilikuwa imefanya safari kadhaa huku circuit breaker mbili zikiwa hazijafungwa, kwani hatua ya AMM ya kutoa C/Bs kwa sehemu ya nyuma ya ncha hiyo haikufuatwa kwa sababu nilidhani haihitajiki kwa sehemu isiyo na antena za VOR. Zamu inayofuata inahitajika kuhakikisha C/Bs zilizoathirika zimefungwa vizuri na kupitia tena hatua za AMM kabla ya kazi nyingine yoyote ya fairing kuidhinishwa.
summary: Circuit breaker mbili ziliachwa wazi baada ya kazi ya kurudisha fairing ya ncha ya vertical stabilizer kwenye Ndege X kutokana na hatua ya AMM kukosa kufuatwa, hivyo inahitaji ukaguzi na uthibitisho kabla ya kazi zaidi.

entities.text: aft fairing ya ncha ya vertical stabilizer (4)
hatua ya AMM ya kutoa C/Bs

narrative_text: Siku ya 0 tulifanya reinstallation ya vertical stabilizer tip (4) aft fairing kwa Aircraft X. Siku ya 1 ikagunduliwa kwamba ndege ilikuwa imefanya multiple flight legs na circuit breakers mbili hazija-close, kwa sababu sikufikiria requirement ya kupull C/Bs kwa aft portion ya tip since haina VOR antennas - nilikosea kufuata AMM steps zote. Next shift ihakikishe C/Bs hizo zimefungwa properly na wa-review AMM steps kabla ya kusign off kazi yoyote ingine ya fairing.
summary: Circuit breakers mbili ziliachwa open baada ya reinstallation ya vertical stabilizer tip fairing kwa Aircraft X kwa sababu ya AMM step kukosa kufuatwa, inahitaji verification kabla ya sign-off inayofuata.

narrative_text: Owner-builder of the experimental exhibition-category aircraft carried out the condition inspection himself, assuming this was permitted under experimental rules, but it was later confirmed an A&P mechanic sign-off was required and this was never obtained. During a subsequent flight the engine lost power and the aircraft was damaged on landing, though there were no injuries. Follow-up needed: verify inspection paperwork status, determine whether the power loss is linked to the unsigned condition inspection, and confirm proper A&P sign-off procedures before further flight.
summary: An owner-performed condition inspection on an experimental aircraft was not signed off by an A&P mechanic as required, and the engine later lost power, causing landing damage that may be maintenance related.

narrative_text: Mmiliki wa ndege ya majaribio (experimental) alifanya ukaguzi wa hali ya ndege mwenyewe, akidhani inaruhusiwa kwa sababu ni ndege ya aina ya majaribio, lakini baadaye ikabainika kuwa ukaguzi huo ulihitaji kuthibitishwa na fundi mwenye leseni ya A&P, jambo ambalo halikufanyika. Wakati wa safari iliyofuata, injini ilipoteza nguvu na ndege ikaharibika wakati wa kutua, ingawa hakuna majeraha yaliyotokea. Inahitajika ufuatiliaji wa haraka kuangalia hati za ukaguzi, kuchunguza kama tatizo la injini lilitokana na ukaguzi usiothibitishwa, na kuhakikisha taratibu sahihi za uthibitisho wa fundi zinafuatwa kabla ya safari nyingine.
summary: Ukaguzi wa ndege ya majaribio ulifanywa na mmiliki bila idhini ya fundi mwenye leseni, na baadaye injini ilipoteza nguvu, hali iliyosababisha uharibifu wakati wa kutua.

narrative_text: Huyu owner wa hiyo experimental aircraft alifanya ile condition inspection mwenyewe, akidhani ni sawa kwa sababu ni experimental, lakini baadaye ikaonekana ilihitajika A&P mechanic sign-off ambayo haikuwahi kufanywa. Baadaye wakati wa flight, engine ikaloss power na aircraft ikapata damage wakati wa landing, ingawa hakuna injuries. Tunahitaji kufuatilia maintenance records, kuangalia kama hiyo power loss inahusiana na ile inspection isiyo-signed, na ku-confirm proper sign-off procedures kabla ya flight nyingine.
summary: Owner alifanya condition inspection bila A&P sign-off kwenye experimental aircraft, halafu engine ika-lose power ikasababisha damage wakati wa landing.

narrative_text: At Parts Receiving, found a box of PSU panels with O2 generators that the storekeeper wanted to bin directly without inspection tags, saying the system allows this. Stock balance actually shows a generic 180-month shelf life instead of the required 999 code, which means the actual generator shelf life (12 or 15 years depending on part number) was never verified against the Work Order notes. Parts are on hold pending Lead/Inspector review; someone changed the tag status to Y overnight but shelf life field still needs correction before these PSU panels can be released to stock or aircraft.
summary: PSU panels with O2 generators were nearly binned without proper HAZMAT shelf-life tagging, and follow-up is needed to verify correct expiry dates before release.

narrative_text: Kwenye eneo la kupokea vipuri, tulikuta boksi la paneli za PSU zenye vizalishi vya O2 ambazo mfanyakazi wa stoo alitaka kuziweka moja kwa moja kwenye bini bila lebo za ukaguzi, akisema mfumo wa kompyuta unaruhusu hivyo. Rekodi ya stoo inaonyesha muda wa matumizi wa miezi 180 badala ya msimbo sahihi wa 999, hivyo muda halisi wa matumizi wa vizalishi vya O2 (miaka 12 au 15 kutegemea namba ya sehemu) haujathibitishwa kwa kuangalia maelezo ya Work Order. Vipuri vimesimamishwa vikisubiri ukaguzi wa Lead na Inspector; lebo ilibadilishwa usiku kucha lakini sehemu ya muda wa matumizi bado inahitaji kurekebishwa kabla ya kutolewa stoo au kwa ndege.
summary: Paneli za PSU zenye vizalishi vya O2 zilikaribia kuwekwa binini bila lebo sahihi za ukaguzi wa HAZMAT, hivyo ufuatiliaji unahitajika kuthibitisha muda sahihi wa matumizi kabla ya kutolewa.

narrative_text: Kwa Parts Receiving, nilikuta box ya PSU panels zenye O2 generators ambazo storekeeper alitaka aziweke bin direct bila inspection tags, akisema system inaruhusu hivyo. Stock balance inaonyesha shelf life ya generic 180 months instead ya ile 999 code inayotakiwa, so hatujathibitisha shelf life halisi ya hizo generators (inaweza kuwa 12 or 15 years kutegemea part number) kutoka kwa Work Order notes. Parts ziko on hold zikisubiri Lead na Inspector wa-review; tag status ilibadilishwa overnight kuwa Y lakini shelf life field bado inahitaji kufix kabla ya kurelease hizo PSU panels kwa stock ama plane.
summary: PSU panels zenye O2 generators zilikaribia ku-bin bila proper HAZMAT tags, so follow-up inahitajika kuconfirm shelf life sahihi kabla ya release.

narrative_text: During the 100-hour inspection on the CRJ200 (Ref X), the left-hand landing gear uplock roller was found not moving freely, so the uplock brackets and roller pin were replaced per the CMM. It was later discovered the uplock brackets were mistakenly installed upside down. Next shift must perform a full gear swing before release to confirm correct installation and free movement of the uplock roller.
summary: Incorrectly installed (upside-down) left landing gear uplock brackets on a CRJ200 require a gear swing check before the aircraft can be released.

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa saa mia moja kwenye ndege ya CRJ200 (Ref X), roller ya uplock kwenye gia ya kutua upande wa kushoto ilionekana haisogei vizuri, hivyo brackets za uplock pamoja na pin ya roller zilibadilishwa kufuatana na CMM. Baadaye ilibainika kuwa brackets za uplock ziliwekwa kimakosa zikiwa zimegeuzwa chini juu. Zamu inayofuata inapaswa kufanya gear swing kikamilifu kabla ya kuiruhusu ndege kuruka, ili kuhakikisha ufungaji ni sahihi na roller inasogea kama inavyotakiwa.
summary: Brackets za uplock kwenye gia ya kutua upande wa kushoto wa ndege ya CRJ200 ziliwekwa kimakosa hivyo gear swing inahitajika kabla ya kuruhusu ndege.

entities.text: gia ya kutua upande wa kushoto

narrative_text: Wakati wa 100-hour inspection kwenye CRJ200 (Ref X), tuligundua left-hand landing gear uplock roller haiku-move freely kama inavyotakiwa, so tuli-replace uplock brackets na roller pin kama CMM inavyosema. Lakini turns out brackets za uplock zili-install upside down bila kukusudia. Zamu inayofuata lazima ifanye gear swing kabla ya release, kuhakikisha installation ni sahihi na roller inasogea properly.
summary: Uplock brackets kwenye left landing gear ya CRJ200 zili-install upside down, hivyo gear swing inahitajika before release.

narrative_text: On the B737-900 in the hangar, panels 195BL and 195CL were removed to gain access to two fasteners requiring cleanup; dry sanding did not fully clear the surface, and a Dremel tool was then used, which removed some surrounding material beyond the intended area. Work stopped immediately and the inspector was consulted to confirm the correct surface condition, then the lead was notified for direction on next steps. Follow-up needed: inspector/lead to assess extent of damage on the fasteners and surrounding surface, confirm rework or part replacement, and review work card instructions and drawings for clarity before further attempts.
summary: Excess material was inadvertently removed from fasteners near panels 195BL/195CL on a B737-900 during a cleanup task using a Dremel tool, requiring inspector and lead review before proceeding.

narrative_text: Katika ndege ya B737-900 ndani ya hangar, paneli namba 195BL na 195CL ziliondolewa ili kupata nafasi ya kusafisha volti mbili zilizohitaji kazi. Njia ya kusugua kwa mkono haikufanya kazi vizuri, hivyo chombo cha Dremel kilitumika, na wakati wa kazi hiyo sehemu ya uso isiyokusudiwa iliondolewa kimakosa. Kazi ilisimamishwa mara moja, mkaguzi akashauriwa kuthibitisha hali sahihi ya uso, kisha kiongozi wa zamu akaarifiwa ili kupata maelekezo ya hatua ijayo. Inahitajika ufuatiliaji: mkaguzi na kiongozi wachunguze kiwango cha uharibifu kwenye volti na eneo la jirani, wathibitishe kama sehemu zinahitaji kutengenezwa upya au kubadilishwa, na kaadi za kazi pamoja na michoro zifafanuliwe zaidi kwa kazi za baadaye.
summary: Sehemu ya uso isiyokusudiwa iliondolewa kimakosa karibu na volti kwenye paneli 195BL/195CL za B737-900 wakati wa kazi ya kusafisha kwa kutumia Dremel, hivyo mkaguzi na kiongozi wanahitajika kuchunguza kabla ya hatua zaidi.

narrative_text: Kwa ile B737-900 iko hangar, tulitoa panels 195BL na 195CL ili tupate access kwa hizo fasteners mbili zenye zilihitaji kusafishwa. Dry sanding haikufanya kazi poa, so tukatumia Dremel tool, lakini in the process kuna surface ambayo haikutakikana kuguswa ikaanza kutoka. Nilistop kazi immediately, nikaenda kwa inspector kuconfirm surface inasupposed kuwa vipi, then nikatafuta lead kupata guidance ya next steps. Follow-up inahitajika: inspector na lead wacheck extent ya damage kwa fasteners na surface ya jirani, waconfirm kama rework au part replacement inahitajika, na work card pamoja na drawings ziwe clear zaidi before attempt ingine.
summary: Kuna surface ambayo ilitoka bila kutakikana karibu na fasteners kwa panels 195BL/195CL za B737-900 wakati wa kazi ya kusafisha na Dremel tool, so inspector na lead wanahitajika kufanya review kabla ya kuendelea.

narrative_text: During receiving, a stores clerk flagged a squib cartridge (hazmat 1.4 explosive) that should have required tagging with a washer stamp and wire for shelf-life/date code tracking, but the inspector finalized the transaction without applying it, relying only on the software prompt and paperwork match. A second inspector confirmed tagging was in fact required, and confusion appears linked to the software showing an inspect/tag mismatch versus a similar cargo extinguisher bottle cartridge part number. The item has been pulled to the supervisor's office for review; next shift needs to confirm correct tagging procedure for this part number and verify no other units were released without proper shelf-life tagging, since supervision reportedly knew of this discrepancy for days without briefing receiving inspectors.
summary: A squib cartridge was released from receiving without required shelf-life tagging due to a software inspect/tag mismatch, and supervision had not briefed inspectors despite knowing of the issue for days.

entities.text: tagging with a washer stamp and wire

narrative_text: Wakati wa kupokea vipuri, karani wa stoo aligundua cartridge ya squib (hazmat 1.4, kilipuzi) ambayo ilipaswa kuwekwa alama ya washer na waya kwa ajili ya kufuatilia tarehe ya matumizi, lakini mkaguzi alimaliza mchakato bila kufanya hivyo, akitegemea tu mfumo wa kompyuta na ulinganifu wa hati. Mkaguzi mwingine alithibitisha kuwa alama hiyo ilihitajika, na inaonekana mkanganyiko ulitokana na mfumo wa kompyuta kuonyesha maelekezo tofauti kati ya kipuri hiki na kipuri kingine kinachofanana cha chupa ya kuzimia moto ya mizigo. Kipuri hicho kimechukuliwa hadi ofisi ya msimamizi kwa uchunguzi zaidi; zamu inayofuata inahitaji kuthibitisha utaratibu sahihi wa kuweka alama kwa nambari hii ya kipuri na kuhakikisha hakuna vipuri vingine vilivyotolewa bila alama sahihi, kwani usimamizi ulijua tatizo hili kwa siku kadhaa bila kuwaeleza wakaguzi wa upokeaji.
summary: Cartridge ya squib ilitolewa kutoka stoo bila alama ya lazima ya tarehe ya matumizi kwa sababu ya mkanganyiko wa mfumo wa kompyuta, na usimamizi haukuwahi kuwaeleza wakaguzi licha ya kujua tatizo hilo kwa siku kadhaa.

entities.text: kuweka alama ya washer na waya
chupa ya kuzimia moto ya mizigo

narrative_text: Wakati wa receiving, stores clerk alinotice squib cartridge (hazmat 1.4 explosive) ambayo ilisupposed kuwekwa tag ya washer stamp na wire kwa shelf-life tracking, lakini inspector aliifinalize bila kufanya hivyo, akitegemea tu system prompt na paperwork match. Inspector mwingine aliconfirm kwamba tagging ilikua required, na confusion inaonekana ilitoka kwa software kuonyesha inspect/tag mismatch kati ya hii part na cartridge nyingine ya cargo ext bottle inayofanana. Item hiyo imeshapelekwa supervisor's office for review; next shift inahitaji kuconfirm correct tagging procedure kwa part number hii na kuverify hakuna units zingine zilizoreleased bila proper tagging, kwa sababu supervision walijua issue hii kwa siku kadhaa bila kubrief inspectors wa receiving.
summary: Squib cartridge ilireleased bila required shelf-life tagging kutokana na software mismatch, na supervision hawakubrief inspectors ingawa walijua issue hii kwa siku kadhaa.

entities.text: tag ya washer stamp na wire

narrative_text: On Aircraft X, both flight deck escape rope compartments were found open prior to departure, with the ropes hanging loose. Technicians discovered that neither rope was actually attached to the airframe, and both were missing cotter pins on the anchor plates, meaning neither would have functioned in an emergency. Next shift please review the task cards for dual maintenance on escape ropes and confirm correct installation on any aircraft that went through the same work package.
summary: Both flight deck escape ropes on Aircraft X were found unattached and missing cotter pins, rendering them unusable in an emergency, requiring a review of related maintenance task cards.

entities.text: task cards for dual maintenance on escape ropes

narrative_text: Kwenye Ndege X, sehemu zote mbili za kuhifadhi kamba za kutorokea dharura kwenye chumba cha marubani zilipatikana zikiwa wazi kabla ya safari kuanza, huku kamba zikining'inia bila kufungwa. Mafundi walibaini kuwa kamba hizo hazikuwa zimeunganishwa kwenye mwili wa ndege, na pini za nondo (cotter pins) hazikuwepo kwenye vibao vya nanga, hali iliyomaanisha kuwa kamba hizo zisingeweza kutumika endapo dharura ingetokea. Zamu inayofuata iangalie tena kadi za kazi za matengenezo yanayohusisha watu wawili kwa kamba za dharura na kuhakikisha ufungaji sahihi kwenye ndege nyingine zilizofanyiwa kazi sawa.
summary: Kamba mbili za kutorokea dharura kwenye Ndege X zilipatikana hazijafungwa vizuri na hazina pini za nondo, hali iliyozifanya zisiweze kutumika dharura ikitokea, hivyo kadi za kazi zinahitaji kukaguliwa upya.

entities.text: sehemu zote mbili za kuhifadhi kamba za kutorokea dharura
kadi za kazi za matengenezo yanayohusisha watu wawili

narrative_text: Kwa Aircraft X, zile escape rope compartments mbili za flight deck zilipatikana zi-open before departure, kamba zikiwa zinadangling tu. Technicians walikuja kukuta kwamba ropes hazikuwa attached kwenye airframe, na cotter pins hazikuwepo kwenye anchor plates, so hizo ropes zisingeweza kufanya kazi in case ya emergency. Shift inayofuata i-review zile task cards za dual maintenance kwa escape ropes na icheki kama installation iko sawa kwenye ndege zingine zilizopitia hiyo hiyo work package.
summary: Escape ropes mbili za Aircraft X zilipatikana hazija-attach na hazina cotter pins, so haziwezi kufanya kazi emergency ikitokea, hivyo task cards zinahitaji ku-reviewiwa.

narrative_text: While performing work card XX-XX-XX in the hangar, the aircraft nose rolled off the spot 3 center line and moved about 14 ft before contacting a scissor lift; it was re-chocked afterward. Likely causes include improperly positioned or worn nose wheel chocks, released parking brake accumulator pressure, and slope in the hangar floor. Next shift please ensure all three landing gear wheels are chocked per revised procedure, and flag the work card for a caution note update regarding brake accumulator pressure during chocking.
summary: Aircraft nose rolled off its hangar spot during maintenance due to chocking and brake accumulator issues, requiring procedure review.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kufanya kazi ya work card XX-XX-XX ndani ya hangar, sehemu ya mbele ya ndege ilitoka kwenye alama ya spot 3 na kusogea takribani futi 14 kabla ya kugonga scissor lift; baadaye ilirekebishwa kwa chocks. Chanzo kinachowezekana ni chocks za tairi la mbele kutowekwa vizuri au kuchakaa, pamoja na shinikizo la parking brake accumulator lililokuwa limetolewa, na pia mteremko wa sakafu ya hangar. Shift inayokuja tafadhali ihakikishe magurudumu yote matatu ya landing gear yamewekwa chocks kulingana na taratibu mpya, na kupendekeza kuongezwa maelezo ya tahadhari kwenye work card kuhusu shinikizo la brake accumulator wakati wa kuweka chocks.
summary: Sehemu ya mbele ya ndege ilitoka mahali pake wakati wa matengenezo hangarini kutokana na tatizo la chocks na shinikizo la brake accumulator, hali inayohitaji marekebisho ya taratibu.

narrative_text: Wakati tunafanya ile work card XX-XX-XX huko hangar, nose ya aircraft ilitoka kwenye spot 3 center line ikasogea kama 14 ft mpaka ikagonga scissor lift, tukairudisha na kuiweka chocks tena. Inawezekana chocks za nose wheel hazikuwa positioned properly au zimechakaa, plus parking brake accumulator pressure ilikuwa released, na floor ya hangar pia ina slope kidogo. Kwa next shift, hakikisheni landing gear zote tatu zime-chock as per updated procedure, na tupendekeze caution note iwekwe kwenye work card kuhusu hatari ya accumulator pressure wakati wa chocking.
summary: Nose ya aircraft ilitoka spot 3 wakati wa maintenance kwa sababu ya chocking issue na brake accumulator pressure, hivyo procedure inahitaji update.

narrative_text: During marshalling of a B787 into the gate this evening, a Company maintenance pickup truck cut into the safety area from the right side, passing very close behind the wing walker and under the jet bridge cab before parking near the maintenance offices. This occurred while the aircraft was still taxiing in, creating a serious ramp safety hazard. Please follow up with ramp supervision and maintenance dispatch to reinforce safety-area clearance procedures during active gate arrivals.
summary: A maintenance vehicle entered the safety area and passed close to ground crew while a B787 was being marshalled into the gate, posing a ramp safety hazard.

narrative_text: Wakati ndege ya B787 ikiwa inaelekezwa kwenye geti jioni ya leo, gari la matengenezo la kampuni liliingia eneo la usalama kutoka upande wa kulia, likipita karibu sana na mfanyakazi aliyekuwa akisaidia kuelekeza ndege, kisha likapitia chini ya sehemu ya jet bridge kabla ya kuegesha karibu na ofisi za matengenezo. Hali hii ilitokea wakati ndege bado ikiwa inasogea kuelekea geti, jambo lililoleta hatari kubwa ya kiusalama eneo la apron. Tafadhali fuatilia na wasimamizi wa apron na idara ya matengenezo ili kuimarisha taratibu za kuheshimu eneo la usalama wakati ndege zinapoingia geti.
summary: Gari la matengenezo liliingia eneo la usalama na kupita karibu na wafanyakazi wakati ndege ya B787 ikielekezwa kwenye geti, na kusababisha hatari ya kiusalama.

narrative_text: So leo jioni tulikuwa tuna-marshal B787 ikiingia gate, halafu maintenance pickup ikatokea kulia ikaingia kwa safety area, ikapita very close nyuma ya yule wing walker, ikapitia chini ya jet bridge cab kabla ya kuparki karibu na maintenance offices. Hii ilitokea wakati aircraft ilikuwa bado inasogea in, so ni real safety concern kwa ramp. Tafadhali fuatilia na ramp supervisor pamoja na maintenance dispatch ili wa-reinforce vizuri clearance procedures za safety area during active gate arrivals.
summary: Maintenance pickup iliingia safety area na kupita karibu na wing walker wakati B787 ikiwa inaelekezwa gate, ikileta safety hazard kwenye ramp.

narrative_text: During the scheduled check on the B757, the body torque tube install inspection was signed off for one of the doors after discrepancies were found at the vendor facility the day before. Both L4 and R4 door assist actuator B-nuts were found disconnected on the pneumatic lines, with red streamers still attached, discovered when sidewall panels forward of the L4/R4 door cutouts were removed. Given the time elapsed since the original event, the exact cause could not be confirmed, but overlapping maintenance tasks or a missed step are suspected; incoming crew should verify B-nut installation and torque tube inspection sign-off before further dispatch.
summary: Disconnected B-nuts with streamers still attached were found on both L4 and R4 door assist actuators during a scheduled check, and the cause remains unconfirmed due to elapsed time, requiring follow-up verification.

entities.text: L4 and R4 door assist actuator B-nuts

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa kawaida wa ndege ya B757, ukaguzi wa ufungaji wa body torque tube ulisainiwa kwa mlango mmoja baada ya matatizo kugundulika kwa kampuni ya nje siku moja kabla. Nati za B (B-nuts) za actuator za milango ya L4 na R4 zilikutwa zikiwa hazijaunganishwa kwenye mabomba ya pneumatic, huku streamer nyekundu zikiwa bado zimefungwa, hali iliyogunduliwa baada ya paneli za pembeni mbele ya milango ya L4 na R4 kuondolewa. Kwa sababu ya muda mrefu uliopita tangu tukio hilo la awali, chanzo halisi cha tatizo hakikuweza kuthibitishwa, lakini inashukiwa kazi za matengenezo zilizofanyika kwa wakati mmoja au hatua iliyosahaulika; zamu inayofuata inashauriwa kuthibitisha ufungaji wa nati za B na saini ya ukaguzi kabla ya safari nyingine.
summary: Nati za B zilizotenganishwa pamoja na streamer bado zikiwa zimefungwa ziligunduliwa kwenye actuator za milango ya L4 na R4 wakati wa ukaguzi, na chanzo cha tatizo hakijathibitishwa kutokana na muda mrefu uliopita.

entities.text: Nati za B (B-nuts) za actuator za milango ya L4 na R4

narrative_text: So during hii scheduled check ya B757, nilisign off ile install inspection ya body torque tube kwa moja ya doors, baada ya discrepancies kupatikana kwa vendor siku moja kabla. Both L4 na R4 door assist actuator B-nuts zilikutwa disconnected kwenye pneumatic lines, na red streamers bado zimebaki attached, ilionekana baada ya sidewall panels forward ya L4/R4 cutouts kutolewa. Kwa sababu ya muda umepita sana tangu ile event ya awali, sijaweza kuconfirm exact cause, but tunasuspect overlapping maintenance tasks ama step iliyoskip; next shift wachek B-nut installation na torque tube sign-off kabla ya kuendelea na dispatch.
summary: Walipata B-nuts disconnected na streamers bado attached kwenye L4 na R4 door assist actuators during check, so next shift inafaa iverify installation kwa sababu cause bado haijaconfirm.

entities.text: L4 na R4 door assist actuator B-nuts

narrative_text: During scheduled lube task on the A300 slat/ball screw and roller assy (both wings, per AMM ref), all panels were opened, serviced, and closed correctly by the sole technician on shift. Aircraft departed ZZZ1-ZZZ Day 3 night, and post-flight walk-around found two inboard leading edge panels missing; field service confirmed all hardware remained intact at the panel location. Suspect a missing/damaged bracket allowed the outboard panel to tuck under and depart with the adjacent one - other aircraft may have same defect, please flag for fleet-wide bracket inspection.
summary: Two inboard leading edge panels were lost in flight on the A300 after scheduled slat lube task, likely due to a missing/damaged bracket rather than technician error, requiring fleet inspection.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kazi ya kawaida ya lubrication kwenye slat na ball screw ya ndege ya A300, mafundi walifungua paneli za mabawa yote mawili, wakafanya kazi kama AMM inavyoelekeza, kisha wakafunga vizuri. Ndege ilitoka ZZZ1 kwenda ZZZ usiku wa siku ya tatu, na baada ya kutua, ukaguzi ulionyesha paneli mbili za leading edge sehemu ya ndani zimepotea angani. Timu ya field service ilithibitisha kuwa vifaa vyote vilikuwa vimewekwa sawa mahali ambapo paneli ilitoka, hivyo tunashuku bracket iliyopotea au kuharibika ndiyo iliyosababisha paneli kutoka na kuvuta nyingine pamoja nayo - jambo hili linahitaji kuangaliwa kwa ndege nyingine pia.
summary: Paneli mbili za leading edge za ndege ya A300 zilipotea angani baada ya kazi ya lubrication, na inashukiwa tatizo la bracket badala ya kosa la fundi, hivyo ukaguzi wa meli nzima unahitajika.

narrative_text: Tulikuwa tuna-perform scheduled lube task kwa slat na ball screw nut ya A300, mabawa yote mawili, nilikuwa peke yangu so nikaopen panels, nika-lube kama AMM inavyosema, nikaclose access properly. Ndege ilideparture from ZZZ1 to ZZZ usiku wa Day 3, then after landing during walk-around pilot alireport panels mbili za inboard leading edge zimepotea kabisa. Field service walienda ku-verify na wakakuta hardware zote ziko installed sawa mahali panel ilitoka, so tunasuspect ni bracket iko missing au damaged ndiyo ilisababisha panel kutuck chini ya ile ingine na zote mbili zikaondoka - please flag hii for other aircraft pia coz inaweza kuwa fleet-wide issue.
summary: Panels mbili za leading edge za A300 zilipotea mid-flight baada ya lube task, inaonekana ni bracket issue si error ya fundi, so inahitaji follow-up kwa fleet nzima.

entities.text: panels mbili za inboard leading edge

narrative_text: During the hangar swap to set up Aircraft X for RON work, Aircraft Y was towed out of the south hangar and Aircraft X was marshalled in deep to allow two narrow body aircraft to park behind it. As the guide man watched clearance at the #1 engine nose cowl, the Lead Technician slowed the tow but a popping sound was heard, and the radome of Aircraft X was found resting on the leading edge of Aircraft Z's left wing. Aircraft X was pushed back immediately and chocked, tow bar disconnected, and power/entry stand positioned; maintenance to inspect both aircraft for damage and review wing-walker/guide-man positioning before next hangar move.
summary: During a hangar repositioning move, Aircraft X's radome contacted the left wing leading edge of Aircraft Z due to inadequate clearance monitoring by the guide man.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kuhamisha ndege hangarini kuandaa Ndege X kwa kazi za RON, Ndege Y ilivutwa kutoka hangar ya kusini ili Ndege X iingizwe ndani zaidi, ikiwa nafasi ya kuegesha ndege mbili za narrow body nyuma yake. Fundi msimamizi alipunguza kasi ya kuvuta ndege huku mwongozaji akiwa mbele akiangalia nafasi kati ya nose cowl ya injini namba moja na eneo la radome, lakini sauti ya kudundika ilisikika na ikagundulika radome ya Ndege X imegusa ukingo wa mbele wa bawa la kushoto la Ndege Z. Ndege X ilisukumwa nyuma mara moja, magurudumu yakawekewa vizuizi, tow bar ikatolewa na stendi ya kuingilia ikawekwa; ukaguzi wa uharibifu kwa ndege zote mbili unahitajika, pamoja na mapitio ya nafasi za wafanyakazi wa kuongoza mabawa kabla ya kuhamisha ndege nyingine hangarini.
summary: Wakati wa kuhamisha ndege hangarini, radome ya Ndege X iligusa ukingo wa bawa la kushoto la Ndege Z kutokana na ufuatiliaji hafifu wa nafasi na mwongozaji.

entities.text: nose cowl ya injini namba moja

narrative_text: Tulikuwa tuna-move Aircraft X kuingia hangar deep kwa ajili ya RON work, so tukatoa kwanza Aircraft Y kutoka south hangar ndio kuwe na nafasi. Lead Technician alikuwa akimarshal, mimi kama guide man nikaenda front kuangalia clearance kati ya #1 engine nose cowl na radome ya Aircraft Z, lakini akapunguza speed kidogo tu na tukasikia popping sound - tukageuka tukaona radome ya Aircraft X imekaa juu ya leading edge ya left wing ya Aircraft Z. Tukapush back mara moja, tukaweka chocks, kutoa tow bar na ku-position power na entry stand; tunahitaji damage inspection kwa hizo aircraft zote mbili na turudi tu-review positioning ya wing walkers kabla ya move ingine yoyote hangarini.
summary: Wakati wa kufanya hangar move, radome ya Aircraft X iligonga leading edge ya left wing ya Aircraft Z kwa sababu guide man hakuwa na enough situational awareness kwa clearance.

narrative_text: A321 (Ref X) had an air interrupt while parked and lost the green hydraulic system, requiring manual gear deployment; the outstanding EO covering this exact hydraulic failure mode had still not been accomplished on this tail. Management deferred the EO again, citing downtime concerns, even after this failure demonstrated the risk it was written to prevent. Next shift must escalate EO compliance on this aircraft and check fleet-wide status before further dispatch.
summary: A321 suffered a green hydraulic system failure requiring manual gear extension because a known EO addressing this exact fault had not been accomplished, and management again deferred the fix.

narrative_text: Ndege ya A321 ilipata hitilafu ya hewa ikiwa imeegeshwa, na mfumo wa hydraulic wa green ukashindwa kabisa, hivyo timu ililazimika kuteremsha gear kwa mkono. EO iliyotolewa kushughulikia hitilafu hii mahususi ilikuwa bado haijafanyiwa kazi kwenye ndege hii, na hata baada ya tukio hili, uongozi uliahirisha tena EO kwa sababu ya muda itakaochukua. Zamu inayofuata inapaswa kufuatilia kwa haraka utekelezaji wa EO hii na kuhakikisha ndege nyingine zenye tatizo kama hili hazijaachwa bila kufanyiwa kazi.
summary: Ndege ya A321 ilipoteza mfumo wa hydraulic wa green na kulazimika kuteremsha gear kwa mkono kwa sababu EO muhimu haikutekelezwa, na uongozi uliahirisha tena marekebisho.

narrative_text: Ile A321 ilipata air interrupt ikiwa parked, na tukapoteza green hydraulic system kabisa, so team ilibidi ideploy gear manually. Ile EO ambayo inaaddress exactly hii failure bado haija-accomplish kwa hii tail, na management wameahirisha tena wakisema itachukua muda mrefu. Zamu inayofuata lazima ifuatilie hii EO compliance na kucheck fleet-wide status kabla ya dispatch yoyote ijayo.
summary: A321 ilipoteza green hydraulic system na ikabidi gear ideployiwe manually kwa sababu EO muhimu bado haijafanywa, management wakiahirisha tena.

narrative_text: Prior to departure, #3 and #4 MLG tires on the B737 MAX 8 had to be replaced after #4 wheel assembly was found with low tire pressure. Root cause was traced to the valve stem on the #4 MLG wheel not being torqued properly in the back shop, so loose it separated when the valve core tool was removed. Next shift please flag this for a back-shop audit and confirm whether torque stripes and valve stem safety measures can be added as a standing inspection item, since the MAX MLG wheel design has no safety wire on the stem.
summary: Low tire pressure on B737 MAX 8 #4 MLG traced to an improperly torqued valve stem from the back shop, requiring tire changes and follow-up audit/inspection action.

narrative_text: Kabla ya ndege kuondoka, matairi ya #3 na #4 MLG ya B737 MAX 8 yalilazimika kubadilishwa baada ya kugundulika hewa ya tairi la #4 imeshuka sana. Chanzo kilibainika kuwa valve stem ya gurudumu la #4 haikubanwa (torque) vizuri wakati wa kazi ya back shop, hivyo ikawa huru mno na ikatoka wakati zana ya kuondoa valve core ilipotumika. Zamu inayofuata tafadhali fuatilieni suala hili kwa ukaguzi wa back shop na muangalie kama inawezekana kuweka alama ya torque na hatua za usalama za valve stem kama sehemu ya ukaguzi wa kudumu, kwani muundo wa gurudumu la MLG la ndege hii haina waya wa usalama kwenye valve stem.
summary: Tatizo la hewa kushuka kwenye tairi la #4 MLG la B737 MAX 8 lilitokana na valve stem isiyobanwa vizuri kutoka back shop, hivyo kuhitaji ukaguzi na hatua za ziada za usalama.

narrative_text: Before departure tulilazimika kubadilisha #3 na #4 MLG tires kwa hii B737 MAX 8 baada ya kugundua #4 wheel assembly ina low tire pressure. Iligundulika kuwa valve stem ya #4 MLG haikuwa torqued vizuri na back shop, ikawa loose sana mpaka ikatoka wakati wa kutoa valve core tool. So next shift please fuatilieni hii issue, tunahitaji audit ya back shop na tuone kama tunaweza kuongeza torque stripe na some safety measure kwa valve stem, kwani design ya MAX MLG wheels haina safety wire kabisa.
summary: Low tire pressure kwenye #4 MLG ya B737 MAX 8 ilitokana na valve stem isiyo-torqued vizuri from back shop, hivyo kuhitaji audit na safety follow-up.

narrative_text: During tow-in from the gate to the hangar, Aircraft X's left winglet contacted Aircraft Y's right winglet while being guided by the marshaller at the lead-in line; the marshaller believed clearance was adequate but a jolt was felt just before the stop signal was given. Flight deck crew set brakes, shut down both engines, and notified Ramp Control and the supervisor once contact was suspected. Post-shutdown inspection confirmed winglet-to-winglet and strakelet-to-strakelet contact; area has been secured pending damage assessment. Follow-up needed: coordinate with maintenance to inspect both aircraft, review marshalling clearance procedures, and debrief flight deck/ground communication breakdown.
summary: Winglet-to-winglet contact occurred between two aircraft during a hangar tow-in due to a marshalling clearance misjudgment, requiring inspection and procedural review.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kuvuta ndege kutoka geti hadi hangarini, ncha ya bawa la kushoto la Ndege X iligusana na ncha ya bawa la kulia la Ndege Y wakati zikiongozwa na marshaller kwenye mstari wa kuingilia; marshaller alidhani nafasi ilikuwa ya kutosha lakini wafanyakazi wa ndani ya ndege walihisi mtikisiko kabla ya ishara ya kusimama kutolewa. Wafanyakazi wa flight deck waliweka breki, wakazima injini zote mbili, na kuwajulisha Ramp Control pamoja na msimamizi mara tu waliposhuku mgusano huo. Ukaguzi baada ya kuzima ulithibitisha mgusano wa ncha za mabawa na strakelet, na eneo limefungwa likisubiri tathmini ya uharibifu. Inahitajika ufuatiliaji: kuratibu na idara ya matengenezo kukagua ndege zote mbili, kupitia taratibu za umbali wa usalama wakati wa uongozaji, na kufanya mazungumzo ya kina kuhusu mawasiliano baina ya flight deck na wafanyakazi wa ardhini.
summary: Mgusano wa ncha za mabawa ulitokea kati ya ndege mbili wakati wa kuvutwa kuelekea hangarini kutokana na makadirio mabaya ya nafasi na marshaller, hivyo ukaguzi na mapitio ya taratibu yanahitajika.

narrative_text: Wakati wa tow-in kutoka gate kwenda hangar, left winglet ya Aircraft X iligonga right winglet ya Aircraft Y wakati marshaller alikuwa akiongoza kwenye lead-in line; marshaller alidhani clearance ilikuwa sawa lakini crew walisikia jolt kidogo before stop signal ipewe. Flight deck crew waliweka brakes, wakazima both engines, halafu wakanotify Ramp Control na supervisor mara tu waliposhuku kuna contact imetokea. Baada ya shutdown, inspection ilithibitisha winglet-to-winglet na strakelet-to-strakelet contact, so area imesecure ikisubiri damage assessment. Follow-up inahitajika: coordinate na maintenance wakague both aircraft, review procedures za marshalling clearance, na debrief kuhusu communication breakdown kati ya flight deck na ground personnel.
summary: Kuliwa na winglet-to-winglet contact kati ya ndege mbili during hangar tow-in kwa sababu ya marshalling clearance error, so inspection na procedure review zinahitajika.

narrative_text: B767 #1 engine was reactivated to allow sheet metal access for a separate deferred item, and thrust reverser deploy/stow was checked normally during that time. The original PIREP was closed based on that check, but this MEL was tied to the #1 engine High Pressure Shut-Off Valve MEL and should not have been closed independently. Next shift please verify MEL status on #1 engine HP shutoff valve before further dispatch and re-open the log if needed.
summary: Technician closed a thrust reverser log tied to the #1 engine HP Shut-Off Valve MEL without noticing the linkage, requiring MEL status verification before next dispatch.

narrative_text: Injini namba 1 ya B767 iliwashwa upya ili kuruhusu ufikiaji wa sehemu ya sheet metal kwa ajili ya kazi nyingine iliyoahirishwa, na wakati huo ilionekana thrust reverser inafanya kazi vizuri ikitoka na kurudi kawaida. Ripoti ya awali ilifungwa kwa msingi wa ukaguzi huo, lakini MEL hiyo ilihusiana moja kwa moja na High Pressure Shut-Off Valve ya injini namba 1 na haikupaswa kufungwa peke yake. Shift inayofuata iangalie hali ya MEL ya valve hiyo kabla ya ndege kuruhusiwa kuondoka, na kufungua tena log kama inahitajika.
summary: Fundi alifunga log ya thrust reverser iliyokuwa imeunganishwa na MEL ya High Pressure Shut-Off Valve bila kutambua uhusiano huo, hivyo inahitajika ukaguzi wa hali ya MEL kabla ya safari inayofuata.

entities.text: ufikiaji wa sehemu ya sheet metal

narrative_text: Tuli-reactivate #1 engine ya B767 ili kupata access ya sheet metal kwa ile deferred item, na wakati huo thrust reverser ilikuwa inadeploy na kustow normally so tukafunga ile PIREP ya awali. Lakini turns out ile log ilikuwa tied to the #1 engine High Pressure Shut-Off Valve MEL, so haikupaswa kufungwa separately kama tulivyofanya. Next shift please recheck MEL status ya HP shutoff valve kabla ya dispatch, na ku-reopen log kama inahitajika.
summary: Fundi alifunga log ya thrust reverser bila kutambua ilikuwa linked na MEL ya HP Shut-Off Valve, kwa hiyo MEL status inahitaji kucheckwa kabla ya next dispatch.

narrative_text: During the PS check on the A321 both engine IDGs were found low on oil and were serviced by the team using the green oil cart, with levels visually confirmed within limits by two technicians afterward. On the next flight the crew received an IDG over-temperature message, and post-flight troubleshooting found reddish fluid in one IDG, raising concern the servicing cart may have been contaminated or mislabeled. A fluid sample has been sent for lab analysis; next shift please follow up on results and hold the oil cart in question out of service pending confirmation.
summary: Suspected contamination of IDG servicing oil on an A321 triggered an in-flight over-temperature warning, and a fluid sample is pending lab analysis.

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa PS kwa ndege ya A321, IDG za injini zote mbili zilionekana mafuta ni chini ya kiwango kinachotakiwa, na mafundi walizihudumia kwa kutumia trolley ya mafuta ya kijani baada ya kuthibitisha kiwango kwa macho. Baada ya safari iliyofuata, wafanyakazi wa ndege waliona ujumbe wa joto kali kwenye IDG, na uchunguzi wa baadaye ulibaini kioevu chenye rangi nyekundu ndani ya IDG moja, jambo linaloashiria huenda trolley ya kuhudumia ilikuwa na uchafuzi au lebo isiyo sahihi. Sampuli ya kioevu imetumwa kwa uchunguzi wa maabara, hivyo zamu inayofuata ihakikishe inafuatilia matokeo na trolley husika ibaki nje ya matumizi hadi uthibitisho upatikane.
summary: Uchafuzi unaoshukiwa wa mafuta ya kuhudumia IDG kwenye ndege ya A321 ulisababisha onyo la joto kali angani, na sampuli ya kioevu inasubiri matokeo ya maabara.

narrative_text: Ju ya PS check ya A321, engines zote mbili IDG zilikuwa low kwa oil, so tukaservice na yale green cart, na after servicing wale watu wawili wakaconfirm level iko within limits. Lakini after flight, crew waliona IDG temperature message ikiwa too high, so wakati wa troubleshooting wakapata reddish fluid ndani ya IDG moja, so tuna suspect huyo cart alikuwa contaminated au ame-mix na fluid tofauti. Sample ya fluid imeenda lab for testing, so next shift please fuatilia results na hiyo cart iendelee kuwa out of service mpaka tupate confirmation.
summary: IDG servicing oil ya A321 inasuspectiwa kuwa contaminated baada ya in-flight over-temperature warning, sample iko lab ikisubiri results.

narrative_text: During R&R of the inboard right wing fuel booster pump, the slide valve retaining pin failed and the slide valve dislodged as the pump was withdrawn, causing fuel to pour out of the wing. Attempts by the two technicians to reinstall the pump and valve were unsuccessful, so the area was evacuated and leads/supervisor plus the fire department were notified immediately. Follow-up: before next removal, defuel the wing tank and inspect the slide valve retaining pin for damage/functionality prior to pulling the pump.
summary: A wing fuel pump removal led to a slide valve failure and fuel spill, requiring fire department response and a recommendation to defuel and inspect the retaining pin before future removals.

entities.text: inboard right wing fuel booster pump
R&R of the inboard right wing fuel booster pump

narrative_text: Wakati wa kuondoa na kubadilisha pampu ya mafuta ya bawa la kulia (inboard), pini ya kushikilia slide valve iliharibika na slide valve ikatoka nje wakati pampu ikitolewa, na hivyo mafuta yakaanza kumwagika kutoka kwenye bawa. Mafundi wawili walijaribu kurudisha pampu na valve mahali pake lakini haikufaulu, hivyo waliondoka eneo hilo na kutaarifu maleadi na msimamizi mara moja, pamoja na idara ya zimamoto. Kufuatilia: kabla ya kuondoa pampu tena, mafuta ya tangi ya bawa yanapaswa kutolewa kwanza na pini ya slide valve ikaguliwe kuhakikisha haijaharibika.
summary: Kuondolewa kwa pampu ya mafuta ya bawani kulisababisha slide valve kuharibika na mafuta kumwagika, hali iliyohitaji uingiliaji wa zimamoto na pendekezo la kukagua pini kabla ya kazi ijayo.

entities.text: pampu ya mafuta ya bawa la kulia
kuondoa na kubadilisha pampu ya mafuta ya bawa

narrative_text: Wakati tuli-R&R ile inboard right wing fuel booster pump, ile slide valve retaining pin iliharibika na slide valve ikatoka kabisa pale pump ilipokuwa inatolewa, mafuta yakaanza kumwagika out of the wing. Sisi wawili tulijaribu ku-reinstall pump na valve lakini haikufanya kazi, so tuli-evacuate area na tukacall leads na supervisor immediately, fire department wakanotifiwa pia. Follow-up: kabla ya kuremove pump tena, lazima tu-defuel wing tank kwanza na tucheki hiyo slide valve retaining pin kama iko in good condition.
summary: Ile fuel pump removal iliisha na slide valve failure na fuel spill, ikahitaji fire department response na pendekezo la kudefuel na kucheck pin kabla ya next removal.

entities.text: inboard right wing fuel booster pump

narrative_text: During accumulator replacement on the A320 (Aircraft X) hydraulic system in the hangar, the Lead Technician stowed the manual gear drop and re-energized the system around end of shift without confirming all personnel were clear of the wheel well. A technician who had gone back to check the accumulator for leaks got his legs caught between the ladder and the main landing gear as it retracted, narrowly avoiding serious injury. Follow-up needed: reinforce clearance/verbal confirmation procedures before re-energizing gear systems, and review time-pressure practices near shift change.
summary: A technician was nearly caught in the landing gear wheel well when the Lead re-energized the hydraulic system without confirming all personnel were clear during accumulator replacement on the A320.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kubadilisha accumulator kwenye mfumo wa hydraulic wa ndege ya A320 (Aircraft X) hangarini, Fundi Mkuu (Lead) alirudisha manual gear drop na kuwasha tena mfumo karibu na mwisho wa zamu bila kuthibitisha kama wafanyakazi wote walikuwa mbali na wheel well. Fundi mmoja aliyekuwa amerudi kuangalia uvujaji wa accumulator miguu yake ilinaswa kati ya ngazi na landing gear kuu wakati ikirudi ndani, hatua ndogo tu kutoka kupata jeraha kubwa. Hatua inayohitajika: kusisitiza taratibu za uthibitisho wa eneo salama kabla ya kuwasha mifumo ya gear, na kupitia upya utaratibu wa kufanya kazi kwa haraka karibu na mabadiliko ya zamu.
summary: Fundi mmoja alikaribia kunaswa kwenye wheel well wakati Lead alipowasha tena mfumo wa hydraulic bila kuthibitisha usalama wa wafanyakazi wakati wa kubadilisha accumulator kwenye A320.

narrative_text: Wakati tulikuwa tuki-replace accumulator kwenye hydraulic system ya A320 (Aircraft X) hangarini, Lead ali-stow ile manual gear drop na kuwasha system tena karibu na end of shift bila kuconfirm kama watu wote walikuwa clear ya wheel well. Fundi mmoja aliyerudi kucheck accumulator kama inaleak, miguu yake ilinaswa kati ya ladder na landing gear ikiwa inaretract, karibu kupata jeraha kubwa. Tunahitaji ku-reinforce ile clearance procedure kabla ya kuwasha gear system tena, na ku-review huu tabia ya kufanya kazi kwa haraka near shift change.
summary: Fundi alikaribia kunaswa kwenye wheel well wakati Lead alipo-re-energize hydraulic system bila kuconfirm usalama wa watu wakati wa accumulator replacement kwenye A320.

narrative_text: Found insulation blanket missing in the aft pit area on the B767-300ER, resulting in lavatory temperatures above 112F and duct readings up to 260F in the aft cargo compartment where insulation was absent. This is a potential fire hazard in an enclosed area and needs urgent follow-up by the next shift to source and install the correct insulation blanket before further dispatch. Recommend incoming techs review the applicable maintenance manual reference for insulation installation before signing off.
summary: Missing insulation blanket in aft pit of B767-300ER caused excessive duct temperatures, posing a fire hazard that requires follow-up repair.

narrative_text: Tumegundua blanketi la insulation halipo kwenye eneo la aft pit la ndege ya B767-300ER, jambo lililosababisha joto la juu ya nyuzi 112 katika lavatory na hadi nyuzi 260 kwenye duct ya aft cargo pasipo insulation. Hali hii ni hatari ya moto kwa sababu iko kwenye eneo lililofungwa, hivyo inahitaji ufuatiliaji wa haraka na shift inayofuata ili kupata na kufunga insulation blanket sahihi kabla ya ndege kuruhusiwa kuruka tena. Mafundi wanaoingia zamu wanashauriwa kupitia maintenance manual husika kabla ya kutia sahihi kazi hiyo.
summary: Kukosekana kwa insulation blanket katika aft pit ya B767-300ER kulisababisha joto kali linaloweza kusababisha hatari ya moto, hivyo linahitaji ufuatiliaji wa haraka.

narrative_text: Tume-discover insulation blanket iko missing kwenye aft pit ya hii B767-300ER, na hiyo imesababisha lavatory temperature kupanda zaidi ya 112F, na duct kwa aft cargo inasoma hadi 260F pale insulation haiko. Hii ni fire hazard kwa sababu ni enclosed area, kwa hivyo next shift wafuatilie haraka ku-source na ku-install insulation blanket sahihi kabla ya dispatch. Techs wanaoingia wapitie maintenance manual reference kabla ya ku-sign off job hii.
summary: Insulation blanket i-missing kwenye aft pit ya B767-300ER imesababisha overheating ambayo ni fire hazard, inahitaji follow-up haraka.

narrative_text: During troubleshooting on the Bell 412, an engine bolt was found jammed near the #1 engine twist grip, lodged in an inaccessible area next to the idle cutoff inner bellcrank. The 12-point bolt had anti-seize applied but no safety wire installed, and last engine maintenance in that area was recorded on Day 1. Incoming powerplant tech to re-verify engine control installation and do a borescope/panel check for any additional FOD before next run.
summary: A loose, unsafetied engine bolt was found near the #1 twist grip on a Bell 412, requiring verification of engine control installation and further FOD inspection.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kufanya uchunguzi kwenye helikopta ya Bell 412, bolt ya injini ilipatikana ikiwa imekwama karibu na twist grip ya injini namba 1, mahali pasipofikika kwa urahisi karibu na bellcrank ya ndani ya idle cutoff. Bolt hiyo yenye vichwa kumi na mbili ilikuwa na anti-seize lakini haikuwa na waya wa usalama, na matengenezo ya mwisho ya injini eneo hilo yalifanyika Siku ya Kwanza kulingana na rekodi. Fundi atakayeingia zamu anaombwa kuthibitisha ufungaji wa vidhibiti vya injini na kufanya ukaguzi wa ziada wa uchafu wowote uliobaki kwa kutumia borescope au kupitia paneli zilizofunguliwa.
summary: Bolt ya injini isiyo na usalama ilipatikana karibu na twist grip namba 1 ya helikopta ya Bell 412, hivyo ufungaji wa vidhibiti vya injini na uchunguzi zaidi wa uchafu unahitajika.

entities.text: bellcrank ya ndani ya idle cutoff

narrative_text: Tulipata engine bolt ikiwa imejam karibu na #1 engine twist grip wakati wa troubleshooting kwenye hii Bell 412, iko mahali pasipoeasy-access karibu na idle cutoff inner bellcrank. Ile 12-point bolt ilikuwa na anti-seize lakini hakukuwa na safety wire kabisa, na maintenance record inaonyesha last work kwenye eneo hilo ilifanyika Day 1. Next shift wafanye verify engine control installation na wafanye borescope au wachek through open panels kuhakikisha hakuna FOD nyingine iliyobaki.
summary: Kuna engine bolt ambayo haikuwa na safety wire iliyopatikana karibu na #1 twist grip kwenye Bell 412, hivyo engine control installation lazima i-verify na FOD check ifanyike.

narrative_text: While servicing a low portable oxygen bottle from a B787 (tail number not confirmed), found corroded batteries inside the bottle assembly, which could pose a spark/fire hazard. This is the third time such corrosion has been found on this bottle style, and each time it was only caught because the green indicator light failed to illuminate during test. Recommend B787 portable oxygen bottles be added to a more frequent inspection interval instead of only checking at servicing/hydrostatic due dates, since current hydro/due intervals are longer than other fleet types. Please flag this component design issue to engineering/reliability for review.
summary: Corroded batteries found inside a B787 portable oxygen bottle during servicing, prompting a recommendation for more frequent inspections due to a recurring design/detection issue.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kuhudumia chupa ya oksijeni ya kubebeka ya ndege ya B787 iliyokuwa na kiwango cha chini, tuligundua betri ndani ya chupa hiyo zimeoza kutu, jambo ambalo linaweza kusababisha cheche na hatari ya moto. Hii ni mara ya tatu tunapata tatizo hili la kutu kwenye betri za muundo huu wa chupa, na kila mara hugunduliwa tu kwa sababu taa ya kijani ya majaribio haiwaki. Napendekeza chupa za oksijeni za B787 zikaguliwe mara kwa mara badala ya kusubiri hadi zihitaji huduma au tarehe ya mtihani wa maji, kwani muda wake wa ukaguzi ni mrefu zaidi ukilinganisha na fleet nyingine. Tafadhali suala hili la muundo lipelekwe kwa idara ya uhandisi kwa ufuatiliaji zaidi.
summary: Betri zilizooza kutu zimepatikana ndani ya chupa ya oksijeni ya kubebeka ya B787 wakati wa huduma, hivyo kupendekezwa ukaguzi wa mara kwa mara kutokana na tatizo la muundo linalojirudia.

narrative_text: Wakati wa ku-service ile portable oxygen bottle ya B787 iliyokuwa low, tulikuta batteries ndani ya bottle zime-corrode, na hiyo inaweza cause spark ndani ya bottle. Hii ni mara ya tatu naona hii issue kwenye hii style ya bottle - kila time inagunduliwa tu kwa sababu ile green light ya test haiwaki. Naomba B787 oxygen bottles zi-check mara kwa mara, si kusubiri hadi due for servicing au hydrostatic test date, kwa sababu interval yao ni ndefu kuliko fleets zingine. Please flag hii kwa engineering kwa follow-up ya design issue.
summary: Batteries za corroded zimepatikana kwenye B787 oxygen bottle wakati wa servicing, hivyo kuna haja ya more frequent checks kwa sababu ya recurring design issue.

narrative_text: During the ETOPS check on the B777 (Ref X) parked at gate ZZZ, the small access door on the #1 engine inboard thrust reverser upper hinge beam (aft area) was found missing; this is not permitted per manual limits for mid/aft access doors. Please follow up with engineering on parts sourcing and inspection sign-off before next departure. Recommend reinstating routine walk-arounds by qualified line mechanics on all through flights, not only ETOPS or scheduled checks, since staffing levels have since normalized and many recent findings could have been caught earlier.
summary: A missing access door on the #1 engine thrust reverser was found during an ETOPS check, prompting a call to restore mechanic walk-arounds on all flights.

entities.text: #1 engine inboard thrust reverser upper hinge beam

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa ETOPS kwenye ndege ya B777 (Ref X) iliyokuwa imeegeshwa lango la ZZZ, ilibainika mlango mdogo wa kufikia sehemu ya juu ya bawaba ya thrust reverser ya injini namba moja umepotea, jambo ambalo halikubaliki kwa mujibu wa taratibu za matengenezo. Tunahitaji ufuatiliaji wa haraka na uhandisi kuhusu upatikanaji wa kipande hicho kabla ya safari ijayo kuondoka. Pia tunapendekeza mafundi wenye sifa warudishwe kufanya ukaguzi wa kutembea kuzunguka ndege kwa safari zote, si tu za ETOPS au ukaguzi maalum, kwani idadi ya wafanyakazi imerejea kawaida na dosari nyingi zingeweza kugunduliwa mapema.
summary: Mlango mdogo wa kufikia sehemu ya thrust reverser ya injini namba moja ulipotea wakati wa ukaguzi wa ETOPS, hivyo kuhitaji mafundi kurejesha ukaguzi wa kutembea kwa safari zote.

entities.text: thrust reverser ya injini namba moja

narrative_text: Wakati wa ETOPS check kwa B777 (Ref X) iliyoegeshwa gate ZZZ, tumeona access door ndogo ya #1 engine inboard thrust reverser upper hinge beam, sehemu ya aft, imekosekana kabisa - na hii haiku allowed per manual. Please follow up na engineering kuhusu part sourcing na sign-off before ndege haijaondoka next flight. Pia tuko na recommendation ya kurudisha walk-arounds za line mechanics kwa through flights zote, sio tu ETOPS ama scheduled checks, kwa sababu staffing imesha-normalize na findings nyingi za hivi karibuni zingeweza kupatikana mapema kama walk-around ingefanywa on time.
summary: Access door ya #1 engine thrust reverser ilikosekana during ETOPS check, hivyo tunahitaji walk-arounds za mechanics zirudishwe kwa flights zote.

entities.text: #1 engine inboard thrust reverser upper hinge beam
