narrative_text: During walkaround on the B737, found a small quarter-sized red mark on the lower left side of the radome; area was cleaned and left side of fuselage, wing leading edge, gear, and flap areas were checked with no further signs of strike. Bird excrement and a small amount of blood at the 5 o'clock position of the #1 engine intake were not caught during that initial pass, which per MM required a separate bird strike inspection. That area was later reviewed and no damage was found, but next shift should confirm both MM references were fully completed and documented before dispatch.
summary: Technician found a possible bird strike mark on the radome and initially missed a related sign at the #1 engine intake requiring a separate MM inspection, which was later checked with no damage found.

entities.text: lower left side of the radome

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa nje wa ndege ya B737, dowa ndogo nyekundu ilionekana upande wa chini wa kushoto wa radome, ikafutwa na sehemu za bawa, gia, na flap zikakaguliwa bila dalili nyingine za mgongano na ndege. Wakati huo huo, kinyesi cha ndege pamoja na damu kidogo katika eneo la intake ya injini namba moja havikutambuliwa mara ya kwanza, jambo lililohitaji ukaguzi maalum wa mgongano na ndege kulingana na maelekezo ya matengenezo. Baadaye eneo hilo lilikaguliwa upya na hakuna uharibifu ulioonekana, lakini zamu inayofuata ihakikishe hatua zote za ukaguzi zimekamilika na kuandikwa vizuri kabla ya ndege kuruhusiwa kuondoka.
summary: Fundi aligundua dalili ya mgongano wa ndege kwenye radome na awali hakutambua alama nyingine karibu na intake ya injini iliyohitaji ukaguzi wa ziada, ambao baadaye ulifanywa bila kupata uharibifu.

narrative_text: Wakati wa walkaround kwenye B737, nilikuta dowa ndogo red spot upande wa chini left ya radome, nikaisafisha kisha nikacheck leading edge, gear, na flap area, hakuna dalili zingine za bird strike. Lakini niliskip kuona bird excrement na damu kidogo kwa 5 o'clock position ya #1 engine intake, ambayo kwa mujibu wa MM inahitaji separate bird strike inspection. Baadaye area hiyo ilicheckiwa tena na hakuna damage iliyopatikana, lakini next shift wahakikishe both MM references zimefuatwa na kuandikwa properly kabla ya dispatch.
summary: Fundi aliona possible bird strike mark kwenye radome na aliskip alama nyingine karibu na #1 engine intake iliyohitaji inspection ya ziada, ambayo baadaye ilicheckiwa bila damage.

narrative_text: After replacing the Emergency Brake Valve on the Gulfstream III, two hydraulic flex lines were reconnected reversed by maintenance, and the required operational check was never completed before the aircraft left the hangar. The Chief Pilot, who is also A&P-qualified, chose to perform the check himself and flew a test flight without doing so, then repositioned the aircraft for a next-day departure; on landing after that flight all four brakes locked up due to the crossed lines building full pressure. Follow-up: confirm operational check is completed and signed off before any further flight, and verify hydraulic line routing on this tail number before dispatch.
summary: Reversed hydraulic brake lines and a skipped operational check on a Gulfstream III led to all four brakes locking on landing.

narrative_text: Baada ya kubadilisha Emergency Brake Valve kwenye Gulfstream III, mafundi waliunganisha mabomba mawili ya hydraulic flex kwa mkorogo (reversed), na ukaguzi wa uendeshaji (operational check) haukufanywa kabla ndege haijaondoka hangarini. Chief Pilot, ambaye pia ana leseni ya A&P, aliamua kufanya ukaguzi huo mwenyewe lakini akaruka ndege ya majaribio bila kuufanya, kisha akaegesha ndege tayari kwa safari ya siku inayofuata; wakati wa kutua baada ya hiyo safari, breki zote nne zilikwama kwa sababu ya mabomba yaliyokorogwa kujaza shinikizo kamili. Inahitajika: kuhakikisha operational check inafanywa na kusainiwa kabla ya safari yoyote ijayo, na kukagua mfumo wa mabomba ya hydraulic kwenye ndege hii kabla ya kuruhusiwa kuruka tena.
summary: Mabomba ya hydraulic yaliyokorogwa na kukosekana kwa ukaguzi wa uendeshaji kwenye Gulfstream III kulisababisha breki zote nne kukwama wakati wa kutua.

narrative_text: Baada ya kubadilisha ile Emergency Brake Valve kwa Gulfstream III, wale maintenance guys waliconnect zile two hydraulic flex lines reversed, na ile operational check haikufanywa before ndege ku-depart hangar. Chief Pilot, ambaye pia ana A&P certificate, akasema atafanya ile check mwenyewe lakini aka-fly test flight bila kuifanya, then aka-position ndege for next-day departure; on landing baada ya hiyo test flight, brakes zote four zika-lock up kwa sababu lines zilizo-crossed zilibuild full pressure. Follow-up: hakikisha operational check imefanywa na kusignoff kabla ya any flight ijayo, na uverify hydraulic line routing kwa hii tail number kabla ya dispatch.
summary: Reversed hydraulic lines na operational check iliyoskipwa kwa Gulfstream III ndio zilisababisha brakes zote four ku-lock during landing.

narrative_text: During IDG servicing on the B737 in the hangar, the aluminum drain plug was found cracked, likely from prior over-torquing or use of improper tools like channel locks. Torque effort suddenly dropped mid-sequence before the crack was confirmed visually, so the plug was replaced. Next shift, please verify replacement plug torque per block 2 step and flag this as a recurring issue with the tech team.
summary: Cracked IDG drain plug found on B737 during hangar maintenance due to prior over-torquing; plug replaced and follow-up torque check needed.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kuhudumia IDG ya ndege ya B737 hangarini, kizibo cha alumini kilipatikana kimepasuka, huenda kutokana na kubana kupita kiasi awali au matumizi ya zana zisizofaa kama channel locks. Nguvu ya kubana ilipungua ghafla katikati ya mchakato kabla ya kuthibitisha ufa kwa macho, hivyo kizibo kilibadilishwa. Zamu inayofuata, tafadhali hakikisheni kubana kwa kizibo kipya kunafuata hatua za block 2, na mjulishe timu ya ufundi kuhusu tatizo hili linalojirudia.
summary: Kizibo cha kutolea mafuta cha IDG kwenye B737 kilipatikana kimepasuka hangarini kutokana na kubana kupita kiasi awali; kizibo kilibadilishwa na ukaguzi zaidi unahitajika.

narrative_text: Tulipokuwa tuki-service IDG kwa B737 hapa hangar, tulipata ile aluminum drain plug imepasuka, most likely ni kwa sababu ya over-torquing ya awali au kutumia tools mbaya kama channel locks. Torque effort ilipungua ghafla mid-sequence kabla hatujaconfirm crack kwa jicho, so tuliibadilisha plug. Zamu inayofuata, please verify torque ya plug mpya as per block 2 step, na muinform tech team hii ni recurring issue.
summary: IDG drain plug ya B737 ilipatikana imepasuka hangarini due to over-torquing awali; plug ilibadilishwa na follow-up torque check inahitajika.

narrative_text: During the morning equipment inspection, opened engine oil cans were found sitting on the oxygen service cart, right next to the oxygen bottle service valves. This is a serious hazard given how reactive oil and oxygen are together, so please remind all technicians to keep oil products well away from oxygen carts. Next shift needs to remove and properly dispose of any remaining oil cans in the HAZMAT area and check the cart again before it goes back into service.
summary: Opened oil cans were found near oxygen service valves on the oxygen cart, posing a contamination/fire hazard requiring crew awareness and proper HAZMAT disposal.

entities.text: dispose of any remaining oil cans in the HAZMAT area

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa vifaa asubuhi, makopo ya mafuta ya injini yaliyofunguliwa yalipatikana yakiwa juu ya gari la huduma la oksijeni, karibu kabisa na valvu za mitungi ya oksijeni. Hali hii ni hatari kubwa kwa sababu mafuta na oksijeni vinaweza kusababisha moto endapo vitakutana. Mafundi wote wanahitaji kukumbushwa umuhimu wa kutenganisha mafuta na vifaa vya oksijeni, na zamu inayofuata ihakikishe makopo hayo yanaondolewa na kutupwa ipasavyo eneo la HAZMAT.
summary: Makopo ya mafuta yaliyofunguliwa yalikutwa karibu na valvu za oksijeni kwenye gari la huduma, jambo linalohitaji tahadhari na utupaji sahihi wa taka eneo la HAZMAT.

narrative_text: Wakati wa morning inspection, tulikuta opened oil cans zikiwa placed juu ya oxygen service cart, karibu sana na oxygen bottle service valves. Hii ni serious hazard maana oil na oxygen vikichanganyika inaweza kusababisha fire. Naomba technicians wote wa-remind kuhusu hii risk, na next shift wahakikishe wanaondoa hizo cans na ku-dispose properly kwenye HAZMAT area kabla cart haija-return kwa service.
summary: Opened oil cans zilikutwa karibu na oxygen valves kwenye service cart, ni hazard inayohitaji awareness na proper disposal HAZMAT.

narrative_text: During inspection of the #4 brake on the MAX, we found seven rotor drive clips cracked, all on the last rotor disk, likely heat related. Parts are still pending so the brake is currently deferred; grave shift trainer confirmed this is a recurring issue on MAX fleet and occasionally on NG aircraft. Next shift please follow up on parts status and continue monitoring other brakes for similar clip cracking.
summary: Multiple cracked rotor drive clips found on a MAX #4 brake, suspected heat-related and recurring fleet-wide, parts pending.

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa breki namba nne kwenye ndege ya MAX, tuligundua klipu saba za rotor zimepasuka, zote zikiwa kwenye diski ya mwisho, jambo linaloashiria tatizo la joto. Vipuri bado havijafika kwa hivyo breki hii imesimamishwa kwa sasa, na fundi wa zamu ya usiku amethibitisha hili ni tatizo la kawaida kwa ndege za MAX na mara chache kwa NG. Zamu inayofuata iendelee kufuatilia hali ya vipuri na kuangalia breki zingine kama zina tatizo kama hili.
summary: Klipu saba za rotor zimepatikana zimepasuka kwenye breki ya ndege ya MAX, tatizo linaloshukiwa kusababishwa na joto na linalojirudia, huku vipuri vikisubiriwa.

narrative_text: Wakati wa inspection ya #4 brake kwa hii MAX, tulipata seven rotor drive clips zimepasuka, zote kwenye last rotor disk, inaonekana ni heat issue. Parts bado hazijafika kwa hivyo brake iko deferred kwa sasa, na yule grave shift trainer amesema hii ni common problem kwa MAX fleet na occasionally kwa NG pia. Next shift wafuatilie parts status na wa-check zingine brakes kama zina crack kama hii.
summary: Tumepata seven rotor drive clips zimepasuka kwenye #4 brake ya MAX, inashukiwa ni heat-related na ni recurring issue, parts bado pending.

narrative_text: During towing into the hangar bay, our aircraft's right winglet nearly struck the tail section of another aircraft parked in the adjacent bay. The tow lines painted in that bay do not correspond to our aircraft type and are unlabeled, which has caused confusion on prior occasions as well. Next shift needs to raise this with hangar planning so the bay markings can be reviewed, correctly labeled, and new straight-in lines added for widebody towing.
summary: A towing near-miss in the hangar was caused by incorrect and unlabeled bay lines, requiring urgent review of hangar towing markings.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kuvuta ndege kuingia hangarini, sehemu ya mrengo wa kulia karibu iguse mkia wa ndege nyingine iliyokuwa bay jirani. Mistari ya kuongoza uvutaji katika bay hiyo haifanani na aina ya ndege yetu, na pia haijawekewa lebo, jambo ambalo limeshatokea mara kadhaa hapo awali. Zamu inayofuata ihakikishe suala hili linapelekwa kwa uongozi wa hangar ili mistari hiyo ikaguliwe, iwekewe lebo sahihi, na mistari mipya ya moja kwa moja iongezwe kwa ajili ya ndege kubwa.
summary: Tukio la karibu kugongana wakati wa kuvuta ndege hangarini lilisababishwa na mistari ya bay isiyo sahihi na isiyo na lebo, hivyo kuhitaji ukaguzi wa haraka.

narrative_text: Wakati tuna-tow AC kuingia bay, right winglet ilikaribia ku-hit tail ya ile aircraft nyingine iliyokuwa parked next bay. Zile towing lines za hapo bay hazi-match na aircraft type yetu, na pia hazina labels, na hii imekuwa recurring issue. Next shift wa-raise hii na hangar planning ili lines zi-review, zi-label properly, na tuongeze new straight lines za widebody towing.
summary: Kulikuwa na near-miss wakati wa towing hangarini kwa sababu ya towing lines ambazo hazi-match aircraft type na hazina labels, so inahitaji review haraka.

narrative_text: During scheduled engine harness replacement on Aircraft X (B737-800), engine #2, a connector was removed and may not have been reinstalled due to the large number of AMTs working the job and pressure to release the aircraft on time. Please have the next shift verify all connectors on engine #2 harness are properly seated and secured before further dispatch. Recommend slowing down and double-checking installation steps regardless of schedule pressure.
summary: A connector on engine #2 may have been left disconnected after harness replacement on Aircraft X due to time pressure and crowded work conditions, requiring verification by incoming shift.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kazi ya kubadilisha waya za injini (engine harness) kwenye Ndege X, aina ya B737-800, injini namba #2, kiungio kimoja (connector) kiliondolewa na inawezekana hakikurudishwa vizuri kutokana na wafanyakazi wengi wa AMT waliokuwa kwenye kazi hiyo pamoja na shinikizo la kutaka ndege iondoke kwa wakati. Zamu inayofuata inaombwa kukagua viunganisho vyote vya waya kwenye injini #2 kuhakikisha vimewekwa na kufungwa vizuri kabla ya ndege kuruhusiwa kuondoka. Ni vyema kupunguza kasi na kuhakikisha kila hatua ya ufungaji inakaguliwa vizuri hata kama kuna shinikizo la muda.
summary: Kiungio kimoja cha waya kwenye injini #2 ya Ndege X huenda kilisahaulika kufungwa baada ya ukarabati kutokana na shinikizo la muda, hivyo kinahitaji ukaguzi wa zamu inayofuata.

narrative_text: So during ile job ya ku-replace engine harness kwa Aircraft X, B737-800, engine #2, kuna connector ilitolewa na inawezekana haikurudishwa vizuri kwa sababu ya AMTs wengi walikuwa site siku hiyo na pressure ya kutaka aircraft irelease on time. Next shift wanaomba wa-verify connectors zote za engine #2 harness ziwe zime-seat properly na zime-secure kabla ya dispatch. Tuchukue muda vizuri next time, tusiache time pressure ituletee mistakes hata kama kuna deadline ya kutoa ndege.
summary: Connector moja ya engine #2 kwa Aircraft X inaweza kuwa haikufungwa vizuri baada ya harness replacement kwa sababu ya time pressure, so next shift wa-verify kabla ya dispatch.

narrative_text: During fuel tank entry inspection on the A319 (parked in the hangar), technicians found heavy corrosion on the attaching hardware and impact fuel panels 640CB and 640BB. Panels and hardware need to be documented and referred to engineering for repair/replacement disposition before the aircraft is released; incoming shift should confirm parts availability before proceeding.
summary: Heavy corrosion found on fuel panel attaching hardware (640CB/640BB) during tank entry inspection on A319, requiring engineering disposition before further work.

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa kuingia kwenye tangi la mafuta la ndege ya A319 iliyokuwa imeegeshwa hangarini, mafundi waligundua kutu nzito kwenye vifaa vya kushikilia pamoja na paneli za mafuta 640CB na 640BB. Inahitajika hali hii iandikwe vizuri na kupelekwa kwa idara ya uhandisi ili kuamua namna ya kutengeneza au kubadilisha sehemu hizo kabla ndege haijaruhusiwa kuruka; zamu inayofuata iangalie kama vipuri vinapatikana kabla ya kuendelea na kazi.
summary: Kutu nzito imepatikana kwenye vifaa vya kushikilia paneli za mafuta 640CB na 640BB za ndege ya A319 wakati wa ukaguzi, hivyo uamuzi wa uhandisi unahitajika kabla ya kazi kuendelea.

entities.text: ukaguzi wa kuingia kwenye tangi la mafuta

narrative_text: Wakati wa fuel tank entry inspection kwa A319 iliyoko hangarini, technicians wamepata heavy corrosion kwenye attaching hardware na fuel panels 640CB na 640BB. Tafadhali document hii issue na uipeleke engineering waamue kama panels zinatakiwa kurepair au kureplace kabla aircraft haija-release; shift inayofuata i-confirm parts availability kabla ya kuendelea na job.
summary: Kuna heavy corrosion imepatikana kwenye fuel panels 640CB/640BB za A319 wakati wa inspection, so tunahitaji engineering disposition kabla ya kuendelea.

narrative_text: MEL fire detector loop heat-test procedure is ambiguous on the B737 MAX 8 currently in the hangar; it is unclear whether each loop segment or the loop in total must be tested, and no AMM reference or approved heat source tool is provided. Maintenance Control advised testing the loop at any single point, but this could mask multiple faults across other segments. Next shift please escalate to Engineering/Tech Pubs for a clarified AMM procedure before signing off the MEL item.
summary: Technician flagged ambiguous MEL heat-test wording for the fire detector loop on a B737 MAX 8, requiring engineering clarification before further sign-off.

entities.text: MEL fire detector loop heat-test procedure

narrative_text: Utaratibu wa MEL wa kupima joto la loop ya detector ya moto kwenye ndege ya B737 MAX 8 iliyopo hangarini haueleweki vizuri; haijulikani wazi kama kila sehemu ya loop inapaswa kupimwa au loop nzima kwa ujumla, wala hakuna rejea ya AMM au chombo kilichoidhinishwa cha kuongeza joto. Maintenance Control walishauri kupima loop mahali popote tu, lakini hii inaweza kuficha hitilafu nyingine katika sehemu zingine za loop. Zamu ijayo tafadhali wasiliana na Uhandisi/Tech Pubs ili kupata utaratibu ulio wazi wa AMM kabla ya kukamilisha kazi hii ya MEL.
summary: Fundi aliripoti utata katika maelekezo ya MEL kuhusu upimaji wa joto wa loop ya detector ya moto kwenye B737 MAX 8, hivyo linahitaji ufafanuzi kutoka kwa Uhandisi kabla ya kuendelea.

entities.text: utaratibu wa MEL wa kupima joto

narrative_text: Kuna confusion na hii MEL procedure ya heat test kwa fire detector loop kwa B737 MAX 8 iko hangar sasa hivi; haiko clear kama unatakiwa kutest kila loop segment ama loop nzima kwa jumla, na hakuna AMM reference wala approved heat source tool imepewa. Maintenance Control walisema tu test loop popote, lakini hiyo inaweza kuficha faults zingine kwa segments zingine. Next shift tafadhali mfollow-up na Engineering/Tech Pubs wapate clear AMM procedure kabla ya ku-sign off hii MEL item.
summary: Fundi ame-flag confusion kwenye MEL heat-test procedure ya fire detector loop kwa B737 MAX 8, so inahitaji clarification kutoka Engineering kabla ya kuendelea na sign-off.

narrative_text: Last week a mechanic requested a rush field service tool shipment near departure time for an Aircraft X flight, so I asked a co-worker to assist with the manual shipping tag and packing while I processed the shipping memo. I asked the mechanic twice if any of the tools were hazmat and he confirmed none were, so the tools were sent out to the gate. That night while updating the tool location log I discovered one of the tools was actually hazmat, and I had to advise the mechanic it cannot be shipped back without proper hazmat documentation. Follow-up needed: confirm tool status with mechanic and process correct hazmat paperwork before next shipment.
summary: A tool later found to be hazmat was shipped without proper documentation after being misidentified by the mechanic, requiring follow-up paperwork before return shipment.

narrative_text: Wiki iliyopita mfundi aliomba vifaa vya huduma vya uwandani vitumwe haraka muda mfupi kabla ya ndege ya Aircraft X kuondoka, hivyo nilimwomba mfanyakazi mwenzangu anisaidie kufunga na kutuma vifaa hivyo huku mimi nikiandaa hati maalum ya usafirishaji. Nilimuuliza mfundi mara mbili kama kuna kifaa chochote chenye hatari ya kemikali (hazmat) na akanihakikishia hakuna, hivyo vifaa vikatumwa hadi lango la ndege. Usiku huo huo, nilipokuwa nikisasisha rekodi ya mahali kifaa kilipo, niligundua kuwa kimoja kati ya vifaa hivyo ni hazmat, na nikamjulisha mfundi kuwa hakiwezi kurejeshwa bila nyaraka sahihi za hazmat. Inahitajika ufuatiliaji: kuthibitisha hali ya kifaa hicho na kukamilisha nyaraka za hazmat kabla ya usafirishaji mwingine.
summary: Kifaa chenye hatari ya kemikali (hazmat) kilitumwa bila nyaraka sahihi baada ya kutambuliwa vibaya na mfundi, hivyo linahitajika ufuatiliaji wa haraka.

narrative_text: Wiki jana kulikuwa na field service tools zilizohitajika ku-shipped haraka kwa sababu Aircraft X ilikuwa karibu ku-depart, so nilimwomba colleague wangu anisaidie na packing wakati mimi naprepare ile special tag na shipping memo. Nilimuuliza yule mechanic mara mbili kama kuna kitu chochote cha hazmat kwa hizo tools, akasema hakuna, so tukazi-ship hadi kwa gate. Later that night nilipokuwa naupdate tool location, ndio nikagundua moja ya hizo tools ni hazmat, nikam-advise mechanic kwamba haiwezi ku-return bila proper hazmat documentation. Tunahitaji follow-up ya kuconfirm status ya hiyo tool na kukamilisha documentation kabla ya next shipment.
summary: Tool ambayo ilikuwa hazmat ili-shipped bila proper documentation baada ya mechanic kutoa taarifa isiyo sahihi, hivyo inahitaji follow-up ya haraka.

narrative_text: Stores personnel processed a hazmat shipment pick in Software B and booked the AWB in Software A, but did not realize the AWB number had to be entered back into Software B to close out the shipment, leaving it incomplete. Root cause appears to be inexperience with hazmat shipping procedures across the two systems. Recommend reinstating two-person sign-off on all hazmat shipments and scheduling refresher training on ground/air hazmat shipping for all shipping staff before next shift.
summary: A hazmat shipment was left incomplete after staff failed to close it out in Software B, prompting calls for two-person sign-off and refresher training.

narrative_text: Mfanyakazi wa stoo alichukua agizo la kusafirisha bidhaa hatari (hazmat) kwenye mfumo B na kukamilisha uandikishaji wa AWB kwenye mfumo A, lakini hakutambua kuwa nambari ya AWB ilipaswa kurudishwa mfumo B ili kufunga shehena hiyo kikamilifu. Chanzo cha tatizo ni ukosefu wa uzoefu katika taratibu za usafirishaji wa bidhaa hatari kati ya mifumo hiyo miwili. Inashauriwa kurejesha utaratibu wa uthibitisho wa watu wawili kwa usafirishaji wote wa hazmat, na kupanga mafunzo ya ziada kuhusu usafirishaji wa nchi kavu na anga kabla ya zamu ijayo.
summary: Shehena ya bidhaa hatari haikufungwa vizuri kwa sababu ya kutojua taratibu za mfumo, hivyo kuhitajika mafunzo na uthibitisho wa watu wawili.

narrative_text: Msee wa stores alichukua pick ya hazmat kwenye Software B, akaenda akabook AWB kwenye Software A, lakini hakujua ati anafaa ku-input hiyo AWB number back kwenye Software B ndio i-close out properly. Kwa hivyo shipment ilibaki incomplete, na cause ni lack of experience na hazmat shipping procedures. Tunapendekeza turudishe two-person sign-off kwa hazmat shipments zote, plus refresher training ya ground and air shipping kwa wale wanahusika kabla ya next shift.
summary: Hazmat shipment ilibaki incomplete baada ya AWB kutokuwa closed out properly kwenye Software B, hivyo kuna haja ya sign-off ya watu wawili na training.

narrative_text: An A321 received a last-minute hazmat/restricted-article shipment plane-side just before flight closure, and as crew chief I accepted it without realizing it could be refused. This forced the ramp crew to close the aft cargo and reopen the forward hold to load it, since that is the only compliant position on this aircraft type. At departure the restricted article was not reflected on the final load sheet; I completed the NOTOC but the final was not updated, so loads had to be called to reopen and rescan the item before refinalizing. Next shift should confirm any hazmat handling training gaps and verify final load sheet reconciliation procedures are being followed.
summary: A crew chief accepted a late hazmat shipment on an A321 without proper reconciliation with the final load sheet, causing delay and requiring the flight to be reopened and rescanned before departure.

narrative_text: Ndege ya aina ya A321 ilipokea mzigo wa hatari (hazmat) muda mfupi kabla ya kufunga safari, na kama crew chief nilipokea mzigo huo bila kujua kwamba ningeweza kuukataa. Hali hiyo ilisababisha wafanyakazi wa uwanjani kufunga cargo ya nyuma na kufungua tena cargo ya mbele ili kuweka mzigo huo, kwa kuwa hapo ndipo pekee panapofaa kwa aina hii ya ndege. Wakati wa kuondoka, ilibainika kuwa kipengele hicho cha hatari hakikuwa kimeonekana kwenye final load sheet, hivyo ilibidi kupigiwa simu idara ya mizigo kufungua tena safari, ku-scan mzigo huo, na kukamilisha upya taratibu za mwisho. Zamu inayofuata inashauriwa kuhakikisha mafunzo kuhusu mizigo ya hatari yameimarishwa na taratibu za uhakiki wa final load sheet zinafuatwa ipasavyo.
summary: Crew chief alipokea mzigo wa hatari kwa dharura kwenye ndege ya A321 bila kuujumuisha vizuri kwenye final load sheet, jambo lililosababisha ucheleweshaji na kufunguliwa upya kwa safari kabla ya kuondoka.

narrative_text: Kuna A321 ilipata hazmat shipment last minute plane-side, na mimi kama crew chief nilipokea bila kujua niko na option ya ku-refuse. Iyo ikafanya crew wa ramp wa-close aft cargo halafu wa-reopen front cargo ndio wa-load hiyo hazmat, coz kwa hii aircraft ndio pekee position inayoruhusiwa. Time ya departure ikaonekana restricted article haikuwa imeshow kwenye final load sheet, nilikua nimefanya NOTOC lakini system haiku-update final, so tulilazimika ku-call loads wa-reopen flight, wa-scan item na ku-finalize tena. Next shift wanafaa kucheki kama kuna training gap ya hazmat na kuhakikisha final load sheet inareconcile properly kabla ya closure.
summary: Crew chief alipokea hazmat shipment last minute kwenye A321 bila kuupdate final load sheet vizuri, na hiyo ikasababisha delay na kufunguliwa upya kwa flight kabla ya departure.

narrative_text: During the 300-hour scheduled maintenance on the Bell 206L1+, the tail rotor gearbox was serviced and the oil cap installed, then verified by a second AMT during the safety and security check before cowling closure. The aircraft passed ground runs and an OCF with no signs of leakage, but the receiving pilot's preflight at destination found the gearbox oil cap missing. Please review the SSC sign-off process and brief incoming techs to double-check fastener/cap security independently before cowling closeout, since two mechanics and two pilots reportedly confirmed the cap was in place prior to departure.
summary: A tail rotor gearbox oil cap was found missing during a post-departure preflight despite two mechanics and pilots having verified its installation before the aircraft left the facility.

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa saa 300 kwa helikopta ya Bell 206L1+, gearbox ya tail rotor ilihudumiwa na kifuniko cha mafuta kikawekwa, kisha kikathibitishwa na fundi mwingine wakati wa ukaguzi wa usalama kabla ya cowling kufungwa. Ndege ilifanyiwa majaribio ya ardhini na safari ya majaribio bila dalili yoyote ya uvujaji, lakini rubani aliyepokea ndege eneo la marudio aligundua kifuniko cha mafuta cha gearbox hakikuwepo. Tafadhali kagua tena mchakato wa uthibitishaji wa ukaguzi wa usalama na uwaelekeze mafundi wanaoingia zamu kuhakikisha vifuniko vimefungwa vizuri kabla ya kufunga cowling, kwani mafundi wawili na marubani wawili walidai walithibitisha kifuniko kilikuwa kimewekwa kabla ya ndege kuondoka.
summary: Kifuniko cha mafuta cha gearbox ya tail rotor kilikutwa hakipo baada ya ndege kuondoka, ingawa mafundi na marubani kadhaa walikuwa wamethibitisha kimewekwa kabla ya safari.

narrative_text: Tulikuwa tunafanya 300-hour scheduled maintenance kwa Bell 206L1+, tail rotor gearbox ikahudumiwa na oil cap ikawekwa, then ikaverified na AMT mwingine during SSC before cowling kufungwa. Aircraft ilipita ground runs na OCF bila leak yoyote kuonekana, lakini pilot alipo-preflight destination alikuta oil cap ya gearbox haiko. Tafadhali review process ya SSC sign-off na brief incoming techs wa-double check cap security independently kabla ya cowling closeout, kwa sababu mechanics wawili na pilots wawili walisema walithibitisha cap ilikuwa imewekwa kabla ya departure.
summary: Oil cap ya tail rotor gearbox ilikutwa missing baada ya aircraft kuondoka, ingawa mechanics na pilots kadhaa walikuwa wame-verify installation before departure.

narrative_text: Fire extinguisher bottle squibs are again arriving from vendors without proper ESD shunt caps installed, only a non-ESD plastic cover, and the shipping cartons are labeled as nonflammable gas with no explosive hazard marking. This was flagged before when shunt cap stock was down to one unit and techs were told to fabricate caps under a supplement due to no inventory. Next shift needs to hold any CRJ200 squib work until shunts are confirmed on hand, and follow up with vendors/shipping dept on proper squib handling and carton labeling.
summary: Fire extinguisher squibs are being received/shipped without proper shunt caps and hazard labeling, requiring vendor education and inventory follow-up.

narrative_text: Squibs za chupa za kuzimia moto zinaendelea kuletwa na wauzaji bila shunt caps za ESD, badala yake zina kifuniko cha plastiki cha kawaida tu, na masanduku ya usafirishaji yameandikwa kuwa na gesi isiyoshika moto pekee bila alama ya hatari ya mlipuko. Suala hili liliwahi kuripotiwa awali wakati akiba ya shunt caps ilipopungua hadi moja, na mafundi waliambiwa watengeneze caps zao kupitia nyongeza ya maelekezo kwa sababu hakukuwa na akiba ya kutosha. Zamu inayofuata inapaswa kusitisha kazi yoyote ya squib kwa ndege za CRJ200 mpaka shunt caps zithibitishwe zipo, na kufuatilia na wauzaji pamoja na idara ya usafirishaji kuhusu utunzaji sahihi wa squibs na uwekaji lebo ya hatari kwenye masanduku.
summary: Squibs za chupa za kuzimia moto zinapokelewa na kusafirishwa bila shunt caps sahihi na lebo ya hatari, hivyo kuhitaji elimu kwa wauzaji na ufuatiliaji wa akiba.

entities.text: Squibs za chupa za kuzimia moto

narrative_text: Hizi squibs za fire extinguisher bottles zinaendelea kuletwa na vendors bila shunt caps za ESD, ni plastic cap ya kawaida tu, na cartons zimewekewa label ya nonflammable gas tu bila kuonyesha ni explosive hazard. Hii ilishawahi kuripotiwa before, wakati stock ya shunt caps ilikuwa moja tu, na tukaambiwa tu-fabricate caps kwa supplement kwa sababu ya no inventory. Zamu ijayo lazima ihold squib work yoyote ya CRJ200 mpaka shunts zithibitishwe ziko in-house, na tufuatilie na vendors na shipping dept kuhusu proper handling na labeling ya cartons.
summary: Squibs za fire extinguisher bottles zinakuja bila proper shunt caps na hazard labeling, hivyo inahitajika vendor education na inventory follow-up.

narrative_text: Aircraft arrived just after 0000Z with a pilot report of a lightning strike, and inspection found extensive damage around the nose cone area. After consultation with Maintenance Control, the aircraft was released for two more flight cycles per AMM reference, but this decision appears to have been driven by aircraft-availability pressure rather than full compliance with inspection procedure. Next shift needs to verify the AMM reference used, confirm records are properly closed out, and re-inspect the nose cone before further dispatch.
summary: Aircraft released after lightning-strike inspection despite nose cone damage, likely due to schedule pressure; follow-up inspection and record verification required.

narrative_text: Ndege iliwasili muda mfupi baada ya saa saba usiku ikiwa na ripoti ya rubani kuhusu radi kuipiga, na ukaguzi ulionyesha uharibifu mkubwa karibu na sehemu ya pua ya ndege. Baada ya mashauriano na Maintenance Control, ndege iliruhusiwa kuendelea kufanya kazi kwa mizunguko miwili zaidi ya safari kwa kuzingatia rejea ya AMM, lakini uamuzi huu unaonekana kuchochewa na uhaba wa ndege badala ya kufuata taratibu kamili za ukaguzi. Zamu inayofuata inahitajika kuthibitisha rejea ya AMM iliyotumika, kuhakikisha kumbukumbu zimekamilika, na kukagua tena sehemu ya pua kabla ya safari nyingine.
summary: Ndege iliruhusiwa kuendelea kufanya kazi baada ya radi kuipiga licha ya uharibifu kwenye pua, jambo linaloonekana kusababishwa na uhaba wa ndege; ukaguzi zaidi unahitajika.

entities.text: muda mfupi baada ya saa saba usiku

narrative_text: Aircraft ilifika saa saba usiku ikiwa na lightning strike report kutoka kwa pilot, na baada ya inspection tukapata damage kubwa sana kwenye nose cone area. Tulishauriana na Maintenance Control na wakasema aircraft iendelee kufanya kazi kwa two more flight cycles kwa reference ya AMM, lakini najua hiyo decision ilikuwa influenced na ukosefu wa aircrafts zingine za kuoperate, si kwa sababu ya procedure kuridhika. Next shift wahakikishe wame-verify hiyo AMM reference, wame-close out records vizuri, na wafanye re-inspection ya nose cone kabla ya dispatch nyingine.
summary: Aircraft iliruhusiwa kuendelea baada ya lightning strike japo kulikuwa na damage kwenye nose cone, inaonekana due to schedule pressure; inspection ya ziada inahitajika.

narrative_text: OTS aircraft remains down for flap lock fault (F/CTL FLAPS LOCKED, SFCS) with FLP 1/2 CHK LH MECH DRIVE messages; no proper turnover was given going into midnight shift, so we had to piece together prior findings from scattered paperwork. Inspection confirmed damage on track 3 and track 4 (outboard flap), with possible related damage to track 1/2 (inboard flap) not yet written up per crew chief's direction, pending track 3 reassembly. Next shift must inspect and write up track 1/2, specifically the possibly worn attaching link, once track 3 work is complete.
summary: Midnight shift continued flap-lock troubleshooting on an OTS aircraft without proper turnover, finding additional track 3/4 damage and an unresolved, unwritten track 1/2 discrepancy needing follow-up.

narrative_text: Ndege iliyo OTS bado ina hitilafu ya flap lock (F/CTL FLAPS LOCKED, SFCS) pamoja na ujumbe wa FLP 1/2 CHK LH MECH DRIVE; hatukupewa turnover ifaayo tulipoanza shift ya usiku, hivyo tulilazimika kupitia makaratasi yaliyotawanyika kutafuta mahali pa kuanzia. Ukaguzi ulithibitisha uharibifu kwenye track 3 na track 4 (flap ya nje), na kuna uwezekano wa uharibifu unaohusiana na track 1/2 (flap ya ndani) ambao haujaandikwa bado kama alivyoelekeza crew chief, hadi track 3 itakapowekwa tena. Shift inayofuata inapaswa kukagua na kuandika hitilafu za track 1/2, hasa kiungo kinachoonekana kuchakaa, mara kazi ya track 3 itakapokamilika.
summary: Shift ya usiku iliendelea kutatua tatizo la flap lock kwenye ndege ya OTS bila turnover ifaayo, na kugundua uharibifu zaidi wa track 3/4 pamoja na hitilafu ya track 1/2 isiyoandikwa inayohitaji ufuatiliaji.

narrative_text: Aircraft ya OTS iko down bado kwa flap lock fault (F/CTL FLAPS LOCKED, SFCS) na messages za FLP 1/2 CHK LH MECH DRIVE; hatukupata turnover ya kutosha tulipoanza night shift, so tulilazimika ku-piece together findings kutoka kwa paperwork iliyotawanyika. Inspection ilithibitisha damage kwa track 3 na track 4 (outboard flap), na kuna possible damage related na track 1/2 (inboard flap) ambayo bado haijaandikwa kama crew chief alivyosema, mpaka track 3 iwe reassembled. Next shift wanafaa ku-check na ku-write up track 1/2, hasa ile attaching link inayoonekana worn, mara tu track 3 itakapo-complete.
summary: Night shift iliendelea na troubleshooting ya flap lock kwenye OTS aircraft bila turnover proper, wakikuta damage zaidi kwa track 3/4 na discrepancy ya track 1/2 ambayo haijaandikwa na inahitaji follow-up.

narrative_text: Aircraft X (A321) was defueled from 22,000 to 13,000 lbs as a precaution ahead of RH wing INBD fuel pump removal for a reported leak; fuel was subsequently transferred to balance tanks before the mechanic began pump removal per AMM. During removal, the slide valve stayed attached to the pump instead of separating as designed, and the pump could not be reseated, causing a fuel leak from the wing that required spill kit response and fire department notification. Follow-up needed: review AMM procedure/design issue with the slide valve-pump separation, confirm leak source fully contained, and inspect wing tank/pump area before next task card is opened.
summary: During precautionary defuel and fuel pump removal on Aircraft X, the slide valve failed to separate from the pump as designed, causing a wing fuel leak requiring emergency response.

narrative_text: Ndege X (A321) ilipunguziwa mafuta kutoka lbs 22,000 hadi 13,000 kama tahadhari kabla ya kuondoa fuel pump ya bawa la kulia (INBD) iliyokuwa na uvujaji. Mafuta yalihamishwa kusawazisha matangi kabla fundi hajaanza kuondoa pump kwa mujibu wa AMM, lakini wakati wa kuiondoa, slide valve haikutengana na pump kama inavyotakiwa, na pump haikuweza kurudishwa mahali pake, hivyo kusababisha uvujaji wa mafuta kutoka kwenye bawa. Timu ilitumia spill kits na zimamoto waliarifiwa mara moja. Inahitajika ufuatiliaji: kagua utaratibu wa AMM kuhusu kutotengana kwa slide valve na pump, thibitisha uvujaji umezimwa kabisa, na kagua eneo la tangi la bawa kabla ya kazi nyingine kuendelea.
summary: Wakati wa kuondoa fuel pump baada ya kupunguza mafuta kwa tahadhari kwenye Ndege X, slide valve haikutengana na pump kama ilivyopangwa, na kusababisha uvujaji wa mafuta kwenye bawa uliohitaji hatua za dharura.

entities.text: fuel pump ya bawa la kulia (INBD)

narrative_text: Aircraft X (A321) tuli-defuel kutoka 22,000 lbs mpaka 13,000 lbs kama precaution kabla ya kutoa ile RH wing INBD fuel pump iliyokuwa na leak. Fuel ilihamishwa ku-balance matangi before mechanic ku-start removal per AMM, lakini during removal, ile slide valve haiku-separate na pump kama inavyotakiwa, so pump haiku-reseat vizuri na ikasababisha fuel leak kwa wing - tuli-call spill kits na fire department wakanotifiwa immediately. Follow-up inahitajika: check AMM procedure kuhusu hii slide valve/pump design issue, confirm leak imezimwa fully, na inspect wing tank area kabla ya next task card kufunguliwa.
summary: Wakati wa fuel pump removal baada ya precautionary defuel kwa Aircraft X, slide valve haikutoka separate na pump kama designed, na kusababisha fuel leak kwa wing iliyohitaji emergency response.

narrative_text: MD-80 nosewheel steering cable rigging was completed overnight by a heavy maintenance mechanic sent in by the carrier; I was not involved in the repair itself and had just returned from days off with no background on the job. After reviewing the logbook and finding all entries and job card turnovers signed off, I signed the airworthiness release, but it was later found that the required inspection item for the steering work was never entered in the logbook. Next shift please verify that any required inspection item tied to this steering repair is properly logged before further release, and confirm with the mechanic who performed the rigging whether the RII was actually completed.
summary: An MD-80's nosewheel steering repair was signed off as airworthy without the required inspection item being logged, and the next shift needs to confirm proper RII documentation.

narrative_text: Kazi ya kurekebisha nyaya za steering za nosewheel kwenye ndege ya MD-80 ilikamilishwa usiku na fundi wa heavy maintenance aliyetumwa na kampuni; mimi sikuhusika kabisa na kazi hiyo kwani nilikuwa ninatoka likizo ya wikendi bila taarifa yoyote kuhusu ilichofanyika. Baada ya kupitia logbook na kuona sahihi zote za kazi zimekamilika, nilisaini airworthiness, lakini baadaye ikagundulika kuwa required inspection item ya kazi hiyo haikuwahi kuandikwa kwenye logbook. Shift inayofuata tafadhali hakikisheni required inspection item ya kazi ya steering imeandikwa vizuri kabla ya kutoa ndege, na muulize fundi aliyefanya rigging kama RII ilikamilishwa.
summary: Ndege ya MD-80 ilisainiwa kuwa airworthy licha ya required inspection item ya ukarabati wa nosewheel steering kutoandikwa, hivyo shift inayofuata inahitaji kuthibitisha uandikaji sahihi.

narrative_text: Ile MD-80 ilikuwa na nosewheel steering issue, na yule heavy maintenance mechanic kutoka carrier ndiye alifanya rigging ya cables usiku - mimi nilikuwa nimetoka tu weekend off so sikujua chochote kuhusu job hiyo. Nikaangalia logbook, nikaona job cards zote zime-sign off, so nikasign airworthiness pia, lakini baadaye wakaniambia kwamba required inspection item ya hiyo steering job haikuwahi kuingizwa logbook. Next shift please mhakikishe RII imeenter vizuri kwa logbook kabla ya kutoa aircraft, na muconfirm na yule mechanic aliye-rig cables kama alifanya required inspection item.
summary: MD-80 ilisign off kama airworthy lakini required inspection item ya nosewheel steering job haikuandikwa logbook, hivyo next shift wanahitaji ku-verify RII documentation.

narrative_text: Overnight shift completed the wire splice repair on MD-11 (electrical wiring/connectors) in the area affected by the external power/APU and fuel system faults, following on from day shift avionics who ran the new wiring to the electrical center. Repair was done per wiring diagrams and maintenance manuals, and cursory checks were performed with the crew chief and engineer, with work signed off on the job card. Next shift/routing manager must ensure the aircraft is pushed back and engines run to fully verify the fuel system, APU, and #3 engine shutdown function before return to service.
summary: Handover on MD-11 wiring splice repair for electrical/fuel system faults, pending engine-run verification including #3 engine shutdown check.

narrative_text: Zamu ya usiku imekamilisha kazi ya kuunganisha nyaya (splice) kwenye ndege ya MD-11 katika eneo lililokuwa na hitilafu za nguvu ya nje, APU, na mfumo wa mafuta, kufuatia kazi ya awali ya zamu ya mchana ya avionics waliopitisha nyaya mpya hadi kituo cha umeme. Ukarabati ulifanywa kwa kuzingatia michoro ya wiring na miongozo ya matengenezo, na ukaguzi wa awali ulifanyika pamoja na crew chief na engineer, kazi ikathibitishwa kwenye job card. Zamu inayokuja inatakiwa kuhakikisha ndege inasukumwa nje na injini kuwashwa kwa ajili ya uthibitisho kamili wa mifumo hiyo, hasa kuhusiana na tatizo la kuzima injini namba tatu.
summary: Taarifa ya makabidhiano kuhusu ukarabati wa nyaya kwenye MD-11 unaosubiri uthibitisho wa mfumo wa mafuta na injini namba tatu.

entities.text: injini kuwashwa kwa ajili ya uthibitisho

narrative_text: Night shift tume-complete ile wire splice repair kwenye MD-11, kwenye eneo lililokuwa na issues za external power, APU, na fuel system. Tulipokea turnover kutoka day shift avionics ambao walikuwa wame-run new wiring mpaka electrical center, hivyo tuli-splice kwa kutumia wiring diagrams na maintenance manuals, tukafanya cursory checks na crew chief na engineer, kazi ikasainiwa kwenye job card. Next shift lazima ihakikishe aircraft inapushiwa nje na engine ku-run kwa full verification ya fuel system na APU, hasa kwa hiyo issue ya kushut down engine number three.
summary: Handover kwa MD-11 kuhusu wire splice repair ambayo inasubiri engine run verification, especially engine #3 shutdown issue.

narrative_text: On ship XYZ, #1 engine thrust reverser bypass pin was not removed after job card completion, and the aircraft flew one revenue flight where the reverser failed to deploy on landing. Personnel movement was heavy during the shift due to ongoing security interviews of maintenance staff, and the original mechanic assigned to the aircraft was pulled and suspended mid-shift, leaving coverage gaps. Please verify all bypass pins and job card sign-offs on this tail before next dispatch, and confirm reassigned mechanics completed proper handover on all open items.
summary: A thrust reverser bypass pin was left installed after maintenance, causing a reverser deployment failure in flight, amid disrupted staffing from concurrent security interviews.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege XYZ, pini ya bypass ya thrust reverser ya injini namba 1 haikutolewa baada ya kazi ya job card kukamilika, na ndege ilifanya safari moja ambapo thrust reverser haikufunguka wakati wa kutua. Zamu hiyo ilikuwa na msukosuko mkubwa wa wafanyakazi kwa sababu ya mahojiano ya usalama yaliyokuwa yakiendelea, na fundi aliyekuwa amepangiwa ndege hiyo alitolewa na kusimamishwa kazi katikati ya zamu, hali iliyoacha pengo la usimamizi. Tafadhali hakikisheni pini zote za bypass na saini za job card kwenye ndege hii kabla ya safari inayofuata, na thibitisheni mafundi waliopangiwa upya walipokea taarifa kamili za kazi zilizobaki wazi.
summary: Pini ya bypass ya thrust reverser iliachwa ikiwa imewekwa baada ya matengenezo, na kusababisha reverser kushindwa kufunguka wakati wa ndege, huku wafanyakazi wakiwa wamevurugika kutokana na mahojiano ya usalama yaliyokuwa yakiendelea.

entities.text: pini ya bypass ya thrust reverser ya injini namba 1

narrative_text: Ship XYZ, baada ya job card kukamilika kwa #1 engine, thrust reverser bypass pin haikutolewa, na aircraft ikafanya flight moja tu reverser ikashindwa deploy wakati wa landing. Zamu ilikuwa na msukosuko sana kwa sababu ya interviews za security zilizokuwa zikiendelea, mechanic aliyekuwa assigned kwa hiyo aircraft alichukuliwa na kusimamishwa mid-shift, so kulikuwa na coverage gap. Tafadhali confirm bypass pins zote na job card sign-offs kwenye hii tail kabla ya next dispatch, na hakikisha mechanics walio-reassigned walipata proper handover ya open items zote.
summary: Bypass pin ya thrust reverser iliachwa kwenye #1 engine baada ya maintenance, ikasababisha reverser kushindwa deploy in-flight, wakati staffing ilikuwa disrupted na security interviews.

narrative_text: During engine maintenance on the MD-11, the #1 pylon thrust reverser was pinned per L1011-style lockout habit, but no log entry was made and it was not communicated at shift turnover. Aircraft was released to service and later had to air turn-back after a passenger noticed a flapping panel on the #1 pylon; the lockout pin was found still installed on arrival at the gate. Next shift must verify all reverser pins are removed/logged before release, and job cards need updating since the access panel closes flush and gives no visual indication of pin status from the ground.
summary: An MD-11 thrust reverser lockout pin was left installed and unlogged at turnover, causing an air turn-back, highlighting a need for improved pin-tracking procedures.

narrative_text: Wakati wa matengenezo ya injini kwenye ndege ya MD-11, pini ya kufunga thrust reverser kwenye pylon namba 1 iliwekwa kwa mtindo unaotumika kwenye L1011, lakini hakuna kumbukumbu iliyoandikwa wala taarifa iliyotolewa wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu. Ndege iliruhusiwa kuendelea na safari na baadaye ilirudi uwanjani kwa sababu abiria aliona paneli ikipepea kwenye pylon namba 1; ilipofika geti, pini ya kufunga ilikutwa bado imewekwa. Zamu inayofuata inapaswa kuhakikisha pini zote zimeondolewa na kuandikwa kwenye rekodi kabla ya ndege kuruhusiwa kusafiri, na taratibu za kazi zinahitaji kurekebishwa kwa kuwa paneli ya ufikiaji hufunga sawasawa na ganda la ndege bila kuonyesha hali ya pini kutoka nje.
summary: Pini ya thrust reverser ya ndege ya MD-11 iliachwa imewekwa bila kuandikwa wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu, jambo lililosababisha ndege kurudi uwanjani, na kuonyesha haja ya kuboresha taratibu za ufuatiliaji wa pini.

narrative_text: Wakati wa maintenance ya engine kwenye MD-11, ile thrust reverser ya #1 pylon ili-pinned kwa style ya L1011, lakini hakuna log entry ilifanywa na hakuna aliye-inform during turnover. Aircraft ili-released for service na ikabidi i-turn-back mid-air baada ya pax ku-notice panel iki-flap kwenye #1 pylon; ilipofika gate, ile lockout pin ilikutwa bado imewekwa. Next shift lazima wa-verify pins zote zimeondolewa na ku-log kabla ya release, na job cards zinahitaji ku-updated kwa sababu ile access panel inafunga flush bila kuonyesha status ya pin kutoka ground.
summary: Thrust reverser lockout pin ya MD-11 iliachwa imewekwa bila kuandikwa during turnover, ikasababisha air turn-back, na inaonyesha need ya kuboresha pin tracking procedures.

narrative_text: DC-10 30F: previous shift had #2 engine reverser reactivated for troubleshooting, throttle reverse block removed and inop procedures cleared, but this was not verbally briefed to the incoming lead technician during turnover. Two mechanics were only told to close #2 fan cowls and stow the work platform, which was done and the aircraft was dispatched with the reverser deferred as inop but not mechanically locked out per MEL. The reactivation entry was logged in the electronic maintenance logbook but was never pulled up or reviewed by the lead, technician, or helper before dispatch; recommend verifying #2 reverser status and confirming electronic logbook entries are actively cross-checked at every shift turnover, not just filed.
summary: A DC-10 30F was dispatched with the #2 engine reverser improperly deferred/not locked out because a verbal shift-turnover briefing omitted a reactivation detail that was only recorded in the electronic maintenance logbook.

entities.text: close #2 fan cowls and stow the work platform

narrative_text: Kwa ndege ya DC-10 30F, shift iliyopita ilikuwa imewasha tena reverser ya injini namba 2 kwa ajili ya troubleshooting, na vizuizi vya throttle reverse na taratibu za inop ziliondolewa, lakini hii haikuelezwa kwa mdomo kwa fundi kiongozi wa zamu iliyofuata wakati wa turnover. Mafundi wawili waliambiwa tu wafunge fan cowls za injini namba 2 na kurudisha jukwaa la kazi mahali pake, jambo lililofanyika, kisha ndege ikaruhusiwa kuruka huku reverser ikiwa imewekwa kama inop bila kufungwa kikamilifu kama MEL inavyotaka. Taarifa ya kuwashwa tena ilikuwepo kwenye logbook ya kielektroniki lakini haikuangaliwa na fundi kiongozi, fundi aliyeripoti, wala msaidizi kabla ya kuruhusu ndege kuondoka; inashauriwa hali ya reverser namba 2 ithibitishwe na kila taarifa ya logbook ya kielektroniki isomwe kikamilifu wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu.
summary: Ndege ya DC-10 30F iliruhusiwa kuondoka huku reverser ya injini namba 2 ikiwa haijafungwa ipasavyo kwa sababu taarifa muhimu ya turnover haikusemwa kwa mdomo bali iliachwa tu kwenye logbook ya kielektroniki isiyoangaliwa.

entities.text: kufunga fan cowls na kurudisha jukwaa la kazi

narrative_text: Kwa hii DC-10 30F, shift ya jana walikuwa wame-reactivate #2 engine reverser kwa troubleshooting, wakaremove throttle reverse block na wakaclear inop procedures, lakini hakuna aliyebrief lead technician mpya about hiyo during turnover. Sisi wawili tuliambiwa tu tu-close #2 fan cowls na turudishe work platform, tulifanya hivyo, ndege ikaenda ika-dispatch na reverser ikiwa deferred as inop lakini haikuwa locked out kama MEL inavyorequire. Hiyo reactivation entry ilikuwa imeandikwa kwenye electronic logbook lakini hakuna aliye-pull up ku-check, si lead, si mimi, wala helper; tafadhali verify status ya #2 reverser na hakikisha kila mtu ana-cross-check electronic logbook entries kabla ya turnover, siyo kuiacha tu system.
summary: DC-10 30F ilidispatch na #2 reverser haiko locked out ipasavyo kwa sababu turnover brief haikutaja reactivation ambayo ilikuwa tu logged kwenye electronic logbook na hakuna aliyeicheck.

entities.text: close #2 fan cowls na turudishe work platform

narrative_text: B737-200, ship on #2 engine oil filter cavity repair: Y shift machinist skipped the skim cut since the cavity was not out of round, and therefore never called for the required final powerplant inspection before sign-off. X shift mechanic went ahead with the pressure test, reinstalled the filter and cap, torqued the studs, and completed the engine run leak check assuming prior steps were done. Z shift inspector signed the logbook based on gearbox and machine shop turnover notes stating all steps were complete, but later phoned the Y shift inspector at home (~0430) and discovered the final powerplant inspection was never actually performed. Inspection supervisor has been notified; need to track down the Y shift machinist to confirm whether an inspector was ever called, and re-verify the oil filter cavity before the aircraft returns to service.
summary: A required final powerplant inspection on a B737-200's #2 engine oil filter cavity repair was never performed, but was mistakenly logged as complete due to a breakdown in shift-to-shift communication.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya B737-200, ukarabati wa kizuizi cha filter ya mafuta ya engine namba mbili ulikuwa unaendelea. Fundi wa mashine wa shift ya Y hakufanya ile skim cut kwa sababu shimo halikuwa nje ya roundness, hivyo hakumwita inspector kufanya ukaguzi wa mwisho wa powerplant kama utaratibu unavyotaka. Fundi wa shift ya X akaendelea na pressure test, akarudisha filter na cap, akakaza studs, na akaomba engine run leak check bila kujua hatua ya ukaguzi haikufanyika. Inspector wa shift ya Z alitia sahihi kwenye logbook akidhani kazi zote zimekamilika kulingana na taarifa za mabadiliko ya shift kutoka gearbox na machine shop, lakini baadaye alipiga simu nyumbani kwa inspector wa shift ya Y saa za asubuhi na kugundua kuwa ukaguzi wa mwisho haujafanyika kabisa. Msimamizi wa ukaguzi ameshaarifiwa; inahitajika kumpata fundi wa mashine wa shift ya Y kuthibitisha kama aliwahi kumwita inspector, na kufanya tena uhakiki wa kizuizi cha filter kabla ndege kurudi kazini.
summary: Ukaguzi wa mwisho wa powerplant kwenye ukarabati wa filter ya mafuta ya engine ya B737-200 haukufanyika, ila ulisainiwa kimakosa kwenye logbook kutokana na mawasiliano mabovu kati ya shift.

entities.text: kizuizi cha filter ya mafuta ya engine namba mbili
Fundi wa mashine wa shift ya Y

narrative_text: Kwa hii B737-200, kuna repair ya #2 engine oil filter cavity ambayo ilikuwa inaendelea. Yule machinist wa Y shift hakufanya skim cut kwa sababu hole haikuwa out of round, so hakucall inspector for final powerplant inspection kama procedure inavyotaka. Halafu X shift mechanic akaenda mbele na pressure test, akareinstall filter na cap, akatorque studs, akarequest engine run leak check akidhani kila kitu kimefanywa. Z shift inspector akasign logbook kwa sababu turnover kutoka gearbox shop na machine shop ilisay kila kitu kimekamilika, lakini alipopiga simu kwa Y shift inspector nyumbani around 0430 akajua final powerplant inspection haijafanyika kabisa. Inspection supervisor ameshanotified; tunahitaji kumfind Y shift machinist kuconfirm kama aliwahi kucall inspector, na tuverify tena hiyo oil filter cavity kabla aircraft irudi service.
summary: Final powerplant inspection kwenye #2 engine oil filter cavity ya B737-200 haikufanyika lakini ilisainiwa kimakosa kwenye logbook due to poor shift handover communication.

narrative_text: The Change Order Auth job cards for the A320 cowling were missing from the system for most of the shift; maintenance control only delivered the paperwork late, close to end of shift. While completing the cards, my co-worker and I went straight to the text steps and illustrations but did not reference the TOD document at the front of the package, so step G's latch security check was not flagged as a Required Inspection Item and no inspector signed it off. This was only caught the next day when a union steward mentioned a similar miss on another aircraft's same Change Order Auth. Follow-up: confirm an inspector has since completed the RII latch inspection on our tail number and the TOD document is properly closed out.
summary: A Change Order Auth on an A320 cowling was completed without the required RII latch inspection because the TOD document was overlooked, and this needs inspector sign-off follow-up.

narrative_text: Karatasi za Change Order Auth za cowling ya ndege ya A320 hazikuwepo mfumoni kwa muda mrefu wa shift; idara ya maintenance ilileta nyaraka hizo taratibu, karibu na mwisho wa kazi. Mimi na mfanyakazi mwenzangu tulianza kazi moja kwa moja tukisoma maandishi na michoro bila kuangalia hati ya TOD iliyokuwa mwanzoni mwa pakiti, hivyo hatua ya G ya kukagua usalama wa latches haikutambuliwa kama Required Inspection Item na hakuna inspector aliyeidhinisha. Jambo hili ligundulika siku iliyofuata baada ya union steward kutaja tatizo linalofanana kwenye ndege nyingine yenye Change Order Auth ile ile. Kinachohitajika: kuthibitisha kwamba inspector amefanya ukaguzi wa RII wa latches kwenye ndege yetu na hati ya TOD imekamilishwa vizuri.
summary: Change Order Auth ya cowling ya A320 ilikamilishwa bila ukaguzi wa RII wa latches kwa sababu hati ya TOD haikuangaliwa, na jambo hili linahitaji ufuatiliaji wa haraka kwa inspector.

narrative_text: Hii Change Order Auth job cards za cowling ya A320 hazikuwa kwa system mpaka late sana kwa shift, maintenance walileta paperwork almost mwisho wa shift. Mimi na co-worker tulistart kazi tukisoma tu text na illustrations, hatuku-refer TOD document iliyokuwa mbele ya package, so step G ya kukagua latches for security haikuflaggiwa kama Required Inspection Item na hakuna inspector aliye-sign off. Tuligundua tu siku iliyofuata wakati union steward alitaja same issue kwa ndege nyingine yenye Change Order Auth hiyo hiyo. Follow-up: confirm inspector amefanya RII latch inspection kwa tail number yetu na TOD document imekamilika properly.
summary: Change Order Auth ya A320 cowling ilikamilika bila RII inspection ya latches kwa sababu TOD document ilipuuzwa, hivyo inahitajika follow-up ya inspector.

narrative_text: Overtime shift on the B737-200 trailing edge flap transmission: previous shift reported a bearing had failed and needed replacement, sourced from a flap transmission arriving from ATL. Turnover instructions said to pull the bearing assembly off the incoming unit and install it on the aircraft transmission, but no rigging details or checks were passed on, and the job was completed in under an hour based on assumption rather than confirmed data. Next shift please verify rigging requirements were not missed and confirm bearing assembly installation was properly documented and signed off.
summary: A bearing assembly swap on a B737-200 flap transmission was completed based on an incomplete shift turnover, raising concern about missed rigging verification.

entities.text: install it on the aircraft transmission

narrative_text: Wakati wa kazi ya ziada kwenye ndege ya B737-200, nilipokea taarifa kuwa bearing ya flap transmission ilikuwa imeharibika na ilihitaji kubadilishwa, ikitolewa kutoka kwa transmission nyingine iliyokuwa ikisafirishwa kutoka ATL. Maelekezo niliyopewa wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu hayakuwa kamili kuhusu taratibu za urekebishaji zinazohitajika, hivyo kazi ilifanywa kwa muda mfupi wa chini ya saa moja bila uhakika kamili wa hatua zote. Zamu ijayo iangalie tena kama ukaguzi na uwekaji wa hati ulifanyika ipasavyo kabla ya kuruhusu ndege kuendelea na safari.
summary: Ubadilishaji wa bearing kwenye flap transmission ya B737-200 ulifanyika kwa msingi wa maelekezo yasiyo kamili ya zamu, hivyo ukaguzi wa ziada unahitajika.

narrative_text: Niliingia overtime kwenye B737-200 na turnover ilisema kuna bearing imeharibika kwenye flap transmission, na tulipaswa kui-rob kutoka kwa transmission nyingine iliyokuwa inatoka ATL. Ile turnover haikuwa na details za rigging au ni checks gani zilifanyika, so nikafanya install ya bearing assembly kwa mikono tu, job ikachukua chini ya saa moja. Next shift ni lazima wa-verify kama rigging requirements na documentation ziko sawa kabla ya kusign off ile job.
summary: Bearing assembly ilibadilishwa kwenye flap transmission ya B737-200 kwa msingi wa turnover isiyo kamili, hivyo verification zaidi inahitajika.

narrative_text: During the #2 layover check on the MD-11, I completed the C1, C2 and C3 cargo compartment inspections under Item 45, except for cycling the C3 cargo door, which was passed on as a verbal turnover due to time pressure. The incoming technician should confirm the C3 door cycle was actually completed before further dispatch. Inspection was signed off and witnessed prior to departure, but please verify the verbal turnover was closed out properly.
summary: Technician handed over verbal turnover for uncompleted C3 cargo door cycle check on MD-11 during layover inspection.

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa layover namba mbili kwa ndege ya MD-11, nilikamilisha ukaguzi wa sehemu za mizigo C1, C2 na C3 kama ilivyoainishwa kwenye Item 45, isipokuwa kufungua na kufunga mlango wa C3 ambao niliuachia mfanyakazi mwingine kwa maelezo ya mdomo kutokana na uchache wa muda. Fundi atakayeendelea na kazi anaombwa kuthibitisha kuwa zoezi hilo la mlango wa C3 limekamilika kabla ya ndege kuruka tena. Ukaguzi ulikamilika na kushuhudiwa kabla ya ndege kuondoka, lakini tafadhali hakikisha maelezo yale ya mdomo yamefuatiliwa ipasavyo.
summary: Fundi aliachia maelezo ya mdomo kuhusu ukaguzi usiokamilika wa mlango wa C3 kwenye ndege ya MD-11.

narrative_text: Kwa hii #2 layover check ya MD-11, nilifanya inspection ya C1, C2 na C3 cargo compartments kama Item 45 inavyotaka, lakini cycling ya C3 cargo door sikuweza kufanya kwa sababu ya time pressure, so niliachia verbal turnover kwa next technician. Mtu atakaye-take over anaombwa akonfirm door cycle imefanywa kabla ya dispatch. Inspection ilikuwa signed off na kuwitnessed before departure, lakini please verify ile verbal turnover imefuatiliwa properly.
summary: Technician aliachia verbal turnover ya C3 cargo door cycle check ambayo haikukamilika kwenye MD-11 layover inspection.

narrative_text: During takeoff roll the DC-9 30 crew could not keep the nosewheel tracking on the runway at 80 kts and the takeoff was aborted; aircraft returned to gate. Investigation traced the cause to the recent L-Check where both elevator power control actuating cylinders and universal joints were replaced, and the elevator rod ends on both left and right sides were reinstalled without proper torque and safetying. Please ensure all mechanics involved in the reassembly are re-briefed on rod end torque/safety procedures and confirm sign-off documentation is reviewed before next flight release.
summary: A DC-9 30 aborted takeoff due to nosewheel control issues traced to improperly torqued and unsafetied elevator rod ends from a recent L-Check, requiring documentation review and crew re-briefing.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kukimbia kabla ya kuruka, ndege ya DC-9 30 ilishindwa kudhibiti gurudumu la mbele kwenye njia ya kurukia ikiwa na spidi ya 80 kts, hivyo marubani walisimamisha safari na ndege kurudishwa geti. Uchunguzi ulibaini kuwa tatizo lilitokana na kazi ya L-Check iliyofanyika hivi karibuni, ambapo mabomba ya kudhibiti elevator na viungo vyake vilibadilishwa, lakini sehemu za mwisho za fimbo za elevator upande wa kushoto na kulia hazikufungwa vizuri kwa torque wala kuwekewa usalama unaostahili. Tafadhali hakikisha mafundi wote waliohusika wanapewa mafunzo tena kuhusu taratibu za torque na usalama, na nyaraka za kazi zikaguliwe kabla ya ndege kuruhusiwa kuruka tena.
summary: Ndege ya DC-9 30 ilisimamisha safari kwa sababu ya tatizo la gurudumu la mbele lililotokana na sehemu za elevator zisizofungwa vizuri baada ya L-Check, hivyo kunahitajika ukaguzi wa nyaraka na mafunzo tena kwa mafundi.

entities.text: sehemu za mwisho za fimbo za elevator

narrative_text: During takeoff roll, hii DC-9 30 crew walishindwa ku-control nosewheel kwenye runway at 80 kts, so wakaabort takeoff na ndege ikarudi gate. Investigation ikaonyesha kwamba tatizo lilitoka kwa L-Check ya hivi karibuni, where elevator power control actuating cylinders na universal joints zilibadilishwa, lakini elevator rod ends za left na right hazikuwa torqued wala safetied properly wakati wa reassembly. Tafadhali hakikisha mechanics wote walio-involve wanapewa re-briefing kuhusu torque na safety procedures, na documentation i-review kabla ya next flight release.
summary: DC-9 30 iliabort takeoff kwa sababu ya nosewheel control issue iliyosababishwa na elevator rod ends ambazo hazikuwa torqued/safetied vizuri baada ya L-Check, hivyo inahitajika review ya documentation na re-briefing ya mechanics.

narrative_text: On #1 engine of the DC-10, we removed the reverser drive motor and overpressure shutoff valve, then installed a new drive motor with the 4 mount bolts; only the short duct section directly below the motor was disconnected. Next shift was briefed in detail before turnover. Be aware the aircraft later had an inflight shutdown due to a fire warning, traced to a duct clamp near the regulator valve about 4 ft from our work area, not the section we touched. Reversers, overpressure shutoff valve and wiring harness have since been replaced by another crew; recommend continued monitoring given this engine's chronic reverser history.
summary: Reverser drive motor replacement on #1 engine was followed by an unrelated duct clamp failure causing an inflight shutdown, prompting further repairs and continued monitoring.

entities.text: installed a new drive motor with the 4 mount bolts
inflight shutdown due to a fire warning

narrative_text: Kwenye injini namba 1 ya ndege ya DC-10, tuliondoa motor ya kuendesha reverser pamoja na valve ya kuzuia overpressure, kisha tukafunga motor mpya kwa bolti nne za kushikilia; sehemu pekee ya duct iliyoguswa ni ile fupi iliyo chini kabisa ya motor. Zamu iliyofuata ilielezwa vizuri kabla ya kuachiwa kazi. Ni muhimu kufahamu kuwa baadaye ndege ilifanya inflight shutdown kutokana na tahadhari ya moto, ambayo ilisababishwa na clamp ya duct karibu na regulator valve, umbali wa futi nne kutoka mahali tulipokuwa tukifanyia kazi. Reversers, valve ya overpressure na waya zilizoharibika zimeshabadilishwa na wafanyakazi wengine; inashauriwa ufuatiliaji zaidi kwani injini hii ina historia ya matatizo ya mara kwa mara kwenye reverser.
summary: Ubadilishaji wa motor ya reverser kwenye injini namba 1 ulifuatiwa na tatizo lisilo husiana la clamp ya duct lililosababisha inflight shutdown, hivyo kuhitaji ukarabati zaidi na ufuatiliaji.

entities.text: kufunga motor mpya kwa bolti nne
inflight shutdown kutokana na tahadhari ya moto

narrative_text: Kwa #1 engine ya DC-10, tuli-remove reverser drive motor na overpressure shutoff valve, kisha tuka-install drive motor mpya na zile 4 mount bolts; ni duct section moja tu fupi chini ya motor ndio ilifunguliwa. Next shift walipewa full briefing kabla ya turnover. Lakini msikie, baadaye ndege ilifanya inflight shutdown kwa sababu ya fire warning, na cause ilikuwa duct clamp karibu na regulator valve, kama futi 4 kutoka mahali tulikuwa tuna-work, si sehemu tuliyogusa. Reversers, overpressure shutoff valve na wiring harness zimeshabadilishwa na crew ingine; tafadhali endeleeni ku-monitor coz engine hii ina chronic history ya reverser issues.
summary: Baada ya kubadilisha reverser drive motor kwenye #1 engine, kulitokea inflight shutdown isiyo husiana na duct clamp failure, hivyo kuna haja ya follow-up na monitoring zaidi.

entities.text: install drive motor mpya na zile 4 mount bolts
inflight shutdown kwa sababu ya fire warning

narrative_text: B757-200 was in for the L pack heater repair plus several logbook write-ups; with limited manpower on shift we prioritized the logbook items, including the #1 engine pneumatic bleed system deferral that is close to MEL time limits. Not all items were completed by end of shift - I gave the incoming foreman a verbal turnover and marked the item 'in work' in the system. Next shift needs to close out the bleed system fix before the MEL clock expires, please confirm status before release.
summary: Incoming shift must urgently complete the #1 engine pneumatic bleed system repair on the B757-200 before it exceeds MEL time limits, following incomplete logbook work from the previous shift.

narrative_text: Ndege ya B757-200 ilikuwa na kazi ya kurekebisha L pack heater pamoja na maandishi kadhaa ya logbook ambayo bado hayajashughulikiwa. Kwa sababu ya upungufu wa wafanyakazi kwenye shift yetu, tulilazimika kuweka kipaumbele kwenye maandishi ya logbook, ikiwa ni pamoja na tatizo la mfumo wa pneumatic bleed wa injini namba moja ambalo linakaribia kufikia muda wake wa mwisho kulingana na MEL. Kazi hazikukamilika kabla ya shift yangu kuisha, hivyo nilimpa foreman taarifa ya mdomo kuhusu kazi zilizobaki na nikaweka alama kwenye mfumo kuonyesha kazi 'inaendelea.' Shift inayofuata inahitajika kukamilisha ukarabati wa mfumo wa bleed haraka kabla muda wa MEL haujaisha.
summary: Shift inayofuata inapaswa kukamilisha haraka ukarabati wa mfumo wa pneumatic bleed wa injini namba moja kwenye ndege ya B757-200 kabla ya muda wa MEL kuisha.

entities.text: mfumo wa pneumatic bleed wa injini namba moja

narrative_text: Hii B757-200 ilikuwa scheduled kwa L pack heater repair plus kuna logbook write-ups kadhaa ambazo zilikuwa zimebaki. Manpower ilikuwa low kwa shift yangu so tulilazimika ku-prioritize logbook items kwanza, including ile #1 engine pneumatic bleed system ambayo iko deferred na inakaribia kutoka nje ya MEL time limits asubuhi. Sikumaliza kila kitu by end of shift, so nilimpa foreman verbal turnover na nika-mark kwenye system kama 'in work'. Next shift lazima wa-confirm status ya bleed system na wai-close out kabla MEL haija-expire.
summary: Next shift wanahitaji ku-close out haraka ile #1 engine pneumatic bleed system fix kwenye B757-200 kabla ya kuvuka MEL time limits.

narrative_text: Took over from swing shift on the DC-10 #1 reverser system pneumatic drive motor and overpressure valve installation, including associated ducting. Completed the installation and ran a leak check on all components I installed, with no leaks noted at that time. On the outbound flight a duct in the shared work area came loose, causing an inflight shutdown and return to field; the issue was corrected at the gate before dispatch. Follow-up needed: confirm exactly which clamp/fitting failed, since there is conflicting information between shifts on the root cause.
summary: A duct clamp in a shared work area on the DC-10 #1 reverser system came loose after shift handover, causing an inflight shutdown, and the exact failure point is still unconfirmed.

narrative_text: Nilipokea kazi kutoka kwa zamu ya jioni kuhusu ufungaji wa motor ya pneumatic drive na overpressure valve pamoja na ducting za mfumo wa #1 reverser wa ndege ya DC-10. Nilimaliza ufungaji na kufanya ukaguzi wa uvujaji hewa kwenye vipengele nilivyofunga, na hakuna uvujaji uliopatikana wakati huo. Katika safari iliyofuata, bomba katika eneo lile ambalo zamu zote mbili zilikuwa zikifanyia kazi lililegea, na kusababisha injini kuzimwa hewani na ndege kurudi uwanjani; tatizo lilirekebishwa langoni kabla ya kuruhusiwa kuruka tena. Inahitajika ufuatiliaji zaidi kubaini ni clamp gani hasa iliyolegea, kwani kuna taarifa zinazokinzana kati ya zamu mbili kuhusu chanzo halisi.
summary: Bomba katika eneo la kazi lililoshirikiwa na zamu mbili kwenye mfumo wa #1 reverser wa DC-10 lililegea baada ya kukabidhiwa kazi, na kusababisha ndege kurudi uwanjani, huku chanzo hasa kikiwa bado hakijathibitishwa.

entities.text: eneo lile ambalo zamu zote mbili zilikuwa zikifanyia kazi

narrative_text: Nilichukua turnover kutoka swing shift kwa ile installation ya pneumatic drive motor na overpressure valve, plus ducting za #1 reverser system ya DC-10. Nilimaliza installation na nikafanya leak check kwa components zote nilizofunga, hakuna leak iliyoonekana that time. Lakini kwa outbound flight, duct kwenye area ambayo both shifts zilikuwa zinafanyia kazi ililegea, ikasababisha inflight shutdown na ndege ikarudi field. Tatizo lilifixiwa palepale gate kabla flight haijaenda tena, but tunahitaji kufollow up kujua ni clamp gani hasa ilikuwa loose kwa sababu kuna conflicting info kati ya shifts.
summary: Duct kwenye area ambayo shifts mbili zilikuwa zikifanya kazi ililegea kwenye #1 reverser system ya DC-10, ikasababisha inflight shutdown, na bado hatujajua ni clamp gani exactly ilifail.

entities.text: area ambayo both shifts zilikuwa zinafanyia kazi

narrative_text: B767-300ER left engine hydraulic pump job was passed through four different shift handovers before completion, and the logbook entry noting case drain and pressure filters removed with housing loosely installed was never verbally reiterated. Incoming technician completed hose/filter housing tightening and proceeded straight to cockpit for engine run without checking the logbook, skipping the required filter contamination check. Upon later removing the housing it was found that no filters were installed at all. Next shift must verbally confirm all open logbook items on multi-shift jobs, especially hydraulic filter status, before any engine run is attempted.
summary: A B767 left engine hydraulic pump job handed over across four shifts led to an engine run being performed without filters installed because the logbook note was not verbally reiterated.

narrative_text: Kazi ya pump ya hydraulic ya engine ya kushoto ya B767-300ER ilipitishwa kwa zamu nne tofauti kabla ya kukamilika, na kumbukumbu ya logbook iliyosema filters za case drain na pressure ziliondolewa na housing kufungwa kwa ulegevu haikuwahi kusemwa kwa mdomo kati ya mafundi. Fundi aliyekuja baadaye alimaliza kukaza hoses na housing kisha akaenda moja kwa moja kufanya engine run bila kuangalia logbook, na hivyo kukosa ukaguzi wa lazima wa uchafu kwenye filter. Baadaye ilipofunguliwa housing ilibainika kuwa hazikuwa na filters kabisa. Zamu inayofuata inatakiwa kuthibitisha kwa mdomo vipengele vyote wazi vya logbook kwenye kazi zinazopitishwa zamu nyingi, hasa hali ya filters za hydraulic, kabla ya kufanya engine run yoyote.
summary: Kazi ya pump ya hydraulic ya B767 iliyopitishwa zamu nne ilisababisha engine run kufanywa bila filters kuwekwa kwa sababu kumbukumbu ya logbook haikusemwa kwa mdomo.

narrative_text: Ile job ya left engine hydraulic pump ya B767-300ER ilipita zamu nne tofauti kabla ya kukamilika, na logbook entry iliyosema pressure filters ziliondolewa na housing kufungwa loosely haikurudiwa verbally kwa yeyote. Fundi aliyekuja alimaliza kukaza hoses na filter housing kisha akaenda cockpit straight kufanya engine run bila hata kuangalia logbook, akaskip ile filter contamination check ilivyotakiwa. Baadaye tuligundua housing haina filters kabisa - hakuna aliyekuwa amesema chochote. Zamu inayofuata lazima ihakikishe logbook items zote za multi-shift job zinapitiwa verbally, hasa status ya hydraulic filters, kabla ya ku-attempt engine run yoyote.
summary: Job ya B767 hydraulic pump iliyopita zamu nne iliishia na engine run kufanyika bila filters kuwekwa kwa sababu logbook note haikurudiwa verbally.

narrative_text: B737-400 (tail assigned for gear/flap damage rectification) had the left-hand inboard trailing edge aft flap signed off as installed and rigged by prior shift mechanic and inspector, but on inspection the eccentric dead-weight rollers were badly out of rig, loose enough to cause severe vibration in service. Re-rigged the flap this shift and walked a new line mechanic through the correct procedure, since the flap ships from the shop with cotter keys installed but unrigged. Next shift needs to verify the sign-off/logbook discrepancy is reported and confirm no other flap surfaces from this aircraft were signed off without proper rig checks.
summary: A left inboard aft flap on a B737-400 was falsely signed off as rigged by the previous shift, requiring re-rig and follow-up on the paperwork discrepancy.

entities.text: left-hand inboard trailing edge aft flap

narrative_text: Ndege ya B737-400 iliyokuwa ikirekebishwa baada ya uharibifu wa gia na flap ilikuwa na flap ya nyuma ya ndani upande wa kushoto ambayo ilisainiwa na fundi na mkaguzi wa zamu iliyopita kuwa imewekwa na ku-rigiwa vizuri, lakini wakati wa ukaguzi ilionekana rollers za eccentric hazikuwa sawa kabisa, na hii ingeweza kusababisha mtetemo mkubwa wakati wa safari. Katika zamu hii, flap hiyo imerekebishwa upya na fundi mpya wa line amefundishwa jinsi ya kufanya kazi hiyo kwa usahihi, kwani flap hutoka workshop ikiwa na cotter keys zimewekwa lakini haijapangwa vizuri. Zamu inayofuata inahitajika kuripoti tofauti hii ya saini kwenye logbook na kuhakikisha hakuna sehemu nyingine za flap za ndege hii zilizosainiwa bila ukaguzi sahihi wa urekebishaji.
summary: Flap ya nyuma ya ndani upande wa kushoto ya ndege ya B737-400 ilisainiwa kimakosa kuwa imerekebishwa na zamu iliyopita, hivyo ikahitaji kufanyiwa kazi upya na kufuatiliwa kwa tofauti ya nyaraka.

entities.text: flap ya nyuma ya ndani upande wa kushoto
kuripoti tofauti hii ya saini kwenye logbook

narrative_text: Hiyo B737-400 ambayo ilikuwa na damage kwa gear na flaps, ile L-hand inboard aft flap ilikuwa imesainiwa na mech na inspector wa shift iliyopita kwamba imewekwa na kurigiwa, lakini nikacheck nikaona eccentric rollers ziko out of rig kabisa, loose sana, ingeeza cause vibration kubwa in flight. Nimeirig upya hiyo flap saa hii shift na nimeshow new line mech vile procedure inaenda, kwa sababu flap inatoka shop na cotter keys zimewekwa lakini haijarigiwa. Next shift wanahitaji ku-report hiyo discrepancy ya logbook sign-off na ku-confirm kama kuna flap zingine za hiyo aircraft zilisainiwa bila proper rig check.
summary: Ile L-hand aft flap ya B737-400 ilisainiwa vibaya na shift iliyopita ati imerigiwa, so ilibidi tuirig upya na kufuatilia hiyo discrepancy ya paperwork.

entities.text: ku-report hiyo discrepancy ya logbook sign-off

narrative_text: A320 fuel booster pump was replaced per the maintenance manual; only the leak check and cover installation remained at shift change, and this was logged accordingly. Daylight shift reportedly found the pump leaking, but the subsequent removal, O-ring reseal, and reinstallation done by two different technicians was never logged. Follow-up: a wiring fault was later found and repaired, and on ops check the pump fell out of the wing, so the undocumented removal/reinstall needs to be traced and the logbook record corrected before the aircraft comes off MEL.
summary: An undocumented pump removal and reinstallation by the following shift left an incomplete logbook trail, and the pump later fell out of the wing during an ops check.

narrative_text: Pampu ya mafuta (fuel booster pump) ya ndege ya A320 ilibadilishwa kufuatana na mwongozo wa matengenezo; wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu, kilichobaki ni ukaguzi wa uvujaji na kufunga kifuniko, jambo ambalo liliandikwa vizuri kwenye logbook. Zamu ya mchana iligundua kuwa pampu bado inavuja, na mafundi wawili tofauti waliondoa na kurudisha pampu baada ya kubadilisha O-ring, lakini hawakuandika hatua hiyo kwenye logbook. Baadaye tatizo la nyaya liligunduliwa na kutengenezwa, na wakati wa ukaguzi wa uendeshaji pampu ilianguka kutoka kwenye bawa; hivyo ni muhimu kufuatilia hatua zilizokosa kuandikwa na kusahihisha rekodi kabla ndege haijarudi kwenye huduma.
summary: Kutokuandikwa kwa uondoaji na urudishaji wa pampu ya mafuta na zamu iliyofuata kulisababisha mkanganyiko, na baadaye pampu ilianguka kutoka kwenye bawa wakati wa ukaguzi.

narrative_text: Tulichange fuel booster pump ya A320 kufuatana na maintenance manual; ilibaki tu leak check na kufit cover ndio job iishe, na nikaweka logbook entry kabla ya kuenda. Daylight crew wakaja wakasema pump bado inaleak, wakaremove na kuinstall tena baada ya kubadilisha O-rings, lakini hawakudocument hiyo action kwenye logbook. Baadaye wakapata wiring fault wakairepair, halafu wakati wa ops check pump ikaanguka kabisa kutoka wing - so tunahitaji kutrace hiyo undocumented removal/reinstall na kusahihisha logbook kabla aircraft haijarudi kwenye service.
summary: Kuna undocumented removal na reinstallation ya fuel booster pump iliyofanywa na daylight crew, and later pump ilianguka from the wing during ops check.

narrative_text: On B767-200, prior shift reported the #2 IDG (internal drive generator) replacement complete and asked that the feeder cable be spliced back before push to gate. In the rush to release the aircraft, I signed off airworthiness without confirming that the RII (Required Inspection Item) sign-off for the IDG change was logged, and the logbook had no such entry.
