Next shift please verify the RII inspection for the #2 IDG has been properly documented and independently signed before further dispatch, since this is an ETOPS aircraft requiring direct communication between shifts on RII items.
summary: A rushed handover on a B767-200 led to an unsigned RII inspection for a #2 IDG replacement, requiring urgent verification before further flight release.

narrative_text: Kwa ndege B767-200, zamu iliyopita ilieleza kuwa kubadilisha #2 IDG (jenereta ya ndani) kulikamilika na kutakiwa niunge tena feeder cable kabla ndege haijasogezwa kwenda geti. Kwa haraka ya kutaka kuiachilia ndege, nilisaini airworthiness bila kuthibitisha kama saini ya RII (Required Inspection Item) kwa mabadiliko ya IDG ilikuwa imeandikwa, na logbook haikuwa na kumbukumbu hiyo. Zamu inayofuata tafadhali hakikisheni ukaguzi wa RII kwa #2 IDG umeandikwa na kusainiwa ipasavyo kabla ya safari nyingine, kwa kuwa hii ni ndege ya ETOPS inayohitaji mawasiliano ya moja kwa moja kati ya zamu kuhusu vitu vya RII.
summary: Kupitia haraka wakati wa kubadilishana zamu kwenye ndege ya B767-200, ukaguzi wa RII kwa #2 IDG haukuandikwa, hivyo unahitaji uthibitisho wa haraka kabla ya safari nyingine.

narrative_text: Kwa hii B767-200, previous shift walisema #2 IDG replacement ilikuwa done na nikaambiwa tu ni-splice feeder cable kabla ndege haijaenda gate. Kwa sababu ya time pressure ya kuipush kwa gate, nikasign airworthiness bila kuconfirm kama RII sign-off ya ile IDG change ilikuwa imefanywa, and logbook haikuwa na entry yoyote kuhusu hilo. Next shift please mverify RII inspection ya #2 IDG imedocumented na kusainiwa properly kabla ya dispatch nyingine, since hii ni ETOPS aircraft na inahitaji direct communication kati ya shifts kwa RII items.
summary: Kwa hii B767-200, time pressure ilisababisha RII sign-off ya #2 IDG isikamilike, so next shift wanahitaji kuverify documentation kabla ya dispatch.

narrative_text: On B727-200, the aux fuel tank was reinstalled after bilge work below it, but a mechanic noticed the L-hand tank fitting was touching the floor beam forging and flagged it verbally to his supervisor instead of writing a non-routine card. The supervisor passed this to the next shift supervisor verbally as well, so it never made it into the written turnover, and the area was closed up with no corrective action taken. Please verify the clearance on that tank fitting before further flight and get a non-routine card raised retroactively; the mechanic who first noticed it says his supervisor intends to pursue this further.
summary: An aux fuel tank clearance issue on a B727-200 was reported verbally but never documented, so it needs formal follow-up and inspection before further flight.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya B727-200, tanki la ziada la mafuta lilirudishwa mahali baada ya kazi kufanyika chini yake, lakini fundi mmoja aligundua kuwa kifaa cha kushikilia tanki upande wa kushoto kilikuwa kinagusa muundo wa chuma wa sakafu, na akamweleza msimamizi wake kwa mdomo tu bila kuandika ripoti rasmi. Msimamizi huyo naye alimweleza msimamizi wa zamu inayofuata kwa maneno tu, hivyo taarifa hii haikuingizwa kwenye makabidhiano yaliyoandikwa, na eneo hilo likafungwa bila hatua yoyote kuchukuliwa. Ni muhimu kuthibitisha nafasi ya kifaa hicho cha tanki kabla ya safari nyingine na kuandika ripoti rasmi haraka, kwani fundi aliyegundua tatizo hili anasema msimamizi wake ana nia ya kufuatilia jambo hili zaidi.
summary: Tatizo la nafasi ya tanki la ziada la mafuta kwenye ndege ya B727-200 liliripotiwa kwa mdomo tu bila kuandikwa, hivyo linahitaji ufuatiliaji rasmi na ukaguzi kabla ya safari nyingine.

narrative_text: Kwenye ile B727-200, aux fuel tank iliwekwa back baada ya kazi ya bilge chini yake, lakini mechanic mmoja aliona kwamba ile L-hand tank fitting inagusa ile floor beam forging na akamwambia supervisor wake kwa mdomo tu, hakuandika non-routine card. Supervisor akapass hiyo info kwa next shift supervisor pia kwa mdomo, so haikuingia kwenye written turnover, na wakaclose up ile area bila corrective action yoyote. Tafadhali tu-verify clearance ya hiyo fitting kabla ya next flight na tu-raise non-routine card retroactively, coz ule mechanic aliyeona kwanza anasema supervisor wake ana intent ya ku-pursue hii issue zaidi.
summary: Kuna aux fuel tank clearance issue kwenye B727-200 iliripotiwa verbally tu bila kuandikwa, so inahitaji follow-up rasmi na inspection kabla ya next flight.

narrative_text: Rudder PCU on the B737-200 was replaced during C-check after the first unit tested faulty; MM test required disconnecting the nosewheel steering input rod, but since the nosewheel well panels were already closed and a separate job card had signed off that task, we installed the steering bypass pin instead. Rudder test and inspection signed off OK and aircraft was released, but on taxi-out the crew reported no nose steering, and it was found the steering rod was left disconnected. Turnover sheets from the prior 7-8 shifts were unclear on completed vs outstanding items - incoming shift needs to verify nosewheel steering rod reconnection status and review C-check job card cross-references before further release.
summary: A B737-200 was released to service with the nosewheel steering rod left disconnected after rudder PCU testing, due to unclear multi-shift turnover documentation.

narrative_text: Wakati wa C-check, PCU ya rudder kwenye B737-200 ilibadilishwa baada ya ile ya kwanza kuonekana na hitilafu wakati wa majaribio. Kulingana na maintenance manual, ilitakiwa kutenganisha nose steering input rod kabla ya kupima, lakini kwa sababu paneli za nosewheel well zilikuwa tayari zimefungwa na job card nyingine ilikuwa tayari imesainiwa kuonyesha kazi hiyo imekamilika, tulitumia bypass pin badala yake. Majaribio ya rudder na ukaguzi vilipita vizuri na ndege ikarudishwa kwenye huduma, lakini wakati wa taxi rubani aliripoti kutokuwepo kwa udhibiti wa steering kwa miguu, na ikagundulika kuwa ile rod ilikuwa bado imetenganishwa. Turnover sheets za zamu takriban saba hadi nane hazikuwa wazi kuhusu kazi zilizokamilika na zile zilizobaki - zamu inayofuata inatakiwa kuthibitisha hali ya nose steering rod na kupitia upya job cards za C-check kabla ya kuruhusu ndege kutumika tena.
summary: Ndege ya B737-200 iliruhusiwa kutumika ikiwa na nose steering rod bado imetenganishwa baada ya majaribio ya rudder PCU, kutokana na turnover sheets zisizo wazi.

narrative_text: Ile rudder PCU ya B737-200 ilibadilishwa during C-check baada ya ya kwanza ku-fail test; per maintenance manual, tulitakiwa ku-disconnect nosewheel steering input rod before testing, lakini since panels za nosewheel well zilikuwa tayari zime-close na kuna job card ingine ilikuwa already imesainiwa ikionyesha imekamilika, tuka-install bypass pin instead. Rudder test na inspection zilipita OK na aircraft ika-return to service, lakini during taxi crew waka-report hakuna nose steering, na tukagundua ile rod ilikuwa bado disconnected. Turnover sheets za shifts kama saba-nane hazikuwa clear kuhusu nini kimefanywa na nini bado open - next shift wanahitaji ku-verify status ya steering rod na ku-cross-check job cards za C-check kabla ya release nyingine.
summary: B737-200 ilirudishwa kwenye service na nose steering rod ikiwa bado disconnected baada ya rudder PCU test, kwa sababu ya turnover documentation isiyo clear.

narrative_text: B737-700 pack trip fault troubleshot overnight; findings pointed to faulty R system bleed overtemp switches rather than heat exchanger contamination per the flight manual, so we deviated from the standard procedure after discussing with the shift manager and zone supervisor. Decision was made around 0100 to replace the 390 and 490 bleed overtemp switches, but we ran out of time on the ramp aircraft to complete the job. Next shift lead has been briefed and logbook entry left open for switch replacement plus required leak check afterward - please confirm completion.
summary: Faulty R system bleed overtemp switches on B737-700 need replacement and leak check, handed over to next shift after time ran out.

narrative_text: Ndege ya B737-700 ilikuwa na tatizo la pack kujizima usiku, na baada ya uchunguzi tuligundua kuwa switch za overtemp za bleed upande wa R ndizo zenye hitilafu, na si heat exchanger kama ilivyoelekezwa kwenye mwongozo wa ndege. Baada ya majadiliano na meneja wa zamu pamoja na msimamizi wa zone, iliamuliwa saa saba usiku kubadilisha switch za 390 na 490, lakini muda haukutosha kukamilisha kazi hiyo kwenye ndege iliyoko rampuni. Zamu inayofuata imeelezwa kikamilifu na maandishi yameachwa wazi kwenye logbook kuhusu kubadilisha switch na kufanya ukaguzi wa uvujaji baada ya hapo - tafadhali thibitisha kama kazi imekamilika.
summary: Switch za overtemp za bleed upande wa R kwenye B737-700 zinahitaji kubadilishwa na kufanyiwa ukaguzi wa uvujaji, kazi imekabidhiwa kwa zamu inayofuata.

entities.text: switch za overtemp za bleed upande wa R

narrative_text: Tulikuwa tuna-troubleshoot pack trip fault kwa hii B737-700 usiku mzima, tukagundua ile bleed overtemp switches za R system ndizo zina fault, si heat exchanger kama flight manual inavyosema, so tukaamua tu-deviate na standard procedure. Tukaenda ku-discuss na shift manager na zone supervisor, tukakubaliana around 0100 tu-replace hizo 390 na 490 switches, lakini time ikaisha tukiwa ramp na hatukuweza kukamilisha job. Tumeshampa turnover next shift lead, logbook entry iko open ikisema switches zinabadilishwa halafu leak check ifanyike baadaye - confirm kama imefanyika.
summary: Bleed overtemp switches za R system kwenye B737-700 zinahitaji replacement na leak check, job imepewa next shift baada ya time kuisha.

entities.text: bleed overtemp switches za R system

narrative_text: B747-400 returned to the field after crew reported crew oxygen system pressure loss of 120 PSI over 2 hours. Previous shift had traced a chronic oxygen leak to the thermal compensator/regulator area and replaced a faulty transducer, but the supply line was left disconnected and capped, masking the true leak at the first observer's mask quick-disconnect fitting during the leak check. Gate mechanics could not identify the no-flow issue found by flight crew during preflight, and the line was only reconnected after further troubleshooting, causing a 51-minute departure delay before the aircraft returned. Next shift needs to verify the mask quick-disconnect valve fitting has been replaced and confirm full system leak check is completed before next dispatch.
summary: A B747-400 returned to the field due to crew oxygen pressure loss traced to a defective mask quick-disconnect fitting, after a prior maintenance error left the supply line disconnected during leak checks.

narrative_text: Ndege ya B747-400 ilirudi uwanjani baada ya wafanyakazi wa ndege kuripoti upotevu wa presha ya oksijeni ya PSI 120 kwa muda wa masaa mawili. Shift iliyopita ilikuwa imegundua uvujaji wa muda mrefu karibu na thermal compensator au regulator, na wakabadilisha transducer mbovu, lakini bomba la kupeleka oksijeni lilisahaulika kuunganishwa tena, hivyo tatizo halisi la uvujaji kwenye fitting ya mask ya kiongozi wa kwanza halikugundulika wakati wa ukaguzi wa uvujaji. Mafundi wa geti walishindwa kutambua sababu ya kukosekana kwa mtiririko wa oksijeni ambao wafanyakazi wa ndege waligundua kabla ya safari, na hii ilisababisha ucheleweshaji wa dakika 51 kabla ya kuondoka, kisha ndege kurudi baada ya masaa mawili angani. Shift inayoingia inahitajika kuhakikisha fitting ya valve ya mask imebadilishwa kikamilifu na ukaguzi mzima wa mfumo wa oksijeni umekamilika kabla ya safari nyingine.
summary: Ndege ya B747-400 ilirudi uwanjani kutokana na upotevu wa presha ya oksijeni uliosababishwa na fitting mbovu ya mask, baada ya hitilafu ya awali ya matengenezo kusababisha bomba la oksijeni kutounganishwa wakati wa ukaguzi wa uvujaji.

narrative_text: B747-400 imerudi field baada ya crew kuripoti oxygen pressure loss ya 120 PSI within 2 hours. Shift ya awali walikuwa wamekamua leak ikafikia thermal compensator ama regulator area, wakabadilisha transducer iliyokuwa faulty, lakini supply line ikasahaulika kuconnect back, hivyo iyo leak halisi kwenye first observer's mask quick-disconnect fitting haikugundulika during leak check. Gate mechs walishindwa kuidentify iyo no-flow issue ambayo flight crew waligundua during preflight checks, na hii ikasababisha delay ya dakika 51 kabla ya departure, then aircraft ikarudi baada ya 2 hours in flight. Next shift wahakikishe mask quick-disconnect fitting imereplace properly na full system leak check imekamilika before dispatch.
summary: B747-400 ilirudi baada ya oxygen pressure loss kutokana na fitting mbovu ya mask, baada ya mistake ya maintenance ya awali kusababisha supply line kubaki disconnected during leak check.

narrative_text: B727-200 nose landing gear doors were opened to lube the drag brace mechanism and were closed, locked, and visually confirmed secure before shift change; day shift then took the aircraft for engine run and towing back to the hangar pad with doors still confirmed up and locked. Tow crew later reported the nose gear door dropping during gate positioning, attempted to push it back up themselves, but did not report the issue to anyone before leaving the aircraft. The door subsequently departed the aircraft on takeoff, causing an air turn back; incoming shift needs to inspect nose gear door rigging/lock mechanism and review tow crew handling procedures before further dispatch.
summary: A B727 nose gear door, previously serviced and confirmed secure, later separated in flight after an unreported handling issue by a tow crew, prompting an air turn back and requiring follow-up inspection.

narrative_text: Milango ya gia ya mbele ya ndege ya B727-200 ilifunguliwa kwa ajili ya kupaka mafuta kwenye drag brace, kisha ikafungwa na kuhakikishiwa usalama kabla ya mabadiliko ya zamu. Zamu ya mchana ilichukua ndege kwa ajili ya kuendesha injini na kuivuta hadi eneo la hangar, huku milango ikiwa bado imefungwa vizuri. Baadaye wafanyakazi wa kuvuta ndege waliripoti kuwa mlango wa gia ya mbele ulidondoka wakati wa kuipeleka gate, walijaribu kuurudisha lakini hawakumjulisha yeyote kabla ya kuondoka; mlango huo hatimaye ulitoka wakati wa kuruka na ndege kulazimika kurudi. Zamu inayoingia inatakiwa kukagua mfumo wa kufunga mlango wa gia ya mbele na kufuatilia utaratibu wa wafanyakazi wa kuvuta ndege kabla ya safari nyingine.
summary: Mlango wa gia ya mbele ya ndege ya B727 uliokuwa umehudumiwa na kuthibitishwa salama ulitoka wakati wa kuruka baada ya tatizo lisiloripotiwa la wafanyakazi wa kuvuta ndege, na kusababisha ndege kurudi.

narrative_text: Tulifungua nose gear doors za B727-200 ili tuweze ku-lube drag brace mechanism vizuri, na baada ya kumaliza tuliclose na kulock zote mbili, tuka-confirm ziko secure kabla ya shift change. Day shift walichukua aircraft kwa engine run kisha wakaitow nyuma hangar pad, doors zikiwa bado zime-lock properly wakati huo. Baadaye tow crew wame-report kwamba nose gear door ilianguka wakati wa kuipeleka gate, walitry kui-push up lakini hawakumwambia mtu yeyote before wao ku-leave aircraft pale. Door ile iliondoka completely during takeoff na ikasababisha air turn back, so incoming shift wanahitaji ku-inspect nose gear door rigging na ku-review vile tow crew wanahandle aircraft kabla ya dispatch nyingine.
summary: Nose gear door ya B727 iliyokuwa imeserviced na kuconfirmiwa secure ilianguka mid-flight baada ya tatizo la tow crew ambalo halikureportiwa, na kusababisha air turn back.

narrative_text: During turnover on EO WVWX Rev A for B737-300, found one ground wire hanging loose and terminated it with a dual ground, but several other ground wires appear to be landed on the wrong terminating grounds per the EO. Notified lead and oncoming shift lead at 0330 and logged a write-up flagging the misrouted grounds, requesting Engineering authorization before further work or release. Please confirm Engineering auth status was actually issued and reviewed before this aircraft is dispatched, as it reportedly departed before the correction was verified.
summary: Ground wiring on a B737-300 was found misrouted during an EO turnover, and follow-up is needed to confirm Engineering authorization was completed before the aircraft's release.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kuendelea na kazi ya zamu iliyopita kwenye EO WVWX Rev A ya ndege ya B737-300, tuligundua waya mmoja wa ground ukiwa umeachwa bila kuunganishwa, na tuliuunganisha na dual ground. Hata hivyo, waya wengine wa ground walionekana kuunganishwa mahali pasipofaa kulingana na maelekezo ya EO. Nilimjulisha lead na lead wa zamu inayofuata saa tisa na nusu usiku, na kuandika ripoti ya turnover ikieleza tatizo hilo na haja ya idhini ya Uhandisi kabla ya kazi zaidi. Ni muhimu kuthibitisha kama idhini hiyo ilitolewa na kuangaliwa kabla ndege haijaruhusiwa kuruka, kwani taarifa zinaonyesha iliondoka kabla tatizo halijarekebishwa.
summary: Waya za ground kwenye ndege ya B737-300 ziligundulika kuunganishwa vibaya wakati wa turnover, na inahitajika kuthibitishwa kama idhini ya Uhandisi ilikamilika kabla ndege haijaruhusiwa kuondoka.

narrative_text: Wakati na-turnover job ya EO WVWX Rev A kwa B737-300, nilikuta ground wire moja iko hanging pekee, so nikai-terminate na dual ground. Lakini kuna zingine za ground wires zinaonekana zi-landed kwenye wrong terminating grounds according to EO. Nili-notify lead na oncoming shift lead saa nane na nusu, nikaandika turnover write-up ku-flag hii issue, tukiomba Engineering authorization kabla ya kazi zaidi ama release. Tafadhali confirm kama engineering auth ilitolewa na kuangaliwa kabla ndege haijaenda, kwa sababu inaonekana ilitoka before correction ime-verify.
summary: Ground wiring ya B737-300 ilipatikana ime-misroute wakati wa EO turnover, na inahitajika confirmation kama Engineering authorization ilikamilika kabla release.

narrative_text: Continued the duct burnout procedure on the MD-88 on the hangar ramp that the previous crew could not finish due to equipment problems; turnover was only verbal/secondhand, not documented in detail. Myself and two other AMTs inspected the augmentation valves and sense line security, and found and reconnected 3 cannon plugs and 1 sense line on the anti-ice valve that had been left disconnected. Engines were run at idle, pack operation checked normal, and the aircraft was released to service, but incoming shift should verify all sense lines/cannon plugs in that area again since disconnected lines were not flagged or tagged.
summary: Handover note on completing an MD-88 duct burnout procedure after a secondhand turnover, with a request to re-verify unflagged disconnected lines.

narrative_text: Tuliendelea na kazi ya duct burnout kwenye ndege ya MD-88 iliyokuwa imeegeshwa kwenye hangar ramp, ambayo wafanyakazi wa zamu iliyopita hawakumaliza kwa sababu ya matatizo ya vifaa; taarifa ya turnover tuliyopewa ilikuwa ya mdomo tu, si ya maandishi kamili. Mimi pamoja na mafundi wengine wawili tulikagua augmentation valves na sense lines, tukagundua cannon plugs tatu na sense line moja ya anti-ice valve zilizokuwa zimeachwa bila kuunganishwa, nazo tukazirudisha. Injini zilijaribiwa kwa idle power na mfumo wa pack ulionekana sawa, hivyo ndege ikarudishwa kwenye huduma, lakini zamu inayofuata inashauriwa kuangalia tena maeneo hayo kwa kuwa nyaya zilizokatwa hazikuwekewa alama yoyote.
summary: Taarifa ya zamu kuhusu kukamilisha kazi ya duct burnout kwenye MD-88 baada ya turnover ya mdomo, ikiwa na ombi la ukaguzi wa ziada wa nyaya ambazo hazikuwekewa alama.

narrative_text: Tuli-continue na ile duct burnout procedure kwa MD-88 iko hangar ramp, ambayo previous crew hawakumaliza kwa sababu ya equipment problems; turnover tuliopewa ilikuwa verbal tu, secondhand, haikuwa documented vizuri. Mimi na ma-AMT wengine wawili tuli-check augmentation valves na sense line security, tukapata cannon plugs tatu na sense line moja ya anti-ice valve ambazo zilikuwa zime-disconnect, tukazi-reconnect zote. Engines zili-run kwa idle power na pack operation ika-check normal, so aircraft ika-release to service, lakini next shift wa-verify tena hizo lines kwa sababu hazikuwa flagged na tape au streamer yoyote.
summary: Handover note ya ku-complete duct burnout procedure kwa MD-88 baada ya turnover ya verbal, na request ya kuverify tena zile sense lines ambazo hazikuwa flagged.

narrative_text: On the MD-11 (MCO check), previous shift turned over an AUX LOWER R PUMP status message with a wiring schematic for the forward aux tanks; this led me to misidentify the fault as forward aux instead of the ctr aux lower tank. I pulled parts and replaced remote control circuit breaker B1 and control relay R2 on the wrong tank circuit, then reapplied power and passed the fuel system controller return-to-service test before pulling the placard. Next shift please verify tank nomenclature on any AUX LOWER status messages before starting work, and re-check ctr aux lower R pump wiring since the original fault was never actually addressed.
summary: A technician replaced fuel pump control components on the wrong aux tank after misreading an ambiguous status message, so the actual fault on the ctr aux lower pump remains unresolved.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya MD-11 iliyokuwa chini ya ukaguzi wa MCO, zamu iliyopita ilinipa taarifa ya ujumbe wa hitilafu ya AUX LOWER R PUMP pamoja na mchoro wa nyaya wa matangi ya mbele ya aux, na hii ilinifanya nidhani hitilafu ilitoka kwenye tangi la mbele badala ya tangi la chini la ctr aux. Niliondoa nguvu kwenye ndege na kubadilisha circuit breaker B1 na relay R2 kwenye mzunguko usiokuwa sahihi, kisha nikarudisha umeme na kufanya jaribio la kurudisha mfumo wa mafuta kwenye huduma, ambalo lilipita salama kabla sijaondoa placard. Zamu inayofuata iangalie kwa makini majina ya matangi kwenye ujumbe wa AUX LOWER kabla ya kuanza kazi, na kuhakiki tena waya za ctr aux lower pump kwani hitilafu halisi bado haijashughulikiwa.
summary: Fundi alibadilisha vipuri vya pump ya mafuta kwenye tangi lisilo sahihi baada ya kutoelewa vizuri ujumbe wa hitilafu, hivyo tatizo halisi la ctr aux lower pump bado halijashughulikiwa.

entities.text: jaribio la kurudisha mfumo wa mafuta kwenye huduma
tangi la chini la ctr aux

narrative_text: Kwenye MD-11 iko under MCO, previous shift walinipatia turnover ya AUX LOWER R PUMP status message pamoja na wiring schematic ya forward aux tanks, so nikaishia ku-assume fault ni ya forward aux instead of the ctr aux lower tank. Nilitoa power kwa ndege, nika-replace remote control circuit breaker B1 na control relay R2 kwenye wrong tank circuit, kisha nika-reapply power na kufanya return-to-service test ya fuel system controller ambayo ilipita before I removed the placard. Next shift wanatakiwa ku-double check tank nomenclature kwa status messages zozote za AUX LOWER kabla ya kuanza task, na ku-recheck wiring ya ctr aux lower pump kwa sababu ile actual fault bado haijafanyiwa kazi.
summary: Fundi ali-replace fuel pump control components kwenye tank isiyo sahihi baada ya ku-misread status message, so real fault kwenye ctr aux lower pump bado haijashughulikiwa.

narrative_text: During shift turnover, I found that a RINX 253 turbine engine part I inspected back in June had the same serial number as a part already scrapped under RINX 353, yet the FAA Form 8130 tag listed it as new. Incoming inspector needs to hold this part from further installation until the serial number discrepancy is verified against maintenance records. Please flag this with quality assurance before end of shift.
summary: An inspector discovered a duplicate serial number between an in-service part and a scrapped part, with the 8130 tag incorrectly certifying it as new, requiring urgent verification.

narrative_text: Wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu, niligundua kwamba sehemu ya injini ya turbine yenye namba RINX 253, niliyokagua mwezi Juni, ina namba ya serial sawa na sehemu iliyokwisha tupwa kama taka chini ya RINX 353, lakini fomu ya FAA 8130 inaonyesha kuwa ni mpya. Msimamizi anayeingia zamu anahitajika kuzuia sehemu hii isiwekwe kwenye ndege hadi hali hii ithibitishwe kwenye rekodi za matengenezo. Tafadhali wasiliana na idara ya udhibiti wa ubora kabla ya mwisho wa zamu.
summary: Mkaguzi aligundua kufanana kwa namba za serial kati ya sehemu iliyo kwenye matumizi na iliyotupwa, huku fomu ya 8130 ikionyesha vibaya kuwa mpya, hivyo kuhitaji uthibitisho wa haraka.

entities.text: sehemu ya injini ya turbine yenye namba RINX 253

narrative_text: Kwa hii shift turnover, niligundua kwamba ile turbine engine part, RINX 253, niliyo-inspect mwezi wa Juni, ina serial number sawa na part iliyokuwa scrapped kama RINX 353, lakini FAA Form 8130 inaonyesha ni new. Incoming inspector ahakikishe part hii haiendi ku-install mpaka discrepancy ya serial number itathibitishwa na maintenance records. Please flag hii issue na QA kabla ya end of shift.
summary: Inspector alipata serial number ya part ikifanana na scrapped part, huku 8130 tag ikisema ni new, so inahitaji verification haraka na QA.

narrative_text: Handover: Skyhawk 172 that completed its 100-hr inspection lost oil pressure in flight and ran rough; pilot shut down the engine and made an emergency landing with only minor damage to airframe and prop. Follow-up found a rag left over the oil intake during magneto removal, likely left by whoever opened the engine for the owner during inspection. Next shift must safety-wire the new oil filter already installed and complete/close out the 100-hr inspection paperwork; also flag to management that we still have no proper job-turnover log to track work in progress.
summary: A Skyhawk 172 suffered an in-flight oil-pressure loss and emergency landing after a rag was left blocking the oil intake during a 100-hr inspection, exposing gaps in the shop's work-tracking system.

narrative_text: Taarifa ya zamu: Ndege ya Skyhawk 172 iliyokamilisha ukaguzi wa saa 100 ilipoteza shinikizo la mafuta angani na injini ikaanza kufanya kazi vibaya; rubani alizima injini na kutua dharura, ndege na propela zikapata uharibifu mdogo tu. Baada ya kuchunguza, tuligundua kitambaa kilichoachwa kwenye tundu la mafuta wakati wa kuondoa magneto, inaonekana kiliachwa na yeyote aliyefungua injini kwa niaba ya mmiliki wakati wa ukaguzi. Zamu inayofuata inatakiwa kufunga waya wa usalama kwenye kichujio kipya cha mafuta kilichowekwa na kukamilisha karatasi za ukaguzi wa saa 100; pia tujulishe uongozi kuwa bado hatuna mfumo mzuri wa kuandika kazi zinazoendelea kwa ajili ya mabadiliko ya zamu.
summary: Ndege ya Skyhawk 172 ilipata tatizo la shinikizo la mafuta angani na kutua dharura baada ya kitambaa kuziba tundu la mafuta wakati wa ukaguzi wa saa 100, jambo lililobainisha upungufu wa mfumo wa kufuatilia kazi.

narrative_text: Handover: ile Skyhawk 172 iliyomaliza 100-hr inspection ilipoteza oil pressure mid-flight na engine ikawa inarun rough, pilot aka-shut down engine na akafanya emergency landing, minor damage tu kwa airframe na prop. Tuligundua kuna rag iliyoachwa kwenye oil intake wakati wa kuremove magneto, seems mtu aliifungua engine kwa ajili ya owner wakati wa inspection na hakuitoa. Next shift lazima wa-safety wire ile new oil filter iliyowekwa na kukamilisha 100-hr inspection paperwork; pia tuflag kwa management kwamba bado hatuna proper job turnover system ya kutrack work in progress.
summary: Skyhawk 172 ilipata oil pressure loss na emergency landing baada ya rag kuziba oil intake wakati wa 100-hr inspection, ikionyesha gaps kwenye shop's documentation system.

narrative_text: Heads up for next shift: took over a work package on the B737-200 tail section that previous shift had signed off as work and inspection complete, but the rudder PCU installation, ops check, and final ops check blocks were still blank. The vertical stabilizer access panels had already been closed up with no inspection actually done on that installation. I flagged it to the supervisor before closing the card, and the panel had to be reopened for the install to be properly inspected and signed. This is the second time in about a month this same job card gap has come up (previous case reported to the office) - the cards need revision so incoming shift please verify sign-offs against actual access status, not just the paperwork.
summary: Incoming shift found rudder PCU installation and inspection sign-offs missing despite access panels being closed, requiring reopening and proper inspection before release.

narrative_text: Taarifa kwa shift inayoingia: nilipokea kazi ya mkia wa ndege B737-200 ambayo shift iliyopita ilikuwa imeandikwa kazi na ukaguzi vimekamilika, lakini sehemu ya usimikaji wa rudder PCU, ukaguzi wa uendeshaji, na ukaguzi wa mwisho wa uendeshaji hazikuwa zimesainiwa. Vifuniko vya ufikiaji wa mkia (vertical stabilizer) vilikuwa vimefungwa tayari bila ukaguzi wowote kufanyika kwenye usimikaji huo. Nilimjulisha msimamizi kabla ya kuendelea, na vifuniko vilifunguliwa upya ili ukaguzi sahihi ufanyike na kusainiwa. Hii ni mara ya pili katika muda wa mwezi mmoja tatizo hili la kadi za kazi linajitokeza, hivyo shift inayofuata iangalie kwa makini saini zote kabla ya kufunga vifuniko.
summary: Shift inayoingia ilikuta usimikaji wa rudder PCU haujakaguliwa wala kusainiwa licha ya vifuniko vya ufikiaji kufungwa, hivyo ilibidi vifunguliwe tena kwa ukaguzi sahihi.

narrative_text: Update kwa next shift: nilipokea work package ya tail section ya B737-200 ambayo previous shift walikuwa wamesign off kama work and inspection complete, lakini yale blocks za rudder PCU installation, ops check, na final ops check hazikuwa zime-signed. Access panels za vertical stabilizer zilikuwa zimefungwa already bila inspection yoyote kufanyika kwenye installation ile. Nilimwambia supervisor before kuendelea, panel ikafunguliwa tena ili inspection ifanyike properly na kusainiwa. Hii ni mara ya pili in about a month hii issue ya job cards inarudia, so next shift please tuangalie sign-offs vizuri kabla ya kuclose panels.
summary: Next shift walikuta rudder PCU installation haijakaguliwa wala kusainiwa despite panels kufungwa, hivyo ilibidi zifunguliwe tena kwa proper inspection.

narrative_text: During corrosion inspection on the B757-200 floor beam at STA:395 RBL 12, we removed intercostals from STA:395 to STA:418 per the upgrade lead's paperwork. When the upgrade lead came to collect the paperwork we were still mid-task, so I noted the intercostal removal on turnover but in the rush forgot to mention we also disconnected several pulley brackets. Next shift needs to be told about the disconnected pulley brackets, which have their own separate work card for reinstallation.
summary: Turnover note omitted mention of disconnected pulley brackets during floor beam corrosion work on a B757-200, requiring follow-up on their separate reinstallation work card.

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa kutu kwenye floor beam ya ndege B757-200 eneo la STA:395 RBL 12, tuliondoa intercostals kutoka STA:395 hadi STA:418 kulingana na karatasi za kazi alizoleta upgrade lead. Alipokuja kuchukua karatasi hizo tulikuwa bado hatujamaliza kazi, hivyo niliandika kwenye turnover kuhusu uondoaji wa intercostals lakini kwa haraka nilisahau kutaja kuwa tulikuwa pia tumeondoa baadhi ya pulley brackets. Zamu inayofuata inahitaji kufahamishwa kuhusu pulley brackets hizo, ambazo zina work card yake tofauti ya kuzirudisha.
summary: Taarifa ya turnover ilisahau kutaja pulley brackets zilizoondolewa wakati wa kazi ya kutu kwenye floor beam ya B757-200, hivyo inahitajika ufuatiliaji kwa work card yake ya kurudisha.

narrative_text: Tulikuwa tuna-inspect corrosion kwa floor beam ya B757-200 kwa STA:395 RBL 12, tukaanza kuondoa intercostals kutoka STA:395 mpaka STA:418 as per ile paperwork ya upgrade lead. Alikuja kuchukua paperwork tukiwa bado tuna-remove ile intercostal, so niliandika turnover kuhusu hiyo part lakini nikiwa nimehurry nikasahau ku-mention kwamba tuliondoa pia pulley brackets kadhaa. Next shift wajue kuhusu hizo pulley brackets, ziko na separate work card ya reinstallation.
summary: Turnover note ilisahau kutaja pulley brackets zilizo-disconnect wakati wa corrosion job kwa floor beam ya B757-200, so follow-up inahitajika kwa ile reinstallation work card.

narrative_text: On the B757-200, structures team removed corroded intercostals aft of station 395 (RBL 12 floor frame) along with attach angles/brackets, and relocated two pulley assemblies from the forward side of station 395 frame to station 4377 frame for access, leaving them floating on the cables. In the rush to complete turnover paperwork, the pulley relocation was not logged, and the crew's interpretation that flagging of controls/pulleys was not required per standard practice has since been found incorrect per maintenance manual guidance. Next shift must verify cable routing and pulley assembly positions at station 395/4377, confirm cables are properly centered and secured, and update the logbook to reflect the actual work performed and flag cockpit controls as required. Recommend review of maintenance practice interpretation on flagging requirements before further reassembly.
summary: Structures crew relocated pulley assemblies during corrosion repair on a B757-200 but failed to log the move or flag controls, an omission later found to violate maintenance procedure, requiring follow-up verification and documentation correction.

narrative_text: Wakati wa zamu yetu kwenye ndege ya B757-200, timu ya structures iliondoa sehemu za intercostal zilizooza karibu na station 395 (eneo la RBL 12), pamoja na attach angles na brackets zake, na pia kuhamisha pulley assemblies mbili kutoka mbele ya frame ya station 395 kwenda station 4377 ili kupata nafasi ya kufanya kazi, huku zikiachwa zikielea kwenye cables. Kwa haraka ya kumaliza risiti za mabadiliko ya zamu, mwenzangu alisahau kuandika kuwa pulley assemblies zilihamishwa, na tulidhani kwa mujibu wa taratibu za matengenezo kuwa hatukuhitajika kuweka alama kwenye vidhibiti vya kwenye chumba cha marubani wala kwenye pulley hizo, jambo ambalo baadaye limegundulika kuwa si sahihi. Zamu inayofuata inapaswa kuhakiki mwelekeo wa cables na nafasi ya pulley assemblies karibu na station 395 na 4377, kuthibitisha kuwa ziko sawa, na kusahihisha kumbukumbu za kazi pamoja na kuweka alama zinazohitajika.
summary: Timu ya matengenezo ilihamisha pulley assemblies wakati wa ukarabati wa kutu kwenye ndege ya B757-200 lakini haikuandika mabadiliko hayo wala kuweka alama zinazohitajika, jambo lililobainika baadaye kukiuka taratibu, hivyo linahitaji ufuatiliaji na urekebishaji wa kumbukumbu.

narrative_text: Kwa hii B757-200, sisi na structures partner tulikuwa tuna-disassemble corroded structure karibu na RBL 12, station 395 floor frame, na tukamaliza kuremove intercostals aft ya station 395 pamoja na attach angles/brackets zake. Pia tulimove pulley assemblies mbili kutoka forward side ya station 395 frame kwenda station 4377 frame kupata access, tukaziacha zika-float kwenye cables. Kwa sababu tulikuwa tume-rush kumalizia turnover paperwork, mwenzangu alisahau ku-note kwamba pulley assemblies zilimoved, na tuliassume per maintenance practices kuwa hatukuhitaji ku-flag controls cockpit ama pulleys hizo, lakini baadaye imegundulika interp yetu ilikuwa si sahihi. Next shift wako-verify cable routing na position za pulley assemblies karibu na station 395/4377, wa-confirm ziko centered vizuri, na wa-update logbook kuonyesha kazi halisi iliyofanywa plus ku-flag controls kama inavyotakiwa.
summary: Structures team walimove pulley assemblies during corrosion work kwenye B757-200 lakini hawakulog change wala kuflag controls, kitu ambacho later kimeonekana kukiuka procedure, hivyo inahitaji follow-up verification na kusahihisha logbook.

narrative_text: B737-300 left elevator tab job: worn hinge bracket was drilled and replaced, inspection approved tab installation, but the tab assembly itself had worn bearings so it was replaced per manual 27-31-31. Note that the tab kit ordered did not include the hardware required by the applicable AD, so new castellated nuts were pulled from bench stock instead. Next shift needs to rig the tab and close up the area, then have inspection re-verify safeties and rigging before release.
summary: Left elevator tab and hinge bracket were replaced on a B737-300 using bench-stock hardware after the ordered kit lacked AD-mandated parts, and next shift must complete rigging and inspection sign-off.

entities.text: rig the tab and close up the area

narrative_text: Kazi ya elevator tab ya upande wa kushoto kwenye B737-300 imefanyika; hinge bracket iliyokuwa imechakaa ilitobolewa na kubadilishwa, na ukaguzi ukaidhinisha kufungwa kwa tab. Lakini tab yenyewe ilikuwa na bearings zilizochakaa hivyo ilibadilishwa yote kama assembly kulingana na manual 27-31-31. Kit iliyoagizwa kwa ajili ya tab haikuwa na vifaa vilivyotakiwa na AD husika, hivyo nuts mpya za castellated zilitolewa kwenye bench stock. Shift ya pili inatakiwa ku-rig tab na kufunga eneo hilo, kisha ukaguzi uthibitishe safety na rigging kabla ndege kurudishwa kwenye huduma.
summary: Tab na hinge bracket ya elevator upande wa kushoto ilibadilishwa kwenye B737-300 kwa kutumia vifaa vya bench stock baada ya kit kukosa vipuri vilivyotakiwa na AD, na shift inayofuata inatakiwa kukamilisha rigging na uthibitisho wa ukaguzi.

narrative_text: Tulikuwa tuna-do left elevator tab change kwa B737-300; hinge bracket ilikuwa worn so tuli-drill na ku-install mpya, inspection ika-approve tab installation. Lakini tab assembly yenyewe ilikuwa na worn bearings, so tuli-replace whole assembly per manual 27-31-31. Issue ni kwamba tab kit iliyo-order haikuwa na hardware iliyo-mandated na AD husika, hivyo tuli-pull nuts mpya za castellated kutoka bench stock. Next shift wanahitaji ku-rig tab na kuclose up eneo, then inspection i-verify safeties na rigging kabla ndege ku-return to service.
summary: Left elevator tab na hinge bracket zi-replaced kwenye B737-300 tukitumia bench stock hardware baada ya kit kukosa AD parts, next shift wana-finish rigging na inspection sign-off.

entities.text: ku-rig tab na kuclose up eneo

narrative_text: Since there is no Crew Chief assigned to our area on the A300 line, management continues to direct me, as senior mechanic, to complete the Crew Chief turnover report at end of shift. This conflicts with the GPM, which states that only a Supervisor working jointly in the same area is required to prepare the turnover when no Crew Chief is assigned. Please follow up with Production Supervisor on assigning a Crew Chief for this area, or clarify in writing who is authorized to sign the turnover report so we stop operating outside the GPM.
summary: A senior mechanic is being required to complete Crew Chief turnover reports on the A300 line despite no Crew Chief being assigned, contrary to GPM policy, and requests clarification/assignment from management.

narrative_text: Kwa kuwa hakuna Crew Chief aliyewekwa katika eneo letu la A300, uongozi umeendelea kunielekeza mimi, kama fundi mwandamizi, kukamilisha ripoti ya turnover ya Crew Chief mwishoni mwa shift. Hali hii inakinzana na taratibu za GPM, ambazo zinasema ni Supervisor pekee anayefanya kazi katika eneo hilo hilo ndiye anayepaswa kuandaa ripoti hiyo endapo hakuna Crew Chief aliyeteuliwa. Tafadhali fuatilia suala hili na Production Supervisor ili aidha ateuliwe Crew Chief wa eneo hili, au itolewe maelezo rasmi ya nani mwenye mamlaka ya kutia sahihi ripoti hiyo, ili tuache kukiuka taratibu za kampuni.
summary: Fundi mwandamizi analazimika kukamilisha ripoti za turnover za Crew Chief kwenye ndege za A300 licha ya kutokuwepo Crew Chief aliyeteuliwa, jambo linalokiuka sera za GPM, hivyo anaomba ufafanuzi na hatua kutoka kwa uongozi.

entities.text: ripoti ya turnover ya Crew Chief

narrative_text: So since hakuna Crew Chief amewekwa kwa area yetu ya A300, management wamekuwa wakinipatia mimi, as the senior mechanic, kufill hiyo Crew Chief turnover report kila mwisho wa shift. Hii inakinzana na GPM, ambayo inasema ni Supervisor tu anayework palepale ndio anafaa kuandika turnover kama hakuna Crew Chief assigned. Tafadhali fuatilia na Production Supervisor kuhusu kuassign Crew Chief kwa hii area, ama watupe something in writing ya nani mwenye authority ya ku-sign hiyo report, ndio tuache kuviolate GPM.
summary: Senior mechanic analazimishwa kufill Crew Chief turnover reports kwa A300 line pasipo Crew Chief assigned, ikikiuka GPM, hivyo anaomba management wafuatilie na kutoa clarification.

narrative_text: B737-300 L-1 windscreen was replaced after it shattered in flight; sealer was applied in cold ambient conditions (approx 40F) and the aircraft was released with speed tape deferred over the uncured sealer per MEL. On the subsequent ferry departure from PDX, the speed tape came loose and wet sealer blew out at the upper left corner of the L-1 window during climb, causing an air leak at altitude; crew returned to PDX uneventfully. Window was retorqued and resealed with fresh protective tape and returned to service; next crew should confirm sealer cure time before further dispatch and monitor L-1 window integrity on next flights.
summary: L-1 windscreen replacement sealer failed to cure properly in cold weather, causing a minor in-flight air leak that required aircraft return and reseal.

narrative_text: Dirisha la L-1 la ndege ya B737-300 lilibadilishwa baada ya kupasuka wakati wa safari; sealer iliwekwa wakati wa hali ya baridi (nyuzi joto 40F hivi) na ndege ikaruhusiwa kuendelea na safari huku speed tape ikiwekwa juu ya sealer ambayo haikuwa imekauka kikamilifu, kama ilivyoruhusiwa na taratibu za matengenezo. Wakati wa safari ya kurudisha ndege PDX, speed tape ililegea na sealer mbichi ikatoka kwenye kona ya juu kushoto ya dirisha la L-1, na kusababisha uvujaji wa hewa angani; wafanyakazi walirudisha ndege PDX salama. Dirisha lilikaziwa tena na kufunikwa na tepi mpya ya kinga kisha ndege ikarudishwa kwenye huduma; zamu inayofuata inapaswa kuthibitisha muda wa kukausha kwa sealer kabla ya safari nyingine na kufuatilia hali ya dirisha la L-1.
summary: Sealer ya dirisha la L-1 haikukauka vizuri kutokana na baridi, na kusababisha uvujaji mdogo wa hewa angani uliohitaji ndege kurudi na kufanyiwa ukarabati zaidi.

entities.text: kukaziwa tena na kufunikwa na tepi mpya

narrative_text: Ile L-1 window ya B737-300 ilipasuka enroute, tukafanya replacement lakini sealer iliwekwa wakati ni baridi sana (about 40F), so tukadeferu na speed tape juu ya sealer ambayo haijakauka kabisa, kama MEL inavyoallow. Wakati ferry flight ilikuwa inatoka PDX, ile speed tape ikaloosen na wet sealer ikablow out kwenye upper left corner ya window, air ikaanza kuleak juu, crew wakarudi PDX salama. Tulikaza window tena na kuweka fresh protective tape kabla ya kuirudisha kwa service; next shift wahakikishe sealer cure time imefikiwa before dispatch na wa-monitor L-1 window kwa flights zinazofuata.
summary: Sealer ya L-1 window haikucure vizuri due to cold weather, ikasababisha air leak kidogo mid-flight na ndege ikahitaji kurudi na kufanyiwa reseal.

entities.text: kukaza window tena na kuweka fresh protective tape

narrative_text: During the overnight 'A' check on the MD-83, I measured brakes #2 and #4 below minimum tolerance and logged a discrepancy on page 27 of the check work package, then verbally notified the crew chief per the turnover report. I later discovered that page 27 had been removed and replaced with a different page, with staple holes showing the original entry was pulled without any written resolution from the mechanic who reportedly re-checked the brakes. This needs urgent follow-up: confirm actual brake #2/#4 measurements before further dispatch, and investigate the altered work package as a records-integrity issue. Please flag this aircraft's full maintenance history for review.
summary: A technician found that his logged brake-tolerance discrepancy on an MD-83 work package had been removed and replaced without written resolution, raising records-integrity concerns needing follow-up.

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa 'A' wa usiku kwenye ndege ya MD-83, nilipima breki namba 2 na namba 4 na kugundua zilikuwa chini ya kiwango kinachokubalika, hivyo nikaandika hitilafu hiyo kwenye ukurasa wa 27 wa kitabu cha kazi na kumjulisha crew chief kwa mujibu wa taratibu za makabidhiano. Baadaye niligundua kuwa ukurasa huo wa 27 umeondolewa na kubadilishwa na ukurasa mwingine, huku alama za stapo zikionyesha wazi kuwa kurasa ya awali iliondolewa bila ufafanuzi wowote ulioandikwa kutoka kwa fundi aliyedaiwa kukagua tena breki hizo. Jambo hili linahitaji ufuatiliaji wa haraka: kuthibitisha vipimo halisi vya breki namba 2 na 4 kabla ya ndege kuruhusiwa kusafiri tena, na kuchunguza uharibifu huu wa kumbukumbu kama tatizo kubwa la uadilifu. Tafadhali historia yote ya matengenezo ya ndege hii ipitiwe upya.
summary: Fundi aligundua kuwa hitilafu ya breki aliyoandika kwenye kumbukumbu ya ndege ya MD-83 iliondolewa na kubadilishwa bila maelezo, jambo linaloonyesha tatizo la uadilifu wa kumbukumbu linalohitaji ufuatiliaji.

narrative_text: Nikiwa naendelea na overnight 'A' check ya hiyo MD-83, nilicheck brakes #2 na #4 nikaona ziko below tolerance, so nikafanya write-up kwa page 27 ya work package na kumnotify crew chief kwa turnover report kama utaratibu unavyosema. Later nikadiscover kwamba page 27 ile imeondolewa na kubadilishwa na page mbaya, staple holes zinaonyesha wazi original entry ilitolewa bila resolution yoyote written kutoka kwa yule mechanic aliyeclaim ku-recheck brakes. Hii inahitaji follow-up ya haraka - confirm measurements halisi za brake #2 na #4 kabla ya aircraft kudispatch tena, na tuinvestigate huu ualteration wa work package kama record-integrity issue. Please pull maintenance history yote ya hii aircraft ipitiwe.
summary: Technician aligundua discrepancy ya brake #2/#4 aliyoiandika kwenye MD-83 work package imeondolewa bila written resolution, so kuna record-integrity concern inayohitaji follow-up ya haraka.

narrative_text: On job card WXBCV for the B737-200 passenger oxygen system operational check, I completed and stamped steps 02-A through 02-J(1). During step 02-J(2) I found all mask bags and hoses discolored and failing inspection, so I wrote them up and ordered replacement masks. I had to leave at shift change before completing the card, so the incoming lead technician needs to follow up on installation and final sign-off of step 02-J(2).
summary: Passenger oxygen mask bags and hoses failed inspection on job card WXBCV and the card remains open for completion after shift change.

narrative_text: Kwenye job card WXBCV ya ukaguzi wa mfumo wa oksijeni wa abiria kwa ndege ya B737-200, nilikamilisha na kusaini hatua za 02-A mpaka 02-J(1). Nilipofika hatua ya 02-J(2), nilibaini mifuko ya masks na hoses zote zimebadilika rangi na kufeli ukaguzi, hivyo nikaandika ripoti na kuagiza masks mpya. Zamu yangu ilikwisha kabla sijamaliza kazi hiyo, hivyo fundi atakayeendelea anahitajika kukamilisha ufungaji na kusaini hatua ya mwisho ya 02-J(2).
summary: Mifuko ya masks na hoses za mfumo wa oksijeni wa abiria zilifeli ukaguzi kwenye job card WXBCV na kazi bado haijakamilika baada ya mabadiliko ya zamu.

entities.text: ukaguzi wa mfumo wa oksijeni wa abiria

narrative_text: Kwenye job card WXBCV ya oxygen system check ya pax kwa hii B737-200, nilicomplete na kustamp steps 02-A mpaka 02-J(1) sawasawa. Nikifika step 02-J(2), nikakuta mask bags na hoses zote zime-discolor na zime-fail inspection, so niliandika write-up na kuorder replacement masks mpya. Shift yangu iliisha kabla sijamaliza card hii, kwa hivyo lead technician anayefuata anahitaji ku-follow up na kukamilisha installation na sign-off ya step 02-J(2).
summary: Mask bags na hoses za oxygen system ya pax zilifail inspection kwenye job card WXBCV, kazi bado haija-complete baada ya shift change.

narrative_text: On MD-88 layover check, found battery charger circuit breaker popped; consulted maintenance manual and coordinator by phone, then rewired charger per verbal guidance and signed off as serviceable after seeing a small charge on the gauge. Crew later reported charger not charging enough and logged a separate emergency power check discrepancy; breaker reset fine. Day shift mechanic changed charger wiring and replaced batteries before release, but aircraft later showed smoke/fumes from the E&E compartment at the gate and battery/charger were replaced again by outstation mechanics. Follow-up needed: verify correct single-charger MEL wiring procedure was followed, as either the initial rewire or the day-shift follow-up work appears to have been done incorrectly.
summary: A battery charger wiring fix on an MD-88 was signed off but proved faulty, leading to a follow-on smoke/fumes event and requiring review of the MEL wiring procedure.

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa usiku kwenye ndege ya MD-88, circuit breaker ya chaja ya betri ilipatikana imetoka; nilipiga simu kwa coordinator wa matengenezo na kuangalia maelezo kwenye kitabu cha matengenezo kabla ya kuunganisha upya waya kama nilivyoshauriwa. Baada ya kuona kiwango kidogo cha chaji kwenye kipimo, niliithibitisha ndege kuwa tayari kwa safari, lakini wafanyakazi wa ndege (marubani) walirudisha taarifa kuwa chaja haikuwa ikifanya kazi vizuri na wakaandika tatizo jingine kuhusu ukaguzi wa nguvu ya dharura. Fundi wa zamu ya mchana alibadilisha baadhi ya nyaya na betri kisha akairuhusu ndege kuendelea na safari, lakini muda mfupi baadaye moshi na mvuke vilionekana kutoka sehemu ya E&E wakati ndege ikiwa geti; mafundi wa kituo kingine walibadilisha betri na chaja tena. Inahitajika ufuatiliaji wa haraka kubaini kama utaratibu sahihi wa uunganishaji wa waya kulingana na MEL ulifuatwa, kwani inaonekana kazi ya awali au ile ya zamu ya mchana haikufanywa ipasavyo.
summary: Ukarabati wa waya za chaja ya betri kwenye ndege ya MD-88 ulithibitishwa kuwa sahihi lakini baadaye ulisababisha tatizo la moshi, hivyo inahitajika ukaguzi wa utaratibu wa uunganishaji kulingana na MEL.

entities.text: circuit breaker ya chaja ya betri
utaratibu wa uunganishaji wa waya kulingana na MEL

narrative_text: Nilikuwa doing layover check kwa MD-88 na nikapata circuit breaker ya battery charger imepop; nikapiga call coordinator na kuangalia manual haraka before ku-rewire charger kama alivyoshauri. Niliona small charge kwenye gauge so nikasign off ndege as serviceable, lakini crew wakaripoti later kwamba charger haikuwa charging enough, wakaandika pia logbook entry mpya kuhusu emergency power check kutofanya kazi. Day shift mech alichange wiring ya charger na batteries kabla ya ku-release ndege, lakini shortly after ndege ikiwa geti, plts waliona smoke na fumes zikitoka E&E compartment na mechs wa outstation wakachange battery na charger tena. Tunahitaji follow-up ya haraka kuconfirm kama MEL wiring procedure ya single charger operation ilifuatwa correctly, coz inaonekana either job yangu au ya day shift ilikuwa incorrect.
summary: Battery charger rewire kwa MD-88 iliyokuwa signed off ilileta smoke event baadaye, hivyo tunahitaji kucheck kama MEL wiring procedure ilifuatwa sawasawa.

entities.text: MEL wiring procedure ya single charger operation

narrative_text: Hydraulic mule was sent back to the hangar for the Fokker 100 after ground crew requested a fluid sample due to suspected overpressure at 3000 PSI, which reportedly blew out two engine pumps and steering valves. The unit was returned to service before shift change without waiting for the 90-day sample results, and no filters or parts were replaced even though it ran fine on our bench for over an hour. Next shift needs to confirm whether the hydro-unit gauges are calibrated (may not have been checked against actual aircraft pressure of 3600 PSI), and verify what paperwork exists for handling a possibly contaminated unit before it's cleared again.
summary: A hydraulic mule suspected of causing an overpressure event on a Fokker 100 was returned to service before sample results came back, raising calibration and contamination-handling concerns for follow-up.

narrative_text: Hydraulic mule ilirudishwa hangarini kwa ajili ya ndege ya Fokker 100 baada ya wafanyakazi wa uwanjani kuomba sampuli ya majimaji kwa sababu ya shaka ya presha kupita kiasi ya 3000 PSI, ambayo inasemekana ilisababisha pump mbili za injini na valves za usukani kuharibika. Kitengo hicho kilirudishwa kazini kabla ya mabadiliko ya zamu bila kusubiri matokeo ya sampuli ambayo huchukua hadi siku 90, na hakuna sehemu wala filta zilizobadilishwa ijapokuwa kilifanya kazi vizuri dukani kwa zaidi ya saa moja. Zamu inayofuata inahitaji kuthibitisha kama gauge za hydro-unit zimehakikiwa vizuri (huenda hazikulinganishwa na presha halisi ya ndege ya 3600 PSI), na kuangalia kama kuna taratibu rasmi za kushughulikia kitengo kinachoshukiwa kuchafuliwa kabla ya kukirudisha tena kazini.
summary: Kitengo cha hydraulic mule kilichoshukiwa kusababisha tatizo la presha kupita kiasi kwenye ndege ya Fokker 100 kilirudishwa kazini kabla ya matokeo ya sampuli kupatikana, jambo linalohitaji ufuatiliaji wa uhakiki wa vipimo na taratibu za uchafuzi.

narrative_text: Tulirudisha ile hydraulic mule hangar kwa ajili ya Fokker 100 baada ya mgmnt kusema wachukue sample ya hydro fluid kwa sababu unit ilionekana ime-overpressurize mpaka 3000 PSI, na hiyo ndio ilisababisha engine pumps mbili na steering valves ku-blow out. Kabla sample results zirudi (huchukua siku 90), hangar wakarudisha unit back to service bila kubadilisha even filters, ingawa ilirun sawa kwa zaidi ya hour moja kwa shop. Next shift wanahitaji kuconfirm kama hizo gauges za hydro-unit zime-calibrate, kwa sababu inaonekana aircraft pressure ilikuwa 3600 PSI si 3000, na pia tuangalie kama kuna paperwork ya kushughulikia unit ambayo inaweza kuwa contaminated kabla ya kuirudisha service.
summary: Hydraulic mule iliyoshukiwa kusababisha overpressure kwenye Fokker 100 ilirudishwa service kabla sample results, hivyo next shift lazima ifuatilie calibration ya gauges na paperwork ya contamination.

narrative_text: B737-400 #1 ILS was placed on MEL overnight; while troubleshooting, an open wire was found in the freq tuning circuit between the NAV control panel and the NAV receiver, but its exact location could not be pinpointed before shift change. Aircraft was released with #1 ILS on MEL, but it was not recognized at the time that the same open wire could also affect the #1 VOR, which cannot be dispatched inop. Follow-up crew should note the #1 VOR requires verification/repair if not already closed out, as this discrepancy resurfaced nine days later via pilot write-up before being fixed by line maintenance.
summary: An unresolved open wire causing an ILS tuning fault also affected the VOR system, which was missed before dispatch and only corrected after a later pilot write-up.

narrative_text: Ndege ya B737-400 ilikuwa na hitilafu ya #1 ILS iliyowekwa kwenye MEL usiku wa kulala ZZZ; wakati wa uchunguzi, kifundo cha waya kilichokatika kiligunduliwa kwenye mzunguko wa kurekebisha frequency kati ya kidhibiti cha NAV na kipokezi cha NAV, lakini mahali hasa hapakuwezekana kubainika kabla ya mabadiliko ya zamu. Ndege iliruhusiwa kuruka ikiwa na #1 ILS kwenye MEL, lakini haikutambuliwa wakati huo kuwa waya huo huo unaweza kuathiri pia #1 VOR, ambayo haifai kuruhusiwa kuruka ikiwa mbovu. Zamu inayofuata inatakiwa kuthibitisha hali ya #1 VOR, kwani hitilafu hiyo ilijitokeza tena baada ya siku tisa kupitia ripoti ya rubani kabla ya kurekebishwa na wafanyakazi wa matengenezo.
summary: Waya uliokatika ulisababisha hitilafu ya ILS na baadaye kuathiri VOR, jambo lililokosa kutambuliwa kabla ya ndege kuruhusiwa kuruka.

narrative_text: Ile B737-400 ilikuwa na #1 ILS ime-MEL usiku ule wa layover ZZZ; tukiwa tuna-troubleshoot, tukapata open wire kwenye freq tuning circuit kati ya NAV control panel na NAV receiver, lakini hatukuweza ku-locate exact spot kabla ya shift change. Aircraft ika-released na #1 ILS on MEL, lakini haikutudawn kwa wakati ule kwamba hiyo hiyo open wire inaweza kuaffect #1 VOR pia, na VOR haiwezi ku-dispatch ikiwa inop. Next shift wacheki #1 VOR status kwa sababu discrepancy hii ilirudi baada ya siku tisa through pilot write-up, na eventually maintenance wakaifix.
summary: Open wire iliyofanya ILS iwe MEL pia iliaffect VOR bila kutambuliwa mapema, ikapelekea write-up ya rubani baada ya siku tisa.

narrative_text: Techs reinstalled the ceiling panels in the aft cargo bay after cleaning, but the aircraft was released back to service before the floor and belly area cleaning turnover was completed. A supervisor signed off the MD-80 without confirming this task was closed, so there is a possible contamination risk to passengers and ramp crew. Next shift please verify cargo bay floor/belly cleaning status before further dispatch and log any deviation found.
summary: MD-80 was returned to service with the aft cargo bay floor/belly cleaning left incomplete, creating a contamination risk that needs verification.

narrative_text: Mafundi walikuwa wamesafisha na kurudisha paneli za dari kwenye sehemu ya mizigo ya nyuma ya ndege, lakini ndege ilirudishwa kazini kabla ya usafi wa sakafu na sehemu ya chini ya tumbo la ndege kukamilika. Msimamizi alitia saini kuruhusu MD-80 kuendelea na safari bila kuthibitisha kazi hiyo imekamilika, jambo linaloweza kusababisha uchafuzi kwa abiria na wafanyakazi wa uwanjani. Zamu inayofuata inaombwa kuthibitisha hali ya usafi wa eneo hilo kabla ya ndege kuruhusiwa kuruka tena, na kuripoti tofauti yoyote itakayoonekana.
summary: Ndege ya MD-80 ilirudishwa kazini kabla ya usafi wa sakafu na tumbo la mizigo kukamilika, hali inayoweza kuleta hatari ya uchafuzi.

entities.text: usafi wa sakafu na sehemu ya chini ya tumbo la ndege

narrative_text: So jana wale techs walimaliza kufunga ceiling panels kwa aft cargo bay baada ya kusafisha, lakini acft ilireleased ku-service kabla ya hiyo floor na belly cleaning turnover kufanyika. Supervisor alisign off hiyo MD-80 bila kuconfirm kama job imeclose, hivyo kuna contamination risk kwa pax na hata ramp workers. Next shift muverify status ya hiyo cleaning kabla ya kuidispatch tena, na mkilog deviation yoyote mtakayoikuta.
summary: MD-80 iliassigned back ku-service ingawa floor/belly cleaning ya aft cargo bay haijakamilika, so kuna contamination risk inayohitaji kuverifiwa.

narrative_text: On the ATR 72 right-hand engine, the #2 fire handle warning light was found illuminated; the fire loop cannon plug was pulled, found contaminated with water, cleaned and reconnected, and the system then checked good. Ignition system A and B ops checks were also completed satisfactorily, and the ignition lead was found misrouted, requiring the lower cowl to be dropped for correction before reinstalling the igniter, lead, and cowl with safety wire and the oil cooler line torqued. Incoming shift should verify all cowl panels (fwd and aft) are properly closed and secured, confirm the maintenance stand has been removed, and double-check safety wire and loose oil line connections on the right side before returning aircraft to service.
summary: Right engine fire warning traced to water in the fire loop cannon plug and a misrouted ignition lead, requiring cowl removal and reinstallation; next shift must confirm cowl closure, stand removal, and safety wire before release.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya ATR 72, taa ya onyo ya moto namba mbili upande wa injini ya kulia ilionekana ikiwaka, na baada ya kuondoa plagi ya fire loop ilibainika kuwa na maji ndani yake; ilisafishwa na kurudishwa, na mfumo ukafanyiwa ukaguzi ukaonekana mzuri. Vilevile, waya wa ignition ulikutwa haujawekwa vizuri hivyo ilibidi kufungua cowl ya chini kuirekebisha, kabla ya kufunga tena igniter, waya, na kuufunga cowl kwa waya wa usalama na kukaza bomba la mafuta ya baridi ya injini. Zamu inayofuata inaombwa kuhakikisha paneli zote za cowl (mbele na nyuma) zimefungwa vizuri, stendi ya matengenezo imeondolewa, na waya za usalama pamoja na mabomba ya mafuta upande wa kulia yamekaguliwa kabla ndege haijarudishwa kwenye huduma.
summary: Onyo la moto la injini ya kulia lilisababishwa na maji kwenye plagi ya fire loop na waya wa ignition uliokosewa njia, hivyo zamu inayofuata inatakiwa kuthibitisha ufungaji wa cowl, uondoaji wa stendi, na waya za usalama kabla ya kurudisha ndege kwenye huduma.

entities.text: bomba la mafuta ya baridi ya injini

narrative_text: Kwenye R-hand engine ya ATR 72, #2 fire handle warning light ilikuwa imewaka, so nikatoa ile fire loop cannon plug ku-troubleshoot, nikakuta maji ndani yake, nikaiclean, nikai-reconnect, na system ika-check good. Pia nilifanya ops check ya ignition A na B, zote zikawa good, lakini nikagundua ignition lead ilikuwa misrouted hivyo nilibidi nidrop lower cowl kuirekebisha kabla ya kurudisha igniter, lead, na kufunga cowl na safety wire plus kutorque ile oil cooler line. Next shift wahakikishe cowls zote (fwd na aft) zimeclose vizuri, maintenance stand imeondolewa, na safety wire pamoja na oil lines upande wa right zime-check kabla ya kurelease aircraft.
summary: R-hand engine fire warning ilitokana na maji kwenye fire loop cannon plug na ignition lead iliyo-misroute, so next shift wanahitaji ku-verify cowl closure, stand removal, na safety wire kabla ya release.

narrative_text: Job card for the B737-300 spoiler and brake hydraulic line replacement on right and left wings was signed off as complete by the lead based on mech stamps, but the attached carry-over page had an inspection step overlooked and the top right wing panel was never secured after installation. The panel and its hydraulic lines separated in flight right after takeoff, causing hydraulic loss and a return to gate. Job card only covers panel removal, not reinstallation/inspection, so please flag this gap for the next shift and confirm the card has been revised before further use.
summary: A wing panel left unsecured due to a job-card gap and missed shift turnover caused an in-flight hydraulic line failure shortly after takeoff.

entities.text: spoiler and brake hydraulic line replacement

narrative_text: Job card ya kubadilisha spoiler na hydraulic lines za brake kwenye mbawa za kulia na kushoto za B737-300 ilisainiwa na lead kama kazi imekamilika, kwa sababu blocks zote za mech zilikuwa zimepigwa stamp. Hata hivyo, ukurasa wa turnover uliyowekwa pamoja na job card ulikuwa na hatua ya ukaguzi iliyosahaulika, na panel ya juu ya mbawa ya kulia haikufungwa vizuri baada ya kufungwa. Panel hiyo pamoja na hydraline zake zilitoka wakati wa ndege muda mfupi baada ya kuruka, na kusababisha upotevu wa hydraulics na ndege kurudi getini. Ni muhimu shift inayofuata iangalie kama job card imesahihishwa ili kuhakikisha hatua ya kufunga panel na ukaguzi inajumuishwa.
summary: Panel ya mbawa haikufungwa vizuri kwa sababu ya pengo katika job card na turnover, na hili lilisababisha tatizo la hydraulics baada ya kuondoka.

entities.text: panel ya juu ya mbawa ya kulia
kubadilisha spoiler na hydraulic lines za brake

narrative_text: Ile job card ya spoiler na brake hyd lines replacement kwa right na left wing ya B737-300 ilisign-offiwa na lead kama complete, kwa sababu blocks zote za mech zilikuwa zime-stamp. Lakini kwenye ile carry-over page, kuna inspection step ambayo ilisahaulika, na ile top right wing panel haikusecure vizuri baada ya installation. Panel na hydraulic lines zake zilitoka in-flight muda mfupi baada ya takeoff, causing hydraulic loss na aircraft ikarudi gate. Job card haina block ya ku-install panel back, ni removal tu iko documented, kwa hivyo next shift wahakikishe kama job card imefanyiwa revision.
summary: Job card haikuwa na step ya ku-reinstall panel, hivyo ile top right wing panel ilibaki loose na ikasababisha hydraulic failure baada ya takeoff.

entities.text: spoiler na brake hyd lines replacement

narrative_text: Completed nose landing gear replacement steps on the DC-9, including cylinder attachment, nosewheel install, strut servicing and lubrication, then assisted with rigging the ground sense control cables and nose gear steering system due to tight access in the wheel well. Nose gear steering functional check was done before end of shift, but landing gear retract/extension functional check and gear door reinstallation were not completed and are handed over to the incoming mechanic. Note: rigging procedure for the ground sense/steering system in the maintenance manual is easy to misread given the confined work area, so double-check cable tension charts before running the retract check.
summary: Nose gear replacement on the DC-9 was left mid-task with the retract/extension functional check and gear door reinstallation pending for the next shift.

narrative_text: Nimekamilisha hatua za kubadilisha nose landing gear kwenye DC-9, ikiwemo kuunganisha silinda, kufunga nosewheel, kuweka mafuta na kuhudumia strut, kisha nikamsaidia fundi mwenzangu kurekebisha nyaya za ground sense control na mfumo wa uongozaji wa nose gear kwa sababu nafasi ya kufanyia kazi kwenye wheel well ni finyu. Ukaguzi wa utendaji wa uongozaji wa nose gear umefanyika kabla ya shift kuisha, lakini ukaguzi wa retract/extension wa landing gear na kufunga tena milango ya gear haujakamilika, hivyo kazi hiyo inabaki kwa shift inayokuja. Tahadhari: taratibu za maandiko ya matengenezo kuhusu urekebishaji wa mfumo wa ground sense zinaweza kuchanganya kwa urahisi kwa sababu ya nafasi finyu, hivyo angalia vizuri chati za mvutano wa nyaya kabla ya kufanya ukaguzi wa retract.
summary: Kazi ya kubadilisha nose landing gear ya DC-9 imesalia nusu, huku ukaguzi wa retract/extension na milango ya gear ikibaki kwa shift inayokuja.

entities.text: mfumo wa uongozaji wa nose gear
ukaguzi wa retract/extension wa landing gear

narrative_text: Nilikamilisha steps za nose landing gear replacement kwenye DC-9 — cylinder attachment, nosewheel install, strut servicing na lubrication zote done. Baadaye nikamsaidia fundi mwingine na rigging ya ground sense control cables na nose gear steering system, kwa sababu access kwenye wheel well ilikuwa tight sana. Nose gear steering functional check tulifanya kabla shift yangu kuisha, lakini landing gear retract/extension functional check na kurudisha gear doors bado, so it's on the next mechanic. Kitu moja tu, ile rigging procedure ya ground sense system kwenye maintenance manual ni rahisi kuchanganya, so double-check cable tension charts kabla ya kuendelea na retract check.
summary: Nose gear replacement kwenye DC-9 imesalia mid-task, na retract/extension check pamoja na gear doors zinabaki kwa next shift.

narrative_text: Night shift found the L throttle sticking at full forward on the MD-80 during eng sync/autothrottle troubleshooting, and disconnected the throttle cable at the bell crank in the aft cargo pit, at the eng xshaft, and at the fuel control unit. Aircraft was towed to the hangar on one engine with the L throttle cable still disconnected; logbook only had write-ups for the removed bolt/nut at xshaft and the cotter pin at the fuel control unit. Incoming tech confirmed with night shift what was left open before continuing troubleshooting - root cause traced to the slotted bracket securing throttle/fuel shutoff cables being out of position, causing the bind. Follow-up: reposition bracket, reconnect and safety all disturbed hardware, and verify full throttle travel before returning aircraft to service.
summary: Night shift left the L throttle cable disconnected on an MD-80 after troubleshooting a sticking throttle traced to a misaligned bracket, requiring day shift to verify disconnections and complete reconnection/rigging before release.

narrative_text: Wafanyakazi wa zamu ya usiku waligundua kuwa throttle ya kushoto (L throttle) ya ndege ya MD-80 ilikuwa inakwama ikisogezwa mbele kabisa, wakati wakifanya uchunguzi wa mfumo wa eng sync na autothrottle. Walitenganisha cable ya throttle kwenye bell crank iliyoko aft cargo pit, kwenye eng xshaft, na kwenye fuel control unit ili kubaini tatizo, na ndege ikahamishwa hadi hangarini kwa injini moja huku cable hiyo ikiwa bado imetenganishwa. Logbook ilikuwa na maandishi kuhusu bolt na nut zilizoondolewa kwenye xshaft na cotter pin ya fuel control unit tu, hivyo fundi wa zamu inayofuata alilazimika kuongea moja kwa moja na fundi wa usiku kujua kilichoachwa wazi kabla ya kuendelea na uchunguzi. Chanzo cha tatizo kilibainika kuwa ni nafasi mbaya ya bracket inayoshikilia cable za throttle na fuel shutoff; inahitajika kurekebishwa nafasi ya bracket hiyo, kuunganisha tena vipengele vyote, na kuthibitisha mwendo kamili wa throttle kabla ndege haijarudishwa kwenye huduma.
summary: Zamu ya usiku iliacha cable ya throttle ya kushoto ikiwa imetenganishwa kwenye ndege ya MD-80 baada ya kubaini tatizo la bracket iliyokosea nafasi, hivyo zamu inayofuata inapaswa kuthibitisha hali na kukamilisha ufungaji kabla ya kutolewa kwa huduma.

entities.text: uchunguzi wa mfumo wa eng sync na autothrottle

narrative_text: Zamu ya usiku waligundua L throttle ya MD-80 inakwama ikienda full forward wakati wa troubleshooting ya eng sync na autothrottle system, wakadisconnect throttle cable kwa bell crank pale aft cargo pit, kwa eng xshaft, na kwa fuel control unit. Ndege ikatowiwa kwenda hangar ikiwa na engine one running huku L throttle cable ikiwa bado disconnected; logbook ilikuwa na write-up ya bolt na nut zilizoremovwa kwenye xshaft plus cotter pin ya fuel control unit tu, so nikaongea na night shift technician moja kwa moja ku-confirm ni nini kimeachwa open kabla sija-proceed na troubleshooting. Root cause ilikuja kuwa ni bracket ile slotted inayoshikilia throttle na fuel shutoff cables ilikuwa out of position ndio ikasababisha binding. Follow-up: reposition ile bracket, reconnect na safety hardware zote zilizoguswa, then verify full throttle travel kabla aircraft haija-return to service.
summary: Night shift waliacha L throttle cable ya MD-80 ikiwa disconnected baada ya kupata root cause ni bracket iliyo out of position, so day shift lazima wa-confirm status na kukamilisha reconnection kabla ya release.

entities.text: troubleshooting ya eng sync na autothrottle system

narrative_text: B737-300 gear air sense proximity switch was replaced after two air turnbacks earlier in the day for landing gear indication faults. New sensor was spliced in and mounted, gap set to target per AMM, and system checkout was turned over to the relief crew. Follow-up needed: verify sensor face orientation against the correct mounting flange/holes, as the aircraft returned for a third air turnback and inspection found the sensor mounted 90 degrees off target despite the gap reading correctly.
summary: A misoriented replacement gear proximity switch on a B737-300 passed gap checks but caused a third air turnback, requiring re-inspection of the mounting.

narrative_text: Ndege ya B737-300 ilikuwa na tatizo la switch ya hisi ya hewa ya gia ya kutua, na tulibadilisha sensor mpya baada ya ndege kurudi uwanjani mara mbili awali kwa sababu ya hitilafu za onyo la gia. Sensor mpya iliunganishwa na kuwekwa, pengo likapimwa kulingana na kiwango kilichoainishwa kwenye mwongozo wa matengenezo, kisha kazi ikakabidhiwa kwa zamu inayofuata kwa ukaguzi wa mfumo. Inahitajika ufuatiliaji wa haraka kwani ndege ilirudi uwanjani mara ya tatu, na ukaguzi ulibaini sensor ilikuwa imewekwa ikiwa imegeuzwa nyuzi 90 kutoka mahali sahihi, ingawa kipimo cha pengo kilionekana sahihi.
summary: Sensor ya gia iliyowekwa vibaya kwenye ndege ya B737-300 ilisababisha ndege kurudi uwanjani mara ya tatu, hivyo inahitaji ukaguzi zaidi.

entities.text: switch ya hisi ya hewa ya gia

narrative_text: Tulikuwa tunafanyia troubleshoot ile B737-300 yenye landing gear problem, baada ya kurudi uwanjani mara mbili siku hiyo kwa gear indication faults. Tuka-splice ile new proximity switch, nikai-mount na tuka-set gap kulingana na maint manual, kisha tukafanya turnover ya system checkout kwa relief crew. Follow-up inahitajika ASAP maana ndege ilifanya third air turnback, na inspection ikaonyesha kwamba sensor ilikuwa imewekwa 90 degrees off from target, ingawa gap reading ilionekana sahihi wakati wa kuiset.
summary: Sensor ya gear iliyo-mount vibaya kwenye B737-300 ilipita gap check lakini ikasababisha third air turnback, hivyo inahitaji re-check ya mounting.

narrative_text: During the #1 engine fan change on B727-200, inspector wrote up the #1 bearing for replacement and I ordered the part from stores using the number listed in the training manual, without cross-checking it against the IPC for correct effectivity. Bearing was still in transit from stores at shift turnover, so relief crew went ahead and installed it. Records dept later flagged the part number as incorrect, and aircraft had to be grounded again for rework of the #1 engine #1 bearing - please verify IPC effectivity before ordering next time.
summary: Wrong bearing part number was ordered from the training manual without IPC verification, leading to incorrect installation and aircraft grounding for rework.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kubadilisha fan ya engine namba moja kwenye B727-200, mkaguzi aliandika kadi ya kubadilisha bearing namba moja, na niliagiza spare kutoka stores kwa kutumia namba niliyoipata kwenye kitabu cha mafunzo bila kuthibitisha na IPC kama ni sahihi kwa ndege hiyo. Bearing ilikuwa bado safarini kutoka stores wakati wa kukabidhi shift, kwa hivyo wafanyakazi wa shift inayofuata waliifunga bila kuthibitisha zaidi. Baadaye idara ya records iligundua kuwa namba ya part si sahihi, na ndege ililazimika kusimamishwa tena kufanyiwa marekebisho ya bearing ya engine namba moja - tafadhali mfuatiliaji wa shift ijayo athibitishe namba sahihi za spare kabla ya kufunga chochote.
summary: Bearing isiyo sahihi iliagizwa kwa kutumia namba ya kitabu cha mafunzo bila kuthibitisha na IPC, hali iliyosababisha ufungaji mbaya na ndege kusimamishwa kufanyiwa marekebisho.

entities.text: kubadilisha fan ya engine namba moja

narrative_text: So during the #1 engine fan change kwenye B727-200, inspector aliandika N/R card ya kubadilisha #1 bearing, nikaorder part kutoka stores nikitumia part number kutoka training manual bila kuverify na IPC kama ni sahihi effectivity-wise. By the time ya turnover bearing ilikuwa bado enroute kutoka stores, so relief crew waka-install tu ile bearing bila kuangalia zaidi. Records dept ndio waligundua later kwamba part number si sahihi, ikabidi aircraft igrounded tena for rework ya #1 engine bearing - tafadhali next shift wathibitishe part number na IPC effectivity kabla ya ku-order chochote next time.
summary: Wrong bearing part number ilikuwa ordered kutoka training manual bila kucheki IPC, na hiyo ikapelekea installation mbaya na aircraft kugroundiwa for rework.

entities.text: wathibitishe part number na IPC effectivity

narrative_text: Final inspection was signed off on the #1 engine on the B737-200 after both engines were transferred from another aircraft, but it is unclear whether the required 'B' check and throttle rigging were actually completed before signoff. The previous shift passed on incomplete information, so the inspection was closed out before all tasks were verified. Next shift must confirm 'B' check status on both engines, verify throttle linkage rigging, and check that the castellated nut and cotter key on the throttle linkage are properly installed before further release.
summary: Final inspection on #1 engine was signed off before throttle rigging and 'B' check work were confirmed complete, due to poor shift turnover.

narrative_text: Ukaguzi wa mwisho ulisainiwa kwa injini namba moja ya ndege ya B737-200 baada ya injini zote mbili kuhamishwa kutoka ndege nyingine, lakini haijulikani wazi kama 'B' check na urekebishaji wa throttle linkage vilikamilika kabla ya kusainiwa. Zamu iliyotangulia ilitoa taarifa isiyokamilika, hivyo ukaguzi ulifungwa kabla kazi zote kuthibitishwa. Zamu inayofuata inatakiwa kuthibitisha hali ya 'B' check kwa injini zote mbili, kukagua urekebishaji wa throttle linkage, na kuhakikisha castellated nut na cotter key vimewekwa vizuri kabla ya kuruhusu ndege kuendelea.
summary: Ukaguzi wa mwisho wa injini namba moja ulisainiwa kabla ya kuthibitisha kazi za 'B' check na urekebishaji wa throttle, kutokana na taarifa mbovu wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu.

narrative_text: Tuli-sign final inspection ya #1 engine kwa hii B737-200 baada ya engines zote mbili ku-transfer kutoka ndege ingine, lakini haiko clear kama 'B' check na throttle rigging zilikuwa complete kabla ya signoff. Shift ya jana walitupatia info ambayo haikuwa sahihi, so ukaguzi ulifungwa before kazi zote ku-verify. Shift inayokuja lazima ithibitishe status ya 'B' check kwa engines zote mbili, i-check throttle linkage rigging, na ihakikishe castellated nut na cotter key zimewekwa properly kabla ya release yoyote.
summary: Final inspection ya #1 engine ili-sign kabla ya 'B' check na throttle rigging kukamilika, kutokana na bad handover info kutoka shift ya jana.

narrative_text: During the C Check on the Fokker 100, the crew replacing the cracked angle on the aft pressure bulkhead could not install solid fasteners without removing components for access, so supervisor authorized Cherry Max fasteners as a temporary workaround and the mechanic short-signed the card noting this. The engineering directive with the specified fastener requirement was missing from the work pack, which caused confusion over the correct fastener type. Aircraft was reworked in September during a repetitive inspection to install the correct fasteners; Quality and Assurance is now reviewing the paperwork gap. Next shift please ensure all directive numbers and engineering authority references are attached to job cards before sign-off.
summary: A missing engineering directive in the work pack led to incorrect fasteners being installed on the aft bulkhead angle, requiring rework and a Quality and Assurance review.

narrative_text: Wakati wa C Check kwenye ndege ya Fokker 100, fundi aliyekuwa akibadilisha angle iliyopasuka kwenye aft pressure bulkhead alishindwa kufunga fasteners imara bila kuondoa vipengele vingine kwa ajili ya access, hivyo msimamizi aliidhinisha matumizi ya Cherry Max fasteners kwa muda na fundi akasaini kadi akieleza sababu hiyo. Hati ya maelekezo ya uhandisi iliyoeleza fasteners sahihi ilikuwa haipo kwenye work pack, jambo lililosababisha mkanganyiko kuhusu fasteners za kutumia. Ndege ilirekebishwa tena mwezi Septemba wakati wa ukaguzi wa marudio kwa kuweka fasteners sahihi, na sasa idara ya Quality and Assurance inafuatilia suala hilo la nyaraka zilizokosekana. Zamu inayofuata ihakikishe nyaraka zote za maelekezo zinaambatanishwa na job card kabla ya kusainiwa.
summary: Hati ya maelekezo ya uhandisi iliyokosekana kwenye work pack ilisababisha ufungaji wa fasteners zisizo sahihi kwenye bulkhead ya nyuma, hivyo kuhitaji marekebisho na ufuatiliaji wa Quality and Assurance.

narrative_text: Kwa hii C Check ya Fokker 100, fundi alikuwa anabadilisha ile cracked angle kwenye aft pressure bulkhead lakini akagundua ata-install solid fasteners atalazimika kuremove components ndio apate access. Supervisor akasema tu-install Cherry Max fasteners as a workaround, so mechanic akasign job card akitaja per supervisor's instruction. Turns out ile engineering directive yenye fastener requirements haikuwa attached kwa work pack, ndio ikaleta hiyo confusion yote. Ndege ilikuja tena September for repetitive inspection wakarekebisha na correct fasteners, na sasa QA wanafuatilia hii paperwork gap - next shift wahakikishe directives zote zinakuwa attached kwa job card kabla ya sign-off.
