summary: Directive ya engineering ilikuwa haipo kwenye work pack ndio ikapelekea kufungwa kwa fasteners zisizo sahihi kwenye bulkhead, hivyo kuhitaji rework na QA follow-up.

narrative_text: Night shift installed the air intake spinner extension on the #2 engine but did not sign off the corresponding block on the 'B' check work card covering all three GPM parts. Day shift completed the spinner and fairing installation, torqued both to manual values, and signed the block for all three items even though the extension was fitted by the previous crew. Please verify with the crew chief who actually performed the extension install so the card reflects the correct technician, and confirm torque values on the extension were properly recorded.
summary: Sign-off on the #2 engine air intake spinner 'B' check card does not match who actually installed the spinner extension, requiring verification.

narrative_text: Zamu ya usiku waliweka spinner extension kwenye engine namba mbili lakini hawakusaini sehemu husika kwenye kadi ya ukaguzi wa 'B' inayohusu vipengele vyote vitatu vya GPM. Zamu ya mchana tulikamilisha ufungaji wa spinner na fairing, tukazibana kwa torque sahihi kulingana na maintenance manual, na kusaini kadi hiyo kwa vitu vyote vitatu ingawa extension iliwekwa na zamu iliyopita. Tafadhali thibitisha na crew chief husika ni nani hasa aliyefunga extension ili kadi ionyeshe fundi sahihi, na uhakiki torque values za extension zimeandikwa vizuri.
summary: Kuna tofauti kati ya aliyesaini kadi ya ukaguzi wa 'B' na aliyefunga spinner extension kwenye engine namba mbili, hivyo inahitaji uthibitisho.

entities.text: torque sahihi kulingana na maintenance manual

narrative_text: Night shift walifunga ile air intake spinner extension kwa engine number two lakini hawaku-sign ile block kwenye 'B' check card ambayo inacover vitu vitatu vya GPM. Mimi nikaja nika-complete installation ya spinner na fairing, nika-torque zote according to manual, na nika-sign card kwa vitu vyote vitatu ata ingawa extension iliwekwa na crew ya usiku. Ni lazima tu-verify na crew chief ni nani hasa alifanya install ya extension ili documentation iwe sahihi, na tu-confirm torque values za extension zi-recorded properly.
summary: Kuna discrepancy kwenye sign-off ya 'B' check card ya spinner extension kwa engine number two, inahitaji verification na crew chief.

narrative_text: On the B737-300, spoiler control cables WSA1-2 and WSA2-2 were found wrapped around each other during a spoiler mixer time-change; they were downstream of cables previously flagged as corroded (WSB2-1, WSA1-4, WSB1-4, WSA2-4, WSB2-4) and were rectified same day with no damage found. Note also that during the earlier corrosion job I handed over the system rigging and turn-barrel safety-wiring to another inspector before shift end because none of the cables were tensioning up and turn-barrels were loose. Next shift must confirm cable routing on all spoiler control runs and verify turn-barrel rigging/safety-wire was completed correctly downstream.
summary: Crossed spoiler control cables were found and fixed on the B737-300 after a prior incomplete rigging handover during corrosion repairs, requiring downstream verification.

entities.text: spoiler control cables WSA1-2 and WSA2-2

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya B737-300, wakati wa kubadilisha spoiler mixer, iligundulika kuwa nyaya za spoiler control WSA1-2 na WSA2-2 zilijikunja zenyewe kwa zenyewe, zikiwa chini ya mfumo ambao awali ulikuwa na nyaya zilizoripotiwa kutu (WSB2-1, WSA1-4, WSB1-4, WSA2-4, WSB2-4). Tatizo lilirekebishwa siku hiyo hiyo na hakuna uharibifu uliopatikana. Ni muhimu kutambua kuwa kazi ya awali ya kurekebisha kutu ilikabidhiwa kwa mkaguzi mwingine kabla ya kumaliza shift, kwani nyaya hazikuwa zinakaza vizuri na turn-barrel zilikuwa huru. Shift inayofuata inatakiwa kuthibitisha upya mpangilio wa nyaya zote za spoiler control na kuhakikisha urekebishaji wa turn-barrel na safety-wiring ulifanyika kwa usahihi.
summary: Nyaya za spoiler control kwenye B737-300 zilipatikana zikiwa zimejikunja baada ya kukabidhiwa kazi isiyokamilika, hivyo inahitaji uthibitisho zaidi wa ukaguzi.

entities.text: nyaya za spoiler control WSA1-2 na WSA2-2

narrative_text: Kwa hii B737-300, tukifanya spoiler mixer time-change, tuligundua spoiler control cables WSA1-2 na WSA2-2 zimejizonga kwa zenyewe, zikiwa downstream ya zile cables ambazo tayari ziliripotiwa corroded (WSB2-1, WSA1-4, WSB1-4, WSA2-4, WSB2-4). Tuli-rectify hiyo issue siku hiyo hiyo, hakuna damage iliyopatikana kwa cables au structure. Cha kukumbuka, wakati wa ile corrosion job nili-hand over ile system rigging na turn-barrel safety-wiring kwa inspector mwingine kwa sababu ya shift change, na cables hazikuwa zina-tension vizuri, turn-barrels zilikuwa loose. Shift inayofuata i-confirm cable routing kwa spoiler control runs zote na i-verify kama rigging na safety-wire ilikamilika sawasawa downstream.
summary: Spoiler control cables kwenye B737-300 zilipatikana zime-cross baada ya incomplete handover ya rigging job, so next shift lazima ifuatilie na ku-verify kila kitu.

entities.text: spoiler control cables WSA1-2 na WSA2-2

narrative_text: B777-200 arrived with an EICAS message for a left engine bleed air fault; R&R of the left engine Fan Air Modulating Valve (FAMV) was initiated but handover to the next shift happened with almost no turnover time, leaving the incoming team to pick up mid-task. After valve replacement, time pressure to avoid further delay led to deferring the required engine bleed ops test and instead rendering the new valve inoperative/open per MEL for dispatch; this required deactivating the thrust reverser isolation shutoff valve before opening the reverser to access the FAMV. Next shift must confirm the MEL steps were fully completed and documented in the logbook, and verify the reverser deactivation/reactivation was properly signed off before further dispatch.
summary: Left engine FAMV replacement on a B777-200 was handed over mid-task with inadequate turnover, and time pressure led to deferring the ops test in favor of an MEL dispatch that required thrust reverser deactivation, needing follow-up verification.

narrative_text: Ndege ya B777-200 ilifika ikiwa na tatizo la bleed air kwenye injini ya kushoto, na kazi ya kubadilisha valve ya FAMV ilianzishwa lakini makabidhiano kati ya zamu mbili hayakuwa na muda wa kutosha, hivyo zamu iliyofuata ililazimika kuendelea na kazi bila maelezo kamili. Baada ya kubadilisha valve, kwa sababu ya shinikizo la muda na kuepuka ucheleweshaji zaidi, uamuzi ulifanywa wa kutofanya kipimo cha lazima cha mfumo wa bleed na badala yake valve mpya ikafanywa isifanye kazi (open) kulingana na MEL ili ndege iruhusiwe kuruka, jambo lililohitaji kuzima thrust reverser kabla ya kufungua kufikia valve hiyo. Zamu inayofuata inatakiwa kuhakikisha hatua zote za MEL zimekamilika na kuandikwa vizuri kwenye logbook, na kuthibitisha kwamba thrust reverser imerejeshwa katika hali sahihi kabla ya safari nyingine.
summary: Ubadilishaji wa valve ya FAMV kwenye injini ya kushoto ya B777-200 ulikabidhiwa kwa zamu nyingine bila maelezo ya kutosha, na shinikizo la muda lilisababisha kuepukwa kwa kipimo cha ops na badala yake kutumika utaratibu wa MEL, hivyo inahitajika ufuatiliaji.

narrative_text: Hii B777-200 ilikuja na EICAS message ya left engine bleed air problem, so wakaanza R&R ya FAMV lakini handover kati ya shifts haikuwa na muda mzuri, so nilikuja tu nikaendelea na kazi bila kupewa full details. Baada ya kubadilisha valve, kwa sababu ya time pressure ya kuepuka delay zaidi, tuka-decide kufanya valve iwe inoperative in open position per MEL for dispatch, na hii ilihitaji ku-deactivate thrust reverser isolation shutoff valve kabla ya kufungua reverser kufikia FAMV. Next shift wahakikishe MEL steps zote zime-completiwa na zime-recorded vizuri kwenye logbook, na wa-verify thrust reverser imerudishwa sawa kabla ya dispatch nyingine.
summary: FAMV replacement kwenye left engine ya B777-200 ilifanyika na handover mbaya kati ya shifts, na time pressure ikasababisha kuskip ops test na badala yake kutumia MEL dispatch, kitu ambacho kinahitaji follow-up ya haraka.

narrative_text: On the B757-200, the mid lavatory was placarded inop for an external leak at the service port, but the two technicians handling it were pulled off for scheduled paid lunch before the clamp was installed and the inop sticker placed at the service panel. Two relief mechs were sent to finish the job with no written or verbal turnover, and the aircraft pushed back before MEL compliance was actually completed. When the original techs checked with the relief mechs, neither party realized the job was incomplete; supervisor was notified and asked to bring the aircraft back to the gate but refused, saying downline station ZZZ1 would handle it instead. Follow-up needed: confirm with ZZZ1 that the clamp was installed and MEL properly closed out before further dispatch.
summary: Lavatory MEL compliance on a B757-200 was left incomplete after a rushed shift/lunch handoff with no turnover, and the aircraft departed the gate without the clamp or inop placard confirmed installed.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya B757-200, choo cha katikati kiliwekwa alama ya inop kwa sababu ya uvujaji nje kwenye service port, lakini mafundi wawili waliokuwa wakishughulikia hilo waliondolewa kazini ili wapate chakula cha mchana kabla ya kuweka clamp na sticker ya inop pale kwenye paneli. Mafundi wengine wawili walipewa kazi ya kumaliza bila maelezo yoyote ya maandishi wala ya mdomo, na ndege ikaondoka geti kabla kazi ya MEL haijakamilika kikamilifu. Wafanyakazi wa awali waliporudi na kuuliza kuhusu hali ya MEL, wote waligundua kuwa kazi haikuwa imekamilika; msimamizi alijulishwa na kuombwa arudishe ndege gate lakini alikataa, akisema kituo cha ZZZ1 kitakamilisha kazi hiyo. Inahitajika ufuatiliaji: thibitisha na ZZZ1 kwamba clamp imewekwa na MEL imefungwa vizuri kabla ya safari nyingine.
summary: Kazi ya MEL kwenye choo cha ndege ya B757-200 iliachwa nusu baada ya mafundi kubadilishwa bila maelezo kamili, na ndege ikaondoka geti bila uhakika wa clamp au alama ya inop.

narrative_text: Kwa hii B757-200, mid lavatory ilikuwa placarded inop due external leak kwa service port, lakini sisi wawili tuliokuwa tunafanya job tuliitwa tuende lunch kabla ya kuweka clamp na kubandika inop sticker pale service panel. Wakaleta wale wengine mechs wawili wamalize kazi bila turnover yoyote, written ama verbal, halafu ndege ikaondoka gate kabla MEL compliance haijakamilika fully. Tuliporudi na kuuliza wale wengine kuhusu MEL, hakuna hata mmoja alikuwa anajua kama job haijaisha; tulienda kwa supervisor tukamwomba arudishe aircraft gate lakini akakataa, akasema atapiga simu ZZZ1 wamalize hapo. Follow-up inahitajika: confirm na ZZZ1 kama clamp imewekwa na MEL imeclose out properly kabla ya next dispatch.
summary: MEL job ya lavatory kwa B757-200 iliachwa incomplete baada ya rushed shift change bila turnover, na aircraft ikaondoka gate bila clamp au inop placard kuconfirm.

narrative_text: MD-88 duct burnout job card (MM 21-20-02-2) was not fully closed out during the previous shift's turnover due to weather and multiple crew changes; no verbal handover was given at the aircraft. During close-up, line 44 (remove caps from L/R augmentation valve T-fittings) was skipped, mistakenly believed already done. Aircraft was released to service, later diverted with a cabin odor/mechanical issue and evacuated on the runway. Next shift must verify all remaining caps/plugs removed and confirm full job card sign-off before further dispatch.
summary: Incomplete verbal turnover and a skipped close-up step on an MD-88 auto temperature system job card led to plugs being left in the augmentation valve fittings, causing an in-flight odor event and emergency evacuation.

narrative_text: Kazi ya duct burnout kwenye MD-88 (job card 21-20-02-2) haikukamilika vizuri wakati wa zamu iliyopita kwa sababu ya hali mbaya ya hewa na mabadiliko ya mafundi kadhaa; hakuna taarifa ya mdomo iliyotolewa kwenye ndege. Wakati wa close-up, line 44 ya kutoa vifuniko kwenye augmentation valve T-fittings za kushoto na kulia ilisahaulika kwa kudhani tayari imeshafanyika. Ndege ilirudishwa kazini na baadaye ikalazimika kutua dharura kutokana na harufu ya ajabu kwenye kabin, na wasafiri wakaondolewa kwa dharura kwenye njia ya kurukia. Zamu inayokuja lazima ihakikishe vifuniko vyote vimetolewa na job card imesainiwa kikamilifu kabla ya ndege kuruhusiwa kuruka tena.
summary: Kukosekana kwa taarifa kamili ya makabidhiano na kusahaulika kwa hatua moja katika ukaguzi wa mfumo wa joto wa MD-88 kulisababisha vifuniko kubaki kwenye valve, na hatimaye tukio la harufu angani na uokoaji wa dharura.

entities.text: augmentation valve T-fittings za kushoto na kulia

narrative_text: Ile duct burnout job card ya MD-88 (MM 21-20-02-2) haikufinishiwa properly wakati wa previous shift kwa sababu ya weather mbaya na mafundi wengi walibadilishana bila kuachiana verbal turnover kwenye aircraft. Wakati wa close-up, fundi aliskip line 44 ya kutoa caps kwenye L na R augmentation valve T-fittings, akidhani step hiyo ilikuwa already done. Aircraft ilirudishwa service na baadaye ikadivert kwa emergency landing na evacuation kwa sababu ya odor kwenye cabin. Next shift wahakikishe caps zote zimetolewa na job card imesainiwa fully kabla ya dispatch yoyote nyingine.
summary: Kukosa verbal handover na kuskip step moja kwenye MD-88 auto temp system job card kulileta plugs kubaki kwenye augmentation valve, hivyo kusababisha odor event angani na emergency evacuation.

entities.text: L na R augmentation valve T-fittings

narrative_text: A300 had its APU replaced on night shift; the exhaust bellows connecting the APU to the exhaust duct was found deteriorated and the work card was stopped at that step, leaving remaining steps including the final inspection RII open. Maint Ops directed that the FMR log entry state the work card was not completed, though QA and the Overhaul Technician Foreman agree this is not proper given the incomplete paperwork on a major component change. Next shift must confirm status before any APU start attempt, as the aircraft routing was changed and the bellows still needs to be repaired and paperwork closed out.
summary: APU replacement on the A300 is incomplete due to a deteriorated exhaust bellows, with open work card steps and unresolved paperwork requiring follow-up before any APU start.

narrative_text: APU ya ndege ya A300 ilibadilishwa wakati wa shift ya usiku, lakini bellows ya exhaust inayounganisha APU na duct imeonekana imechakaa, na work card ilisimamishwa kwenye hatua hiyo huku hatua zilizobaki, ikiwemo final inspection RII, zikiwa bado wazi. Maint Ops walielekeza kuandikwa kwenye FMR kwamba work card haijakamilika, ingawa QA na Foreman wa Overhaul wanakubaliana kuwa hali hii si sahihi kwa sababu component kubwa imebadilishwa lakini nyaraka hazijakamilika. Shift inayofuata inatakiwa kuthibitisha hali hiyo kabla ya kujaribu kuanzisha APU, kwani njia ya ndege ilibadilishwa na tatizo la bellows bado halijatengenezwa na nyaraka bado hazijafungwa.
summary: APU ya A300 haijakamilika kubadilishwa kutokana na bellows ya exhaust iliyochakaa, na nyaraka zake bado ziko wazi hivyo zinahitaji ufuatiliaji kabla ya kuanzisha APU.

narrative_text: Kwenye A300, APU ilibadilishwa night shift lakini exhaust bellows inayounganisha APU na exhaust duct imeonekana imechakaa, so work card ilistop kwenye hiyo step na remaining steps, including final inspection RII, ziko open. Maint Ops walisema tuweke kwenye FMR kwamba work card haikukamilika, lakini QA na Overhaul Technician Foreman wanaona hii si sawa kwa sababu ni major component replacement na paperwork bado incomplete. Next shift lazima wafollow-up status kabla ya kufanya APU start attempt yoyote, kwa sababu aircraft routing ilibadilishwa na bellows bado haijafanyiwa repair wala paperwork kufungwa.
summary: APU replacement kwenye A300 bado haijakamilika kwa sababu ya exhaust bellows iliyochakaa, na paperwork bado open hivyo inahitaji follow-up kabla ya APU start yoyote.

narrative_text: During tonight's scheduled check on the B757, the 700+ lb fly-away kit was removed from the aft cargo compartment while the logbook signoff was in progress, and shift change created confusion over whether removal needed a logbook entry at all. A day-shift tech advised us that this kit is only signed off when installed, not removed, so no entry was made and responsibility for signoff was left unclear. Next shift please confirm with QA/records whether an entry is required for kit removal before release, as the aircraft was released with this write-up open and later had to be grounded elsewhere for a nose-heavy condition.
summary: Miscommunication over logbook signoff responsibility for a removed fly-away kit led to an aircraft release with an open item, resulting in a nose-heavy condition and later grounding.

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa kawaida wa ndege ya B757 usiku huu, kifaa cha fly-away kit chenye uzito wa zaidi ya kilo 300 kiliondolewa kwenye sehemu ya mizigo ya nyuma huku sahihi ya logbook ikiwa bado haijakamilika, na mabadiliko ya zamu yalisababisha mkanganyiko kuhusu kama uondoaji huo unahitaji kuandikwa kwenye logbook. Fundi wa zamu ya mchana alituambia kuwa kifaa hicho husainiwa tu kinapowekwa, si kinapoondolewa, hivyo hakuna maelezo yaliyoandikwa na hakukuwa na uwazi kuhusu nani anastahili kusaini. Zamu inayofuata tafadhali mthibitishe na idara ya ubora kama kuna haja ya kuandika maelezo hayo kabla ya kutoa ndege, kwani ndege ilitolewa ikiwa na hitilafu hiyo bado wazi, na baadaye ilibidi isimamishwe mahali pengine kwa sababu sehemu yake ya mbele ilikuwa nzito kupita kiasi.
summary: Mkanganyiko wa mawasiliano kuhusu wajibu wa kusaini logbook kwa kifaa kilichoondolewa ulisababisha ndege kutolewa ikiwa na hitilafu wazi, na baadaye kusimamishwa kwa sababu ya uzito usio sawa mbele.

narrative_text: Leo usiku tulikuwa tunafanya scheduled check kwa B757, na wakati tunaendelea na logbook signoff, watu walikuwa wanaondoa ile fly-away kit ya zaidi ya 700 lbs kutoka aft cargo. Kulikuwa na shift change wakati huo huo, na fundi wa day shift akatuambia kwamba signoff ya hiyo kit inafanywa tu ikiwa imewekwa (installed), sio ikiondolewa, so hakuna entry iliyofanywa kwenye logbook. Next crew please fuatilia na QA kama entry inahitajika kwa removal ya kit, kwa sababu ndege ilipewa airworthiness release na hiyo write-up bado open, na baadaye ilibidi i-ground mahali pengine kwa sababu ilikuwa nose heavy.
summary: Kulikuwa na miscommunication kuhusu nani anasign logbook baada ya fly-away kit kuondolewa, na hiyo ikasababisha aircraft kupewa release na open write-up ambayo baadaye ikasababisha grounding kwa sababu ya nose heavy condition.

narrative_text: On the B757-200 lightning damage repair, the static port was pulled on suspicion of damage but inspection found it serviceable, so the original port was reinstalled. Measurements did not meet MMOV 34-11-03 and SRM 51-10-03 tolerances, so a carry-forward item was written for shaving/smoothing per those references. Note: the removed ports were tagged correctly by the previous crew, but the turnover paperwork and existing write-up on the port swap were not updated to show the originals went back in - next shift needs to verify port identity against tags before closing the shave task.
summary: Reinstalled static port on B757 requires shaving per MMOV/SRM specs, and paperwork must be corrected to confirm original port identity.

narrative_text: Katika ukarabati wa ndege ya B757-200 iliyopigwa na radi, static port iliondolewa kwa tuhuma za uharibifu lakini ukaguzi ulionyesha iko sawa, hivyo ile port ya asili ilirudishwa mahali pake. Vipimo havikukidhi masharti ya MMOV 34-11-03 na SRM 51-10-03, hivyo kazi ya kuchonga na kulainisha port iliandikwa kama carry-forward kufuata miongozo hiyo. Timu iliyoondoa ports ilikuwa imeziweka lebo sahihi, lakini nyaraka za mabadiliko ya zamu na taarifa iliyoandikwa awali kuhusu kubadilishana ports hazikusasishwa kuonyesha kuwa ports za asili ndizo zilizorudishwa - zamu inayofuata inahitaji kuthibitisha utambulisho wa port kwa kutumia lebo kabla ya kufunga kazi ya kuchonga.
summary: Static port iliyorudishwa kwenye B757 inahitaji kuchongwa kulingana na taratibu za MMOV/SRM, na nyaraka zinahitaji kusahihishwa kuthibitisha utambulisho wa port ya asili.

narrative_text: Kwenye lightning damage repair ya B757-200, tuli-remove static port tukidhani imeharibika, lakini after inspection ikaonekana iko sawa so tuli-reinstall ile original port. Measurements hazikupass requirements za MMOV 34-11-03 na SRM 51-10-03, so tuli-write carry-forward item ya ku-shave na ku-smooth port kama reference inavyosema. Issue ni kwamba crew iliyo-remove ports walitag vizuri, lakini turnover paperwork na ile write-up ya awali kuhusu kubadilishana ports haikuwa updated kuonyesha original ports ndizo zimerudi - next shift wanahitaji ku-verify port identity against tags kabla ya ku-close ile shave task.
summary: Static port ya B757 inahitaji ku-shave kufuata MMOV/SRM specs, na paperwork inahitaji kusahihishwa ku-confirm original port identity.

narrative_text: Picked up mid-shift: contract maintenance was unable to secure the loose passenger seat at row 5 on the B737-300, seat kept slipping in the track. I applied MEL 25-6 to defer the entire seat assembly and released the aircraft, but on review afterward realized this was the wrong MEL application for the discrepancy. Please have SAN contract maintenance inspect and repair the seat track properly and clear the MEL as soon as possible. Flag this in the logbook so the next shift is aware of the correction needed.
summary: An incorrect MEL was applied to defer a loose row 5 passenger seat on a B737-300, and SAN contract maintenance now needs to fix the seat and clear the MEL properly.

narrative_text: Nilipokea kazi hii ikiwa tayari inaendelea wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu: fundi wa kandarasi alishindwa kutengeneza kiti cha abiria kwenye safu ya tano cha ndege ya B737-300, kiti kilikuwa kinalegea kwenye njia yake. Niliamua kutumia MEL 25-6 kuahirisha kiti kizima na ndege ikaruka, lakini baadaye nikagundua kuwa hilo halikuwa chaguo sahihi kwa tatizo hilo. Tafadhali hakikisha timu ya kandarasi ya SAN inarekebisha kiti hicho vizuri na kufunga MEL hiyo haraka iwezekanavyo. Weka kumbukumbu sahihi kwenye logbook ili zamu inayofuata ijue hali halisi.
summary: MEL isiyofaa ilitumika kuahirisha kiti cha abiria kilicholegea kwenye safu ya tano cha ndege ya B737-300, na sasa timu ya SAN inahitajika kukirekebisha na kufunga MEL hiyo.

narrative_text: Nilikuta hii issue tayari iko in work wakati wa turnover kwa maint control. Contract maintenance walikuwa wanajaribu kufix seat ya row 5 kwenye hiyo B737-300, but seat ilikuwa loose kwenye track na haikuwa fixable. Niliamua kuapply MEL 25-6 for the whole seat assembly na aircraft ikadepart, lakini baadaye nikagundua that was the wrong call kwa hii discrepancy. Please arrange na SAN contract maintenance wafix properly na waclear ile MEL, na hakikisha logbook entry iko updated for next shift.
summary: Wrong MEL iliapplyiwa kwa loose seat ya row 5 kwenye B737-300, na SAN contract maintenance wanahitajika kufix na kuclear MEL hiyo properly.

narrative_text: Repaired sound deadening material on the #2 engine cowling per SRM 54-00-01-2, using heat gun due to outside air temp being below the minimum required for curing. Patch had set but remained tacky to touch after reheating; a second heat application did not improve cure. Incoming shift to recheck the patch at least 1 hour before shift change and confirm proper set before releasing the aircraft.
summary: Engine cowling patch repair on #2 engine remains tacky after cold-weather cure attempts and needs rechecking by next shift.

entities.text: at least 1 hour before shift change

narrative_text: Nimefanya ukarabati wa sound deadening material kwenye cowling ya engine namba 2 kufuata SRM 54-00-01-2, nikitumia heat gun kwa sababu joto la nje lilikuwa chini ya kiwango kinachohitajika kukausha patch. Baada ya muda patch ilionekana imeshikamana lakini bado ilikuwa inanata nikigusa, na hata baada ya kurudia heat gun mara ya pili haikubadilika. Shift inayofuata ichunguze tena patch angalau saa moja kabla ya mabadiliko ya zamu ili kuhakikisha imekauka vizuri kabla ndege haijaruhusiwa kusafiri.
summary: Ukarabati wa patch kwenye cowling ya engine namba 2 bado unanata baada ya kukaushwa kwenye joto la baridi, hivyo unahitaji kuchunguzwa tena na zamu inayofuata.

entities.text: saa moja kabla ya mabadiliko ya zamu

narrative_text: Nilifanya repair ya sound deadening material kwa #2 engine cowling as per SRM 54-00-01-2, nikatumia heat gun kwa sababu outside air temp ilikuwa below minimum required for cure. Patch ilikuwa imeset lakini bado ilikuwa tacky nikigusa, so nikarudia heat gun lakini haikusaidia kuwa harder. Next shift wachek tena patch at least 1 hour before shift change kuconfirm imeset vizuri kabla ya release ya aircraft.
summary: Patch ya #2 engine cowling bado ni tacky baada ya heat gun applications mbili, so next shift wanahitaji kurecheck kabla ya release.

entities.text: at least 1 hour before shift change

narrative_text: Completed adjustments on the R normal brake control valve on the Fokker 100 after valve replacement by previous mech; scatter shield had been unfastened and moved aft to gain access during the job. After adjusting the brake tension spring at the capt's R rudder pedal, gear doors were closed and acft was pushed out and taxied for ops brake check, which came back good. Realized after first flight, when crew reported gear would not retract fully, that the scatter shield was never refastened before the wheel well was closed up. Next shift needs to verify scatter shield installation and fasteners on R wheel well before any further brake system closeout is signed off.
summary: A technician forgot to refasten the R wheel well scatter shield after brake valve adjustments, leading to a gear retraction problem on the aircraft's first flight.

narrative_text: Nilimaliza kazi ya ku-adjust R normal brake control valve kwenye ndege ya Fokker 100 baada ya fundi mwenzangu kubadilisha valve hiyo; scatter shield ilikuwa imefunguliwa na kusogezwa nyuma ili kupata nafasi ya kufanya kazi. Baada ya kurekebisha spring ya breki karibu na rudder pedal ya kulia ya kapteni, milango ya landing gear ilifungwa na ndege ikatolewa nje kwa ajili ya taxi na brake check, ambayo ilionekana sawa. Baadaye, wakati wa safari ya kwanza, tatizo la gear kutoingia vizuri kwenye wheel well liligundulika kuwa lilisababishwa na scatter shield ambayo sikuifunga vizuri kabla ya kufunga milango ya gear. Shift inayofuata inatakiwa kuhakikisha scatter shield na fasteners zake zimefungwa vizuri kwenye R wheel well kabla ya kutia sahihi kazi hiyo kama imekamilika.
summary: Fundi alisahau kufunga scatter shield kwenye R wheel well baada ya kurekebisha valve ya breki, jambo lililosababisha tatizo la gear kutoingia vizuri wakati wa safari ya kwanza ya ndege.

narrative_text: Nilimaliza adjustments kwenye R normal brake control valve ya Fokker 100 baada ya yule mech kubadilisha valve; scatter shield ilikuwa imetolewa na kusukumwa aft kupata access wakati wa job. Tulipo-adjust ile brake tension spring karibu na capt's R rudder pedal, tulifunga gear doors, tukatoka hangar na kufanya ops check ya brakes, ambayo ilikuwa good. Lakini kwenye first flight, crew waliripoti gear haiwezi retract properly, tukagundua scatter shield haikuwa refastened kabla ya kufunga wheel well. Shift inayofuata i-verify scatter shield na fasteners zake kwenye R wheel well kabla ya kusign off kazi yoyote ya brake system.
summary: Fundi alisahau ku-refasten scatter shield kwenye R wheel well baada ya brake valve adjustments, na hii ndio ilisababisha gear retraction problem kwenye first flight.

narrative_text: On the B737-700, the FMC control display unit was pulled to support another aircraft right at shift change, and the removal was never logged. A test LRU was fitted for the functional check, but the aircraft was released back to service with that test unit still installed since no spare CDU was available. Next shift needs to verify logbook entries, confirm CDU status, and swap in a proper serviceable unit before further dispatch.
summary: A B737-700 was dispatched with a test FMC display unit installed after the original removal went unlogged during a rushed shift change.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya B737-700, kitengo cha maonyesho cha FMC kiliondolewa ili kutumika kwenye ndege nyingine karibu na wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu, lakini uondoaji huo haukuandikwa kwenye logbook. Kifaa cha majaribio (test LRU) kiliwekwa kwa ajili ya ukaguzi wa utendaji, na ndege ikaruhusiwa kuendelea na safari huku kifaa hicho cha majaribio kikiwa bado kimewekwa kwa sababu hapakuwa na kipuri halisi. Zamu inayofuata inahitajika kuhakiki maandiko ya logbook, kuthibitisha hali ya CDU, na kubadilisha kwa kifaa sahihi kabla ya safari nyingine.
summary: Ndege ya B737-700 iliruhusiwa kuruka ikiwa na kifaa cha majaribio cha FMC baada ya uondoaji wa kifaa halisi kutoandikwa wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu yenye haraka.

narrative_text: Kwa hii B737-700, ile FMC control display unit iliremove kwa ajili ya aircraft nyingine karibu na shift change, but logbook entry ya removal haikuandikwa. Walifit test LRU kwa functional check, halafu ndege ikadispatch na hiyo test unit ikiwa imebaki installed kwani hapakuwa na spare CDU. Next shift wanahitaji ku-verify logbook, confirm status ya CDU, na kubadilisha na proper unit before dispatch tena.
summary: B737-700 ilidispatch na test FMC display unit baada ya removal ya original unit kutoandikwa during shift change ya haraka.

narrative_text: B737-700 ACARS antenna doubler installation completed this shift; rivets were bucked too flat while installing the two antenna doublers on the upper fuselage skin, causing the skin to distort. Shift inspector signed off the work as acceptable and cover plates/seals were installed before turnover. Incoming shift inspection rejected the doubler installation and found aircraft skin damage requiring a sheet metal repair — please coordinate with QA and follow up on the repair disposition.
summary: Improperly bucked rivets during antenna doubler installation on a B737-700 caused fuselage skin damage, discovered by the next shift's inspection after initial sign-off.

narrative_text: Kazi ya kufunga doubler mbili za antenna ya ACARS kwenye ndege B737-700 imekamilika zamu hii, lakini wakati wa kufunga, rivets zilibonyezwa bapa mno na hii ilisababisha ngozi ya fuselage kuharibika kidogo. Msimamizi wa ukaguzi wa zamu alikubali kazi hiyo kama sahihi, na cover plates pamoja na sealing zilifanywa kabla ya mabadiliko ya zamu. Ukaguzi wa zamu iliyofuata haukukubali ufungaji wa doubler na uligundua uharibifu wa ngozi ya ndege unaohitaji ukarabati wa metal sheet; tafadhali fuatilia hali ya ukarabati huo na uwasiliane na idara ya ubora.
summary: Rivets zilizobonyezwa vibaya wakati wa ufungaji wa doubler za antenna kwenye B737-700 zilisababisha uharibifu wa ngozi ya ndege, jambo lililobainika baada ya ukaguzi wa zamu iliyofuata.

entities.text: kufunga doubler mbili za antenna ya ACARS

narrative_text: Tulikamilisha installation ya antenna doublers mbili za ACARS kwenye B737-700 zamu hii, lakini wakati wa kubuck rivets kwenye fuselage skin, buck tails zilikuwa flat mno na skin ikaharibika kidogo. Shift inspector alikubali kazi ile as OK, tukafunga cover plates na kufanya sealing kabla ya turnover. Sasa incoming inspection wame-reject ile doubler installation, wamekuta damage kwenye skin inayohitaji sheet metal repair — tafadhali fuatilia na QA kuhusu disposition ya hiyo repair.
summary: Rivets zilizobuckwa flat wakati wa antenna doubler installation kwenye B737-700 zilisababisha fuselage skin damage, ambayo iligunduliwa na next shift inspection.

narrative_text: B737-300 standby attitude indicator squawk was completed on night shift; phase adapter in the lower nose compartment and the P2-1 panel were reinstalled after afternoon shift had opened them up for troubleshooting. Logbook and turnover report were signed off as all items complete and ops checked. Next day pilot reported standby airspeed altimeter appears inop; corrective action was reconnecting the pitot/static lines on the indicator, so incoming shift please verify all P2-1 panel connections were properly reinstalled, especially pitot/static lines, before next dispatch.
summary: After a standby attitude indicator repair involving removal of the P2-1 panel, pitot/static lines were apparently left disconnected, causing a follow-on standby altimeter squawk that needs verification on the next shift.

narrative_text: Tatizo la standby attitude indicator kwenye B737-300 lilishughulikiwa na wafanyakazi wa zamu ya usiku, baada ya zamu ya mchana kutoa phase adapter kwenye chumba cha chini cha pua na P2-1 panel kwa ajili ya uchunguzi. Vifaa vyote vilirudishwa, na logbook pamoja na turnover report vilisainiwa kuonyesha kazi imekamilika na imefanyiwa ops check. Siku iliyofuata rubani aliripoti standby airspeed altimeter inaonekana haifanyi kazi, na ilibainika kuwa hoses za pitot/static hazikuunganishwa vizuri baada ya kufunga panel; zamu inayofuata iangalie tena muunganiko wa panel ya P2-1 kabla ya ndege kuruhusiwa kuruka tena.
summary: Baada ya kutengeneza standby attitude indicator na kufungua P2-1 panel, hoses za pitot/static hazikuunganishwa vizuri, hivyo kusababisha tatizo jipya la altimeter linalohitaji ukaguzi wa haraka.

entities.text: kuangalia muunganiko wa panel ya P2-1

narrative_text: Ile squawk ya standby attitude indicator kwa B737-300 tuliifanyia kazi night shift, baada ya afternoon shift kuremove ile phase adapter kwenye lower nose compartment na P2-1 panel kwa ajili ya troubleshooting. Tulirudisha kila kitu, tuka-sign off logbook na turnover report kwamba job imekamilika na ime-pass ops check. Siku ya pili pilot ame-report standby airspeed altimeter inaonekana inop, na ikagundulika ati pitot/static lines hazikuwa zime-reconnect vizuri baada ya kufunga panel - kwa hivyo next shift please mrudi mcheck connections zote za P2-1 panel kabla ya next dispatch.
summary: Baada ya repair ya standby attitude indicator na kufungua P2-1 panel, pitot/static lines hazikuwa reconnected vizuri, na hii imesababisha squawk mpya ya altimeter inayohitaji follow-up haraka.

entities.text: mcheck connections zote za P2-1 panel

narrative_text: During shift, observed a new-hire technician securing the Dash 8-100 aircraft batteries to the battery tray using copper breakaway wire instead of the required 0.032 inch safety wire. She admitted using the same incorrect method on another aircraft the previous week. Supervisor was notified and maintenance control was contacted to trace that aircraft for inspection; incoming shift must confirm status of that aircraft and verify the aux battery connector rework was completed.
summary: A new-hire technician improperly safety-wired aircraft batteries with copper breakaway wire, prompting a search for a previously affected aircraft and follow-up on battery connector rework.

entities.text: verify the aux battery connector rework

narrative_text: Wakati wa shift, nilimwona fundi mpya akiwa anafunga betri za ndege ya Dash 8-100 kwenye tray kwa kutumia waya wa shaba (copper breakaway wire) badala ya waya sahihi wa usalama wa 0.032 inch. Alikiri kuwa alitumia mbinu hiyo hiyo isiyo sahihi wiki iliyopita kwenye ndege nyingine. Supervisor alijulishwa na maintenance control wakawasiliana kuifuatilia ndege hiyo kwa ukaguzi; shift inayokuja lazima wathibitishe hali ya ndege hiyo na kuhakikisha aux battery connector imerekebishwa ipasavyo.
summary: Fundi mpya alifunga betri za ndege kwa waya wa shaba usiofaa, hivyo kuhitajika ufuatiliaji wa ndege iliyoathirika na urekebishaji wa connector ya betri.

entities.text: waya sahihi wa usalama wa 0.032 inch
kuhakikisha aux battery connector imerekebishwa ipasavyo

narrative_text: Wakati wa shift yangu niliona new hire mech akifunga aircraft batteries kwenye battery tray ya Dash 8-100 akitumia copper breakaway wire badala ya ile 0.032 inch safety wire inayotakiwa. Akaniambia alitumia hiyo copper wire hivyo hivyo last week kwenye ndege nyingine. Nikamwambia supervisor, akacontact maintenance control ili watrace hiyo aircraft ya awali for inspection; next shift wanahitaji kufollow up status ya hiyo ndege na kuconfirm kama aux battery connector imesecure vizuri na copper safety wire.
summary: New hire mech alifunga batteries za ndege kwa copper wire isiyo sahihi, hivyo maintenance control inatrace ndege ya awali na next shift wanahitaji kuconfirm rework ya battery connector.

entities.text: watrace hiyo aircraft ya awali for inspection
kuconfirm kama aux battery connector imesecure vizuri

narrative_text: During B767-200 main landing gear support beam fitting repair, boring fixture was set up and the initial bore cut was made and signed off before the boring motor failed at shift change; small tool repair was called and the job was verbally handed to next shift. On return next day the bore was found a couple of sizes larger with no documentation, and we discovered the fixture had been removed for the air motor repair and not correctly reinstalled, leaving the bore eccentric and out of square. We enlarged and spot-faced the bore per the service instruction and documented it, but suspect the hole is now misaligned even though the support link assembled fine; management is not yet convinced. Next shift crew chief has been briefed verbally and asked to ensure all work performed is properly documented going forward.
summary: A misaligned/eccentric bore on a B767-200 main landing gear support beam fitting, caused by an undocumented fixture reinstallation error during shift handover, needs management follow-up despite parts fitting up correctly.

entities.text: main landing gear support beam fitting

narrative_text: Wakati wa kurekebisha fitting ya main landing gear support beam ya ndege ya B767-200, boring fixture iliwekwa na kuanzishwa bore ya kwanza, kazi ikasainiwa, kabla motor ya kuchimba kuharibika wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu. Fundi wa kurekebisha vifaa aliitwa na kazi ikakabidhiwa kwa zamu inayofuata kwa maneno tu. Siku iliyofuata, tulikuta bore imeongezeka ukubwa kidogo bila nyaraka zozote, na tukagundua fixture ilikuwa imeondolewa wakati wa kurekebisha air motor na haikurudishwa vizuri, jambo lililosababisha bore kuwa mlalo na isiyo sawa. Tuliongeza ukubwa wa bore na kufanya spot-facing kulingana na maelekezo ya huduma na kuandika kazi hiyo, ila tunashuku shimo bado halijalingana vizuri hata ingawa support link ilifungamana bila shida; usimamizi bado haujakubaliana na hoja hii, na zamu inayofuata imeambiwa kuhakikisha kazi zote zinaandikwa vizuri.
summary: Bore ya support beam fitting ya main landing gear katika ndege ya B767-200 haikulingana vizuri kwa sababu ya fixture kutorudishwa ipasavyo wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu, na hili linahitaji ufuatiliaji zaidi wa usimamizi.

narrative_text: Tulikuwa tunafanya repair ya main landing gear support beam fitting kwa hiyo B767-200, boring fixture ikawekwa, tukasign initial cut halafu boring motor ikafail exactly end of shift. Tulicall small tool repair na tuka-handover job kwa next shift kwa mdomo tu. Next day tukirudi, tunakuta bore imekuwa sizes mbili kubwa zaidi bila documentation yoyote, tukagundua fixture ilikuwa imeondolewa wakati wa kufix air motor na haikurudishwa properly, kwa hivyo bore ikawa eccentric na out of square kabisa. Tuka-enlarge bore mpaka max diameter, tukafanya spot-facing per service instruction na kudocument kazi hiyo, lakini bado nina suspicion hii hole haija-align vizuri, ingawa support link na parts zake zilifit sawasawa - management bado hawaja-convince. Nimeambia crew chief wa next shift verbally aensure watu wake wanadocument kazi zao vizuri.
summary: Bore ya support beam fitting kwa B767-200 landing gear haija-align sawasawa kwa sababu fixture haikurudishwa properly during handover, na issue hii inahitaji follow-up zaidi na management.

entities.text: main landing gear support beam fitting

narrative_text: Robbed the #1 Nav Control Panel (FCU) from Aircraft Y to replace the inop unit on Aircraft X; all paperwork was completed except the serviceable parts tag, which I missed since I was focused on the robbed-parts tag. At shift change I was told a serviceable tag is required, and there was confusion between duty center, lead controller, QC supervisor and receiving inspector on whether to print a physical tag or just issue one in the computer. Next shift please confirm with QC/receiving inspection which method is correct and ensure a properly printed and filled serviceable tag is generated before closing out the job.
summary: A robbed FCU panel swap between two B737-500s was completed without the required serviceable parts tag, and follow-up is needed to resolve confusion over correct tag documentation procedure.

narrative_text: Tulitoa #1 Nav Control Panel (FCU) kutoka kwa Ndege Y ili kubadilisha ile iliyokuwa mbovu kwenye Ndege X; karatasi zote zilikamilishwa isipokuwa tag ya serviceable part, ambayo nilisahau kwa sababu nilikuwa nimezingatia tu ile tag ya kitu kilichotolewa. Wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu niliambiwa kuwa tag ya serviceable inahitajika, na kulikuwa na mkanganyiko kati ya duty center, lead controller, msimamizi wa QC na receiving inspector kuhusu kama tag ichapishwe kwa mkono au itolewe tu kwenye kompyuta. Zamu inayofuata tafadhali thibitisheni na QC/receiving inspection njia sahihi, na muhakikishe tag ya serviceable imechapishwa na kujazwa vizuri kabla ya kazi kufungwa.
summary: Ubadilishaji wa kifaa cha FCU kati ya ndege mbili za B737-500 ulikamilika bila tag ya serviceable inayohitajika, hivyo ufuatiliaji unahitajika kutatua mkanganyiko wa taratibu za nyaraka.

narrative_text: Tulirob ile #1 Nav Control Panel (FCU) kutoka Aircraft Y kubadilisha ile inop kwa Aircraft X; paperwork zote zilikuwa complete except serviceable parts tag, nilimiss kwa sababu nilikuwa nimefocus tu kwa ile robbed-parts tag. Kwa shift change waliniambia serviceable tag inahitajika, na kulikuwa na confusion kati ya duty center, lead controller, QC supervisor na receiving inspector kama tuprint tag physically ama tuissue tu number kwenye computer. Next shift tafadhali confirm na QC/receiving inspection method sahihi, na mhakikishe serviceable tag imeprint na kufilled properly kabla ya kuclose out ile job.
summary: Wakati wa kurob FCU panel kati ya ndege mbili za B737-500, serviceable tag ilimissed, so follow-up inahitajika kuclear confusion ya documentation procedure.

narrative_text: During climb the B757 right engine overheat EICAS and warning activated; right bleed was switched off and the power reduced light extinguished, so the aircraft continued with bleed off. A high power engine run of approximately 5 minutes at takeoff power was performed and no discrepancies were found with bleeds on or off, so the aircraft was released for continued service. However, after logbook sign-off Maintenance Control requested a follow-up leak check of the pneumatic ducting and bleed air tubing in the right engine nacelle, and the incoming technician subsequently found an actual leak on the high pressure duct between the HPSOV and top of engine. Follow-up needed: review why the general visual inspection and idle leak check were not completed before sign-off, and confirm duct repair status before next flight.
summary: A right engine overheat warning on a B757 was cleared after a high power run showed no fault, but a later inspection found an actual bleed duct leak that should have been checked before logbook sign-off.

entities.text: leak check of the pneumatic ducting

narrative_text: Wakati wa kupaa, ndege ya B757 ilionyesha onyo la joto kupita kiasi kwenye injini ya kulia (EICAS), na fundi aliyekuwepo alizima bleed ya kulia hadi taa ya kupungua nguvu ikazimika, ndege ikaendelea safari na bleed ikiwa imezimwa. Ukaguzi wa injini ulifanywa kwa muda wa dakika tano kwa nguvu ya juu kama za kuruka, na hakuna hitilafu iliyoonekana ikiwa bleed imewashwa au imezimwa, hivyo ndege iliruhusiwa kuendelea na safari. Hata hivyo, baada ya kusaini kitabu cha matengenezo, Kitengo cha Udhibiti wa Matengenezo kiliomba ukaguzi wa ziada wa uvujaji kwenye mabomba ya hewa karibu na injini ya kulia, na fundi aliyefuata alibaini uvujaji halisi kwenye bomba kati ya HPSOV na sehemu ya juu ya injini. Inahitajika ufuatiliaji: kupitia kwa nini ukaguzi wa jumla na ukaguzi wa uvujaji haukufanyika kabla ya kusaini kitabu, na kuthibitisha hali ya ukarabati wa bomba kabla ya safari ijayo.
summary: Onyo la joto kupita kiasi kwenye injini ya kulia ya B757 lilionekana kutokuwa na hitilafu baada ya jaribio la nguvu, lakini ukaguzi uliofuata ulibaini uvujaji halisi wa bomba ambao ulipaswa kukaguliwa kabla ya kusaini kitabu cha matengenezo.

entities.text: ukaguzi wa injini kwa nguvu ya juu

narrative_text: Ile time tulikuwa tuna-climb, right engine overheat EICAS na warning zilikuja on, tukazima right bleed na power reduced light ikaenda off, so tukaendelea na bleed ikiwa off. Nikafanya high power engine run kama dakika tano at takeoff power, na hakuna discrepancy iliyoonekana on or off bleeds, kwa hiyo nikasign logbook ni ok for continued service. Lakini baada ya ku-sign, Maintenance Control waliomba turudi tu-troubleshoot na tufanye leak check ya pneumatic ducting kwenye nacelle area ya right engine, na yule technician aliyepokea turnover akapata leak halisi kwenye high pressure duct between HPSOV na top of engine. Tunahitaji follow-up: tuangalie kwa nini general visual inspection na idle leak check hazikufanyika before sign-off, na tuconfirm duct imefixiwa kabla ya next flight.
summary: Right engine overheat warning kwenye B757 ilionekana clear baada ya high power run, lakini baadaye leak halisi ilipatikana kwenye duct ambayo ingepaswa kuchekiwa kabla ya kusign logbook.

narrative_text: MD-80 forward cargo ceiling panels 5160C, 5161C and 5162C were signed off as installed on the pattern card Monday, but were found open at shift start Wednesday morning with no logbook entry or verbal turnover explaining the change. Incoming lead technician please verify current panel status against the pattern card before further work and confirm with previous shift lead why the discrepancy was not documented. Close out logbook entry once panels are reinstalled and re-inspected.
summary: Forward cargo ceiling panels on an MD-80 were found open despite being signed off as installed, with no turnover documentation, requiring verification and logbook correction.

narrative_text: Paneli za dari za sehemu ya mizigo ya mbele kwenye ndege ya MD-80, yaani 5160C, 5161C na 5162C, zilisainiwa kwenye pattern card Jumatatu kuwa zimefungwa, lakini asubuhi ya Jumatano zilikutwa zikiwa wazi bila maelezo yoyote kwenye logbook au taarifa ya mkabidhi wa zamu iliyopita. Fundi mkuu anayeingia zamu aangalie hali halisi ya paneli hizo kabla ya kuendelea na kazi nyingine, na afuatilie kwa nini hitilafu hii haikuandikwa popote. Baada ya paneli kufungwa upya na kukaguliwa, logbook ijazwe ipasavyo.
summary: Paneli za dari za mizigo kwenye ndege ya MD-80 zilikutwa wazi ingawa zilisainiwa kama zimefungwa, bila maelezo ya turnover, hivyo zinahitaji ukaguzi na marekebisho ya logbook.

entities.text: Paneli za dari za sehemu ya mizigo ya mbele... 5160C, 5161C na 5162C

narrative_text: Kwenye MD-80, ile forward cargo ceiling panels 5160C, 5161C na 5162C zilikuwa zime-sign off kwenye pattern card as installed siku ya Monday, lakini Wednesday morning tumekuja tukazikuta ziko open, hakuna log entry wala mtu ame-brief kuhusu hio discrepancy. Lead technician anayeingia shift a-verify status ya panels dhidi ya pattern card kabla ya kuendelea na other tasks, na a-confirm na previous shift kwanini hio issue haikua-documented. Panels zikishafungwa tena na kukaguliwa, logbook i-update ipasavyo.
summary: MD-80 forward cargo ceiling panels zilikutwa open ingawa zilikuwa zime-sign off as installed, na hakukuwa na turnover notes, kwa hivyo inahitaji verification na logbook update.

narrative_text: Following flap track inspection completion on the B727-200, we reinstalled the main gear flying door and finished the flap track fairing, but had repeated difficulty aligning the attach linkage over the drag brace and had to reposition the door several times for fairing hardware access. Aircraft was returned to service after task closeout, but the flying door reportedly separated in flight after takeoff and was discovered missing only after arrival at destination. Suspect either the forward attach fitting or linkage possibly seated below the drag brace during repositioning; recommend follow-up inspection of forward attach fittings on similar tasks. Note there is no door indication switch for this door, so a dedicated sign-off step for flying door installation should be considered going forward.
summary: A B727-200 main gear flying door was lost in flight after a maintenance reinstall where the attach linkage may have been mispositioned, prompting recommendations for additional inspection and a dedicated sign-off.

narrative_text: Baada ya kukamilisha ukaguzi wa flap track kwenye ndege ya B727-200, tulirudisha mlango wa flying door wa main gear na kumaliza fairing, lakini tulipata ugumu mara kadhaa kuweka linkage sawasawa juu ya drag brace, hivyo tukalazimika kuuhamisha mlango mara kadhaa ili kupata nafasi ya kufunga fairing hardware. Ndege ilirudishwa kwenye huduma baada ya kazi kukamilika, lakini baadaye ilielezwa kuwa mlango huo uliporomoka ukiwa angani muda mfupi baada ya kupaa, na haikugundulika mpaka ndege ilipofika kwenye kituo cha marudio. Tunashuku tatizo linaweza kuwa kwenye forward attach fitting au linkage kuwekwa chini ya drag brace wakati wa kuuhamisha mlango, hivyo tunapendekeza ukaguzi zaidi wa fittings hizo pamoja na kuanzishwa kwa sahihi maalum ya kuthibitisha ufungaji wa flying door, kwa kuwa mlango huu hauna door indication switch.
summary: Mlango wa flying door wa ndege ya B727-200 ulipotea ukiwa angani baada ya kazi ya matengenezo ambapo linkage huenda haikuwekwa vizuri, hivyo kupendekeza ukaguzi zaidi na sahihi maalum ya kuthibitisha kazi.

narrative_text: Tulipata turnover ikisema flap track inspection ya B727-200 imeisha, so tukaenda ku-reinstall flying door na kumaliza flap track fairing. Lakini tulipata shida kidogo ku-align attach linkage juu ya drag brace, tukalazimika ku-reposition ile door mara kadhaa ili tupate access ya kufunga fairing hardware. Baada ya kumaliza task, tuka-return aircraft to service, lakini baadaye tukaambiwa flying door imeondoka mid-flight after takeoff bila crew kujua, na waligundua imepotea only after landing destination. Tuna-suspect forward attach fitting au linkage inaeza kuwa iliwekwa below drag brace wakati wa repositioning, so tunarecommend follow-up inspection ya attach fittings, na pia tuwe na separate sign-off ya flying door installation kwa sababu hakuna door indication switch ya hii door.
summary: Flying door ya B727-200 iliondoka mid-flight baada ya installation ambapo linkage inaweza kuwa haikuwekwa vizuri juu ya drag brace, hivyo inahitajika follow-up inspection na separate sign-off.

narrative_text: During shift, rags left in the stabilizer jackscrew area on the B737-400 were not removed after fairing/seal work, and the aircraft could not be trimmed to zero degrees on check. Crew was juggling two sliding seal jobs on two late-arriving aircraft plus a spar damage finding that pulled in sheetmetal and engineering, so the jackscrew area was not properly closed out before shift end. Next shift must inspect jackscrew for FOD, confirm rags removed, and verify trim function before release.
summary: Rags left in the stabilizer jackscrew during a rushed shift with multiple concurrent jobs caused a trim-to-zero fault that next shift needs to inspect and clear.

narrative_text: Wakati wa zamu, vitambaa vilivyowekwa kwenye eneo la jackscrew ya stabilizer katika ndege ya B737-400 havikuondolewa baada ya kazi ya sliding seal, na hivyo ndege haikuweza kupimwa trim hadi digrii sifuri. Wafanyakazi walikuwa na majukumu mengi kwa wakati mmoja, ikiwemo kazi mbili za sliding seal kwenye ndege mbili zilizochelewa, pamoja na uharibifu wa spar uliohitaji timu za sheetmetal na engineering, hivyo eneo la jackscrew halikufungwa vizuri kabla ya zamu kuisha. Zamu inayofuata inatakiwa kukagua jackscrew kuhakikisha hakuna vitu vilivyosalia, na kuthibitisha trim inafanya kazi vizuri kabla ndege kutolewa.
summary: Vitambaa vilivyosalia kwenye jackscrew ya stabilizer wakati wa zamu yenye shughuli nyingi vilisababisha tatizo la trim, na zamu inayofuata inahitajika kukagua na kuthibitisha kabla ya kutoa ndege.

narrative_text: Kwa hii B737-400, tuligundua rags zilizowekwa kwenye jackscrew ya stabilizer hazikuondolewa baada ya sliding seal job, so aircraft haikuweza kutrim to zero degrees wakati wa check. Zamu ilikuwa na workload kubwa - two sliding seals, ndege zote zikiwa late arrivals, plus tukagundua spar damage ambayo ilihitaji sheetmetal na engineering kuja evaluate, so jackscrew area haikuclose out properly before shift end. Next shift wafanye inspection ya jackscrew for FOD, confirm rags zimeondolewa, na verify trim function kabla ya release.
summary: Rags zilibaki kwenye stabilizer jackscrew ya B737-400 wakati wa zamu yenye workload kubwa, causing trim fault ambayo next shift wanahitaji kuinspect na kuclear kabla ya release.

narrative_text: MD-80 overnight service check: swing shift Avionics had been troubleshooting a pax intercom breaker popping, and grave shift took over to R&R 3 pax service units. Around 0430 Avionics installed the 3 new units while I completed the oxygen generator transfer, but I forgot to call for inspection before Avionics signed off the logbook write-up and I signed off the service check after 0600 with the aircraft already scheduled to fly. Aircraft has since flown 3 legs and is now at ZZZ1 for heavy check - please notify Inspection there to review this maintenance and open a line non-routine work card.
summary: A missed inspection call-out after pax service unit replacement on an MD-80 needs to be reviewed by Inspection at ZZZ1 before further dispatch.

narrative_text: Wakati wa service check ya usiku kwa ndege ya MD-80, shift ya jioni ya Avionics walikuwa wakifanya troubleshooting ya intercom ya abiria iliyokuwa ikiondoa breaker mara kwa mara, kisha sisi wa shift ya usiku tukapewa kazi ya kubadilisha vitengo vitatu vya huduma za abiria. Karibu saa kumi na moja alfajiri, Avionics walimaliza kufunga vitengo vipya huku mimi nikikamilisha kazi ya kuhamisha jenereta za oksijeni, lakini nilisahau kuita ukaguzi kabla Avionics hawajatia sahihi kwenye logbook, na mimi nikatia sahihi baada ya saa kumi na mbili asubuhi ndege ikiwa tayari imepangiwa safari. Ndege imeshafanya safari tatu na sasa iko ZZZ1 kwa heavy check - idara ya ukaguzi pale inahitaji kuarifiwa ili kuchunguza kazi hii na kutengeneza non-routine work card.
summary: Ukaguzi ulisahaulika baada ya kubadilishwa kwa vitengo vya huduma za abiria kwenye ndege ya MD-80, na hali hiyo sasa inahitaji kuangaliwa na idara ya ukaguzi huko ZZZ1.

entities.text: vitengo vitatu vya huduma za abiria
kubadilisha vitengo vitatu vya huduma za abiria

narrative_text: Kwa hii overnight service check ya MD-80, swing shift Avionics walikuwa wanafanya troubleshooting ya pax intercom ambayo ilikuwa inapop breaker, then sisi grave shift tukaambiwa turemove and replace zile 3 pax service units. Karibu 0430 Avionics walikuja na units mpya wakaziinstall wakati mimi nafanya oxygen generator transfer, but nikasahau kucall inspection kabla Avionics hawajasign logbook write-up, na mimi nikasign service check baada ya 0600 ndege ikiwa already scheduled for a flight. Ndege imeshafly 3 trips na sasa iko ZZZ1 kwa heavy check - inspection department pale wanafaa kuarifiwa wachunguze hii maintenance na wagenerate line non-routine work card.
summary: Kuna missed inspection call-out after pax service units replacement kwenye MD-80, na sasa inahitaji review na Inspection huko ZZZ1.

entities.text: remove and replace zile 3 pax service units

narrative_text: B737 had a fuel leak from the drip stick access on the left wing mid-section; wing was defueled to stop the leak. Attempted to remove the drip stick per the maintenance manual but found a damaged retainer screw and excessive resistance, so the panel is being opened instead to access it from behind. Crew was pulled to another job before completion; a second lead (qualified for this carrier's logbook) took over later that night, transferred fuel to the right wing to keep load below the panel, and flagged the damaged retainer screw to the lead and foreman at the start of panel removal. Follow-up needed: complete panel removal, replace damaged screw, verify drip stick reinstallation, and confirm no further leak before release.
summary: A B737 left-wing fuel leak at the drip stick required defueling and panel removal for access, with a damaged retainer screw and crew handover complicating the repair.

narrative_text: Ndege ya B737 ilikuwa na uvujaji wa mafuta kwenye eneo la drip stick, katikati ya bawa la kushoto, hivyo ilibidi kutolewa mafuta (defuel) ili kuzuia uvujaji huo usiendelee. Tulijaribu kuondoa drip stick kama inavyoelekezwa kwenye maintenance manual, lakini tuligundua screw moja ya retainer imeharibika na kulikuwa na ugumu mkubwa wa kuitoa, hivyo tuliamua kufungua panel ili kufikia sehemu ya nyuma ya stick. Kazi ilisimamishwa kwa muda kwa sababu ya majukumu mengine, na baadaye lead mwingine aliyeruhusiwa kutia sahihi logbook ya kampuni hii alichukua nafasi, akahamisha mafuta kwenda bawa la kulia ili kupunguza uzito chini ya panel, na kumjulisha lead na foreman kuhusu screw iliyoharibika kabla ya kuanza kuondoa panel. Inahitajika ufuatiliaji: kukamilisha uondoaji wa panel, kubadilisha screw iliyoharibika, na kuhakikisha drip stick imewekwa vizuri kabla ya ndege kuruhusiwa kuruka.
summary: Ndege ya B737 ilikuwa na tatizo la uvujaji wa mafuta kwenye bawa la kushoto lililohitaji kutolewa mafuta na kufunguliwa kwa panel, huku screw iliyoharibika ikichelewesha ukarabati.

narrative_text: Kwa hii B737, kulikuwa na fuel leak kwa drip stick area, mid-wing kwa L side, so tuli-defuel wing hio kuzuia leak isiendelee. Tulitry kuondoa drip stick kama manual inavyosema, lakini tukapata retainer screw imeharibika na kuna resistance nyingi, so tukaamua kuopen panel ndio tupate access from the back. Job ilisimamishwa kidogo kwa sababu workload iliongezeka, na baadaye lead mwingine ambaye ame-qualify ku-sign logbook ya carrier hii akachukua job, aka-transfer fuel kwenda R wing kupunguza load chini ya panel, na aka-flag ile damaged screw kwa lead na foreman kabla ya kuanza panel removal. Follow-up inahitajika: kumaliza panel removal, kubadilisha screw iliyoharibika, na ku-verify drip stick imefit vizuri kabla ya release.
summary: B737 ilikuwa na fuel leak kwa L wing drip stick, ikahitaji defuel na panel removal, huku damaged retainer screw ikichelewesha repair na kuna handover kati ya mechanics.

narrative_text: On B737-500, the left wing fuel access panel was removed to service the drip stick, and the stick was repacked without issue. Shift ended before reinstallation, so the task was verbally turned over to the incoming lead technician in the supervisor's presence. Follow-up: confirm the panel was reinstalled, as it was reportedly still open the next day.
summary: A fuel panel on the left wing was left uninstalled after a verbal shift turnover was not followed up on.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya B737-500, kifuniko cha mafuta cha bawa la kushoto kiliondolewa ili kuhudumia drip stick, na kazi hiyo ilikamilika vizuri bila tatizo. Zamu ilipoisha kabla ya kufunga kifuniko, kazi ilikabidhiwa kwa maneno tu kwa fundi mkuu aliyekuwa akiingia zamu, mbele ya msimamizi. Inahitajika kufuatilia kwani siku iliyofuata kifuniko kilikutwa bado hakijafungwa.
summary: Kifuniko cha mafuta cha bawa la kushoto kilibaki wazi baada ya makabidhiano ya zamu kutofuatiliwa ipasavyo.

entities.text: kifuniko cha mafuta cha bawa la kushoto

narrative_text: Kwa B737-500, tulitoa ile fuel panel ya left wing kuhudumia drip stick, na stick ikarepack fine bila noma. Time ya kuquit ilikuwa inakaribia so tuka-call supervisor, akatuambia tu-turnover kazi kwa incoming lead mech aliekuwa amesimama pale. Turnover ilifanyika sawa lakini next day panel ilikuwa bado haijainstall, kwa hivyo hii inahitaji kufuatiliwa.
summary: Fuel panel ya left wing ilibaki uninstalled baada ya turnover verbal kutofollow-up-iwa.

narrative_text: B767-300ER right engine IDG was replaced overnight and given an engine run, leak check and operational check with no faults found; logbook signed off as good. Please note during the maintenance run all indications were normal, but follow up to confirm the shaft configuration was verified correct for the Pratt and Whitney engine, since a similar IDG replacement on another tail later required a shaft reconfiguration. Recommend re-verifying this installation before releasing the aircraft further.
summary: Right engine IDG on a B767-300ER was replaced and checked out normal, but shaft configuration should be re-verified given a similar case later needed correction.

entities.text: engine run, leak check and operational check

narrative_text: IDG ya injini ya kulia kwa ndege ya B767-300ER ilibadilishwa usiku uliopita na kufanyiwa uendeshaji wa injini, ukaguzi wa uvujaji na ukaguzi wa uendeshaji bila hitilafu kuonekana, hivyo logbook ilisainiwa kuwa sawa. Zamu inayofuata ihakikishe kuwa mpangilio wa shaft ya IDG umewekwa sahihi kwa injini ya Pratt and Whitney, kwani kesi kama hii kwenye ndege nyingine baadaye ilihitaji kurekebishwa tena. Tafadhali fanya ukaguzi wa ziada kabla ya kuiruhusu ndege kuendelea na safari.
summary: IDG ya injini ya kulia ya B767-300ER ilibadilishwa na kuonekana sawa, lakini mpangilio wa shaft unahitaji kuthibitishwa tena kutokana na tukio jingine lililojitokeza baadaye.

entities.text: uendeshaji wa injini, ukaguzi wa uvujaji na ukaguzi wa uendeshaji

narrative_text: Tulibadilisha ile right engine IDG ya B767-300ER usiku, tukafanya engine run pamoja na leak check na operational check, hakuna trouble found so tuka-sign off kwa logbook kama good fix. Lakini zamu inayofuata i-verify vizuri kama shaft configuration ilikuwa correct for the Pratt and Whitney engine, kwa sababu kuna case ingine ilitokea baadaye ikahitaji kurekebishwa. Tafadhali msifanye assume tu, someone should double-check hiyo installation before releasing aircraft.
summary: Right engine IDG ya B767-300ER ilikuwa sawa during maintenance run, lakini shaft configuration inahitaji kuverifiwa tena kwa sababu ya issue iliyojitokeza later kwenye case kama hii.

narrative_text: On the B757-200, L and R thrust levers were reported stiff and hard to move forward; lower torque box on L engine was removed per AMM 76-11-10 to inspect throttle cable linkage and FFG lever, then reinstalled. After reinstallation the levers still felt stiff/binding even when disconnected, but supervisor closed the item as fixed without further inspection. During subsequent engine start at the hangar an uncommanded rapid acceleration occurred, and troubleshooting found the lower torque box misaligned and improperly installed on the L engine. Next shift must re-verify torque box alignment/rigging per AMM 76-11-10-404-015 before next start and confirm proper sign-off documentation.
summary: Improperly reinstalled lower torque box on L engine of a B757-200 caused stiff/binding thrust levers and an uncommanded acceleration during ground start, requiring re-inspection and proper rigging verification.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya B757-200, levers za thrust za kushoto na kulia zilikuwa ngumu kusogeza mbele. Torque box ya chini ya engine ya kushoto ilitolewa kwa mujibu wa AMM 76-11-10 ili kukagua linkage ya throttle cable na FFG lever, kisha ikafungwa tena. Baada ya kufungwa, levers ziliendelea kuwa ngumu na kubana hata zikiwa hazijaunganishwa, lakini msimamizi alifunga hitilafu hiyo kama imeshughulikiwa bila ukaguzi wa ziada. Baadaye wakati wa kuanzisha engine hangarini, ilitokea kuongezeka kwa kasi bila amri, na ukaguzi ulionyesha torque box haikuwekwa sawa. Shift inayokuja lazima ikague upya uwekaji wa torque box kabla ya kuanzisha engine tena na kuthibitisha usahihi wa saini za kufunga kazi.
summary: Torque box ya chini ya engine ya kushoto ya B757-200 haikuwekwa sawa baada ya kukaguliwa, hali iliyosababisha levers ngumu na kuongezeka kasi bila amri wakati wa kuanzisha engine, hivyo inahitaji ukaguzi zaidi.

entities.text: kukague upya uwekaji wa torque box

narrative_text: Kwa hii B757-200, thrust levers za L na R zilikuwa stiff sana, ngumu kusukuma forward. Tulitoa lower torque box ya L engine per AMM 76-11-10 kukagua throttle cable linkage na FFG lever, then tuka-reinstall. Lakini even after reinstalling, levers zilikuwa still binding hata zikiwa disconnected, lakini supervisor akasema imeshughulikiwa bila ku-inspect zaidi. Later wakati wa engine start hangarini, kulikuwa na uncommanded rapid acceleration, na troubleshooting ikaonyesha torque box ilikuwa misaligned na haiku-install properly. Next shift lazima ku-verify tena alignment ya torque box per maintenance manual kabla ya start next time, na kuconfirm sign-off iko sawa.
summary: Lower torque box ya L engine kwenye B757-200 haiku-install properly baada ya inspection, causing stiff levers na uncommanded acceleration wakati wa start, so inahitaji re-check ya alignment.

entities.text: ku-verify tena alignment ya torque box

narrative_text: Forward cargo bay stringer repair on the B737-200 was passed across three shifts and the fabricated parts (trimmed, drilled, alodined and primed) were partly installed before anyone caught that no inspector signoffs existed for damage removal, treat-and-prime, or part fabrication. The mechanic who started the install said he was following what he'd been taught in new-hire training, which suggests a gap in how paperwork procedures are being conveyed to new technicians. Repair had to be removed, parts cleaned up, and damage-removal signoff obtained before work can resume; next shift please confirm all buyback/inspection stamps are in place before continuing installation.
summary: A multi-shift stringer repair on a B737-200 was partially installed without required inspector signoffs due to time pressure and unclear paperwork training, requiring removal and rework.

narrative_text: Ukarabati wa stringer kwenye forward cargo bay ya ndege ya B737-200 ulipitia zamu tatu za wafanyakazi, na vipande vilivyotengenezwa (kukatwa, kuchimbwa matundu, kupakwa alodine na primer) vilianza kufungwa kabla ya mtu yeyote kugundua kuwa hakuna sahihi za ukaguzi kwa ajili ya kuondoa uharibifu, matibabu na kupaka rangi ya kwanza, au utengenezaji wa vipande. Fundi aliyeanza ufungaji alisema alifundishwa hivyo wakati wa mafunzo ya wafanyakazi wapya, jambo linaloonyesha kuna tatizo katika jinsi taratibu za makaratasi zinavyofundishwa. Ukarabati ulibidi uondolewe, vipande visafishwe, na sahihi ya kuondoa uharibifu ipatikane kabla ya kazi kuendelea; zamu ijayo tafadhali thibitisha muhuri zote za ukaguzi zipo kabla ya kuendelea na ufungaji.
summary: Ukarabati wa stringer kwenye B737-200 uliofanywa na zamu kadhaa ulifungwa kiasi bila sahihi za ukaguzi zinazohitajika kwa sababu ya haraka na mafunzo yasiyo wazi ya makaratasi, hivyo ilibidi uondolewe na kurekebishwa.

entities.text: matibabu na kupaka rangi ya kwanza

narrative_text: Kwa hii stringer repair ya forward cargo bay kwa B737-200, imepitia mpaka zamu tatu, na yule mechanic wa turnover aliweza trim na drill zile parts, akazi-alodine na kuzi-prime, halafu akaanza install bila kupata inspector signoff kabisa - hakuna signoff ya damage removal wala treat and prime, hata fabrication ya parts haina buyback. Yule mtu wa turnover alisema huyo ndio alifundishwa hivyo kwenye new-hire training, so kuna gap kwa jinsi paperwork procedures zinafundishwa kwa mechanics wapya. Tulilazimika kuremove ile repair, tuclean up parts, na tupate damage removal signoff kabla ya kuendelea; next shift please confirm hizo inspection stamps zote ziko in place kabla ya kuinstall tena.
summary: Stringer repair ya B737-200 iliinstall kiasi na zamu tofauti bila inspector signoffs muhimu, kwa sababu ya time pressure na mafunzo yasiyo clear ya paperwork, hivyo ikabidi iremove na kufanywa upya.

narrative_text: During the C150 annual inspection, the prop spinner was not removed, so the spinner retaining bulkhead security check was missed; the prop was only dressed for minor nicks and the checklist item was signed off assuming the inspection was complete. This happened near shift change under time pressure, and the next shift did not follow up to verify it. The aircraft later developed rough running in flight due to a loose spinner and landed uneventfully; spinner and bulkhead have since been replaced and the prop re-dressed. Next shift: confirm the new detailed prop-inspection checklist is being used and watch for unauthorized panel removal by owner/pre-buy parties on this aircraft.
summary: A missed spinner bulkhead inspection during a rushed shift-change annual led to in-flight rough running from a loose spinner, now corrected with parts replacement and a revised checklist.

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa mwaka wa ndege ya C150, spinner ya propela haikutolewa, hivyo ukaguzi wa usalama wa bulkhead inayoshikilia spinner ulikosekana; propela ilisafishwa tu kwa mikwaruzo midogo na sehemu ya orodha ya ukaguzi ilitiwa saini kana kwamba kazi yote ilikamilika. Hili lilitokea karibu na mabadiliko ya zamu huku kukiwa na haraka, na zamu iliyofuata haikufuatilia jambo hili kuhakikisha limekamilika ipasavyo. Baadaye ndege ilipata tatizo la injini kuendesha kwa mshtuko hewani kutokana na spinner iliyolegea, ikatua salama; spinner na bulkhead vimeshabadilishwa na propela imesafishwa upya. Zamu inayofuata: hakikisha orodha mpya ya ukaguzi wa kina wa propela inatumika, na kuwa mwangalifu na uwezekano wa watu kuondoa paneli bila idhini kwenye ndege hii.
summary: Ukaguzi wa spinner ya propela ulikosekana wakati wa zamu ya haraka, na kusababisha tatizo la injini hewani ambalo sasa limerekebishwa kwa vipuri vipya na orodha mpya ya ukaguzi.

entities.text: orodha mpya ya ukaguzi wa kina wa propela

narrative_text: Wakati wa annual inspection ya C150, spinner haikutolewa kabisa, so tuka-miss ile check ya security ya spinner retaining bulkhead; prop ilidressiwa tu kwa nicks ndogo na checklist ika-signed off kana kwamba kila kitu kilikuwa done. Hii ilitokea karibu na shift change, kukiwa na rush na stress, na next shift hawakufollow up ku-confirm. Baadaye engine ika-develop rough running mid-flight kwa sababu ya loose spinner, ikalanda salama; spinner na bulkhead zimebadilishwa na prop imedressiwa upya. Next shift: hakikisheni ile new checklist ya prop inspection inafuatwa, na kuwa alert na watu wanao-remove panels bila authorization kwa hii aircraft.
summary: Spinner bulkhead check ilimissiwa during rushed shift change, causing rough engine running mid-flight, sasa imefixiwa na parts mpya plus revised checklist.

narrative_text: During my shift I worked on the L-hand main gear strut repack per MM 32-11-02 on the MD-82 but did not finish before shift change. While writing the turnover entry I missed the required adjustment/test step for the wheel proximity sensor per MM 32-60-05 pg 201, and the aircraft was released back to service. Next shift must check with the crew that troubleshot the resulting discrepancies, since they found the L-hand main gear prox sensor out of adjustment and had to re-adjust and re-test it. Please confirm no further squawks remain before next flight.
summary: A missed prox sensor adjustment/test step during an MD-82 main gear strut repack led to an out-of-adjustment sensor that required later troubleshooting and correction.

narrative_text: Wakati wa zamu yangu nilikuwa nikifanya kazi ya kubadilisha grisi kwenye strut ya gia kuu ya kushoto ya ndege ya MD-82 kwa mujibu wa mwongozo 32-11-02, lakini sikumaliza kabla ya zamu kuisha. Nilipokuwa nikiandika taarifa ya makabidhiano nilisahau hatua muhimu ya kufanya marekebisho na kipimo cha sensor ya ukaribu wa gurudumu kama inavyotakiwa kwenye ukurasa 201 wa mwongozo 32-60-05, na ndege ikarudishwa kwenye huduma. Timu iliyofuata ilibidi ifanye uchunguzi baada ya matatizo kujitokeza, wakagundua sensor hiyo haikuwa sahihi kwa vipimo, wakaifanyia marekebisho na kipimo tena. Naomba zamu inayofuata ithibitishe kuwa hakuna hitilafu nyingine iliyobaki kabla ndege haijaruka tena.
summary: Hatua ya kufanya kipimo cha sensor ya ukaribu ilisahaulika wakati wa ukarabati wa gia ya ndege ya MD-82, jambo lililosababisha sensor kutokuwa sahihi na kuhitaji marekebisho baadaye.

entities.text: strut ya gia kuu ya kushoto

narrative_text: Kwa shift yangu nilikuwa nikifanya main gear strut repack kwa L-hand side ya MD-82 kufuata MM 32-11-02, lakini sikumaliza before shift change. Nilipokuwa naandika turnover note kwenye logbook nilimiss hatua ya adjustment/test ya wheel prox sensor per MM 32-60-05 page 201, na aircraft ikaenda back into service. Maintenance crew waliokuja ku-troubleshoot discrepancies walikuta L-hand main gear prox sensor iko out of adjustment, wakai-adjust na kufanya test tena. Please confirm hakuna discrepancy nyingine before next flight.
summary: Wakati wa strut repack ya MD-82, hatua ya prox sensor adjustment/test ilimissed, hivyo sensor iligundulika out of adjustment na ikahitaji marekebisho baadaye.

narrative_text: B737-300 came into the hangar after its second air return, right after shift change, for an overheat problem on the No. 2 engine. We opened the engine cowl and reverser cowl, checked the fire loop and ruled it out, then pressurized the bleed system with APU bleed holding the PRSOV open and found no leaks. Lead technician spotted a loose duct clamp on the case during a walk-around check; bolts, gasket and clamp were replaced and safety-wired per the maintenance manual. Next shift please confirm final ops check and log entry before return to service.
summary: Engine bleed duct clamp found loose during overheat troubleshooting on B737-300 and was reinstalled per manual; final ops check pending.

narrative_text: Ndege ya B737-300 iliingia hangarini baada ya kurudi mara ya pili angani kutokana na tatizo la joto kupita kiasi kwenye injini namba mbili, muda mfupi baada ya mabadiliko ya zamu. Tulifungua kifuniko cha injini na cha reverser, tukachunguza fire loop na kuthibitisha si chanzo cha tatizo, kisha tukatumia hewa ya APU kujaribu mfumo huku PRSOV ikiwa wazi, hakuna uvujaji ulioonekana. Fundi mkuu aligundua clamp ya duct ikiwa legelege wakati wa ukaguzi wa mwisho, hivyo bolti, gasket na clamp vilibadilishwa na kufungwa kwa waya wa usalama kulingana na mwongozo wa matengenezo. Zamu inayofuata itathibitishe ukaguzi wa mwisho wa uendeshaji na kuingiza taarifa kwenye logbook kabla ndege haijarudi kazini.
summary: Clamp ya duct ya mfumo wa injini ilipatikana ikiwa legelege wakati wa uchunguzi wa tatizo la joto kwenye B737-300 na ilirekebishwa kulingana na mwongozo; ukaguzi wa mwisho bado unasubiriwa.

entities.text: muda mfupi baada ya mabadiliko ya zamu

narrative_text: Ile B737-300 ilikuja hangar baada ya air return ya pili, ikaingia straight baada ya shift change kwa sababu ya overheat problem kwa engine namba mbili. Tulifungua engine cowl na reverser cowl, tuka-check fire loop tukaona sio hiyo, then tuka-pressurize system na APU bleed while holding PRSOV open, hakuna leak iliyopatikana. Lead tech alikuja aki-do walk-around akaona ile duct clamp iko loose, so tukaenda kwa engine shop kuchukua bolts, gasket na safety wire tool, tukainstall duct na kuifunga per maintenance manual. Next shift wa-confirm ops check na wa-log iyo entry before release.
summary: Duct clamp ilipatikana loose wakati wa troubleshooting ya overheat kwa B737-300, ikafanyiwa fix per manual, ops check bado inahitajika.

narrative_text: B747 returned to cargo ramp after cockpit smoke traced to Capt's annunciator panel, which was replaced with a new unit. After the new panel install, an unexpected green FD/PMS light appeared on the overhead switching panel whenever either flight director was selected to A1 or C3. Troubleshooting so far has swapped autopilot pitch/roll computers and CADCs with no change; pulling the PMS coupler extinguishes the light, suggesting an internally shorted coupler, but no spare coupler is in stock. Next shift to coordinate with maintenance control on approval to apply MEL 34-38A (remove switching unit and collar the circuit breaker) pending parts availability.
summary: Technicians are troubleshooting a persistent FD/PMS annunciator light following cockpit smoke and annunciator panel replacement on a B747, and are pursuing MEL relief due to lack of a replacement PMS coupler.

narrative_text: Ndege ya B747 ilirudi kwenye cargo ramp baada ya moshi kuripotiwa cockpit-ni, ukafuatiliwa hadi kwenye annunciator panel ya Kapteni, ambayo ilibadilishwa na mpya. Baada ya ufungaji wa panel mpya, taa ya kijani ya FD/PMS ilianza kuwaka kwenye overhead switching panel kila flight director ya Kapteni au FO ilipochaguliwa kwenye A1 au C3. Hadi sasa tumebadilisha autopilot pitch/roll computers na CADCs bila mafanikio; kuvuta PMS coupler kunazima taa hiyo, hivyo tunashuku coupler imepata short ndani, lakini hakuna nakala ya ziada stoo-ni. Zamu ijayo iwasiliane na maintenance control kupata idhini ya kutumia MEL 34-38A wakati vipuri vikisubiriwa.
summary: Mafundi wanafuatilia tatizo la taa ya FD/PMS iliyoendelea kuwaka baada ya moshi cockpit-ni na kubadilishwa kwa annunciator panel kwenye ndege ya B747, na wanatafuta idhini ya MEL kwa sababu ya ukosefu wa PMS coupler mpya.

narrative_text: Ile B747 ilirudi cargo ramp baada ya smoke kuripotiwa cockpit-ni, ikafuatiliwa hadi kwa Capt's annunciator panel, ambayo ilikuwa tayari imebadilishwa na panel mpya. Baada ya install ya panel mpya, tukaona green FD/PMS light inawaka kwa overhead switching panel kila mara flight director ya Capt au FO ime-select kwa A1 au C3. Tumeshaswap autopilot pitch/roll computers na CADCs, hakuna mabadiliko; ukivuta PMS coupler, light inazima, so tuna-suspect coupler ime-short internally, lakini hakuna spare coupler stock-ini. Next shift wa-coordinate na maintenance control ku-request MEL 34-38A relief wakati wanasubiri parts.
summary: Wanafundi wana-troubleshoot FD/PMS light ambayo iliendelea kuwaka baada ya smoke incident na panel replacement kwenye B747, na wana-pursue MEL approval kwa sababu ya lack ya PMS coupler mpya.

narrative_text: MD-80 drain valve circuit breaker B1-842 was popping whenever the selector switch was set to DRAIN with system pressurized; troubleshooting traced the fault to wire M637022 between P1-652 and 53-292-2, which were left disconnected at end of shift. This job was not closed out and should have carried over as an open write-up, but the paperwork went missing and a supervisor later signed it off after simply pressurizing the system with no fault found, without confirming P1-652 and 53-292-2 were reconnected. Next shift must verify continuity/reconnection of P1-652 to 53-292-2 and re-check the drain valve circuit before releasing the aircraft.
summary: Drain valve circuit breaker fault on an MD-80 was left mid-repair with wiring disconnected, and the write-up was lost and signed off without confirming the reconnection, so the connection needs verification before further release.
