narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya MD-80, circuit breaker ya drain valve B1-842 ilikuwa ikiruka kila selector switch ikiwekwa DRAIN wakati mfumo umepressurized; uchunguzi ulionyesha tatizo liko kwenye waya M637022 kati ya P1-652 na 53-292-2, ambazo ziliachwa zikiwa hazijaunganishwa mwishoni mwa zamu. Kazi hii haikukamilika na ingepaswa kuendelezwa na zamu inayofuata, lakini karatasi ya write-up ilipotea na baadaye supervisor alisaini kuwa imekamilika baada tu ya kupressurize mfumo na kutokuona tatizo, bila kuthibitisha kama P1-652 na 53-292-2 zimeunganishwa tena. Zamu inayofuata lazima ithibitishe kuunganishwa kwa P1-652 na 53-292-2 na kukagua tena mzunguko wa drain valve kabla ndege haijaruhusiwa kuruka.
summary: Tatizo la circuit breaker ya drain valve kwenye MD-80 liliachwa likiwa halijakamilika na nyaya zikiwa hazijaunganishwa, na write-up ilipotea na kusainiwa bila kuthibitisha muunganisho, hivyo inahitaji ukaguzi zaidi.

entities.text: circuit breaker ya drain valve B1-842

narrative_text: Kwa hio MD-80, drain valve circuit breaker B1-842 ilikuwa ina-pop kila time selector switch iko DRAIN na system iko pressurized; nikaenda troubleshoot nikapata tatizo iko kwa wire M637022 kati ya P1-652 na 53-292-2, ambazo niliziacha disconnected mwisho wa shift yangu. Job haiku-close, ilikuwa isupposed to carry over kama open write-up, lakini paper ilipotea na supervisor akaenda kusign off after just akipressurize system na aka-find no fault, bila hata kuconfirm kama P1-652 na 53-292-2 zimereconnect. Next shift wanafaa wa-verify connection ya P1-652 to 53-292-2 na warecheck drain valve circuit kabla ya kurelease aircraft.
summary: Drain valve circuit breaker ya MD-80 iliachwa mid-repair na wires zikiwa disconnected, na write-up ikapotea ikasainiwa without confirming reconnection, so inahitaji verification zaidi.

narrative_text: On the A300, we carried out a nose landing gear swing after night shift replaced the shock absorber, and both of us signed off the task without flagging it as an RII. GPM requires RII sign-off whenever a component or actuator affecting extension, retraction or locking is installed or rigged, and we did not realize the shock absorber falls under that category. Please have QA review the paperwork and confirm whether a proper RII inspection needs to be completed before further dispatch.
summary: Nose gear swing on the A300 was signed off without recognizing the shock absorber replacement required an RII inspection, needing QA follow-up.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya A300, tulifanya ukaguzi wa mwendo wa gia ya mbele baada ya wafanyakazi wa zamu ya usiku kubadilisha shock absorber, na wote wawili tulisaini kazi hiyo bila kutambua kuwa ilihitaji ukaguzi wa RII. Kitabu cha GPM kinaeleza kuwa RII inahitajika pale sehemu au kifaa kinachohusika na kutanda, kurudisha, au kufunga gia kinapowekwa au kurekebishwa, na hatukufahamu kuwa shock absorber inahusika na hilo. Tunahitaji timu ya udhibiti wa ubora kupitia nyaraka hizo na kuthibitisha kama ukaguzi kamili wa RII unahitajika kabla ndege kuruhusiwa kuruka tena.
summary: Ukaguzi wa gia ya mbele ya ndege ya A300 ulisainiwa bila kutambua kuwa ulihitaji ukaguzi wa RII baada ya kubadilishwa kwa shock absorber.

entities.text: ukaguzi wa mwendo wa gia ya mbele

narrative_text: Kwa hii A300, tulido nose gear swing baada ya night shift kubadilisha shock absorber, tukasign off the item bila kugundua kwamba ilikuwa RII item. GPM inasay RII inahitajika whenever component au actuator inayoaffect extension, retraction ama locking imeinstall au kurigwa, na sisi hatukuconsider shock absorber kama inaaffect hizo functions. Tunahitaji QA wapitie hii paperwork na waconfirm kama proper RII inspection inahitajika kabla ndege irelease for dispatch.
summary: Nose gear swing ya A300 ilisign off bila kutambua ni RII item baada ya shock absorber kubadilishwa, so QA wanahitajika kufollow up.

narrative_text: On the B737-300, the autopilot stabilizer trim motor was replaced during a downline call, but the technician is unsure whether the rear mount bolt was fully torqued. Maintenance control was notified before shift turnover, but it appears the message did not carry over clearly to the next shift and no logbook writeup was made. Next shift please have line maintenance verify the rear mount bolt on the trim motor is properly tightened before further dispatch.
summary: Rear mount bolt on a B737-300 autopilot trim motor may not have been fully torqued after replacement, and the handover to maintenance control/next shift was incomplete, requiring verification before dispatch.

entities.text: verify the rear mount bolt on the trim motor is properly tightened

narrative_text: Katika ndege ya B737-300, motor ya trim ya autopilot ilibadilishwa wakati wa kazi ya downline, lakini fundi hana uhakika kama bolt ya nyuma ya mount ilikazwa vizuri kabisa. Idara ya udhibiti wa matengenezo ilijulishwa kabla ya zamu kubadilika, lakini inaonekana taarifa hiyo haikufika vizuri kwa zamu iliyofuata na hakuna kiingilio kilichoandikwa kwenye logbook. Zamu inayofuata itafute wafanyakazi wa line maintenance wathibitishe kuwa bolt hiyo ya nyuma imekazwa sawasawa kabla ndege haijaruhusiwa kuruka tena.
summary: Bolt ya nyuma ya motor ya trim ya autopilot kwenye B737-300 huenda haikukazwa vizuri, na mawasiliano ya zamu hayakukamilika, hivyo uthibitisho unahitajika kabla ya ndege kutumika tena.

entities.text: wathibitishe kuwa bolt hiyo ya nyuma imekazwa sawasawa

narrative_text: Kwa B737-300, tuli-replace ile autopilot stabilizer trim motor kwa downline call, lakini sina uhakika kama ile rear mount bolt ilikazwa fully. Nili-call maintenance control kabla ya shift turnover kuwaeleza, lakini inaonekana handover haiku-clear vizuri kwa next shift na hakuna logbook entry iliyofanywa. Kwa hivyo next shift wa-confirm na line guys kwamba hiyo bolt ya rear mount imekazwa vizuri kabla aircraft haija-dispatch tena.
summary: Kuna doubt kama rear mount bolt ya trim motor ya B737-300 ilikazwa properly, na handover kati ya shifts haiku-complete, so inahitaji verification before dispatch.

entities.text: wa-confirm na line guys kwamba hiyo bolt ya rear mount imekazwa vizuri

narrative_text: While completing a task handed over from another technician on the B767-300ER turbine rear frame, I installed a ring seal that is not part of this engine's configuration; the paperwork I was following referenced the wrong manual section, and I mistook the seal shown in the illustrated parts catalog attached to the new parts box. Day shift found the open ring seal package I left behind and traced it back to the install, confirming the error with me directly. Aircraft has been located and the incorrect ring seal removed, but please verify the correct seal and hardware are installed per the right IPC reference before further sign-off.
summary: A technician mistakenly installed a non-configuration ring seal on a B767 turbine rear frame due to incorrect manual reference and unfamiliarity with the task; the aircraft was located and the seal removed, pending final verification.

narrative_text: Nikimaliza kazi niliyoachiwa na fundi mwenzangu kwenye turbine rear frame ya ndege ya B767-300ER, nilifunga ring seal ambayo si sehemu ya usanidi wa injini hiyo, kwani karatasi za kazi nilizotumia zilikuwa na rejea isiyo sahihi ya manual, na nilidhani niliona seal hiyo kwenye illustrated parts catalog iliyokuwa imebandikwa kwenye boksi la spea mpya. Zamu ya mchana waligundua kifurushi wazi nilichoacha cha ring seal na kufuatilia hadi kwenye ufungaji huo, na walithibitisha nami kuhusu tatizo hilo. Ndege imepatikana na seal isiyo sahihi imeondolewa, lakini ni muhimu kuthibitisha kuwa seal na vifaa sahihi vimefungwa kulingana na rejea sahihi ya IPC kabla ya kukamilisha kazi.
summary: Fundi alifunga ring seal isiyo sahihi kwenye turbine rear frame ya ndege ya B767 kwa sababu ya rejea potofu ya manual na uzoefu mdogo; ndege imepatikana na seal imeondolewa, ikisubiri uthibitisho wa mwisho.

narrative_text: Nilikuwa nina-complete job ya technician mwenzangu kwenye turbine rear frame ya B767-300ER, na niliinstall ring seal ambayo si part ya configuration ya hio engine. Paperwork niliyokuwa nikitumia ilikuwa na wrong manual reference, na nikafikiri niliona hio seal kwenye illustrated parts catalog iliyokuwa attached kwenye box ya parts mpya. Day shift walipata open package niliyoacha ya ring seal, wakafuatilia mpaka kwa install na kuconfirm na mimi. Aircraft imepatikana na seal imeremovwa, lakini tunahitaji ku-verify kwamba correct seal na hardware zimefungwa according to sahihi IPC reference kabla ya kufunga job hii.
summary: Technician aliinstall wrong ring seal kwenye B767 turbine rear frame kwa sababu ya manual reference isiyo sahihi na inexperience; aircraft imepatikana, seal imeremovwa, but verification bado inahitajika.

narrative_text: A320 #2 engine starter had an intermittent fault caused by a bare wire grounding against the engine; day shift located and made an interim repair but the deferral and repair details were never properly written up in the logbook. During turnover this was miscommunicated, so oncoming mechanics assumed the job was complete, closed the cowls and released the aircraft. Lead tech only learned the next day that the repair was never formally signed off; please verify wire routing/insulation at the ground point and ensure the deferral paperwork is completed before further dispatch.
summary: Poor shift-turnover communication left an A320 engine starter wiring repair undocumented and the aircraft was dispatched believing the fault was fixed.

entities.text: bare wire grounding against the engine

narrative_text: Ndege ya A320 ilikuwa na hitilafu ya starter ya injini namba mbili, ikisababishwa na waya uliokuwa umegusana na injini na kusababisha operesheni ya mara kwa mara isiyo ya kawaida. Wafanyakazi wa zamu ya mchana walibaini tatizo na kufanya ukarabati wa muda, lakini maelezo ya kazi hiyo na uahirishaji wake hayakuandikwa vizuri kwenye logbook. Wakati wa kukabidhi zamu, taarifa hazikuelezwa vizuri, hivyo mafundi wa zamu iliyofuata walidhani kazi imekamilika, wakafunga cowl na kuruhusu ndege kuruka. Fundi Mkuu aligundua siku iliyofuata kuwa ukarabati haukuthibitishwa rasmi; inahitajika ukaguzi wa waya huo na kukamilika kwa fomu za uahirishaji kabla ya safari nyingine.
summary: Mawasiliano hafifu wakati wa kukabidhi zamu yalisababisha ndege ya A320 kuruhusiwa kuruka bila ukarabati wa starter ya injini kuthibitishwa rasmi.

narrative_text: A320 #2 engine starter ilikuwa na chronic problem, day shift wakapata bare wire imeground kwa engine ndio inasababisha starter valve ku-operate intermittent. Wakati wa turnover, mambo ya nini imefanyika na nini imebaki hayakuelezwa poa, so logbook haikuandikwa vizuri, deferral na interim repair hazikuwekwa kwa paperwork. Oncoming mechs walidhani job imekamilika, wakafunga cowls na ku-dispatch acft. Lead nikaambiwa repair imefanyika lakini next day nikagundua sivyo, tuneed kucheck hiyo wiring tena na ku-close paperwork properly kabla ya dispatch ingine.
summary: Kwa sababu ya miscommunication during turnover, A320 ilirelease bila wale wa #2 engine starter repair kufanywa properly kwa paperwork.

narrative_text: During nose gear drag brace installation on the MD-80, we found a corroded taper pin; the replacement ordered against the IPC did not match the original. Gear shop and machinist confirmed pins are individually machined per hole and a single pin cannot be substituted, so the entire drag brace assembly required replacement. New assembly arrived from stores late in shift; next crew to complete installation and verify sign-off from step 7 onward.
summary: A mismatched taper pin during nose gear drag brace work led to full assembly replacement, with installation to be completed by the next shift.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kufunga drag brace ya nose gear kwenye ndege ya MD-80, tuligundua taper pin moja imeoza kwa kutu; pin mpya iliyoagizwa kwa kutumia IPC haikufanana na ile ya awali. Gear shop pamoja na fundi wa mashine walithibitisha kuwa pini hizo hutengenezwa kila moja kulingana na tundu lake mahususi, hivyo haiwezekani kubadilisha pin moja peke yake. Hii ilipelekea uamuzi wa kubadilisha assembly nzima ya drag brace, ambayo ilifika stoo karibu na mwisho wa shift. Shift inayofuata inatakiwa kukamilisha ufungaji na kuhakikisha sahihi za ukaguzi zimekamilika kutoka hatua ya saba kuendelea.
summary: Pin isiyofanana ilisababisha kubadilishwa kwa drag brace assembly nzima ya nose gear, na kazi ya ufungaji itakamilishwa na shift inayofuata.

narrative_text: Tulikuwa tunafanya installation ya drag brace kwenye nose gear ya MD-80, tukagundua taper pin moja imeoza na kutu. Tuka-order replacement kutoka IPC lakini pin iliyokuja haikumatch na ile original. Tukaenda gear shop, machinist akatuconfirm kwamba hizo pins ni machined specifically per hole, so hatuwezi kuinstall pin moja tu. Mwishowe tulilazimika kuchange whole drag brace assembly, ambayo ilifika stores late kwenye shift - next crew waendelee na installation na wacheck sign-off kutoka step 7.
summary: Taper pin haiku-match ikasababisha kubadilishwa kwa drag brace assembly nzima, installation itacompletewa na shift inayofuata.

narrative_text: On the A300 R/H inboard flap repair, the new Rib 7 being installed showed bent/dented ribs; the mechanic continuing the match-drilling per turnover was unaware and a non-routine repair form was raised after crew chief review. Follow-up two days later found the dents had simply been straightened on a machined part, which is not an acceptable repair method, and the crew chief agreed with this concern. By the next check, the crew chief confirmed management was aware but the repair was proceeding without NDT inspection or engineering approval, and the aircraft was released to service that Saturday. Next shift must verify whether Rib 7 has since received proper NDT/engineering sign-off before further flap closure work continues.
summary: A300 inboard flap Rib 7 repair proceeded without required NDT inspection or engineering approval despite mechanic concerns, and the aircraft was returned to service; status of proper sign-off needs verification.

narrative_text: Katika ukarabati wa flap ya ndani upande wa kulia (R/H inboard flap) kwenye ndege ya A300, Rib 7 mpya iliyokuwa ikiwekwa ilionekana imeinama/kubonyea, na fundi aliyeendelea na kazi ya kuchimba mashimo (match-drilling) kwa mujibu wa ripoti ya zamu iliyopita hakuwa na taarifa ya hali hiyo, hivyo fomu ya ukarabati usio wa kawaida ilijazwa baada ya kushauriana na kiongozi wa zamu. Siku mbili baadaye ilibainika kuwa uharibifu ulikuwa umenyooshwa tu bila kufuata utaratibu unaokubalika kwa sehemu iliyotengenezwa kwa mashine, jambo ambalo kiongozi wa zamu alikubaliana kuwa si sahihi. Baadaye ikathibitika kuwa uongozi ulifahamu hali hiyo lakini ukarabati uliendelea bila ukaguzi wa NDT wala idhini ya uhandisi, na ndege ilirudishwa kazini Jumamosi hiyo. Zamu inayofuata ihakikishe kama Rib 7 imepata uthibitisho sahihi wa NDT na uhandisi kabla ya kazi zaidi kuendelea.
summary: Ukarabati wa Rib 7 kwenye flap ya ndege ya A300 uliendelea bila ukaguzi wa NDT au idhini ya uhandisi licha ya wasiwasi wa mafundi, na ndege ilirudishwa kazini; hali ya idhini hiyo inahitaji kuthibitishwa.

narrative_text: Kwa hii repair ya R-hand inboard flap ya A300, Rib 7 mpya iliyokuwa inainstall ilikuwa na ribs zimebend, na yule mechanic alikuwa ana-continue na match-drilling kwa mujibu wa turnover report bila kujua issue hiyo, so tukaraise non-routine repair form baada ya kuongea na crew chief. Siku mbili baadaye tukagundua kwamba dents zilikuwa zimestraighten tu, ambayo si sawa kwa machined part, na crew chief mwenyewe akakubali concern hiyo. By Thursday, crew chief akaconfirm kwamba management walikuwa aware lakini repair iliendelea bila NDT inspection wala engineering approval, na aircraft ikarelease for service that Saturday. Zamu inayofuata i-verify kama Rib 7 imepata sign-off inayotakiwa ya NDT na engineering kabla ya kuendelea na flap closure.
summary: Repair ya Rib 7 kwenye flap ya A300 iliendelea bila NDT inspection wala engineering approval licha ya concerns za mechanic, na aircraft ikarudishwa service; inabidi tu-verify sign-off status.

narrative_text: On the Dash 8-400, the L-hand main landing gear door seal deferred item was actioned tonight: only one bulb seal segment (approx 2.5-3 inches) was actually missing, so the seal was replaced in full (CVR49 type, all attach hardware removed and reinstalled). As a new line tech (11 days in dept), I was unfamiliar with the sign-off process for reopening a deferred item, especially with the recently revised logbook format, and needed supervisor assistance to complete the entry before he left. Please confirm the deferred item was properly closed out in the logbook and verify the sign-off format is correct for future reference.
summary: Technician replaced a damaged L-hand main landing gear door seal on a Dash 8-400 but needed supervisor help closing out the deferred item due to unfamiliarity with the revised logbook process.

entities.text: L-hand main landing gear door seal

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya Dash 8-400, kazi ya deferred item ya seal ya mlango wa main landing gear upande wa kushoto ilifanywa usiku wa leo; ilibainika kipande kimoja tu cha seal (kama inchi 2.5 hadi 3) kilikuwa kimekatika, hivyo seal nzima ilibadilishwa kwa aina ya CVR49 pamoja na hardware zote za kuunganisha. Kwa kuwa bado ni mpya kwenye idara ya line maintenance (siku 11 tu), sikuelewa vizuri jinsi ya ku-sign off deferred item hiyo, hasa kwa vile logbook imebadilishwa hivi karibuni, hivyo nilihitaji msaada wa supervisor kabla hajaondoka. Tafadhali hakikisheni deferred item hiyo imefungwa vizuri kwenye logbook na fomu ya sign-off ni sahihi kwa siku zijazo.
summary: Fundi alibadilisha seal ya mlango wa main landing gear upande wa kushoto kwenye Dash 8-400 lakini alihitaji msaada wa supervisor kufunga deferred item kwa sababu ya logbook mpya.

entities.text: seal ya mlango wa main landing gear upande wa kushoto

narrative_text: Kwenye Dash 8-400, tuli-address ile deferred item ya L-hand main landing gear door seal usiku wa leo - ilikuwa ni kipande kimoja tu kimekatika, about 2.5-3 inches, kwa hivyo tuli-replace seal nzima na ya CVR49 type, tukatoa na kurudisha hardware zote za attachment. Mi ni mpya line maintenance (siku 11 tu), sikujua vizuri jinsi ya ku-sign off deferred item hasa na huu logbook mpya iliyo-revise, so nilihitaji supervisor a-assist kabla ha-jaondoka. Please confirm kama ile deferred item imeclose properly kwenye logbook na sign-off format iko sahihi for future reference.
summary: Fundi alibadilisha L-hand main landing gear door seal kwenye Dash 8-400 lakini alihitaji supervisor a-assist ku-sign off deferred item kwa sababu ya logbook mpya.

narrative_text: Completed the double nosewheel assembly change on the MD-88 near shift change, but tire pressure check was skipped due to time pressure and phone interruptions during the task. Flight departed and the next maintenance station found both tires flat, causing a delay. Incoming shift please ensure tire pressure verification is added as a mandatory step on the logbook sign-off before returning tools to storage.
summary: Nosewheel change on MD-88 was completed without a tire pressure check due to time pressure at shift change, resulting in flat tires and a delay at the next station.

narrative_text: Kazi ya kubadilisha matairi mawili ya gurudumu la pua ya ndege ya MD-88 iliisha karibu na wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu, lakini ukaguzi wa shinikizo la hewa la matairi haukufanyika kwa sababu ya haraka na simu zilizokuwa zikiingia wakati wa kazi. Ndege iliruka na station iliyofuata ikagundua matairi yote mawili ni tambara, jambo lililosababisha ucheleweshaji wa safari. Zamu inayofuata itafute kuhakikisha ukaguzi wa shinikizo la matairi unafanywa na kuandikwa kwenye logbook kabla vifaa havijarudishwa stoo.
summary: Ubadilishaji wa matairi ya gurudumu la pua ya MD-88 haukuwa na ukaguzi wa shinikizo la hewa kwa sababu ya haraka wakati wa zamu, na hivyo kusababisha matairi tambara na ucheleweshaji wa safari station iliyofuata.

narrative_text: Tulimaliza ile nosewheel assembly change ya MD-88 karibu na shift change, lakini tire pressure check ikaskip kwa sababu ya time pressure na hizo phone calls zilikuwa zikiingia wakati wa kazi. Aircraft ikafly na next maintenance station wakakuta matairi yote mawili ni flat, ikasababisha delay ya flight. Shift inayofuata please hakikisheni tire pressure verification inakuwa mandatory step kwenye logbook sign-off kabla ya kurudisha equipment storage.
summary: Tire pressure check ilimissed baada ya nosewheel change kwenye MD-88 kwa sababu ya time pressure wakati wa shift change, na hiyo ikasababisha flat tires na delay next station.

narrative_text: On the B737-500, corrosion was found on the upper wing skin below the overwing exit while working the left wing; Quality Control and Engineering were notified and an NRC was raised. Engineering instructed blending until corrosion was fully removed, but the blended area was then found out of limits, so the aircraft is on hold pending a revised repair from Engineering. Wing tanks still need to be opened for the repair; note that some blended fastener locations were not captured on the maintenance form, though dayshift was verbally briefed on this by the supervisor and Quality Control. Please confirm this fastener detail gets documented properly before further work proceeds.
summary: Wing skin corrosion on the B737-500 was blended out of limits and is awaiting a revised Engineering repair, with a documentation gap on fastener locations that was only communicated verbally at turnover.

entities.text: blending until corrosion was fully removed

narrative_text: Wakati wa kufanya kazi kwenye bawa la kushoto la ndege ya B737-500, kutu ilipatikana juu ya ngozi ya bawa chini ya mlango wa dharura wa juu ya bawa. Idara ya Ubora na Uhandisi zilijulishwa mara moja na ripoti ikaandikwa, na Uhandisi wakaelekeza eneo hilo lisafishwe hadi kutu iondoke kabisa. Baada ya kusafisha, ilibainika eneo lililosafishwa limezidi kiwango kinachoruhusiwa, hivyo kazi imesimamishwa hadi Uhandisi watoe maelekezo mapya ya ukarabati. Kumbuka kuwa baadhi ya sehemu za bolti zilizosafishwa hazikuandikwa kwenye fomu ya matengenezo, ingawa zamu ya mchana ilielezwa kwa mdomo na msimamizi pamoja na Idara ya Ubora; tunahitaji kuboresha uandikaji wa taarifa na mawasiliano.
summary: Kutu kwenye ngozi ya bawa la ndege ya B737-500 ilisafishwa lakini eneo likazidi kiwango, na kazi imesimama ikisubiri maelekezo mapya ya ukarabati kutoka Uhandisi, huku kukiwa na pengo la uandikaji kuhusu bolti.

narrative_text: Nilikuwa nafanya kazi kwa left wing ya B737-500 nikakuta corrosion juu ya wing skin, chini ya overwing exit. Nikacall Quality Control na Engineering mara moja, wakaandika NRC, na Engineering wakasema tu-blend area hiyo mpaka corrosion iishe. Lakini baada ya kublend, ikaonekana eneo limekuwa out of limits, kwa hivyo tuko on hold mpaka Engineering warudi na revised repair. Tunahitaji pia kufungua wing tanks kwa ajili ya hiyo repair - note kwamba baadhi ya fasteners zilizoblendiwa hazikuandikwa kwenye maintenance form, ingawa dayshift walijulishwa verbally na supervisor na Quality Control. Tafadhali hakikisha hiyo detail ya fasteners inaandikwa vizuri kabla ya kuendelea.
summary: Corrosion kwenye wing skin ya B737-500 ilikuwa blended lakini eneo likaenda out of limits, sasa tunasubiri revised repair kutoka Engineering na kuna documentation gap kuhusu fasteners.

entities.text: tu-blend area hiyo mpaka corrosion iishe

narrative_text: During the A-check on the B737, brake pin measurements were taken per the maintenance manual, checking only the forward pin as specified, and the #1 brake measured 5/32 inch, within limits. Day shift had earlier replaced a brake after an auditor flagged the aft pin at 4/32 inch and insisted all pins must be checked, which conflicts with the manual and the TR on file that calls for measuring only one pin. Please clarify with local control/QA which procedure is authoritative before further brake measurements are logged, and confirm the audit finding does not require additional brake changes.
summary: A conflict arose over brake pin measurement procedure during an A-check, with an auditor requiring all pins checked contrary to the manual and TR guidance, needing clarification from local control.

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa A-check kwenye ndege ya B737, vipimo vya pini za breki vilifanywa kulingana na mwongozo wa matengenezo, ambapo pini ya mbele pekee ilipimwa kama inavyotakiwa, na breki namba moja ilionyesha kipimo cha 5/32 inchi, kikiwa ndani ya kiwango kinachokubalika. Zamu ya mchana ilikuwa tayari imebadilisha breki moja baada ya mkaguzi kudai pini ya nyuma ilikuwa 4/32 inchi na kusisitiza kuwa pini zote lazima zipimwe, jambo linalokinzana na mwongozo rasmi na waraka wa kiufundi uliopo unaoeleza pini moja pekee ndiyo inayopaswa kupimwa. Tafadhali wasiliana na wasimamizi wa ubora ili kufafanua utaratibu sahihi kabla ya vipimo vingine kuandikwa, na kuhakikisha matokeo ya ukaguzi huo hayahitaji mabadiliko zaidi ya breki.
summary: Kulikuwa na mgongano wa maelekezo kuhusu upimaji wa pini za breki wakati wa A-check, ambapo mkaguzi alitaka pini zote zipimwe kinyume na mwongozo, hivyo kuhitaji ufafanuzi zaidi kutoka kwa wasimamizi.

narrative_text: Kwa A-check ya hii B737, nilipima brake pins kama manual inavyosema, forward pin tu, na #1 brake ilikuwa 5/32 inch, iko within limits. Lakini nikaambiwa day shift walishabadilisha brake moja after auditor akadai aft pin ilikuwa 4/32 inch akisema lazima uchek pins zote, jambo ambalo linakinzana na maintenance manual na ile TR iliyopo inayosema upime pin moja tu. Tafadhali local control wa-clarify utaratibu sahihi kabla ya kuendelea na measurements zingine, na confirm kama audit finding haihitaji brake change zaidi.
summary: Kuna discrepancy kuhusu brake pin measurement procedure wakati wa A-check, auditor alitaka pins zote zichekwe against manual, hivyo inahitajika clarification kutoka local control.

narrative_text: On the B737-500, the standby hydraulic module in the MLG wheel well was replaced after a previous shift's replacement unit was found cracked in the same spot. New module was installed per the maintenance manual, leak-checked and operationally tested, and passed. A month later the reverser hydraulic line was found disconnected and pushed behind the B pumps, never reconnected to the new module. Maintenance manual does not call out the adapter/plug for the reverser line or require a reverser operational test after module replacement -- next shift please flag this to engineering and verify reverser line connection on any future module swaps.
summary: Standby hydraulic module on a B737-500 was replaced and tested per the manual, but the reverser hydraulic line was left disconnected because the manual does not call out the adapter or a reverser operational test.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya B737-500, moduli ya hydraulic ya standby kwenye wheel well ya MLG ilibadilishwa baada ya ile iliyowekwa na zamu iliyopita kupatikana imepasuka mahali pale pale. Moduli mpya iliwekwa kufuata maintenance manual, ikafanyiwa leak check na operational test, na ikafaulu. Mwezi mmoja baadaye, line ya hydraulic ya reverser ilikutwa haijaunganishwa, imesukumwa nyuma ya B pumps bila kurudishwa kwenye moduli mpya. Maintenance manual haijataja adapter au plug ya line hiyo wala haijaeleza operational test ya reverser baada ya kubadilisha moduli -- zamu inayokuja iarifu engineering na kuhakikisha line ya reverser imeunganishwa vizuri kwa kazi zozote za baadaye za kubadilisha moduli.
summary: Moduli ya hydraulic ya standby kwenye B737-500 ilibadilishwa na kupimwa kufuata manual, lakini line ya reverser ilibaki bila kuunganishwa kwa sababu manual haitaji adapter wala operational test ya reverser.

narrative_text: Kwenye B737-500, tulichange ile standby hydraulic module kwenye MLG wheel well baada ya module iliyowekwa na shift iliyopita kupatikana imecrack sehemu ile ile. New module ilikuwa installed per manual, ikapitia leak check na operational test, ikapass sawa. Mwezi mmoja baadaye reverser line ikakutwa haiko connected, ilikuwa imesukumwa nyuma ya B pumps out of sight, haikurudishwa kwa module mpya. Manual haitaji adapter ya reverser line wala operational test ya reverser after module replacement -- next shift wafuatilie na engineering na wacheck reverser line connection kwenye future module swaps.
summary: Standby hydraulic module kwenye B737-500 ilibadilishwa na kutested per manual, lakini reverser line iliachwa disconnected kwa sababu manual haitaji adapter wala reverser operational test.

narrative_text: Handover on B737-400 L1 pax door: previous shift replaced the snubber but did not flag the RII requirement to inspection before turnover, and this was only caught when lead inspector reviewed the job. Technicians later traced the door operation problem to a loose upper hinge bolt (ref maint manual 52-11-00, fig 401 sheet 3), which was tightened and improved operation; on inspection the snubber was also found incorrectly installed and was corrected per 52-11-71. During final checks the lower hinge seal's flexible cosmetic covering pulled loose and was re-secured; no further damage noted, but next shift should confirm RII sign-off is complete and re-check door operation before dispatch.
summary: During a multi-shift B737-400 L1 door repair, an RII inspection was missed on a snubber replacement, a loose upper hinge bolt and incorrect snubber install were later corrected, and a seal covering was re-secured, with follow-up RII documentation still needed.

narrative_text: Kabambe wa mlango wa L1 wa ndege B737-400: shift iliyopita walibadilisha snubber lakini hawakuwajulisha wakaguzi kuhusu sharti la RII kabla ya kukabidhi kazi, jambo lililobainika baadaye wakati lead inspector alipopitia kazi hiyo. Mafundi walipogundua tatizo halisi lilikuwa bolt ya juu ya hinge iliyolegea (rejea maint manual 52-11-00, figure 401 sheet 3), waliifunga vizuri na uendeshaji wa mlango ukaboreka; wakati wa ukaguzi, ilibainika snubber pia haikuwekwa sawasawa na ikarekebishwa kulingana na 52-11-71. Wakati wa ukaguzi wa mwisho, kifuniko cha mapambo cha seal ya hinge ya chini kililegea na kikarudishwa mahali pake; hakuna uharibifu mwingine uliobainika, lakini shift inayofuata inapaswa kuthibitisha nyaraka za RII zimekamilika na kufanya ukaguzi wa mwisho wa uendeshaji wa mlango kabla ya ndege kutumika.
summary: Katika ukarabati wa mlango wa L1 wa ndege B737-400 uliochukua zamu kadhaa, ukaguzi wa RII ulisahaulika kwenye kubadilisha snubber, baadaye bolt ya hinge ya juu iliyolegea na snubber iliyowekwa vibaya zikarekebishwa, na kifuniko cha seal kikarudishwa, huku nyaraka za RII zikihitaji kukamilishwa.

narrative_text: Handover kwa L1 door ya B737-400: previous shift walibadilisha snubber lakini hawakunotify inspection kuhusu RII requirement kabla ya turnover, na hii ilibainika tu baada ya lead inspector kupitia kazi ile. Technicians baadaye walipata kwamba door operation problem ilikuwa ni upper hinge bolt iliyokuwa loose (ref maint manual 52-11-00, figure 401 sheet 3), wakaitighten na operation ikaimprove; wakati wa inspection, snubber pia ilikuwa imeinstalliwa incorrectly, ikacorrect-iwa according to 52-11-71. During final look-over, flexible cosmetic covering ya lower hinge seal ilipull loose na ikare-secure-iwa; hakuna damage nyingine iliyoonekana, lakini next shift wanahitaji confirm RII documentation imekamilika na warecheck door operation kabla ya dispatch.
summary: Kwenye door repair ya B737-400 L1 iliyochukua several shifts, RII inspection ilimisiwa kwenye snubber replacement, baadaye upper hinge bolt na snubber install zikacorrect-iwa, na seal covering ikare-secure-iwa, huku RII documentation ikihitaji kukamilishwa na next shift.

narrative_text: Handover from night shift on B737-800: the FO's system annunciator light assembly (six pack) is faulty and needs replacement, but there is no specific removal/installation procedure in the maintenance manual. Tech Services initially said 'just install it,' then referred us to GPM 2-01 Para C2, and later to Maint Manual 33-18-00-02 (Master Dim and Test Lights), which is only a generic lighting procedure with no dedicated ops check for this assembly. Next shift please follow up with Tech Pubs/Engineering to get a proper task-specific procedure and installation test, since these lights annunciate critical dispatch items and have caused repeated ground interrupts after gate departure.
summary: Night shift left an unresolved FO annunciator light (six pack) replacement on a B737-800 due to lack of a specific maintenance manual procedure, requiring further coordination with Tech Pubs/Engineering.

entities.text: Maint Manual 33-18-00-02 (Master Dim and Test Lights)

narrative_text: Zamu ya usiku iliniachia taarifa kuhusu ndege ya B737-800 ambapo taa za annunciator za FO, zinazojulikana kama 'six pack,' zimeharibika na zinahitaji kubadilishwa, lakini hakuna utaratibu maalum wa kuziondoa na kuzifunga kwenye kitabu cha matengenezo. Tech Services mwanzoni walisema tu 'zifunge,' kisha wakatuelekeza kwa GPM 2-01 Aya ya C2, na baadaye kwa sehemu 33-18-00-02 ya kitabu cha matengenezo, ambayo ni maelekezo ya jumla tu kuhusu taa na haina ukaguzi maalum wa uendeshaji kwa sehemu hii. Zamu inayofuata tafadhali mfuatilie suala hili na Tech Pubs/Uhandisi ili kupata utaratibu sahihi, kwani taa hizi huonyesha hitilafu muhimu za usafiri na zimekuwa zikisababisha usumbufu mara kadhaa baada ya ndege kuondoka geti.
summary: Zamu ya usiku iliacha suala la ubadilishaji wa taa za annunciator za FO kwenye B737-800 bila kutatuliwa kwa sababu ya ukosefu wa utaratibu maalum, hivyo linahitaji ufuatiliaji zaidi na Tech Pubs/Uhandisi.

entities.text: taa za annunciator za FO (six pack)

narrative_text: Night shift walinipatia handover ya B737-800: ile FO's annunciator light assembly, six pack, imeharibika na inahitaji replacement, lakini hakuna specific procedure ya removal and installation kwenye maintenance manual. Tech Services walisema tu 'just install it,' kisha wakatupeleka GPM 2-01 Para C2, na baadaye tukaambiwa tutumie 33-18-00-02 Master Dim and Test Lights ambayo ni generic sana na haina task-specific ops check. Next shift, please follow up na Tech Pubs/Engineering tupate proper procedure na installation test, kwa sababu hizi lights zinaannunciate critical dispatch items na zimekuwa zikisababisha ground interrupts mara kadhaa baada ya gate departure.
summary: Night shift waliacha issue ya FO annunciator light (six pack) kwenye B737-800 bila kutatuliwa kwa sababu ya lack of specific procedure, hivyo inahitaji follow-up na Tech Pubs/Engineering.

narrative_text: On the B737-300, three cracks on the #3 slat aft edge were stop-drilled and NDT completed per SRM reference; verification confirmed the repair was correctly logged and the slat was programmed for repeated inspections. However, a later ramp inspection found the aircraft still flying with a temporary repair to the #3 slat outer lower skin that is not authorized by the Boeing SRM, despite engineering having endorsed it previously. Next shift please follow up with Engineering and QA to clarify the correct SRM disposition before further flight, and confirm the repeat inspection schedule is being tracked.
summary: Unauthorized temporary repair found on B737-300 #3 slat despite prior stop-drill sign-off, requiring Engineering/QA clarification before further flight.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya B737-300, nyufa tatu kwenye ukingo wa nyuma wa slat namba 3 zilichimbwa (stop-drill) na ukaguzi wa NDT ukafanywa kulingana na rejea ya SRM, na ukaguzi ulithibitisha kazi ilikuwa sahihi na slat ikapangwa kwa ukaguzi wa mara kwa mara. Hata hivyo, ukaguzi wa baadaye kwenye uwanja uligundua ndege ikiendelea kutumika ikiwa na ukarabati wa muda kwenye ngozi ya chini ya nje ya slat hiyo, jambo ambalo halijaidhinishwa na kitabu cha SRM cha Boeing, ingawa idara ya uhandisi ilikuwa imekubali ukarabati huo hapo awali. Zamu ijayo tafadhali wasiliana na Uhandisi na Idara ya Ubora kufafanua hatua sahihi kabla ndege haijaruka tena, na kuhakikisha ratiba ya ukaguzi wa marudio inafuatiliwa.
summary: Ukarabati wa muda usioidhinishwa uligunduliwa kwenye slat namba 3 ya B737-300 licha ya kazi ya awali kuthibitishwa, hivyo kuhitaji ufafanuzi kutoka Uhandisi na Idara ya Ubora.

entities.text: ngozi ya chini ya nje ya slat

narrative_text: Kwenye B737-300, zile cracks tatu kwa #3 slat aft edge zilifanyiwa stop-drill na NDT ikakamilika kulingana na SRM reference, na tulithibitisha kwamba kazi ilikuwa correct na slat ika-programiwa for repeated inspections. Lakini later, wakati wa ramp inspection, wakakuta ndege ikiendelea ku-fly na temporary repair kwa slat outer lower skin ambayo haija-authorized na Boeing SRM, hata ingawa Engineering walikuwa wame-endorse hiyo repair awali. Next shift wafuatilie na Engineering na QA ku-clarify correct disposition kabla aircraft haija-fly tena, na confirm kama repeat inspection schedule inafuatwa.
summary: Temporary repair isiyo-authorized ilipatikana kwa #3 slat ya B737-300 despite sign-off ya awali, so inahitajika follow-up na Engineering/QA kabla ya further flight.

narrative_text: B737-700 arrived late with a dual bleed trip on #1 engine, which has a known history of bleed trip issues; per instruction we did not troubleshoot that item further. During lockout we mistakenly isolated the high stage valve instead of the bleed valve (PRSOV), and the fail-safe engine run afterward did not catch the error due to time pressure from a shift change and weather delays. Aircraft was later moved to another gate; next shift please verify correct valve lockout status on #1 engine before next dispatch.
summary: Wrong valve (high stage instead of PRSOV) was locked out on #1 engine during a rushed shift-change troubleshooting event, and the follow-up engine run failed to catch the error.

narrative_text: Ndege ya B737-700 iliwasili ikiwa imechelewa kutokana na tatizo la bleed trip mbili kwenye injini namba 1, ambayo ina historia ya matatizo kama hayo; tulielekezwa tusiendelee kuchunguza zaidi. Wakati wa kuzima valve, tulikosea na kufunga high stage valve badala ya bleed valve (PRSOV), na ukaguzi wa injini uliofuata haukubaini kosa hilo kwa sababu ya haraka iliyosababishwa na mabadiliko ya zamu na hali mbaya ya hewa. Ndege ilihamishwa baadaye hadi geti lingine; zamu inayofuata ihakikishe valve sahihi imefungwa kabla ya safari inayofuata.
summary: Valve isiyo sahihi (high stage badala ya PRSOV) ilifungwa kwenye injini namba 1 wakati wa zamu yenye shughuli nyingi, na ukaguzi wa injini haukugundua kosa hilo.

narrative_text: B737-700 ilikuja late na dual bleed trip kwenye engine number 1, ambayo ina history ya bleed trips, so tuliambiwa tusiguse item hiyo tena. Wakati wa lockout, tuli-miss na tukafunga high stage valve badala ya bleed valve (PRSOV), na yule engine run ya fail-safe haikucatch mistake hiyo kwa sababu ya time pressure ya shift change na weather ilikuwa mbaya. Aircraft ilihamishiwa gate ingine baadaye; next shift wacheki valve iko correct kwa engine number 1 kabla ya next dispatch.
summary: Wrong valve (high stage badala ya PRSOV) ilifungwa kwa engine number 1 during rushed shift change, na engine run haikucatch ile mistake.

narrative_text: Carryover from previous shift: B767-400ER had a fuel imbalance with fuel config light on, and the L CTR fuel boost pump was removed for replacement. The replacement pump installed was later found to be the wrong effectivity (unmodified unit), even though the previous shift ordered it using the manufacturer's part number off the removed unit. Next shift needs to verify effectivity of the pump currently installed and pull correct part before further dispatch; recommend review of part procurement process with supplier.
summary: Wrong-effectivity fuel boost pump was installed on a B767-400ER during a fuel imbalance carryover repair and needs verification/replacement.

narrative_text: Kutoka zamu iliyopita: ndege ya B767-400ER ilikuwa na tatizo la mafuta kutokusawazika na taa ya config ilikuwa inawaka, hivyo pump ya mafuta ya L CTR iliondolewa kwa ajili ya kubadilishwa. Pump iliyowekwa badala yake ilikuja kugundulika kuwa si ya effectivity sahihi kwa ndege hii, ingawa zamu iliyopita walidai walitumia namba ya sehemu kutoka kwa mtengenezaji ya ile pump iliyoondolewa walipofanya order. Zamu inayofuata inatakiwa kuthibitisha effectivity ya pump iliyopo sasa kabla ndege haijaruhusiwa kuruka, na inashauriwa mchakato wa kuagiza vipuri ufanyiwe ukaguzi wa ndani.
summary: Pump ya mafuta yenye effectivity isiyo sahihi iliwekwa kwenye ndege ya B767-400ER wakati wa kutengeneza tatizo la mafuta kutokusawazika, hivyo inahitaji uthibitisho na marekebisho.

entities.text: pump ya mafuta ya L CTR
ukaguzi wa mchakato wa kuagiza vipuri

narrative_text: Carryover kutoka zamu iliyopita: ile B767-400ER ilikuwa na fuel imbalance na config light iliwaka, so tuliondoa L CTR fuel boost pump kwa ajili ya replacement. Ile pump ambayo ni-install ilikuja kugundulika si sahihi effectivity, unmodified unit, ingawa previous shift walisema walitumia manufacturer part number kutoka kwa ile iliyoondolewa wakati wa ku-order. Next shift wanafaa ku-verify effectivity ya pump iliyoko sasa before dispatch, na tunashauri procurement process irudiwe kuangaliwa na supplier.
summary: Wrong effectivity pump iliwekwa kwenye B767-400ER wakati wa kufix fuel imbalance, so inahitajika verification haraka.

narrative_text: During the wheelchair stowage change order on the B737-300, the FDR was removed briefly to allow adjustment of the upper attach rod, then re-seated in the rack but not secured. Shift ended before the R&R was documented, and the handover to the next crew did not flag that the FDR was still unsecured. Incoming technicians must inspect the FDR rack immediately and confirm it is properly secured and logged before further dispatch.
summary: An FDR was reinstalled but left unsecured during a stowage unit change and not documented at shift turnover, requiring immediate inspection and paperwork correction.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kazi ya kubadilisha kifaa cha kuhifadhi kiti cha magurudumu kwenye ndege ya B737-300, FDR iliondolewa kwa muda ili kuruhusu urekebishaji wa fimbo ya juu ya kushikilia, kisha ikarudishwa mahali pake lakini haikufungwa vizuri. Zamu ilikwisha kabla ya kazi hiyo kuandikwa kwenye rekodi, na wakati wa mkabidhiano hakuna aliyetaja kuwa FDR bado haijafungwa kikamilifu. Fundi wa zamu inayofuata anapaswa kukagua mara moja rafu ya FDR na kuhakikisha imefungwa sawasawa na kuandikwa kwenye logbook kabla ndege haijaruhusiwa kuruka tena.
summary: FDR iliwekwa tena bila kufungwa vizuri wakati wa kazi ya kubadilisha kifaa cha kuhifadhi kiti, na jambo hilo halikuandikwa wakati wa mkabidhiano wa zamu, hivyo linahitaji ukaguzi wa haraka.

entities.text: kubadilisha kifaa cha kuhifadhi kiti cha magurudumu
urekebishaji wa fimbo ya juu ya kushikilia

narrative_text: Tulikua tunafanya ile wheelchair stowage change order kwa B737-300, na ile FDR ilibidi tuiremove kidogo ili tuweze kuadjust ile upper attach rod. Baada ya kumaliza, FDR iliwekwa tena kwenye rack lakini haiku-secure vizuri, halafu shift ikaisha kabla mtu kuandika ile R&R kwenye logbook. Turnover haikutajwa kabisa kuhusu hiyo FDR, so fundi wa next shift lazima acheki rack hiyo mapema na ahakikishe imefungwa properly na ime-documented before dispatch.
summary: FDR iliwekwa tena bila kusecure wakati wa stowage change job na haikuandikwa kwenye handover, hivyo inahitaji ukaguzi wa haraka na documentation kabla ya flight ijayo.

narrative_text: Handover: B737-300 had a missing fastener on the strut access panel above #2 engine; prior shift mechanic secured the panel and taped over the fastener hole per procedure. As lead technician I logged the carry forward using the maintenance procedures reference. On arrival in ZZZ1 the panel itself was found missing, so the carry forward reference used may have been inadequate - next shift should verify SRM/repair manual requirements before further dispatch and close out the item correctly.
summary: A carry-forward entry for a missing strut panel fastener on a B737-300 was logged using the wrong reference manual, and the panel was later found missing on arrival, requiring follow-up verification against the repair manual/SRM.

entities.text: carry forward using the maintenance procedures reference

narrative_text: Makabidhiano: Ndege ya B737-300 ilikuwa na tatizo la fastener iliyokosekana kwenye panel ya strut juu ya engine namba mbili; fundi wa shift iliyopita alisema alifunga panel hiyo na kubandika tepi juu ya tundu la fastener kama taratibu zinavyotaka. Mimi kama lead technician nilijaza carry forward nikitumia rejea ya taratibu za matengenezo. Baadaye ikagundulika kwamba panel yenyewe ilikuwa imekosekana wakati ndege ilipowasili ZZZ1, hivyo inaonekana rejea sahihi ingekuwa repair manual. Shift inayokuja ifuatilie suala hili na kuthibitisha taratibu sahihi za kufunga kabla ndege kuruhusiwa kuendelea na safari.
summary: Fastener ya panel ya strut kwenye B737-300 ilikosekana na carry forward iliandikwa kwa rejea isiyo sahihi, hivyo shift inayokuja inahitajika kuthibitisha taratibu sahihi kabla ndege kuendelea na safari.

entities.text: panel ya strut juu ya engine namba mbili

narrative_text: Handover note: Yule B737-300 alikuwa na fastener missing kwenye strut access panel juu ya engine number 2. Fundi wa shift iliyopita aliniambia amesecure panel na akaweka tape juu ya hole ile as per procedure. Mimi kama lead nikaandika carry forward nikitumia maintenance procedures ref, lakini baadaye tukagundua panel yenyewe imekosekana on arrival ZZZ1. Naona rejea sahihi ilikuwa repair manual, so next shift wafuatilie hili na wacheck SRM requirements kabla ya kuclose item.
summary: Panel ya strut kwenye B737-300 ilikutwa imekosekana ZZZ1 baada ya carry forward kuandikwa na rejea isiyo sahihi, so next shift wafanye follow-up na SRM/repair manual.

entities.text: strut access panel juu ya engine number 2

narrative_text: Signed off on oil filter work on the MD-80 #1 engine that was actually performed by another technician; I only witnessed the post-work engine run and leak check, which showed no leaks at the time. Aircraft later had an inflight shutdown of #1 engine due to oil loss, so this needs a full investigation of the filter installation. Please note I was on my first shift back from leave and coming off a near 24-hour duty period, so double-check all my sign-offs from this shift. Going forward, each mechanic must sign only for work they personally perform, not just observe.
summary: Technician signed for oil filter work performed by a colleague on an MD-80, and the aircraft subsequently suffered an inflight shutdown of the #1 engine due to oil loss.

narrative_text: Nilisaini kazi ya oil filter kwenye engine namba moja ya ndege ya MD-80 ambayo kwa kweli ilifanywa na fundi mwenzangu; mimi nilishuhudia tu engine ikiwashwa na leak check ikifanyika, na hapo hakukuwa na uvujaji wowote. Baadaye ndege ilipata tatizo la engine namba moja kuzimwa ikiwa angani kutokana na kupoteza mafuta, hivyo jambo hili linahitaji kufuatiliwa kwa undani kuhusu ufungaji wa filter hiyo. Tafadhali zingatia kuwa hii ilikuwa zamu yangu ya kwanza baada ya likizo, na nilikuwa nimeshafanya kazi karibu masaa ishirini na nne bila kupumzika, hivyo saini zangu zote za zamu hii zichunguzwe kwa makini. Kuanzia sasa, kila fundi anapaswa kusaini tu kazi aliyoifanya mwenyewe, si kazi aliyoiona tu ikifanywa.
summary: Fundi alisaini kazi ya oil filter iliyofanywa na mfanyakazi mwenzake kwenye ndege ya MD-80, na baadaye ndege hiyo ilipata tatizo la engine kuzimwa angani kutokana na upotevu wa mafuta.

narrative_text: Nilisign yale oil filter job kwenye MD-80 #1 engine lakini kwa ukweli ile kazi ilifanywa na mechanic mwenzangu, mimi nilikuwa tu present wakati wa engine run na leak check, na haikuonyesha leak yoyote wakati huo. Later kwenye flight, #1 engine ilishutdown inflight due to oil loss, kwa hivyo inahitajika investigation ya hiyo filter installation asap. Tafadhali note that hii ilikuwa first shift yangu baada ya leave, na nilikuwa nimeshakaa karibu masaa 24 without rest, so double-check sign-offs zangu zote za shift hii. Going forward, kila mechanic ana-sign tu kazi ambayo yeye mwenyewe amefanya, si kuangalia tu na kutrust kazi ya mwenzake.
summary: Mechanic alisign kazi ya oil filter iliyofanywa na colleague kwenye MD-80, na baadaye engine #1 ika-shutdown inflight due to oil loss.

narrative_text: DC-9 50 standby horizon indicator was replaced after a red-flag fault and passed all functional checks per the manual, but voltage at the indicator measured 60 VAC instead of the 120 VAC specified on the wiring diagram. The same 60 VAC reading was confirmed on a second aircraft, and after consulting other technicians it was accepted as normal, likely a drawing misprint. Next shift should follow up with Engineering to get an official authorization issued to correct the wiring diagram, even though the unit is functioning correctly.
summary: Standby horizon on a DC-9 50 checks out functionally, but a voltage discrepancy against the wiring diagram needs formal Engineering correction.

narrative_text: Kiashiria cha standby horizon cha ndege ya DC-9 50 kilibadilishwa baada ya kuonyesha hitilafu (red flag), na kikapita vipimo vyote kwa mujibu wa mwongozo, lakini voltage iliyopimwa kwenye kiashiria ilikuwa 60 VAC badala ya 120 VAC kama ilivyoainishwa kwenye mchoro wa nyaya. Usomaji huohuo wa 60 VAC ulithibitishwa kwenye ndege nyingine, na baada ya kushauriana na mafundi wenzangu, tulikubaliana kuwa hilo ni la kawaida na huenda mchoro una kosa la uchapishaji. Zamu inayofuata ifuatilie suala hili na idara ya Uhandisi ili kupata idhini rasmi ya kurekebisha mchoro wa nyaya, ingawa kifaa kinafanya kazi vizuri.
summary: Kiashiria cha standby horizon cha DC-9 50 kinafanya kazi vizuri, lakini tofauti ya voltage dhidi ya mchoro wa nyaya inahitaji kufuatiliwa na Uhandisi.

narrative_text: Kwa hii DC-9 50, ile standby horizon indicator ilikuwa na red flag, tukaibadilisha na iki-pass functional checks zote kama manual inavyosema. Lakini tukigundua voltage reading kwa indicator ni 60 VAC badala ya 120 VAC kama wiring diagram inavyoonyesha. Tulicheki na aircraft ingine, same reading, so after kuconsult na wenzetu tukaona 60 VAC ndio normal na diagram ndio ina typo. Next shift wafuatilie na Engineering wapate authorization ya kurekebisha ile drawing, hata kama unit inafanya kazi poa.
summary: Standby horizon indicator ya DC-9 50 ime-pass checks lakini kuna voltage discrepancy na wiring diagram inahitaji kufuatiliwa na Engineering.

narrative_text: Followed up on the B757-200 pilot log write-up for L1 door hard to open; found an external fuselage hinge access panel removed with no logbook entry or non-routine write-up documenting prior troubleshooting. A replacement part had already been ordered, but door operation checked normal to us and to other mechanics and both crew chiefs; only the damping snubber pin indicator was found extended. Lubricated the door and coordinated with Technical Services, who agreed the snubber does not affect door operation and will raise an item to replace it. Next shift please confirm the replacement part item is logged and ensure the supervisor turnover sheet is available at the hangar going forward.
summary: Technicians found undocumented prior troubleshooting on a B757 L1 door hard-to-open write-up, confirmed normal door operation, lubricated it, and flagged a snubber pin for replacement via Technical Services.

narrative_text: Tulipokea report ya L1 door ya ndege B757-200 kuwa ngumu kufunguliwa, na tukagundua panel ya nje ya hinge ya fuselage ilikuwa imeondolewa bila kuandikwa logbook wala non-routine write-up ya troubleshooting iliyofanyika awali. Part mpya ilikuwa tayari imeorder, lakini baada ya kuangalia, mlango ulionekana kufanya kazi vizuri kama walivyothibitisha mafundi wengine na crew chiefs wawili; kitu tu kilichoonekana tofauti ni pin indicator ya snubber ya damping iliyokuwa imetoka nje kidogo. Tulilainisha (lube) mlango na kuwasiliana na Technical Services, ambao walikubaliana kuwa snubber hiyo haiwezi kuathiri operesheni ya mlango na wataandaa order ya kuibadilisha. Shift inayokuja tafadhali thibitisha kama order ya part hiyo imewekwa kwenye system na kwamba turnover sheet ya supervisor inapatikana hangar-ni siku zijazo.
summary: Mafundi waligundua kuwa troubleshooting ya awali ya mlango wa L1 wa ndege ya B757 haikuandikwa vizuri, wakathibitisha mlango unafanya kazi vizuri, wakaulainisha, na kutoa taarifa ya kuibadilisha snubber kupitia Technical Services.

entities.text: panel ya nje ya hinge ya fuselage
pin indicator ya snubber ya damping

narrative_text: Tuliendelea na troubleshooting ya B757-200 kwa ile pilot log kwamba L1 door ni hard to open; tukakuta external fuselage hinge access panel imeondolewa lakini hakuna documentation yoyote kwenye logbook au non-routine write-up ya kile kilichofanyika before. Part ilikuwa tayari imeorder, lakini door operation ilikuwa normal kwetu na pia kwa mechs wengine na crew chiefs, isipokuwa pin indicator ya damping snubber ilikuwa imeextend kidogo. Tulilube door na kutalk na Technical Services, wakakubali kwamba snubber haiaffect operation ya door na watapanga replacement item. Kwa next shift, please confirm kama part order imeenter kwenye system, na pia hangar inatakiwa iwe na turnover sheet ya supervisor kila wakati.
summary: Wakati wa troubleshooting ya L1 door write-up kwenye B757, mechs walikuta hakuna documentation ya awali, walithibitisha door operation ni normal, walilube, na wakaraise item ya kubadilisha snubber pin kupitia Technical Services.

narrative_text: While troubleshooting a bleed leak on the A300, I opened the wheel well and pack bay access panels to trace the source. Two incoming technicians arrived near end of shift and I gave them a verbal handover before leaving for a taxi-tow assignment; there was no lead technician available to coordinate the turnover. It was later found that some panels were never reinstalled, resulting in aircraft damage. Next shift should verify all access panels are closed/secured before further dispatch and confirm lead coverage for future shift handovers.
summary: Verbal-only handover of an open A300 panel troubleshooting task, with no lead present, led to panels being left uninstalled and subsequent aircraft damage.

entities.text: wheel well and pack bay access panels

narrative_text: Wakati wa kutafuta chanzo cha bleed leak kwenye ndege ya A300, nilifungua panels za wheel well na pack bay ili kuchunguza tatizo. Mafundi wawili wa shift inayofuata walifika karibu na mwisho wa zamu yangu, nikawapa taarifa ya mdomo kuhusu kazi iliyoendelea kabla ya kuhamishiwa kazi ya taxi-tow, kwani hapakuwa na lead technician wa kuratibu mabadiliko ya zamu. Baadaye ilibainika kuwa baadhi ya panels hazikurudishwa mahali pake, na hii ilisababisha uharibifu wa ndege. Zamu inayofuata inahitaji kuhakikisha panels zote zimefungwa vizuri kabla ya ndege kutumika tena, na kuwepo kwa lead technician wa kusimamia mabadiliko ya zamu siku zijazo.
summary: Taarifa ya mdomo pekee bila lead technician ilisababisha panels za ndege ya A300 kutorudishwa, hivyo kusababisha uharibifu.

entities.text: panels za wheel well na pack bay

narrative_text: Nilikuwa nina-troubleshoot bleed leak kwa A300, nikaopen access panels za wheel well na pack bay area kutafuta leak. Karibu na mwisho wa shift yangu, technicians wawili wa next shift walikuja ku-assist, nikawapea verbal handover tu kabla sijaenda ku-report kwa taxi-tow crew, kwa sababu hakukuwa na lead technician wa ku-coordinate turnover. Baadaye ikagundulika panels zingine hazikuwa reinstalled, ikasababisha aircraft damage. Next shift wahakikishe panels zote zime-close vizuri before dispatch, na tupate lead coverage kwa hizi turnovers zijazo.
summary: Verbal handover pekee bila lead technician ilisababisha panels za A300 kubaki open, na hatimaye aircraft damage.

entities.text: access panels za wheel well na pack bay area

narrative_text: During turnover on the two ERJ-140 aircraft, the inspector flagged that the Base Manager had signed off a work card block that neither outgoing shift mechanic could confirm was actually performed. About 3 hours later the same block was changed to N/A, with the Base Manager stating the inspection was not required since winds stayed under 50 kts, and the logbook was then signed off as cleared and worked. Next shift needs to verify actual completion status of that inspection block and reconcile the conflicting logbook/work card entries before further release.
summary: A work card block on an ERJ-140 was first signed off then later marked N/A by the Base Manager with no clear record of whether the inspection was actually done, requiring follow-up verification.

narrative_text: Wakati wa turnover kwa ndege mbili za ERJ-140, mkaguzi alibaini kwamba Meneja wa Kituo alikuwa amesaini sehemu ya work card ambayo hakuna fundi wa zamu iliyopita angeweza kuthibitisha kama kazi hiyo ilifanyika. Baada ya masaa matatu hivi, sehemu hiyo ilibadilishwa kuwa 'Haihusiki' (N/A), Meneja akisema ukaguzi haukuhitajika kwa sababu upepo haukuzidi mafundo 50, kisha logbook ikasainiwa kuonyesha kazi imekamilika. Zamu inayofuata inapaswa kuthibitisha hali halisi ya ukaguzi huo na kupatanisha maelezo yanayopingana kati ya logbook na work card kabla ya ndege kuruhusiwa kuendelea kutumika.
summary: Sehemu ya work card katika ndege ya ERJ-140 ilisainiwa kisha baadaye kubadilishwa kuwa haihusiki na Meneja wa Kituo bila uthibitisho wazi kama kazi ilifanyika, hivyo inahitaji ufuatiliaji.

narrative_text: Kwa turnover ya hizi ndege mbili za ERJ-140, inspector aligundua kwamba Base Manager amesign off block ya work card, lakini hakuna hata fundi mmoja wa shift iliyopita ambaye anaweza confirm kama kazi hiyo ilifanywa. Baada ya kama masaa tatu, block ile ile ika-changwa kuwa N/A, Base Manager akisema inspection haikuhitajika kwa sababu winds hazikuzidi 50 kts, kisha logbook ika-signed off kuonyesha kazi imekamilika na kucleared. Next shift wanahitaji ku-verify status halisi ya ile inspection block na kupatanisha hizo discrepancies kati ya logbook na work card kabla ya release yoyote.
summary: Block ya work card kwa ERJ-140 ilisign off kisha baadaye kubadilishwa kuwa N/A na Base Manager bila confirmation kama kazi ilifanyika, so inahitaji follow-up ya haraka.

narrative_text: Following a taxi-in vibration complaint from the outbound crew, I logged the write-up and reviewed the aircraft history, which showed one prior similar event on this B767-300ER. After inspecting the engine, wiring and sensors with no faults found, I replaced the engine vibration monitor using the part number pulled from the IPC and maintenance manual, then released the aircraft with the vibration system on carry-over. Post-departure it was discovered that the installed monitor's effectivity does not match this tail number, likely due to conflicting effectivity data in the maintenance manual versus the IPC. Next shift needs to confirm correct part effectivity, coordinate replacement, and track the change request submitted to the manuals department.
summary: A B767-300ER was released with an engine vibration monitor of incorrect part effectivity due to conflicting manual data, requiring follow-up part correction and a manual revision request.

entities.text: change request submitted to the manuals department

narrative_text: Baada ya wafanyakazi wa ndege waliotoka kuripoti tatizo la mtetemo wakati wa taxi-in, niliandika ripoti kwenye logbook na kuangalia historia ya ndege, ambapo ilionekana kulikuwa na tatizo kama hilo hapo awali kwenye ndege hii ya B767-300ER. Nilikagua injini, nyaya na sensa bila kupata hitilafu, kisha nikabadilisha kifaa cha kupima mtetemo wa injini kwa kutumia namba ya sehemu niliyopata kwenye IPC na kitabu cha matengenezo, na baadaye nikaruhusu ndege kuondoka huku mfumo huo ukiwekwa kwenye orodha ya ufuatiliaji. Baada ya ndege kuondoka, ilibainika kuwa kifaa kilichowekwa hakikulingana na namba ya mkia wa ndege hii, jambo linaloonekana kutokana na taarifa zinazokinzana kwenye kitabu cha matengenezo. Zamu inayofuata inahitajika kuthibitisha sehemu sahihi, kuiweka, na kufuatilia ombi la mabadiliko lililotumwa idara ya vitabu vya matengenezo.
summary: Ndege ya B767-300ER iliruhusiwa kuondoka ikiwa na kifaa cha kupima mtetemo wa injini chenye namba isiyolingana na ndege hiyo, hivyo kuhitaji marekebisho na mapitio ya kitabu cha matengenezo.

entities.text: kifaa cha kupima mtetemo wa injini
tatizo la mtetemo wakati wa taxi-in
ombi la mabadiliko lililotumwa idara ya vitabu vya matengenezo

narrative_text: Outbound crew walireport vibration issue wakati wa taxi-in, so nikaingiza write-up kwenye logbook na kucheck aircraft history, nikaona kulikuwa na previous incident moja tu kwenye hii B767-300ER. Nilifanya inspection ya engine, wiring na sensors, sikupata fault yoyote, so nikaamua kubadilisha ile vibration monitor nikitumia part number niliyopata kwenye IPC na maintenance manual, kisha nikarelease aircraft na system iko kwenye carry-over. Baada ya departure, tukaambiwa kwamba part effectivity ya ile monitor haimatch na tail number ya hiyo aircraft, sababu manual inaonyesha info inayo-conflict na IPC. Next shift wafuatilie correct part, wa-coordinate replacement, na watrack ile change request niliyosubmit kwa manuals department.
summary: B767-300ER ilirelesiwa na vibration monitor ambayo haimatch na tail number, kwa hivyo inahitajika follow-up ya part correction na manual review.

entities.text: change request niliyosubmit kwa manuals department

narrative_text: While troubleshooting the cockpit airflow write-up on the B737-300, I pulled the instrument panel and several cannon plugs, including #1 and #2 engine N1 tachometer indicator plugs, then reinstalled everything. Shift ended before the airflow issue was resolved and I had to wait for the logbook/turnover book to be free, so I briefed the oncoming crew verbally in a rush and missed writing up that an engine run is required to check the tach gauges after the cannon plug work. Next shift please confirm an engine run has been done to verify #1 and #2 N1 tachometer indications before further dispatch.
summary: A rushed, incomplete written handover after cannon plug work on the tachometer indicators omitted the required engine run check, which was only caught at pushback.

entities.text: #1 and #2 engine N1 tachometer indicator plugs

narrative_text: Wakati nikichunguza tatizo la mtiririko wa hewa kwenye cockpit ya ndege ya B737-300, niliondoa kibao cha vyombo vya kupimia pamoja na cannon plugs kadhaa, ikiwemo zile za tachometer za engine namba 1 na namba 2, kisha nikazirudisha zote mahali pake. Zamu yangu iliisha kabla tatizo la hewa kutatuliwa kabisa, na kwa sababu kitabu cha logbook na turnover kilikuwa kikitumiwa na fundi mwenzangu, niliwaeleza wafanyakazi wa zamu inayofuata kwa mdomo tu kwa haraka, na nikasahau kuandika kwamba inahitajika engine run kuhakikisha vipimo vya tachometer vinafanya kazi sawasawa baada ya kazi ile ya cannon plugs. Zamu inayofuata inahitajika kuthibitisha kuwa engine run imefanywa na vipimo vya tachometer namba 1 na namba 2 vinaonyesha sahihi kabla ndege kutumika tena.
summary: Taarifa ya mkabidhiano iliyoandikwa kwa haraka baada ya kazi ya cannon plugs kwenye tachometer haikutaja hitaji la engine run, jambo lililogunduliwa tu wakati wa pushback.

entities.text: tachometer za engine namba 1 na namba 2

narrative_text: Nilikuwa nikitroubleshoot ile airflow write-up kwa B737-300, nikaremove instrument panel na cannon plugs kadhaa, including zile za #1 na #2 engine N1 tachometer indicators, kisha nikazireinstall zote. Shift yangu iliisha before airflow issue kutatuliwa, na kwa sababu logbook na turnover book zilikuwa zikitumiwa na mwenzangu, nikaeleza incoming crew verbally huku nikiwa in a rush, na nikaforget kuwrite down kwamba inahitajika engine run kucheck zile tach gauges baada ya kazi ya cannon plugs. Next shift wachek kama engine run imefanywa kuconfirm #1 na #2 N1 tachometer indications kabla ya kurelease ndege.
summary: Turnover note iliandikwa kwa haraka baada ya cannon plug work kwenye tachometer, ikamiss ile requirement ya engine run, na ikagundulika saa ya pushback.

narrative_text: Completed the visual inspection of the engine driven fuel pump installation on the B737-700; installation appeared satisfactory with no signs of mechanical fault. Due to shift change I was unable to stay and witness the fuel pump leak check during engine runs, so this was handed over to the incoming maintenance team. Next shift to confirm whether any leaks were observed during the runs and ensure findings, if any, are properly documented in the logbook.
summary: Fuel pump visual inspection completed but leak check handed over to next shift due to time constraints, pending confirmation and documentation.

narrative_text: Nimemaliza ukaguzi wa kuona wa pampu ya mafuta iliyowekwa kwenye injini ya ndege ya B737-700; ufungaji ulionekana kuwa mzuri bila dalili za hitilafu ya kimitambo. Kutokana na mabadiliko ya zamu, sikuweza kubaki kushuhudia ukaguzi wa uvujaji wa pampu ya mafuta wakati wa majaribio ya injini, hivyo jukumu hilo limekabidhiwa kwa wafanyakazi wa zamu inayofuata. Zamu inayofuata inaombwa kuthibitisha kama kulikuwa na uvujaji wowote uliobainika wakati wa majaribio na kuhakikisha taarifa hizo zimeandikwa vizuri kwenye kitabu cha matengenezo.
summary: Ukaguzi wa kuona wa pampu ya mafuta umekamilika lakini ukaguzi wa uvujaji umekabidhiwa kwa zamu inayofuata kwa uthibitisho na uandikishaji.

entities.text: ukaguzi wa uvujaji wa pampu ya mafuta

narrative_text: Nimefanya visual inspection ya ile fuel pump installation kwa B737-700, na installation ilikuwa sawa, hakuna dalili za mechanical fault. Lakini kwa sababu ya shift change sikuweza ku-witness ile leak check wakati wa engine runs, so nimehand over kwa next shift wakamilishe. Wao waconfirm kama kulikuwa na leaks zozote during the runs na wahakikishe wame-document vizuri kwenye logbook.
summary: Fuel pump visual inspection imekamilika but leak check imehandover kwa next shift for confirmation na documentation.

narrative_text: B737-300 returned to gate before shift change for a takeoff warning fault; the takeoff warning test switch had failed. To gain access for the switch replacement, the tech disconnected the flight deck hydraulic brake pressure indicator cannon plug and the No. 2 oil pressure gauge cannon plug. After the switch was replaced, the cannon plugs were reconnected but appear to have been swapped, causing the brake pressure indicator circuit breaker to trip; the indicator was placed on MEL as a temporary measure. Overnight crew must verify the cannon plug connections are correctly matched and confirm the MEL can be cleared.
summary: Cannon plugs for the brake pressure indicator and No. 2 oil pressure gauge were swapped during a takeoff warning switch repair on a B737-300, tripping a circuit breaker and requiring MEL action, with overnight follow-up needed.

entities.text: hydraulic brake pressure indicator cannon plug
No. 2 oil pressure gauge cannon plug

narrative_text: Ndege ya B737-300 ilirudi getini kabla ya mabadiliko ya zamu kutokana na hitilafu ya onyo la kuruka; swichi ya kupima onyo hilo ilikuwa imeharibika. Ili kupata nafasi ya kubadilisha swichi, fundi aliondoa plugs mbili za waya, moja ya kipimo cha shinikizo la breki na nyingine ya kipimo cha mafuta ya injini namba mbili. Baada ya kukamilisha ukarabati, plugs hizo zilirudishwa lakini zinaonekana zilibadilishwa mahali, jambo lililosababisha breaker ya umeme kukatika; hivyo kipimo cha shinikizo la breki kiliwekwa kwenye orodha ya MEL kwa muda. Wafanyakazi wa zamu ya usiku wanahitajika kuhakikisha waya hizo zimeunganishwa sawasawa na kufuta MEL baada ya ukaguzi.
summary: Waya za kipimo cha shinikizo la breki na kipimo cha mafuta zilibadilishwa mahali wakati wa ukarabati wa swichi ya onyo la kuruka kwenye ndege ya B737-300, na kusababisha hitilafu iliyohitaji hatua ya MEL na ufuatiliaji zaidi.

entities.text: kipimo cha mafuta ya injini namba mbili

narrative_text: B737-300 ilirudi gate kabla ya shift change kwa sababu ya takeoff warning fault; ile switch ya test ilikuwa imefail. Ili ku-access vizuri, fundi alidisconnect cannon plug ya brake pressure indicator ya flight deck pamoja na ile ya No. 2 oil pressure gauge. Baada ya kubadilisha switch, ali-reconnect plugs lakini zinaonekana zili-swap, hivyo circuit breaker ya brake pressure indicator ika-trip; iko sasa kwenye MEL kwa muda. Crew wa overnight wa-confirm cannon plugs zimeconnect sahihi kabla ya kuclear MEL.
summary: Cannon plugs za brake pressure indicator na No. 2 oil pressure gauge zilibadilishwa (swapped) wakati wa kufanya repair ya takeoff warning switch kwenye B737-300, na hii ikasababisha circuit breaker kutrip na MEL kuwekwa, hivyo overnight crew wana-follow up.

entities.text: cannon plug ya brake pressure indicator

narrative_text: B737-700 lost its aft lower #2 VHF antenna in flight; FAA inspectors traced the install record to a tech whose employee number was on the tag, but he only prepped/cleaned the mount surface before shift change, and another mechanic completed the actual installation. Records do not clearly show who torqued the final fasteners or confirmed screw length per the mesh-gasket tip sheet, so the cause of separation remains unexplained. Next shift needs to pull the full install history and fastener torque sequence for this tail number, and confirm with the mechanic who took over the job at shift change.
summary: A B737-700 lost its VHF antenna in flight, and handover records are unclear on who completed the final installation steps, requiring further investigation into torque and fastener procedures.

entities.text: pull the full install history and fastener torque sequence

narrative_text: Ndege ya B737-700 ilipoteza antenna ya VHF (ya nyuma chini) ikiwa angani; wakaguzi wa FAA walifuatilia rekodi ya usakinishaji hadi kwa fundi ambaye namba yake ya kazi ilikuwa kwenye tagi, lakini alisema alifanya tu usafishaji na maandalizi ya sehemu ya kuunganisha kabla ya zamu kubadilika, na fundi mwingine ndiye aliyemaliza kazi ya kufunga antenna. Rekodi hazionyeshi wazi ni nani alifunga fasteners za mwisho kwa nguvu (torque) sahihi au kuthibitisha urefu wa screws kulingana na maelekezo ya gasket ya mesh, hivyo sababu halisi ya antenna kuanguka bado haijulikani. Zamu inayofuata inahitaji kupitia upya historia kamili ya usakinishaji na mfululizo wa torque ya fasteners kwa ndege hii, na kuwasiliana na fundi aliyemaliza kazi hiyo baada ya mabadiliko ya zamu.
summary: Ndege ya B737-700 ilipoteza antenna yake ya VHF angani, na rekodi za zamu hazionyeshi wazi ni nani alikamilisha usakinishaji, hivyo uchunguzi zaidi wa taratibu za torque na fasteners unahitajika.

entities.text: kupitia upya historia kamili ya usakinishaji

narrative_text: Ile B737-700 ilipoteza #2 VHF antenna ya aft lower ikiwa in flight; FAA inspectors walifuatilia install record hadi kwa fundi ambaye employee number yake ilikuwa kwenye tag, lakini alisema ni yeye alifanya tu prep na cleaning ya mount surface kabla ya shift change, halafu mechanic mwingine ndiye alicomplete installation. Records hazi-show clearly ni nani alitorque final fasteners au akaconfirm screw length kulingana na mesh-gasket tip sheet, so cause ya separation bado haiko clear. Next shift wanahitaji ku-pull full install history na torque sequence ya fasteners kwa hii tail number, na ku-confirm na yule mechanic aliyechukua job baada ya shift change.
summary: B737-700 ilipoteza VHF antenna ikiwa in flight, na handover records hazi-clarify vizuri ni nani alicomplete installation, so follow-up inahitajika kwa torque na fastener procedures.

entities.text: ku-pull full install history na torque sequence

narrative_text: Handover on the MD-80 fan blade blending job: at turnover on Friday, the only damage in work was limited to blade tip and acoustic liner areas. By the time the job was reassessed, the C-1 disk blades were found damaged well beyond manual limits, which does not match the condition recorded at turnover. Please verify the blending records and photos against the maintenance manual limits before continuing, since the engine repair is scheduled and this discrepancy needs to be resolved with the incoming shift.
summary: A shift-handover discrepancy on an MD-80 engine revealed C-1 disk blade damage exceeding manual limits, inconsistent with the lesser tip/liner damage noted at the original turnover.

narrative_text: Kuna suala la kufuatilia kuhusu kazi ya kusawazisha blade za injini ya ndege ya MD-80. Wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu Ijumaa, uharibifu uliokuwepo ulikuwa kwenye ncha ya blade na sehemu ya acoustic liner pekee. Baadaye ilipatikana kuwa blade za disk ya C-1 zimeharibika zaidi ya kiwango kinachoruhusiwa na mwongozo wa matengenezo, jambo ambalo halifanani na hali iliyoripotiwa awali. Zamu inayofuata inaombwa kupitia rekodi na picha za kazi hiyo ili kubaini chanzo cha tofauti hii kabla ya kuendelea na ukarabati.
summary: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa zamu, blade za disk C-1 za injini ya MD-80 zilikutwa zimeharibika zaidi ya kiwango kinachoruhusiwa, tofauti na hali iliyoripotiwa awali ya uharibifu mdogo.

narrative_text: Kwa hii MD-80 engine, kulikuwa na blade blending job ambayo tulipokea turnover Ijumaa, na wakati huo damage ilikuwa tu kwa blade tip na acoustic liner. Sasa tumeona kwamba C-1 disk blades zimeharibika beyond maintenance manual limits, jambo ambalo halimatch na hali ya turnover ya awali. Please the next shift wa-verify records na photos against manual limits kabla ya kuendelea na repair, coz kuna discrepancy inabidi ifuatiliwe.
summary: During inspection, C-1 disk blades za MD-80 zilipatikana na damage beyond manual limits, tofauti na hali ndogo iliyoripotiwa during original turnover.

narrative_text: Continuing repair of intercostal blanket FOD damage on the MD-80 fan blades; still need to deburr the rough edge left over from the previous repair. Photos and signoff are required at the end of each shift per the applicable chart/publication reference. Please ensure supervisor and crew chief review and formal turnover are completed before shift end.
summary: Lead technician is handing over unfinished MD-80 fan blade FOD repair and deburring work requiring photo documentation and supervisor/crew chief turnover review.

entities.text: repair of intercostal blanket FOD damage

narrative_text: Kazi ya kurekebisha uharibifu wa FOD kwenye blanketi ya intercostal ya fan blades za ndege ya MD-80 bado inaendelea, na sehemu iliyobaki ya ukingo mkali kutoka kwa ukarabati uliopita bado inahitaji kusawazishwa. Kila mwisho wa zamu, ni lazima kupigwa picha na kutiwa sahihi kulingana na chati husika. Tafadhali hakikisheni msimamizi na crew chief wamepitia kazi hii na kufanya turnover rasmi kabla ya zamu kuisha.
summary: Fundi anayeongoza anakabidhi kazi isiyokamilika ya ukarabati wa fan blades za MD-80 zilizoharibiwa na FOD, ikihitaji picha na ukaguzi wa msimamizi na crew chief.

narrative_text: Bado tunaendelea na repair ya intercostal blanket FOD damage kwa fan blades za MD-80, na ile rough edge ya repair ya mwanzo bado inahitaji kudeburr. Kila end of shift lazima uchukue photos na signoff kulingana na chart iliyotolewa. Hakikisha supervisor na crew chief wamefanya review na turnover kabla shift haijaisha, sawa?
summary: Lead tech anahand over kazi ya FOD repair kwenye MD-80 fan blades ambayo bado haijakamilika, ikihitaji photos na supervisor/crew chief turnover.

entities.text: repair ya intercostal blanket FOD damage

narrative_text: Handover: Rudder balancing job on the Gulfstream I in the other hangar was completed last night by the mechanic and a senior tech using an incomplete set of maintenance manual pages (Ref G-100, 51-60-00) — wording in the procedure was confusing though the figures/setup seemed to match. Paperwork was signed off before shift end without a thorough review; on closer read next day the procedure language remains ambiguous and was not followed to the letter. No immediate safety concern identified, but please flag to QA/Inspection for clarification of the balancing procedure and manual references before this is closed out.
summary: A rudder balancing task was signed off despite ambiguous manual references, and needs QA review to clarify the procedure.

narrative_text: Taarifa ya mabadilishano: Kazi ya kusawazisha rudder ya ndege ya Gulfstream I katika hangar nyingine ilikamilishwa jana usiku na fundi pamoja na fundi mwandamizi, wakitumia kurasa chache tu za kitabu cha matengenezo (Rejea G-100, 51-60-00) — maandishi ya utaratibu huo yalikuwa na utata ijapokuwa vipimo na mpangilio vilionekana sahihi. Karatasi za kazi zilisainiwa kabla ya mabadiliko ya shifti bila ukaguzi wa kina; baada ya kusoma tena kesho yake kwa umakini, utaratibu bado unaonekana kutokuwa wazi na haukufuatwa kikamilifu. Kwa sasa hakuna hatari ya haraka, lakini tafadhali suala hili lipelekwe kwa idara ya ukaguzi wa ubora (QA) ili kufafanua utaratibu wa kusawazisha na marejeo ya kitabu cha matengenezo kabla kazi kufungwa rasmi.
summary: Kazi ya kusawazisha rudder ilisainiwa licha ya utata katika marejeo ya kitabu cha matengenezo, na inahitaji ufafanuzi kutoka idara ya ubora.

narrative_text: Handover: Ile rudder balancing job ya Gulfstream I kwa hangar ingine ilikamilika jana usiku na mechanic pamoja na senior tech, lakini walikuwa na maintenance manual pages chache tu (Ref G-100, 51-60-00) — wording ya procedure ilikuwa confusing lakini figures na setup zilikuwa zinaonekana sahihi. Paperwork ilisainiwa before end ya shift bila review ya kutosha; nikisoma tena keshoye kwa makini nikaona procedure bado ni ambiguous na haikufuatwa to the letter. Hakuna immediate safety concern kwa sasa, lakini please flag hii kwa QA/Inspection ili tuclarify balancing procedure na manual references kabla ya kuclose out job hii.
summary: Rudder balancing job ilisainiwa ingawa manual references zilikuwa ambiguous, hivyo inahitaji QA review kwa clarification.

narrative_text: B737 crew reported the L #2 engine circuit breaker popped again; found system already on MEL from previous station with no maintenance procedure listed on the MEL page. Reset the breaker and signed off per prior deferral, but crew questioned what to do if it pops again, so ignition box/lead replacement was discussed with tech services before shift change. Next shift lead agreed to leave the breaker pulled and system on MEL rather than perform further troubleshooting under time pressure; please confirm with tech services on final disposition before next flight.
summary: L #2 engine circuit breaker on a B737 popped again after being reset and deferred per MEL, and the decision was made to leave it pulled on MEL pending further review by tech services.

narrative_text: Wafanyakazi wa ndege ya B737 waliripoti circuit breaker ya engine ya kushoto namba mbili imepopa tena, na tulipoangalia MEL tuligundua mfumo huo ulikuwa tayari umewekwa kwenye MEL kutoka station iliyopita bila utaratibu wowote wa matengenezo. Tulirudisha breaker na kusaini logbook kama ilivyokuwa imependekezwa awali, lakini crew waliuliza itakuwaje ikiwa breaker itapopa tena, hivyo tukashauriana na tech services kuhusu kubadilisha ignition box kabla ya mabadiliko ya shift.
