Shift lead aliyekuja baadaye alikubali tuiache breaker imetolewa na mfumo ubaki kwenye MEL badala ya kufanya ukaguzi zaidi kwa haraka; tafadhali fuatilia na tech services kabla ya safari inayofuata.
summary: Circuit breaker ya engine ya kushoto namba mbili kwenye B737 ilipopa tena baada ya kurudishwa na kuwekwa kwenye MEL, na uamuzi ulifanywa kuiacha ikiwa imetolewa hadi tech services watoe uongozi zaidi.

entities.text: circuit breaker ya engine ya kushoto namba mbili

narrative_text: Crew wa B737 waliripoti ile L #2 engine circuit breaker imepop tena; tukacheki MEL page tukaona system iko already on MEL kutoka previous station, but hakuna maintenance procedure iliyowekwa. Tuka-reset breaker na kusign logbook as previously deferred, lakini crew wakauliza 'what if inapop again?' hivyo tukacall tech services kudiscuss kubadilisha ignition box/lead before turnover. Next shift lead akaamua tu-leave breaker pulled na system ibaki on MEL badala ya kuendelea na troubleshooting kwa haraka, so please follow up na tech services kabla ya next flight.
summary: L #2 engine circuit breaker ya B737 ilipop tena baada ya kuwa reset na kudeferred kwenye MEL, na wakaamua kui-leave pulled hadi tech services watoe final call.

narrative_text: Taking over the #1 engine fan assembly reinstall on the B757 from previous shift, we found the fan blades and annulus fillers were incorrectly marked/tagged during removal, making correct reassembly very difficult. Turnover paperwork was inadequate and the outgoing mechanic acknowledged the mistagging before leaving. Foreman, lead mech and powerplant engineer were briefed and instructed us to proceed using best judgment to restore correct blade/filler sequencing; recommend a full verification check on next shift before engine run.
summary: Poor shift turnover left fan blades/fillers mismarked on a B757 #1 engine, requiring the incoming crew to reconstruct correct sequencing and flagging the issue to supervision.

narrative_text: Tulipokea kazi ya kuunganisha tena fan assembly ya engine namba 1 kwenye ndege ya B757 kutoka shift iliyotangulia, na tukagundua blade na fillers za annulus zilikuwa zimewekewa alama vibaya wakati wa kuziondoa. Turnover ya makaratasi ilikuwa mbovu sana, na fundi aliyehusika alikubali kuwa kulikuwa na makosa kabla ya kuondoka. Tulishauriana na foreman, lead mech, na powerplant engineer, wakatuambia tufanye tuwezavyo kurekebisha mpangilio sahihi wa blade na fillers; inashauriwa ifanyike ukaguzi kamili shift inayofuata kabla ya kuwasha engine.
summary: Turnover mbaya iliacha blade na fillers za engine namba 1 kwenye B757 zikiwa na alama zisizo sahihi, hivyo wafanyakazi wa shift mpya walilazimika kurekebisha mpangilio na kuripoti tatizo kwa wasimamizi.

narrative_text: Tuli-take over ile job ya kurudisha #1 engine fan assembly pamoja on the B757 kutoka previous shift, na tukakuta fan blades na annulus fillers zime-markiwa vibaya during removal. Turnover paperwork ilikuwa mbaya sana, na yule mechanic aliekuwa amefanya job alikubali mwenyewe ati kuna screw-up before ku-punch out. Tuli-confirm na foreman, lead mech na powerplant engineer, wakatuambia 'do your best' kufanya correct reinstall ya blades na fillers; kesho next shift wafanye verification check kabla ya engine run.
summary: Turnover mbaya iliacha fan blades na fillers za #1 engine kwenye B757 zime-mismarked, hivyo crew ya sasa walilazimika ku-figure out correct sequencing wenyewe.

narrative_text: B737-300 left over from hangar overnight routine had a fuselage crack repair on the left side; outgoing shift said the package was complete except for the crack repair and aft cargo sidewall panels removed for access. After the repair we closed up the cargo bin and signed off our shift paperwork including engine cowling closure and leak checks, but we were not told there was a second cover sheet with a duplicate 'A' check containing additional blanks for the same cowling closure and leak check items. Next shift needs to verify the 'A' check package for any unsigned blocks before further release, and this should go through a coordinator review given the size of the package.
summary: A duplicate 'A' check cover sheet on a B737-300 structural repair package went unnoticed at shift turnover, leaving some paperwork blocks unsigned despite the physical work being complete.

entities.text: engine cowling closure and leak checks

narrative_text: Ndege ya B737-300 iliyoachwa na zamu ya usiku ya hangar ilikuwa na ukarabati wa ufa kwenye fuselage upande wa kushoto; zamu iliyoondoka ilituambia kazi ilikuwa imekamilika isipokuwa ukarabati wa ufa huo na paneli za ukuta wa cargo ya nyuma zilizotolewa kupata sehemu ya ukarabati. Baada ya ukarabati kukamilika, tulifunga mlango wa cargo na kusaini nyaraka zote za zamu yetu ikiwemo ukaguzi wa uvujaji wa injini na kufunga cowling, lakini hatukuarifiwa kuhusu jarida la pili la ukaguzi lenye 'A' check ya ziada yenye visanduku vingine vya kazi zilezile. Zamu inayofuata inahitajika kupitia upya kifurushi chote cha nyaraka za 'A' check kuhakikisha hakuna kisanduku kilichoachwa bila saini, na kwa kazi kubwa namna hii, ukaguzi wa mratibu unapaswa kufanyika kabla ndege haijaruhusiwa kuondoka.
summary: Jarida la pili la ukaguzi lenye 'A' check ya nakala mbili kwenye ndege ya B737-300 halikutambuliwa wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu, hivyo baadhi ya visanduku vya nyaraka kubaki bila saini ingawa kazi halisi ilikuwa imekamilika.

entities.text: paneli za ukuta wa cargo ya nyuma
ukaguzi wa uvujaji wa injini na kufunga cowling

narrative_text: Hii B737-300 ilikuwa leftover kutoka hangar overnight routine, ilikuwa na crack repair kwa left side ya fuselage; zamu iliyotoka waliniambia package ilikuwa complete isipokuwa hiyo crack repair na aft cargo sidewall panels ambazo zilitolewa kupata access ya kufanya repair. Baada ya repair kukamilika tulifunga cargo bin na kusign off paperwork yote ya shift yetu including engine cowling closure na leak checks, lakini hatukujua kama kulikuwa na second cover sheet na duplicate 'A' check yenye additional blocks za hizo hizo cowling closure na leak checks. Next shift wanafaa wapitie 'A' check package vizuri kuhakikisha hakuna block imebaki open, na kwa package kubwa namna hii coordinator anafaa a-review kabla ndege ha-release.
summary: Duplicate 'A' check cover sheet kwa B737-300 structural repair package haikutambuliwa wakati wa shift turnover, hivyo baadhi ya paperwork blocks zikabaki unsigned ingawa kazi halisi ilikuwa complete.

entities.text: engine cowling closure na leak checks

narrative_text: Handover: #2 engine nose cowl R&R (WO ref, MM 71-11-00) was not completed by end of shift — only 6 bolts fitted, remaining bolts finger-tight only, no torque or hookups done. Supervisor was informed of the exact stopping point but the logbook was short-signed against 71-11-00-4 step 3C(4), which reads as if the cowl is fully installed. Next shift must verify actual cowl status before further work/dispatch, as the paperwork does not reflect true state of installation.
summary: Nose cowl installation on #2 engine was left incomplete with only finger-tight bolts, but logbook entry incorrectly implies full installation per MM step 3C(4).

narrative_text: Taarifa ya mabadiliko ya zamu: Kazi ya kuondoa na kurudisha nose cowl ya engine namba 2 haikukamilika mwishoni mwa zamu — bolt sita tu ndizo zilizowekwa, na zilizobaki ziliwekwa kwa vidole tu bila torque wala kuunganisha mifumo mingine. Supervisor alijulishwa hatua halisi tulipoishia, lakini logbook iliandikwa kana kwamba kazi imekamilika kulingana na hatua 3C(4) ya MM 71-11-00, jambo ambalo si kweli. Zamu inayofuata inapaswa kuthibitisha hali halisi ya cowl kabla ya kazi yoyote zaidi au ndege kuruhusiwa kuruka, kwani hati za kazi hazionyeshi hali halisi ya usakinishaji.
summary: Usakinishaji wa nose cowl ya engine namba 2 haukukamilika lakini logbook ilionyesha kama kazi imekamilika, hivyo kuhitaji uhakiki wa haraka.

narrative_text: Handover: Ile nose cowl ya engine #2, ile R&R job ya MM 71-11-00, haikukamilika by end of shift — tulisecure na bolts sita tu, zingine ziko finger-tight tu, hakuna torque wala hookups zilizofanywa. Tulimwambia supervisor exact point tuliyoishia, lakini logbook ikaandikwa short-signed against step 3C(4), inaonyesha kama cowl imeinstall kabisa, ambayo si kweli. Next shift wanafaa ku-verify actual status ya cowl kabla ya kuendelea na kazi au dispatch, coz paperwork haionyeshi hali halisi.
summary: Nose cowl installation ya engine #2 iliachwa incomplete na bolts finger-tight tu, lakini logbook inasomeka kama kazi imekamilika kulingana na step 3C(4).

narrative_text: CRJ700 came off the gate with a #1 engine hydraulic leak reported by gate mechs as the thrust reverser actuator; I logged it on the daily turnover with the RII box marked '?' since the source was unconfirmed. Inspection found the manual drive unit leaking instead, and it was robbed from another aircraft to return this one to service. Note that the manual drive unit is on the RII list — this was missed during turnover due to lateness, so please verify RII sign-off was completed before further dispatch.
summary: A CRJ700's #1 engine hydraulic leak was traced to the manual drive unit, which was replaced from another aircraft without confirming required RII inspection sign-off.

narrative_text: Ndege ya CRJ700 ilitoka geti ikiwa na tatizo la uvujaji wa hydraulic kwenye injini namba moja, ambapo mafundi wa geti walidai chanzo ni thrust reverser actuator. Niliandika taarifa hiyo kwenye kitabu cha mabadiliko ya zamu nikaweka alama ya kuuliza kwenye sehemu ya RII kwa sababu chanzo halikuwa dhahiri. Baada ya ukaguzi ilibainika kuwa manual drive unit ndiyo iliyokuwa ikivuja, na sehemu hiyo ilitolewa kutoka ndege nyingine bila kutambua kuwa manual drive unit iko kwenye orodha ya RII; hivyo inahitajika ufuatiliaji wa haraka kuhakikisha ukaguzi huo umefanyika kabla ya ndege kutumika tena.
summary: Ndege ya CRJ700 ilikuwa na uvujaji wa hydraulic uliobainika kutoka kwa manual drive unit, ambayo ilibadilishwa bila kuthibitisha ukaguzi wa lazima wa RII.

entities.text: uvujaji wa hydraulic kwenye injini namba moja

narrative_text: Ile CRJ700 ilitoka gate na discrepancy ya #1 engine hyd leak, gate mechs walisema ni thrust reverser actuator ndio inaleak. Niliandika kwa turnover book na nikaweka '?' kwa RII box kwa sababu haikuwa clear kama ni actuator kweli. Baada ya inspection wakagundua ni manual drive unit ndio ilikuwa inaleak, tukaitoa kwa ile ndege nyingine tukarudisha hii kwa service, lakini hatukurealize manual drive unit iko kwa RII list. Please someone acheck kama RII sign-off ilifanywa kabla ya kuipush tena for dispatch.
summary: CRJ700 ilikuwa na hydraulic leak iliyotokana na manual drive unit, part ambayo ilitolewa kwa aircraft nyingine bila kuconfirm RII requirement.

narrative_text: CRJ200 had a roll issue traced to flight controls; a Bombardier rep and two company mechs worked the aileron and flap rigging through the shift. I repeatedly told the mechs to generate work cards so the disturbed flight control items could be flagged for RII, but by end of shift the cards for the flaps and aileron were still not written up. I logged a turnover note and verbally briefed the incoming inspector that RII is still required on the flaps and aileron before further flight. Next shift must confirm work cards are generated and RII completed before the aircraft is released for test flight.
summary: Outgoing inspector flags that RII documentation for CRJ200 flap and aileron work was not completed and must be verified before flight.

narrative_text: Ndege ya CRJ200 ilikuwa na tatizo la kuyumba (roll) lililohusiana na flight controls; mwakilishi wa Bombardier pamoja na mafundi wawili wa kampuni walikuwa wakifanyia kazi aileron na flap wakati wa shift. Niliwaeleza mafundi mara kadhaa watengeneze work cards ili vipengele vilivyofunguliwa viweze kuwekwa alama ya RII, lakini mpaka shift yangu ikiisha work cards za flaps na aileron hazikuwa zimeandaliwa. Nimeandika turnover note na pia nimemweleza kwa mdomo inspector wa shift inayokuja kuwa RII bado inahitajika kwenye flaps na aileron kabla ndege kuruhusiwa kuruka. Shift inayokuja lazima ihakikishe work cards zimeandaliwa na RII imekamilika kabla ya test flight.
summary: Inspector aliyeondoka anaonya kuwa nyaraka za RII kwa kazi ya flaps na aileron ya CRJ200 hazijakamilika na zinahitaji kuthibitishwa kabla ya safari ya ndege.

narrative_text: Hii CRJ200 ilikuwa na roll issue, ikaishia kwa flight controls; Bombardier rep na mechs wawili wa company walikuwa wanafanya kazi kwenye aileron na flaps kwa shift yote. Nikawaambia mechs several times waandike work cards ndio nizi-flag for RII, lakini mpaka shift yangu inaisha, hizo cards za flaps na aileron hazikuwa zimegenerate. Nimeandika turnover note kwa log na pia nikamwambia verbally inspector wa next shift kwamba RII bado inahitajika kwa flaps na aileron kabla ya kuendelea na test flight. Shift inayokuja wahakikishe work cards zimegenerate na RII imecompletiwa kabla plane iende for flight.
summary: Outgoing inspector anaflag kwamba RII documentation ya CRJ200 flaps na aileron work bado haijakamilika, inahitaji verification kabla ya flight.

narrative_text: On B757, the APU hour meter was replaced last shift, but the placard/MEL was not cleared because the ops check was never done and no INOP sticker was left on the new meter. I signed Block 7 of the ETOPS #1 check assuming the placard had been cleared and recorded the meter reading instead of estimating hours per Block 7B. Next shift, please verify the log for any open APU hour meter placard before signing Block 7, since the work card does not explicitly direct this check. Ops check and paperwork to remove the placard were completed on the return flight, but better turnover reporting is needed going forward.
summary: Miscommunication over an uncleared APU hour meter placard led to an incorrect ETOPS #1 check sign-off, since prior shift left no INOP sticker or turnover note.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya B757, APU hour meter ilibadilishwa shift iliyopita, lakini placard/MEL haikuondolewa kwa sababu ops check haikufanywa na hakuna INOP sticker iliyowekwa kwenye meter mpya. Nilisaini Block 7 ya ETOPS #1 check nikidhani placard ilishaondolewa, na nikaandika reading ya meter badala ya kukadiria masaa kama inavyotakiwa. Shift inayofuata, tafadhali angalia logbook kuhusu placard yoyote ya APU hour meter kabla ya kusaini Block 7, kwa kuwa work card haisemi wazi kufanya hivyo. Ops check na makaratasi ya kuondoa placard yalikamilishwa wakati wa safari ya kurudi, lakini kunahitajika taarifa bora za turnover kati ya zamu.
summary: Kutokuwepo kwa mawasiliano sahihi kuhusu placard ya APU hour meter kulisababisha sahihi isiyo sahihi kwenye ETOPS #1 check, kwani zamu iliyotangulia haikuacha alama ya INOP wala taarifa ya turnover.

narrative_text: Kwa hii B757, APU hour meter ilibadilishwa last shift, lakini placard/MEL haikuwa cleared kwa sababu ops check haikufanywa na hakuna INOP sticker iliyowekwa kwenye meter mpya. Nikasign Block 7 ya ETOPS #1 check nikifikiria placard ilikuwa imeshakua cleared, so nikarecord reading ya meter tu badala ya ku-estimate hours kama Block 7B inavyotaka. Next shift, please check logbook kama kuna open placard ya APU hour meter kabla ya kusign Block 7, coz work card haiseme wazi ku-review hiyo. Ops check na paperwork ya kuremove placard ziliisha kufanyika on return flight, lakini tunahitaji turnover reporting bora kati ya shifts.
summary: Kulikua na communication breakdown kuhusu APU hour meter placard, ikapelekea sign-off isiyo sahihi kwenye ETOPS #1 check kwa sababu ya poor turnover kutoka previous shift.

narrative_text: B737-300 arrived with crew report of intermittent flickering DC FAIL light, initially relayed to me as #2 IRU during troubleshooting at the gate; no fault could be duplicated, so both the IRU and integrated flight accessory unit were replaced per the maintenance manual and CAT III recertification was completed satisfactorily. Logbook entry was closed against #2 IRU, but the duty line maintenance supervisor flagged before shift change that the original captain's discrepancy write-up actually named #1 IRU, not #2. I have re-contacted the mechanic who debriefed the crew to confirm which unit was actually reported faulty; incoming shift needs to verify the logbook entry matches the correct IRU and re-check paperwork/wiring diagram reference before final close-out.
summary: A logbook discrepancy over which IRU (#1 vs #2) was actually reported faulty on a B737-300 needs verification and correction before the write-up can be considered fully closed.

narrative_text: Ndege ya B737-300 ilifika na taarifa kutoka kwa wafanyakazi wa ndege kuhusu taa ya DC FAIL iliyokuwa ikimulika mara kwa mara, na wakati wa ukaguzi kwenye geti tatizo lilielezwa kwangu kama la IRU namba mbili; hatukuweza kuthibitisha hitilafu hiyo tena, hivyo tulibadilisha IRU pamoja na kitengo cha integrated flight accessory unit kulingana na maelekezo ya matengenezo, na urekebishaji wa CAT III ulikamilika vizuri. Taarifa katika logbook iliandikwa ikitaja IRU namba mbili, lakini msimamizi wa matengenezo wa zamu aliniarifu kabla ya mabadiliko ya zamu kuwa taarifa ya awali ya kapteni ilitaja IRU namba moja. Nimewasiliana tena na fundi aliyezungumza na wafanyakazi wa ndege ili kuthibitisha IRU sahihi; zamu inayoingia inahitaji kuhakiki na kusahihisha taarifa hiyo kwenye logbook kabla ya kufunga suala hili kikamilifu.
summary: Kuna mkanganyiko kuhusu ni IRU gani (namba moja au mbili) iliyoripotiwa kuwa na hitilafu kwenye ndege ya B737-300, na jambo hili linahitaji kuthibitishwa na kusahihishwa kwenye logbook.

narrative_text: Tuli-receive B737-300 na crew wame-report DC FAIL light iko flickering intermittent; wakati wa troubleshooting kwa gate, niliambiwa ni #2 IRU. Hatukuweza ku-duplicate fault yoyote, so tuli-remove and replace IRU pamoja na integrated flight accessory unit kama maintenance manual inavyoeleza, tukafanya CAT III recertification na ikapass sawa. Nilikuwa nime-enter logbook entry kwa #2 IRU, lakini duty supervisor ame-flag kabla ya shift change kwamba discrepancy ya captain original iliandikwa #1 IRU, si #2. Nime-contact tena mechanic aliyeongea na crew ku-confirm which unit hasa ilikuwa faulty; shift inayoingia inahitaji ku-verify logbook entry na ku-correct kabla ya close-out ya mwisho.
summary: Kuna mix-up kuhusu IRU gani (#1 au #2) ilikuwa faulty kwenye B737-300, hivyo logbook entry inahitaji ku-verified na ku-corrected na incoming shift.

narrative_text: B737-800 arrived at the gate and ramp reported a dent on the left horizontal stabilizer leading edge, about 6 ft outboard of the fuselage. The mechanic assigned to inspect it got pulled to another aircraft before the dent measurement and SRM evaluation were finished, and a second mechanic only completed the clean-up of the area, not the inspection. Next shift please confirm the SRM damage assessment and measurement have actually been completed and signed off before further dispatch, as this was not verbally handed over properly.
summary: Incomplete SRM inspection of a left horizontal stabilizer dent was mistakenly assumed complete due to poor handover between reassigned mechanics.

narrative_text: Ndege ya B737-800 ilifika geti na wafanyakazi wa ramp waliripoti bonge (dent) kwenye ukingo wa mbele wa horizontal stabilizer ya kushoto, karibu futi 6 kutoka fuselage. Fundi aliyekuwa akifanya ukaguzi alihamishiwa ndege nyingine kabla ya kupima na kuthibitisha uharibifu kulingana na SRM, na fundi wa pili aliyeteuliwa alifanya tu usafi wa eneo hilo bila kukamilisha ukaguzi. Shift inayokuja tafadhali thibitisha kama tathmini ya SRM na vipimo vimekamilika na kusainiwa kabla ya kuruhusu ndege kuendelea na safari, kwani kulikuwa na upungufu wa mawasiliano na makabidhiano ya kazi.
summary: Ukaguzi wa SRM kwa bonge kwenye horizontal stabilizer ya kushoto haukukamilika kutokana na mawasiliano hafifu wakati wa mabadiliko ya fundi.

narrative_text: Hii B737-800 ilarrive gate, ramp wakareport dent kwa left horizontal stabilizer leading edge, kama 6 ft outboard from fuselage. Mechanic aliyekuwa anahandle inspection alireassign kwa aircraft nyingine before hii dent measurement na SRM evaluation kukompletishwa, then mechanic wa pili akaassignwa tu ku-clean up eneo, si kukamilisha inspection. Next shift please mconfirm kama SRM assessment na measurement zimekompletishwa na kusignwa before dispatch, coz turnover ya verbal haikuwa proper hapo.
summary: SRM inspection ya dent kwa left horizontal stabilizer haikukompletishwa juu ya poor verbal handover kati ya mechanics waliobadilishwa.

narrative_text: ATR 72 at ZZZZ1 still has an unresolved propeller control fault; the replacement part was not on site so we reinstalled the previously removed hardware and ran an engine run-up for troubleshooting, but the fault persisted. During reassembly a safety wire was used in place of a cotter pin due to unavailability of stock, and this was not logged since the PVM was due to be replaced. Maintenance control has been briefed verbally and is sending the correct part with the relieving crew; incoming techs must confirm part installation, verify the cotter pin substitution, and complete the logbook entry.
summary: ATR 72 propeller control fault remains unresolved at ZZZZ1, with a temporary safety-wire fix undocumented and correct part/logbook follow-up required from the next crew.

narrative_text: Ndege ya ATR 72 iliyoko ZZZZ1 bado ina hitilafu ya propeller control ambayo haijatatuliwa; sehemu mpya haikuwepo kwenye stoo kwa hivyo tulirudisha vipuri vilivyokuwa vimeondolewa na kufanya engine run-up kwa ajili ya uchunguzi, lakini tatizo liliendelea kuwepo. Wakati wa kuunganisha tena, tulitumia safety wire badala ya cotter pin kwa sababu haikuwepo, na jambo hili halikuandikwa kwenye logbook kwa kuwa PVM alikuwa anatarajiwa kubadilishwa. Maintenance control walipewa taarifa kwa mdomo na watatuma sehemu husika pamoja na wafanyakazi watakaotuchukua nafasi; timu inayofuata inapaswa kuhakikisha sehemu imewekwa vizuri, kuangalia matumizi ya safety wire badala ya cotter pin, na kukamilisha logbook entry.
summary: Ndege ya ATR 72 huko ZZZZ1 bado ina hitilafu ya propeller control ambayo haijatatuliwa, na urekebishaji wa muda kwa safety wire haujaandikwa, hivyo timu inayofuata inahitajika kufuatilia.

narrative_text: Kwa ATR 72 iko ZZZZ1, propeller control bado ina issue, haijafix. Part haikuwa available site, so tuka-reinstall zile parts za wale wa awali tukafanya engine run-up ya troubleshooting, lakini problem imebaki vilevile. Tulitumia safety wire badala ya cotter pin coz hatukuwa na stock, na hii haiku-documented kwa sababu PVM ilikuwa inaenda kubadilishwa. Maintenance control walijulishwa verbally na wanasend part sahihi na crew itakayo-relieve sisi; wale wanaokuja lazima wa-confirm installation, wacheck hiyo safety wire substitution, na wa-complete logbook entry.
summary: ATR 72 iko na propeller control fault ambayo bado haiju-resolve, na kuna temporary fix ya safety wire ambayo haiku-log, so next crew wana-follow up.

narrative_text: ERJ-145 has an inop FO's side pitch trim switch; no spare switch was available in stock or in the system, so we attempted to cannibalize one from an aircraft in the hangar. AMM pre-mod pages call for unsoldering wires, but avionics tech later advised that a new pitch trim switch with harness (new part number) is now in use, so soldering may not apply. Next shift needs to verify correct part number in the IPC/engineering notes before proceeding with removal or installation.
summary: FO's side pitch trim switch inop on ERJ-145; part number/procedure discrepancy found during cannibalization attempt needs verification before further work.

entities.text: verify correct part number in the IPC/engineering notes

narrative_text: Ndege ya ERJ-145 ina hitilafu kwenye swichi ya pitch trim upande wa FO, na hakuna swichi ya akiba stoo wala kwenye mfumo. Tulijaribu kuchukua moja kutoka kwa ndege iliyopo hangarini, lakini baada ya kuangalia AMM, kulikuwa na mkanganyiko kuhusu utaratibu sahihi wa kuondoa waya. Fundi wa avionics alieleza kuwa sasa kuna swichi mpya yenye namba tofauti ya sehemu, hivyo zamu inayofuata inahitaji kuthibitisha taarifa hii kwenye IPC kabla ya kuendelea na kazi.
summary: Swichi ya pitch trim upande wa FO kwenye ERJ-145 imeharibika, na kuna haja ya kuthibitisha namba sahihi ya sehemu kabla ya kuendelea na ukarabati.

narrative_text: Tuna issue na FO's side pitch trim switch kwa ERJ-145, ni inop na hakuna spare stock wala kwenye system. Tulijaribu ku-cannibalize switch kutoka aircraft iko hangarini, lakini according to AMM pre-mod pages ilikuwa unsolder wires, halafu avionics tech akasema kuna new pitch trim switch na harness, part number tofauti kabisa. Next shift wanahitaji ku-verify part number kwenye IPC/engineering notes kabla ya kuendelea na installation.
summary: FO's side pitch trim switch iko inop kwa ERJ-145, next shift wanahitaji ku-confirm correct part number kabla ya kuproceed na repair.

entities.text: verify part number kwenye IPC/engineering notes

narrative_text: A321 engine was opened for VBV inspection following an overtemp condition; metal was found in the tailpipe screen and job was escalated to an engine change. Engine change work was in progress up to lunchtime when we were told to hold off so a borescope could be done first; borescope came back clean, so the engine change was cancelled. Job card and associated forms were stamped/closed up to the point work stopped, and a verbal turnover was given to the next shift lead. Next shift should verify all paperwork reflects the cancelled engine change status and confirm no open items remain before further troubleshooting on the EGT/FADEC harness issue reported by the flight crew.
summary: Engine change on an A321 was started after metal was found during a VBV inspection but was cancelled following a clean borescope, and work was handed over verbally with paperwork closed at the stopping point.

narrative_text: Injini ya ndege ya A321 ilifunguliwa kwa ukaguzi wa VBV baada ya tatizo la joto kupita kiasi, na wakati wa kuandaa taratibu, chuma kilionekana kwenye skrini ya tailpipe. Hali hiyo ilisababisha uamuzi wa kubadilisha injini kabisa, na kazi hiyo ilikuwa ikiendelea hadi saa za mchana ambapo tuliagizwa kusitisha ili ufanyike ukaguzi wa borescope. Matokeo ya borescope hayakuonyesha hitilafu yoyote, hivyo mpango wa kubadilisha injini ulisitishwa, na tulikamilisha fomu na kadi za kazi kulingana na hatua tuliyofikia kabla ya kukabidhi taarifa kwa msimamizi wa zamu inayofuata. Zamu inayofuata inahitajika kuthibitisha nyaraka zote na kufuatilia zaidi tatizo la waya wa FADEC lililoripotiwa na rubani.
summary: Ukaguzi wa VBV kwenye injini ya A321 ulifichua chuma kwenye tailpipe na kusababisha mpango wa kubadilisha injini, lakini mpango huo ulisitishwa baada ya matokeo mazuri ya borescope, na kazi ikakabidhiwa kwa zamu inayofuata.

narrative_text: Tuli-open engine ya A321 kwa VBV inspection baada ya overtemp condition, halafu tukapata metal kwenye tailpipe screen, so ikaamuliwa hii ni engine change. Tuliendelea na engine change mpaka lunchtime, ndipo wakatuambia tu-hold kwanza kwa sababu wanataka kufanya borescope. Borescope ilikuja clean, hakuna defects, so engine change iki-cancel. Tulifunga job card na forms kulingana na point tuliyofika, tukaipatia verbal turnover kwa next shift lead, so wao wafuatilie paperwork na hii issue ya FADEC harness ambayo pilot alireport.
summary: VBV inspection kwenye A321 ilifichua metal kwenye tailpipe screen ikasababisha engine change kuanzishwa, lakini ikafutwa baada ya borescope clean, na kazi ikakabidhiwa kwa next shift.

narrative_text: On the B737, we replaced both the 90-degree and 120-degree flap gearboxes and completed the full flap gear lube per logbook and non-routine items, but ran out of time to check gearbox operation before shift end. Hydraulics were kept off most of the shift to support heavy engine work on both engines, which was leak-checked afterward. Verbal turnover was given to the incoming crew; Saturday shift lead should confirm flap gearbox operational check is completed before further dispatch.
summary: Flap gearbox replacement on B737 was completed but not operationally checked at shift end due to time pressure from concurrent engine work, requiring follow-up by incoming crew.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya B737, tulibadilisha gearbox za flap za digrii 90 na 120 na kukamilisha lube kamili ya gear kama ilivyoandikwa kwenye logbook, lakini muda haukutosha kufanya ukaguzi wa uendeshaji wa gearbox kabla ya shift kuisha. Hydraulics zilibaki zimezimwa kwa muda mwingi wa shift kwa sababu ya kazi kubwa za engines zote mbili, ambazo baadaye zilikaguliwa kwa uvujaji. Turnover ya mdomo ilitolewa kwa wafanyakazi wa shift inayofuata; shift ya Jumamosi inafaa kuthibitisha kuwa ukaguzi wa uendeshaji wa gearbox ya flap umekamilika kabla ya kuruhusu ndege kuendelea.
summary: Ubadilishaji wa gearbox za flap kwenye B737 ulikamilika lakini ukaguzi wa uendeshaji haukufanyika kabla ya shift kuisha kwa sababu ya shughuli nyingi za wakati mmoja, hivyo unahitaji ufuatiliaji na shift inayofuata.

entities.text: gearbox za flap za digrii 90 na 120

narrative_text: Kwa hii B737, tumereplace zile flap gearboxes mbili, 90 degree na 120 degree, na tume-complete full gear lube kama logbook item na non-routine items zilivyokuwa. Lakini time ilituwahi, hatujafanya operational check ya gearboxes maana hydraulics zilikuwa off most of the shift kwa ajili ya heavy engine jobs kwenye both engines, ambazo tulizileak check baadaye. Nimefanya verbal turnover kwa incoming crew; shift ya Saturday wanapaswa kuconfirm gearbox operational check imekamilika before dispatch.
summary: Flap gearboxes za B737 zimereplace lakini operational check haijafanywa by shift end kwa sababu ya time pressure, so incoming crew wanapaswa kufollow up.

entities.text: flap gearboxes mbili, 90 degree na 120 degree

narrative_text: Completed the #1 engine lube and scavenge pump replacement on the B757-200 per AMM; old pump was removed and new unit installed, then high-power oil pressure run performed with no leaks observed by the lead AMT. Two days later the #5 bearing scavenge line nut backed off, causing oil loss and an in-flight shutdown; investigation found the line had not been safety wired. Since we did not disconnect that line during the job, we were unaware it required safety wire, and the AMM does not call it out. Recommend flagging the AMM for revision to add a safety-wire step on the #5 bearing scavenge line nut before further pump replacements.
summary: Missing safety-wire step in AMM for #1 engine scavenge pump replacement led to a loose fitting and subsequent in-flight shutdown.

narrative_text: Tulimaliza kubadilisha pump ya #1 engine lube na scavenge kwenye B757-200 kulingana na AMM; pump ya zamani iliondolewa na mpya ikafungwa, kisha ukafanywa mtihani wa oil pressure kwa high power run na lead AMT akakagua bila kupata uvujaji wowote. Baada ya siku mbili, nati ya line ya scavenge ya bearing namba 5 ililegea na kusababisha upotevu wa mafuta ya engine na engine kuzimika hewani. Uchunguzi ulionyesha kuwa line hiyo haikuwa imefungwa na safety wire, jambo ambalo hatukujua kwa sababu hatukuiondoa wakati wa kazi na AMM haikutaja hilo. Inashauriwa AMM irekebishwe kuongeza hatua ya kufunga safety wire kwenye nati hiyo ili kuzuia tukio kama hili tena.
summary: Kukosekana kwa hatua ya safety wire kwenye AMM kulisababisha nati kulegea na engine kuzimika hewani baada ya kubadilisha pump ya #1 engine.

entities.text: pump ya #1 engine lube na scavenge
line ya scavenge ya bearing namba 5

narrative_text: Tulichukua turnover ya #1 engine lube na scavenge pump replacement kwa B757-200, old pump ilikuwa disconnected tayari so tuli-remove na kufunga new pump kama AMM inavyosema. Tuli-perform oil pressure test na high power engine run, lead AMT aka-inspect for leaks, hakuna leaks zilizopatikana. Siku mbili baadaye nut ya #5 bearing scavenge line ika-loosen, oil ika-loss na engine ika-shutdown mid-flight; investigation imeonyesha line haikuwa safety wired na sisi hatukujua kwa sababu hatukuwa tume-remove hiyo line wakati wa job. Tafadhali flag hii AMM step kwa revision, wai-add safety wire requirement kwa hiyo #5 bearing scavenge nut kabla ya next pump job.
summary: AMM haikuwa na step ya safety wire kwa #5 bearing scavenge line, na hiyo ndio iliyosababisha nut kulegea na engine kuzimika mid-flight baada ya pump replacement.

narrative_text: Handover from midnight shift on the B757-200 left engine lube pump change: verbal turnover confirmed only the oil tank and gearbox drain plugs were safetied, but the #5 bearing scavenge tube B-nut safety holes were missed during reinstallation and left un-safetied. Pump was replaced, oil tank serviced, leak and operational checks completed with no issues noted, and logbook was signed off before return to gate. Next shift must verify safety wire on the #5 bearing scavenge tube B-nut given the missed step, especially since the aircraft later had an in-flight shutdown of the left engine after oil pressure loss.
summary: A missed safety wire on the #5 bearing scavenge tube B-nut during a B757-200 left engine lube pump change led to an in-flight engine shutdown, and follow-up verification is required.

narrative_text: Wakati wa mkabidhi kutoka zamu ya usiku kuhusu kubadilishwa kwa pump ya lube kwenye engine ya kushoto ya B757-200, ilielezwa kuwa safety wire ziliwekwa tu kwenye oil tank na gearbox drain plugs. Hata hivyo, wakati wa kufunga tena #5 bearing scavenge tube B-nut, matundu ya safety wire hayakuonekana hivyo haikuwekwa waya wa usalama. Kazi zote za ukaguzi wa leak na uendeshaji zilikamilika bila tatizo na logbook ilisainiwa kabla ndege kurudi kwenye gate. Zamu inayofuata inahitajika kuthibitisha kuwa B-nut hiyo ina safety wire, kwani baadaye engine ya kushoto ilizimika ikiwa angani kutokana na kupungua kwa mafuta ya oil.
summary: Kukosekana kwa waya wa usalama kwenye #5 bearing scavenge tube B-nut wakati wa ukarabati wa engine ya B757-200 kulisababisha kuzimika kwa engine ikiwa angani, hivyo ufuatiliaji unahitajika.

narrative_text: Kwa handover kutoka night shift kwenye lube pump change ya L engine, B757-200, waliniambia safety wire iliwekwa tu kwenye oil tank na gearbox drain plugs. Ple, tukiwa na day shift mech tunafanya reinstall ya #5 bearing scavenge tube, nikamiss zile safety holes za B-nut, so haikuwa safety wired. Leak check na operational check zote zilipass, tuka-sign off logbook kabla ndege kurudi gate. Next shift wanahitaji kucheck hiyo B-nut ina safety wire, coz baadaye kuna IFSD ya L engine angani, oil pressure ikadrop kabisa.
summary: Kuna missed safety wire kwenye #5 bearing scavenge tube B-nut baada ya lube pump change kwenye B757-200, na hiyo ndio ilisababisha IFSD, so follow-up inahitajika.

narrative_text: B737-300 was moved from Gate A to Gate B for continued electrical troubleshooting after the #2 generator repeatedly dropped off line during taxi; APU power was used to feed both busses as a workaround. Attempts to reset the thrust reverser #2 and #3 circuit breakers did not resolve the fault, and we ran out of time to complete diagnosis before shift change. Next shift found the cause to be a failed R4 ALT transfer relay, which has since been replaced; an ops check is still required before return to service.
summary: B737-300 #2 generator fault traced to a failed R4 ALT transfer relay, now replaced and pending ops check.

narrative_text: Ndege ya B737-300 ilihamishwa kutoka geti A kwenda geti B ili kuendelea kutafuta chanzo cha tatizo la umeme, baada ya jenereta namba mbili kukatika mara kwa mara wakati wa taxi. Tulitumia nguvu ya APU kulisha mifumo yote miwili ya umeme huku tukiendelea kutafuta chanzo cha hitilafu, ikiwemo kujaribu kurudisha circuit breakers za thrust reverser namba mbili na tatu, lakini muda wa zamu yetu uliisha kabla ya kumaliza uchunguzi. Zamu iliyofuata iligundua kuwa tatizo lilitokana na relay ya R4 ALT iliyoharibika, ambayo tayari imebadilishwa; hata hivyo ukaguzi wa uendeshaji (ops check) bado unahitajika kabla ndege kurejea kazini.
summary: Tatizo la jenereta namba mbili kwenye B737-300 lilisababishwa na relay ya R4 ALT iliyoharibika, ambayo sasa imebadilishwa na inasubiri ukaguzi wa uendeshaji.

entities.text: circuit breakers za thrust reverser namba mbili na tatu

narrative_text: Tuli-move B737-300 kutoka Gate A kwenda Gate B ku-continue troubleshooting ya electrical problem, kwa sababu #2 generator ilikuwa inadrop off line kila taxi. Tulitumia APU power ku-feed busses zote mbili wakati tukiendelea kuangalia, tukajaribu ku-reset thrust reverser #2 na #3 circuit breakers lakini haikusaidia, na shift yetu ikaisha kabla hatujamaliza. Next shift walipata kwamba tatizo ni R4 ALT transfer relay iliyofail, imeshabadilishwa but bado inahitaji ops check kabla ya return to service.
summary: #2 generator ya B737-300 ilikuwa na tatizo kwa sababu ya R4 ALT relay iliyofail, sasa imebadilishwa na inasubiri ops check.

narrative_text: Received only a verbal turnover on the EMB 140 that was towed to the gate for steering and gust lock complaints, no corresponding EICAS messages, and gear pins already installed by the previous technician. Replaced the nose landing gear air/ground (WOW) prox switch per AMM and ran op checks on air/ground, steering, and gust lock, all satisfactory, then closed out the job per the AMM steps. Next shift please note the AMM task sequence includes a step to install the gear pins but the close-out does not call out their removal, aircraft returned to gate after takeoff unable to retract gear with pins still installed, verify pin removal is captured as a mandatory step before further dispatch.
summary: A technician closed out an EMB 140 nose gear WOW switch job per AMM but the aircraft returned after takeoff with gear pins still installed because the task card lacked a pin-removal step.

entities.text: nose landing gear air/ground (WOW) prox switch
op checks on air/ground, steering, and gust lock

narrative_text: Nilipokea taarifa ya mdomo tu kuhusu ndege ya EMB 140 iliyovutwa hadi geti kwa sababu ya matatizo ya steering na gust lock, bila ujumbe wowote wa EICAS, na pini za gear zilikuwa zimewekwa tayari na fundi wa awali. Nilibadilisha kihisi cha air/ground (WOW) cha gear ya mbele kulingana na AMM na kufanya op check za air/ground, steering, na gust lock, zote zikaonekana sawa, kisha nikafunga kazi kama taratibu za AMM zinavyoelekeza. Shift inayofuata tafadhali angalia kwamba hatua za AMM zinataka pini za gear ziwekwe lakini hazitaji zoezi la kuzitoa, ndege ilirudi geti baada ya kuondoka kwa kutokuweza kukunja gear huku pini bado zikiwa zimewekwa, hivyo hakikisheni utoaji wa pini umeandikwa kama hatua ya lazima kabla ya safari nyingine.
summary: Fundi alifunga kazi ya kihisi cha WOW cha gear ya mbele ya EMB 140 kwa mujibu wa AMM lakini ndege ilirudi baada ya kuondoka kwa sababu pini za gear zilikuwa bado zimewekwa kwani hatua ya kuzitoa haikutajwa kwenye karatasi ya kazi.

entities.text: kihisi cha air/ground (WOW) cha gear ya mbele
op check za air/ground, steering, na gust lock

narrative_text: Nilipata verbal turnover tu kwa hii EMB 140 iliyokuwa towed mpaka gate kwa sababu ya steering na gust lock issues, hakuna EICAS messages zozote, na gear pins zilikuwa already installed na yule technician wa kabla. Nika-replace ile nose landing gear air/ground (WOW) prox switch kama AMM inavyosema, then nika-run op checks za air/ground, steering, na gust lock, zote zikawa good, halafu nika-close out job kwa mujibu wa AMM steps. Shift inayokuja tuangalie vizuri, AMM task ina step ya kuinstall gear pins lakini close-out haitaji kuzitoa, ndege ilirudi gate baada ya takeoff haikuweza retract gear na pins bado zimeingia, so tuconfirm removal ya pins imewekwa as mandatory step before dispatch tena.
summary: Fundi ali-close out job ya WOW switch ya nose gear kwenye EMB 140 kwa mujibu wa AMM lakini ndege ilirudi gate baada ya takeoff kwa sababu gear pins zilikuwa bado zimeingia, task card ikikosa step ya kuzitoa.

entities.text: nose landing gear air/ground (WOW) prox switch
op checks za air/ground, steering, na gust lock

narrative_text: B737-800 arrived last night with a crew report of a loud squeal from the cockpit handset. Stores pulled a replacement unit and the AMT swapped the handset at the gate before I relieved him; the old unit had no legible serial number so we logged it as UNK. Capt and I checked out the new handset and ops were normal, but Quality Assurance later found the replacement part number was wrong effectivity and it has since been replaced again with the correct part number. Please confirm QA closeout is documented in the logbook and verify no further interphone squawks from this tail.
summary: Wrong-effectivity handset was installed on a B737-800 to fix a cockpit interphone squeal, later corrected by QA, and logbook closeout needs verification.

narrative_text: Ndege ya B737-800 iliwasili jana usiku na ripoti ya sauti kali ya kupasuka kutoka kwenye handset ya cockpit. Stores walitoa kipande cha kubadilisha na fundi (AMT) akabadilisha handset kule gate kabla mimi kumhudumia zamu; kile kilichotolewa hakikuwa na namba ya serial inayosomeka hivyo tuliandika UNK kwenye logbook. Kapteni na mimi tulifanya ukaguzi wa handset mpya na mambo yalionekana sawa, lakini baadaye Quality Assurance walibaini part number iliyowekwa haikuwa sahihi kwa effectivity ya ndege hiyo, na handset imebadilishwa tena kwa namba sahihi. Tafadhali thibitisha kwamba kufungwa kwa suala hili na QA kumeandikwa vizuri kwenye logbook na kwamba hakuna malalamiko mengine ya interphone kutoka ndege hiyo.
summary: Handset yenye part number isiyo sahihi ilifungwa kwenye B737-800 kurekebisha tatizo la interphone, hitilafu iliyogunduliwa na QA baadaye na kurekebishwa.

narrative_text: Hii B737-800 ilikuja jana usiku na crew report ya loud squeal kutoka kwa cockpit handset. Stores walitoa unit ya kubadilisha, na yule AMT alikuwa amemaliza kubadilisha handset kwa gate before nikafika ku-relieve him; ile old unit haikuwa na serial number inayosomeka so tuliandika UNK kwenye logbook. Capt na mimi tulido checkout ya handset mpya, ops ikaonekana normal, lakini baadaye QA walipata kwamba part number tuliyoweka ilikuwa wrong effectivity, so handset imebadilishwa tena na correct part number. Please confirm kwamba QA closeout imeandikwa properly kwenye logbook, na verify hakuna squawks zingine za interphone kwa hii tail.
summary: Handset ya wrong part number ilifungwa kwenye B737-800 for interphone squeal, QA wakagundua effectivity issue baadaye na wakairekebisha.

narrative_text: B757-200 engine IDG was replaced on the previous shift; turnover stated only the chip detectors still needed checking and all other work was complete. Oncoming lead technician relied on this verbal handover and did not call out the RII inspection for the IDG installation before assigning the mechanic to the next check item. RII was later accomplished at another station with no flight discrepancies, but logbook review flagged the missed call-out; recommend verifying RII status directly against the logbook, not verbal turnover, before further assignments.
summary: A verbal shift turnover on a B757-200 IDG replacement omitted the required RII call-out, which was only caught later during logbook review.

narrative_text: IDG ya B757-200 ilibadilishwa zamu iliyopita, na taarifa ya makabidhiano ilieleza kuwa ni chip detectors tu zilizobaki kukaguliwa, kazi nyingine zote zikiwa zimekamilika. Fundi mkuu wa zamu inayofuata alitegemea taarifa hiyo ya mdomo na hakuita ukaguzi wa RII uliohitajika kwa ufungaji wa IDG kabla ya kumpangia fundi kazi ya ukaguzi uliobaki. Ukaguzi wa RII ulifanywa baadaye kituo kingine bila tatizo lolote la ndege, lakini ukaguzi wa logbook ulibaini kosa hilo la kutoita RII; inashauriwa kuthibitisha hali ya RII kupitia logbook moja kwa moja, si kwa taarifa ya mdomo tu.
summary: Makabidhiano ya mdomo kuhusu ubadilishaji wa IDG kwenye B757-200 yalisababisha kukosekana kwa ukaguzi wa RII, jambo lililobainika baadaye kwenye ukaguzi wa logbook.

narrative_text: Kwenye B757-200, engine IDG ilibadilishwa zamu iliyopita, na handover ilisema chip detectors ndio pekee zilizobaki ku-check, kazi zingine zote zimekamilika. Lead tech wa oncoming shift alitegemea hiyo verbal turnover pekee na hakufanya call-out ya RII inspection ya IDG install kabla ya ku-assign mechanic kwenye check item nyingine. RII ilifanywa later kwenye station tofauti, hakuna flight discrepancies, lakini logbook review ilibaini kwamba call-out ilikosekana; tafadhali future assignments zi-confirm RII status straight kwenye logbook, si kwa word of mouth tu.
summary: Verbal handover ya IDG replacement kwenye B757-200 ilisababisha kukosekana kwa RII call-out, iliyogunduliwa later kwenye logbook review.

narrative_text: B767-300 rudder PCA replacement was completed and checked out normally, including rig pin install, trim set, and multi-system operational checks, but the RII final inspection was never signed off before the aircraft was moved from the hangar back to the line due to concrete work blocking the bay. Job was worked off maintenance manual pages instead of RII work cards, so the required inspection sign-off reminder was missed during handover between shifts. Downline station completed the RII inspection after the flight, but this needs to be flagged for the hangar crew and lead AMT so paperwork discipline is reinforced when working off manual pages. Please confirm RII status on any open rudder actuator jobs before further release.
summary: RII final inspection for a rudder actuator/PCA replacement on a B767 was missed due to time pressure and use of non-RII paperwork, and was later completed at the next station.

narrative_text: Kazi ya kubadilisha rudder PCA kwenye ndege ya B767-300 ilikamilika na ukaguzi wa uendeshaji ukafanyika vizuri, ikiwemo kuweka rig pin na kurekebisha trim, lakini ukaguzi wa mwisho wa RII haukufanyika kabla ndege haijahamishwa kutoka hangar kwenda line kwa sababu ya kazi za saruji zilizokuwa zikiendelea nyuma ya bay. Kazi ilifanywa kwa kutumia karatasi za maintenance manual badala ya work cards zenye sehemu za RII, hivyo ukumbusho wa ukaguzi ulikosekana wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu. Kituo kingine kilifanya ukaguzi wa RII baada ya ndege kuruka, jambo ambalo linahitaji kuarifiwa kwa wafanyakazi wa hangar na lead AMT ili nidhamu ya nyaraka iimarishwe. Tafadhali hakikisha status ya RII kwa kazi zozote za rudder actuator zinazoendelea kabla ya kutolewa kwa ndege.
summary: Ukaguzi wa mwisho wa RII kwa ubadilishaji wa rudder actuator kwenye B767 ulikosekana kutokana na shinikizo la muda na matumizi ya karatasi zisizo sahihi, na baadaye ulikamilika kituo kingine.

narrative_text: Ile rudder PCA replacement kwa B767-300 ilikamilika sawa, tuli-check operation na all 3 hyd systems, tukaweka rig pin na kuset trim as required, lakini RII final inspection haikufanyika kabla aircraft ime-move kutoka hangar kwenda line kwa sababu ya concrete work iliyokuwa inaendelea behind our bay. Tulikuwa tunafanya job kwa maintenance manual pages badala ya RII work cards, so ile reminder ya kusign RII ilikosekana during shift turnover. Downline station walicomplete ile RII inspection baada ya flight, lakini hii inahitaji kuflagiwa kwa hangar crew na lead AMT ili tuimarishe paperwork discipline when working off manual pages. Please confirm RII status ya any open rudder actuator jobs kabla ya release yoyote.
summary: RII final inspection ya rudder actuator kwenye B767 ilikosekana kwa sababu ya time pressure na kutumia karatasi mbaya, na ilimaliziwa station ingine baadaye.

narrative_text: MD-88 R main landing gear strut repack completed this shift: scissors, brake lines, and both electrical conduits/cannon plugs reconnected, gear swung 4x with normal indications, then lower wing panel reinstalled and aircraft returned to service. Follow-up crew must note that the required operational check of the weight-on-wheels sensor and wheel speed transducers was NOT performed before release, which likely contributed to the antiskid/autobrake/autospoiler faults reported after departure. Next shift to verify WOW sensor and gland nut lock installation and confirm cannon plug keying/routing before further flight.
summary: After an MD-88 gear strut repack, the required WOW sensor and wheel speed transducer checkout was missed, contributing to inflight antiskid/autobrake anomalies that need follow-up verification.

narrative_text: Kazi ya kubadilisha mafuta ya strut ya gear ya kulia (R main landing gear) ya ndege ya MD-88 imekamilika kwa shift hii, ikiwemo kuunganisha upya scissors, mabomba ya breki, na conduit mbili za umeme pamoja na cannon plugs zake. Gear ilijaribiwa mara nne na dalili zote zilionekana kuwa za kawaida, hivyo panel ya chini ya bawa ilirudishwa na ndege ikarudishwa kwa huduma. Hata hivyo, ukaguzi wa lazima wa sensor ya weight-on-wheels na transducers za mwendo wa magurudumu haukufanyika kabla ya kuachiliwa, jambo ambalo linaaminika kuchangia matatizo ya autobrake, anti-skid, na autospoiler yaliyojitokeza baada ya kuruka. Shift ijayo inatakiwa kuthibitisha usakinishaji sahihi wa sensor hiyo na gland nut lock, na pia kuangalia tena mpangilio wa cannon plugs.
summary: Baada ya kazi ya kubadilisha mafuta ya strut ya gear ya ndege ya MD-88, ukaguzi muhimu wa sensor ya weight-on-wheels haukufanyika, jambo lililochangia matatizo ya mfumo wa breki angani na linahitaji ufuatiliaji.

narrative_text: Tuma-complete ile R main landing gear strut repack ya MD-88 kwa shift hii - tuli-reconnect scissors, brake lines, na conduits mbili za umeme pamoja na cannon plugs zao. Tuli-swing gear mara nne, indications zote zikawa normal, kisha tuka-reinstall lower wing panel na ndege ika-return to service. Shida ni kwamba hatuku-do ile required checkout ya WOW sensor na wheel speed transducers kabla ya release, na hiyo ndio inaonekana ilichangia zile antiskid, autobrake na autospoiler irregularities baada ya departure. Next shift wa-verify installation ya WOW sensor na gland nut lock, pia wa-confirm kama cannon plugs zime-route sawa.
summary: Baada ya MD-88 gear strut repack, checkout ya WOW sensor na wheel speed transducers haiku-done kabla ya release, na hiyo imesababisha antiskid/autobrake issues zinazohitaji follow-up.

narrative_text: On the A320, we removed and installed the #1 normal brake servo valve per the maintenance reference card, but the aircraft had no electrical power due to #2 engine removal for pylon duct work, so the required leak and operational check could not be completed. A follow-up card was written to accomplish the leak/op check once power was restored, but no verbal handover was given to the incoming shift, and the card was signed off without the deferred check being clearly linked. Next shift must verify the leak and op check on the #1 brake servo valve was actually performed before further release; this was tied to a recurring hot/sticky brake condition on that side.
summary: Incomplete leak/op check on a replaced #1 brake servo valve was not properly passed down to the next shift, risking premature sign-off.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya A320, tuliondoa na kufunga valve ya breki namba 1 (normal brake servo valve) kwa kufuata kadi ya matengenezo, lakini ndege haikuwa na umeme kwa sababu injini ya pili ilikuwa imeondolewa kwa kazi ya pylon duct, hivyo ukaguzi wa uvujaji na uendeshaji haukukamilika. Tuliandika kadi nyingine ili ukaguzi huo ufanyike baada ya umeme kurudishwa, lakini hatukumpa zamu inayofuata maelezo ya mdomo kuhusu kilichobaki kufanyika, na kadi ilisainiwa bila kuunganishwa wazi na kazi iliyoahirishwa. Zamu inayofuata inapaswa kuhakikisha ukaguzi wa uvujaji na uendeshaji wa valve hiyo umefanyika kabla ya kuruhusu ndege kutumika, kwani tatizo hili lilihusiana na breki kupata joto na kushikama mara kwa mara upande huo.
summary: Ukaguzi wa uvujaji na uendeshaji wa valve ya breki namba 1 haukukamilika wala kuelezwa vizuri kwa zamu iliyofuata, hali iliyoweza kusababisha kadi kusainiwa kimakosa.

narrative_text: Kwa hii A320, tuliremove na kuinstall ile #1 normal brake servo valve kwa kufuata reference card, lakini aircraft haikuwa na power kwa sababu #2 engine ilikuwa imeondolewa kwa ile pylon duct job, so ile leak na op check haikufanyika. Tuliandika follow-up card ili ifanyike after power irudishwe, but hatukufanya verbal handover kwa next shift, na card ikasainiwa without kuunganisha vizuri na deferred item. Next shift wahakikishe ile leak and op check ya valve imefanyika kabla ya ku-release ndege, kwa sababu hii ilikuwa related na ile recurring hot/sticky brake issue upande huo.
summary: Leak and op check ya #1 brake servo valve haikukamilika na hakuna verbal handover iliyofanywa, ikileta hatari ya card kusainiwa mapema bila kukamilisha task.

narrative_text: While servicing the L and R main landing gear on the B737-800 per the job instruction card, the aircraft was moved on management's request before shift change, and tooling/equipment was cleared and returned to complete the handover on time. After turnover, I noticed the strut extension looked off and found I had measured the X dimension from the wrong reference point, leaving it about 1/2 inch too high. I informed the oncoming lead mechanic of the error; he is arranging for a mechanic to recheck the strut extension and pressure. Follow-up needed: verify nose gear servicing still pending and confirm strut recheck is completed before next flight.
summary: A servicing error on the B737-800 main landing gear strut extension was found after shift turnover and flagged to the oncoming lead mechanic for recheck.

narrative_text: Nilikuwa nikihudumia main landing gear ya kushoto na kulia kwenye ndege ya B737-800 kulingana na job card, lakini menejimenti waliagiza ndege ihamishwe kabla ya mabadiliko ya shift, hivyo nikakamilisha kazi na kurudisha vifaa store. Baada ya kukabidhi kazi kwa shift inayokuja, niligundua strut extension haikuonekana sawa, na nikagundua nilipima X dimension kutoka sehemu isiyo sahihi, hivyo urefu ulikuwa juu kwa inchi nusu. Nilimjulisha lead mechanic wa shift inayokuja kuhusu tatizo hilo, na ameahidi mechanic mwingine atarudi kukagua strut extension na pressure. Inahitajika ufuatiliaji wa haraka kabla ndege kutumika tena.
summary: Kosa la kupima strut extension kwenye main landing gear ya B737-800 lilibainika baada ya kukabidhi kazi, na lead mechanic ameagizwa kufuatilia.

narrative_text: Nilikuwa nikiservice main landing gear, left na right, kwa hii B737-800 kufuata job instruction card, lakini management walitaka aircraft imoved before shift change so nikafinish servicing haraka na kurudisha equipment kwa tool room. Baada ya kufanya turnover, nikakuwa nikicheck area for cleanliness ndio nikanotice strut extension inaonekana off. Nikacheck job card nikagundua nilimeasure X dimension kutoka wrong point, so strut extension ilikuwa high by half inch. Nikamwinform oncoming lead mechanic, akaniambia atasend mechanic arecheck strut extension na pressure kabla flight ya next.
summary: Kuna error ya measurement kwenye strut extension ya main landing gear, B737-800, iligundulika after turnover na lead mechanic ameagiza recheck.

narrative_text: B737-700 fuel nozzle replacement (positions 5-9) was carried over from previous shift; incoming tech was told the earlier-installed nozzles were already signed off, so part number verification against the engineering order was not repeated before continuing. Remaining nozzles were installed, mounting flange bolts and coupling nuts were torqued and safetied, but shrouds are not yet reinstalled. Next shift must confirm all nozzle part numbers match the engineering order before proceeding with the pressure leak check.
summary: Fuel nozzle replacement on a B737-700 continued across shifts without re-verifying part numbers, and the pressure leak check plus shroud installation remain outstanding.

narrative_text: Kazi ya kubadilisha nozzle za mafuta kwenye ndege ya B737-700 (positions 5 mpaka 9) iliendelezwa kutoka shift iliyopita; fundi aliyekuja alijulishwa kwamba nozzle zilizowekwa awali tayari zimekaguliwa na kuridhiwa, hivyo uhakiki wa part number dhidi ya engineering order haukurudiwa kabla ya kuendelea. Nozzle zilizobaki ziliwekwa, bolts za flange na coupling nuts zikafungwa kwa torque na kuwekewa safety, lakini shrouds bado hazijarudishwa. Shift inayofuata inatakiwa kuthibitisha part numbers zote za nozzle zinalingana na engineering order kabla ya kuendelea na pressure leak check.
summary: Ubadilishaji wa nozzle za mafuta kwenye B737-700 uliendelezwa bila kurudia uhakiki wa part numbers, na pressure leak check pamoja na ufungaji wa shrouds bado hazijakamilika.

narrative_text: Ile kazi ya kubadilisha fuel nozzles kwa B737-700, positions 5 through 9, ilikuwa carried over kutoka shift iliyopita; niliambiwa tu ati nozzles zilizoinstalled awali zime-signed off already, kwa hivyo si-kucheki tena part numbers dhidi ya engineering order kabla ya kuendelea. Nozzles zilizobaki tuli-install, tuka-torque flange bolts na coupling nuts na tuka-safety, lakini shrouds bado hazija-installed. Next shift wa-confirm part numbers zote against engineering order kabla ya ku-proceed na pressure leak check.
summary: Fuel nozzle replacement job kwa B737-700 iliendelea bila kuhakiki part numbers tena, na pressure leak check na shrouds bado hazijafanywa.

narrative_text: On the B737-500, #2 engine fuel shutoff cable R&R is still in progress; new cable was routed from the turnbuckle in the forward cargo bay through the pulley in the air conditioning bay to the #2 engine pylon quadrant. The pulley behind the aft cargo wall was reinstalled but the retaining nut was not confirmed torqued before I was pulled away on a family emergency. Verbal turnover was given to the incoming mechanic but the untorqued pulley/nut detail was not clearly communicated. Next shift must inspect and torque that pulley nut and the cable guard installation before releasing the aircraft.
summary: Incomplete #2 engine fuel shutoff cable installation on B737-500 left a pulley nut unconfirmed for torque due to an interrupted shift handover, requiring follow-up inspection.

narrative_text: Kazi ya kubadilisha cable ya #2 engine fuel shutoff kwenye B737-500 haijakamilika; cable mpya ilipitishwa kutoka turnbuckle iliyoko forward cargo bay hadi pulley ya air conditioning bay mpaka #2 engine pylon quadrant. Pulley iliyoko nyuma ya ukuta wa cargo iliwekwa tena lakini nut yake haikuthibitishwa kama imekazwa vizuri kabla sijaondoka ghafla kutokana na dharura ya kifamilia. Nilimpa taarifa ya mdomo fundi wa zamu inayofuata lakini suala la nut hiyo halikuelezwa vizuri. Zamu inayokuja inatakiwa kukagua na kukaza nut ya pulley hiyo pamoja na cable guard kabla ndege kuruhusiwa kuruka.
summary: Ukarabati wa cable ya #2 engine fuel shutoff kwenye B737-500 uliachwa nusu njia kwa sababu ya dharura ya kifamilia, na nut ya pulley haikuthibitishwa kukazwa, hivyo inahitaji ukaguzi wa haraka.

narrative_text: Kwa B737-500, job ya kubadilisha #2 engine fuel shutoff cable haijaishia; cable mpya iliroutewa kutoka turnbuckle ya forward cargo bay through pulley ya air conditioning bay mpaka #2 engine pylon quadrant. Pulley ile ya nyuma ya cargo wall tuliiweka lakini sikuconfirm kama nut imetightened, family emergency ikanibana nikaenda haraka. Nilimwambia mechanic wa next shift kwa mdomo tu, lakini hakupata point ya hiyo nut vizuri. Next shift wanafaa kucheck na kutorque ile pulley nut na pia cable guard kabla ya kurelease ndege.
summary: Job ya #2 engine fuel shutoff cable kwenye B737-500 ilibaki nusu kwa sababu ya family emergency, na pulley nut haijaconfirm kutightened, so next shift wanafaa kucheck.

narrative_text: Logbook item #2 on the SF340B (R-hand bleed air leak, recurred twice within 3 minutes during climbout) was initially closed with 'info noted' instead of being written up as an open discrepancy. Lead tech caught this and opened a new write-up (item #3) referencing item #2, assigned techs to troubleshoot and repair the bleed air leak, but mistakenly also added a note in the corrective action block of item #2 for continuity purposes. Next shift please verify item #3 write-up is properly closed with correct corrective action documented, and double-check item #1's reference to item #4 is consistent in the logbook.
summary: A bleed air leak discrepancy was initially mis-logged as informational instead of an open write-up, requiring correction and follow-up on logbook cross-referencing.

entities.text: troubleshoot and repair the bleed air leak

narrative_text: Kwenye logbook ya ndege ya SF340B, hitilafu ya uvujaji wa bleed air upande wa kulia (item #2) ilikuwa imefungwa kimakosa kama 'imeeleweka tu' badala ya kufunguliwa kama hitilafu halisi inayohitaji ukarabati. Fundi mkuu aligundua hili na akafungua andiko jipya (item #3) likirejelea item #2, akawapangia mafundi kufanya utambuzi na ukarabati wa uvujaji huo, ingawa pia aliweka maelezo ya ziada kwenye sehemu ya corrective action ya item #2 kwa makosa. Zamu inayofuata iangalie kama item #3 imefungwa vizuri na corrective action sahihi imeandikwa, na pia ithibitishe kuwa rejeleo la item #1 kwa item #4 ni sahihi.
summary: Hitilafu ya uvujaji wa bleed air iliandikwa kimakosa kama taarifa tu badala ya hitilafu halisi, hivyo inahitaji uhakiki wa marekebisho kwenye logbook.

narrative_text: Kwa SF340B, ile item #2 ya bleed air leak upande wa right hand ilikuwa imesignwa 'info noted' badala ya kufunguliwa kama proper discrepancy, yaani si sawa kabisa. Lead mech aligundua hiyo, akaopen write-up mpya item #3 ikiref item #2, akaassign technicians wafanye troubleshoot na repair ya bleed air leak, lakini akaadd pia note kwa corrective action block ya item #2 kwa mistake. Next shift please confirm item #3 imeclose vizuri na corrective action iko documented sawa, na pia check kama item #1 reference kwa item #4 iko consistent kwenye logbook.
summary: Bleed air leak discrepancy ilisignwa kimakosa kama info noted badala ya write-up, so next shift wacheck logbook entries zote zimefixiwa properly.

entities.text: troubleshoot na repair ya bleed air leak

narrative_text: On the B737-400 in the hangar for PSU replacement, approximately 28 oxygen generators were installed with shipping safety pins still in place, and this was only verbally passed to the next shift instead of being fully documented on the maintenance write-up. Inspection was able to verify part numbers, firing pin and release pin installation, and PSU drop per the manual, but could not stamp off the pin removal task since it was left incomplete by maintenance. Please follow up with maintenance lead to confirm all safety pins are removed from rows XYZ before further inspection buy-off, and reinforce that partial work must be fully documented, not just verbally handed over.
summary: Incomplete documentation and communication gap between mechanics and inspection over oxygen generator safety pin removal on a B737-400 led to a partial, unstamped inspection task.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya B737-400 iliyokuwa hangarini kwa kazi ya kubadilisha PSU, jenereta za oksijeni takribani 28 ziliwekwa zikiwa bado na pini za usalama za usafirishaji, na taarifa hii ilipitishwa kwa zamu inayofuata kwa maneno tu bila kuandikwa vizuri kwenye karatasi ya kazi. Ukaguzi ulithibitisha namba za sehemu, uwekaji wa pini za kufyatua na kutolewa, pamoja na kushuka kwa PSU kulingana na mwongozo, lakini haikuwezekana kutia muhuri kamili kwani kazi ya kuondoa pini katika safu XYZ haikukamilika. Tafadhali fuatilia na kiongozi wa matengenezo kuhakikisha pini zote za usalama zimeondolewa kabla ya ukaguzi wa mwisho, na ihakikishwe kazi isiyokamilika inaandikwa kikamilifu badala ya kupitishwa kwa maneno tu.
summary: Kulikuwa na mawasiliano hafifu kati ya mafundi na wakaguzi kuhusu kuondolewa kwa pini za usalama za jenereta za oksijeni kwenye B737-400, hivyo kazi kubaki bila kukamilika na muhuri wa ukaguzi.

narrative_text: Kwenye B737-400 iliyokuwa hangar kwa PSU replacement, tuliweka approximately 28 oxygen generators lakini zilikuwa bado na safety pins za shipping, na hii information ilipitishwa verbally tu kwa next shift bila kuandikwa fully kwenye maintenance write-up. Inspection ilithibitisha part numbers, firing pin na release pin installation, na PSU drop check kwa manual, lakini hatukuweza kutoa stamp kamili kwa sababu pin removal task kwenye rows XYZ haikukamilika. Tafadhali fuatilia na maintenance lead ku-confirm pins zote zimeondolewa kabla ya inspection buy-off, na tuhakikishe partial work inaandikwa vizuri si kupitishwa kwa maneno tu.
summary: Kuna miscom kati ya mechs na inspection kuhusu oxygen generator safety pins kwenye B737-400, so task imebaki incomplete bila stamp ya inspection.

narrative_text: While assisting another crew on the B737-700, my partner (new to the company) and I each changed one nose gear tire, but with the other crew arriving mid-task and the handover distracting us, we did not verify that both tires matched (a radial and a bias-ply tire were installed together). Next shift please inspect the nose tires to confirm correct matched pair before next flight, and flag this in the logbook. Recommend distinct part numbers for radial vs bias tires going forward to prevent recurrence.
summary: Mismatched radial and bias nose gear tires were installed on a B737-700 during a rushed handover and need urgent inspection/correction.

entities.text: inspect the nose tires to confirm correct matched pair

narrative_text: Wakati mimi na mwenzangu (mfanyakazi mpya) tulipokuwa tukisaidia timu nyingine kwenye ndege ya B737-700, kila mmoja alibadilisha tairi moja ya gia ya mbele, lakini kwa sababu ya timu ya awali kuwasili wakati tukiwa bado tunamaliza kazi na kuvurugika kwa mawasiliano wakati wa mkabidhi, hatukuthibitisha kama tairi zote mbili zinafanana (tairi moja ilikuwa aina ya radial na nyingine bias). Zamu inayofuata tafadhali kaguweni tairi za gia ya mbele kuhakikisha zimefanana kabla ya safari inayofuata, na liandikwe suala hili kwenye logbook. Pia napendekeza namba tofauti za sehemu (part number) kati ya tairi za radial na bias ili kuzuia hili lisijirudie.
summary: Tairi za gia ya mbele za aina tofauti (radial na bias) ziliwekwa kwenye ndege ya B737-700 wakati wa mkabidhi wa haraka, hivyo zinahitaji ukaguzi wa haraka.

entities.text: kaguweni tairi za gia ya mbele kuhakikisha zimefanana

narrative_text: Mimi na partner wangu (ni mpya kwa company) tulikuwa tuki-assist crew nyingine kwenye B737-700, kila mmoja aka-change nose tire moja, lakini kwa sababu ya timu ya zamu ilifika wakati bado tunamaliza na handover ikawa rushed, hatukucheck kama tires zote mbili zinamatch (turned out ni radial na bias mixed pamoja). Zamu inayofuata please inspect nose tires kuhakikisha ni matched pair before next flight, na iandikwe kwenye logbook. Pia i-recommend different part numbers for radial vs bias tires ili hii isijirudie tena.
summary: Nose gear tires za B737-700 zilikuwa mismatched (radial na bias) baada ya rushed handover, so inahitaji inspection haraka.

entities.text: inspect nose tires kuhakikisha ni matched pair

narrative_text: During shift turnover on the MD-80, the outgoing technician confirmed part and serial numbers for the right-side ice protection anticipator and thermostat. When I went back to verify the left side, I found two thermostats installed instead of one thermostat and one anticipator, since both components look nearly identical. I removed the incorrectly installed thermostat and fitted the correct anticipator in its place; please confirm the logbook entry and part numbers are updated before further sign-off.
summary: A technician found a thermostat mistakenly installed in place of the ice protection anticipator on the left side of an MD-80 and corrected it during shift handover verification.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kukabidhi zamu kwenye ndege ya MD-80, fundi wa zamu iliyopita alikuwa amethibitisha namba za sehemu na serial za anticipator na thermostat za mfumo wa kuzuia barafu upande wa kulia. Nilipoenda kuthibitisha upande wa kushoto, nilikuta thermostat mbili zimewekwa badala ya thermostat moja na anticipator moja, kwa kuwa vipande hivyo vinafanana sana. Niliondoa thermostat iliyowekwa kimakosa na kufunga anticipator sahihi mahali pake; tafadhali hakikisha logbook na namba za sehemu zimesahihishwa kabla ya kutia sahihi kazi hiyo.
summary: Fundi aligundua thermostat imewekwa kimakosa badala ya anticipator ya mfumo wa kuzuia barafu upande wa kushoto wa ndege ya MD-80, na akairekebisha wakati wa kuhakiki zamu.

narrative_text: Wakati wa turnover kwenye MD-80, fundi wa shift iliyopita ali-check part na serial numbers za right side ice protection anticipator na thermostat, akaonekana ni sawa. Nilipoenda ku-verify left side, nikakuta thermostat mbili zime-install badala ya thermostat moja na anticipator moja, coz hizo parts zinafanana sana ukiangalia. Nili-remove ile thermostat iliyowekwa wrong halafu nikafunga anticipator sahihi mahali pake; tafadhali confirm logbook entry na part numbers ziko sawa kabla ya ku-sign off.
summary: Fundi aligundua thermostat imewekwa kimakosa instead of anticipator kwenye left side ya ice protection system ya MD-80, akaicorrect during shift verification.

narrative_text: Handover: engine change on B737-700 (#2 engine) still requires closure of the thrust rating verification step. Data plate check confirmed both engines as 24K rated, but the CDU IDENT/CONFIG page cross-check was not independently verified before the EEC software check was signed off — this was assumed done by the mech who pulled the serial number. Before proceeding to the 65% power assurance run, next shift must confirm the thrust rating plug and CDU config page match the maintenance manual entry, as loaner engines from other facilities may carry a different rating (22K vs 24K).
summary: An engine change on a B737-700 proceeded to power assurance run-up without independent verification of the thrust rating plug/CDU config, based on an assumption between mechs, and next shift must confirm this before continuing.

narrative_text: Taarifa ya zamu: kazi ya kubadilisha injini namba mbili kwenye B737-700 bado inahitaji ufuatiliaji kabla ya kuendelea. Data plate ilithibitisha injini zote mbili ni za kiwango cha 24K, lakini ukaguzi wa ukurasa wa IDENT/CONFIG kwenye CDU haukuthibitishwa moja kwa moja kabla ya kusaini hatua ya EEC check - ilidhaniwa fundi mwingine ameshafanya hivyo. Kabla ya kuendelea na jaribio la nguvu la asilimia 65, zamu inayofuata lazima ithibitishe thrust rating plug pamoja na taarifa za CDU zinalingana na maelekezo ya kitabu cha matengenezo, hasa ikizingatiwa injini za kukopa kutoka kituo kingine zaweza kuwa na kiwango tofauti (22K badala ya 24K).
summary: Kazi ya kubadilisha injini kwenye B737-700 iliendelea hadi jaribio la nguvu bila uthibitisho wa kujitegemea wa kiwango cha injini, hivyo zamu inayofuata inahitajika kuthibitisha kabla ya kuendelea.

narrative_text: Handover note: engine change ya #2 engine kwa B737-700 bado needs follow-up kabla ya kuendelea. Tuli-verify data plate, both engines ziko 24K rated, lakini CDU IDENT/CONFIG page hatukui-confirm independently before signing off ile EEC software check step - tuli-assume mech aliyekuwa amepea serial number ameshafanya hiyo check pia. Before proceeding to run-up area kwa 65% power assurance run, next shift lazima wathibitishe thrust rating plug na CDU config inamatch na maintenance manual, kwa sababu loaner engines kutoka facility ingine zaeza kuwa 22K badala ya 24K.
summary: Engine change kwenye B737-700 ilienda mpaka power assurance run bila kuthibitisha thrust rating independently, so next shift wanapaswa ku-verify hiyo before proceeding.

narrative_text: During the R outboard aft flap R&R on the B737-800, the forward attach covers on the flap support fairings were closed by other technicians without confirming the forward attach point had been torque checked after disturbance. One tech short-signed the task and left before completion, and the card was later signed off as complete following a normal flap ops check. Oncoming inspector needs to verify whether the forward fairing attach point torque was actually checked before the aircraft returns to service.
summary: Possible unverified torque check on flap support fairing forward attach point after aft flap replacement on B737-800; requires follow-up before dispatch.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kubadilisha aft flap ya R outboard kwenye B737-800, mafundi wengine walifunga vifuniko vya sehemu ya mbele ya flap support fairing bila kuthibitisha kama torque check ilifanyika baada ya kuguswa. Fundi mmoja alitia sahihi kazi bila kuikamilisha kisha akaenda zake, na kadi ya kazi ikatiwa sahihi kuwa imekamilika baada ya ukaguzi wa kawaida wa flap. Inspekta atakayeingia anahitajika kuthibitisha kama torque ya sehemu ya mbele ya fairing ilikaguliwa kabla ndege kurudi kazini.
summary: Kuna wasiwasi kuwa torque check ya sehemu ya mbele ya flap support fairing haikuthibitishwa baada ya ukarabati wa aft flap kwenye B737-800, hivyo inahitaji ufuatiliaji kabla ndege kutumika.

narrative_text: Kwenye ile R&R ya R outboard aft flap kwa B737-800, wale wengine walifunga forward attach covers za flap support fairings bila kuconfirm kama torque check ilifanyika baada ya kudisturb ile connection. Kuna fundi mmoja alishort-sign kazi akaenda zake kabla ya kukamilika, na baadaye card ikasign off as complete after normal flap ops check. Tafadhali oncoming inspector aangalie kama forward attach point ilipata torque check sahihi kabla ya aircraft kurudi service.
summary: Kuna concern kuwa torque check ya forward attach point ya flap support fairing haikuconfirm baada ya kubadilisha aft flap kwenye B737-800, so inahitaji follow-up before dispatch.

narrative_text: MD-80 nose landing gear down-and-locked indicator pin was found protruding in flight even though gear was up and locked; contract maintenance worked on it overnight and short-signed that gear pins were installed. On arrival we jacked the aircraft per maintenance control instructions and, after a shift change on their end, were told to open everything up and check for rubbing or catching; multiple gear swings showed no fault and the pin cycled correctly each time. Follow-up needed: contract tech later admitted safeties were broken and the system was adjusted and swing-tested overnight, none of which was documented, so rigging and safety wire on the NLG system still need to be verified and all work properly logged.
summary: Undocumented contract maintenance work on an MD-80 nose gear indicator system led to an incomplete handover and unverified rigging/safety checks.

entities.text: nose landing gear down-and-locked indicator pin

narrative_text: Ndege ya MD-80 ilikuwa na tatizo kwenye pini ya kiashiria cha gia la mbele (nose landing gear) ambayo ilionekana ikitokeza wakati wa safari ya anga hata ingawa gia lilikuwa juu na limefungwa vizuri. Fundi wa kampuni ya kandarasi alifanya kazi usiku kucha na kutia sahihi kwa kifupi kuwa pini za gia zimewekwa, kisha sisi tulipofika tuliagizwa na kituo cha udhibiti wa matengenezo kuinua ndege na kufanya ukaguzi wa jumla baada ya mabadiliko ya zamu upande wao. Tulikagua kila sehemu, tukalizungusha gia mara nyingi bila kupata hitilafu, lakini baadaye tuligundua kuwa fundi wa kandarasi alikuwa amevunja usalama (safeties) na kurekebisha mfumo bila kuandika chochote kwenye rekodi; jambo hili linahitaji ufuatiliaji wa haraka kuhakikisha urekebishaji na hati za usalama vimekaguliwa upya na kuandikwa ipasavyo.
summary: Kazi ya matengenezo ya kandarasi kwenye mfumo wa kiashiria cha gia la mbele la ndege ya MD-80 haikuandikwa, hivyo kusababisha mawasiliano hafifu wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu na hitaji la ukaguzi zaidi.

entities.text: pini ya kiashiria cha gia la mbele

narrative_text: Kwenye hii MD-80, ile nose landing gear down-and-locked indicator pin ilikuwa inaonekana ikitokeza wakati wa flight ingawa gear ilikuwa up and locked, na contract maintenance tech alifanya kazi mpaka usiku ukiisha na aka-short sign kwamba gear pins zimewekwa. Tulipofika, maintenance control walituambia tu-jack ndege na baada ya shift change upande wao tukaambiwa tuopen up na tuangalie kama kuna kitu kina-catch au ku-rub; tulifanya gear swings kadhaa but hakuna prob tuliyoipata, pin ilikuwa inafanya kazi sawasawa kila mara. Shida ni kwamba baadaye tuligundua contract tech alikuwa ame-break safeties na ku-adjust system halafu aka-swing test bila kudocument chochote, kwa hivyo tunahitaji kufuatilia rigging na safety wire za NLG system na kuhakikisha kila kitu kime-log properly.
summary: Contract maintenance walifanya kazi kwenye MD-80 nose gear indicator system bila documentation, na hii imesababisha communication gap wakati wa handover inayohitaji follow-up.

entities.text: nose landing gear down-and-locked indicator pin

narrative_text: During the A-check on the Dash 8-400, avionics ran test equipment that inadvertently inflated the main cabin door seal without informing the mechanics on shift; a technician then opened/closed the door and tore the seal. After the seal was replaced, the ops check crew was not told the reservoir was already filled and began servicing it, which caused the reservoir end cap to blow off and damage the airframe structure. Next shift needs to verify structural repair status and confirm avionics-maintenance communication procedure is updated before further door seal work.
summary: Poor coordination between avionics and mechanics led to an over-pressurized door seal reservoir rupturing and causing structural damage on a Dash 8-400.

narrative_text: Wakati wa A-check kwenye ndege ya Dash 8-400, fundi wa avionics alitumia vifaa vya kupima ambavyo kwa bahati mbaya vilijaza hewa kwenye seal ya mlango mkuu wa abiria, bila kuwajulisha mafundi wengine waliokuwa kazini. Fundi mmoja alifungua na kufunga mlango huo, jambo lililosababisha seal kuraruka. Baada ya seal kubadilishwa, timu iliyofanya ukaguzi haikujulishwa kuwa reservoir ilikuwa imejaa tayari, hivyo walijaribu kuijaza zaidi, na hii ilisababisha mwisho wa reservoir kutoka kwa nguvu na kuharibu muundo wa ndege. Shift inayokuja inahitajika kuthibitisha hali ya ukarabati wa muundo huo na kuboresha mawasiliano kati ya avionics na wahandisi wa matengenezo.
summary: Kukosekana kwa mawasiliano kati ya avionics na mafundi wa matengenezo kulisababisha reservoir ya seal ya mlango kulipuka na kuharibu muundo wa ndege ya Dash 8-400.

entities.text: seal ya mlango mkuu wa abiria

narrative_text: Wakati wa A-check kwenye Dash 8-400, avionics guy alikuwa akitest equipment na aku-inflate ile main cabin door seal bila kuwaambia mechanics waliokuwa on shift. Mechanic mmoja aka-open na kuclose door, seal ikatear. Baada ya kubadilisha seal, tulifanya ops check lakini hatukujua reservoir ilikuwa already filled na avionics test, so tuka-service tena, matokeo end ya reservoir ika-blow off na kuharibu structure ya ndege. Next shift wafuatilie status ya structural repair na wa-confirm communication procedure kati ya avionics na maintenance imeboreshwa kabla ya kufanya door seal job tena.
summary: Miscommunication kati ya avionics na mechanics ilisababisha door seal reservoir kulipuka na kuharibu structure ya Dash 8-400.

narrative_text: B737-800: #1 cargo door seal installation was left incomplete at end of last shift, with a written turnover noting the top 24 inches still required. Incoming tech completed the remaining section and closed the door to check seal contact, signing off the install based on the ink stamp appearing correct.
