Next crew must verify seal orientation carefully before next flight, as this aircraft previously had an air turnback due to failure to pressurize from a backwards-installed seal.
summary: Cargo door seal installation on a B737-800 was handed over incomplete and later signed off incorrectly, requiring careful re-verification before further flight.

narrative_text: Ndege ya B737-800: kazi ya kufunga seal ya mlango wa cargo namba 1 ilibaki haijakamilika mwishoni mwa shift iliyopita, ikiwa na taarifa ya maandishi kuwa inchi 24 za juu bado zilihitaji kufanyiwa kazi. Fundi aliyeingia zamu alimalizia sehemu iliyobaki na kufunga mlango kuangalia mgusano wa seal, kisha akatia sahihi kazi hiyo kwa kuamini muhuri wa wino ulionyesha imefungwa sawasawa. Zamu inayofuata inatakiwa kuhakikisha tena mwelekeo wa seal kabla ya safari nyingine, kwani ndege hii tayari ilirudi ardhini kwa dharura kwa sababu ya kushindwa kubana hewa baada ya seal kufungwa kinyume.
summary: Kazi ya kufunga seal ya mlango wa cargo katika ndege ya B737-800 ilikabidhiwa ikiwa haijakamilika kisha ikathibitishwa vibaya, hivyo inahitaji ukaguzi wa makini kabla ya safari inayofuata.

entities.text: seal ya mlango wa cargo namba 1

narrative_text: Kwa hii B737-800, #1 cargo door seal ilikuwa haijakamilika from previous shift, kuna turnover note ilisema top 24 inches bado zinahitaji kufanywa. Nikaja nikamalizia hio section na nikafunga door ku-check seal contact, nikasign off kazi coz ile ink stamp ilionekana sawa. Next shift wahakikishe seal orientation vizuri kabla ya next flight, kwa sababu ndege hii ilishawahi kuwa na air turnback ya kushindwa pressurize baada ya seal kufungwa backwards.
summary: Cargo door seal ya B737-800 ilihandoverwa incomplete kisha ika-signed off vibaya, hivyo inahitaji re-check ya haraka kabla ya flight ijayo.

narrative_text: Overtime crew completed the stringer doubler/filler fabrication per SRM procedures on the B777-200; no elongated holes were observed on the stringer during fit-up. Fasteners were installed in the tight-access areas and the splice repair was closed out. Both the technician and inspection reviewed the repair and found no discrepancies, and Quality Control signed off the buyback; next shift should re-verify hole condition documentation before final closure.
summary: Overtime crew finished a stringer doubler/filler repair on a B777-200 with no defects noted, and it was signed off by inspection and QC, but documentation should be double-checked.

narrative_text: Wafanyakazi wa muda wa ziada walimaliza kutengeneza doubler na filler kwenye stringer ya ndege ya B777-200 kwa kufuata taratibu za SRM, na hawakuona matundu yaliyoharibika kwenye stringer. Fasteners ziliwekwa katika sehemu ngumu kufikia, na ukarabati wa splice ulikamilika bila tatizo lolote kuonekana. Ukaguzi na fundi wote walithibitisha kuwa hakuna dosari, kisha Idara ya Ubora ilitia sahihi kuidhinisha kazi; zamu ijayo iangalie tena hati za ukaguzi wa matundu kabla ya kufunga kazi rasmi.
summary: Wafanyakazi wa zamu ya usiku walimaliza ukarabati wa stringer kwenye ndege ya B777-200 bila dosari kuonekana, na kazi ilithibitishwa na ukaguzi pamoja na Idara ya Ubora, ingawa hati zinahitaji kuangaliwa tena.

narrative_text: Team ya overtime ilimaliza ku-fabricate doubler na filler kwa stringer ya B777-200 kufuata SRM procedures, hakuna elongated holes zilizoonekana kwenye stringer wakati wa fit-up. Fasteners ziliwekwa kwa zile tight-access areas na splice repair ikakamilika fine. Inspection na fundi wote walicheck repair na hawakupata discrepancy yoyote, then QC ika-sign off buyback; zamu inayofuata i-verify tena documentation ya hole condition kabla ya final closure.
summary: Overtime crew wamemaliza stringer doubler/filler repair kwenye B777-200 bila discrepancy, ime-sign off na inspection pamoja na QC, lakini documentation inahitaji kuangaliwa tena.

narrative_text: A321 work pack had 3 priority-1 items plus MEL items, including an inbound writeup for R2 cabin door indication in flight and a must-fix MEL on the cabin interphone system. We ran doors open/close and armed/disarmed each door/exit but could not duplicate the R2 door indication fault; MEL relief is available if maint control approves. Interphone MEL was cleared after ceiling panel removal and wire continuity checks, but door issue remains open pending a new plan from maint control before next flight. Fuel filter change (priority-1) still outstanding due to no filters in stock, no flight time remaining to use.
summary: Interphone MEL cleared on the A321, but R2 cabin door indication fault could not be duplicated and remains unresolved along with an outstanding fuel filter change.

narrative_text: Ndege ya A321 ilikuwa na vitu vitatu vya kipaumbele cha juu pamoja na MEL nyingine, ikiwemo tatizo la kiashiria cha mlango wa R2 lililoripotiwa wakati wa safari, na MEL ya lazima kurekebishwa kwenye mfumo wa intaphone wa kabati. Tulifungua na kufunga milango yote na kuziwasha/kuzizima lakini hatukupata tatizo lililoripotiwa la mlango wa R2; kama maint control wataruhusu, MEL inaweza kutumika kama suluhisho la muda. Tatizo la intaphone lilitatuliwa baada ya kutoa vifuniko vya juu ya kabati na kukagua nyaya, lakini tatizo la mlango bado halijafungwa na linasubiri mpango mpya kutoka maint control kabla ya safari inayofuata. Kazi ya kubadilisha vichujio vya mafuta (kipaumbele cha juu) bado haijafanyika kwa sababu havipo stoo, na muda wa ndege kutumika umeisha.
summary: MEL ya intaphone imefungwa kwenye ndege ya A321, lakini tatizo la kiashiria cha mlango wa R2 halijasuluhishwa na kazi ya vichujio vya mafuta bado inasubiri.

entities.text: kutoa vifuniko vya juu ya kabati

narrative_text: Kwa hii A321, work pack ilikuwa na priority-1 items tatu plus MEL zingine, including inbound writeup ya R2 cabin door indication wakati wa flight, na must-fix MEL kwenye cabin interphone system. Tuliopen/close milango yote na kuarm/disarm each door lakini hatukumanage kuduplicate ile door indication fault; kama maint control wataapprove, tuna option ya kuMEL hiyo item. Interphone MEL imecleared baada ya kutoa ceiling panels na kucheck wires kwa shorts/opens, lakini door issue bado open, tunasubiri new plan kutoka maint control kabla ya next flight. Fuel filter change (priority-1) bado haijafanyika kwa sababu hakuna filters stoo, na flight time ya kutumia imeisha.
summary: Interphone MEL imecleared kwenye A321 lakini R2 door indication fault haijaresolve na fuel filter change bado imeenda pending.

narrative_text: During prep for the #1 engine borescope inspection on the B767, I removed the gearbox crank pad cover so the engine could be turned, but my shift ended before the job was finished and I did not tell the incoming AMT where I had placed it. The cover was never reinstalled; aircraft departed, lost oil pressure/quantity, and #1 engine was shut down in flight with an air turn-back. Follow-up: reinforce shift-turnover checklist for open engine panels/covers and verify crank pad cover installation before closing up any borescope task.
summary: A missed crank pad cover reinstallation after an incomplete shift handover led to an in-flight #1 engine shutdown and air turn-back on a B767.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kutayarisha ndege ya B767 kwa ukaguzi wa boroskopu wa injini namba 1, niliondoa kifuniko cha crank pad ili injini iweze kuzungushwa, lakini shift yangu ilikamilika kazi ikiwa bado haijakamilika na sikumwambia fundi aliyeingia mahali nilipoweka kifuniko hicho. Kifuniko hakikurudishwa; ndege ilianza safari na kupoteza shinikizo na kiwango cha mafuta, hivyo injini namba 1 ikazimwa hewani na ndege ikarudi uwanjani. Kinachohitaji ufuatiliaji: kuboresha utaratibu wa mkabidhiano wa shift kuhusu vifuniko vya injini vilivyofunguliwa, na kuhakikisha crank pad cover imerudishwa kabla ya kufunga kazi ya boroskopu.
summary: Kushindwa kurudisha kifuniko cha crank pad baada ya mkabidhiano hafifu wa shift kulisababisha kuzimika kwa injini namba 1 hewani na ndege kurudi uwanjani kwenye B767.

narrative_text: Wakati tuna-prepare #1 engine kwa borescope inspection kwa hii B767, nilitoa ile gearbox crank pad cover ndio engine iweze kugeuzwa, lakini shift yangu ikaend before job imecompletiwa na sikumtell yule AMT anayeingia nilipoweka ile cover. Cover haikurudishwa, ndege ikadepart ikapoteza oil pressure na quantity, matokeo #1 engine ika-shutdown mid-flight na wakafanya air turn-back. Follow-up: tuboreshe shift handover checklist kwa open panels na covers, na kila mtu ahakikishe crank pad cover imeinstalliwa vizuri kabla ya kuclose out borescope task.
summary: Crank pad cover haikurudishwa baada ya handover mbaya, na hiyo ikasababisha #1 engine ishutdown mid-flight na air turn-back kwa B767.

narrative_text: Fan blade #4 was installed on the #1 engine of the A320 using paperwork left over from a previous shift, and the retaining ring illustration in the maintenance manual was unclear, causing a row of securing fasteners to be omitted. The engine run afterward showed excessive vibration, and the next crew found the missing bolts when pulling the spinner to add weights. Handover between the foreman and lead was inconsistent, with each tech getting different information, and the fasteners were left loose in cups instead of bagged/tagged with the part; please verify fastener kits are properly labeled and confirm full turnover briefing before any follow-on fan blade work.
summary: Incomplete retaining ring fastener installation on an A320 #1 engine fan blade, caused by unclear manual illustration and inconsistent shift handover, led to excessive vibration and required rework by the next crew.

narrative_text: Blade ya fani namba 4 kwenye engine ya kwanza ya ndege ya A320 ilifungwa kwa kutumia karatasi za kazi zilizobaki kutoka shift iliyopita, na picha ya jinsi ya kufunga retaining ring kwenye maintenance manual haikuwa wazi, hivyo safu moja ya bolti za kufunga ikakosekana. Baada ya kufanya engine run, mtetemo mkubwa uligundulika, na wafanyakazi wa shift inayofuata walipata bolti zilizokosekana walipokuwa wakitoa spinner kuongeza uzito. Mawasiliano kati ya foreman na lead yalikuwa hayaeleweki vizuri kwani kila fundi alipewa maelezo tofauti, na bolti zenyewe zilikuwa zimewekwa kwenye vikombe bila kuandikwa lebo au kufungwa pamoja na kipande chake; tafadhali hakikisheni bolti zote zina lebo sahihi na kwamba maelezo kamili ya turnover yanatolewa kabla ya kazi yoyote ya blade kufanywa tena.
summary: Kukosekana kwa bolti za kufunga retaining ring kwenye fan blade ya engine ya kwanza ya A320, kulikosababishwa na picha isiyo wazi kwenye manual na mawasiliano mabovu ya shift, kulisababisha mtetemo mkubwa na kazi ya kurekebisha kufanywa na shift nyingine.

narrative_text: Tuliinstall fan blade #4 kwa #1 engine ya A320 tukitumia paperwork iliyobaki kutoka shift ya jana, na hiyo illustration ya retaining ring kwenye maintenance manual haikuwa clear, hivyo tukamiss row moja ya fasteners. Baada ya engine run tukapata excessive vibration, halafu crew ya next shift wakakuta zile bolts missing wakati wanapull spinner kuadd weights. Handover kati ya foreman na lead haikuwa sawa, kila AMT alipewa turnover tofauti, na hizo fasteners zilikuwa zimewekwa tu kwa cups bila kubagged wala kutagged kwa part yake; tafadhali verify ma-kit ya fasteners yamewekwa labeled sawasawa na turnover ifanywe properly kabla ya kufanya fan blade job tena.
summary: Fasteners za retaining ring zilimiss kwa fan blade ya #1 engine ya A320 kwa sababu ya illustration mbovu kwenye manual na handover isiyo clear, hivyo ikasababisha vibration excessive na rework na next crew.

narrative_text: Heads up: on the CRJ200, the L wing trailing edge flap panels opened by second shift for the flap actuator inspection during the A13 check were only partially removed, but the panel card was stamped as fully open. Third shift and the lead tech were not told only some screws had been taken out, so when the panel appeared installed at close-up, it was signed off closed without climbing up to visually confirm all screws were seated. Aircraft departed on the morning revenue flight before a bag of loose screws was found in the hangar, matching those from the L wing panel. Aircraft needs to be re-inspected on arrival and the panel card / handover process reviewed to prevent sign-off without physical verification.
summary: Miscommunication between shifts over partially removed flap panel screws led to a sign-off without verification, and the aircraft departed with loose panel screws left in the hangar.

entities.text: L wing trailing edge flap panels

narrative_text: Taarifa ya kuhamisha zamu: kwenye ndege ya CRJ200, paneli za bawa la kushoto (trailing edge flap) zilizofunguliwa na zamu ya pili kwa ukaguzi wa flap actuator wakati wa A13 check hazikutolewa kabisa screws zote, lakini kadi ya paneli ilipigwa stempu kama imefunguliwa kikamilifu. Zamu ya tatu na fundi msimamizi hawakujulishwa kuwa baadhi tu ya screws zilitolewa, hivyo paneli ilipoonekana imewekwa tena mahali pake ilisainiwa kufungwa bila kupanda chini ya bawa kuthibitisha kuwa screws zote zimewekwa vizuri. Ndege ilisafiri kwa safari ya asubuhi ya kibiashara kabla ya mfuko wa screws zilizokuwa zimebaki kupatikana ndani ya hangar, zikilingana na zile za paneli la bawa la kushoto. Inahitajika ndege ikaguliwe upya baada ya kutua, na mfumo wa kusaini kadi za paneli kati ya zamu ufanyiwe mapitio ili kuzuia hali kama hii kutokea tena.
summary: Kutokuwepo mawasiliano bora kati ya zamu kuhusu screws za paneli ya flap kulisababisha kusainiwa kwa kazi bila uthibitisho, na ndege ikasafiri huku screws zikiwa zimebaki hangarini.

narrative_text: Handover kidogo: kwenye CRJ200, ile L wing trailing edge flap panels ambazo zamu ya pili walifungua kwa flap actuator inspection wakati wa A13 check, ziliondolewa screws chache tu, but panel card ikapigwa stamp kama imefunguliwa fully. Zamu ya tatu na lead tech hawakujulishwa kwamba ni baadhi ya screws tu zilitolewa, so panel ilipoonekana imewekwa tena, ikasign-off kama closed bila mtu kupanda chini ya wing kuconfirm screws zote ziko place. Aircraft ikaenda kwa morning revenue flight kabla mfuko wa loose screws kupatikana hangarini, zikimatch na zile za L wing panel. Tunahitaji aircraft ikaguliwe upya on arrival, na tuangalie process ya kusign panel card between shifts ili hii isirudie tena.
summary: Kuna miscommunication kati ya shifts kuhusu screws za flap panel zilizoachwa, ikasababisha sign-off bila verification na aircraft ikatoka na screws zimebaki hangarini.

entities.text: L wing trailing edge flap panels

narrative_text: Handover: A310 returned with a hydraulic leak reported at the inboard right wing area; previous shift confirmed and replaced the leaking speed brake valve and pressure-tested the aux green, yellow, and blue systems with no leaks found. Aircraft was called back same afternoon for a leak in the same area; flaps were dropped and under-wing panels removed, revealing pooled fluid at the aft spar running toward the landing gear bay, but an expanded leak check on all three hydraulic systems found nothing abnormal and fluid levels were normal, so this was assessed as residual fluid and the area was re-cleaned. Note the earlier green system low-level warning was traced separately to a leaking right aileron droop actuator, a different system and location, so the two events are considered unrelated. Next shift should re-verify the aft spar/landing gear area on next inspection to confirm no active leak recurs.
summary: A310 hydraulic leak traced to a replaced speed brake valve; a later fluid finding near the aft spar was assessed as residual rather than a new leak, and is unrelated to a separate green system actuator issue.

entities.text: aux green, yellow, and blue systems

narrative_text: Taarifa ya zamu: Ndege ya A310 ilirudi ikiwa na tatizo la kuvuja kwa hydraulic fluid upande wa ndani wa bawa la kulia; zamu iliyopita ilithibitisha uvujaji huo kwenye speed brake valve, wakaibadilisha, na kufanya majaribio kwenye mifumo ya aux green, yellow na blue bila kupata uvujaji wowote. Mchana huo huo ndege iliitwa tena kwa sababu ya uvujaji katika eneo lile lile; flaps zilishushwa na paneli za chini ya bawa ziliondolewa, na maji ya hydraulic yalionekana yamekusanyika karibu na aft spar yakielekea eneo la landing gear, lakini ukaguzi wa ziada wa mifumo yote mitatu ya hydraulic haukubaini uvujaji mpya na viwango vya maji vilikuwa vya kawaida, hivyo ilihitimishwa kuwa ni mabaki tu ya maji na eneo likasafishwa tena. Tahadhari ya awali ya kupungua kwa mfumo wa green ilibainika kutokana na tatizo tofauti la droop actuator ya aileron ya kulia, hivyo matukio hayo mawili si yanayohusiana. Zamu inayofuata inashauriwa kuangalia tena eneo la aft spar na landing gear ili kuhakikisha hakuna uvujaji unaoendelea.
summary: Ndege ya A310 ilikuwa na uvujaji wa hydraulic uliohusishwa na speed brake valve, na baadaye maji yaliyoonekana karibu na aft spar yalihitimishwa kuwa ni mabaki tu, jambo lisilohusiana na tatizo tofauti la mfumo wa green.

entities.text: droop actuator ya aileron ya kulia

narrative_text: Handover note: A310 ilirudi na hydraulic leak kwenye inboard right wing; previous shift walithibitisha speed brake valve ndio ilikuwa inavuja, waka-replace, na wakafanya pressure test kwenye aux green, yellow na blue systems, hakuna leak iliyopatikana. Alasiri ile ile aircraft ika-callback kwa leak sawa area ile ile; tuka-drop flaps na kuremove under-wing panels, tukakuta fluid imekusanyika karibu na aft spar ikielekea landing gear area, lakini baada ya kufanya extended leak check kwenye systems zote tatu hatukupata leak yoyote na fluid levels zilikuwa normal, so tuka-conclude ni residual fluid tu na tuka-clean area tena. Ile green system low warning ya awali ilikuwa separate issue, iliyotokana na leaking droop actuator ya right aileron, so hizi issues mbili hazihusiani. Next shift wapitie tena aft spar/landing gear area on next check ku-confirm hakuna leak inayoendelea.
summary: A310 ilikuwa na hydraulic leak iliyofix kwa ku-replace speed brake valve, halafu fluid iliyoonekana karibu na aft spar ika-assess kama residual tu, na haihusiani na separate green system actuator issue.

entities.text: aux green, yellow na blue systems

narrative_text: B737-400 was worked for a service check plus #1 main gear brake inspection, #2 main gear tire change, and MEL troubleshooting on #1 engine igniter and generator, while also carrying an ACARS pressurization complaint from the inbound crew. With multiple teams working the aircraft simultaneously (engine run support, brake/tire change), the leading edge slats deactivation was missed amid the task overload. Leading edge flaps subsequently deployed and damaged the #1 engine inboard thrust reverser translating sleeve. Next shift must verify reverser damage extent, confirm all deactivation tags/procedures are followed before any further engine or leading edge work, and close out remaining MEL items.
summary: During overlapping maintenance tasks on a B737-400, a missed leading-edge deactivation led to slat deployment that damaged the #1 engine thrust reverser, with several MEL items still open for follow-up.

entities.text: #1 engine inboard thrust reverser translating sleeve

narrative_text: Ndege ya B737-400 ilikuwa ikifanyiwa service check pamoja na ukaguzi wa brake ya main gear namba moja, kubadilisha tire ya main gear namba mbili, na kufanyia troubleshooting MEL za igniter na generator za engine namba moja, huku pia kukiwa na taarifa ya ACARS kuhusu tatizo la pressurization kutoka kwa crew iliyoleta ndege. Kwa sababu ya timu nyingi kufanya kazi kwa wakati mmoja kwenye ndege, hatua ya deactivation ya leading edge slats ilisahaulika kutokana na msongamano wa kazi. Baadaye leading edge flaps zilijitokeza na kuharibu thrust reverser ya ndani ya engine namba moja. Shift inayofuata ihakikishe kiwango cha uharibifu kimeangaliwa, taratibu za deactivation zinafuatwa kabla ya kazi nyingine yoyote, na MEL zilizobaki zimalizwe.
summary: Wakati wa kazi za matengenezo zilizoingiliana kwenye ndege ya B737-400, kusahaulika kwa deactivation ya leading edge kulisababisha slats kujitokeza na kuharibu thrust reverser ya engine namba moja, na MEL kadhaa bado zinasubiri kufuatiliwa.

entities.text: brake ya main gear namba moja
tire ya main gear namba mbili
thrust reverser ya ndani ya engine namba moja

narrative_text: Tulikuwa tuna-work hii B737-400 ya service check, tukiwa na #1 main gear brake inspection, tire change ya #2 main gear, na tuna-troubleshoot MEL za #1 engine igniter na generator, plus kulikuwa na ACARS ya pressurization issue kutoka kwa inbound crew. Kwa sababu ya multiple teams kufanya kazi kwa wakati mmoja on the aircraft, deactivation ya leading edge slats ilisahaulika kwa hiyo confusion ya tasks nyingi. Baadaye leading edge flaps zika-deploy na kuharibu inboard thrust reverser ya engine namba moja. Next shift wahakikishe wame-check extent ya damage, wafuate deactivation procedures kabla ya kuendelea na engine work, na wamalize MEL zingine zilizobaki.
summary: Wakati wa kazi nyingi zikiendelea kwa hiyo B737-400, deactivation ya leading edge ilisahaulika na ikasababisha slats ku-deploy na kuharibu thrust reverser ya engine namba moja, MEL kadhaa bado zina-pending follow-up.

entities.text: inboard thrust reverser ya engine namba moja

narrative_text: While covering as second shift crew chief on short notice, I was pulled into turnover and job assignments when ERJ 145 called in requesting a nose gear visual inspection following a towbar incident at the previous station. With no mechs free and the aircraft boarded, I went out myself, inspected the nose gear, found no abnormalities, and the captain felt no write-up was needed. Neither the crew's request nor my inspection got logged before release, so a second inspection had to be repeated later to confirm no defects. Next shift please ensure any verbal inspection requests on this tail are formally logged going forward.
summary: An undocumented nose gear inspection requested after a towbar incident led to a repeat inspection before dispatch.

narrative_text: Nilipokuwa nikisimamia kama kiongozi wa zamu ya pili kwa dharura, nilikuwa nikishughulikia makabidhiano na kugawa kazi wakati ndege ya ERJ 145 ilipoita ikiomba ukaguzi wa kuona wa gia ya pua baada ya tukio la towbar kituo kilichopita. Kwa kuwa hakuna fundi mwingine aliyekuwa huru na abiria walikuwa tayari wamepanda, nilienda mwenyewe, nikakagua gia hiyo, sikuona hitilafu yoyote, na kapteni akaona hakuna haja ya kuandika ripoti. Hata hivyo, wala ombi la wafanyakazi wa ndege wala ukaguzi wangu haukuandikwa kabla ya ndege kuruhusiwa kuruka, hivyo ukaguzi ulirudiwa baadaye kuthibitisha hakuna hitilafu. Zamu inayofuata itafute kuhakikisha maombi yoyote ya ukaguzi yanaandikwa rasmi.
summary: Ukaguzi wa gia ya pua uliofanywa bila kuandikwa baada ya tukio la towbar ulisababisha ukaguzi kurudiwa kabla ya ndege kuruhusiwa.

narrative_text: Nikiwa nime-cover kama second shift crew chief last minute, nilikuwa busy na turnover na kugawa jobs ndio ERJ 145 ika-call in ikiomba nose gear visual inspection baada ya towbar incident station iliyopita. Kwa sababu hakukuwa na mech ye yote free na aircraft ilikuwa already boarded, nilienda mwenyewe, nika-inspect gear, sikupata abnormalities, na captain akasema hana haja ya write-up. Issue ni kwamba request ya crew na inspection yangu hazikuwahi ku-documented before release, so ikabidi tu-repeat inspection later kuconfirm no defects. Zamu inayofuata please hakikisheni verbal requests za inspection zina-logged properly kwenye maintenance log.
summary: Nose gear inspection ilifanywa baada ya towbar incident lakini haikuandikwa, hivyo ikabidi i-repeat kabla ya dispatch.

narrative_text: Overnight shift adjusted the L1 door stops on the MD-80 per the job card, with a second mechanic assisting under the assumption this was a routine door rig. The prior write-up actually referenced a failed running torque check on the door set screws, but this detail was not passed on at turnover, so the rig was completed per the maintenance manual without replacing any hardware. Discrepancy was caught the following night; aircraft did not fly in this condition and new set screws/nuts have now been ordered. Follow-up: door inspection required once parts arrive, and turnover notes need to specify running torque failures and manual references going forward.
summary: A door rig on an MD-80 was completed without addressing a set-screw running torque failure because the turnover note lacked technical detail, requiring new parts and a follow-up inspection.

narrative_text: Tuliwekewa kazi ya kurekebisha L1 door stops kwenye ndege ya MD-80 kama ilivyoandikwa kwenye job card, na fundi mwingine alitumwa kutusaidia akidhani ni door rig ya kawaida. Maandishi ya awali ya matengenezo kwa kweli yalihusu set screws zilizoshindwa 'running torque check', lakini taarifa hii haikuelezwa vizuri wakati wa turnover, hivyo tuliendelea kurekebisha mlango kwa mujibu wa maintenance manual bila kubadilisha vipuri. Tatizo liligundulika usiku uliofuata, ndege haikuruka katika hali hiyo, na vipuri vipya vimeshaagizwa. Kinachosubiriwa: ukaguzi wa mlango baada ya vipuri kufika, na turnover notes zinahitaji kuwa na maelezo zaidi ya kiufundi pamoja na rejea za maintenance manual.
summary: Marekebisho ya mlango wa MD-80 yalifanywa bila kushughulikia tatizo la set screws kwa sababu turnover haikuwa na maelezo ya kutosha, hivyo vipuri vipya vimeagizwa na ukaguzi unasubiriwa.

narrative_text: Jana usiku tulipewa job ya kuadjust L1 door stops kwenye MD-80 kulingana na job card, na mechanic mwingine akaja kuassist akifikiri ni door rig tu ya kawaida. Turns out ile maandishi ya awali ilikuwa inarefer kwa set screws ambazo zilifail ile running torque check, lakini hiyo detail haikuwekwa clearly kwenye turnover, so tukafanya rig kama per maintenance manual bila kuorder parts mpya. Tulidiscover discrepancy hiyo usiku uliofuata - aircraft haikufly hivyo, na parts mpya zimeagizwa sasa. Follow-up: door inspection lazima ifanyike parts zikifika, na next time turnover sheet iwe na technical details na maintenance manual references ziko clear.
summary: Door rig ya MD-80 ilifanywa bila kuaddress tatizo la set screws kwa sababu turnover haikuwa na details za kutosha, hivyo parts mpya zimeorder na inspection inasubiriwa.

narrative_text: While reviewing the work package for the Dash 8-400 (job card for the tail cone repair), I missed checking the RII buyback, major repair sign-off, and airworthiness release before shift end. I handed the incomplete package to the swing shift supervisor at 1800, who caught the discrepancies after the aircraft had already departed at 0100. A mechanic had to be dispatched to the diversion station to complete the RII inspection and issue the major repair airworthiness release. Next shift please note we need better paperwork review support during the day, as workload and constant callouts are causing packages to be missed.
summary: A lead technician missed reviewing critical RII and airworthiness paperwork on a Dash 8-400 tail cone repair before the aircraft departed, requiring a mechanic to be sent to the diversion station to close it out.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kukagua kifurushi cha kazi cha ndege ya Dash 8-400 kinachohusiana na ukarabati wa tail cone, sikuweza kukamilisha ukaguzi wa RII buyback, uthibitisho wa ukarabati mkubwa, na cheti cha uwezo wa kurudi kwa ndege kabla ya mabadiliko ya zamu. Nilikabidhi kifurushi hicho kwa msimamizi wa zamu ya jioni saa sita mchana, ambaye alibaini makosa hayo baada ya ndege kuwa imeondoka tayari saa saba usiku. Fundi mmoja alilazimika kutumwa kituo cha dharura kukamilisha ukaguzi wa RII na kutoa cheti cha uwezo wa kurudi kwa ndege. Zamu inayokuja tafadhali zingatieni haja ya usaidizi zaidi wa kukagua nyaraka mchana kwa sababu shughuli nyingi na simu za mara kwa mara zinasababisha makosa kama haya.
summary: Msimamizi mkuu wa ufundi alishindwa kukagua nyaraka muhimu za RII na uwezo wa kurudi kwa ndege ya Dash 8-400 kabla ya kuondoka, hivyo fundi alihitajika kutumwa kituo kingine kukamilisha kazi hiyo.

entities.text: cheti cha uwezo wa kurudi kwa ndege

narrative_text: Nilikuwa nikireview work package ya Dash 8-400, job card ya tail cone repair, lakini sikupata time ya kucheck ile RII buyback, major repair sign-off, na airworthiness release kabla ya shift kuisha. Nikahand over package kwa swing shift supervisor saa sita mchana, na ndiye alicatch zile discrepancies baada ya aircraft kuwa imeondoka saa saba usiku. Mechanic alilazimika kutumwa kwa station ile ndege ilienda ili afanye RII na atoe airworthiness release ya major repair. Kwa next shift, tunahitaji msaada zaidi wa kureview paperwork mchana, coz workload ni mzito sana na maintenance control na ops wanacall constantly, hivyo packages zinapass bila kucheck properly.
summary: Lead technician alimiss kucheck RII buyback na airworthiness release kwenye Dash 8-400 tail cone repair kabla aircraft kuondoka, hivyo mechanic akatumwa station nyingine kukamilisha paperwork.

narrative_text: During weekend modification work on the Dash 8-400, the aft flight attendant seat bulkhead assembly was removed and reinstalled to allow underfloor repairs; the seatbelt was not reinstalled on that seat. The lead technician mentioned the missing belt to the tech handling the job but assumed it would be fixed before release, and it was missed during the final airworthiness walkaround before sign-off. Gate maintenance is now installing a new seatbelt and the flight is delayed; next shift please confirm belt installation and inspect all bulkhead hardware disturbed during the modification before further sign-off.
summary: A missing flight attendant seatbelt on a Dash 8-400 went unnoticed after bulkhead removal for underfloor repairs, due to a communication gap, requiring gate maintenance follow-up and delaying the flight.

narrative_text: Wakati wa marekebisho ya wikendi kwenye ndege ya Dash 8-400, kiti cha mhudumu wa ndege sehemu ya nyuma kiliondolewa pamoja na muundo wake wa bulkhead ili kuruhusu ukarabati chini ya sakafu, lakini mkanda wa usalama haukurudishwa baada ya kazi kukamilika. Fundi mkuu alimwambia fundi mwenzake kuhusu mkanda uliokosekana lakini alidhani ingeshughulikiwa kabla ndege haijatolewa, na jambo hilo lilikosekana pia wakati wa ukaguzi wa mwisho kabla ya kusaini kibali. Sasa matengenezo ya getini yanaweka mkanda mpya na ndege imecheleweshwa; zamu inayofuata ihakikishe mkanda umewekwa vizuri na ikague sehemu zote za bulkhead zilizoguswa wakati wa marekebisho kabla ya kutia sahihi tena.
summary: Mkanda wa usalama wa kiti cha mhudumu wa ndege kwenye Dash 8-400 ulikosekana baada ya ukarabati wa bulkhead kutokana na mawasiliano hafifu kati ya mafundi, hali iliyosababisha ndege kucheleweshwa hadi mkanda mpya uwekwe.

entities.text: kiti cha mhudumu wa ndege sehemu ya nyuma

narrative_text: Kwa hii weekend mod kwenye Dash 8-400, wale walitoa ile bulkhead assembly ya aft FA seat kufanya underfloor repairs, lakini seatbelt haikurudishwa baada ya job kukamilika. Nilimwambia yule fundi anayehandle job kwamba seat inahitaji belt, nikadhani atafix before release, but tuka-miss during final walkaround before sign-off. Sasa gate maintenance wanainstall belt mpya na flight imedelay; next shift please confirm belt installation na icheki bulkhead hardware zote zilizoguswa during mod kabla ya sign-off ingine.
summary: Seatbelt ya FA seat kwenye Dash 8-400 ilikosekana baada ya bulkhead removal kwa underfloor repairs due to miscommunication, na flight imedelay mpaka gate maintenance waweke belt mpya.

narrative_text: During the B757 door 1R escape slide change, we pinned the door assist bottle using two bolts instead of the proper MM pin since none were available, but did not attach safety streamers since we expected to finish the job ourselves. The ceiling panel near the main entrance was closed afterward to prevent head strikes, so the bolts were never visually confirmed or removed by the next shift. Aircraft continued flying until C-check, where the bolts were discovered still installed in the bottle. Next shift must always verify and remove all temporary pins/bolts on the door assist bottle before closing panels, and streamers must be used regardless of expected job completion.
summary: A B757 door slide bottle was pinned with unmarked bolts instead of proper pins during a slide change, and the omission went undetected for the panel closure until discovered at C-check.

entities.text: ceiling panel near the main entrance

narrative_text: Wakati wa kubadilisha slide ya mlango 1R kwenye ndege ya B757, tulitumia boliti mbili badala ya pin sahihi ya bottle ya door assist kwa sababu pin haikupatikana, lakini hatukuweka streamer za usalama kwa kuwa tulitarajia kumaliza kazi wenyewe. Baada ya hapo tulifunga panel ya juu karibu na mlango mkuu ili kuzuia watu kugonga vichwa, hivyo boliti hazikuthibitishwa au kutolewa na zamu iliyofuata. Ndege iliendelea kufanya safari mpaka ilipoenda C-check ndipo boliti zikagundulika bado zimewekwa kwenye bottle. Zamu inayofuata inapaswa kuhakikisha pins/boliti zote za muda zinatolewa kabla ya kufunga paneli, na streamer lazima zitumike hata kama kazi inatarajiwa kukamilika mara moja.
summary: Bottle ya door assist ya B757 iliwekewa boliti badala ya pin sahihi wakati wa kubadilisha slide, na jambo hilo halikugunduliwa mpaka ndege ilipofika C-check.

entities.text: panel ya juu karibu na mlango mkuu

narrative_text: Tulikuwa tunafanya door 1R slide change kwa B757, tukatumia bolts mbili kwa ku-pin ile door assist bottle badala ya proper pin kwa sababu haikuwa available, lakini hatukuweka streamers coz tulitegemea kumaliza job wenyewe. Then tukafunga ile ceiling panel karibu na main entrance ili watu wasigonge vichwa, so bolts hazikuwa verified au removed na next shift. Ndege iliendelea kufly mpaka ikaenda C-check ndio wakagundua bolts bado ziko kwa bottle. Next shift lazima wa-check na kutoa hizo pins/bolts zote kabla ya ku-close panel, na streamers zi-installed always regardless ya expectation ya kumaliza job.
summary: Wakati wa B757 door slide change, bottle ilipinned na bolts bila streamer, na iko missed mpaka C-check ndipo ikagunduliwa.

entities.text: ceiling panel karibu na main entrance

narrative_text: B757-200 nose gear steering valve job (from the July pressurization air turn-back) was handed over mid-task, with the steering valve cover panel already partially removed by the previous shift. Incoming tech completed the panel removal, found and fixed a sticking towing bypass lever (seals replaced, leak/ops check good), then reinstalled that cover and signed off the write-up. It was later realized the panel actually referenced in the write-up is a separate one on the forward left side of the nosewheel well, not the one that was closed out - no maintenance manual reference was available to confirm panel location at the time. Next shift needs to verify which panel corresponds to the open write-up item and confirm proper closure, referencing the maintenance manual for exact panel location before sign-off.
summary: A technician mistakenly signed off the wrong nose gear steering valve panel on a B757-200 due to lack of clear maintenance manual location reference, leaving the actual write-up panel in the nosewheel well unconfirmed.

entities.text: forward left side of the nosewheel well

narrative_text: Kazi ya kubadilisha steering valve ya nose gear kwenye ndege B757-200, iliyotokana na tukio la kurudi hewani mwezi Julai kwa sababu ya kushindwa kubana hewa, ilikutwa ikiendelea kutoka shift iliyopita, huku kifuniko cha steering valve kikiwa kimeanza kuondolewa. Fundi aliyeingia zamu aliendelea kuondoa kifuniko hicho, akagundua towing bypass lever ilikuwa inakwama, na pamoja na fundi mwenzake wakabadilisha seals na kufanya ukaguzi wa uvujaji ambao ulionyesha hali nzuri, kisha wakarudisha kifuniko na kusaini kazi kama imekamilika. Baadaye ilibainika kuwa panel iliyotajwa kwenye write-up halisi iko upande wa mbele kushoto wa nosewheel well, tofauti na ile iliyofungwa - hakukuwa na rejea ya maintenance manual kuonyesha eneo sahihi la panel hiyo wakati huo. Zamu inayofuata inahitajika kuthibitisha ni panel gani hasa inayohusika na write-up, na kuhakikisha imefungwa ipasavyo kwa kutumia maintenance manual kuonyesha eneo kamili kabla ya kusaini.
summary: Fundi alisaini kwa makosa panel isiyo sahihi ya steering valve ya nose gear kwenye B757-200 kutokana na kukosekana kwa rejea wazi ya eneo la panel, na hivyo kuacha panel halisi iliyoandikwa kwenye write-up ikiwa haijathibitishwa.

narrative_text: Ile job ya ku-change nose gear steering valve kwa B757-200, ambayo ilitokana na ile air turn-back ya July kwa sababu ndege ilishindwa ku-pressurize, nilikuta imeshaanzishwa na previous shift, panel ya steering valve cover ikiwa imeanza kutolewa. Nikamalizia kutoa ile cover, nikagundua towing bypass lever inasticking, so mimi na AMT mwenzangu tuka-replace seals na ku-do leak check, ikaonyesha ok. Nikarudisha ile panel na ku-sign off write-up, lakini baadaye ikagundulika kwamba panel halisi iliyoandikwa kwenye write-up iko forward left side ya nosewheel well, si ile niliyofunga - hapakuwa na maintenance manual reference ya kuonyesha location ya hiyo panel. Next shift lazima wa-confirm ni panel gani hasa inahusiana na open write-up item na wa-verify imefungwa properly, wakiangalia maintenance manual kwa exact location kabla ya kusign off.
summary: Fundi alisign off panel mbaya ya nose gear steering valve kwa B757-200 kwa sababu hakukuwa na clear reference ya location kwenye maintenance manual, hivyo ile actual panel iliyo kwenye write-up bado haijaconfirm.

narrative_text: Overnight shift completed installation of the No. 1 engine top mount on the Q400, following AMM tasks with guidance from the outgoing mechanic since I had not performed this task before; alignment was difficult but mount was torqued and cotter-pinned, and QC inspector signed it off as good. We then moved on to the spoiler tensioning task pending the 24-hr soak time. Next shift should be aware that another technician and QC later flagged a possible improper installation of the L-hand top engine mount; it was re-inspected and found acceptable, but please verify engine #1 mount integrity again before further work.
summary: Engine #1 top mount was installed and signed off as good, but a later concern about the L-hand mount was raised and re-cleared, so the mount should be re-checked by the next shift.

narrative_text: Zamu ya usiku ilikamilisha ufungaji wa mount ya juu ya injini namba moja ya ndege ya Q400, tukifuata maelekezo ya AMM baada ya fundi wa zamu iliyopita kunielekeza kwa kuwa sikuwahi kufanya kazi hiyo hapo awali; kulikuwa na changamoto ya ulinganifu lakini mount ilikaziwa na kuwekwa cotter pin, na mkaguzi wa ubora akaithibitisha kuwa nzuri. Baadaye tulihamia kazi ya spoiler tensioning huku tukisubiri muda wa saa 24 wa soaking. Zamu ijayo inapaswa kufahamu kuwa fundi mwingine pamoja na mkaguzi wa ubora baadaye waligundua dalili za ufungaji usiofaa wa mount ya juu upande wa kushoto wa injini; ilikaguliwa tena na kuonekana sawa, lakini ni vyema kuthibitisha tena hali ya mount hiyo kabla ya kazi zaidi.
summary: Mount ya juu ya injini namba moja ilifungwa na kuthibitishwa kuwa nzuri, lakini baadaye kulitokea wasiwasi kuhusu mount ya upande wa kushoto ambayo ilikaguliwa tena, hivyo inahitaji uhakiki zaidi na zamu inayofuata.

entities.text: mount ya juu ya injini namba moja
mount ya juu upande wa kushoto wa injini

narrative_text: Zamu ya usiku tulifanya installation ya top engine mount ya engine number one kwa Q400, tukifollow AMM tasks after previous shift mech ali-brief me kwa sababu sijawahi fanya hii kazi before. Kulikuwa na hard time kidogo na alignment lakini tuli-torque na cotter-pin as per AMM, na QC inspector ame-sign off kama nzuri. Baada ya hapo tuli-proceed na spoiler tensioning task huku tukisubiri ile 24-hr soak time. Next shift mjue kwamba baadaye technician na QC wengine walinotice possible improper installation ya L-hand top engine mount; iliverify tena ikaonekana OK, lakini ni vizuri mki-re-check engine #1 mounts kabla ya kuendelea na kazi.
summary: Top engine mount ya engine #1 iliinstall na kusign off as good, lakini kuna concern iliyoibuka baadaye kuhusu L-hand mount ambayo ime-re-inspect, hivyo next shift wanapaswa kuverify tena.

entities.text: top engine mount ya engine number one

narrative_text: On the MD-80, #2 engine CSD and generator were replaced and serviced per manual after ZZZ found a loose B-nut at the CSD oil cooler that had caused the CSD to run dry; this reason was never passed on to the AMTs assigned the swap. Leak and ops check after engine run showed no leaks and oil stayed in the green band, so the job was closed and paperwork signed off. Next shift/AMTs should be briefed on the root cause (loose B-nut) before similar tasks, and the oil cooler B-nut torque should be re-verified to rule out recurrence.
summary: CSD/generator on #2 engine were changed without technicians being told the root cause was a loose B-nut at the oil cooler that ran the CSD dry, so follow-up briefing and B-nut check are needed.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya MD-80, CSD na generator ya engine namba mbili zilibadilishwa na kuhudumiwa kwa mujibu wa manual, baada ya wafanyakazi wa ZZZ kugundua B-nut iliyokuwa legelege kwenye oil cooler ambayo ilisababisha CSD kukosa mafuta kabisa; sababu hii haikuwahi kufikishwa kwa mafundi waliopewa kazi ya kubadilisha vipengele hivyo. Ukaguzi wa uvujaji na uendeshaji baada ya kuwasha engine ulionyesha hakuna uvujaji na kiwango cha mafuta kilikuwa sawa, hivyo kazi ilifungwa na fomu zikasainiwa. Shift inayokuja inapaswa kujulishwa chanzo halisi cha tatizo (B-nut legelege) kabla ya kazi kama hiyo, na ukakamilifu wa B-nut hiyo kwenye oil cooler uangaliwe upya kuzuia kujirudia.
summary: CSD na generator ya engine namba mbili zilibadilishwa bila mafundi kujulishwa kuwa chanzo cha tatizo ni B-nut legelege kwenye oil cooler, hivyo inahitajika taarifa zaidi na ukaguzi wa ziada.

narrative_text: Kwa MD-80, tulichange #2 engine CSD na generator kama per manual, baada ya wale wa ZZZ kupata loose B-nut kwa oil cooler ambayo ndio ilifanya CSD irun dry completely; issue hii haikuwahi kutold kwa AMTs walioassignwa job hiyo. Leak and ops check baada ya engine run ilikuwa clean, hakuna leak, na oil level ilikuwa in the green band, so job ikaclose na paperwork ikasignwa. Next shift washauriwe about root cause (loose B-nut) before wanaanza kazi kama hii, na B-nut ya oil cooler icheckwe tena torque yake ili kuavoid recurrence.
summary: CSD na generator ya #2 engine zilichangwa bila AMTs kujuishwa kuwa root cause ni loose B-nut kwa oil cooler, so follow-up briefing na re-check ya B-nut inahitajika.

narrative_text: During RII inspection of the CRJ700 left-hand wing 1-3 Slat Track rub blocks, inspector found reinstalled worn rub blocks that had been hand-ground and polished to a new profile with no approved data. Mechanic and Maintenance Lead could not produce documentation, and both Maintenance Supervisor and Line QC Lead dismissed concerns raised about non-compliance with Engineering's requirement to return worn parts for evaluation. These are flight-control load-bearing surfaces, so next shift must obtain approved engineering disposition before any further work is signed off.
summary: Inspector flagged undocumented re-profiling of slat track rub blocks on a CRJ700 and was rebuffed by supervision when requesting approved data.

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa RII kwenye bawa la kushoto la ndege CRJ700, sehemu ya 1-3 ya Slat Track, mkaguzi aligundua rub blocks za zamani zilizorudishwa lakini zikiwa zimechongwa kwa mkono na kung'arishwa kuwa umbo jipya bila nyaraka zozote za idhini. Fundi na Kiongozi wa Matengenezo hawakuweza kutoa uthibitisho wa maandishi, na Msimamizi wa Matengenezo pamoja na Kiongozi wa Udhibiti wa Ubora walikataa malalamiko kuhusu kutofuata agizo la Uhandisi la kurejesha vipande vilivyochakaa kwa tathmini. Kwa kuwa hivi ni vipengele muhimu vinavyobeba mzigo wa udhibiti wa ndege, zamu ijayo inapaswa kupata kibali rasmi cha kihandisi kabla ya kazi yoyote zaidi kuidhinishwa.
summary: Mkaguzi aligundua urekebishaji usio na nyaraka wa rub blocks za slat track kwenye CRJ700 na akakataliwa na wasimamizi alipoomba idhini rasmi.

narrative_text: Wakati wa RII inspection kwenye left wing ya CRJ700, sehemu ya 1-3 Slat Track, niliona zile rub blocks ni za zamani, zimereinstall lakini zimefilewa na kupolishwa kuwa profile mpya bila approved data yoyote. Nikamuuliza Mechanic na Maintenance Lead wanipe documentation, wakakataa, hata Maintenance Supervisor na Line QC Lead walipokuja walidismiss concerns zangu kuhusu Engineering's requirement ya kurudisha worn parts kwa evaluation. Hizi ni flight control load bearing surfaces, kwa hivyo next shift inafaa ipate engineering disposition approved kabla ya kusign off kazi yoyote zaidi.
summary: Inspector aliflag undocumented modification ya slat track rub blocks kwenye CRJ700 na akarefusiwa na supervision alipoomba approved data.

narrative_text: A319 arrived requiring an MEL for a previous powerplant fire/overheat warning fault, per Maintenance Control, but boarding had already started before the Lead reached the aircraft. While handling an engine HPTCC replacement on another aircraft, the Lead coordinated by phone with Maintenance Control and applied MEL #26-12-01b from the jetway phone without the MEL book in hand, relying entirely on verbal guidance. Please confirm the logbook entry wording was correctly transcribed and verify no special maintenance procedures were missed during the phone-in MEL process.
summary: Lead Technician applied an MEL for a powerplant overheat warning fault on an A319 by phone, without direct access to the MEL manual, while juggling another aircraft's engine repair, requiring follow-up verification of the logbook entry.

narrative_text: Ndege ya A319 ilifika ikihitaji MEL kwa tatizo la awali la onyo la moto/joto kali la injini, kama Maintenance Control walivyoeleza, lakini abiria walikuwa tayari wanaanza kuingia kabla Lead hajafika kwenye ndege. Wakati huo huo, Lead alikuwa anashughulikia ubadilishaji wa HPTCC ya injini ya kushoto kwenye ndege nyingine, hivyo aliwasiliana na Maintenance Control kwa simu na kuweka MEL namba 26-12-01b akiwa kwenye simu ya jetway bila kitabu cha MEL mkononi. Inahitajika ukaguzi wa haraka kuhakikisha maneno yaliyoandikwa kwenye logbook ni sahihi na kwamba hakuna hatua maalum za matengenezo zilizosahaulika wakati wa mchakato huo wa simu.
summary: Kiongozi wa ufundi aliweka MEL kwa tatizo la onyo la moto la injini kwenye ndege ya A319 kwa njia ya simu bila kitabu cha MEL, huku pia akishughulikia ukarabati wa injini kwenye ndege nyingine, hivyo inahitajika uthibitisho wa maandishi ya logbook.

entities.text: onyo la moto/joto kali la injini

narrative_text: Hii A319 ilifika na iko na issue ya zamani ya powerplant fire/overheat warning, Maintenance Control walisema lazima tu-apply MEL, lakini boarding ilikuwa imeanza kabla Lead hajaifikia aircraft. Wakati huo Lead alikuwa busy na HPTCC replacement ya left engine kwa ndege ingine, so akaenda ku-coordinate na Maintenance Control kwa simu na aka-apply MEL #26-12-01b akiwa jetway phone bila hata MEL book, akitegemea tu verbal guidance kutoka kwa controller. Tafadhali confirm logbook entry imeandikwa sawa na check kama kulikuwa na special procedures ambazo zilipita bila kufanywa during hiyo phone-in MEL process.
summary: Lead alifanya MEL apply kwa A319 kwa powerplant overheat warning issue kwa njia ya simu bila MEL book mkononi, wakati akihandle pia engine repair ya ndege ingine, so logbook entry inahitaji verification.

narrative_text: B737-700 has the RH main landing gear inner door removed under CDL 32-10-3B, which requires daily greasing of the Fuel Crossfeed Valve Actuator Shaft with logbook sign-off. Line Maintenance Coordinator was called at approx 0050 and told the daily task had not been done and must be completed and logged before midnight. On shift turnover review of Maintenance Compliance Systems, the entry showed the grease application logged a day late, meaning the CDL requirement was missed for that day. Incoming shift needs to verify current compliance status, correct the log entry discrepancy, and confirm daily tracking is back on schedule.
summary: A daily CDL-required greasing task on the Fuel Crossfeed Valve Actuator Shaft was missed and logged a day late, requiring follow-up verification and correction.

narrative_text: Ndege ya B737-700 ina mlango wa ndani wa gia ya kutua upande wa kulia ukiwa umeondolewa kwa mujibu wa CDL 32-10-3B, ambayo inahitaji mafuta ya grisi kuwekwa kila siku kwenye shafti ya kiendeshi cha valvu ya crossfeed ya mafuta, na kuandikwa kwenye kumbukumbu. Msimamizi wa Matengenezo ya Line alipigiwa simu saa saba na dakika hamsini usiku na kuambiwa kazi ya siku hiyo bado haijafanyika na lazima ikamilishwe na kuandikwa kabla ya saa sita usiku. Wakati wa ukaguzi wa mabadiliko ya zamu kwenye mfumo wa ufuatiliaji wa utii, ilibainika kuwa uwekaji wa grisi uliandikwa siku moja baadaye, hivyo kuonyesha kazi ya siku hiyo haikutimizwa kama ilivyotakiwa. Zamu inayoingia inahitajika kuthibitisha hali ya sasa ya utii, kurekebisha hitilafu ya kumbukumbu, na kuhakikisha ufuatiliaji wa kila siku umerejea sawa.
summary: Kazi ya kila siku ya kuweka grisi kwenye shafti ya valvu ya crossfeed ilikosekana na kuandikwa siku moja baadaye, hivyo inahitaji ufuatiliaji na urekebishaji.

entities.text: shafti ya kiendeshi cha valvu ya crossfeed ya mafuta
saa saba na dakika hamsini usiku

narrative_text: Hii B737-700 iko na RH main landing gear inner door imeremovwa kwa mujibu wa CDL 32-10-3B, ambayo inahitaji daily greasing ya Fuel Crossfeed Valve Actuator Shaft na lazima iwe logged. Nilipiga call Line Maintenance Coordinator around 0050 nikamwambia hio daily task bado haijafanywa, so lazima icompletiwe na kulogiwa kabla ya midnight. Nikiwa nachecki Maintenance Compliance Systems wakati wa turnover, niliona hio entry ya grease imelog siku moja late, so ile CDL requirement ilikuwa missed for that day. Zamu inayokuja iangalie compliance status ya sasa, ifix hiyo log discrepancy, na iconfirm daily tracking iko sawa tena.
summary: Daily CDL task ya kugrease Fuel Crossfeed Valve Actuator Shaft ilimissiwa na kulogiwa late, hivyo inahitaji follow-up na correction.

narrative_text: During trim troubleshooting on the B757-200, the rudder LVDT was replaced at shift change but the outgoing mechanic did not sign for the installation, so I verified his work and countersigned per the General Manual before briefing the oncoming crew on required rig and operational checks. The next crew found that LVDT faulty, installed a new one, and signed it off as serviceable in the logbook, but the RII block was never signed off since the LVDT is not clearly listed as an RII item near the autopilot system. Please review the logbook entry and confirm RII sign-off is completed, and flag this ambiguity in the manual for clarification.
summary: An unsigned RII inspection on a replaced rudder LVDT was missed during shift handover due to unclear manual guidance and needs follow-up sign-off.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kutafuta hitilafu ya trim kwenye B757-200, LVDT ya rudder ilibadilishwa wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu lakini fundi aliyeondoka hakusaini usakinishaji, hivyo nilikagua kazi yake na kutia sahihi kulingana na General Manual kabla ya kuwaeleza zamu inayofuata kuhusu ukaguzi wa rig na uendeshaji unaohitajika. Zamu iliyofuata ilikuta LVDT hiyo ni mbovu, wakaweka mpya, na kuisaini kwenye logbook kama salama, lakini sehemu ya RII haikutiwa sahihi kwa sababu LVDT haionekani wazi kama kipengele cha RII karibu na mfumo wa autopilot. Tafadhali kagua logbook na thibitisha sahihi ya RII imekamilika, na uarifu utata huu kwenye manual ili ufafanuliwe.
summary: Ukaguzi wa RII kwa LVDT ya rudder iliyobadilishwa haukusainiwa wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu kutokana na maelekezo yasiyo wazi kwenye manual, hivyo unahitaji ufuatiliaji.

narrative_text: Wakati tunacheck trim problem kwenye B757-200, rudder LVDT ilibadilishwa during shift change lakini yule mechanic hakusign installation, so nili-verify kazi yake na kuweka sahihi yangu kama General Manual inavyosema, kisha nikabrief oncoming crew kuhusu rig na operational checks required. Crew ya next ika-find hiyo LVDT ni bad, wakaweka new one, wakai-sign off kwenye logbook kama serviceable, lakini RII block haikusainiwa kwa sababu LVDT haiko clearly listed as RII item karibu na autopilot system. Please recheck logbook entry uconfirm RII sign-off imefanywa, na uflag hii ambiguity kwenye manual for clarification.
summary: RII sign-off ya rudder LVDT iliyobadilishwa ilikosekana during shift handover kwa sababu ya manual isiyo clear, inahitaji follow-up.

narrative_text: On B777-200, forward cargo pit ceiling wiring repair was completed at end of an extended shift with no turnover received from the previous crew. Two damaged wires were spliced per General Manual 2-0-15, and the two damaged C2 hydraulic pump cables were spliced with AMP copalum splices per SWPM 20-30-13 and signed off; a third small wire near the C2 cables with slight insulation discoloration was Teflon-taped but its write-up was inadvertently not documented. Aircraft was unpowered throughout so the hydraulic pump could not be functionally checked; incoming crew must verify close-up/securing of the area, confirm the untagged third wire write-up, and perform hydraulic pump operational check once powered.
summary: Incomplete documentation and unverified hydraulic pump function following overnight wiring repair on B777-200 forward cargo pit, requiring follow-up by next crew.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya B777-200, ukarabati wa nyaya kwenye dari ya sehemu ya mizigo mbele ulifanywa mwishoni mwa zamu ndefu, bila taarifa yoyote kutoka kwa wafanyakazi wa awali. Nyaya mbili zilizoharibika zilikarabatiwa kulingana na General Manual 2-0-15, na nyaya mbili za pampu ya hydraulic C2 zilikarabatiwa kwa splice za AMP copalum kulingana na SWPM 20-30-13 na kusainiwa, lakini waya wa tatu wenye alama ndogo ya kuharibika haukuandikwa kwenye ripoti kwa bahati mbaya. Ndege haikuwa na umeme wakati wote hivyo pampu ya hydraulic haikuweza kujaribiwa; zamu inayofuata inahitaji kuthibitisha kufungwa kwa eneo hilo, kuandika taarifa ya waya wa tatu, na kufanya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa pampu ya hydraulic mara umeme utakaporudishwa.
summary: Ukarabati wa nyaya kwenye B777-200 uliachwa bila taarifa kamili na bila kuthibitishwa utendaji wa pampu ya hydraulic, hivyo zamu inayofuata inahitaji kufuatilia.

entities.text: nyaya kwenye dari ya sehemu ya mizigo mbele
nyaya za pampu ya hydraulic C2
splice za AMP copalum kulingana na SWPM 20-30-13
ukaguzi wa utendaji wa pampu ya hydraulic

narrative_text: Kwa B777-200, tulikarabati wiring kwenye forward cargo pit ceiling mwishoni mwa shift ndefu bila turnover kutoka crew ya awali. Zile wires mbili zilikuwa spliced per General Manual 2-0-15, na zile C2 hydraulic pump cables mbili zilifanyiwa AMP copalum splices per SWPM 20-30-13 kisha ku-sign off, lakini ile third wire ndogo iliyokuwa na discoloration kidogo ilifunikwa na Teflon tape na sikuandika write-up yake kwa mistake. Aircraft haikuwa na power wakati wote so hatukuweza ku-check hydraulic pump operation; next crew wahakikishe close-up ya area, wajaze write-up ya ile third wire, na wafanye operational check ya hydraulic pump aircraft ikipata power.
summary: Baada ya wiring repair kwenye B777-200, kuna write-up ilikosekana na hydraulic pump haijachekiwa, so next crew wanahitaji ku-follow up.

narrative_text: B737-800 right-hand main gear speed brake interlock cable was routed but left uninstalled/unadjusted at end of day shift; work interruption card was written and verbal handover given to swing shift lead detailing remaining task. Next day found cable attached and safetied, with the interlock adjustment already signed off as complete, so gear door installation and rigging proceeded on that basis. Aircraft later experienced right gear retraction failure and air return; suspect the interlock adjustment signoff was made without proper verification. Follow-up: audit signoff on speed brake interlock cable installation/adjustment and reinforce shift handover documentation for incomplete gear tasks.
summary: Improper handover and unverified signoff on a speed brake interlock cable installation led to a gear retraction failure and air return on a B737-800.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya B737-800, kebo ya interlock ya speed brake kwa gear ya kulia ilikuwa imepitishwa lakini haikuwekwa wala kurekebishwa kikamilifu mwishoni mwa shift. Kadi ya usumbufu wa kazi iliandikwa na maelezo ya mdomo yalitolewa kwa lead wa swing shift kuhusu kazi iliyobaki. Siku iliyofuata, kebo ilionekana imefungwa na kusafishwa (safetied), na sehemu ya marekebisho ilikuwa tayari imesainiwa kama imekamilika, hivyo kazi ya kufunga milango ya gear na kuipanga (rigging) iliendelea kwa msingi huo. Baadaye ndege ilirudi uwanjani (air return) kwa sababu ya hitilafu ya kurudisha gear ya kulia; inashukiwa saini ya marekebisho ilitolewa bila uthibitisho sahihi. Hatua inayofuata: kufanya ukaguzi wa saini kwenye ufungaji wa kebo ya interlock na kuboresha mawasiliano ya kazi zisizokamilika baina ya zamu.
summary: Mawasiliano hafifu wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu na saini isiyothibitishwa kwenye kebo ya interlock ya speed brake vilisababisha hitilafu ya gear na kurudi kwa ndege ya B737-800.

entities.text: kebo ya interlock ya speed brake
kufunga milango ya gear na kuipanga

narrative_text: Kwa B737-800, ile speed brake interlock cable ya right gear tuliipitisha lakini hatukuweza ku-install na ku-adjust kabla ya shift kuisha. Niliandika work interruption card na nikatoa verbal handover kwa swing shift lead kuhusu kazi iliyobaki. Next day nikakuta cable imeshikwa na kusafetiwa, na interlock adjustment ilikuwa already signed off as complete, so tukaendelea na gear door installation na rigging tukiamini iko sawa. Baadaye aircraft ikapata right gear retraction failure na air return; inaonekana ile signoff ilifanywa bila proper verification. Follow-up inahitajika: audit ya signoff kwenye interlock cable installation, na tuboreshe communication during shift handover kwa open tasks.
summary: Communication breakdown wakati wa shift handover na signoff isiyo-verified kwenye speed brake interlock cable ndio ilisababisha gear retraction failure na air return kwa B737-800.

narrative_text: MD-80 stabilizer trim primary drive motor was replaced after 7 hours of troubleshooting a PIREP reporting trim operating in one direction only; work was done in poor weather (high wind, snow, cold) and near shift end. Trim was checked and operated in both directions during checkout, but the part number effectivity for the newer MD-80 configuration versus the legacy motor was not verified, and the trim speed difference was not evaluated. Next shift must confirm correct part number/serial number against aircraft effectivity records and re-verify trim speed against spec before releasing the aircraft.
summary: Stabilizer trim drive motor replacement on MD-80 was completed under time and weather pressure without confirming correct part effectivity or trim speed, requiring follow-up verification.

narrative_text: Tulifanya kazi kwa masaa saba tukitatua tatizo la ndege ya MD-80 ambapo ripoti ya rubani ilionyesha stabilizer trim inafanya kazi upande mmoja tu; hatimaye motor kuu ya stabilizer trim ilibadilishwa katika hali ngumu ya hewa yenye baridi kali, upepo mkali na theluji, karibu na mwisho wa zamu. Wakati wa ukaguzi, trim ilijaribiwa pande zote mbili na ilionekana sawa, lakini hatukuthibitisha kama namba ya part inaendana na muundo mpya wa MD-80 wala kuangalia tofauti ya kasi ya trim. Zamu inayofuata inatakiwa kuthibitisha upya namba ya part na serial dhidi ya rekodi za ndege, na kupima kasi ya trim kabla ya kuruhusu ndege kuruka.
summary: Ubadilishaji wa motor ya stabilizer trim kwenye MD-80 ulifanyika chini ya shinikizo la muda na hali mbaya ya hewa bila kuthibitisha usahihi wa part, hivyo inahitaji ufuatiliaji zaidi.

narrative_text: Tuli-troubleshoot MD-80 kwa saa saba nzima kwa sababu ya PIREP ya stabilizer trim kufanya kazi one direction tu; mwisho tuka-replace ile primary drive motor, lakini weather ilikuwa mbaya sana - baridi, upepo mkali na snow, na tulikuwa tunataka kumaliza kwa haraka since ilikuwa near end of shift. Wakati wa checkout, trim ili-operate vizuri pande zote mbili, lakini hatukuchunguza kama part number ya hii motor mpya ina-match effectivity ya MD-80 hii, wala speed difference ya trim mpya. Next shift wa-verify part number na serial dhidi ya manual ya effectivity, then wa-recheck trim speed before release.
summary: Waliweka replacement drive motor kwenye MD-80 wakiwa under time pressure na weather mbaya bila kuconfirm part effectivity, so next shift lazima wa-verify.

narrative_text: Took over the down-line fuel tank slat can repair on the B737-300 and found no turnover from the previous crew; paperwork was incomplete and parts were scattered. The tank had already been open over 18 hours with no tank sniffer check done, and in the confusion a confined space entry form was never completed. Repair was finished and Maintenance Control approved ferrying the aircraft with borrowed slat cans, but next shift must verify confined space entry documentation is closed out and review down-line crew continuity procedures.
summary: Down-line slat can repair on a B737-300 was completed despite missing turnover, scattered parts, and a skipped confined space entry form, requiring follow-up on documentation and crew continuity procedures.

narrative_text: Nilipokea kazi ya ukarabati wa slat can kwenye tanki la mafuta la ndege ya B737-300 mahali pa 'down-line' bila mkabidhi wowote kutoka kwa zamu iliyotangulia; makaratasi yalikuwa hayajakamilika na vipuri vilikuwa vimetapakaa ovyo. Tanki lilikuwa limefunguliwa kwa zaidi ya masaa 18 bila kufanyiwa ukaguzi wa hewa, na kwa sababu ya machafuko hayo fomu ya kuingia eneo lenye hatari (confined space entry) haikujazwa kabisa. Ukarabati ulikamilishwa na Maintenance Control wakaruhusu ndege kusafirishwa kwa kutumia slat cans za mkopo, lakini zamu inayokuja lazima ihakikishe fomu hiyo imekamilika na kupitia upya utaratibu wa mwendelezo wa wafanyakazi kwenye kazi za 'down-line'.
summary: Ukarabati wa slat can kwenye tanki la mafuta la B737-300 ulikamilishwa licha ya kukosekana kwa mkabidhi, vipuri vilivyotapakaa, na fomu ya eneo hatari isiyojazwa, hivyo kuhitaji ufuatiliaji wa nyaraka na taratibu za wafanyakazi.

entities.text: fomu ya kuingia eneo lenye hatari

narrative_text: Nilipata hii job ya slat can repair kwa fuel tank ya B737-300 down-line lakini hakuna turnover kutoka crew iliyotangulia; paperwork ilikuwa messed up na parts zimetapakaa kila mahali. Tank ilikuwa imekaa open zaidi ya 18 hours bila tank sniffer check, na kwa hii confusion yote tukakosa kufanya confined space entry form kabisa. Repair ilikamilika na Maintenance Control wakaapprove ferry flight ya aircraft na borrowed slat cans, but next shift wanahitaji kuconfirm hiyo entry form imefanywa na tuangalie crew continuity procedure kwa down-line jobs.
summary: Slat can repair kwa B737-300 down-line ilifanywa bila turnover proper na confined space entry form ikakosekana, so follow-up inahitajika kwa documentation na crew continuity.

narrative_text: ERJ145 had ADC #2 replaced this shift following an unclear turnover from days; unit was R&R'd and tested per AMM, but RII inspection was missed because I was assuming an outdated bulletin exempting single-line ADC swaps from RII. Lead was asked three times for an RII-qualified tech with barometer tester experience, and the mechanic eventually sent had never operated the equipment, causing delays. Aircraft departed before the missed RII was caught; QC flagged it later that evening, and it turns out the ADC is RVSM-sensitive too, which still needs clarification. Please follow up with QC and confirm current RVSM/RII paperwork status before further dispatch.
summary: ADC #2 replacement on an ERJ145 was completed without required RII inspection due to unclear guidance, staffing/qualification gaps, and confusion over RVSM sensitivity.

narrative_text: Ndege ya ERJ145 ilikuwa na tatizo la ADC namba mbili, na tulibadilisha kifaa hicho baada ya taarifa isiyo wazi kutoka kwa zamu ya kwanza. Nilimwomba Lead mara tatu atume fundi mwenye sifa za RII na uzoefu wa kutumia kipimo cha barometer, lakini fundi aliyetumwa hakuwa na uzoefu huo, jambo lililosababisha ucheleweshaji. Baada ya kukamilisha ukaguzi wa uendeshaji na uvujaji kwa mujibu wa AMM, ndege iliondoka kabla ya mtu yeyote kugundua kuwa ukaguzi wa RII ulikosekana, na baadaye idara ya ubora (QC) iligundua kosa hilo jioni hiyo. Pia imebainika kuwa kifaa hicho kinahusiana na RVSM, jambo ambalo bado halijafafanuliwa vizuri, hivyo linahitaji ufuatiliaji wa haraka.
summary: Ukarabati wa ADC namba mbili kwenye ndege ya ERJ145 ulikamilika bila ukaguzi wa RII uliohitajika, kutokana na taarifa isiyo wazi, uhaba wa wafanyakazi wenye sifa, na mkanganyiko kuhusu RVSM.

narrative_text: Tuli-troubleshoot ADC #2 kwa hii ERJ145 baada ya turnover isiyo clear kutoka first shift, tukafanya R&R ya component na kuitest kwa mujibu wa AMM. Niliomba Lead mara tatu atume mtu mwenye RII qualification na experience na barometer tester, lakini akatuma fundi ambaye hakuwahi kutumia hiyo equipment, so ilituchukua muda. Ndege ilikuwa imeshaondoka before mtu yeyote agundue kuwa RII iliskip, na jioni yake QC wakagundua issue hiyo, ikaonekana kwamba huo ADC pia ni RVSM-sensitive, kitu ambacho bado hatujaelewa vizuri. Tafadhali follow up na QC kuconfirm status ya RII na RVSM paperwork kabla ya dispatch inayofuata.
summary: ADC #2 kwenye ERJ145 ili-R&R bila RII inspection kwa sababu ya miscommunication, staffing gap, na confusion kuhusu RVSM sensitivity.

narrative_text: B737-700 #1 engine fan blade change (bird strike) taken over from RON Inspector, who briefed maintenance manual references and task cards completed to date. Fan blade weights and spinner weights confirmed with Maintenance Control, and fan blade platform pins inspected per manual before four steps were stamped off. Handed over to incoming Inspector with mechanics still lubricating and installing remaining blades per manual; note that engine run and borescope sign-off are still pending, and aircraft later diverted due to high engine vibration, so vibration history should be reviewed against the blade installation steps.
summary: Incoming inspector should review the #1 engine fan blade installation/sign-off steps after the aircraft diverted for high vibration following the bird-strike repair.

narrative_text: Ndege ya B737-700 ilikuwa ikifanyiwa ubadilishaji wa blade za fan za injini namba moja baada ya kugongwa na ndege, kazi iliyoanzishwa na Mkaguzi wa zamu ya usiku ambaye alinipa maelezo ya taratibu za matengenezo na hatua zilizokwisha kamilika. Nilithibitisha uzito wa blade mpya na uzito wa spinner pamoja na Udhibiti wa Matengenezo, kisha nikakagua pini za jukwaa la blade kama zinavyotakiwa kabla ya kutia sahihi hatua nne zilizokamilika. Nilimkabidhi Mkaguzi mwingine kazi hiyo huku mafundi wakiendelea kulainisha na kufunga blade zilizobaki, ingawa uendeshaji wa injini na ukaguzi wa borescope bado haujakamilika; baadaye ndege ililazimika kugeuza njia kwa sababu ya mtetemo mkubwa wa injini, hivyo suala hili linahitaji ufuatiliaji wa haraka.
summary: Mkaguzi anayeingia zamu anapaswa kufuatilia hatua za ufungaji wa blade za injini namba moja baada ya ndege kugeuza njia kutokana na mtetemo mkubwa wa injini.

entities.text: blade za fan za injini namba moja

narrative_text: Kwa B737-700 tulikuwa tuna-handle fan blade change ya engine number one baada ya bird strike, nikapewa turnover na RON Inspector ambaye alinionyesha maintenance manual references na ma-task cards zilizoshakamilika. Nilithibitisha fan blade weights na spinner weights na Maintenance Control, kisha nikaangalia fan blade platform pins kama manual inavyosema before ku-stamp hizo steps nne. Nikampa turnover Inspector mwingine, mechanics wakiwa bado wanaendelea kulubricate na kuinstall blades zilizobaki, lakini engine run na borescope sign-off zilikuwa bado; baadaye nikasikia ndege ilidivert kwa sababu ya high engine vibration, kwa hivyo hiyo issue inahitaji follow-up haraka.
summary: Inspector anayeingia anafaa ku-review fan blade installation steps za engine number one baada ya ndege kudivert kwa sababu ya high engine vibration.

entities.text: fan blade change ya engine number one

narrative_text: Dash 8-400 was down all day for #2 engine oil pressure indication fluctuating at and above rating detent; swing shift replaced several items with no improvement. Grave shift installed a replacement relay in relay junction box 1 under the cabin floor, using a part number provided by a lead, and it passed all AMM operational checks at the time. Note that a green sheet exists in ATA-79 wiring manual referencing an engineering order on this relay that is easy to miss and is not clearly worded, so please verify correct part number before any future relay swap on this aircraft to avoid repeat of the fault.
summary: Dash 8-400 #2 engine oil pressure indication fault was addressed with a relay replacement that passed checks, but the part number reference in the ATA-79 green sheet needs verification to prevent recurrence.

entities.text: green sheet in ATA-79 wiring manual

narrative_text: Ndege ya Dash 8-400 ilikaa chini siku nzima kwa sababu ya shinikizo la mafuta la injini namba mbili kubadilika badilika ikifikia kiwango cha juu; zamu ya jioni ilibadilisha vipuri kadhaa lakini tatizo halikuisha. Zamu ya usiku ilifunga relay mpya katika relay junction box namba moja iliyopo chini ya sakafu ya kabini, wakitumia namba ya kipuri iliyotolewa na kiongozi wa zamu, na ukaguzi wote wa uendeshaji kulingana na AMM ulipita wakati huo. Kumbuka kuwa kuna karatasi ya kijani kwenye kitabu cha nyaya ATA-79 inayohusiana na agizo la uhandisi kuhusu relay hii ambayo ni rahisi kutoiona na haielezwi vizuri, hivyo tafadhali hakikisha namba sahihi ya kipuri kabla ya kubadilisha relay tena ili kuepuka tatizo hili kujirudia.
summary: Tatizo la shinikizo la mafuta ya injini namba mbili kwenye Dash 8-400 lilishughulikiwa kwa kubadilisha relay iliyopita ukaguzi, lakini namba ya kipuri katika karatasi ya kijani ya ATA-79 inahitaji kuthibitishwa ili kuzuia kujirudia.

entities.text: shinikizo la mafuta la injini namba mbili
ukaguzi wa uendeshaji kulingana na AMM
karatasi ya kijani kwenye kitabu cha nyaya ATA-79

narrative_text: Hii Dash 8-400 ilikuwa down siku nzima kwa oil pressure indication ya engine namba mbili, ilikuwa inafluctuate karibu na rating detent. Swing shift walibadilisha vitu kadhaa but hakuna kilichosaidia. Sisi grave shift tukaamua kubadilisha relay kwenye relay junction box 1 chini ya cabin floor, tukapata part number kutoka kwa lead, tukainstall na ikapita operational checks zote za AMM saa hiyo. Cha muhimu, kuna green sheet kwenye ATA-79 wiring manual inayotaja engineering order kuhusu hii relay ambayo si rahisi kuiona na haiko clear sana, kwa hivyo next time mtu akihitaji kubadilisha relay hii, ahakikishe part number ni sahihi ili tusirudie tatizo hili.
summary: Dash 8-400 ilikuwa na oil pressure indication issue kwa engine namba mbili, relay ilibadilishwa na ikapita checks, lakini part number kwenye green sheet ya ATA-79 inahitaji kuverify ili kuepuka repeat.

entities.text: oil pressure indication ya engine namba mbili
green sheet kwenye ATA-79 wiring manual

narrative_text: B737-800 #1 engine HMU replacement was completed and closed out after leak check and operational test showed no anomalies; aircraft was released and dispatched. Post-flight inspection at the downline station found a fuel leak from the HMU fuel discharge line caused by two loose bolts, which were secured before return to service. Next shift to pull the maintenance records and torque data for this HMU installation and confirm compliance with the Maintenance Manual procedure, since this may be referenced in a pending FAA review.
summary: A B737-800 #1 engine HMU replacement passed leak/operational checks but later developed a fuel leak from loose discharge line bolts, prompting a records review amid a possible FAA inquiry.

narrative_text: Kazi ya kubadilisha HMU ya engine namba moja kwenye B737-800 ilikamilika na ukaguzi wa uvujaji pamoja na majaribio ya uendeshaji hayakuonyesha hitilafu, hivyo ndege ilirudishwa kazini. Baada ya safari, kituo cha mwisho kiligundua uvujaji wa mafuta kwenye bomba la HMU uliosababishwa na bolti mbili zilizolegea, ambazo zilikazwa kabla ndege kurudishwa kazini tena. Shift inayoingia iangalie kumbukumbu za matengenezo na taratibu za mwongozo wa matengenezo kuhusu ufungaji huu wa HMU, kwani suala hili linaweza kuhusishwa na uchunguzi unaoendelea wa FAA.
summary: Ubadilishaji wa HMU kwenye engine namba moja ya B737-800 ulipita ukaguzi lakini baadaye ukavuja mafuta kwenye bomba kutokana na bolti zilizolegea, jambo linalohitaji ukaguzi wa kumbukumbu kwa sababu ya uchunguzi wa FAA.

entities.text: ukaguzi wa uvujaji pamoja na majaribio ya uendeshaji

narrative_text: Tuli-complete HMU replacement kwa #1 engine ya B737-800, leak check na operational test zikawa clean kabisa so ndege ikarudi service. Lakini baada ya flight, downline station wakapata fuel leak kwenye HMU discharge line, ilikuwa ni bolts mbili zililegea, waka-secure na kurelease aircraft. Next shift please pull maintenance records na torque data za hii installation, tuconfirm ilifuata Maintenance Manual procedure vizuri kwa sababu kuna FAA review inaweza kuja.
summary: HMU replacement ya #1 engine kwenye B737-800 ilipita checks lakini baadaye ikaleak kwa loose bolts, so next shift wanapaswa kucheck records kwa sababu ya potential FAA inquiry.

narrative_text: MD-80 fuel pump and harness replacement was completed on overtime; tape application on fuel pump wiring was delayed pending an Engineering Approval addition to the AMM for the correct tape type. After approval arrived, tape was installed, fuel tank plates and spar wire feed-through grommet were leak-checked during fuel transfer, and tie tape was installed and signed off. Because the AMT was rushing to make the start of the next regular shift, recommend next crew double-check that all fuel tank paperwork (Work Cards, AMM reference, GPM 13-02) is complete and a dedicated Fuel Tank Coordinator function is confirmed for any follow-on work.
summary: Fuel tank work on an MD-80 was closed out under time pressure after an AMM tape-approval delay, so paperwork completeness and coordinator assignment should be verified by the next shift.

narrative_text: Kazi ya kubadilisha fuel pump na harness kwenye ndege ya MD-80 ilikamilika wakati wa overtime, lakini kulikuwa na ucheleweshaji kwa sababu ya kusubiri idhini ya Uhandisi kuhusu aina sahihi ya tape ya kutumika kwenye AMM. Baada ya idhini kufika, tape iliwekwa, na ukaguzi wa uvujaji ulifanyika kwenye fuel tank plates na grommet ya spar wakati fuel ikihamishwa, kisha tie tape iliwekwa na kazi ikasainiwa. Kwa kuwa fundi alikuwa na haraka kuanza zamu yake ya kawaida, inashauriwa zamu inayofuata ihakikishe karatasi zote za fuel tank (Work Cards, AMM, na GPM 13-02) zimekamilika na afisa maalum wa uratibu wa fuel tank ateuliwe kwa kazi zijazo.
summary: Kazi ya fuel tank kwenye MD-80 ilikamilishwa haraka baada ya ucheleweshaji wa idhini ya AMM, hivyo zamu inayofuata inapaswa kuhakiki nyaraka na uteuzi wa mratibu wa fuel tank.

narrative_text: Tulikamilisha ile fuel pump na harness replacement job kwa MD-80 during overtime, lakini kulikuwa na delay kidogo tukisubiri Engineering Approval ya tape type ya ku-satisfy AMM. Baada ya approval kufika, nika-install tape, tukafanya leak check kwa fuel tank plates na spar grommet wakati fuel ikitransfer, then tie tape ikawekwa na ikasign off. Nilikuwa na haraka ku-start regular shift yangu, so next crew wa-double check paperwork zote za fuel tank (Work Cards, AMM, GPM 13-02) na kama Fuel Tank Coordinator ame-assign properly kwa kazi zinazokuja.
summary: Fuel tank job kwenye MD-80 ilikamilika kwa haraka baada ya delay ya AMM approval, so next shift inapaswa kuverify paperwork na coordinator assignment.

narrative_text: While checking the right hand overwing exit on the B757-200 for reported damage, I assumed the pre-dock card had already been completed since seats were loose and several doors were open nearby. My Lead and I opened the overwing exit and the slide deployed, but the pre-dock inspection had not actually been signed off yet. This happened close to shift break with inspectors already leaving, so please verify pre-dock status on this door before any further access and confirm slide repack/inspection is scheduled.
summary: Technician opened overwing exit on B757-200 assuming pre-dock was complete, causing an unintended slide deployment; pre-dock status needs verification and slide requires repack.

narrative_text: Wakati nikikagua mlango wa dharura wa juu ya bawa upande wa kulia kwenye ndege ya B757-200 kwa uharibifu ulioripotiwa, nilidhani kadi ya pre-dock ilikuwa imeshakamilika kwa sababu viti vilikuwa vimelegea na milango kadhaa ilikuwa wazi karibu pale. Mimi na Lead wangu tulifungua mlango huo na slide ikatoka nje, lakini ukaguzi wa pre-dock ulikuwa bado haujafanyika. Jambo hili lilitokea karibu na mwisho wa zamu huku wakaguzi wakiwa wanaondoka, hivyo tafadhali hakikisheni hali ya pre-dock ya mlango huu kabla ya kuufikia tena na kuwa slide imepangiwa ukaguzi na kufungwa upya.
summary: Fundi alifungua mlango wa dharura kwenye B757-200 akidhani pre-dock imeshakamilika, hivyo slide ikatoka bila mpango; hali ya pre-dock na ukaguzi wa slide vinahitaji kufuatiliwa.

entities.text: mlango wa dharura wa juu ya bawa

narrative_text: Nilikuwa nakagua ile overwing exit ya right hand kwenye B757-200 for damage, nikadhani pre-dock card ilishafanywa kwa sababu seats zilikuwa loose na doors kadhaa zikiwa open karibu. Mimi na Lead wangu tuli-open ile exit na slide ikadeploy, lakini pre-dock haikuwa imecomply bado. Ilikuwa close to shift break na inspectors wanaanza kuondoka, kwa hivyo please confirm pre-dock status ya door hii kabla mtu mwingine ku-access tena, na hakikisha slide repack/inspection imeschedule.
summary: Technician ali-open overwing exit ya B757-200 akidhani pre-dock ilishacomply, slide ikadeploy bila mpango; pre-dock status na slide repack zinahitaji follow-up.

narrative_text: Q400 at 4-spot, PIREP on #2 engine TQ/FF/ITT split; swing shift ordered the P2.6 valve and pulled the AMM removal/install task. I completed R&R of the P2.7 inter-compressor bleed valve but did not cross-check the supplement requiring heat shrink on the P6 Cannon connector, so it was installed without it. Day shift lead has been briefed and is following up on the heat shrink installation before further engine run/close-out.
summary: A Q400 P2.7 bleed valve replacement was completed without applying required heat shrink to the P6 Cannon connector due to a missed AMM supplement, and day shift has been notified to correct it.

narrative_text: Ndege ya Q400 iko 4-spot, kuna ripoti ya rubani kuhusu tatizo la injini namba mbili - TQ, FF na ITT split. Shift ya jioni walishaagiza valve ya P2.6 na kutoa task ya AMM ya kuondoa na kufunga. Mimi nilifanya kazi ya kuondoa na kufunga valve ya P2.7 lakini sikuangalia nyongeza ya maelekezo inayotaka heat shrink ifungwe kwenye kiungio cha Cannon P6, hivyo ilifungwa bila hiyo heat shrink.
