Nimeshamweleza kiongozi wa shift ya mchana na anafuatilia jambo hili kabla ya hatua nyingine yoyote kuchukuliwa kwenye ndege.
summary: Kazi ya kubadilisha valve ya P2.7 kwenye ndege ya Q400 ilikamilika bila kufunga heat shrink inayotakiwa kwenye kiungio cha Cannon P6 kwa sababu ya kupuuza nyongeza ya maelekezo, na kiongozi wa shift ya mchana ameshaarifiwa.

narrative_text: Q400 iko 4-spot, tuna PIREP ya #2 engine - TQ, FF na ITT split. Swing shift walishaorder ile P2.6 valve na wakaprint AMM task ya removal and installation. Mimi nilifanya R&R ya P2.7 inter-compressor bleed valve, lakini sikucheck ile supplement inayosema lazima ufunge heat shrink kwenye P6 Cannon connector, so ikaenda bila hiyo heat shrink. Nimeshatell Day shift lead kuhusu hii issue, anafollow up before they sign off or run the engine tena.
summary: Baada ya kufanya R&R ya P2.7 bleed valve kwenye Q400, heat shrink ya P6 Cannon connector haikufungwa kwa sababu ya kumiss ile supplement, na Day shift lead ameshaarifiwa afollow up.

narrative_text: Reassembled the R/H MLG stabilizer strut 'H' member after NDT using original hardware; both stabilizer brace pins had a small greased washer on the bolt head side and a larger washer on the nut side, and the anti-rotation tab only permitted one orientation. Installed per that orientation, torqued and safetied, then handed off the remaining install to swing shift; operational checks were not performed until day shift next day, at which point the gear failed to lock down during the alternate extension check. Please verify the washer stack-up/orientation against the maintenance manual before further gear swings, as the nut-side washer may have been installed too tight.
summary: Confusion over washer stack-up orientation during R/H MLG strut reassembly led to a gear-down lock failure discovered on the next shift's operational check.

narrative_text: Tulirudisha pamoja 'H' member ya R/H MLG stabilizer strut baada ya NDT tukitumia vifaa vya awali; pini zote mbili za stabilizer brace zilikuwa na washer ndogo yenye grisi upande wa kichwa cha bolt na washer kubwa upande wa nut, huku anti-rotation tab ikiruhusu mpangilio mmoja tu. Tulifunga kulingana na mpangilio huo, tukakaza torque na kuweka safety wire, kisha kazi iliyobaki ikakabidhiwa kwa zamu ya jioni. Ukaguzi wa uendeshaji haukufanyika mpaka zamu ya asubuhi siku iliyofuata, ambapo gear ya R/H haikufunga chini vizuri wakati wa alternate extension check. Tafadhali hakikisheni mpangilio wa washer kulingana na manual kabla ya kufanya gear swing nyingine, kwani inawezekana washer ya upande wa nut ilikazwa kupita kiasi.
summary: Mkanganyiko kuhusu mpangilio wa washer wakati wa kuunganisha upya strut ya R/H MLG ulisababisha gear kushindwa kufunga chini, hali iliyogunduliwa na zamu iliyofuata.

narrative_text: Nili-reassemble ile R/H MLG stabilizer strut 'H' member baada ya NDT nikitumia original hardware; zile pins mbili za stabilizer brace zilikuwa na washer ndogo yenye grease upande wa bolt head, na washer kubwa upande wa nut, na anti-rotation tab ilikuwa inaruhusu orientation moja tu. Ni-install kwa hiyo orientation, torque na safety wire zikafanywa, kisha nikaachia kazi iliyobaki kwa swing shift. Operational check haikufanywa mpaka day shift ya siku iliyofuata, ndipo wakagundua gear ya R/H haifungi down vizuri wakati wa alternate extension check. Tafadhali angalieni ile washer stack-up per manual kabla ya kufanya gear swing ingine, huenda ile washer ya nut side ilikazwa too tight.
summary: Kuna confusion kuhusu washer orientation wakati wa ku-reassemble R/H MLG strut, na hii ikasababisha gear kushindwa lock down, iliyogunduliwa na shift iliyofuata.

narrative_text: On the B737-800, the #1 engine Anti-Ice HP Modulating valve was deferred per MEL following an ACARS alert prior to arrival; during the lockout procedure a mid-task interruption led to the wrong connector being pulled, which was only caught after further troubleshooting found no fault on the HP valve itself. Maintenance Control was consulted and both valves plus associated seals and placards are being replaced to fully resolve the annunciation. Incoming shift please confirm the MPM steps were re-verified from the start and check the connector routing before closing this task out.
summary: A B737-800 engine anti-ice valve deferral task was disrupted by a distraction, causing a wrong-connector removal that requires follow-up verification and full valve/seal replacement.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya B737-800, valve ya Anti-Ice ya injini namba moja ilipangwa kuahirishwa kwa mujibu wa MEL baada ya taarifa ya ACARS kabla ya kutua; wakati wa utaratibu wa kufunga valve, kulitokea usumbufu wa kazi nyingine ambao ulisababisha kutolewa kwa kiungio kisicho sahihi. Baada ya kufanya ukaguzi zaidi bila kupata hitilafu kwenye valve ya HP, Udhibiti wa Matengenezo ulishauriwa na iliamuliwa kubadilisha valve zote mbili pamoja na seal na alama zake ili kumaliza tatizo kabisa. Zamu inayofuata itahakikishe hatua zote za MPM zimesomwa upya tangu mwanzo kabla ya kufunga kazi hii.
summary: Kazi ya kuahirisha valve ya kupasha moto injini kwenye ndege ya B737-800 ilikatizwa na usumbufu, hivyo kusababisha hitilafu ya kiungio na hatimaye uamuzi wa kubadilisha valve zote mbili.

entities.text: valve ya Anti-Ice ya injini namba moja

narrative_text: Kwa hiyo B737-800, tuli-defer #1 engine Anti-Ice HP Modulating valve kufuatia MEL baada ya ACARS alert kabla ya arrival; lakini during lockout procedure kuliingia distraction ikatufanya tu-pull connector mbaya bila ku-verify step kikamilifu. Tuli-troubleshoot zaidi tukiangalia HP valve lakini hakuna fault iliyopatikana, so tuliconsult Maintenance Control na wakaamua tu-replace valves zote mbili pamoja na seals na placards ili ku-clear annunciation. Shift inayofuata please i-confirm MPM steps zime-redo from scratch na i-check connector routing kabla ya ku-close hii task.
summary: Deferral ya HP valve kwa B737-800 iliharibika kidogo baada ya distraction ikasababisha wrong connector kutolewa, hivyo valves zote mbili zinachangiwa kubadilishwa na follow-up inahitajika.

narrative_text: During RII sign-off for the nose landing gear Sequence Valve replacement on the B757-200, prior shift verbally confirmed the ADC VMU/MMO switch was returned to Normal and logged separately, so we assumed the aircraft was fully back to normal config after the Op/Leak checks. However, a permanent-type collar was left installed on the Gear Lever Lock circuit breaker, which had been pulled for the gear swing, and this was not caught before turnover. Flight crew subsequently had to use the Lock Override procedure to retract the gear after departure. Next shift/QA please review use of permanent collars on pulled breakers and confirm all breaker/config items are logged, not just verbally passed at turnover.
summary: A permanent collar left on a pulled Gear Lever Lock circuit breaker after nose gear maintenance was missed at shift turnover, forcing flight crew to use gear Lock Override in flight.

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa RII baada ya kubadilisha Sequence Valve kwenye gia ya mbele ya ndege ya B757-200, zamu iliyotangulia ilituambia kwa mdomo kwamba swichi ya ADC VMU/MMO ilikuwa imerudishwa katika hali ya kawaida na kuandikwa kwenye logbook tofauti, hivyo tulidhani ndege nzima ilikuwa imerudi kwenye hali ya kawaida baada ya ukaguzi wa uendeshaji na uvujaji. Hata hivyo, kola ya kudumu iliachwa kwenye circuit breaker ya Gear Lever Lock iliyokuwa imetolewa kwa ajili ya kazi hiyo, na jambo hili halikugundulika kabla ya kukabidhi zamu. Wafanyakazi wa ndege walilazimika kutumia utaratibu wa Lock Override kurudisha gia baada ya kuruka. Zamu inayofuata na idara ya ubora wanaombwa kupitia matumizi ya kola za kudumu kwenye breakers zilizotolewa na kuhakikisha taarifa zote za usanidi zinaandikwa, si kupitishwa kwa mdomo tu.
summary: Kola ya kudumu iliyoachwa kwenye circuit breaker ya Gear Lever Lock baada ya matengenezo ya gia ya mbele haikugunduliwa wakati wa kukabidhi zamu, na kusababisha wafanyakazi wa ndege kutumia Lock Override wakiwa angani.

narrative_text: Wakati wa RII sign-off baada ya kubadilisha ile Sequence Valve kwa nose gear ya B757-200, previous shift walitwambia kwa mdomo tu kwamba ADc VMU/MMO switch imerudi Normal na wamesign separate logbook entry, so tulidhani aircraft iko back to normal config baada ya Op check na Leak check. Lakini kumbe kuna permanent collar iliachwa kwenye Gear Lever Lock circuit breaker ambayo ilikuwa pulled kwa ajili ya gear swing, na hii haikuonekana kabla ya turnover. Flight crew waliishia ku-use Lock Override procedure kurudisha gear baada ya kutake-off. Next shift na QA please recheck matumizi ya permanent collars kwenye breakers zilizo-pulled, na hakikisha config items zinaandikwa kwenye logbook, si kuambiana tu kwa mdomo wakati wa turnover.
summary: Permanent collar iliachwa kwenye Gear Lever Lock circuit breaker baada ya gear maintenance na haikugunduliwa turnover, hivyo flight crew wakalazimika ku-use Lock Override wakiwa airborne.

narrative_text: During a QA audit, the #2 engine hydraulic pump depressurization valve connector was found disconnected with no paperwork covering it. Reviewing my past work, I recalled that back in February, while doing the #2 engine igniter plug immersion depth check on this B777-200, I had to break a stubborn igniter boss loose and pulled that connector as a precaution to protect the wiring from the tools. The job got handed over at shift end due to parts delay, and the connector disconnection was never logged in the write-ups. Next shift needs to verify the connector is properly reconnected and safetied, and update the maintenance records accordingly.
summary: An engine hydraulic pump connector was left disconnected and undocumented after an igniter plug task was handed over mid-job, requiring follow-up inspection and paperwork correction.

entities.text: #2 engine hydraulic pump depressurization valve connector

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa QA, kiunganishi cha valve ya depressurization ya pump ya hydraulic ya injini namba mbili kilipatikana kimetenganishwa bila hati yoyote ya kueleza sababu. Baada ya kupitia kazi zangu za nyuma, nilikumbuka kuwa mwezi Februari, wakati nikifanya ukaguzi wa immersion depth ya igniter plug ya injini namba mbili kwenye ndege hii ya B777-200, boss ya igniter ilikuwa ngumu kuachiliwa hivyo nikatumia zana nzito zaidi, na kwa tahadhari niliondoa kiunganishi hicho ili kulinda nyaya. Kazi ilikabidhiwa kwa shift ijayo mwisho wa kazi kwa sababu ya ukosefu wa vipuri, na uondoaji wa kiunganishi haukutajwa kwenye ripoti zilizoandikwa. Shift inayokuja inahitajika kuhakikisha kiunganishi kimeunganishwa vizuri na kusalimika, pamoja na kusahihisha hati za matengenezo.
summary: Kiunganishi cha pump ya hydraulic ya injini kilibaki kimetenganishwa bila kuandikwa baada ya kazi ya igniter plug kukabidhiwa kwa shift nyingine, hivyo inahitajika ukaguzi na usahihishaji wa hati.

entities.text: kiunganishi cha valve ya depressurization ya pump ya hydraulic
ukaguzi wa immersion depth ya igniter plug

narrative_text: Wakati wa QA audit, connector ya #2 engine hydraulic pump depressurization valve ilipatikana disconnected bila documentation yoyote. Nikirudi kwa records za nyuma, nikakumbuka Februari, wakati nikifanya igniter plug immersion depth check kwenye hii B777-200, boss ilikuwa ngumu sana ku-loosen hivyo nikahitaji tools nzito, na kwa precaution niliondoa hiyo connector ili kuprotect wiring kutoka kwa tools. Job ilibidi ikabidhiwe kwa shift nyingine end of shift kwa sababu ya parts delay, na hiyo connector removal haikuandikwa kwenye write-ups. Next shift wanahitaji ku-verify connector imerudishwa properly na kusafety, halafu ku-update maintenance log.
summary: Connector ya hydraulic pump ilibaki disconnected bila documentation baada ya igniter task kuhandover kwa shift nyingine, so inahitajika verification na kuupdate maintenance records.
