narrative_text: Aircraft Y (CRJ700) had starting/APU/bleed air issues on the gate, traced to a faulty APU Load Control Valve; crew declined due to Cowl Anti-ice cautions and were swapped to Aircraft Z. Aircraft towed to the hangar for the valve change-out; also noted Center tank had 1300 lbs fuel, suspect leaking ejector, so tank was defueled and next shift needs to complete the leak check and sumping. Aircraft X was also brought into the hangar to continue troubleshooting the right-hand Wing Slat Status MEL using the skew sensors; please continue with multimeter checks, was frequently interrupted by other tasks so verify progress before proceeding.
summary: Aircraft Y's APU valve fault and possible fuel leak, plus Aircraft X's slat sensor MEL troubleshooting, both need follow-up in the hangar.

narrative_text: Ndege Y (CRJ700) ilikuwa na tatizo la kuanza, APU na bleed air, na baada ya uchunguzi ilipatikana valve ya APU Load Control imeharibika; marubani walikataa kutumia ndege hiyo kwa sababu ya tahadhari za Cowl Anti-ice, hivyo walihamishiwa Ndege Z. Ndege Y ilivutwa hadi hangar kwa ajili ya kubadilisha valve, na pia ilibainika tanki la Center lina mafuta ya lbs 1300, hali inayoweza kuonyesha uvujaji wa ejector, kwa hivyo mafuta yametolewa na zamu inayofuata inahitajika kukamilisha ukaguzi wa uvujaji na sump. Ndege X pia ililetwa hangar kuendelea na uchunguzi wa MEL ya Wing Slat Status kwa kutumia skew sensors; kazi hii ilikatizwa mara kadhaa na masuala mengine, hivyo ni vyema kuhakiki maendeleo kabla ya kuendelea.
summary: Ndege Y ina tatizo la valve ya APU na uwezekano wa uvujaji wa mafuta, na Ndege X inahitaji kukamilishwa uchunguzi wa slat MEL hangarini.

narrative_text: Aircraft Y (CRJ700) ilikuwa na starting/APU/bleed air issues kwa gate, tukagundua APU Load Control Valve ndio imeharibika; pilots walikataa kuchukua ndege due to Cowl Anti-ice cautions, so wakahamishiwa Aircraft Z. Tuli-tow Aircraft Y kurudi hangar kwa valve change-out, na wakati wa kuivuta nikaona Center tank ina 1300 lbs fuel, suspect leaking ejector, so tume-defuel na next shift wanahitaji kufanya leak check na sumping. Aircraft X pia imeletwa hangar for the Wing Slat Status MEL, nilikuwa nikicheki skew sensors na multimeter lakini nilikatizwa several times na watu wakiuliza maswali mengine, so please verify progress before continuing.
summary: Aircraft Y ina APU valve issue na possible fuel leak, na Aircraft X bado inahitaji kukamilishwa slat MEL troubleshooting hangarini.

narrative_text: On the SF340B engine mount replacement, Mechanic X handed over the left side to me verbally, stating the new mount was on and secured loosely with old hardware pending new bolts. When the new bolts arrived I removed the old ones and torqued/safetied the new hardware without re-verifying which mount was actually installed, and it turned out an old/bad mount had been swapped back in during tagging. Engine has since been removed and the correct mount installed, but incoming shift should confirm all verbal turnovers on mount/hardware jobs are backed up with written or tagged confirmation before closing out torque and safety steps. Recommend double-checking any job left mid-task where good and bad parts were staged together on the bench.
summary: A verbal-only turnover between mechanics on an SF340B engine mount replacement led to a bad mount being reinstalled, later corrected; written turnovers recommended going forward.

narrative_text: Katika kazi ya kubadilisha engine mount kwenye SF340B, Fundi X alinipa taarifa ya mdomo tu kuhusu upande wa kushoto, akisema mount mpya imewekwa na imefungwa kwa muda kwa hardware ya zamani huku tukisubiri bolts mpya. Bolts zilipofika niliondoa zile za zamani na kufunga zile mpya kikamilifu bila kuthibitisha tena kama mount iliyowekwa ni ile sahihi, na baadaye ikagundulika kuwa mount mbovu ilirudishwa kimakosa wakati wa kuweka tag. Engine imeondolewa na mount sahihi imewekwa, lakini zamu inayoingia inapaswa kuhakikisha taarifa za mdomo pekee hazitumiwi tena bila uthibitisho wa maandishi, hasa pale sehemu nzuri na mbovu zinapowekwa pamoja mezani.
summary: Taarifa ya mdomo pekee kati ya mafundi kuhusu engine mount ya SF340B ilisababisha mount mbovu kurudishwa kimakosa, hali iliyorekebishwa baadaye; taarifa za maandishi zinapendekezwa.

narrative_text: Kwenye ile engine mount replacement ya SF340B, Mechanic X aliniambia verbally tu kuhusu left side, akisema mount mpya iko 'on' loosely na old hardware while tunasubiri bolts mpya kufika. Bolts zilipoarrive niliremove zile old na kufunga new hardware, ni-torque na ku-safety, bila ku-double check kama ile mount imewekwa ni sahihi, na turns out ile bad mount ndio ilirudishwa by mistake wakati wa tagging. Engine imekuwa removed na correct mount imefungwa, lakini next shift wanapaswa kuconfirm turnovers zote za hardware jobs ziko documented, si verbal pekee, especially pale good na bad parts zinawekwa pamoja mezani.
summary: Verbal passdown pekee kwenye engine mount job ya SF340B ilileta confusion na bad mount kurudishwa, later fixed; written turnovers zina-recommendiwa going forward.

narrative_text: Continuing work on the Citation 560 Ultra rudder trim system: previous shift replaced the trim actuator and signed it off before I took over, so cable installation was not independently rechecked. Rudder trim was traveling more in one direction than the other, so the trim tab control chain was recentered on the sprocket in the cockpit and at the actuator, cables were retensioned, and the travel check passed within limits. Next shift should verify the actuator installation and sprocket centering were properly documented, and confirm no further asymmetry shows up on subsequent checks.
summary: Rudder trim asymmetry on the Citation 560 Ultra was corrected by recentering the trim tab chain/sprocket and retensioning cables, but actuator installation was not independently verified and needs follow-up documentation.

narrative_text: Tunaendelea na kazi ya mfumo wa rudder trim wa ndege ya Citation 560 Ultra; shift iliyopita walibadilisha actuator ya trim na kuisaini kabla sijapokea kazi, hivyo usimamizi wa cables haukuangaliwa upya kwa makini. Rudder trim ilikuwa ikisogea zaidi upande mmoja kuliko mwingine, kwa hiyo mnyororo wa udhibiti wa trim tab ulirekebishwa katikati kwenye gia cockpit na pia kwenye actuator, cables zikawekwa tension tena, na ukaguzi wa msogeo ukapita ndani ya viwango vinavyokubalika. Shift inayokuja inapaswa kuhakiki kama ufungaji wa actuator na urekebishaji wa gia uliandikwa vizuri, na kufuatilia kama tatizo la usawa halitajitokeza tena.
summary: Tatizo la usawa wa rudder trim kwenye Citation 560 Ultra lilirekebishwa kwa kuweka katikati mnyororo na gia ya trim tab na kuweka tension ya cables, lakini ufungaji wa actuator haujathibitishwa kikamilifu na unahitaji ufuatiliaji.

entities.text: mnyororo wa udhibiti wa trim tab

narrative_text: Tunaendelea na ile job ya rudder trim system kwa Citation 560 Ultra; previous shift walibadilisha ile trim actuator wakaisign off before nikuje, so sikucheck vizuri kama cable installation ilikuwa sahihi. Rudder trim ilikua ikitravel zaidi upande mmoja kuliko mwingine, so tuli-recenter ile trim tab chain kwenye sprocket cockpit na pia kwenye actuator, tuka-tension cables, na travel check ikapass within limits. Next shift wanafaa wa-verify kama actuator installation na sprocket centering zimedocumented vizuri, na kufollow-up kama asymmetry haitarudi tena.
summary: Rudder trim asymmetry kwenye Citation 560 Ultra ilifixiwa kwa kurecenter chain/sprocket na kutension cables, lakini actuator installation haija-verify fully so inahitaji follow-up.

narrative_text: During night shift we swapped the right Air Cycle Machine on the MD-80 following a pilot report of poor cooling; dayshift techs completed the remaining duct connections and were to run the Leak and Operational Checks. While closing out the 8130 tag I did not catch that the installed unit was part number XYZ-AAA6 instead of the IPC-required XYZ-AAA1, and this was only discovered later that day. Maintenance Control has been notified; dayshift must verify the part number before further ops and confirm whether the aircraft needs to be pulled from service.
summary: Wrong-part ACM was installed on an MD-80 during a night-shift pack change and only caught later, requiring Maintenance Control follow-up.

narrative_text: Wakati wa shift ya usiku tulibadilisha Air Cycle Machine ya kulia kwenye ndege ya MD-80 kutokana na ripoti ya rubani kuhusu upoezaji hafifu; wafanyakazi wa mchana waliendelea kuunganisha mabomba yaliyobaki na walikuwa wapange kufanya ukaguzi wa uvujaji na uendeshaji. Nilipokamilisha fomu ya 8130 sikugundua kwamba kipande kilichowekwa kilikuwa namba XYZ-AAA6 badala ya XYZ-AAA1 inayohitajika kwa mujibu wa kitabu cha vipande (IPC), na hili ligundulika baadaye siku hiyo. Idara ya Udhibiti wa Matengenezo imejulishwa; wafanyakazi wa mchana wanahitajika kuthibitisha namba sahihi ya kipande kabla ya operesheni zaidi na kuamua kama ndege inahitaji kutolewa kwa huduma.
summary: Kipande kisicho sahihi cha ACM kiliwekwa kwenye ndege ya MD-80 wakati wa shift ya usiku na kugunduliwa baadaye, hivyo kuhitaji ufuatiliaji wa Udhibiti wa Matengenezo.

narrative_text: Jana usiku tuli-swap right Air Cycle Machine kwa MD-80 kwa sababu ya pilot report ya insufficient cooling; dayshift wataconnect ducting iliyobaki na wafanye Leak and Operational Checks. Nilipokuwa nikifill ile 8130 tag sikunotice kwamba part iliyoinstall ni XYZ-AAA6 badala ya XYZ-AAA1 kama IPC inavyorequire, na tuligundua hii mistake mwishoni mwa siku. Nimeshanotify Maintenance Control; dayshift wanahitaji ku-verify part number kabla ya kuendelea na kuconfirm kama aircraft inahitaji kutolewa service.
summary: Part number ya ACM ilikuwa wrong pale MD-80, kama ilivyodiscover baadaye, hivyo Maintenance Control inahitaji kufuatilia.

narrative_text: Night shift spent over two hours removing the #1 engine VSV actuator on the B767-300; the MM steps did not call out three fittings (Items 9, 12, 14, Fig 401) that actually needed removal to free the actuator from its bracket, so update the job card notes for the next crew. During reinstall, the eyebolt nut was dropped and lost for a long time, delaying the task further and requiring an AOG part request from ZZZ1 since ZZZ had no stock. Supervisor pushed to move the aircraft out for an engine run due to a broken-down cleaning truck blocking the hangar, and in the rush to complete tests and leak-check the actuator, a step may have been missed — please verify all paperwork and checks were closed out before next flight.
summary: VSV actuator replacement on B767-300 ran long due to unlisted MM fittings and a lost hardware item, and rushed completion under hangar-move pressure may have left a step unverified.

narrative_text: Wafanyakazi wa zamu ya usiku walitumia zaidi ya masaa mawili wakiondoa actuator ya VSV ya injini namba moja kwenye ndege ya B767-300; maelekezo ya matengenezo hayakutaja vifaa vitatu (Items 9, 12, 14, Fig 401) ambavyo kwa hakika vilihitajika kuondolewa ili actuator itoke kwenye bracket yake, hivyo tafadhali sasisha maelezo ya kazi kwa zamu inayofuata. Wakati wa kuweka kipya, nati ya eyebolt ilidondoka na kupotea kwa muda mrefu, jambo lililochelewesha kazi zaidi na kulazimu kuombwa kipuri kutoka ZZZ1 kwa haraka kwani ZZZ hawakuwa na hicho kipuri stoo. Msimamizi alitaka ndege isogezwe nje kwa ajili ya kuwasha injini kwa sababu gari la kusafisha lilikuwa limeharibika na kuzuia hangar, hivyo kwa haraka ya kumaliza vipimo na ukaguzi wa uvujaji wa actuator, huenda hatua moja ilisahaulika — tafadhali thibitisha nyaraka na ukaguzi wote vimekamilika kabla ya safari inayofuata.
summary: Uwekaji wa actuator ya VSV kwenye B767-300 ulichukua muda mrefu kutokana na vifaa visivyotajwa kwenye maelekezo na kupotea kwa kipuri, na haraka ya kukamilisha kazi chini ya shinikizo la kuhamisha ndege huenda iliacha hatua moja bila kuthibitishwa.

entities.text: actuator ya VSV ya injini namba moja

narrative_text: Night shift tulitumia saa mbili plus tukitoa ile VSV actuator ya engine number one kwenye B767-300; MM haikutaja fittings tatu (Items 9, 12, 14, Fig 401) ambazo zilihitajika kuondolewa ili actuator i-clear kutoka kwa bracket, kwa hivyo please update job card notes kwa crew inayofuata. Wakati wa install, ile eyebolt nut ilidondoka na kupotea kwa muda mrefu, ikatuchelewesha zaidi, tukalazimika ku-order part kutoka ZZZ1 kwa AOG since ZZZ hawakuwa na stock. Supervisor alitaka aircraft i-move out for engine run kwa sababu cleaning truck ilikuwa imeharibika ikizuia hangar, so tulikuwa tuna-rush kumaliza tests na leak check ya actuator — kuna step ambayo huenda ilisahaulika, so please verify paperwork na checks zote zime-close before next flight.
summary: VSV actuator job kwenye B767-300 ilichukua muda mrefu because ya fittings zisizotajwa kwenye MM na kupotea kwa hardware, halafu rush ya ku-clear hangar space huenda iliacha step moja bila kucheki.

entities.text: VSV actuator ya engine number one

narrative_text: CRJ200 was received on turnover from dayshift still on jacks with NLG torque link change incomplete; release was set for a time that left minimal margin to finish the job. Under pressure from Lead and Maintenance Control to hurry, extra mechanics were pulled in to downjack quickly and Proximity System targets were not reset per the manual. Aircraft departed and NLG failed to retract, resulting in an air return; next shift must verify targeting was completed and confirm whether a gear swing is required before further dispatch.
summary: A rushed NLG torque link turnover led to missed proximity target rigging and an air return after gear failed to retract.

narrative_text: Ndege ya CRJ200 ilikabidhiwa kutoka zamu ya mchana ikiwa bado juu ya jacks, kazi ya kubadilisha torque links za NLG haijakamilika, na muda wa kuruhusiwa kuruka ulikuwa umewekwa karibu sana hivyo kupunguza muda wa kumaliza kazi. Kwa sababu ya shinikizo kutoka kwa Lead na Maintenance Control kuhimiza kuharakisha, mafundi wengine waliitwa kusaidia kushusha ndege haraka, na hatua ya kuweka targets za mfumo wa Proximity iliachwa kimakosa. Ndege ilipoondoka, gia la mbele halikurudi ndani kama ilivyotarajiwa, na ikalazimu kurudi uwanjani; zamu inayofuata inatakiwa kuhakikisha targets zimewekwa sahihi na kuthibitisha kama gear swing inahitajika kabla ya safari nyingine.
summary: Ukaguzi wa haraka wa torque links za NLG ulisababisha kukosekana kwa uwekaji sahihi wa targets za Proximity na ndege kulazimika kurudi baada ya gia kushindwa kurudi ndani.

narrative_text: Tulipata turnover ya CRJ200 kutoka dayshift ikiwa bado iko juu ya jacks, torque link change ya NLG haijaisha, na release time ilikuwa imewekwa karibu sana so muda ulikuwa mchache sana kumaliza job. Lead na Maintenance Control walikuwa wanauliza 'how much longer?' kila mara mpaka wakaleta mechanics wengine wasaidie kudownjack haraka, na tukamiss kuset targets za Proximity System kabla ya kufunga job. Aircraft ilipo-depart NLG haikurudi ndani properly ikafanya air return; next shift wajaribu kuconfirm kama targets ziliwekwa sawa na kama gear swing inahitajika kabla ya kuidispatch tena.
summary: Job ya torque links za NLG ilifanywa kwa haraka sana ikasababisha targets za Proximity kutosetiwa, na aircraft ikafanya air return baada ya gear kushindwa kuretract.

narrative_text: The Agusta A119 was grounded overnight after the pilot reported a rapid ITT spike to 805C during transition from idle to max power, and shut the engine down as a precaution. On inspection, EDU #1 showed ITT pegged at 1277C, so the engine compartment was opened per the AW A119 and PT6 EMM procedures and the engine trim compensator was swapped with one from the parts room. Note that the replacement unit had no accompanying paperwork; Records Office needs to confirm documentation before further flight. Next shift should verify trim compensator paperwork and re-check ITT readings on ground run.
summary: An Agusta A119 helicopter's engine was grounded and trim compensator replaced after an ITT overtemperature event, but the incoming shift must still confirm the replacement part's missing paperwork.

entities.text: re-check ITT readings on ground run

narrative_text: Helikopta ya Agusta A119 ilizuiwa kuruka usiku uliopita baada ya kiongozi ndege kuripoti joto la ITT kupanda ghafla hadi 805C wakati wa kubadilisha kutoka mwendo wa taratibu kwenda kasi kamili, na akaamua kuzima injini kwa tahadhari. Baada ya ukaguzi, kifaa cha EDU namba moja kilionyesha ITT ikiwa juu kabisa kwenye 1277C, hivyo sehemu ya injini ilifunguliwa kwa kufuata taratibu za matengenezo za Agusta-Westland na PT6, na kifaa cha trim compensator kikabadilishwa na kingine kilichotolewa ghalani. Ni muhimu kutambua kuwa kifaa kipya hakikuwa na nyaraka zake; Ofisi ya Kumbukumbu inahitajika kuthibitisha nyaraka hizo kabla ya safari nyingine. Zamu inayofuata inatakiwa kuthibitisha nyaraka za trim compensator na kuangalia tena vipimo vya ITT wakati wa majaribio ardhini.
summary: Helikopta ya Agusta A119 ilizuiwa na injini yake kubadilishiwa kifaa cha trim compensator baada ya tatizo la joto kupita kiasi la ITT, lakini zamu inayofuata bado inahitaji kuthibitisha nyaraka za kifaa kilichobadilishwa.

narrative_text: Ile Agusta A119 iligrounded usiku, pilot aliripoti ITT ikipanda ghafla mpaka 805C wakati wa transition kutoka idle kwenda max power, so akashut down engine kwa precaution. Baada ya kuangalia, EDU #1 ilikuwa inashow ITT imepeak kwenye 1277C, so tuka-decowl engine compartment kufuata AW A119 na PT6 EMM procedures, tuka-remove trim compensator na kuinstall replacement kutoka parts room. Cha kuzingatia, hiyo unit haikuwa na paperwork yake; Records Office wanahitaji kuconfirm documentation kabla ya next flight. Next shift wako-verify hiyo paperwork ya trim compensator na kurudia ITT check wakati wa ground run.
summary: Agusta A119 ilipata ITT overtemperature issue, trim compensator ika-replace, lakini bado kuna paperwork ya kifaa haijaconfirm kwa next shift.

entities.text: verify hiyo paperwork ya trim compensator
kurudia ITT check wakati wa ground run

narrative_text: During turnover with the midnight crew on the B767 (Aircraft X) winglet mod, we found 12 fasteners (two groups of 6) missing at Rib 32, where the lower doubler was not pre-drilled at the L-7 and L-9 stringer locations. The new splice plate fastener pattern does not match the Engineering print, and the task card does not call out a layout location for these fasteners. A write-up has been initiated for Engineering clarification; next shift should also verify how fasteners were laid out on Aircraft Y since no one can confirm who did that layout.
summary: Missing fasteners and a splice-plate/drawing mismatch on a B767 winglet mod require Engineering follow-up and a cross-check on a second aircraft.

narrative_text: Wakati wa turnover na crew ya usiku kwenye B767 (Aircraft X) inayofanyiwa mabadiliko ya winglet, tulikuta fasteners 12 (makundi mawili ya sita) hazipo kwenye Rib 32, ambapo lower doubler haikuwa na mashimo ya pilot kwenye maeneo ya L-7 na L-9. Muundo wa fasteners kwenye splice plate mpya haulingani na drawing ya Engineering, na task card haikuonyesha eneo la kuweka fasteners hizo. Write-up imeandikwa kwa ajili ya ufafanuzi wa Engineering, na shift inayokuja inatakiwa kuangalia pia jinsi fasteners zilivyowekwa kwenye Aircraft Y kwani hakuna aliyekumbuka nani alifanya kazi hiyo.
summary: Fasteners zilizokosekana na tofauti kati ya splice plate na drawing kwenye winglet ya B767 zinahitaji ufafanuzi wa Engineering na ukaguzi wa ndege ya pili.

narrative_text: Wakati wa turnover na midnight crew kwenye B767 (Aircraft X) ya winglet mod, tuligundua fasteners 12 (two groups za six) hazipo kwenye Rib 32, kwa sababu lower doubler haikuwa na pilot holes kwenye L-7 na L-9 locations. Ile fastener pattern ya splice plate mpya haifit na Engineering print, na task card haitaji ku-specify layout location ya hizo fasteners. Tumeandika write-up kwa Engineering clarification, so next shift wacheki pia jinsi fasteners zilivyowekwa kwenye Aircraft Y coz hakuna mtu anaremember nani alilaid out hiyo pattern.
summary: Kuna missing fasteners na mismatch kati ya splice plate na drawing kwenye B767 winglet mod, inahitaji Engineering follow-up na cross-check kwenye aircraft nyingine.

narrative_text: B757-300 door 1-Left escape slide had detached and was replaced per AMM 25-66-01 following a verbal turnover from swing shift; the old slide was removed and a new one installed. On arrival at the down-line station, crew reported the D-Ring missing and the Door Assist Bottle empty, apparently overlooked during the changeout as the D-Ring was confused with another ring on the slide. Next shift to verify D-Ring installation and Assist Bottle pressure/status before further dispatch, and confirm AMM steps were fully completed.
summary: A B757-300 1-Left door slide replacement was completed but the D-Ring and Assist Bottle check were missed, requiring follow-up verification.

narrative_text: Ndege ya B757-300 ilikuwa na tatizo la slide ya mlango wa 1-Left iliyokuwa imeanguka, na ilibadilishwa kufuatana na AMM 25-66-01 baada ya maelezo ya mdomo kutoka kwa zamu ya jioni; slide ya zamani iliondolewa na mpya kufungwa. Ilipofika kwenye kituo cha chini, wafanyakazi waliripoti kuwa D-Ring haikuwepo na chupa ya msaada wa mlango (Door Assist Bottle) ilikuwa tupu, jambo lililosahaulika wakati wa kazi kwani D-Ring ilichanganywa na pete nyingine kwenye slide. Zamu inayofuata ihakikishe D-Ring imefungwa vizuri na hali ya chupa ya msaada kabla ya ndege kuruhusiwa kuendelea na safari, na kuthibitisha hatua zote za AMM zimekamilika.
summary: Ubadilishaji wa slide ya mlango wa 1-Left kwenye B757-300 ulikamilika lakini ukaguzi wa D-Ring na chupa ya msaada ulisahaulika, hivyo unahitaji ukaguzi wa ziada.

entities.text: chupa ya msaada wa mlango (Door Assist Bottle)

narrative_text: Kwa B757-300, door 1-Left slide ilikuwa imeanguka, tukafanya replacement kufuata AMM 25-66-01 baada ya verbal turnover kutoka swing shift; old slide iliondolewa na new one ikafungwa. Aircraft ilipofika down-line station, crew waliripoti D-Ring missing na Door Assist Bottle ilikuwa empty, seems ilisahaulika during changeout coz D-Ring ilichanganywa na ring mwingine kwenye slide. Next shift wa-verify D-Ring installation na status ya Assist Bottle before dispatch, na confirm AMM steps zote zimefanywa vizuri.
summary: Slide replacement ya door 1-Left kwenye B757-300 ilikamilika lakini D-Ring check na Assist Bottle zilisahaulika, so inahitaji follow-up.

narrative_text: ATR-72 in the hangar on jacks: completed full NLG strut service per job card and AMM 12-12-32 after previous shift flagged low strut with no leakage signs. On removal of the strut servicing tool, the second half of the tool (same part number, chrome-threaded like the schrader valve) was left behind on the schrader valve, which later broke and caused sheet metal damage behind the NLG when the aircraft returned to the hangar. Next shift please inspect NLG area for full extent of damage and confirm tool inventory/count before closing the job card.
summary: During NLG strut servicing on an ATR-72, a mistakenly unremoved tool piece broke the schrader valve and damaged sheet metal, requiring follow-up inspection.

entities.text: full NLG strut service per job card and AMM 12-12-32

narrative_text: Ndege ya ATR-72 ilikuwa hangarini ikiwa juu ya jacks; huduma kamili ya NLG strut ilifanywa kufuata job card na AMM 12-12-32 baada ya shift iliyopita kuripoti strut kuwa chini bila dalili za uvujaji. Wakati wa kutoa tool ya huduma, sehemu ya pili ya chombo hicho (yenye namba sawa na ile ya kwanza, na thread inayofanana na ya schrader valve) ilisahaulika juu ya schrader valve, na baadaye ikasababisha valve hiyo kuvunjika na uharibifu wa sheet metal nyuma ya NLG ndege iliporudi hangarini. Shift inayofuata iangalie eneo la NLG kwa uharibifu zaidi na ihakikishe hesabu ya vifaa kabla ya kufunga job card.
summary: Wakati wa huduma ya NLG strut kwenye ATR-72, kipande cha tool kilichosahaulika kilisababisha uharibifu wa schrader valve na sheet metal, hivyo ukaguzi zaidi unahitajika.

narrative_text: Tulikuwa na ATR-72 hapo hangar ikiwa on jacks, tukafanya full service ya NLG strut kufuata job card na AMM 12-12-32 baada ya previous shift kuflag strut ilikuwa low but hakuna leakage. Ile tool ya servicing, part yake ya pili (ina same part number, chrome na imethread kama schrader valve) ilibaki imeinstall pale kwa schrader valve, na later ikasababisha valve ikabreak na sheet metal damage nyuma ya NLG wakati ndege irudi hangarini. Next shift wapitie NLG area waangalie damage yote na wa-confirm tool count kabla ya kuclose job card.
summary: During NLG servicing kwenye ATR-72, tool piece iliyobaki accidentally ilisababisha schrader valve kubreak na sheet metal damage, so follow-up inspection inahitajika.

narrative_text: During the A330 right engine change, previous shift robbed the anti-ice valve, start valve and duct assembly from the old engine and installed them on the new engine without raising any robbing paperwork or Maintenance reporting form. Incoming crew was only verbally told at turnover that parts were robbed, and later completed the shop work order sign-off and M/M leak/operational checks based on that verbal info alone, since no jobcards exist for A330 engine changes (unlike A320/319 which callout the anti-ice valve removal/reinstall step). Please verify and close out the robbing documentation for these three components before further release, and flag the missing engine-change jobcard gap to Engineering/QA.
summary: Parts robbed off the old A330 engine and installed on the new one without proper robbing paperwork, discovered after sign-off due to lack of an A330 engine-change jobcard.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kubadilisha engine ya kulia ya A330, shift iliyotangulia ilitoa valve ya anti-ice, start valve, na duct assembly kutoka kwenye engine ya zamani na kuziweka kwenye engine mpya bila kujaza fomu ya robbing wala maintenance reporting form. Sisi tuliopokea kazi tuliambiwa tu kwa mdomo wakati wa turnover kuwa parts zimetolewa, na baadaye tukafanya sign-off ya shop work order na leak/operational checks kwa mujibu wa M/M kutegemea tu maelezo hayo ya mdomo, kwa sababu kampuni haina jobcard ya engine change ya A330 (tofauti na A320/319 ambayo ina hatua ya kuondoa na kurudisha anti-ice valve). Tafadhali hakikisheni documentation ya robbing kwa hizo parts tatu imekamilika kabla ya release yoyote, na mjulishe Engineering/QA kuhusu upungufu wa jobcard.
summary: Parts zilitolewa kwenye engine ya zamani ya A330 na kuwekwa kwenye mpya bila documentation sahihi ya robbing, jambo lililogunduliwa baada ya sign-off kwa sababu ya kukosekana jobcard ya engine change.

narrative_text: Kwa hii A330 right engine change, previous shift walirob parts - anti-ice valve, start valve na duct assembly - kutoka kwa old engine wakaziinstall kwa new engine bila kufanya robbing paperwork ama maintenance reporting form. Sisi tuliopokea job tuliambiwa tu verbally during turnover ati parts zimerobbed, ndio tukaenda tuka-sign off ile shop work order na kufanya leak/operational checks per M/M kutegemea tu hiyo verbal info, kwa sababu company haina jobcard ya A330 engine change (tofauti na A320/319 ambayo ina step ya remove/reinstall anti-ice valve). Tafadhali confirm documentation ya robbing kwa hizo three components ikamilike kabla ya release, na raise the jobcard gap kwa Engineering/QA.
summary: Parts zilirobbed kutoka old A330 engine zikaenda new engine bila proper paperwork, ikagunduliwa baada ya sign-off kwa sababu ya kukosekana jobcard ya A330 engine change.

narrative_text: During the CVR ULB test on the Q400 tail section, the ULB Tester was borrowed from the bench instead of being pulled from its assigned drawer, and after the task it was returned to the wrong drawer since its correct storage location was unclear. The tester has since gone missing from Avionics for about two weeks; Stores was asked but could not confirm if it was pulled for turn-in. Follow-up needed: confirm the correct ULB Tester storage location, verify station tool authorization list, and check Aircraft Y tail section where a ULB Tester was reportedly found, in case it belongs to our inventory.
summary: A ULB Tester used during a Q400 CVR test was misplaced due to unclear storage procedures and remains unaccounted for, requiring follow-up with Stores and verification against another aircraft's tail section.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kufanya kipimo cha CVR ULB kwenye mkia wa ndege ya Q400, Kifaa cha kupima ULB (ULB Tester) kilitolewa kwenye meza badala ya kutolewa mahali pake rasmi cha kuhifadhiwa, na baada ya kazi kilirudishwa mahali pasipo sahihi kwa sababu eneo lake halali halikuwa wazi. Kifaa hicho kimekuwa hakipatikani kwa muda wa wiki mbili sasa, na Stores waliulizwa lakini hawakuweza kuthibitisha kama kilitolewa kwa ajili ya kurejeshwa. Inahitajika ufuatiliaji: kuhakikisha mahali sahihi pa kuhifadhi ULB Tester, kuangalia orodha ya vibali vya vifaa vya kituo, na kukagua mkia wa ndege ya Aircraft Y ambako kifaa kimoja cha ULB kiliripotiwa kupatikana, ili kuona kama ni chetu.
summary: Kifaa cha kupima ULB kilichotumika wakati wa kipimo cha CVR kwenye ndege ya Q400 kilipotea kutokana na utaratibu usio wazi wa kuhifadhi vifaa, na kinahitaji ufuatiliaji na Stores pamoja na uangalizi kwenye ndege nyingine.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kufanya CVR ULB test kwenye tail ya Q400, tulitumia ULB Tester ambayo ilikuwa imewekwa kwenye bench, si kwenye drawer yake ya kawaida, halafu baada ya kazi ikarudishwa drawer isiyo sahihi kwa sababu proper location haikuwa clear. Sasa ni kama wiki mbili, tester haipatikani Avionics, na Stores waliulizwa lakini hawajaconfirm kama ilipull for turn-in. Tunahitaji follow-up: confirm correct storage location ya ULB Tester, check station tool authorization list, na uangalie tail ya Aircraft Y ambapo ULB Tester nyingine iliripotiwa kupatikana, maybe ni yetu.
summary: ULB Tester iliyotumika during CVR test kwenye Q400 imepotea kwa sababu ya confusion ya storage location, na inahitaji follow-up na Stores pamoja na kuangalia Aircraft Y.

narrative_text: Heads up on the B737-700 horizontal stabilizer jackscrew/cable R/R at STA 328: two pulleys (STA and STB cables) were removed during the job but never reinstalled before panels were closed up. Day shift signed off cable tension and adjustment as OK, and the Inspector closed out the R/R and NRC cards without knowing the pulleys were missing. Please pull jobcard XXXX and the maintenance form, verify pulley installation against the maintenance manual before further flight release.
summary: Two horizontal stabilizer cable pulleys were left uninstalled after a jackscrew/cable R/R on a B737-700 and were signed off in error, requiring verification before release.

narrative_text: Kuna tatizo kwenye kazi ya kubadilisha jackscrew na cable za horizontal stabilizer kwenye ndege ya B737-700 karibu na STA 328: pulley mbili, moja ya STA na nyingine ya STB, ziliondolewa wakati wa kazi lakini hazikurudishwa kabla ya paneli kufungwa. Zamu ya mchana walithibitisha mvutano wa cable kuwa sawa, na Inspector alisaini fomu za R/R na NRC bila kujua pulley hazikuwekwa. Tafadhali angalia jobcard XXXX na fomu ya matengenezo, na hakikisha pulley zimewekwa kulingana na maelekezo ya maintenance manual kabla ya ndege kuruhusiwa kuruka.
summary: Pulley mbili za cable za horizontal stabiliza ziliachwa bila kuwekwa baada ya kazi ya R/R kwenye B737-700, na zilisainiwa kimakosa, hivyo zinahitaji kuangaliwa kabla ya kuruhusu ndege.

entities.text: jackscrew na cable za horizontal stabilizer

narrative_text: Guys, kuna issue kwenye ile horizontal stabilizer jackscrew/cable R/R kwenye B737-700 pale STA 328. Zile pulley mbili, moja ya STA cable na nyingine ya STB cable, ziliremovewa lakini hazikurudishwa before panels zikacloswa. Day shift walisema cable tension na adjustment ni OK, halafu Inspector akasign-off R/R card na NRC bila kujua kama pulley hazijawekwa. Tafadhali check jobcard XXXX na ile maintenance form, tuconfirm pulley zimeinstall properly kulingana na manual kabla ya release.
summary: Pulley mbili za horizontal stabilizer cable ziliachwa bila kuinstall kwenye B737-700 na zikasignwa off kimakosa, so inahitaji kuchekiwa kabla ya release.

narrative_text: Overnight #2 engine change on the Dash 8-100 was completed with a skeleton crew and limited RII/QC coverage due to severe weather delaying the QC Inspector; Maintenance Control authorized a temporary RII for one technician from ZZZ1 to sign off portions of the installation, including propeller hub work. Aircraft was later ferried and returned to service, but a flight crew subsequently reported oil coming from the propeller hub assembly. Next shift needs to pull the full QC/RII paperwork trail on the hub and propeller installation and verify all inspection blocks were properly covered before further flight.
summary: Engine change on Dash 8-100 completed under staffing/weather pressure with temporary RII coverage; oil leak later found at propeller hub, requiring inspection paperwork review.

narrative_text: Usiku uliopita tulifanya mabadiliko ya injini namba mbili kwenye ndege ya Dash 8-100 tukiwa na wafanyakazi wachache na msaada mdogo wa ukaguzi wa ubora kwa sababu ya mvua kali iliyochelewesha Mkaguzi wa QC; Udhibiti wa Matengenezo waliruhusu fundi mmoja kutoka ZZZ1 kupewa idhini ya muda ya kukagua na kusaini sehemu ya kazi hiyo, ikiwemo eneo la hub ya propela. Ndege ilipelekwa na kuendelea na safari, lakini baadaye wafanyakazi wa ndege waliripoti mafuta yanayovuja kutoka kwenye hub ya propela. Zamu inayofuata inahitaji kupitia kabisa nyaraka za ukaguzi wa QC/RII za sehemu ya hub na propela kabla ya safari nyingine.
summary: Mabadiliko ya injini ya Dash 8-100 yalifanywa chini ya shinikizo la wafanyakazi na hali ya hewa, na baadaye mafuta yaligundulika yakivuja kwenye hub ya propela, hivyo nyaraka za ukaguzi zinahitaji kupitiwa.

narrative_text: Jana usiku tulido engine change ya #2 engine kwa Dash 8-100, lakini tulikuwa na manpower kidogo sana na hakuna QC Inspector wa kutosha kwa sababu ya mvua kali iliyo-delay msaada kutoka ZZZ1. Maintenance Control walimpa fundi mmoja temporary RII ili aendelee ku-sign off sehemu za installation, including yale propeller hub work. Ndege ilifanya ferry flight na kuendelea na operations, lakini baadaye crew wa flight waliripoti oil inavuja kwa propeller hub assembly. Next shift lazima wa-verify hizo QC/RII paperwork zote za hub na propeller kabla ya kuendelea na flights.
summary: Engine change ya Dash 8-100 ilifanywa na staffing na weather pressure, halafu oil leak ikagunduliwa kwa propeller hub, hivyo paperwork ya RII inahitaji review.

narrative_text: Took over logbook closeout for the B767-300 from the outgoing Lead Mechanic after a rushed handover with seven aircraft OTS; reviewed the work package and accountability sheet and cleared the one outstanding item, believing everything else was accounted for. This morning it was found that two MEL items had been signed off on the Maintenance Report but never actually entered into the aircraft logbook. Next shift please verify logbook entries against the Maintenance Report for this tail number before further dispatch, and ensure a proper verbal turnover is done between Lead Mechanics on busy shifts.
summary: Incoming Lead Mechanic closed out a B767-300 logbook after a rushed turnover and missed two MEL items that were signed off but never entered into the logbook.

narrative_text: Nilipokea jukumu la kufunga logbook ya B767-300 kutoka kwa Lead Mechanic aliyekuwa akiondoka, turnover ikiwa ya haraka kwa sababu ndege saba zilikuwa hazifanyi kazi (OTS) siku hiyo. Nilipitia work package na accountability sheet, nikaona kila kitu kimesainiwa isipokuwa kipengele kimoja ambacho nilikifunga mwenyewe. Asubuhi hii imegundulika kuwa vipengele viwili vya MEL vilisainiwa kwenye Maintenance Report lakini havikuwahi kuandikwa kwenye logbook. Zamu inayofuata inaombwa kuhakiki logbook dhidi ya Maintenance Report kabla ya ndege hiyo kutumika tena, na kuhakikisha turnover kamili inafanyika kati ya Lead Mechanics wakati wa siku zenye shughuli nyingi.
summary: Lead Mechanic aliyeingia zamu alifunga logbook ya B767-300 baada ya turnover ya haraka na kukosa kuona vipengele viwili vya MEL vilivyosainiwa lakini havikuandikwa kwenye logbook.

narrative_text: Nili-take over closeout ya logbook ya B767-300 kutoka kwa Lead Mechanic aliyekuwa anaenda home, lakini turnover ilikuwa ya haraka sana coz tulikuwa na seven aircraft OTS siku hiyo. Ni-review work package na accountability sheet, kila kitu kimeonekana signed-for except item moja ambayo ni-clear mwenyewe. Leo asubuhi tumepata report kwamba MEL items mbili zilikuwa signed-off kwenye Maintenance Report lakini hazikuwahi ku-enter kwenye logbook. Next shift please mu-verify logbook against Maintenance Report kabla ya kuendelea na dispatch, na tuhakikishe tuna-do proper verbal turnover kati ya Lead Mechanics especially siku za busy namna hii.
summary: Lead Mechanic ali-close logbook ya B767-300 after rushed turnover na aka-miss MEL items mbili ambazo zilikuwa signed-off lakini hazikuingizwa kwenye logbook.

narrative_text: CRJ900 CAT II/TOGA check completed after prior shift's RH pitot probe replacement did not resolve airspeed disagree between PFD-1 and PFD-2 on the DPS-450 ADTS. Swapped pitot probe adaptors from another test kit, reran the check, and both PFDs read 85 KTS correctly; leak check on RH probe verified good per AMM. Removed tape from AOA vanes and S2 ports, but tape on the LH S1 port was inadvertently left in place. Aircraft flew three legs and on the last leg crew reported EFIS COMP MON and a 250 FT altitude split; ground crew found melted tape at the LH S1 port and replaced the pitot/static probe before return to service. Next shift should audit tape removal procedure on CAT II job cards and confirm all S1/S2 port coverings are logged and removed prior to release.
summary: Leftover electrician's tape on the LH pitot S1 port after a CAT II/TOGA check caused an in-flight EFIS/altitude disagreement, requiring probe replacement; tape-removal verification process needs review.

narrative_text: Kazi ya CAT II/TOGA check kwenye CRJ900 imekamilika baada ya shift iliyopita kubadilisha pitot probe ya RH bila kutatua tatizo la airspeed kutofautiana kati ya PFD-1 na PFD-2 kwenye kifaa cha DPS-450. Nilibadilisha adaptors za pitot probe kutoka test kit nyingine, nikarudia ukaguzi, na PFD zote mbili zikasoma 85 KTS sawasawa; ukaguzi wa leak kwenye probe ya RH ulionekana mzuri kulingana na AMM. Tepu ilitolewa kwenye AOA vanes na S2 ports, lakini kwa bahati mbaya tepu ya S1 port upande wa kushoto haikutolewa. Ndege iliruka safari tatu, na katika safari ya mwisho crew waliripoti onyo la EFIS COMP MON pamoja na tofauti ya altitude ya futi 250; wafanyakazi wa ardhini walikuta tepu iliyoungua kwenye S1 port ya kushoto na kubadilisha pitot/static probe kabla ndege kurudi kazini. Shift inayokuja inatakiwa kuangalia utaratibu wa kutoa tepu kwenye job card ya CAT II na kuhakikisha ports zote za S1/S2 zimeandikwa na kutolewa kabla ya kutolewa kwa ndege.
summary: Tepu iliyosalia kwenye S1 port ya pitot upande wa kushoto baada ya ukaguzi wa CAT II/TOGA ilisababisha tofauti ya EICAS/altitude wakati wa ndege, hivyo probe kubadilishwa, na utaratibu wa kuangalia utolewaji wa tepu unahitaji kuboreshwa.

narrative_text: Tume-finish CAT II/TOGA check kwenye CRJ900 baada ya previous shift kubadilisha RH pitot probe lakini bado airspeed disagree kati ya PFD-1 na PFD-2 kwenye DPS-450 tester. Nika-swap pitot probe adaptors kutoka test kit nyingine, nika-rerun check, both PFDs zika-read 85 KTS vizuri; leak check ya RH probe ilikuwa good per AMM. Tuli-remove tape kwenye AOA vanes na S2 ports, lakini tape ya LH S1 port ilibaki bila kutolewa kwa mistake. Ndege ilifanya legs tatu, na kwenye last leg crew wame-report EFIS COMP MON message na altitude split ya 250 FT; ground crew walikuta tape imeungua karibu na LH S1 port, waka-replace pitot/static probe kabla aircraft kurudi service. Next shift wanahitaji kuangalia procedure ya tape removal kwenye CAT II job card na ku-confirm ports zote za S1/S2 zime-log na kutolewa before release.
summary: Tape iliyobaki kwenye LH pitot S1 port baada ya CAT II/TOGA check ilisababisha EFIS/altitude disagreement mid-flight, hivyo probe ika-replace na tape-removal check inahitaji kuboreshwa.

narrative_text: During the Number 2 Hydraulic System flush and EDP installation on the Q400, the aft cowl door was left open while working from the highlift, and the capped case drain line on top of the EDP was not spotted from that angle. The pump was hooked up on pressure, return, and bottom drain lines only, and the aircraft later dispatched with the case drain still capped, causing a reported hydraulic fluid loss and flight cancellation. Incoming shift needs to confirm the Number 2 EDP R/R is complete, verify all four hydraulic lines including the case drain are properly connected, and recommend closing cowl doors before lift access on future EDP tasks.
summary: A technician missed connecting a capped case drain line on the Q400's Number 2 EDP during installation, leading to a hydraulic fluid loss report and flight cancellation, requiring follow-up verification of the pump R/R.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kazi ya kusafisha Mfumo wa Hydraulic Namba 2 na kufunga EDP kwenye ndege ya Q400, mlango wa cowl wa nyuma ulibaki wazi wakati fundi akifanya kazi kutoka kwenye highlift, na line ya case drain iliyokuwa na kifuniko juu ya EDP haikuonekana kutokana na pembe ile ya kufanyia kazi. Pump ilikamiliana tu na mistari ya pressure, return, na drain ya chini, kisha ndege ikaruka huku case drain ikiwa bado imefungwa, jambo lililosababisha taarifa ya upungufu wa maji ya hydraulic na hatimaye safari kufutwa. Shift inayoingia inatakiwa kuthibitisha kuwa R/R ya EDP Namba 2 imekamilika, kuangalia mistari yote minne ya hydraulic ikiwa imeunganishwa vizuri ikiwemo case drain, na kuhakikisha milango ya cowl inafungwa kabla ya kutumia lift kwenye kazi za EDP baadaye.
summary: Fundi alishindwa kuunganisha line ya case drain yenye kifuniko kwenye EDP ya Namba 2 ya Q400, jambo lililosababisha taarifa ya upungufu wa maji ya hydraulic na kufutwa kwa safari, hivyo linahitaji uthibitisho wa ufuatiliaji.

narrative_text: Jana wakati wa ile flush ya Number 2 Hydraulic System na kufunga EDP kwenye Q400, aft cowl door ilibaki open wakati fundi akiwa kwenye highlift, na case drain line iliyokuwa capped juu ya EDP haikuonekana from that angle. Pump ilikamiliana na pressure line, return line, na drain ya bottom tu, halafu aircraft ika-dispatch na case drain bado imefungwa, kukasababisha crew kureport low hydraulic fluid na flight kucancel. Shift inayoincoming iconfirm kama EDP R/R imekamilika, ichecki lines zote four za hydraulic ziko connected properly including case drain, na tukumbuke kuclose cowl doors kabla ya kutumia lift next time.
summary: Fundi alimiss kuconnect capped case drain line kwenye Number 2 EDP ya Q400 wakati wa installation, na hii ikaleta hydraulic fluid loss report na flight cancellation, so incoming shift inahitaji kufollow up.

narrative_text: A319 was released for service after overnight completion of the First Officer's sliding window replacement per AMM 56-12-11-400, work having been turned over from Third Shift with only final adjustments and trim installation pending. After release, the Third Shift mechanic called to report he had forgotten to install one of two bolts and nuts securing the window release handle to the window trolley bellcrank (IPC item #380). The aircraft was already on layover in ZZZ1; ZZZ1 maintenance confirmed the missing hardware and coordinated with our lead using IPC 56-12-11 to identify the correct part numbers. Follow-up: verify hardware install completed and re-inspect airworthiness sign-off before next dispatch.
summary: A319 was released for service with missing window-handle hardware after an incomplete overnight turnover, requiring urgent follow-up at the layover station.

narrative_text: Ndege ya A319 ilitolewa kwa huduma baada ya kazi ya kubadilisha dirisha la kuteleza la First Officer kukamilika usiku, kulingana na AMM 56-12-11-400, huku kazi ikiwa imekabidhiwa kutoka zamu ya tatu na kubaki tu marekebisho ya mwisho na ufungaji wa ukingo wa dirisha. Baada ya ndege kutolewa, fundi wa zamu ya tatu alipiga simu kuripoti kwamba alisahau kufunga bolt moja pamoja na nati zake kwenye kishikizo cha dirisha kilichounganishwa na bellcrank ya trolley ya dirisha (kipengele namba 380 cha IPC). Ndege ilikuwa tayari imelala ZZZ1, na wafanyakazi wa matengenezo huko walithibitisha vifaa hivyo vilikosekana, kisha wakashirikiana na kiongozi wetu kutumia IPC 56-12-11 kutambua namba sahihi za sehemu. Inahitajika ufuatiliaji wa haraka kuthibitisha ufungaji umekamilika kabla ya safari inayofuata.
summary: Ndege ya A319 ilitolewa kwa huduma ikiwa na vifaa vya kishikizo cha dirisha havijakamilika baada ya kukabidhiana kazi vibaya usiku, hivyo inahitaji ufuatiliaji wa haraka mahali ndege ilipolala.

entities.text: dirisha la kuteleza la First Officer

narrative_text: Aircraft A319 ilirelease for service baada ya ile window replacement ya First Officer's sliding window kukamilika usiku, tukifuata AMM 56-12-11-400 — kazi ilikuwa imekabidhiwa kutoka Third Shift na yale yaliyobaki ni final adjustments na ku-install trim tu. Baada ya release, yule mechanic wa Third Shift alicall akasema alisahau ku-install one of two bolts na nuts kwenye window release handle inayo-attach kwa window trolley bellcrank, item #380 kwa IPC. Ndege ilikuwa tayari on layover ZZZ1, so tulicall ZZZ1 maintenance wakaconfirm hardware ilikuwa missing, then tukatumia IPC 56-12-11 kupata part numbers sahihi na lead wetu. Follow-up: hakikisha hardware imefungwa properly kabla ya next dispatch, na tuverify sign-off ya airworthiness upya.
summary: A319 ilirelease ikiwa na bolts na nuts missing kwenye window release handle baada ya turnover isiyo complete, so inahitaji follow-up ya haraka kwa layover station.

narrative_text: B737-400 had a lengthy gate squawk list; last item was FCU replacement due to a wheel well fault. Paperwork lagged behind part arrival, and under time pressure the breaker was pulled and aircraft powered down before proper documentation was in hand; during light plate reinstall the APU and #2 engine fire handles were slightly disturbed and had to be re-verified for discharge. Captain declined to accept the aircraft or an MEL for crew O2 at 1000 PSI, so O2 was serviced to full; FCU swap ops-checked good but aircraft went out of service over 30 minutes into the delay for drug/alcohol testing of all involved. Follow-up: confirm FCU paperwork closure and reinforce not starting critical jobs before documentation arrives, regardless of delay pressure.
summary: FCU replacement on a B737-400 was completed under time pressure without proper paperwork sequencing, leading to fire handle disturbance, crew O2 concerns, and a delay with post-incident testing.

narrative_text: Ndege ya B737-400 ilikuwa na orodha ndefu ya matatizo wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu, jambo la mwisho likiwa kubadilisha FCU kutokana na hitilafu kwenye wheel well. Nyaraka za sehemu zilichelewa kufika kuliko sehemu yenyewe, na kwa sababu ya shinikizo la muda, breaker iliondolewa na ndege kuzimwa kabla ya nyaraka kukamilika; wakati wa kufunga light plate, mikono ya fire handle ya APU na injini namba mbili iliguswa kidogo na ilibidi ithibitishwe tena kuwa haijatoa moshi. Kapteni alikataa kupokea ndege au kukubali MEL kwa oksijeni ya wafanyakazi ikiwa kwenye 1000 PSI, hivyo oksijeni ilijazwa hadi kiwango kamili; ukaguzi wa FCU ulionyesha matokeo mazuri lakini ndege iliondolewa kwenye huduma baada ya dakika thelathini za ucheleweshaji kwa ajili ya vipimo vya dawa za kulevya na pombe kwa wote waliohusika. Ufuatiliaji unahitajika: kuthibitisha nyaraka za FCU zimekamilika na kusisitiza umuhimu wa kusubiri nyaraka kabla ya kuanza kazi muhimu, hata kama kuna shinikizo la muda.
summary: Ubadilishaji wa FCU kwenye ndege ya B737-400 ulifanywa haraka bila kusubiri nyaraka kikamilifu, na kusababisha mguso wa fire handles, wasiwasi wa oksijeni ya wafanyakazi, na ucheleweshaji uliofuatiwa na vipimo vya dawa za kulevya.

entities.text: fire handle ya APU na injini namba mbili
vipimo vya dawa za kulevya na pombe

narrative_text: Kwa B737-400 kulikuwa na long list ya squawks kwa gate call, item ya mwisho ikiwa kubadilisha FCU kwa sababu ya fault kwenye wheel well. Part ilifika kabla ya paperwork, na kwa sababu ya time pressure tulipull breaker na kupower down aircraft kabla nyaraka hazijakamilika; tulipokuwa tunaweka light plate, tuligusa kidogo fire handles za APU na engine namba mbili so tulilazimika kuverify tena discharge. Captain alirefuse kuchukua aircraft ama kuaccept MEL ya crew O2 ikiwa 1000 PSI, so tulisevice O2 hadi full; FCU swap ilipita ops check poa lakini aircraft ikatoka service baada ya delay ya zaidi ya dakika 30 for drug and alcohol testing kwa wote walohusika. Follow-up: confirm FCU paperwork imeclose na tusisitize kusubiri documentation kabla ya kuanza job muhimu, hata kama kuna delay pressure.
summary: FCU swap kwenye B737-400 ilifanywa under time pressure bila paperwork kukamilika, na kusababisha fire handles kuguswa, wasiwasi wa crew O2, na delay yenye drug/alcohol testing.

entities.text: fire handles za APU na engine namba mbili

narrative_text: Aircraft X (B747-400) TCAS lower antenna write-up: coax found bad at the bench plug. On instruction from the Line Maintenance Specialist, we pulled a good harness from Aircraft Y (ferry flight for corrosion repair) and were then directed to install the known-bad harness from Aircraft X onto Aircraft Y. A Union Steward intervened since the Specialist, a Management position, was performing hourly rated work himself. Next shift: confirm no bad part was installed on Aircraft Y, verify TCAS harness sourcing, and follow up on the policy/procedure conflict raised with Management.
summary: A known-bad TCAS harness was nearly swapped between two B747-400s under management pressure, raising procedural and union concerns needing follow-up.

narrative_text: Ndege X (B747-400) ilikuwa na hitilafu ya TCAS lower antenna; coax ilipatikana mbovu kwenye bench plug. Kwa maagizo ya Line Maintenance Specialist, tuliondoa harness nzuri kutoka Ndege Y (ambayo ilikuwa inaenda ferry flight kwa ukarabati wa corrosion), kisha tukaambiwa tufunge ile harness mbovu ya Ndege X kwenye Ndege Y. Union Steward aliingilia kati kwa sababu Specialist huyo, ambaye ni Management, alikuwa akifanya kazi ya hourly rated peke yake. Zamu ijayo: hakikisheni hakuna sehemu mbovu iliyofungwa kwenye Ndege Y, thibitisheni chanzo cha TCAS harness, na fuatilieni suala la sera lililoibuliwa na Management.
summary: Harness mbovu ya TCAS ilikaribia kufungwa kwenye ndege nyingine kutokana na shinikizo la Management, jambo linalohitaji ufuatiliaji.

narrative_text: Kwenye Aircraft X (B747-400) kulikuwa na TCAS lower antenna write-up, tukapata coax ni bad kwenye bench plug. Line Maintenance Specialist akatuambia tu-rob harness nzuri kutoka Aircraft Y ambayo ilikuwa inaenda ferry flight kwa corrosion repair, then akatuambia tuinstall ile bad harness ya Aircraft X kwenye Aircraft Y badala yake. Union Steward alilazimika kuingilia kati kwa sababu huyu Specialist, ambaye ni Management, alikuwa anafanya hourly rated work mwenyewe. Kwa next shift, hakikisheni hakuna bad part iliyoinstall kwenye Aircraft Y, mconfirm TCAS harness sourcing, na mfollow up hii policy conflict na Management.
summary: Kulikuwa na pressure ya kuinstall known-bad TCAS harness kwenye ndege nyingine, jambo linalohitaji follow-up ya haraka.

narrative_text: Heads up on the EMB-120 left elevator event flagged by the Maintenance Director: two outer hinge bolts on the vertical axis were found missing, and elevator movement in flight triggered a serious inflight emergency before a safe landing. My involvement was limited to cleaning and inspecting the hardware and confirming the washer/spacer pileup against the IPC; no bolt replacement was flagged at that time. Please follow up with QA on the bolt-torque and installation procedure for both elevator hinges, and pull the maintenance records for the last inspection cycle for review.
summary: An EMB-120 left elevator suffered a serious inflight emergency after two hinge bolts were found missing, requiring follow-up review of inspection and installation procedures.

narrative_text: Taarifa kutoka kwa Mkurugenzi wa Matengenezo kuhusu tukio la elevator ya kushoto ya ndege ya EMB-120: bolti mbili za nje za bawaba katika mhimili wa wima zilikutwa hazipo, na mwendo wa elevator ukiwa hewani ulisababisha dharura kubwa kabla ya ndege kutua salama. Kazi yangu ilikuwa ni kusafisha na kukagua vifaa hivyo tu, na kuthibitisha mpangilio wa washer na spacer kulingana na kitabu cha vipuri vya mtengenezaji; sikuona sababu ya kubadilisha bolti wakati huo. Tafadhali fuatilia na idara ya udhibiti wa ubora kuhusu utaratibu wa ufungaji wa bolti kwenye bawaba zote mbili za elevator, na pia mkague rekodi za ukaguzi wa mwisho.
summary: Elevator ya kushoto ya ndege ya EMB-120 ilisababisha dharura kubwa hewani baada ya bolti mbili za bawaba kukutwa hazipo, hivyo kunahitajika ufuatiliaji wa taratibu za ukaguzi na ufungaji.

entities.text: bolti mbili za nje za bawaba

narrative_text: Kuna update kuhusu ile EMB-120 left elevator issue ambayo Maintenance Director aliripoti: walikuta zile outer hinge bolts mbili kwa vertical axis hazipo, na movement ya elevator ikiwa in-flight ilisababisha emergency kubwa kabla ndege ku-land salama. Mimi nilikuwa naclean na kuinspect tu hizo hardware, nika-confirm ile washer/spacer pileup according to IPC, sikuona reason ya ku-replace bolts wakati huo. Tafadhali follow up na QA kuhusu bolt-torque na installation procedure ya zile hinges mbili, pia pull maintenance records za last inspection cycle for review.
summary: Kuna serious inflight emergency ilitokea kwa EMB-120 left elevator baada ya bolts mbili za hinge kukosekana, so inahitajika follow-up na QA kuhusu inspection procedures.

narrative_text: On arrival at the gate, B777-200's #1 Engine kept running about four minutes after chocks and later showed smoke for a few minutes; flight deck displayed a Left Engine Fuel Valve message that cleared per Chapter-31 MAT reference, so aircraft was released after a one-hour delay with two normal subsequent starts. During taxi to the hangar for the inbound A-Check, the Cutoff switch failed to shut down #1 Engine on first and second attempts, and the Fire handle had to be pulled before the engine spooled down about 30 seconds later. Next shift needs to follow up on the Fuel Control Unit fault, pull the MAT printout that was generated, and coordinate with engineering before any further engine runs.
summary: A B777-200 had a Left Engine Fuel Valve fault and an engine that would not shut down normally via the Cutoff switch, requiring the Fire handle to stop it; follow-up on the fuel control unit fault is required.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kupokea ndege ya B777-200 kwenye geti, Engine namba 1 iliendelea kufanya kazi kwa dakika kama nne baada ya kuwekwa chocks, na baadaye ikaonekana moshi kwa muda mfupi; kwenye cockpit kulikuwa na ujumbe wa Left Engine Fuel Valve ambao ulikaguliwa kwenye Chapter-31 na kuonekana ni wa kawaida kufuta, hivyo ndege ilisafirishwa baada ya ucheleweshaji wa saa moja na kuanzishwa vizuri mara mbili baadaye. Wakati wa kusogeza ndege kuelekea hangar kwa ukaguzi wa A-Check, Engine namba 1 haikuzimika kwa kutumia Cutoff switch mara mbili, hivyo ilihitajika kuvuta Fire handle kabla injini kuzima baada ya sekunde thelathini. Zamu inayokuja inafaa kufuatilia hitilafu ya Fuel Control Unit, kupata nakala ya taarifa iliyochapishwa kutoka MAT, na kushauriana na uhandisi kabla ya kuendesha injini tena.
summary: Ndege ya B777-200 ilikuwa na hitilafu ya Left Engine Fuel Valve na injini isiyozima kwa njia ya kawaida, hivyo ikahitaji kutumia Fire handle, hali inayohitaji ufuatiliaji zaidi wa Fuel Control Unit.

narrative_text: Tulipokea B777-200 kwenye gate, na #1 Engine ilikaa ikirun kama dakika nne baada ya chocks, kisha tukaona smoke kidogo pale engine. Cockpit display ilikuwa na message ya Left Engine Fuel Valve, tukacheck Chapter-31 na ikaonekana ni erasable message tu, so aircraft ilirelease baada ya delay ya about one hour, na starts mbili zilizofuata zilikuwa normal. Lakini wakati wa taxi kuelekea hangar kwa A-Check, Cutoff switch ilifail kushut down #1 Engine mara mbili, mpaka tukalazimika kuvuta Fire handle ndipo engine ikaspooldown after 30 seconds. Zamu ijayo waangalie ile Fuel Control Unit fault, wapate ile MAT printout, na wawasiliane na engineering kabla ya engine runs zozote zingine.
summary: B777-200 ilikuwa na Left Engine Fuel Valve fault na engine ambayo haikushut down normally, ikilazimu kutumia Fire handle, hivyo Fuel Control Unit fault inahitaji follow-up.

narrative_text: EMB-145 came into the hangar for a First Officer's windshield heat fault; third shift removed the bad windshield and prepped the frame with a new seal before turnover. Day shift Mechanic X installed the windshield and operational leak checks were good, but it was later found the seal used was not correct for the aircraft's mod status/effectivity. Next shift needs to verify seal part number against effectivity records and confirm with the Lead Mechanic before closing out the RII sign-off. Please double-check any windshield seal jobs in progress for correct effectivity.
summary: A First Officer's windshield seal installed on an EMB-145 during shift turnover did not match the aircraft's mod effectivity, requiring follow-up verification with the Lead Mechanic.

narrative_text: Ndege ya EMB-145 iliingia hangar kwa sababu ya hitilafu ya joto la kioo cha mbele upande wa First Officer; shift ya usiku ilitoa kioo kilichoharibika na kuandaa fremu pamoja na seal mpya kabla ya kukabidhi kazi. Shift ya mchana, Fundi X aliweka kioo hicho na ukaguzi wa leak ulikuwa mzuri, lakini baadaye ikagundulika kuwa seal iliyowekwa haikuwa sahihi kulingana na hali ya marekebisho (mod effectivity) ya ndege hiyo. Shift inayofuata inahitaji kuthibitisha namba ya seal dhidi ya rekodi za effectivity na kuongea na Fundi Kiongozi kabla ya kufunga saini ya RII. Tafadhali kaguweni tena kazi zozote za seal za kioo zinazoendelea kuhakikisha effectivity ni sahihi.
summary: Seal ya kioo cha mbele cha First Officer kwenye ndege ya EMB-145 haikuwa sahihi kulingana na effectivity ya ndege, hivyo inahitaji uthibitisho zaidi na Fundi Kiongozi.

entities.text: kioo cha mbele upande wa First Officer

narrative_text: EMB-145 iliingia hangar kwa windshield heat fault upande wa First Officer; third shift walitoa ile windshield mbovu na kuprep frame na seal mpya kabla ya turnover. Day shift, Mechanic X akaweka ile windshield na operational leak checks zikawa fine, lakini baadaye tukagundua seal iliyotumika haikuwa correct kwa mod status/effectivity ya ndege. Next shift lazima wa-verify part number ya seal against effectivity records na kuongea na Lead Mechanic before kufunga RII sign-off. Tafadhali check tena kazi zozote za windshield seal zinazoendelea kuhakikisha effectivity ni sahihi.
summary: Seal ya First Officer windshield kwenye EMB-145 haikuwa correct kulingana na effectivity, hivyo next shift wanahitaji ku-verify na Lead Mechanic.

narrative_text: Opened the #1 engine cowl and thrust reverser on the MD-11 at the gate to hand over to hangar crew for the #1 engine IDG R&R. Due to workload from covering multiple gates that night, I turned the job over to the hangar mechanics without pulling and collaring the circuit breakers per AMM 71-10-00-2-1. Incoming crew/hangar team must verify breaker status before continuing work, and this needs to be flagged given the manpower shortage that night. Recommend anyone assigned an OTS aircraft be relieved of other gate duties to prevent this kind of miss.
summary: Technician failed to pull and collar circuit breakers before handing over an MD-11 #1 engine IDG R&R to hangar crew due to workload from covering multiple gates.

narrative_text: Nilifungua cowl na thrust reverser ya engine namba 1 kwenye ndege ya MD-11 gate ili kuikabidhi kwa wafanyakazi wa hangar kwa ajili ya kuondoa na kubadilisha IDG ya engine namba 1. Kwa sababu ya shughuli nyingi usiku huo nikizunguka gate mbalimbali, nilikabidhi kazi hiyo kwa mafundi wa hangar bila kuvuta na kufunga circuit breakers kama inavyotakiwa na AMM 71-10-00-2-1. Timu inayoendelea na kazi inahitajika kuthibitisha hali ya circuit breakers kabla ya kuendelea, na suala hili liangaliwe kwa uzito kutokana na uhaba wa wafanyakazi usiku huo. Napendekeza mtu anayeshughulikia ndege iliyo OTS asipangiwe gate nyingine ili kuepuka makosa kama haya.
summary: Fundi alisahau kuvuta na kufunga circuit breakers kabla ya kukabidhi kazi ya IDG ya engine namba 1 ya MD-11 kwa wafanyakazi wa hangar, kutokana na shughuli nyingi za gate nyingi usiku huo.

narrative_text: Nilifungua ile #1 engine cowl na thrust reverser kwenye MD-11 pale gate, ku-turnover kwa hangar crew wafanye R&R ya #1 engine IDG. Nilikuwa nazunguka gates zingine hiyo usiku, so nikiwapa turnover hangar mechanics nikaforget kupull na kucollar circuit breakers kama AMM 71-10-00-2-1 inavyosema. Whoever anacontinue na job hii lazima acheck circuit breaker status kabla ya kuendelea, tunayo staffing shortage hiyo night ndio maana things zikawa hectic. Nadhani ukiassign mtu OTS aircraft, apewe break kutoka gates zingine ili asimiss vitu kama hivi.
summary: Fundi alimiss kupull na kucollar circuit breakers before turnover ya #1 engine IDG R&R kwenye MD-11, kwa sababu ya workload ya kuzunguka gates nyingi hiyo usiku.

narrative_text: During cable tension checks on the CRJ-200 aileron, rudder and elevator systems, rig pins were installed in the rudder to support the upcoming Rudder PCU Functional Check, with plans to remove them after task completion post-lunch. With over 90 task cards in progress across dayshift and multiple mechanics working related tasks, the rig pin removal was missed and not caught since no travel check is required after this task. Incoming shift and lead mechanics must verify all rig pins are removed before aircraft release, especially when multiple technicians share pinning requirements across tasks.
summary: Rudder rig pins installed for a PCU functional check on a CRJ-200 were inadvertently left in place due to task overlap and workload, requiring verification by the next shift before release.

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa mvutano wa nyaya kwenye mifumo ya aileron, rudder na elevator ya ndege ya CRJ-200, pini za kurekebisha ziliwekwa kwenye rudder kwa ajili ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa Rudder PCU uliokuwa unatarajiwa baada ya chakula cha mchana. Kutokana na wingi wa kadi za kazi zaidi ya tisini pamoja na mafundi kadhaa kufanya kazi zinazohusiana, uondoaji wa pini hizo ulisahaulika na haukugunduliwa kwa sababu hakuna ukaguzi wa ziada unaohitajika baada ya kazi hiyo. Zamu inayofuata na mafundi wakuu wanapaswa kuhakikisha pini zote zimeondolewa kabla ndege kutolewa kwa huduma, hasa pale mafundi wengi wanaposhirikiana katika kazi zinazohitaji pini zilezile.
summary: Pini za kurekebisha rudder kwenye ndege ya CRJ-200 zilisahaulika kuondolewa baada ya ukaguzi wa PCU kutokana na msongamano wa kazi, hivyo zamu inayofuata inapaswa kuthibitisha zimeondolewa.

entities.text: ukaguzi wa utendaji wa Rudder PCU

narrative_text: Wakati wa cable tension checks kwenye aileron, rudder na elevator ya CRJ-200, tuliweka rig pins kwenye rudder ili ku-support Rudder PCU Functional Check ambayo ilikuwa ifanyike after lunch, na plan ilikuwa ku-remove pins baada ya task kukamilika. Na task cards zilikuwa zaidi ya tisini plus mechanics wengine wako on different tasks, uondoaji wa rig pins ulisahaulika kwa sababu hakuna travel check inayohitajika after hiyo task. Next shift lazima wa-verify rig pins zote zimeondolewa before release ya aircraft, especially pale mechanics wengi wanashare pinning requirements kwenye tasks tofauti.
summary: Rig pins za rudder kwenye CRJ-200 zilisahaulika kuondolewa after PCU check kutokana na workload, so next shift lazima wa-confirm removal before release.

narrative_text: During the last shift, the floor beam on the A320 (contract MRO line) was found forced down over a Hi-Lok, causing a gouge in an area with zero damage tolerance; the beam was pulled for review. On return we found the same damaged beam had already been re-installed by another crew without disposition, which is a safety concern. Two technicians were directly involved, and the DOM was notified but has not responded. Incoming shift must stop work on this beam, confirm engineering disposition before any further installation, and escalate DOM non-response.
summary: A damaged A320 floor beam was re-installed without proper disposition despite it being flagged, and DOM notification received no response.

narrative_text: Katika zamu iliyopita, boriti ya sakafu ya ndege ya A320, katika kituo cha ukarabati cha kandarasi, ilipatikana ikiwa imesukumwa kwa nguvu juu ya Hi-Lok na kusababisha mkwaruzo katika sehemu isiyoruhusiwa kuwa na uharibifu wowote; boriti hiyo iliondolewa kwa ukaguzi zaidi. Tuliporudi kazini, tuligundua kuwa boriti ile ile yenye hitilafu ilikuwa tayari imewekwa tena bila idhini rasmi, jambo ambalo ni hatari kiusalama. Mafundi wawili walihusika moja kwa moja, na Meneja wa Matengenezo (DOM) alijulishwa lakini hajajibu mpaka sasa. Zamu inayofuata inapaswa kusitisha kazi kwenye boriti hii, kuthibitisha idhini ya kihandisi kabla ya kuendelea, na kufuatilia ukimya wa DOM.
summary: Boriti ya sakafu ya A320 yenye hitilafu iliwekwa tena bila idhini rasmi, na taarifa kwa DOM haijajibiwa.

narrative_text: Kwa hii zamu iliyopita, ile floor beam ya A320 huko contract MRO ilipatikana imeforce down juu ya Hi-Lok, ikaleta gouge kwa area ambayo hakuna damage limits allowed - so tuka-remove hio beam for review. Tulipo-return, tukakuta hio beam ile ile yenye damage imeshaingizwa tena bila disposition, which ni safety concern kabisa. Watu wawili walikuwa heavily involved, na DOM alijulishwa lakini hajarespond mpaka sasa. Next shift lazima wa-stop work kwa hii beam, wa-confirm engineering disposition kabla ya kuendelea na installation, na ku-escalate hii DOM silence.
summary: Ile A320 floor beam yenye damage ilirudishwa kwa installation bila disposition, na DOM hajarespond kwa report.

narrative_text: During inspection of Zone A on the B777-200, found the First and Business Class oxygen generators still de-activated even though the task card had already been signed off by an AMT and bought back by an Inspector. I flagged this to the Inspector who performed the buy-back, and due to the shift change he has raised a non-routine write-up instead of correcting it directly. Next shift needs to inspect Zone 1 oxygen generator firing mechanism re-activation on all PSUs before this is closed out.
summary: Oxygen generators in First/Business class were signed off as re-activated but were found still de-activated, requiring a non-routine write-up and follow-up inspection.

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi katika Zone A ya ndege ya B777-200, iligundulika kuwa jenereta za oksijeni za First na Business Class hazijawashwa tena, licha ya kadi ya kazi kuwa imesainiwa na fundi na kukubaliwa na mkaguzi. Nilimjulisha mkaguzi aliyefanya ukaguzi huo, lakini kwa sababu ya mabadiliko ya shift aliamua kuandika ripoti ya dosari isiyo ya kawaida badala ya kurekebisha papo hapo. Shift inayokuja inahitajika kukagua tena uwashaji wa mfumo wa kuchochea jenereta za oksijeni katika Zone 1 kwenye vitengo vyote vya huduma kwa abiria kabla suala hili kufungwa.
summary: Jenereta za oksijeni katika First na Business Class zilikutwa hazijawashwa licha ya kusainiwa kuwa kazi imekamilika, hivyo kuhitaji ukaguzi wa ziada.

entities.text: ripoti ya dosari isiyo ya kawaida

narrative_text: Wakati wa inspection kwa Zone A ya B777-200, nikapata First na Business Class oxygen generators bado hazijaactivated, ilhali task card ilikuwa imesainiwa na AMT na ku-buy back na Inspector. Nikamwambia yule Inspector aliye-inspect, lakini kwa sababu ya shift change akaamua kufanya non-routine write-up badala ya kurekebisha mara moja. Next shift wanahitajika kuinspect Zone 1 oxygen generator firing mechanism re-activation kwa PSUs zote before hii ifungwe.
summary: Oxygen generators za First/Business class zilikuwa zime-sign off lakini bado hazijaactivated, hivyo ikahitaji non-routine write-up na follow-up inspection.

narrative_text: ERJ 145 nose gear sliding tube seals were replaced on nightshift after a strut leak write-up, and reinstallation of the strut assembly was carried over to dayshift per Embraer AMM 32-20-08. Inspector and AMT completed the reinstall and aircraft was released, but the first flight had an air turnback due to an AIR/LDG IND EICAS message with gear selected up; override worked and gear was down and locked for landing. Later teardown found the centering upper cam 90 degrees out; note that the AMM does not call for a gear extension/retraction or WOW check after this seal replacement, so next shift should verify cam alignment and push for a procedure review.
summary: A nose gear seal reinstallation on an ERJ 145 was missed on cam alignment, causing an air turnback, and the maintenance manual gap needs follow-up.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya ERJ 145, mihuri ya bomba la nose gear ilibadilishwa zamu ya usiku baada ya ripoti ya kuvuja kwa strut, na kazi ya kurudisha strut ile ilihamishiwa zamu ya mchana kwa mujibu wa mwongozo wa Embraer 32-20-08. Inspekta na fundi walimaliza kazi hiyo na ndege ikaruhusiwa kurudi kazini, lakini safari ya kwanza ilirudi uwanjani kutokana na ujumbe wa EICAS wa AIR/LDG IND wakati gear ilikuwa imewekwa juu; mfumo wa override ulifanya kazi vizuri na gear ilishuka na kufungwa vizuri kabla ya kutua. Baadaye, ukaguzi wa kina ulionyesha kuwa centering upper cam ilikuwa imegeuka digrii 90 kimakosa; kwa kuwa mwongozo haujataja ukaguzi wa gear extension/retraction au WOW baada ya kazi hii, zamu inayofuata ihakikishe mpangilio wa cam na itafute marekebisho ya taratibu.
summary: Ukarabati wa mihuri ya nose gear katika ERJ 145 ulikosea mpangilio wa cam na kusababisha ndege kurudi uwanjani, hivyo mwongozo wa matengenezo unahitaji kuangaliwa upya.

entities.text: mihuri ya bomba la nose gear

narrative_text: Sasa hii ERJ 145, nose gear sliding tube seals zilibadilishwa night shift baada ya pilot report ya strut kuvuja, na reinstallation ya strut assembly ikaachwa turnover kwa dayshift, tukifuata Embraer AMM 32-20-08. Inspector na AMT walimaliza ile task, aircraft ikarudi service, lakini first flight ikawa na air turnback kwa sababu ya AIR/LDG IND message kwenye EICAS wakati gear ilikuwa selected up; override ilifanya kazi sawa na gear ikawa down and locked kwa landing. Baadaye teardown ilionyesha centering upper cam iko 90 degrees out - manual haina requirement ya gear extension/retraction au WOW check baada ya hii seal replacement, so next shift wahakikishe cam alignment na tuangalie hii procedure gap.
summary: Kuna ERJ 145 ambayo ilikuwa na air turnback baada ya nose gear cam kukosewa alignment wakati wa reinstall, so tunahitaji follow-up kwenye manual procedure.

narrative_text: Corrosion was found on the intercostal at the aft end of the BS 986.50 floor beam on the B737-400, visible from the ground through the open outflow valve; the area also had a roughly trimmed rework cutout for a Hi-Lok, and photos were taken before shift turnover. At morning handover, graveyard advised dayshift that the aircraft would be ferried out for the floor beam repair, but the write-up was instead closed out on dayshift with only surface corrosion removed by a graveyard mechanic who stayed late. Next shift please confirm whether Airframe Shop ever evaluated this discrepancy, as there is no documentation of their review before paint and final sign-off.
summary: Handover flags that a suspected structural corrosion finding on a B737-400 floor beam was signed off without Airframe Shop evaluation, needing follow-up verification.

entities.text: intercostal at the aft end of the BS 986.50 floor beam

narrative_text: Kutu ilipatikana kwenye intercostal ya sehemu ya nyuma ya floor beam ya BS 986.50 kwenye ndege ya B737-400, ikionekana kutoka chini kupitia outflow valve iliyokuwa wazi; eneo hilo pia lilikuwa na sehemu iliyokatwa kwa uzembe kwa ajili ya Hi-Lok, na picha zilipigwa kabla ya kubadilisha zamu. Wakati wa mkutano wa asubuhi, zamu ya usiku ilieleza zamu ya mchana kuwa ndege ingepelekwa mahali pengine kwa matengenezo makubwa ya floor beam, lakini badala yake hitilafu ilifungwa na zamu ya mchana huku fundi wa zamu ya usiku aliyebaki akiondoa tu kutu ya juu juu. Zamu inayokuja ihakikishe kama Airframe Shop walishirikishwa kutathmini tatizo hili, kwani hakuna nyaraka zinazothibitisha ukaguzi wao kabla ya kupaka rangi na kusaini kazi kukamilika.
summary: Taarifa ya mabadiliko ya zamu inaonyesha kuwa hitilafu ya kutu inayoshukiwa kuwa ya kimuundo kwenye floor beam ya B737-400 ilisainiwa kukamilika bila tathmini ya Airframe Shop, hivyo inahitaji ufuatiliaji.

narrative_text: Kuna corrosion iliokutwa kwa intercostal, aft end ya BS 986.50 floor beam kwa B737-400, ilikuwa inaonekana ukistand chini na kuangalia through open outflow valve; area hiyo pia ilikuwa na rework cutout iliyokatwa roughly kwa Hi-Lok kupita, na inspection walipiga photos kabla ya turnover. Kwa morning meeting, graveyard shift walieleza dayshift kuwa aircraft itaferried mahali pengine kwa floor beam repair kwa sababu job ni extensive, lakini mwisho write-up ilisign off na dayshift, huku graveyard mechanic aliyestay over aki-remove tu surface corrosion. Next shift wacheki kama Airframe Shop kweli walievaluate discrepancy hii, kwa sababu hakuna documentation ya review yao before painting na final sign-off.
summary: Handover inaflag kwamba corrosion finding kwenye B737-400 floor beam ilisign off bila Airframe Shop kuevaluate, hivyo inahitaji follow-up.

narrative_text: Handover from graveyard shift: BE400A on gate-turn back had the Anti-Skid Control Valve union filter cleaned per M/M 32-40-00, but the aft hydraulic pressure lines to the valve were cross-connected on reinstallation despite tagging, and lead mechanic buy-back missed it. Task was job-stopped before Brake Bleeding and Anti-Skid Control Check; incoming crew must verify line routing against M/M and photos before continuing, then complete bleed and system check individually on each brake, not simultaneously.
summary: Anti-skid valve lines were mixed up during reinstallation on a Beechjet 400, and follow-up crew must verify routing before completing brake bleed and system checks.

entities.text: Brake Bleeding and Anti-Skid Control Check

narrative_text: Taarifa ya mabadiliko ya shift kutoka usiku: Ndege ya BE400A ilirudishwa geti baada ya kazi ya kusafisha kichujio cha Anti-Skid Control Valve kufanywa kwa mujibu wa M/M 32-40-00. Wakati wa kurudisha mabomba, mabomba ya shinikizo la hydraulic ya nyuma yaliunganishwa vibaya licha ya kuwa yamewekwa tag, na ukaguzi wa fundi mkuu haukugundua hitilafu hiyo. Kazi ilisimamishwa kabla ya kufanya Brake Bleeding na Anti-Skid Control Check; shift inayoingia inahitajika kuhakiki muunganiko wa mabomba kwa kutumia M/M na picha kabla ya kuendelea, kisha kufanya ukaguzi wa breki kila moja kivyake, sio kwa pamoja.
summary: Mabomba ya valve ya anti-skid yalichanganywa wakati wa kufunga tena kwenye ndege ya Beechjet 400, na shift inayofuata inahitaji kuhakiki kabla ya kukamilisha ukaguzi wa breki.

entities.text: mabomba ya shinikizo la hydraulic ya nyuma
Brake Bleeding na Anti-Skid Control Check

narrative_text: Handover kutoka graveyard shift: BE400A ilirudi gate-turn back baada ya kufanya cleaning ya Anti-Skid Control Valve union filter kwa mujibu wa M/M 32-40-00. Wakati wa reinstalling ya lines, aft hydraulic pressure lines kwa valve zilichanganywa hata ingawa zilikuwa tagged, na lead mechanic buy-back hakugundua issue hiyo. Task ilikuwa job-stopped kabla ya Brake Bleeding na Anti-Skid Control Check; shift inayoingia i-verify line routing kwa kutumia M/M na pictures kabla ya kuendelea, then complete the check kwa each brake individually, sio wote pamoja.
summary: Anti-skid valve lines zilichanganywa wakati wa reinstallation kwenye Beechjet 400, na incoming shift inahitaji ku-verify kabla ya kukamilisha brake checks.
