narrative_text: Aileron cable rigging task was completed about eight days ago on the Embraer, with cable tensions adjusted per AMM 27-11-01 using the temperature/load chart, but readings were taken as hangar temperature was dropping. Aircraft was later released for a Functional Check Flight; crew found ailerons stiff and could not engage the Aileron Trim System, so the flight was cancelled and aircraft returned. Follow-up inspection found the flight deck aileron control cables over-tensioned; next shift please re-verify rigging and tension against current cabin temperature before further flight release.
summary: Aileron control cables were found over-tensioned after an aborted Functional Check Flight, traced back to earlier rigging done during a changing hangar temperature, requiring re-verification before next release.

narrative_text: Kazi ya kurekebisha nyaya za aileron kwenye ndege ya Embraer ilifanyika siku nane zilizopita, tensheni ikawekwa kulingana na chati ya joto kama AMM 27-11-01 inavyoelekeza, lakini joto la hangar lilikuwa likishuka wakati vipimo vikichukuliwa. Baadaye ndege ilipelekwa kwa ndege ya majaribio ya kiufundi (FCF), lakini wafanyakazi wa ndege waligundua aileron zimekakamaa na hawakuweza kuwasha mfumo wa Aileron Trim, hivyo safari ilisitishwa na ndege ikarudishwa. Ukaguzi zaidi ulionyesha nyaya za udhibiti wa aileron eneo la flight deck zimekazwa kupita kiasi; zamu inayofuata iangalie tena urekebishaji na tensheni kabla ya kuiruhusu ndege kuruka tena.
summary: Nyaya za udhibiti wa aileron zilikutwa zimekazwa kupita kiasi baada ya ndege ya majaribio kusitishwa, hali iliyochangiwa na urekebishaji wa awali uliofanyika wakati joto la hangar likibadilika, hivyo inahitaji ukaguzi zaidi kabla ya safari nyingine.

entities.text: nyaya za udhibiti wa aileron eneo la flight deck
kazi ya kurekebisha nyaya za aileron

narrative_text: Aileron cable rigging task ilifanywa siku nane zilizopita kwenye Embraer, tension ikawekwa kwa mujibu wa AMM 27-11-01 load chart, lakini temperature ya hangar ilikuwa ikishuka wakati tunachukua readings, so si sahihi kabisa. Baadaye aircraft ikaenda kwa FCF, lakini crew wakapata aileron zimekakamaa na hawakuweza kuengage Aileron Trim System, hivyo flight ikacancel na ndege ikarudi ZZZ. Baada ya inspection, walipata flight deck aileron control cables zimekazwa over-tensioned; next shift wakague tena rigging na tension kabla ya kutoa release nyingine, usifanye assumption tu.
summary: Aileron control cables zilikutwa over-tensioned baada ya FCF ku-cancel, ikitokana na rigging ya awali iliyofanyika wakati temperature ikibadilika, so next shift wanahitaji kurecheck kabla ya release.

narrative_text: During #2 Engine Oil Cooler shroud reinstallation on the Q400, dayshift picked up from graves but ran engines to warm oil without the printed Oil Pressure Check and Adjustment task (Para 5E) onboard; only the Installation and Leak Check tasks were referenced. Oil temp was brought up to low-mid 60s from memory, missing the required 80% NH parameter, though pressure looked normal during the run. Leak check after shutdown was clean and the non-routine was signed off, but next shift must pull Para 5E and verify the oil pressure check/adjustment was actually completed per task before further flight release review.
summary: Oil Cooler task card follow-up was signed off without completing the required Oil Pressure Check and Adjustment step (Para 5E), which needs verification by next shift.

entities.text: Oil Pressure Check and Adjustment task (Para 5E)

narrative_text: Wakati wa kufunga tena shroud ya Oil Cooler ya Injini namba 2 kwenye ndege ya Q400, shift ya mchana ilipokea kazi kutoka shift ya usiku na kuendesha injini kupasha mafuta bila kuwa na task ya Oil Pressure Check and Adjustment (Para 5E) ikiwa imechapishwa na kuwekwa ndani ya ndege. Joto la mafuta lilifikishwa kiasi cha miongo ya sitini kwa kumbukumbu tu, bila kuzingatia kigezo cha 80% NH kilichotakiwa, ingawa presha ya mafuta ilionekana ya kawaida wakati wa majaribio. Ukaguzi wa uvujaji baada ya kuzima injini haukuonyesha tatizo na fomu ya non-routine ilisainiwa, lakini shift inayofuata inatakiwa kuangalia tena Para 5E na kuthibitisha kama ukaguzi wa presha ya mafuta ulifanyika kikamilifu kabla ya kuidhinisha ndege kurudi kazini.
summary: Kazi ya kuangalia na kurekebisha presha ya mafuta (Para 5E) haikukamilika kabla ya kusainiwa kwa fomu, hivyo shift inayofuata inapaswa kuthibitisha.

entities.text: shroud ya Oil Cooler ya Injini namba 2

narrative_text: Tulipokea turnover kutoka night shift kwenye Q400 #2 Engine Oil Cooler shroud reinstallation, tukaenda mbele na engine runs kupasha oil lakini bila kuwa na printed copy ya Oil Pressure Check and Adjustment task, Para 5E, on board — tulikuwa na Installation na Leak Check tasks tu. Oil temp tuliifikisha low-mid 60s from memory, tukamiss ile requirement ya 80% NH, japo oil pressure ilikuwa ikionekana normal during the run. Leak check baada ya shutdown ilikuwa clean na non-routine ikasignwa, lakini next shift wanahitaji ku-pull Para 5E na kuconfirm kama oil pressure check/adjustment ilikamilika kabla ya kuclear ndege for release.
summary: Task ya Oil Pressure Check and Adjustment (Para 5E) haikucompletewa kabla ya sign-off, kwa hivyo next shift wanahitaji kuverify.

entities.text: Oil Pressure Check and Adjustment task, Para 5E

narrative_text: Picked up the EO job card on the B777-200 mid-shift starting at Step 10A(7); the crew O2 stowage box was already installed and signed off as leak-checked by prior shift but fastener security was not confirmed, so I re-verified those myself. I was later informed that all four O2 mask microphones were not connected to the back of the stowage box, meaning the leak check sign-off may not be reliable. Next shift needs to pull the stowage box, verify mic connections, and Avionics should run an operational check before release. Multi-shift turnover on this job card was poorly documented and needs tightening.
summary: A multi-shift B777-200 O2 stowage box job was signed off despite the four mask microphones not being connected, requiring follow-up verification and better turnover documentation.

narrative_text: Nilipokea kadi ya kazi ya EO kwenye ndege ya B777-200 nikianzia hatua ya 10A(7) baada ya wenzangu wa zamu iliyopita kuanza kazi hiyo. Sanduku la oksijeni la wafanyakazi wa ndege lilikuwa tayari limewekwa na kuandikwa kuwa limepitisha ukaguzi wa uvujaji, ingawa uimara wa vifungashio haukuthibitishwa vizuri, hivyo nikaukagua mwenyewe. Baadaye niliambiwa kuwa maikrofoni zote nne za barakoa za oksijeni hazikuwa zimeunganishwa nyuma ya sanduku hilo, jambo linaloweka shaka kwenye ule ukaguzi uliosainiwa. Zamu inayofuata ifuatilie uunganishaji wa maikrofoni na Idara ya Avionics ifanye ukaguzi wa uendeshaji kabla ndege haijaruhusiwa kuruka, kwani mawasiliano kati ya zamu kwenye kazi hii yalikuwa dhaifu.
summary: Kadi ya kazi ya sanduku la oksijeni kwenye B777-200 ilisainiwa licha ya maikrofoni nne za barakoa kutounganishwa, hivyo inahitaji ufuatiliaji na maboresho ya mawasiliano baina ya zamu.

narrative_text: Nilipick up ile EO job card kwa B777-200 nikianza Step 10A(7) kwa sababu previous shift walikuwa wameanza kazi hiyo. Ile crew O2 stowage box ilikuwa already installed na imesainiwa kama leak check imepass, lakini fastener security haikuwa verified vizuri so nikaicheck mwenyewe. Baadaye waliniambia ati zile four O2 mask microphones hazikuwa connected nyuma ya stowage box, so ule leak check sign-off inakuwa questionable. Next shift wafuatilie mic connections na Avionics wafanye operational check kabla aircraft haija-release, coz turnover documentation ya job card hii ilikuwa poa sana.
summary: Job card ya O2 stowage box kwa B777-200 ilisainiwa ingawa zile microphones nne hazikuwa connected, so inahitaji follow-up na turnover kuboreshwa.

narrative_text: During RII inspection of the replacement Number 8 Slat for the B767-300 in the hangar, I found an existing aircraft damage sticker and an adjacent dent on the inboard leading edge lip, not visible earlier since the slat was packed inverted in the crate. I halted the inspection and asked Line Maintenance to trace the part's prior aircraft history, but the sticker could not be matched to any recorded damage on that aircraft or wing. Next shift needs to continue researching SRM damage limits for this area and hold installation until serviceability is confirmed.
summary: An unexplained damage sticker and dent were found on a replacement B767-300 slat during RII inspection, and installation is on hold pending SRM damage-limit review and part-history verification.

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa RII wa Slat namba 8 mbadala kwa ndege ya B767-300 pale hangarini, nilikuta stika ya uharibifu iliyokuwepo awali pamoja na bonyeo karibu na ukingo wa mbele wa ndani, ambayo haikuonekana mwanzoni kwa sababu slat ilifungwa kinyume ndani ya kasha. Nilisimamisha ukaguzi na kuomba Line Maintenance wafuatilie historia ya sehemu hiyo kwenye ndege iliyotangulia, lakini stika hiyo haikulingana na rekodi yoyote ya uharibifu wa ndege au bawa hilo. Zamu inayofuata inahitajika kuendelea kuchunguza mipaka ya uharibifu kwenye SRM na kusimamisha usakinishaji hadi uthibitisho wa ubora wa kifaa upatikane.
summary: Stika ya uharibifu isiyoeleweka na bonyeo viligundulika kwenye slat mbadala ya B767-300 wakati wa ukaguzi wa RII, hivyo usakinishaji umesimamishwa hadi uthibitisho wa mipaka ya uharibifu na historia ya kifaa ukamilike.

narrative_text: So wakati na-do RII inspection ya Number 8 Slat mbadala kwa B767-300 pale hangar, nikapata damage sticker ya zamani na dent karibu na inboard leading edge lip, haikuonekana awali coz slat ilikuwa packed inverted kwa crate. Nikastop inspection na ku-ask Line Maintenance wa-trace part history ya aircraft iliyotangulia, lakini sticker haikumatch na damage records za hiyo aircraft au wing. Next shift wanahitaji ku-continue checking SRM damage limits for that area na ku-hold installation mpaka serviceability i-confirm.
summary: Kuna damage sticker na dent zisizoelezeka zilipatikana kwenye replacement slat ya B767-300 during RII inspection, so installation imesimama pending SRM check na part history verification.

narrative_text: Second Shift rushed to complete the copilot flight control cable tension adjustment on the Gulfstream G650 before end of shift ahead of an early morning departure. QC gave 'OK to Close' on the main under-floor access area after inspecting for FOD and rig pin removal, but was not informed that adjacent inspection panels had been opened or that a control rod had been removed at the aileron control system. Later found (when crew seats were removed) that those panels were left unsecured under the carpet and a cotter pin at the control rod attach point was not properly secured. Incoming shift must verify all under-floor inspection panels and cotter pins on both pilot and copilot control modules, and tighten turnover accountability between shifts.
summary: Incomplete shift turnover led to unsecured inspection panels and an improperly secured cotter pin on the G650 aileron control system after a rushed cable tension adjustment.

entities.text: copilot flight control cable tension adjustment

narrative_text: Shift ya Pili ilikimbizwa kukamilisha marekebisho ya tension ya cable ya udhibiti wa ndege ya copilot kwenye Gulfstream G650 kabla ya kuisha kwa shift, kwa sababu ndege ilikuwa na safari ya asubuhi mapema. Msimamizi wa Ubora alitoa idhini ya kufunga eneo la chini ya sakafu baada ya kukagua uchafu na kuondoa rig pin, lakini hakujulishwa kuwa paneli za ukaguzi za jirani zilikuwa zimefunguliwa au kwamba control rod ilikuwa imeondolewa kwenye mfumo wa udhibiti wa aileron. Baadaye, wakati viti vya crew vilipoondolewa, ilibainika kuwa paneli hizo hazikufungwa vizuri na zilikuwa zimefichwa na carpet, na cotter pin ya control rod haikuwa imefungwa sawasawa. Shift inayoingia inapaswa kuhakikisha paneli zote za ukaguzi na cotter pins za mifumo ya udhibiti ya pilot na copilot zimekaguliwa vizuri, na uwajibikaji wa mkabidhi kati ya shift uboreshwe.
summary: Mkabidhi wa shift usiokamilika ulisababisha paneli za ukaguzi zisizofungwa vizuri na cotter pin isiyokamilika kwenye mfumo wa udhibiti wa aileron wa Gulfstream G650 baada ya marekebisho ya haraka ya cable.

narrative_text: Second Shift walikimbizwa kufinish cable tension adjustment ya copilot flight controls kwenye Gulfstream G650 kabla ya shift kuisha, kwa sababu kulikuwa na early morning flight. QC nikatoa 'OK to Close' kwa under-floor access area baada ya kukagua FOD na kuremove rig pin, lakini sikuwa notified kuwa inspection panels za jirani zilikuwa zimefunguliwa au kwamba control rod ilikuwa imeremovwa kwenye aileron control system. Baadaye, wakati crew seats zilipoondolewa, ikabainika kuwa panels hazikuwa secured vizuri na zilikuwa zimefunikwa na carpet, plus cotter pin ya control rod haikuwa properly secured. Shift inayoingia lazima iverify panels zote na cotter pins kwenye pilot na copilot control modules, na turnover communication kati ya shifts iimarishwe.
summary: Poor shift handover ilisababisha unsecured inspection panels na cotter pin isiyo secure kwenye aileron control system ya G650 baada ya rushed cable adjustment.

narrative_text: Dash 8-400 was found with the Weather Radar not installed by the previous station, only the transceiver, which should have been caught during the avionics coupler install. We were waiting on parts and cannibalized items that arrived just 15 minutes before departure, so the swing-shift Mechanic ran out of time and Maintenance Control swapped this aircraft with the RON aircraft already finishing its Line Check. The TMU and avionics coupler were installed, but after power-up the FMS 'Configuration Module Fail' message returned, so the Weather Radar test was not completed. Next shift needs to follow up on the coupler fault before attempting the Weather Radar check again.
summary: Weather Radar install/FMS coupler fault carried over from previous station, requires further troubleshooting on next shift.

narrative_text: Ndege ya Dash 8-400 ilikutwa bila Weather Radar kuwekwa na kituo kilichotangulia, transceiver pekee ndiyo iliwekwa, jambo ambalo lingegundulika wakati wa ufungaji wa avionics coupler. Tulisubiri vipuri, ikiwemo vilivyotolewa kwa ndege nyingine, ambavyo viliwasili dakika kumi na tano tu kabla ya ndege kuondoka, hivyo Fundi wa zamu ya jioni hakuwa na muda wa kutosha na Maintenance Control waliamua kubadilisha ndege hii na ile iliyokuwa RON ikimalizia Line Check. TMU na avionics coupler viliwekwa, lakini baada ya kuwasha mfumo, ujumbe wa 'Configuration Module Fail' wa FMS ulirudi tena, hivyo kipimo cha Weather Radar hakikufanyika. Zamu inayofuata ihakikishe tatizo la coupler limetatuliwa kabla ya kujaribu tena Weather Radar.
summary: Tatizo la usakinishaji wa Weather Radar na hitilafu ya FMS coupler limebaki kwa zamu inayofuata kufuatilia.

entities.text: dakika kumi na tano kabla ya kuondoka

narrative_text: Kwa hii Dash 8-400, previous station hawakuweka Weather Radar, waliweka transceiver tu, na tungeigundua wakati wa install ya avionics coupler. Tulikuwa tunasubiri parts pamoja na zile cannibalized ambazo zilifika dakika 15 tu kabla ya departure, so yule swing-shift Mechanic akaishiwa na time na Maintenance Control wakaamua ku-swap na yule RON aircraft ambayo ilikuwa inamaliza Line Check. Coupler na TMU ziliwekwa sawa, lakini baada ya power-up, FMS ikirudisha 'Configuration Module Fail' tena, so hatukuweza ku-test Weather Radar. Next shift wafuatilie hiyo coupler fault kabla ya kujaribu Weather Radar tena.
summary: Weather Radar install na FMS coupler fault bado zina issue, next shift wa-follow up kabla ya test tena.

narrative_text: During reinstallation of the Number-Two Forward Firewall panel on the S-76 Mark II, several camlocks required replacement and their retainers could not be located; QA inspected the area but no hardware was found and it was not noted in prior turnover notes. On the second panel, hardware count also did not match: three extra bolts, one missing spacer, and four missing washers were found before install. Please follow up with QA on the discrepancy and confirm hardware control/tool control procedures before this aircraft returns to service.
summary: Hardware discrepancies (missing retainers, spacer, and washers, plus extra bolts) found during firewall panel reinstallation on the S-76 Mark II were not documented in prior turnover and need QA follow-up before release to service.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kuweka tena paneli ya Firewall ya Mbele Namba-Mbili kwenye helikopta ya S-76 Mark II, camlocks kadhaa zilihitaji kubadilishwa na retainers zake hazikupatikana; Idara ya Ubora (QA) ilikagua eneo hilo lakini hazikuonekana wala kuandikwa kwenye taarifa za awali za mabadiliko ya zamu. Kwenye paneli ya pili, idadi ya vifaa vya chuma pia haikulingana: bolts tatu za ziada zilipatikana, na spacer moja pamoja na washers nne zilikosekana kabla ya kufunga paneli. Tafadhali fuatilia jambo hili na QA na uhakikishe taratibu za udhibiti wa vifaa na zana kabla ndege hii kurejea kazini.
summary: Vifaa vya chuma vilivyokosekana au kuzidi vilipatikana wakati wa kuweka paneli za Firewall kwenye S-76 Mark II, jambo ambalo halikuandikwa awali na linahitaji ufuatiliaji wa QA kabla ndege kurejea huduma.

entities.text: paneli ya Firewall ya Mbele Namba-Mbili

narrative_text: Wakati wa ku-reinstall ile Number-Two Forward Firewall panel kwenye S-76 Mark II, kulikuwa na camlocks kadhaa ambazo zilihitaji replacement lakini retainers zake hazikupatikana; QA walikagua area lakini hakuna hardware ilipatikana, na haikuwa noted kwenye turnover notes za awali. Kwenye panel ya pili pia, hardware count haikumatch: kulikuwa na bolts tatu za extra, spacer moja missing, na washers nne missing kabla ya install. Tafadhali follow up na QA kuhusu discrepancy hii na confirm hardware control/tool control procedures kabla aircraft hii i-return to service.
summary: Kuna hardware discrepancies (missing retainers, spacer, washers, na extra bolts) zilizopatikana wakati wa panel reinstallation kwenye S-76 Mark II, ambazo hazikua documented awali na zinahitaji QA follow-up kabla ya return to service.

narrative_text: A319 TRF vibration sensor replacement was completed per AMM 77-31-30-400 up to Step 9 (Close-Up), but final closeout paperwork was not finished due to shift-turnover confusion, a Mechanic needing help with the MEL Call Horn (Interphone) swap, and Manager pressure to move the aircraft to the gate during heavy rain. Logbook was requested before entries were complete and paperwork got disorganized during handover. Next shift must verify Step 9 close-up is signed off, confirm logbook entries are accurate/complete, and check status of the Call Horn/Interphone MEL item before dispatch.
summary: Incomplete closeout paperwork on an A319 after TRF vibration sensor replacement, caused by shift-change confusion and weather-related time pressure, needs verification by next shift.

narrative_text: Ubadilishaji wa TRF vibration sensor kwenye ndege ya A319 ulifanyika kwa kufuata AMM 77-31-30-400 hadi Step 9 (Close-Up), lakini karatasi za mwisho hazikukamilika kwa sababu ya msukosuko wa mabadiliko ya zamu, Fundi mwingine alihitaji msaada kubadilisha Call Horn iliyokuwa MEL, na Meneja alisisitiza ndege ipelekwe getini haraka wakati wa mvua kubwa. Logbook ilihitajika kabla maandishi hayajakamilika na karatasi zikaharibika mpangilio wakati wa mkabidhiano. Zamu inayokuja inapaswa kuthibitisha kama Step 9 imesainiwa, kuangalia usahihi wa maandishi ya logbook, na kuhakiki hali ya Call Horn/Interphone kabla ndege haijaruhusiwa kuondoka.
summary: Karatasi za mwisho za kazi ya A319 hazikukamilika baada ya kubadilisha TRF vibration sensor, kwa sababu ya msukosuko wa zamu na shinikizo la muda kutokana na mvua, hivyo zinahitaji kuangaliwa na zamu inayofuata.

narrative_text: Tulikamilisha replacement ya TRF vibration sensor kwa A319 kufuata AMM 77-31-30-400 mpaka Step 9 (Close-Up), lakini closeout paperwork haikukamilika kwa sababu ya confusion ya shift turnover, mmoja wa Mechanic alihitaji msaada wa kubadilisha Call Horn (Interphone) ambayo ilikuwa MEL, na Manager alikuwa akipush aircraft ipelekwe gate 'now' wakati wa heavy rain. Logbook ilihitajika before entries zikamilike, na paperwork ikaenda disarray during handover. Next shift wajaribu kuconfirm kama Step 9 close-up imesignwa, kucheck logbook entries ziko complete, na kuverify status ya Call Horn/Interphone MEL item before dispatch.
summary: A319 ilikuwa na incomplete paperwork baada ya TRF vibration sensor replacement, caused na shift-change confusion pamoja na time pressure kutoka kwa weather, hivyo inahitaji follow-up na next shift.

narrative_text: During overnight hangar work on the CRJ200, a handwritten shift turnover note incorrectly identified Number 1 IDG instead of Number 2 IDG, causing the wrong unit to be removed initially. The AGB carbon seal was inspected and replaced on the Number 1 engine, verified for torque and seating by the Inspector but the actual buildup was not witnessed; both engines passed idle leak checks with no leakage noted at the time. Next shift please be aware the aircraft later had an air turn back for oil loss on the left engine, likely linked to o-ring seating on the carbon seal installation - AMM reference for correct o-ring seating needs review before further seal work.
summary: A mix-up over IDG numbering during CRJ200 overnight maintenance led to a carbon seal installation issue that later caused an oil-loss air turn back.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kazi ya usiku kwenye ndege ya CRJ200 kwenye hangar, kulikuwa na kosa kwenye kumbukumbu ya mabadiliko ya zamu iliyoandikwa kwa mkono, ikieleza IDG Namba 1 badala ya Namba 2, jambo lililosababisha kuondolewa kwa kifaa kisicho sahihi mwanzoni. Seal ya kaboni ya AGB ilikaguliwa na kubadilishwa kwenye injini ya Namba 1, na Mkaguzi alithibitisha msukumo na jinsi ilivyokaa vizuri, ingawa hakushuhudia mchakato mzima wa ujenzi wake; injini zote mbili zilipita ukaguzi wa uvujaji wakati wa mwendo wa taratibu bila dalili za uvujaji. Zamu inayofuata ifahamu kuwa ndege hiyo baadaye ilirudi angani kwa sababu ya upotevu wa mafuta kwenye injini ya kushoto, jambo linaloonekana kuhusiana na jinsi pete za o-ring zilivyowekwa kwenye seal ya kaboni - ni muhimu kupitia tena maelekezo ya AMM kabla ya kazi nyingine yoyote ya seal.
summary: Kosa la namba za IDG wakati wa matengenezo ya usiku ya CRJ200 lilisababisha tatizo la ufungaji wa seal ya kaboni ambalo baadaye lilipelekea ndege kurudi angani kwa sababu ya upotevu wa mafuta.

narrative_text: Jana usiku kwenye hangar tulikuwa na CRJ200 na kulikuwa na confusion kwenye shift turnover note - iliandikwa Number 1 IDG lakini ilikuwa supposed to be Number 2, so tukaremove IDG wrong mwanzoni. Tulicheck AGB carbon seal, ikaonekana degraded, tukaorder replacement na ku-install kwenye Number 1 engine - nili-verify torque na seating lakini sikuwitness build-up yenyewe. Both engines zilipita leak check at idle, hakuna leakage iliyoonekana wakati huo, lakini baadaye kuna air turn back kwa sababu ya oil loss kwenye left engine, inaonekana ni o-ring seating issue kwenye carbon seal - next shift tafadhali angalia AMM procedure vizuri kabla ya kuendelea na hii job.
summary: Kuna mix-up ya IDG numbering wakati wa maintenance ya CRJ200 usiku, ikasababisha carbon seal issue ambayo baadaye ilipelekea air turn back kwa sababu ya oil loss.

narrative_text: During the recent A320 elevator R&I, we later learned that one or more Elevator Servo-Control bushings may not have been reinstalled, discovered only after the operator reported tail flutter during a high-speed descent. Sign-off practice at the time allowed one technician to sign behind another without an RII inspection on this flight-control task, so verification was not enforced. Incoming shift please pull the task card and AMM pages used for that elevator install, confirm bushing part numbers/quantities against stock records, and flag this task for mandatory RII on future flight-control reassembly.
summary: An A320 elevator reassembly may have missed installing servo-control bushings due to lack of RII inspection and unclear sign-off responsibility, requiring follow-up verification.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kazi ya kuondoa na kurudisha elevator ya ndege ya A320 hivi karibuni, tuligundua baadaye kwamba baadhi ya bushing za Elevator Servo-Control huenda hazikuwekwa vizuri, jambo lililobainika baada ya shirika la ndege kuripoti mtikisiko wa mkia wakati wa kushuka kwa kasi. Utaratibu wa saini uliokuwepo wakati huo uliruhusu fundi mmoja kusaini kazi iliyofanywa na mwenzake bila ukaguzi wa RII kwenye kazi hii ya sehemu muhimu ya udhibiti wa ndege. Wafanyakazi wa shift inayoingia wanaombwa kupitia task card na kurasa za AMM zilizotumika, kuhakiki idadi na namba za bushing dhidi ya rekodi za stoo, na kuweka alama kwenye kazi hii ili ukaguzi wa RII uwe wa lazima kwa kazi zijazo za flight control.
summary: Ukaguzi wa baadaye ulionyesha kuwa bushing za elevator servo-control huenda hazikuwekwa vizuri kwenye A320 kutokana na ukosefu wa ukaguzi wa RII, hivyo shift inayoingia inahitajika kuthibitisha na kurekebisha utaratibu.

narrative_text: Kwa ile elevator R&I ya A320 tuliyofanya, tumepata report kwamba bushings za Elevator Servo-Control huenda hazikuwekwa vizuri wakati wa reassembly, ilijitokeza baada ya crew kuripoti flutter kwenye tail wakati wa high speed descent. Wakati huo, sign-off procedure ilikuwa ya line moja tu, so fundi mmoja angeweza kusaini kazi iliyofanywa na mwenzake bila RII inspection kwenye flight control kama hii. Shift inayokuja please pitia ile task card na AMM pages zilizotumika, confirm bushing part numbers dhidi ya stock, na iwekwe flag ili RII iwe mandatory kwa future elevator work.
summary: Kuna possibility kwamba bushings za elevator servo-control hazikuwekwa vizuri kwenye A320 kwa sababu ya lack of RII inspection, hivyo next shift inatakiwa kuverify na kurekebisha procedure.

narrative_text: B777-200 in Hangar Bay is down for the potable/waste water storage tank replacement; the new tank from ZZZ1 stock arrived damaged and Supervisor X asked mechanics to swap the inlet fitting onto the old tank, but the fitting is molded as one piece with the tank, not a separate assembly. An Engineering Order was issued but only a partial one-page repair procedure starting at Step 6 was received, and inspection of the mating seal on both tanks showed additional damage. Next shift needs to chase Engineering for the complete technical data/E.O. before any installation decision is made, and confirm tank availability status with Stores.
summary: AOG waste water tank swap on B777-200 is on hold pending complete Engineering Order documentation after a damaged replacement tank and an incomplete repair procedure were found.

narrative_text: Ndege ya B777-200 iliyoko Hangar Bay bado imesimama kwa sababu ya kubadilisha tanki la maji machafu; tanki jipya lililotoka stoo ya ZZZ1 lilikuja limeharibika, na Supervisor X aliagiza mafundi wabadilishe fitting ya inlet kwa tanki la zamani, ijapokuwa fitting hiyo ni sehemu moja na tanki, haiwezi kutolewa peke yake. Engineering Order ilitolewa lakini ilikuwa na ukurasa mmoja tu wa maelekezo ukianzia Hatua ya 6, na ukaguzi wa seal ya kuunganisha kwenye matanki mawili ulionyesha uharibifu zaidi. Zamu inayofuata inahitaji kufuatilia Engineering kupata taarifa kamili ya kiufundi kabla ya kufanya uwekaji, na kuthibitisha hali ya upatikanaji wa tanki na Stores.
summary: Kazi ya kubadilisha tanki la maji machafu kwenye B777-200 imesimama kwa sababu ya tanki lililoharibika na maelekezo ya Engineering yasiyo kamili, hivyo yanahitaji ufuatiliaji.

narrative_text: Hii B777-200 iko Hangar Bay imesimama kwa waste water tank replacement; tank mpya ya ZZZ1 stock ilikuja damaged, na Supervisor X akasema mechanics wa-swap ile inlet fitting kwenda kwa old tank, lakini fitting ni one piece na tank, si assembly separate. Engineering waliissue E/O lakini tulipata one page tu ya repair steps ikianzia Step 6, na tulipo-inspect mating seal kwa both tanks tukapata damage zaidi. Next shift wafuatilie Engineering wapate full technical data kabla ya kufanya installation decision, na wacheck na Stores kuhusu tank availability.
summary: B777-200 waste water tank job iko on hold kwa sababu ya damaged part na incomplete E/O documentation, inahitaji follow-up na Engineering.

narrative_text: Left MLG truck shield crack found last shift was assigned for replacement, but no clear AMM procedure was available so we referenced AMM 32-11-18, which covers shield and electric harness R/I only; harness was left undisturbed. Turnover briefing was unclear on scope, and it was only after the task that we realized the correct procedure required wheel and brake removal, which was not done. Next shift needs to verify gear condition and reaccomplish per correct AMM steps once available. Please request Air Carrier issue a proper repair document and AMM reference for truck shield replacement.
summary: Truck shield replacement on left MLG was done using the wrong AMM reference due to unclear turnover, leaving required wheel/brake removal step unaccomplished.

narrative_text: Ufa ulipatikana kwenye Truck Shield ya Left Main Landing Gear zamu iliyopita, na sisi tulipangiwa kubadilisha shield hiyo lakini hatukupata maelekezo kamili ya AMM. Tulitumia sehemu ya AMM 32-11-18 inayohusu Shield na Electric Harness pekee, bila kugusa harness. Wakati wa mabadilishano ya zamu maelekezo hayakuwa wazi, na baada ya kazi ndipo tukagundua utaratibu sahihi ulihitaji kutolewa kwa magurudumu na breki, jambo ambalo halikufanyika. Zamu inayokuja inapaswa kuangalia hali ya gear hiyo na kukamilisha kazi kwa usahihi, na Air Carrier anahitajika kutoa hati rasmi ya ukarabati pamoja na AMM sahihi ya kubadilisha Truck Shield.
summary: Ubadilishaji wa Truck Shield kwenye Left Main Landing Gear ulifanywa kwa AMM isiyo sahihi kutokana na mawasiliano hafifu wakati wa zamu, na hatua ya kutoa magurudumu na breki haikukamilika.

narrative_text: Kuna crack ilipatikana kwa Left MLG Truck Shield zamu iliyopita, na tuliassignwa kufanya replacement lakini hatukupata specific AMM procedure. Tulitumia AMM 32-11-18 ambayo inatalk about Shield na Electric Harness R/I tu, harness tulileave kama ilivyo. During turnover kulikuwa na confusion, hatukupata clear direction, na baada ya kazi ndio tukarealize kwamba procedure sahihi ilitaka wheels na brakes ziremovwe, jambo ambalo hatukufanya. Next shift wanahitaji kuverify hiyo gear na kuensure inafanyika sawa, pia tuombe Air Carrier atupe repair document na correct AMM reference kwa Truck Shield replacement.
summary: Truck Shield replacement kwa Left MLG ilifanywa na AMM isiyo sahihi kwa sababu ya confusion wakati wa turnover, hivyo wheel and brake removal haikufanyika.

narrative_text: During the HC1 Heavy Check on Aircraft X (B737-700), two cracks were found on the L/H Horizontal Stabilizer lower inspar skin and repair was started per SRM Repair 11, which calls for a 2024-T3 doubler at .090in thickness. Night shift verified the material tag as 2024-T3 .090in and signed off the fab steps before handing over to dayshift, but the actual tag showed 2023-T3 and a dayshift mechanic raised concern about correctness of the material, which was not resolved before continuing installation. All solid fasteners are installed; the job is on hold pending Engineering Authorization for the two blind fasteners. Next shift must confirm actual doubler material/thickness against SRM Table 201/202 before any further installation or E/A approval.
summary: A B737-700 heavy-check stabilizer repair proceeded with an unverified/possibly incorrect doubler material due to a communication breakdown between night and day shift, requiring material confirmation before completing fastener installation.

entities.text: L/H Horizontal Stabilizer lower inspar skin

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa HC1 Heavy Check kwenye Aircraft X (B737-700), nyufa mbili zilipatikana kwenye L/H Horizontal Stabilizer lower inspar skin na kazi ya ukarabati ilianzishwa kwa kufuata SRM Repair 11, ambayo inahitaji doubler ya 2024-T3 na unene wa .090in. Shift ya usiku ilithibitisha lebo ya chuma kuwa 2024-T3 .090in na kusaini hatua za utengenezaji kabla ya kukabidhi kazi kwa shift ya mchana, lakini lebo halisi ilionyesha 2023-T3, na fundi wa shift ya mchana aliuliza kama chuma ni sahihi, jambo ambalo halikutatuliwa kabla ya kuendelea na ufungaji. Fasteners zote za solid zimefungwa; kazi imesimama ikisubiri idhini ya Engineering Authorization kwa fasteners mbili za blind. Shift inayofuata inapaswa kuthibitisha aina na unene halisi wa doubler kulingana na SRM Table 201/202 kabla ya kuendelea na ufungaji au kupata idhini ya E/A.
summary: Ukarabati wa stabilizer kwenye B737-700 uliendelea huku aina ya chuma cha doubler ikiwa haijathibitishwa vizuri kutokana na mawasiliano mabovu kati ya shift za usiku na mchana, hivyo inahitajika uthibitisho kabla ya kukamilisha ufungaji wa fasteners.

entities.text: L/H Horizontal Stabilizer lower inspar skin

narrative_text: Kwa hii HC1 Heavy Check ya Aircraft X (B737-700), tulipata cracks mbili kwenye L/H Horizontal Stabilizer lower inspar skin, so repair ikaanzishwa kwa SRM Repair 11 ambayo inataka doubler ya 2024-T3, .090in thick. Night shift walicheck material tag ikaonekana 2024-T3 .090in, wakasign off fab steps kabla ya kuhandover kwa dayshift, lakini turns out tag halisi ilikuwa 2023-T3, na dayshift mechanic aliuliza kama material ni sahihi but hakuna aliyefollow up properly kabla kazi ikiendelea. All solid fasteners zimeinstall, tunasubiri Engineering Authorization ya zile blind fasteners mbili. Next shift wacheck vizuri material na thickness ya doubler against SRM Table 201/202 kabla ya kuproceed na installation au E/A approval.
summary: Repair ya stabilizer kwenye B737-700 iliendelea na doubler material ambayo haikuconfirm properly juu ya communication breakdown kati ya night na day shift, so inahitajika verification kabla ya kukamilisha fastener installation.

narrative_text: Dayshift cut the tack welds on the TRF strut studs on the No. 3 engine per the DC-10 and assisted Line Maintenance with stud removal and replacement; after shift change we were recalled to tack weld the studs back per the GE engine manual repair procedure. Before closing out the logbook entry I contacted QC to schedule the required FPI, and QC flagged that this repair procedure cannot be used on the flight line without an Engineering Authorization since we are not in a shop environment. An ER has already been submitted to Engineering; incoming shift please follow up on the EA status before any further work or sign-off on this strut repair.
summary: Tack weld repair on a DC-10 No. 3 engine TRF strut was performed using a shop-only manual reference without the required Engineering Authorization, and follow-up on the pending EA/ER is needed before sign-off.

narrative_text: Shift ya mchana ilikata welds za muda kwenye studs za TRF strut ya engine namba 3 ya DC-10, na kusaidia Line Maintenance kuondoa na kurudisha studs; baada ya mabadiliko ya shift, tulirudi jioni kuweka tena tack welds kulingana na maelekezo ya kitabu cha ukarabati cha GE. Kabla ya kumaliza kuandika kwenye logbook, niliwasiliana na QC kuhakikisha FPI itafanyika, lakini QC walisema utaratibu huo hauwezi kutumika kwenye flight line bila idhini ya Engineering (EA). Ombi la EA tayari limepelekwa Engineering; shift inayofuata ifuatilie hali ya idhini hiyo kabla ya kazi yoyote zaidi kuendelea au kusainiwa.
summary: Ukarabati wa tack weld kwenye strut ya engine namba 3 ya DC-10 ulifanywa bila idhini inayohitajika ya Engineering, hivyo inahitaji ufuatiliaji wa haraka.

narrative_text: Dayshift tulicut tack welds za studs kwenye TRF strut ya engine number 3 ya hii DC-10, tukasaidia Line Maintenance ku-remove na ku-replace studs; baada ya shift change tuka-recall back jioni kufanya tack weld again ya studs kama repair procedure ya GE manual inavyosema. Before ni-close logbook nilipiga QC ili wa-schedule ile FPI required, lakini wakaniambia hii repair procedure haiwezi kutumika flight line bila Engineering Authorization kwa sababu si shop environment. ER tayari imetumwa Engineering; shift inayokuja i-follow up status ya EA kabla ya kuendelea na kazi au ku-sign off strut hii.
summary: Tack weld repair kwenye DC-10 engine number 3 TRF strut ilifanywa bila EA required, hivyo incoming shift wanahitajika ku-follow up status ya Engineering Authorization.

narrative_text: During overnight routine service on the B737-800 (BOW open), walkaround inspection found possible damage/delamination on the wing-to-body fairing panel. I requested an LEO around 0300 to defer the panel and release the aircraft, but local tech support had not completed it by shift turnover. Maintenance Supervisor became confrontational, insisting the LEO was unnecessary and that I finish the aircraft without reviewing the paperwork; next shift please confirm LEO status or arrange NDT before further dispatch.
summary: Wing-to-body fairing damage on a B737-800 was deferred pending an LEO, but a supervisor's unprofessional conduct delayed proper closeout, so the next shift must verify LEO/NDT completion before release.

narrative_text: Wakati wa huduma ya kawaida usiku kwenye ndege ya B737-800, ukaguzi wa awali ulionyesha uwezekano wa uharibifu au mgawanyiko kwenye kifuniko cha 'wing-to-body'. Niliomba LEO karibu saa tisa alfajiri ili kuruhusu ndege kuondoka huku hitilafu hiyo ikiwa imesajiliwa, lakini timu ya kiufundi haikuwa imekamilisha mchakato huo wakati wa mabadiliko ya shift. Msimamizi wa matengenezo alionyesha hasira na kudai LEO haikuhitajika bila kusoma nyaraka husika; shift inayokuja ihakikishe hali ya LEO au ipange ukaguzi wa NDT kabla ya ndege kuruhusiwa kuondoka.
summary: Uharibifu kwenye kifuniko cha 'wing-to-body' cha ndege ya B737-800 ulisababisha mgogoro kati ya fundi na msimamizi kuhusu uidhinishaji wa LEO, hivyo shift inayokuja inahitaji kuthibitisha hali kabla ya ndege kuruhusiwa.

narrative_text: Wakati wa overnight routine service kwenye B737-800, wakati wa walkaround niligundua possible damage au delamination kwenye ile wing-to-body fairing panel. Niliomba LEO around 0300 ili tudefer ile panel na ndege iweze kuruhusiwa kuondoka, lakini local tech support hawajaikamilisha by the time ya shift turnover. Maintenance Supervisor alikuja akiwa na attitude, akidai LEO haikuwa necessary bila hata kusoma ile paperwork; next shift wacheki status ya LEO au warrange NDT kabla ya release.
summary: Kuna damage kwenye wing-to-body panel ya B737-800 ambayo ilikuwa pending LEO, lakini disagreement na supervisor ilidelay closeout, so next shift wanahitaji kuconfirm LEO/NDT kabla ya dispatch.

narrative_text: A320 RH main landing gear side stay bushing job (EC/RA task card) was picked up mid-shift under time pressure while waiting on the retaining nut and washer to arrive. Lead verbally briefed final torque as 500 ft-lbs and initial torque as 440 ft-lbs, but the task card details were not re-verified as a crew before torquing began. Next shift please confirm torque values against the actual EC/RA paperwork before final torque is applied, and re-check inspector sign-off on the initial torque setting.
summary: RH main gear side stay bushing torque values were relayed verbally instead of confirmed against the EC/RA card, requiring verification by next shift before final torque.

entities.text: RH main landing gear side stay bushing

narrative_text: Kazi ya bushing ya side stay ya gear kuu ya kulia (RH) ya ndege A320, chini ya EC/RA task card, ilianzishwa wakati wa shinikizo la muda huku tukisubiri nut na washer mpya kufika. Lead alitueleza kwa mdomo kuwa torque ya mwisho ni 500 ft-lbs na ya awali ni 440 ft-lbs, lakini hatukurejea pamoja kama timu kuhakiki taarifa hizo kwenye task card kabla ya kuanza kukaza. Shift inayokuja tafadhali hakikisheni namba za torque zinalingana na hati halisi ya EC/RA kabla ya torque ya mwisho kufanywa, na mrejeshe sahihi ya inspector kwenye torque ya awali.
summary: Namba za torque za bushing ya side stay ya gear ya RH zilipitishwa kwa mdomo badala ya kuhakikiwa kwenye hati ya EC/RA, hivyo zinahitaji ukaguzi na shift inayofuata.

entities.text: bushing ya side stay ya gear kuu ya kulia (RH)

narrative_text: Tulikuwa tunafanya ile RH main gear side stay bushing job kwa A320, under EC/RA task card, tukiwa na time pressure while tunasubiri nut na washer mpya kufika. Lead alitupea verbally final torque as 500 ft-lbs na initial torque 440 ft-lbs, lakini hatuku-cross check na wenzetu kwa task card kabla ya kuanza torquing. Next shift please hakikisheni torque values against actual EC/RA paperwork before final torque, na mcheck tena inspector sign-off kwa ile initial torque setting.
summary: Torque values za RH main gear side stay bushing zilipitishwa verbally tu badala ya kuverify na EC/RA card, so next shift wanahitaji kuconfirm kabla ya final torque.

entities.text: RH main gear side stay bushing

narrative_text: B747-400 Number-3 engine pylon fuel line was replaced after a leak was found during walk-around; installation was completed and leak-checked per AMM, but the aircraft was moved to the departure gate and the departure time was advanced by two hours during the job, causing distraction. It was later discovered post-departure that the safety wire lock on the fuel line coupling was not installed; downline station was notified and the wire lock has since been installed. Next shift should double check all AMM steps are re-verified against the job card for sign-off, and review time-pressure handling on gate moves during open maintenance tasks.
summary: A missed safety wire installation on a B747-400 Number-3 engine fuel line coupling, caused by time pressure and a gate move during maintenance, was corrected after departure at the downline station.

narrative_text: Ndege ya B747-400 ilikuwa na tatizo la kuvuja mafuta kwenye bomba la mafuta la injini namba tatu, hivyo bomba lilibadilishwa na kufanyiwa ukaguzi wa uvujaji kulingana na taratibu za AMM. Wakati wa kazi, ndege ilihamishwa kwenda geti la kuondokea na muda wa safari ukasogezwa mbele kwa masaa mawili, jambo lililosababisha usumbufu na kukosa umakini. Baada ya ndege kuondoka ilibainika kuwa waya wa usalama (safety wire lock) haukuwekwa kwenye kiunganishi cha bomba hilo; kituo cha mwisho kilijulishwa na hatua ya kurekebisha ilichukuliwa papo hapo. Zamu inayofuata inatakiwa kuhakikisha hatua zote za AMM zinathibitishwa tena kabla ya kusaini kadi ya kazi.
summary: Waya wa usalama haukuwekwa kwenye kiunganishi cha bomba la mafuta la injini namba tatu ya ndege ya B747-400 kutokana na msongo wa muda na kuhamishwa kwa ndege, na hitilafu hiyo ilirekebishwa baada ya ndege kufika kituo cha mwisho.

entities.text: bomba la mafuta la injini namba tatu
ukaguzi wa uvujaji kulingana na taratibu za AMM

narrative_text: Kwenye B747-400, tuligundua fuel leak kwenye Number-3 engine pylon fuel line wakati wa walk-around, so tukabadilisha ile line na kufanya leak check kama AMM inavyosema. Lakini wakati wa installation, aircraft ikahamishwa kwenda departure gate na wakaturudishia departure time kwa masaa mawili mapema, so tulikuwa distracted kabisa. Baada ya flight ku-depart ndio nikagundua sikuweka safety wire lock kwenye coupling, tukanotify downline station haraka na wakai-install pale pale. Kwa next shift, hakikisheni AMM steps zote zime-verify kabla ya ku-sign job card, especially ukiwa na time pressure ya namna hii.
summary: Kwenye B747-400, safety wire lock haikuwekwa kwenye Number-3 engine fuel line coupling kutokana na time pressure na kuhamishwa kwa aircraft, na tatizo lilirekebishwa baada ya flight kufika downline station.

narrative_text: MD-80 remains AOG after original crew reported a runaway nose-down horizontal stabilizer trim on landing; contract mechanics on site confirmed the same defect. On troubleshooting, trim now operates normally nose-down but will not run nose-up, so we proceeded to replace the Primary Trim Motor. Replacement unit arrived as a serviceable pull with only half the required motor-to-gearbox gasket; Maintenance Control was notified and approved installing it with the incomplete gasket for troubleshooting purposes while a new gasket is ordered AOG. Next shift to confirm fix effectiveness and follow up on gasket delivery/installation.
summary: MD-80 stabilizer trim motor replaced using an incomplete gasket after coordination with Maintenance Control, pending gasket delivery and fix verification.

narrative_text: Ndege ya MD-80 bado iko AOG baada ya rubani kuripoti stabilizer trim ikienda nose-down bila kudhibitiwa wakati wa kutua; mafundi wa kandarasi waliokuwepo walithibitisha hitilafu hiyo. Baada ya uchunguzi, trim sasa inafanya kazi vizuri upande wa nose-down lakini haifanyi kazi upande wa nose-up, hivyo tuliamua kubadilisha Primary Trim Motor. Motor mpya iliyoletwa ilikuwa imetolewa kwenye ndege nyingine na ilikuwa na nusu tu ya gasket inayohitajika kati ya motor na gearbox; tulimjulisha Maintenance Control na tukakubaliana kuifunga kwa ajili ya majaribio huku gasket mpya ikiagizwa kwa dharura. Zamu inayofuata ihakikishe urekebishaji umefanikiwa na ifuatilie uwasilishaji wa gasket mpya.
summary: Motor ya trim ya stabilizer ya MD-80 ilibadilishwa kwa gasket isiyokamilika kwa idhini ya Maintenance Control, ikisubiriwa uthibitisho wa urekebishaji na uwasilishaji wa gasket mpya.

narrative_text: MD-80 bado iko AOG, pilot aliripoti stabilizer trim ilikuwa inaenda runaway nose-down wakati wa landing; contract mechanics wale walikuwepo wakathibitisha ile defect. Tukafanya troubleshooting, trim sasa inaoperate poa nose-down lakini haitaki kuoperate nose-up, so tukaamua kuchange the Primary Trim Motor. Yule motor mpya alikuja as serviceable pull kutoka ndege ingine na alikuwa na nusu tu ya gasket inayohitajika between motor na gearbox; tukanotify Maintenance Control, wakakubali tuinstall na hiyo gasket ya used kwa ajili ya troubleshooting wakati gasket mpya inaorder AOG. Next shift wafuatilie kama fix imefanya kazi na kucheck delivery ya gasket mpya.
summary: Trim motor ya MD-80 imebadilishwa na gasket incomplete baada ya Maintenance Control kuconcur, tunasubiri gasket mpya na verification ya fix.

narrative_text: MD-80 remains AOG following pilot report of a runaway nose-down horizontal stabilizer trim that felt heavy on landing; contract maintenance on scene at arrival confirmed the same defect. During troubleshooting we could not duplicate the runaway condition — trim now runs normally nose-down but will not run nose-up. We began replacement of the primary trim motor, but the new unit (a serviceable pull from another aircraft) arrived missing half its motor-to-gearbox gasket; maintenance control was notified and agreed to install using the old gasket for troubleshooting purposes while a replacement gasket is ordered AOG. Next shift please verify installation per AMM, confirm gasket arrival, and re-check nose-up trim operation before releasing aircraft.
summary: MD-80 stabilizer trim motor replacement in progress with a temporary gasket while nose-up trim fault is still unresolved and needs follow-up verification.

narrative_text: Ndege ya MD-80 bado iko chini (AOG) baada ya rubani kuripoti tatizo la trim ya horizontal stabilizer kushuka chini yenyewe na kuhisi uzito wakati wa kutua; wafanyakazi wa matengenezo ya kandarasi walithibitisha hitilafu hiyo walipofika. Wakati wa uchunguzi, hatukuweza kurudia hali ile ile ya kushuka yenyewe — sasa trim inafanya kazi vizuri ikienda chini lakini haifanyi kazi ikienda juu. Tulianza kubadilisha motor ya trim, lakini kipande kipya (kilichotolewa kikiwa bado kizima kutoka ndege nyingine) hakikuwa na nusu ya gasket inayounganisha motor na gearbox; ofisi ya udhibiti wa matengenezo ilijulishwa na kukubali tuweke gasket ya zamani kwa madhumuni ya uchunguzi huku gasket mpya ikiagizwa kwa haraka. Zamu inayofuata iangalie ufungaji kulingana na mwongozo wa matengenezo (AMM), ithibitishe kuwasili kwa gasket mpya, na ikague tena uendeshaji wa trim ikienda juu kabla ndege haijaruhusiwa kurudi kazini.
summary: Ndege ya MD-80 inaendelea kufanyiwa ukarabati wa motor ya trim ya stabilizer huku ikitumia gasket ya muda, na tatizo la trim kwenda juu bado halijatatuliwa kikamilifu.

entities.text: ufungaji kulingana na mwongozo wa matengenezo

narrative_text: Hii MD-80 bado iko AOG, pilot alireport kwamba horizontal stabilizer trim ilikuwa na runaway nose-down na ilikuwa heavy wakati wa landing; contract maintenance guys walikuwa on scene wakaconfirm defect hiyo hiyo. Tulitry ku-troubleshoot lakini hatuku-duplicate ile runaway condition — sasa trim inaoperate fine ikienda nose-down lakini haiwork ikienda nose-up. Tulianza kubadilisha primary trim motor, lakini ile unit mpya (ilikuwa serviceable kutoka ndege ingine) ilikuja missing half ya gasket kati ya motor na gearbox; tuli-notify maintenance control wakakubali tuinstall na ile old gasket kwa purposes za troubleshooting wakati gasket mpya inaorder AOG. Shift inayofuata please verify installation per AMM, confirm kama gasket imefika, na urudie kucheck nose-up trim operation kabla ya ku-release aircraft.
summary: MD-80 iko AOG, tunaendelea na trim motor replacement na temporary gasket, lakini nose-up trim fault bado haijafix kabisa so inahitaji follow-up.

narrative_text: Fleet-wide safety concern: ramp agents continue to approach and attempt to open cargo doors/service ports while aircraft are under maintenance pressurization. On the CRJ200, a ramp agent rushed the cargo bay past a ground spotter and tried to open the cargo door while the aircraft was pressurized, triggering a cargo door caution in the cockpit; no pressure was lost as the door handle was not fully turned. The mechanic on headset completed depressurization and briefed the ramp agent and her supervisor afterward. Please reinforce ramp coordination procedures and spotter authority during pressurization checks fleet-wide.
summary: A ramp agent attempted to open a cargo door on a pressurized CRJ200 despite a ground spotter, prompting renewed calls for fleet-wide procedural reinforcement.

narrative_text: Kuna tatizo la usalama linaloathiri ndege zote: wafanyakazi wa rampu wamekuwa wakijaribu kufungua milango ya mizigo na sehemu za huduma wakati ndege zikiwa zinapewa presha na wahandisi. Katika tukio la hivi karibuni kwenye ndege ya CRJ200, wakala wa rampu alikimbilia sehemu ya mizigo licha ya kuwepo mlinzi wa ardhini, na akajaribu kufungua mlango wa mizigo huku ndege ikiwa na presha, jambo lililosababisha onyo la mlango wa mizigo kwenye chumba cha marubani. Hakuna presha iliyopotea kwani kishikizo cha mlango hakikuzungushwa kikamilifu. Fundi aliyekuwa akiongoza zoezi hilo alimaliza kutoa presha kisha akaongea na wakala huyo na msimamizi wake; inashauriwa taratibu za mawasiliano kati ya rampu na matengenezo ziimarishwe kwa ndege zote.
summary: Wakala wa rampu alijaribu kufungua mlango wa mizigo wa ndege ya CRJ200 ikiwa na presha licha ya mlinzi wa ardhini kuwepo, hali iliyosababisha wito wa kuimarisha taratibu za usalama kwa ndege zote.

narrative_text: Kuna issue ya safety ambayo inaaffect fleet nzima: ramp agents wamekuwa wakijaribu ku-open cargo doors na service ports wakati aircraft iko under pressurization ya maintenance. Kwa hii CRJ200 tuko nayo, ramp agent alirush cargo bay akipita ground spotter na aki-attempt kufungua cargo door wakati aircraft ilikuwa pressurized, ikatrigger cargo door caution kwa cockpit. Hakuna pressure iliyopotea kwani ile door handle haikuzungushwa fully. Mechanic aliyekuwa headset alicomplete depressurization kisha aki-brief huyo ramp agent na supervisor wake baadaye. Tafadhali tu-reinforce ramp coordination procedures na spotter authority during pressurization checks kwa fleet nzima.
summary: Ramp agent alijaribu ku-open cargo door ya CRJ200 iliyo pressurized licha ya ground spotter kuwepo, hivyo ku-prompt need ya kuimarisha procedures fleet-wide.

narrative_text: A321 RON aircraft was left to dayshift without a proper turnover; night shift could not finish the vibration survey after the blade change due to a vibration computer fault. Once avionics cleared the computer issue, the incoming technicians ran the survey but got verbal confirmation from the supervisor that engine #1 needed the check, when it was actually engine #2 that had the blade change. The survey was completed and signed off on the wrong engine before the error was discovered the next day. Follow-up required: verify correct engine on the blade change card and repeat the vibration survey on engine #2.
summary: Poor shift turnover and incorrect verbal confirmation led to a post-blade-change vibration survey being performed on the wrong engine on an A321.

narrative_text: Ndege ya A321 iliyokuwa RON haikupewa turnover sahihi kwa shift ya mchana baada ya night shift kushindwa kukamilisha vibration survey kutokana na hitilafu ya kompyuta ya vibration baada ya blade change. Baada ya avionics kurekebisha hitilafu hiyo, mafundi walioingia walipata uthibitisho wa mdomo kutoka kwa supervisor kuwa engine namba moja ndiyo ilihitaji ukaguzi, ilhali kumbe engine namba mbili ndiyo iliyofanyiwa blade change. Survey ilikamilishwa na kusainiwa kwenye engine isiyofaa kabla tatizo hilo kugunduliwa siku iliyofuata. Inahitajika ufuatiliaji wa haraka kuthibitisha engine sahihi kwenye karatasi ya blade change na kurudia vibration survey kwenye engine namba mbili.
summary: Turnover mbovu na uthibitisho wa mdomo usio sahihi ulisababisha vibration survey kufanywa kwenye engine isiyofaa ya ndege ya A321 baada ya blade change.

narrative_text: Aircraft ya A321 ilikuwa RON na hapakuwa na proper turnover kwa dayshift kwa sababu night shift hawakuweza kukamilisha vibration survey baada ya blade change, kuna vibration computer ilikuwa na malfunction. Baada ya avionics kufix computer issue, technicians tuliopokea job tulipiga call supervisor kuconfirm ni engine gani inahitaji survey, akatuambia ni engine 1 lakini kumbe ni engine 2 ndiyo ilikuwa na blade change. Tukafanya survey na kusign off kwa engine mbaya kabla tatizo kugunduliwa next day. Inabidi tucheck tena blade change card na turudie vibration survey kwenye engine 2 correct one.
summary: Turnover haikuwa clear na supervisor akaconfirm engine mbaya, hivyo vibration survey ikafanywa kwenye engine isiyo sahihi ya A321 baada ya blade change.

narrative_text: A321 CDL follow-up for the right-hand #4 flap track fairing lubrication was not completed by departure station maintenance, and the AML was not updated to reflect it. The gap was only caught at shift change after the aircraft had already departed, so I contacted Maintenance at the arrival station to have the lubrication check accomplished before the next flight. Flight crew also did not catch the missing AML entry during their pre-departure review; please remind crews to verify CDL follow-up items in the AML before releasing the aircraft.
summary: An A321's required CDL flap fairing lubrication check was missed and not logged, and it was only caught after departure, requiring arrival-station maintenance to complete it before the next flight.

narrative_text: Ukaguzi wa lazima wa CDL kwa ajili ya ulainishaji wa fairing ya njia ya flap namba nne upande wa kulia kwenye ndege ya A321 haukufanyika kituo cha kuondokea, na kumbukumbu kwenye logbook ya ndege haikusasishwa. Jambo hili liligundulika tu wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu, ndege ikiwa tayari imeruka, hivyo nililazimika kuwasiliana na wahandisi wa matengenezo kituo cha kutua ili kazi hiyo ikamilishwe kabla ya safari inayofuata. Wafanyakazi wa ndani ya ndege nao hawakubaini kukosekana kwa taarifa hiyo kwenye logbook kabla ya kuondoka; ni muhimu marubani wahakikishe vipengele vya CDL vimeshughulikiwa kabla ya kuruhusu ndege kuondoka.
summary: Ukaguzi wa ulainishaji wa fairing ya flap ya ndege ya A321 uliokuwa wa lazima kutokana na CDL haukufanyika wala kuandikwa, na jambo hilo liligundulika ndege ikiwa tayari imeondoka, na kulazimu kituo cha kutua kukamilisha kazi hiyo.

entities.text: fairing ya njia ya flap namba nne upande wa kulia

narrative_text: Kwa hii A321, ile CDL follow-up ya flap track fairing namba four, right-hand side, haikufanyiwa lubrication check kama required, na wa departure station hawakuweka entry yoyote kwenye AML. Niliona hii gap tu wakati wa shift change, ndege ikiwa already in the air, so nikapiga simu Maintenance huko arrival station wafanye ile check kabla ya next flight. Flight crew nao hawakucatch hiyo missing entry wakati wa review yao before departure, so tukumbushane crews wa-verify CDL items kwenye AML kabla ya kuclear ndege iondoke.
summary: A321 ilikosa lubrication check ya CDL kwa flap fairing na entry haikuwekwa kwenye AML, ikagundulika baada ya ndege kuondoka na ikabidi arrival station wa-fix before next flight.
