narrative_text: During a walk-around near the hardstand, Safety observed the vendor conducting a fuel tank entry job on the B777-200 with multiple unsafe conditions: aircraft not grounded, venting motors positioned under the aircraft instead of using a 100ft hose, generator and a running vehicle within 30-50ft of the open tank, no man-lift in place, and no barrier roping around the aircraft. Maintenance was notified by email and acknowledged the issue, but similar procedural lapses have recurred previously without real correction. Next shift please confirm the vendor has grounded the aircraft, repositioned equipment to safe distances, and barricaded the work area before further fuel tank work resumes.
summary: Fuel tank entry job on B777-200 was performed with multiple safety violations (no grounding, unsafe equipment placement, no barrier), requiring follow-up to confirm corrective action by maintenance/vendor.

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi karibu na hardstand, Idara ya Usalama iligundua kuwa kandarasi aliyekuwa akifanya kazi ya kuingia kwenye tanki la mafuta ya ndege ya B777-200 alikiuka taratibu kadhaa za usalama: ndege haikuwa imeunganishwa na ardhi (grounding), mota za kutoa hewa ziliwekwa chini ya ndege badala ya kutumia hose ya futi 100, jenereta na gari lililokuwa linaendesha injini yalikuwa karibu na tanki wazi kuliko umbali unaotakiwa, hakukuwa na man-lift wala kizuizi cha kuzungushia eneo la kazi. Idara ya Matengenezo ilijulishwa kwa barua pepe na ikakiri tatizo, lakini matatizo kama haya yamekuwa yakijirudia bila hatua thabiti kuchukuliwa. Zamu inayofuata itathibitishe kuwa kandarasi ameunganisha ndege na ardhi, amehamisha vifaa hadi umbali salama, na amezungushia eneo kabla ya kazi kuendelea.
summary: Kazi ya kuingia kwenye tanki la mafuta ya ndege ya B777-200 ilifanywa kinyume na taratibu za usalama, hivyo inahitajika ufuatiliaji wa hatua za kurekebisha na kandarasi/idara ya matengenezo.

entities.text: kazi ya kuingia kwenye tanki la mafuta

narrative_text: Nikiwa na round karibu na hardstand, Safety aliona vendor akifanya fuel tank entry job kwa B777-200 na kulikuwa na violations kadhaa za safety: aircraft haikuwa grounded, venting motors ziko chini ya plane badala ya kutumia hose ya 100ft, generator na gari ambayo ilikuwa running iko within 30-50ft ya open tank, hakuna man-lift ilikuwa in place na hakuna barrier ya kuzungushia aircraft. Maintenance walijulishwa via email na wakakiri issue, lakini hizi procedural lapses zimekuwa zikirudia bila corrective action ya kweli. Shift inayofuata i-confirm kama vendor ame-ground aircraft, ame-reposition equipment kwa safe distance, na ame-barricade eneo kabla ya kuendelea na fuel tank work.
summary: Fuel tank entry job kwa B777-200 ilifanywa na multiple safety violations (hakuna grounding, equipment placement mbaya, no barrier), so follow-up inahitajika kuconfirm corrective action kutoka kwa maintenance/vendor.

narrative_text: During hangar moves, an A330 was towed out with only one mechanic watching the tail, since the wings appeared clear of the hangar opening; while correcting course to clear another parked aircraft, the wing swept closer to the hangar structure than expected before the mechanic waved to stop the tow. We were short-staffed with only one supertug and one qualified tow driver for the shift, and the crew lost track of the aircraft type's actual wingspan during the sequence. Next shift needs to enforce the 5-person minimum for hangar tows, no exceptions, and confirm supertug/tow-qualified staffing before any A330 moves.
summary: An A330 hangar tow proceeded with insufficient wing-watch staffing and nearly resulted in a wingtip strike due to workload and staffing shortfalls.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kuhamisha ndege kutoka hangar, ndege ya aina ya A330 ilivutwa nje huku fundi mmoja tu akiangalia mkia, kwa sababu ilidhaniwa mabawa yalikuwa hayana kizuizi chochote; lakini wakati wa kurekebisha mwelekeo ili kuepuka ndege nyingine iliyokuwa imeegeshwa, bawa lilikaribia sana muundo wa hangar kabla fundi hajaashiria kusimamisha zoezi hilo. Tulikuwa na uhaba wa wafanyakazi, tukiwa na supertug moja tu na dereva mmoja aliyehitimu kuvuta ndege, na wafanyakazi walipoteza mwelekeo kuhusu ukubwa halisi wa mabawa ya ndege hiyo. Zamu inayofuata inapaswa kuhakikisha angalau watu watano wanahusika kila mara ndege inapotolewa hangarini, bila ubaguzi, na kuthibitisha idadi ya wafanyakazi waliohitimu kabla ya kusogeza A330 nyingine yoyote.
summary: Zoezi la kuvuta ndege ya A330 kutoka hangarini lilifanywa bila wafanyakazi wa kutosha wa kuangalia mabawa, jambo lililosababisha hatari ya karibu ya mgongano.

narrative_text: Wakati wa hangar moves, tulitow out A330 na mechanic mmoja tu akiwatch mkia, kwa sababu tulidhani wings zilikuwa clear ya hangar opening; lakini tulipofanya adjustment kuepuka ndege nyingine iliyoparked karibu, wing ilikaribia sana structure ya hangar kabla mechanic hajawave kusimamisha tow. Tulikuwa short-staffed, tukiwa na supertug moja tu na tow-qualified driver mmoja tu kwa shift hiyo, so tuliforget wingspan halisi ya hiyo aircraft type. Zamu inayofuata lazima ienforce minimum ya watu five kwa hangar tows, no exceptions, na icheck supertug/tow-qualified staffing kabla ya kusonga A330 nyingine yoyote.
summary: A330 hangar tow ilifanyika bila watu wa kutosha kuwatch wings, na ikakaribia kusababisha strike kutokana na workload na staffing shortage.

narrative_text: Heads up: the ERJ-145 L/H fuel tank vent valve replacement from last shift was signed off as buy-back without QC actually witnessing the install steps, since only one of the two mechanics who did the job approached me and the turnover notes were incomplete. I had the mechanic correct his sign-off to reflect only the steps actually completed before I bought back that portion, but full traceability of who did what is still questionable. Also note a new form was opened after the wiring conduit to the vent valve was found damaged from pulling wires during install, so that repair needs inspection and closure. Please confirm with QC lead if the original buy-back paperwork needs re-review.
summary: An ERJ-145 fuel tank vent valve installation was inspected and bought back with incomplete handover documentation, and a follow-on conduit damage repair still needs inspection.

narrative_text: Taarifa: ile kazi ya kubadilisha valve ya vent ya tanki la mafuta upande wa kushoto kwenye ndege ilifanywa shift iliyopita, lakini QC hawakushuhudia hatua zote za ufungaji kwa sababu fundi mmoja tu ndiye alinijia, wakati wenzake wawili walihusika kwenye kazi hiyo, na maandishi ya turnover hayakuwa kamili. Nilimwomba fundi arekebishe sahihi yake ili ionyeshe hatua zilizokamilika tu kabla sijafanya buy-back ya sehemu hiyo, ingawa bado kuna mashaka kuhusu nani alifanya nini hasa. Pia kumbuka fomu mpya ilifunguliwa baada ya kugundulika kuwa kebo ya waya kwenda kwenye valve hiyo iliharibika wakati wa kuvuta nyaya, hivyo ukarabati huo unahitaji ukaguzi na kufungwa rasmi. Tafadhali wasiliana na kiongozi wa QC kuthibitisha kama karatasi za awali za buy-back zinahitaji kupitiwa upya.
summary: Ufungaji wa valve ya vent ya tanki la mafuta kwenye ndege ulikaguliwa na kufanyiwa buy-back huku maandishi ya turnover yakiwa hayajakamilika, na kuna ukarabati wa kebo unaosubiri ukaguzi.

entities.text: valve ya vent ya tanki la mafuta

narrative_text: Heads up: ile L/H fuel tank vent valve replacement ya ERJ-145 ilifanywa na shift iliyopita, lakini QC hawakuwitness install steps zote maana ni fundi mmoja tu ndiye alinikaribia, ilhali walikuwa wawili wanafanya ile job, na turnover notes hazikuwa complete. Nilimfanya fundi a-correct sign-off yake iwe reflect only steps alizocomplete kabla nifanye buy-back ya hiyo portion, lakini bado kuna doubt kuhusu who did what exactly. Pia note kwamba another form imeopenwa baada ya kupata ile wiring conduit kwa vent valve imeharibika from pulling wires wakati wa install, so hiyo repair inahitaji inspection na kufungwa properly. Tafadhali check na QC lead kama ile original buy-back paperwork inahitaji re-review.
summary: Ile vent valve installation ya ERJ-145 ilifanyiwa buy-back huku turnover documentation ikiwa incomplete, na kuna conduit damage repair inayosubiri inspection.

narrative_text: Rudder R&R on the B737-800 was not completed overnight due to inadequate hangar tooling; the overhead crane lacks sufficient height and the sling setup used for 700-series rudders does not transfer safely to the 800. Nose jacking attempts on the ramp incline nearly caused the aircraft to roll off the jack, so the crew shifted to an outside washrack crane with an extension arm, but after six mechanics and a crane operator worked an extended period, only the #1 hinge bolt was installed. Next shift needs proper equipment/tooling assessment before continuing, as current setup is unsafe and inefficient for 800 rudder changes.
summary: Overnight B737-800 rudder installation was left incomplete due to inadequate crane/tooling and unsafe jacking conditions, requiring equipment review before continuation.

narrative_text: Kazi ya kuondoa na kuweka rudder mpya kwenye ndege ya B737-800 haikukamilika usiku kucha kwa sababu vifaa vya hangar havitoshi; crane haifiki urefu unaohitajika na mfumo wa sling unaotumika kwa ndege za 700 haufai kwa 800. Majaribio ya kuinua sehemu ya mbele ya ndege kwa jack yalikaribia kusababisha ndege kuanguka kutoka kwenye jack, hivyo wafanyakazi walihamishia kazi hiyo nje kwenye washrack wakitumia crane yenye extension arm, lakini baada ya mafundi sita na dereva wa crane kufanya kazi kwa muda mrefu, bolt moja tu ya hinge ya kwanza ndiyo iliwekwa. Zamu inayofuata inahitaji kupitia upya vifaa na taratibu kabla ya kuendelea kwani hali ya sasa si salama wala haifanyi kazi vizuri.
summary: Kazi ya kubadilisha rudder ya B737-800 haikukamilika usiku kwa sababu ya uhaba wa vifaa na hatari za kuinua ndege, hivyo inahitaji ukaguzi wa vifaa kabla ya kuendelea.

entities.text: bolt moja tu ya hinge ya kwanza

narrative_text: Tulikuwa tuna-attempt rudder R&R kwa hii B737-800 lakini haikukamilika overnight kwa sababu hangar tooling ni inadequate; ile overhead crane haifiki height inayohitajika na sling setup ya 700 haiwezi kutumika direct kwa 800. Tuli-try nose jacking huko ramp lakini incline ilikuwa inaweza kufanya aircraft i-roll off jack, so supervision waka-instruct tutumie ile crane ya nje kwenye washrack yenye extension arm, but after mechanics sita na crane operator kufanya kazi masaa mengi, ni bolt moja tu ya #1 hinge ndio iliingia. Next shift wanahitaji ku-review equipment na tooling before wanaendelea kwa sababu hii setup ya sasa si safe wala efficient.
summary: Rudder R&R ya B737-800 haiku-complete overnight due to poor tooling na crane setup, hivyo next shift wanahitaji ku-assess equipment kwanza kabla ya kuendelea.

narrative_text: Final installation inspection on the No. 9 slat (B767-300) was completed and signed off, but attention was split with another concurrent inspection task, which limited direct observation of the full install sequence. A week later the aircraft returned with a slat asymmetry fault, revealing a damaged outboard auxiliary slat track and two main slat tracks missing bushings that were not visible during the original security and operational checks. Next shift should flag this as a lesson on inspection coverage when handling parallel tasks, and review similar recent slat installations for missed hardware.
summary: A B767-300 slat installation was signed off during a period of divided attention, and a later slat asymmetry fault exposed missed track damage and missing bushings that need follow-up review.

narrative_text: Ukaguzi wa mwisho wa ufungaji wa slat namba tisa kwenye ndege ya B767-300 ulikamilishwa na kusainiwa, lakini wakati huo huo nilikuwa nikishughulikia kazi nyingine ya ukaguzi, jambo lililopunguza uwezo wa kufuatilia hatua zote za ufungaji kwa karibu. Wiki moja baadaye ndege hiyo ilirudi ikiwa na hitilafu ya usawa wa slat, ambapo ilibainika kuwa track ya nje ya slat msaidizi ilikuwa imeharibika na bushing mbili za track kuu za slat zilikuwa hazipo, mambo ambayo hayakuonekana wazi wakati wa ukaguzi wa awali. Zamu inayofuata inafaa kuangazia suala hili kama fundisho kuhusu ukamilifu wa ukaguzi wakati wa kazi zinazoendana, na kupitia upya ufungaji mwingine wa hivi karibuni wa slat kuangalia vifaa vinavyoweza kuwa vimekosekana.
summary: Ukaguzi wa ufungaji wa slat kwenye B767-300 ulifanywa wakati wa umakini uliogawanyika, na baadaye hitilafu ya usawa wa slat ilidhihirisha uharibifu na vifaa vilivyokosekana ambavyo vinahitaji ufuatiliaji.

entities.text: track ya nje ya slat msaidizi

narrative_text: Nilifanya final installation inspection ya No. 9 slat kwenye B767-300 na nikasign off, lakini wakati huo huo nilikuwa na inspection task nyingine inaendelea, so sikuwa na full attention kwa install sequence yote. Baada ya wiki moja aircraft ilirudi na slat asymmetry issue, ikaonekana kuwa outboard auxiliary slat track imeharibika na bushings mbili za main slat tracks zimekosekana, vitu ambavyo havikuonekana wazi during original security check na operational checks. Kwa shift inayofuata, tuchukue hii kama lesson kuhusu inspection coverage wakati wa parallel tasks, na tu-review installations za slat za hivi karibuni kuangalia kama kuna hardware iliyomiss.
summary: Slat installation ya B767-300 ilisign-offiwa wakati wa divided attention, na baadaye slat asymmetry fault ikaonyesha damage na missing hardware ambazo zinahitaji follow-up.

narrative_text: Major hydraulic leak found covering the entire belly of the tail section on the MD-11; entered via the tail access door and traced fluid up to the hydraulic lines near the engine, with fittings/connectors suspected as the source. Due to time pressure to release another aircraft, we only documented that the panels were opened to F.O.M. and did not run hydraulics or move flight controls; job was handed to out-of-service crew without a face-to-face turnover. Next shift must verify actual panel/access status, confirm no hydraulics or flight controls were cycled, and complete a proper source trace before further troubleshooting.
summary: Unresolved MD-11 tail-section hydraulic leak was handed over to the next crew with an incomplete turnover after troubleshooting was cut short due to time pressure.

narrative_text: Tulipata uvujaji mkubwa wa hydraulic chini ya mkia wa ndege ya MD-11, ukienea sehemu nzima ya belly. Tulipanda kupitia mlango wa ukaguzi wa mkia na kugundua kuwa chanzo huenda ni kwenye mabomba ya hydraulic karibu na injini; kwa sababu ya haraka ya kuhudumia ndege nyingine, tuliandika kwenye logbook kuwa milango ilifunguliwa kwa ukaguzi wa F.O.M. tu, bila kuwasha mfumo wa hydraulic wala kusogeza vidhibiti vya ndege. Kazi ilikabidhiwa kwa timu ya out-of-service bila mazungumzo ya moja kwa moja ya predictable turnover, hivyo shift inayokuja inahitaji kuthibitisha hali ya milango, kuhakikisha hakuna kilichoguswa, na kukamilisha ufuatiliaji wa chanzo cha uvujaji.
summary: Uvujaji wa hydraulic kwenye mkia wa ndege ya MD-11 haukukamilika kutatuliwa na ulikabidhiwa kwa shift nyingine bila taarifa kamili ya mkabidhiano.

narrative_text: Tulipata leak kubwa ya hydraulic chini ya tail section ya MD-11, imeenea belly nzima. Tulipanda through tail access door kuangalia na tukagundua fluid inaonekana inatoka kwa hydraulic lines karibu na engine; kwa sababu tulikuwa na time pressure ya kuhudumia aircraft nyingine, tuliandika logbook tu kuwa panels zilifunguliwa kwa F.O.M. only, hatujawasha hydraulics wala kusogeza flight controls. Job ilihandiwa over kwa out-of-service crew but hakukuwa na proper turnover face-to-face, so next shift wanahitaji kuconfirm status ya panels, kuverify hakuna kilichotouched, na kufinish source trace ya leak.
summary: MD-11 hydraulic leak kwenye tail haiku-resolve fully na handover ilikuwa incomplete kwa sababu ya time pressure.

narrative_text: During cabin walkthrough on Aircraft X, found several overhead bin access panels missing fasteners and bins misaligned, especially at emergency exit rows with tray tables; flight crew claimed bins should close on their own but Bin Assist Mechanisms were found inoperative. Lead Mechanic confirmed via IPC that each panel requires screws, contradicting earlier guidance that panels were Non-Essential Furnishings covered by AMM reference. Maintenance Operations Manager was notified and aircraft was pulled to hangar and taken Out of Service; next shift to confirm vendor rework status and BAM functional check before return to service.
summary: Aircraft X was taken out of service after missing panel fasteners and inoperative overhead bin mechanisms were found following a poor vendor interior installation.

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa ndani ya ndege kwenye Aircraft X, tuligundua paneli kadhaa za sehemu za juu za kuwekea mizigo hazina screws na baadhi hazijapangiliwa vizuri, hasa kwenye foleni za emergency exit zenye tray tables; wafanyakazi wa ndege walisema bins zinafaa kufunga zenyewe lakini Bin Assist Mechanisms zilikutwa hazifanyi kazi. Lead Mechanic alithibitisha kupitia IPC kwamba kila paneli inahitaji screws, jambo lililopingana na maelezo ya awali kwamba paneli hizo ni za NEF tu zinazoshughulikiwa kwa AMM. Maintenance Operations Manager alijulishwa na ndege ilipelekwa hangarini na kuwekwa Out of Service; zamu inayofuata ihakikishe hali ya kazi iliyofanywa na vendor na ikague BAM kabla ndege haijarudishwa kazini.
summary: Aircraft X iliwekwa nje ya huduma baada ya kupatikana paneli zisizo na screws na mifumo ya bins isiyofanya kazi kutokana na ufungaji mbaya wa ndani uliofanywa na vendor.

entities.text: paneli za sehemu za juu za kuwekea mizigo

narrative_text: Nikifanya cabin walkthrough kwa Aircraft X, nikakuta panels za overhead bins hazina screws na zingine hazija-align vizuri, especially kwa emergency exit rows zenye tray tables; crew walisema bins zinafaa kujifunga zenyewe lakini BAM zilikuwa inoperative. Lead Mechanic akacheki IPC akaconfirm kila panel inahitaji screws, tofauti na ile info ya awali ati ni NEF tu covered na AMM. Nikamcall Maintenance Operations Manager kumjulisha, ndege ikaenda hangar na kuwekwa OTS; next shift wacheki status ya vendor rework na wafanye BAM check kabla aircraft haija-return to service.
summary: Aircraft X ime-go OTS baada ya kukutwa na missing screws na overhead bin mechanisms zisizo-fanya kazi baada ya vendor kufanya interior installation vibaya.

narrative_text: During the RH elevator R&R on the B737-800 (lightning strike repair), the trim tab balance weights were transferred from the old assembly without verification against the AMM illustration. New elevator had 3 weights per location versus 2 on the old unit; extra weights were removed only after Inspector queried the discrepancy, but this was not fully cross-checked against the manual at time of closeout. Next shift/QA to double-confirm balance weight configuration is per AMM before any further ops checks, especially since a similar LH elevator R&R on another aircraft later revealed incorrect weights were pulled. Recommend reviewing handover communication between shifts on this task and flagging balance weight verification as a mandatory sign-off item.
summary: Balance weight configuration on a B737-800 RH elevator replacement was not properly verified between shifts, leading to a discrepancy later confirmed on a similar job on another aircraft.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kuondoa na kufunga upya elevator ya kulia (RH) ya ndege ya B737-800 kutokana na kupigwa na radi, uzani wa kusawazisha (balance weights) ulihamishwa kutoka kwa assembly ya zamani bila kuthibitishwa vizuri kulingana na mchoro wa AMM. Elevator mpya ilikuwa na uzani tatu kwa kila sehemu badala ya mbili kama ya zamani, na hii ilibainika tu baada ya Inspector kuhoji tofauti hiyo, lakini uthibitisho kamili haukufanyika mapema. Shift inayokuja au timu ya ubora (QA) wanahitajika kuthibitisha tena mpangilio wa uzani huo kwa mujibu wa AMM, hasa kwa kuwa hitilafu kama hiyo ilijitokeza tena wiki moja baadaye kwenye kazi ya elevator ya kushoto (LH) ya ndege nyingine. Inashauriwa kuboresha mawasiliano ya turnover kati ya shift na kufanya uthibitisho wa uzani kuwa hatua ya lazima kabla ya kufunga panel.
summary: Uzani wa kusawazisha kwenye ukarabati wa elevator ya B737-800 haukuthibitishwa vizuri kati ya shift, jambo lililosababisha hitilafu iliyogunduliwa tena kwenye kazi nyingine baadaye.

narrative_text: Kwenye ile RH elevator R&R ya B737-800 baada ya lightning strike, tulitransfer trim tab balance weights kutoka kwa assembly ya zamani bila kuverify vizuri na AMM illustration. New elevator ilikuwa na weights tatu kila location, lakini ya zamani ilikuwa na mbili tu, so extra weights zilitolewa but ni baada ya Inspector kuquestion discrepancy hiyo, si mapema. Next shift au QA wanafaa wadouble-check balance weight configuration kulingana na AMM kabla ya kuendelea na operational checks, especially since incident kama hii ilirudia wiki moja baadaye kwenye LH elevator ya ndege nyingine. Tafadhali flag hii kwenye turnover, weight verification lazima iwe mandatory sign-off item.
summary: Balance weights za elevator ya B737-800 hazikuverifiwa properly kati ya shifts, na hitilafu ile iligunduliwa tena kwenye kazi nyingine baada ya wiki moja.

narrative_text: B737 arrived from ZZZ with a known right engine exceedance light that came on during ground shutdown; the previous shift reset the light and cockpit EGT gauge box but this was never logged or passed on, so the aircraft departed and flew to IAH with the discrepancy unresolved. On arrival Maintenance Control finally directed an FMC Test on the right EEC, which returned two faults and pulled the aircraft out of service. ETR is set for today; technicians need to inspect and clean/replace the affected probe, and shift turnover procedures must be reviewed since the original write-up was dropped during handover.
summary: A B737 flew from ZZZ to IAH with an unresolved right engine exceedance fault after the issue was lost during shift turnover, and it is now out of service pending probe repair.

entities.text: inspect and clean/replace the affected probe

narrative_text: Ndege ya B737 ilifika kutoka ZZZ ikiwa na tatizo la injini ya kulia lililoonekana kama taa ya exceedance wakati ndege ilipozimwa, lakini shift iliyopita ilirudisha taa hiyo pamoja na kisanduku cha EGT bila kuandika ripoti wala kuelezea shift inayofuata, hivyo ndege ikaruka hadi IAH ikiwa na hitilafu hiyo bado haijatatuliwa. Ilipofika IAH, Maintenance Control waliagiza FMC Test ifanyike kwenye EEC ya kulia, na matokeo yalionyesha hitilafu mbili zilizosababisha ndege kutolewa nje ya matumizi. ETR imewekwa leo; mafundi wanahitajika kukagua na kusafisha au kubadilisha probe husika, na taratibu za mabadiliko ya zamu zinahitaji kupitiwa upya kwa sababu tatizo hili lilisahaulika wakati wa kuhamisha majukumu.
summary: Ndege ya B737 iliruka kutoka ZZZ hadi IAH ikiwa na hitilafu ya injini ya kulia iliyosahaulika wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu, na sasa iko nje ya matumizi ikisubiri ukarabati wa probe.

entities.text: kukagua na kusafisha au kubadilisha probe

narrative_text: Hii B737 imetoka ZZZ na tatizo la right engine, exceedance light ilikuwa imewaka wakati wa shutdown lakini shift iliyopita walirudisha ile light na EGT gauge box bila kuandika kwa logbook, so ikaenda tu na deferred issue mpaka IAH. Ikifika IAH, Maintenance Control walidirect FMC Test kwenye right EEC, matokeo yakatoa faults mbili, ndio maana aircraft imekuwa out of service. ETR ni leo; technicians wanahitaji kukagua probe, either clean ama replace, na tunahitaji kuangalia hii issue ya shift turnover coz report ilisahaulika kabisa.
summary: B737 ilifly kutoka ZZZ mpaka IAH na known engine fault ambayo ilisahaulika during shift turnover, sasa iko out of service ikisubiri probe repair.

narrative_text: CRJ700 came to us from day shift with a flap fail caution, traced to the right torque tube disconnected from the PDU. Night shift completed the right BPSU installation, manually retracted the flaps to correct the misalignment, then mechanically and electrically rigged the flap system and reconnected the torque tube per AMM, all confirmed by the RII inspector via tug test and measurement per the work order. Panels were closed after FOD check and the flap/slat operational check was run 7+ consecutive cycles with no faults recurring; next shift to monitor for any repeat caution message on the following flights.
summary: Right torque tube disconnection causing flap fail caution on a CRJ700 was rectified and rigged per AMM, with repeated operational checks clean, pending continued monitoring by next shift.

narrative_text: Ndege ya CRJ700 ilikabidhiwa na zamu ya mchana ikiwa na tatizo la flap fail caution, lililotokana na torque tube ya upande wa kulia kutoka kwenye PDU. Zamu ya usiku ilimaliza kufunga BPSU upande wa kulia, ikarudisha flaps kwa mkono ili kusahihisha kutolingana, kisha ikafanya urekebishaji wa kimekaniki na kielektroniki wa mfumo wa flap na kuunganisha tena torque tube kulingana na AMM, kazi ikathibitishwa na afisa wa RII kupitia tug test na vipimo kama ilivyoainishwa kwenye work order. Paneli zilifungwa baada ya ukaguzi wa FOD na operational check ya flap/slat ikafanywa zaidi ya mara saba mfululizo bila hitilafu yoyote; zamu inayofuata ifuatilie kuhakikisha tatizo halijirudii kwenye safari zijazo.
summary: Tatizo la torque tube kujitenga na PDU lililosababisha flap fail caution kwenye CRJ700 lilirekebishwa na kupimwa kulingana na AMM, ukaguzi ukafanikiwa, lakini ufuatiliaji zaidi unahitajika.

narrative_text: Tuli-receive CRJ700 kutoka day shift ikiwa na flap fail caution, ikaturn out ni right torque tube imedisconnect kutoka kwa PDU. Sisi night shift tuli-finish installation ya right BPSU, tuka-manually retract flaps kufix misalignment, halafu tuka-rig flap system mechanically and electrically na tuka-reconnect torque tube per AMM, na RII akaconfirm installation kupitia tug test na measurements kama zilivyo kwa work order. Baada ya panels kufungwa tuka-do FOD check, tuka-run flap/slat operational check for 7+ cycles consecutively bila fault yoyote; next shift wafuatilie kuona kama caution message itarudi kwenye flights zijazo.
summary: Right torque tube ilikuwa imedisconnect kutoka PDU ikisababisha flap fail caution kwa CRJ700, iliconfirm-iwa fixed per AMM after operational checks zote zikapass, but follow-up bado inahitajika.

narrative_text: During the tow of two B737-900 aircraft into the hangar tonight, I noticed the right ram air door on both aircraft was soft/deflected when pushed, consistent with the known Fleet Engineering Directive issue on these doors. I confirmed no open log pages existed for either aircraft, so I wrote up both discrepancies before returning to my assigned task on the EEC install. Next shift should verify both write-ups have been actioned by maintenance control and confirm parts/inspection follow-up on the ram air doors.
summary: Technician found and logged suspect ram air door discrepancies on two B737-900 aircraft during a hangar move; follow-up on write-up action is needed.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kuvuta ndege mbili za aina ya B737-900 kuingiza hangarini usiku wa leo, niligundua kuwa mlango wa right ram air kwenye ndege zote mbili ulikuwa laini/unaingia ndani nilipoubonyeza, jambo linalofanana na tatizo linalojulikana kwenye Fleet Engineering Directive. Nilihakikisha hakuna log page iliyofunguliwa kwa ndege hizo mbili, hivyo niliandika ripoti za matatizo hayo kabla ya kurudi kwenye kazi yangu ya kufunga EEC. Shift inayofuata inapaswa kuthibitisha kama ripoti hizo zimeshughulikiwa na maintenance control na kufuatilia ukaguzi wa milango hiyo.
summary: Fundi aligundua na kuripoti hitilafu za mlango wa ram air kwenye ndege mbili za B737-900 wakati wa kuzihamishia hangarini, na ufuatiliaji unahitajika.

narrative_text: Wakati tuna-tow zile ndege mbili za B737-900 kuingiza hangar usiku wa leo, niliobserve kwamba right ram air door kwa zote mbili ilikuwa inaingia ndani nikiipush, sawa na ile issue ya Fleet Engineering Directive tumekuwa tukiiona sana. Nilicheck kwenye system kama kuna open log page, na kuona hakuna, so niliandika write-up za zote mbili kabla ya kurudi kwa task yangu ya ku-install EEC. Shift inayofuata iconfirm kama write-ups zimeactioned na maintenance control, na ifuatilie inspection ya hizo ram air doors.
summary: Technician alifind na kulog ram air door discrepancies kwenye ndege mbili za B737-900 wakati wa hangar move, na follow-up inahitajika.

narrative_text: A319 #1 engine HP/PRV valve job at gate C20 was picked up mid-progress from midnight shift after the aircraft was changed from a live flight to RON status; engine was closed and reopened due to an unplanned gate move to C26, then HP and PRV valves were replaced and ops checks completed before closing for run. Post-flight it was found in ZZZ1 that the #1 engine T/R had no reverser operation, and the HCU was discovered locked out with a lockout pin that had no streamer attached, so the incoming tech was unaware of the lockout status while working the job. Next shift needs to verify HCU lockout/streamer procedure was followed and confirm reverser system status before further dispatch.
summary: An A319's #1 engine thrust reverser failed to operate after an HCU lockout pin was missed during a valve replacement job disrupted by a gate change.

entities.text: HP and PRV valves were replaced

narrative_text: Kazi ya kubadilisha valve za HP na PRV kwenye engine namba 1 ya ndege ya A319 kwenye gate C20 ilikabidhiwa ikiwa bado inaendelea kutoka shift ya usiku, baada ya ndege kubadilishwa kutoka safari halisi hadi hali ya RON. Engine ilifungwa kisha ikafunguliwa tena kwa sababu ndege ilihitajika kuhamishwa ghafla hadi gate C26, kisha valve za HP na PRV zikabadilishwa na ukaguzi wa uendeshaji ukakamilika kabla ya kufunga engine kwa ajili ya kuwasha. Baada ya ndege kufika ZZZ1, ilibainika kuwa thrust reverser ya engine namba 1 haikufanya kazi, na ikagundulika kuwa HCU ilikuwa imefungwa (locked out) kwa pini bila alama ya utambulisho, hivyo fundi aliyeendeleza kazi hakujua kuhusu hali hiyo. Zamu inayofuata inahitajika kuhakiki utaratibu wa lockout pin na streamer ya HCU, na kuthibitisha hali ya mfumo wa reverser kabla ya ndege kuruhusiwa kuruka tena.
summary: Ndege ya A319 ilipata tatizo la thrust reverser kwenye engine namba 1 baada ya pini ya kufunga HCU kukosa kuonekana wakati wa kazi ya kubadilisha valve iliyokatizwa na mabadiliko ya gate.

entities.text: valve za HP na PRV zikabadilishwa

narrative_text: Ile job ya HP na PRV valve replacement kwa #1 engine ya A319 pale gate C20 nilichukua ikiwa in progress kutoka midnight shift, baada ya flight ku-change from live flight kwenda RON status. Tuli-close engine kisha tuka-reopen tena kwa sababu ndege ilibidi imove ghafla to C26, halafu tuka-replace HP na PRV valves na tuka-complete ops checks kabla ya kufunga engine for run. Baadaye ZZZ1 iligundulika kwamba T/R ya #1 engine haikuwa na reverser operation, na ikaonekana HCU ilikuwa locked out na pin lakini bila streamer, so mimi kama nilikuwa nimeendeleza ile job sikujua kuhusu lockout status hiyo. Next shift wanahitaji ku-verify HCU lockout procedure na streamer, na ku-confirm reverser system status kabla ya dispatch inayofuata.
summary: A319 #1 engine T/R haikuwa na reverser operation baada ya HCU lockout pin kukosa streamer wakati wa valve job iliyodisrupted na gate move.

narrative_text: B737-700 had a right engine EGT exceedance reported by the previous controller, who briefed the operator on required steps before departure. During shift handover the mechanic signed off the item as EGT red box reset with inlet/exhaust inspection, but the aircraft departed before the inspection could be verified against the AMM. Since EGT exceedances are a known chronic issue on this fleet, a log entry has been raised for EEC interrogation and the aircraft is being held at the next station for repair; going forward, any item requiring Maintenance Management follow-up should be locked until concurrence is confirmed.
summary: A B737-700 departed with an unverified right engine EGT exceedance inspection, prompting a follow-up log entry and a decision to hold the aircraft at the next station for repair.

narrative_text: Ndege ya B737-700 ilikuwa na tatizo la joto kupita kiasi (EGT) kwenye injini ya kulia, na kontroller wa awali alikuwa amewaelekeza wahusika hatua zinazotakiwa kabla ya safari. Wakati wa mabadiliko ya shift, fundi aliweka sahihi kwamba EGT ilirudishwa katika hali ya kawaida na ukaguzi wa mlango wa hewa na wa moshi ulifanyika, lakini ndege iliondoka kabla ya ukaguzi huo kuthibitishwa kulingana na taratibu za AMM. Kwa kuwa tatizo hili la EGT ni la kawaida kwenye fleet hii, taarifa imewekwa kwenye logi kuomba ukaguzi wa EEC, na ndege itasimamishwa kituo kinachofuata kwa ajili ya matengenezo; kuanzia sasa, kipengele chochote kinachohitaji uthibitisho wa Usimamizi wa Matengenezo kifungwe hadi idhini itolewe.
summary: Ndege ya B737-700 iliruka huku ukaguzi wa tatizo la EGT kwenye injini ya kulia ukiwa haujathibitishwa, hivyo kusababisha maombi ya ukaguzi zaidi na uamuzi wa kuisimamisha ndege kituo kinachofuata kwa matengenezo.

entities.text: ukaguzi wa mlango wa hewa na wa moshi

narrative_text: Tuli-receive turnover kwamba B737-700 ina right engine EGT exceedance, na controller wa kabla alikuwa ame-brief crew kuhusu steps zinazotakiwa. Kwa hivyo during handover, mechanic ame-sign off item kama EGT red box reset pamoja na inspection ya inlet na exhaust, lakini aircraft ikaondoka kabla inspection kuverify na AMM procedures. Since hii ni chronic issue kwenye fleet, nimeraise log entry ya EEC interrogation na tume-decide kuistop ndege next station kwa repair; going forward, any item inayohitaji Maintenance Management concurrence lazima ilockwe mpaka verification ikamilike.
summary: B737-700 ilidepart na right engine EGT inspection isiyo-verify, hivyo tuka-raise EEC interrogation na kudecide kuistop aircraft next station kwa repair.

narrative_text: During storage prep on the A320, Block 10 of the task card for draining oil from both engines was signed off early to close out the shift, with a write-up left for midnight shift to actually perform the drain per the AMM, including LOTO tagging of the cockpit. Midnight crew completed the draining and the log page was later closed after remaining items were finished. Follow-up needed: confirm both engines and gearboxes are verified empty before any future engine run, and review sign-off practice to prevent premature Block 10 closure ahead of actual task completion.
summary: A320 oil-drain task card was signed off before the drain was actually performed, and both engines were later run dry, requiring review of sign-off timing and LOTO compliance.

entities.text: Block 10 of the task card for draining oil

narrative_text: Wakati wa maandalizi ya kuhifadhi ndege ya A320, Block 10 ya task card ya kutoa mafuta kwenye injini zote mbili ilisainiwa mapema ili kufunga zamu, huku maelezo ya kufanya kazi hiyo halisi yakiachwa kwa zamu ya usiku wa manane kufuata AMM, ikiwemo kuweka tag ya LOTO kwenye cockpit. Zamu ya usiku ilikamilisha kutoa mafuta na logbook ilifungwa baadaye baada ya kazi zilizobaki kukamilika. Inahitajika ufuatiliaji: kuhakikisha injini zote mbili na gearbox zimehakikiwa hazina mafuta kabla ya kuwasha injini tena, na kupitia upya utaratibu wa kusaini ili kuzuia kufunga Block 10 mapema kabla kazi halisi haijafanyika.
summary: Task card ya kutoa mafuta ya injini za A320 ilisainiwa kabla ya kazi kufanyika, na baadaye injini zote mbili ziliwashwa bila mafuta, hivyo inahitaji ukaguzi wa utaratibu wa kusaini na uzingatiaji wa LOTO.

entities.text: Block 10 ya task card ya kutoa mafuta

narrative_text: So kwa storage prep ya hiyo A320, Block 10 ya task card ya kudrain oil kwa engines zote mbili ilisign off mapema kabla kazi haijafanyika, ni kwa sababu ilikuwa late in shift, tukaachia write-up kwa midnight shift wafanye actual draining kufuata AMM, pamoja na ku-tag cockpit per LOTO. Midnight crew walimaliza ile draining na log page ikafungwa baadaye baada ya remaining items kukamilika. Follow-up inahitajika: hakikisha both engines na gearboxes zime-verify hazina oil kabla ya engine run yoyote ijayo, na tuangalie tena utaratibu wa sign-off ili kuzuia kufunga Block 10 mapema before kazi halisi imefanyika.
summary: Task card ya kudrain oil ya A320 ilisainiwa before kazi kufanyika, engines zote mbili zikaend up ku-run bila oil, hivyo inahitaji review ya sign-off procedure na LOTO compliance.

entities.text: Block 10 ya task card ya kudrain oil

narrative_text: Beechjet 400 was placed in wheels-up configuration to troubleshoot an ADS-B fail; both proximity switch arms were disconnected but no streamer/tags were fitted due to a phone interruption with tech support. Verbal turnover to the relieving technicians focused mainly on the ADS-B/GPS antenna issue, with only a brief mention of the disconnected squat switches. Next shift must confirm both proximity switch arms are properly reconnected and streamers procedure followed before further dispatch; aircraft was released after ADS-B fail cleared but squat switch rigging was not independently verified.
summary: Incomplete handover on disconnected squat switch proximity arms during ADS-B troubleshooting on a Beechjet 400 requires follow-up verification before next dispatch.

narrative_text: Ndege ya Beechjet 400 iliwekwa katika hali ya 'wheels up' kwa ajili ya kuchunguza hitilafu ya ADS-B; proximity switch arms mbili zilifunguliwa lakini alama za onyo hazikuwekwa kwa sababu ya kuingiliwa na simu kutoka tech support. Wakati wa kukabidhi kazi kwa mafundi waliopokea zamu, mazungumzo mengi yalielekea kwenye tatizo la ADS-B na antenna ya GPS, huku kutajwa kwa kifupi tu kuhusu squat switches zilizofunguliwa. Zamu inayofuata inapaswa kuthibitisha kuwa proximity switch arms zimeunganishwa vizuri na taratibu za alama za onyo zimezingatiwa kabla ya safari nyingine; ndege ilitolewa baada ya hitilafu ya ADS-B kuisha lakini urekebishaji wa squat switch haukuthibitishwa kwa uhakika.
summary: Kukosekana kwa taarifa kamili wakati wa kukabidhi kazi kuhusu squat switches zilizofunguliwa wakati wa uchunguzi wa ADS-B kwenye Beechjet 400 kunahitaji uthibitisho zaidi kabla ya safari inayofuata.

narrative_text: Beechjet 400 iliwekwa 'wheels up' ili tu-troubleshoot ADS-B fail; nilidisconnect zile proximity switch arms zote mbili lakini sikuweka streamer kwa sababu nilikuwa on the phone na tech support wakati huo. Wakati wa turnover kwa wale technicians walioingia, most ya conversation ilikuwa about ADS-B issue na GPS antenna, squat switches zilitajwa tu kidogo in passing. Next shift wanahitaji kuconfirm zile proximity switch arms zimereconnect properly na streamer procedure imefollowiwa kabla ya dispatch ingine, kwa sababu aircraft ilirelease baada ya ADS-B fail kuclear bila kuverify squat switch rigging.
summary: Kuna gap kwenye turnover kuhusu disconnected squat switches wakati wa ADS-B troubleshooting kwenye Beechjet 400, inahitaji follow-up verification kabla ya dispatch nyingine.

narrative_text: During turnover on the A321, swing shift did not clearly identify which engine had the oil cooler discrepancy versus the other write-up, and the job card/logbook entries did not specify engine numbers either. Based on a verbal gesture from the swing shift mechanic, we assumed the oil cooler leak check was on #2 engine and focused work only on #1 engine issue, leaving #2 engine oil cooler unaddressed; the aircraft later diverted due to loss of oil pressure on #1 engine, confirming the oil cooler was actually on #1 engine. Next shift must ensure job cards and logbook entries always specify engine position, and get direct confirmation from the mechanic who performed each task before signing off.
summary: Poor shift-turnover communication about which engine needed an oil cooler check led to the wrong engine being serviced, resulting in an in-flight oil pressure loss and diversion.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kukabidhiana kazi kwenye ndege ya A321, mfanyakazi wa zamu ya jioni hakuweka wazi ni injini gani ilikuwa na hitilafu ya oil cooler, na kadi ya kazi pamoja na logbook havikutaja nambari ya injini. Kwa sababu ya ishara tu kutoka kwa fundi wa zamu ya jioni, tulidhania ukaguzi wa uvujaji wa oil cooler ulihusu injini namba mbili, hivyo tukashughulikia tu tatizo la injini namba moja na kuacha injini namba mbili bila kuangaliwa; baadaye ndege ililazimika kugeuza njia kutokana na kupungua kwa shinikizo la mafuta kwenye injini namba moja, ikithibitisha kuwa hitilafu ilikuwa injini hiyo hiyo. Zamu inayofuata inapaswa kuhakikisha kadi za kazi na logbook zinaonyesha wazi injini husika, na kupata uthibitisho wa moja kwa moja kutoka kwa fundi aliyefanya kazi husika kabla ya kutia sahihi.
summary: Mawasiliano hafifu wakati wa kukabidhiana zamu kuhusu injini iliyohitaji ukaguzi wa oil cooler yalisababisha injini isiyofaa kuhudumiwa, na hatimaye ndege kupoteza shinikizo la mafuta na kulazimika kugeuza njia.

entities.text: ukaguzi wa uvujaji wa oil cooler

narrative_text: During turnover kwenye A321, swing shift hakuweza ku-clarify vizuri ni engine gani ilikuwa na oil cooler discrepancy, na job card na logbook pia hazikuonyesha engine number. Tulidhania tu, kutokana na ishara ya yule mechanic wa swing shift, kwamba leak check ya oil cooler ilikuwa ni ya #2 engine, so tukafanya focus kwenye #1 engine issue tu na tukaacha #2 engine bila kuangaliwa; ndege ikatoka na baadaye ika-divert kwa sababu ya oil pressure loss kwenye #1 engine, ikathibitisha kuwa oil cooler ndio ilikuwa na tatizo huko. Zamu inayofuata lazima ihakikishe job card na logbook zina-specify engine position wazi, na ku-confirm moja kwa moja na mechanic aliyefanya kazi kabla ya sign-off.
summary: Turnover communication ilikuwa poor kuhusu ni engine gani ilihitaji oil cooler check, hivyo engine isiyo sahihi ikahudumiwa na ndege ika-divert kutokana na oil pressure loss.

narrative_text: Taking over Aircraft X from 2nd shift; APU MEL troubleshooting was done but the #2 tire wear was only mentioned verbally, not logged in the logbook. Workload for the shift includes the Service Check, APU Start MEL, and TAC for the #2 brake, plus an unrecorded VHF #3 inbound write-up that still needs to be relayed. Service Check also turned up NLG tires, glareshield relamping, a broken FA flashlight strap, a torn aft cargo net, and Row 23 sidewall lights needing attention; brake for the TAC is on order from the warehouse, so please follow up on delivery and get help lined up for the brake change before the morning gate call.
summary: Handover flags an unlogged worn #2 tire, pending APU MEL/TAC/brake work, and several Service Check findings that need closing out before the morning gate call.

narrative_text: Tulipokea Aircraft X kutoka zamu ya pili; APU MEL ilikuwa imeangaliwa lakini uharibifu wa tairi namba mbili haukuandikwa kwenye logbook, ulisemwa tu kwa mdomo. Kazi za zamu hii zinahusisha Service Check, APU Start MEL, na TAC ya breki namba mbili, pamoja na taarifa ya VHF namba tatu ambayo haikufikishwa kwa lead wa zamu. Wakati wa Service Check tulikuta pia matairi ya NLG yanahitaji kubadilishwa, taa za glareshield zinahitaji kurekebishwa, ukanda wa tochi wa FA umekatika, wavu wa mizigo nyuma umeraruka, na taa za safu ya 23 zinahitaji kubadilishwa; breki imeagizwa kutoka bohari, kwa hivyo tafadhali fuatilia utoaji wake na uandae msaada wa kubadilisha breki kabla ya gate call ya asubuhi.
summary: Taarifa ya kukabidhi inaonyesha tairi namba mbili lililoharibika lisilo andikwa, kazi za APU MEL/TAC/breki zinazosubiri, na matokeo mengine ya Service Check yanayohitaji kukamilishwa kabla ya gate call ya asubuhi.

narrative_text: Tulichukua Aircraft X kutoka 2nd shift; APU MEL ilikuwa imeshughulikiwa lakini #2 tire ilikuwa worn na hiyo info ilikuja tu kwa mdomo, haikuwekwa kwenye logbook. Workload ya zamu ni Service Check, APU Start MEL, na TAC ya #2 brake, plus kuna VHF #3 inbound write-up ambayo haikupelekwa kwa lead. Wakati wa Service Check tumepata pia NLG tires zimechoka, glareshield lights zinahitaji relamping, FA flashlight strap imekatika, aft cargo net imeraruka, na Row 23 sidewall lights zinahitaji kufanyiwa kazi; brake iko on order kutoka warehouse, so please follow up na uconfirm msaada wa kubadilisha brake kabla ya morning gate call.
summary: Handover inaonyesha #2 tire iliyoharibika bila kulogiwa, plus pending APU MEL/TAC/brake work na Service Check findings zinazohitaji kufungwa kabla ya gate call ya asubuhi.

narrative_text: During #11 slat adjustment, the outboard target on the auxiliary track appeared misaligned with its sensor, so we swapped target positions without confirming against the AMM. Under time pressure to release the aircraft and rushing paperwork before the 2nd shift inspector's stamp, the swap was never documented, and subsequent sensor gap and PSEU/FSEU checks all passed without catching it. Next shift needs to re-verify target installation against the AMM before signing off any further adjustment steps.
summary: An undocumented, unverified target swap during slat adjustment was masked by passing electrical checks and needs re-verification next shift.

narrative_text: Wakati wa marekebisho ya slat namba 11, target ya nje kwenye auxiliary track ilionekana haikupatana vizuri na sensor yake, hivyo tulibadilisha nafasi za target bila kuthibitisha na AMM. Kwa sababu ya shinikizo la muda kutoa ndege na haraka ya kumaliza karatasi kabla mkaguzi wa zamu ya pili hajaondoka, mabadiliko hayo hayakuandikwa popote, na ukaguzi wa umbali wa sensor pamoja na PSEU/FSEU uliofuata ulipita bila kubaini tatizo. Zamu inayofuata inatakiwa kuthibitisha tena usakinishaji wa target kulingana na AMM kabla ya kuendelea na hatua zozote za marekebisho.
summary: Ubadilishaji wa target usioandikwa wakati wa marekebisho ya slat ulifichwa na ukaguzi uliofaulu, hivyo unahitaji kuthibitishwa tena zamu ijayo.

entities.text: ukaguzi wa umbali wa sensor pamoja na PSEU/FSEU

narrative_text: Tulikuwa tuna-adjust #11 slat, tukaona ile outboard target kwa auxiliary track haiko aligned na sensor yake, so tuka-swap positions bila hata ku-verify na AMM kwanza. Tulikuwa under pressure ya kutoa ndege na tuka-rush paperwork ili 2nd shift inspector apate ku-stamp kabla ya kuondoka, so ile swap haikuandikwa mahali popote, na hata sensor gap checks na PSEU/FSEU zote zika-pass bila kucatch tatizo. Zamu inayofuata lazima ita-verify tena target installation na AMM kabla ya kuendelea na adjustment steps zozote.
summary: Kuna target swap ambayo haiku-documented wakati wa slat adjustment, ikafichika kwa checks zilizo-pass, so inahitaji ku-verify tena next shift.

narrative_text: ERJ175 had a repeat write-up for no cool air in the cockpit during cruise, though packs worked fine on ground. CMC interrogation found two active fault codes (21000020AM2 and 21000030AM2) pointing to SPDA 2 Module 26 per the FIM, and there is no MEL deferral covering this fault. Parts were ordered but will not arrive until tomorrow; next shift signed it off as left pack deferred and released the aircraft without checking the FIM or fault codes, so this needs to be re-evaluated as non-deferrable before further flight.
summary: An ERJ175 with a non-deferrable SPDA 2 Module 26 fault was incorrectly released using a left pack deferral, requiring follow-up before next flight.

narrative_text: Ndege ya ERJ175 ina malalamiko ya kurudia kuhusu hewa baridi kutopatikana chumbani kwa marubani wakati wa safari, ingawa mifumo ya packs ilifanya kazi vizuri chini. Baada ya kuangalia kompyuta ya matengenezo, tulipata makosa mawili yanayoendelea, 21000020AM2 na 21000030AM2, yanayoonyesha tatizo kwenye SPDA 2 Module 26 kulingana na mwongozo wa FIM, na hakuna ruhusa ya kuahirisha kazi hiyo kwenye orodha ya MEL. Vipuri vimeagizwa lakini havitafika hadi kesho asubuhi; hata hivyo zamu iliyofuata iliruhusu ndege kuruka ikiwa imeandikwa kuwa pack ya kushoto imeahirishwa bila kuangalia FIM wala makosa yaliyopo. Jambo hili linahitaji kufuatiliwa haraka kwani tatizo si la kuahirishwa.
summary: Ndege ya ERJ175 iliruhusiwa kuruka kimakosa kwa tatizo la SPDA 2 Module 26 lililoandikwa kama tatizo la pack pekee, jambo linalohitaji ufuatiliaji wa haraka.

narrative_text: Kuna ERJ175 ina repeat write-up ya cool air kutokuwepo cockpit wakati wa cruise, ingawa packs zinafanya kazi poa ground. Nili-interrogate CMC nikapata two active faults, 21000020AM2 na 21000030AM2, zikielekeza SPDA 2 Module 26 kwa mujibu wa FIM, na hakuna MEL deferral ya hiyo item. Parts zimeagizwa lakini zitafika kesho asubuhi tu; but shift iliyofuata wa-sign off kama left pack deferred wakaruhusu ndege iruke bila hata ku-check FIM wala fault codes. Hii inahitaji kufuatiliwa fast kwa sababu tatizo si la ku-defer, ni non-deferrable kabisa.
summary: ERJ175 ilipewa green light kimakosa ikiwa na SPDA 2 Module 26 fault iliyowekwa kama pack deferral, inahitaji follow-up haraka.

narrative_text: Aircraft X came in with a potable water system inop write-up; troubleshooting started on first shift and continued into second shift, with parts changed and panels removed. No written turnover or Form 10194 was left for third shift, only a verbal handover, so we had no clear picture of what work was actually completed. Supervisor was notified immediately, and during the RON check we found multiple cargo panels still open confirming undocumented work had been done. Leads and crew chiefs must ensure all turnover is logged per company policy before shift change.
summary: Undocumented multi-shift troubleshooting on Aircraft X's potable water system left the incoming crew without a proper turnover, exposing a procedural gap in shift handover documentation.

narrative_text: Ndege Aircraft X ilikuwa na hitilafu ya mfumo wa maji safi (potable water) ambayo ilianza kufanyiwa kazi shift ya kwanza na kuendelea shift ya pili, huku baadhi ya vipuri vikibadilishwa na paneli kadhaa kutolewa. Cha kusikitisha, hakuna turnover iliyoandikwa wala Form 10194 iliyowekwa kwa shift ya tatu, ni maelezo ya mdomo tu yaliyotolewa, hivyo hatukuwa na uhakika wa kazi iliyofanyika. Supervisor alijulishwa mara moja, na wakati wa ukaguzi wa RON tulikuta paneli nyingi za mizigo bado wazi, ikithibitisha kazi ilifanyika bila kuandikwa. Ni muhimu viongozi wa shift na crew chiefs wahakikishe kila turnover inaandikwa kama sera ya kampuni inavyotaka.
summary: Kazi ya kutafuta hitilafu ya mfumo wa maji safi kwenye Aircraft X ilifanyika kwa shift mbili bila kuandikwa vizuri, na hivyo kusababisha mkanganyiko wakati wa mabadiliko ya shift.

narrative_text: Aircraft X ilikuwa na write-up ya potable water system inop, troubleshooting ilistart shift ya kwanza na ika-continue mpaka second shift, parts zikabadilishwa na panels zingine zikatolewa. Lakini turnover ya written haikuwepo, hata Form 10194 haikuwekwa kwa third shift, tulipewa verbal turnover tu, so hatukuwa na clear picture ya kazi iliyofanyika. Nikamjulisha supervisor immediately, na tukienda kwa RON check tukakuta cargo panels kadhaa zikiwa bado open, ikiconfirm kwamba kazi ilikuwa inafanyika without proper documentation. Leads na crew chiefs wanahitaji kuensure turnover zote zinadocumented as per company policy kabla ya shift change.
summary: Kuna troubleshooting ya potable water system kwenye Aircraft X iliyofanyika kwa shifts mbili bila proper documentation, causing confusion wakati wa handover.

narrative_text: After completing the aircraft job, we separated our three tool containers (SLI labels attached, no HAZMAT) from three HAZMAT-labeled hard cases on the baggage cart and briefed the escort that only the tooling boxes should go out on the first ZZZ1 flight, with the HAZMAT cases routed through the freight house. She was told to leave the cart in place and to pass on a turnover note if she wasn't available in the morning, but I did not manage to hand her a copy of step 3A after Maintenance Control confirmed receipt of all documents. Next shift needs to verify the HAZMAT cases were never loaded with our tooling and confirm the missing paperwork copy is closed out with Maintenance Control.
summary: Tooling and HAZMAT containers were segregated and briefed to the escort before the ZZZ1 flight, but a paperwork copy (step 3A) was not handed over, requiring follow-up confirmation.

narrative_text: Baada ya kumaliza kazi kwenye ndege, tulitenganisha masanduku matatu ya zana zetu (yenye lebo za SLI, bila HAZMAT) na masanduku matatu magumu yenye lebo za HAZMAT kwenye gari la mizigo, na tukamweleza msindikizaji kuwa masanduku ya zana pekee ndiyo yatakayosafirishwa kwenye ndege ya kwanza ya ZZZ1, huku masanduku ya HAZMAT yakipitishwa kupitia idara ya mizigo. Aliambiwa aache gari mahali pale pale na aandike taarifa ya makabidhiano kama hatakuwepo asubuhi, lakini sikufanikiwa kumpa nakala ya hatua ya 3A baada ya Udhibiti wa Matengenezo kuthibitisha kupokea nyaraka zote. Zamu inayofuata inahitaji kuhakikisha masanduku ya HAZMAT hayakupakiwa pamoja na zana zetu, na kufuatilia nakala ya nyaraka iliyokosekana na Udhibiti wa Matengenezo.
summary: Zana na masanduku ya HAZMAT yalitenganishwa na kuelezwa kwa msindikizaji kabla ya ndege ya ZZZ1, lakini nakala ya nyaraka (hatua ya 3A) haikukabidhiwa, hivyo inahitaji ufuatiliaji.

entities.text: masanduku magumu yenye lebo za HAZMAT

narrative_text: Baada ya kumaliza job kwa aircraft, tuli-separate zile tool containers tatu zenye SLI labels, no HAZMAT, na zile hard cases tatu za HAZMAT kwa baggage cart, tukamwambia escort ati boxes za tooling ndizo zitaenda na first ZZZ1 flight tu, na hizo HAZMAT ziende through freight house. Tulimwambia aache cart pale pale na aweke turnover note kama hatakuwa available asubuhi, lakini sikufanikiwa kumpea copy ya step 3A baada ya Maintenance Control ku-confirm wamepokea documents zote. Next shift wahakikishe hizo HAZMAT hazikuenda na tooling yetu, na wa-follow up hiyo missing paperwork na Maintenance Control.
summary: Tooling na HAZMAT containers zili-separate na kuelezwa kwa escort kabla ya ZZZ1 flight, lakini copy ya step 3A haikupewa, so inahitaji follow-up.

narrative_text: Midnight shift completed IDG installation on the A319 in Bay 2; crew chief assisted after initial difficulty seating the IDG onto the gearbox, which required repositioning the quad ring. Two engine runs and a leak check were performed with no leaks noted, and post-taxi walkaround was also clean. Flight crew later reported oil loss from the gearbox pad cover, which was apparently left off during the install and not caught by anyone on the team. Next shift please verify pad cover installation procedures and inspect similar installs for the same oversight.
summary: IDG installation on an A319 passed ground checks but the gearbox pad cover was left off, causing in-flight oil loss and requiring follow-up review.

narrative_text: Katika shift ya usiku, timu ilikamilisha ufungaji wa IDG kwenye ndege ya A319 pale Bay 2, ambapo crew chief alisaidia baada ya changamoto za kuweka IDG kwenye gearbox na kubidi kuhamisha quad ring. Baada ya ufungaji, injini ilijaribiwa mara mbili na ukaguzi wa uvujaji ulifanyika, hakuna uvujaji ulioonekana wakati huo wala baada ya kusogeza ndege gate. Baadaye ilijulikana kuwa gearbox pad cover haikuwekwa, hali iliyosababisha upotevu wa mafuta wakati wa safari. Shift inayofuata inahitaji kuhakiki taratibu za ufungaji wa pad cover na kukagua kazi nyingine zinazofanana kuepuka kosa hilo tena.
summary: Ufungaji wa IDG kwenye A319 ulionekana sawa kwenye ukaguzi wa ardhini, lakini gearbox pad cover ilisahaulika na kusababisha upotevu wa mafuta angani, hivyo inahitaji ufuatiliaji.

narrative_text: So during midnight shift tulikuwa assigned kufunga IDG kwenye A319 pale Bay 2, ikawa ngumu kidogo kuiweka onto the gearbox mpaka crew chief akaja kutusaidia, tukashift quad ring ndio ikakubali kumount. Baada ya installation tuka-push aircraft, tukafanya engine runs mbili plus leak check, hakuna leaks zilizoonekana, even post-taxi walkaround ilikuwa clean. Lakini baadaye tukajulishwa kuna oil loss during flight coming from the gearbox pad cover ambayo ilikuwa haijawekwa, na hakuna hata mmoja aliye-notice wala kutuinform ilitolewa. Next shift please recheck installation procedure ya pad cover na verify similar jobs ili tuepuke hii kosa tena.
summary: IDG installation kwenye A319 ilipita ground checks lakini gearbox pad cover ilisahaulika, causing oil loss mid-flight, hivyo inahitaji follow-up review.

narrative_text: THSA was replaced after failing the oil inspection for a leak, but operational checks have failed repeatedly across multiple shifts, with position transducer suspected faulty. 1st shift signed off the non-routine without addressing the no-fix statement, and the stab control wheel still does not return to zero after the 13.5 up position/SEC 1 reset check. Aircraft was pulled back to the hangar from the gate and management was notified, but it was never formally removed from service. Next shift: assign a different mechanic and inspector to rerun the full ops check per the THSA replacement job card before further dispatch.
summary: THSA operational checks continue to fail across shifts with an unresolved no-fix statement, requiring an independent recheck before the aircraft can be returned to service.

narrative_text: THSA ilibadilishwa baada ya kukosa ukaguzi wa mafuta kwa sababu ya uvujaji, lakini ukaguzi wa uendeshaji umeendelea kushindwa kupitia zamu kadhaa, na inashukiwa kuwa position transducer ndiyo ina hitilafu. Zamu ya kwanza ilisaini non-routine bila kushughulikia taarifa ya kutopatikana kwa suluhu, na stab control wheel bado haichukui sifuri baada ya kuwekwa 13.5 up na SEC 1 kurudishwa upya. Ndege ilirudishwa hangar kutoka kwenye gate na uongozi ulijulishwa, lakini haijawahi kuondolewa rasmi kwenye huduma. Zamu inayofuata: mpangie fundi na inspector wengine tofauti wafanye tena ukaguzi kamili wa uendeshaji kulingana na job card ya kubadilisha THSA kabla ya kuruhusu ndege kuruka.
summary: Ukaguzi wa uendeshaji wa THSA umeendelea kushindwa kupitia zamu tofauti bila suluhu iliyothibitishwa, hivyo inahitajika ukaguzi mpya na wafanyakazi tofauti kabla ndege haijarudishwa kwenye huduma.

narrative_text: So THSA ilibadilishwa after ilifail oil inspection due to leak, lakini ops checks zimeendelea kufail through zamu nyingi, na wanasuspect position transducer ndio ina fault. 1st shift walisign off ile non-routine bila kuaddress ile no-fix statement, na stab control wheel bado haireturn kwa zero after kuwekwa 13.5 up position na SEC 1 kufanyiwa reset. Ndege ilirudishwa hangar kutoka gate na management walinotified, lakini haijawahi kuremove from service rasmi. Kwa next shift: pata mechanic na inspector wengine different warerun ile full ops check kulingana na THSA replacement job card kabla ya kuidispatch tena.
summary: Ops checks za THSA zimeendelea kufail across shifts na no-fix statement bado haijaaddressed, kwa hivyo inahitajika independent recheck kabla ndege haijarudi kwa service.

narrative_text: During overnight borescope inspection on #2 engine, 3rd shift completed the job and reinstalled all borescope plugs and igniters that were bagged and tagged by 2nd shift. One plug near the 10 o'clock position, at eye level, was not bagged or tagged and was missed during reinstallation since it was not verified against the job card which ports 2nd shift had actually removed. Next shift/QA needs to confirm all borescope plugs on #2 engine are accounted for and installed before further engine run or dispatch. Recommend job card be updated to require streamers/tags on all removed plugs and improved shift-to-shift verification at the aircraft.
summary: A borescope plug on #2 engine was left uninstalled overnight because it was not tagged like the others, and the outgoing shift did not verify all removed ports against the job card.

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa borescope kwenye injini namba 2 usiku, zamu ya tatu ilimaliza kazi na kurudisha plugs na igniters zote zilizowekwa kwenye mfuko na lebo na zamu ya pili. Plug moja karibu na nafasi ya saa kumi, iliyokuwa karibu na usawa wa jicho, haikuwa na mfuko wala lebo hivyo ikasahaulika kurudishwa kwa sababu hatukuthibitisha kwenye job card ni ports zipi hasa zilizotolewa na zamu iliyotangulia. Zamu inayofuata na idara ya ubora wanahitajika kuhakikisha plugs zote za borescope kwenye injini namba 2 zimewekwa vizuri kabla ya kuendesha injini au ndege kutumika tena. Pia inashauriwa job card iongezwe kipengele cha kuweka alama au vitambulisho vinavyoonekana wazi kwenye plugs zote zinazotolewa, na mawasiliano kati ya zamu ziboreshwe kwenye ndege.
summary: Plug moja ya borescope kwenye injini namba 2 ilisahaulika kurudishwa usiku kwa sababu haikuwa na lebo kama zingine, na zamu iliyoondoka haikuthibitisha ports zote zilizotolewa dhidi ya job card.

narrative_text: Jana usiku tulikuwa tunafanya borescope inspection kwenye #2 engine, na 3rd shift ndio walimaliza job baada ya 2nd shift kuanza na ku-remove borescope ports. Tulirudisha plugs na igniters zote zilizokuwa bagged and tagged, lakini kuna plug moja karibu na 10 o'clock position, level na jicho, ambayo haikuwa na bag wala tag so tukaikosa kabisa. Tatizo ni kwamba hatukuverify na job card ports zipi hasa zilizokuwa removed na previous shift, tulitegemea tu zile zilizokuwa bagged. Next shift na QA wanahitaji ku-confirm plugs zote za #2 engine ziko installed kabla ya engine run, na tunapendekeza job card iwe na streamers kwa hardware zote plus overlap nzuri zaidi kati ya shifts.
summary: Plug moja ya borescope kwenye #2 engine ilikosekana kuinstall kwa sababu haikuwa tagged, na kulikuwa na communication breakdown kati ya shifts kuhusu ports zilizo removed.

narrative_text: Aircraft X was in overnight for A-Check items including a tow collar replacement and dual engine leak checks; I assumed the tow collar job was closed out since I saw techs working on it that morning, but the paperwork turnover was unclear. Under pressure to release the aircraft on schedule, I signed the Airworthiness Release after checking the Company Form and AML, but a Non-Routine Work Card was missed in the handover. The aircraft completed 6 legs before an air return occurred. Follow-up needed: tighten shift turnover communication and slow down paperwork verification during A-Check sign-offs.
summary: A rushed, unclear shift handover on an A-Check led to a missed non-routine work card and an Airworthiness Release sign-off error, resulting in an air return after six legs.

narrative_text: Ndege X ilikuwa imeshikiliwa usiku kwa ukaguzi wa A-Check, ikiwemo kubadilisha tow collar na kufanya leak checks za engine mbili; nilidhani kazi ya tow collar ilikuwa imekamilika kwani niliwaona mafundi wa zamu ya usiku wakiifanyia kazi asubuhi. Kutokana na shinikizo la wakati kuirudisha ndege ratiba, nilisaini Airworthiness Release baada ya kuangalia Company Form na AML, lakini kadi moja ya Non-Routine Work ilikosekana wakati wa kukabidhi kazi. Ndege ilifanya safari sita kabla ya kurudi ghafla angani kwa tatizo. Inahitajika kuboresha mawasiliano ya zamu na kutochelewa wakati wa kuthibitisha nyaraka za A-Check.
summary: Mawasiliano hafifu ya kukabidhi kazi kati ya zamu wakati wa A-Check yalisababisha kukosekana kwa kadi ya Non-Routine Work na hitilafu katika kusaini Airworthiness Release, hivyo kupelekea ndege kurudi baada ya safari sita.

narrative_text: Aircraft X ilikuwa overnight kwa A-Check, tulikuwa na tow collar replacement na leak checks za engines mbili; nikiona technicians wa night shift wanafanyia kazi tow collar asubuhi, nikadhani job ilikuwa complete lakini turnover haikuwa clear. Kwa sababu ya time pressure ya kuirudisha aircraft on schedule, nilisign Airworthiness Release baada ya kucheck Company Form na AML, lakini kuna Non-Routine Work Card ilikosekana kwenye handover. Ndege ikafanya six legs kabla air return ikitokea. Tunahitaji kuboresha communication wakati wa shift turnover na kuslow down kwenye paperwork verification ya A-Check sign-off.
summary: Turnover isiyo clear na time pressure wakati wa A-Check ziliweza kufanya Non-Routine Work Card ikosekane, na hii ikapelekea air return baada ya six legs.

narrative_text: Aircraft X MLG bay OVHT caution MEL troubleshooting: wheel bay loops checked good, Gear OVHT Controller replaced and functional tested, but OVHT warning indication on the landing gear panel in the center pedestal still not working. Per acting supervisor's instruction, panel was swapped with Aircraft Y for test purposes and then reinstalled on original aircraft when it did not resolve the fault. Note for next shift: the panel swap was not logged and QC flagged that a writeup plus RII landing gear operations test is required on both aircraft; this has since been corrected but please confirm paperwork is fully closed before further work.
summary: Aircraft X MLG OVHT MEL troubleshooting led to an undocumented panel swap with Aircraft Y that QC caught, requiring writeups and an RII ops test on both jets before further action.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kutatua tatizo la MLG bay OVHT caution MEL kwenye Aircraft X, loops za wheel bay zilikaguliwa na kuonekana ziko sawa, Gear OVHT Controller ikabadilishwa na kufanyiwa functional test, lakini onyo la OVHT kwenye landing gear panel eneo la center pedestal bado halifanyi kazi. Kwa maelekezo ya supervisor wa zamu, panel ilibadilishwa na ile ya Aircraft Y kwa majaribio, na baadaye kurudishwa kwa ndege yake asili kwa kuwa haikutatua tatizo. Kumbuka kwa zamu inayokuja: mabadiliko ya panel hayakuandikwa kwenye logbook, na QC waligundua kasoro hii wakitaka maandishi rasmi pamoja na RII landing gear operations test kwa ndege zote mbili; hili tayari limerekebishwa lakini tafadhali thibitisha karatasi zote zimekamilika kabla ya kazi zaidi.
summary: Utatuzi wa tatizo la OVHT kwenye Aircraft X ulipelekea kubadilishana panel na Aircraft Y bila kuandikwa, hali iliyogunduliwa na QC na kuhitaji maandishi na RII test kwa ndege zote mbili.

narrative_text: Tulikuwa tuna-troubleshoot ile MLG bay OVHT caution MEL kwa Aircraft X; loops za wheel bay zilikuwa fine, tukachange Gear OVHT Controller na kufanya functional test, lakini ile OVHT warning kwenye landing gear panel pale center pedestal bado haiwork. Supervisor akatuambia tuswap panel na ile ya Aircraft Y kwa testing, lakini haikufix issue so tukairudisha kwenye ndege yake original. Heads up kwa next shift: ile panel swap hatukuwrite up, na QC alitupata tukiwa turnover, akasema tunahitaji writeup plus RII landing gear operations test kwa ndege zote mbili — tumeshacorrect sasa lakini confirm paperwork imekamilika kabla ya kuendelea na kazi.
summary: Troubleshooting ya OVHT MEL kwenye Aircraft X ilisababisha panel swap na Aircraft Y ambayo haikuwritten up, QC akaigundua na sasa inahitaji writeup na RII test kwa ndege zote mbili.

narrative_text: MEL 78-XX deferral is open on the B737-800 for Eng #1 thrust reverser actuators; only the upper left outboard sleeve actuator was worked on this shift, using the job card, while the MEL was updated to reflect both actuators still requiring replacement. The new actuator was only partially installed by end of shift, and the monitor deferral sheets were mistakenly tagged to the component instead of the airframe, so this needs correction. Next shift lead must confirm actuator installation is completed and verify the deferral paperwork/monitors are properly linked to the aircraft before close-out.
summary: Overnight actuator replacement on Eng #1 thrust reverser was left partially complete with deferral/monitor paperwork errors requiring next-shift follow-up.

narrative_text: Kazi ya kubadilisha actuator ya thrust reverser ya Eng #1 kwenye ndege ya B737-800 haikukamilika usiku huu; actuator ya juu kushoto tu ndiyo iliyofanyiwa kazi kwa kutumia job card, ilhali MEL ilisemwa kuwa actuator zote mbili zinahitaji kubadilishwa. Karatasi za ufuatiliaji (monitor deferral sheets) zilibandikwa kimakosa kwenye kipengele badala ya ndege yenyewe, jambo linalohitaji kurekebishwa kabla ya kufunga kazi hii. Zamu inayokuja inatakiwa kuthibitisha usanikishaji wa actuator umekamilika na kuhakikisha nyaraka za MEL zimewekwa sawa.
summary: Ubadilishaji wa actuator ya thrust reverser ya Eng #1 haukukamilika usiku huu na kuna makosa ya nyaraka za MEL yanayohitaji kufuatiliwa na zamu inayokuja.

narrative_text: Kwa hii B737-800, MEL 78-XX deferral bado iko open kwa Eng #1 thrust reverser actuators; tulifanya replacement ya upper left outboard sleeve actuator tu kwa kutumia job card, but MEL bado inaonyesha actuators zote mbili zinahitaji replacement. By end of shift, installation ya actuator mpya ilikua only partial, na monitor deferral sheets zilikua zimeattachiwa kwa component instead of airframe, so hiyo inahitaji kufixiwa. Next shift wanafaa waverify kama installation imecomplete na wacheck MEL paperwork iko sawa before close-out.
summary: Overnight, actuator replacement ya Eng #1 thrust reverser ilikua partial na kuna paperwork issue ya MEL deferral inayohitaji follow-up na next shift.

narrative_text: Aircraft remains out of service for the fumes-odor decontamination job; multiple job card duplicates were circulating unstamped, causing confusion between shifts on what had actually been completed. After an initial Phase 1 decontam was signed off, engine runs revealed fumes were still present, so we restarted and completed a full Phase 2 decontamination, stamping each step as done. Please verify only the correct, final work cards were turned in this morning, as some duplicate/incomplete cards were mistakenly left in the office and may need to be pulled and discarded.
summary: Aircraft remained out of service after a Phase 2 fume decontamination was completed following card-duplication and turnover confusion, and the correct paperwork needs verification.

narrative_text: Ndege bado iko nje ya huduma kwa ajili ya kazi ya kuondoa harufu ya moshi ndani ya ndege; kulikuwa na nakala nyingi za jobcard bila muhuri, jambo lililosababisha mkanganyiko kati ya zamu kuhusu kazi iliyokwisha kufanyika. Baada ya Phase 1 ya usafishaji kukamilika na kusainiwa, tulipofanya majaribio ya injini tuligundua harufu bado ipo, hivyo tulianza upya na kukamilisha Phase 2 kikamilifu, tukipiga muhuri kila hatua ilipokamilika. Tafadhali hakikisheni jobcards sahihi tu ndizo zilizokabidhiwa asubuhi hii, kwa sababu baadhi ya nakala za ziada zisizo kamili ziliachwa ofisini kimakosa na huenda zikahitaji kuondolewa.
summary: Ndege ilibaki nje ya huduma baada ya usafishaji wa Phase 2 wa harufu ya moshi kukamilika kufuatia mkanganyiko wa nakala za jobcard, na hati sahihi zinahitaji kuthibitishwa.

entities.text: kazi ya kuondoa harufu ya moshi

narrative_text: Ile aircraft bado iko out of service kwa ile SOF (smell of fumes) decontam job; kulikuwa na duplicate jobcards nyingi zikizunguka bila kustampiwa, so kuli-cause confusion kati ya shifts kuhusu nini kimeshamalizika. Tulisign off Phase 1 decontam mapema, lakini tulipofanya engine runs tukanuka fumes bado, so tulianza upya tukafanya full Phase 2 mpaka tukakamilisha, kila step ikistampiwa as we went. Tafadhali verify ni zile correct final work cards ndizo zilizo-turn in asubuhi hii, coz kuna zile duplicate/incomplete cards ziliachwa ofisini by mistake na labda zinahitaji ku-discard.
summary: Aircraft ilibaki out of service after Phase 2 fume decontam ilikamilika following jobcard confusion, na paperwork sahihi inahitaji kucheckwa.

narrative_text: B767 arrived with a pilot writeup for #1 engine reverse thrust and MEL XX-XX-X was started per turnover. The MEL calls for an electrical cap part number that has never been stocked or procured, and Engineering declined to issue relief since they cannot deviate from the MEL. Separately the cord manufacturer part number in the MEL does not cross-reference correctly to the M/E part number, and the correct number appears to be a one-digit typo away, so it is unclear whether the card is wrong or the part simply cannot be sourced. Additional discrepancies (helicoil damage, incorrect T-R sleeve markings) were found and logged; next shift needs to follow up with Engineering on the part number conflict before continuing the MEL procedure.
summary: Technician could not complete MEL procedure for #1 engine reverse thrust on a B767 due to unresolved part-number discrepancies and needs Engineering follow-up.

narrative_text: Ndege ya B767 ilifika ikiwa na ripoti ya rubani kuhusu reverse thrust ya injini namba moja, na utaratibu wa MEL XX-XX-X ulianzishwa kulingana na turnover. Hata hivyo, namba ya sehemu ya electrical cap inayotakiwa na MEL haijawahi kununuliwa wala kuhifadhiwa stoo, na idara ya Uhandisi imekataa kutoa ruhusa ya kubadilisha kwa kuwa hawawezi kukiuka maelekezo ya MEL. Zaidi ya hayo, namba ya sehemu ya cord kutoka kwa mtengenezaji haiendani kabisa na namba sahihi ya M/E, ikionekana kama kuna kosa la kuandika tarakimu moja, hivyo bado haijulikani kama ni hitilafu ya karatasi ya MEL au tatizo la upatikanaji wa sehemu hiyo. Pia kulibainika matatizo mengine kama uharibifu wa helicoil na alama zisizo sahihi kwenye T-R sleeve, hivyo zamu inayofuata inapaswa kufuatilia na Uhandisi kabla ya kuendelea na kazi hii.
summary: Fundi hakuweza kukamilisha utaratibu wa MEL kwa reverse thrust ya injini namba moja ya B767 kutokana na mkanganyiko wa namba za sehemu, hivyo inahitajika ufuatiliaji na idara ya Uhandisi.

entities.text: reverse thrust ya injini namba moja

narrative_text: Aircraft B767 ilikuja na pilot report kuhusu #1 engine reverse thrust, tukaanza MEL XX-XX-X kama tulivyopewa turnover. Tatizo ni kwamba ile electrical cap part number iliyo listed kwenye MEL haijawahi kununuliwa wala ku-stock, na Engineering wamekataa kutoa relief kwa sababu hawawezi ku-deviate MEL bila EO. Pia kuna hii cord part number ambayo haiendani vizuri na M/E number, inaonekana kama typo ya digit moja tu, so hatujui kama ni MEL error au part haiwezi kupatikana kabisa. Kuna pia issues zingine kama helicoil damage na wrong markings kwenye T-R sleeve, so next shift wafuatilie na Engineering before ku-proceed na hii MEL procedure.
summary: Fundi ame-struggle ku-comply na MEL procedure ya #1 engine reverse thrust kwenye B767 kwa sababu ya part number discrepancies, so inahitajika follow-up na Engineering.

narrative_text: B737 left inboard fuel tank access plate was reworked for a leak; old gasket and cracked sealant were replaced and leak check passed after fuel transfer. Aircraft returned with the same leak - turns out the plate installed at the opening does not match the correct plate number for that cavity, and the door key index was deformed so the mismatch was not obvious on fit-check. Next shift please verify plate part numbers against the AMM diagram (not just hole/cavity match) on both wings, as the two innermost plates on the opposite wing show the same mix-up.
summary: Mismatched fuel tank access plates on a B737 caused a repeat leak after gasket replacement, requiring plate part-number verification on both wings.

entities.text: left inboard fuel tank access plate
verify plate part numbers against the AMM diagram

narrative_text: Bamba la ufikiaji la tangi la mafuta upande wa ndani wa mrengo wa kushoto kwenye ndege ya B737 lilirekebishwa kwa sababu ya kuvuja; gasket ya zamani na sealant iliyopasuka ziliondolewa na ukaguzi wa kuvuja ulipita baada ya mafuta kuhamishwa. Ndege ilirudi ikiwa na tatizo lilelile - ikagundulika kuwa bamba lililowekwa halikufanana na namba sahihi ya bamba la eneo hilo, na alama ya ufunguo wa mlango ilikuwa imeharibika hivyo hitilafu hiyo haikuonekana wazi wakati wa ufungaji. Zamu inayofuata itafute kuthibitisha namba za mabamba kulingana na mchoro wa AMM (si tu kufanana kwa shimo) kwenye mabawa yote mawili, kwani mabamba mawili ya ndani kabisa upande wa mrengo mwingine yana tatizo lilelile.
summary: Mabamba ya tangi la mafuta yaliyochanganywa kwenye ndege ya B737 yalisababisha uvujaji kurudia baada ya kubadilishwa kwa gasket, hivyo inahitajika uthibitisho wa namba za mabamba kwenye mabawa yote mawili.

entities.text: Bamba la ufikiaji la tangi la mafuta
kuthibitisha namba za mabamba kulingana na mchoro wa AMM

narrative_text: Kwenye hii B737, tulifanya rework ya ile left inboard fuel tank access plate kwa sababu ilikuwa inaleak; ile gasket ya zamani na cracked sealant tuliziremove, tukafanya leak check ikapass baada ya fuel transfer. Lakini aircraft imerudi na same issue - ikaonekana ile plate iliyowekwa haimatch na correct part number ya ile cavity, na ile door key index ilikuwa deformed so mismatch haikuwa obvious wakati wa fit-check. Next shift wasaidie ku-verify plate part numbers against the AMM diagram (si tu hole match) kwa mabawa yote mawili, kwa sababu even zile innermost plates upande mwingine zina tatizo kama hilo.
summary: Mabamba ya fuel tank ya B737 yalikuwa swapped na kusababisha leak kurudia, hivyo next shift wana-verify plate part numbers kwenye mabawa yote mawili.
