narrative_text: During the parking-program walk-around on the out-of-service aircraft, several discrepancies were found after more than 5 days on the ground: nose tire worn beyond limits, hydraulic leak at the steering actuator, hydraulic system B pressure module leak in the main wheel well, a dent near the trailing edge of the inboard flap, and a chafed hydraulic line at the main gear shimmy damper caused by a nearby flexible line. Crew chief has flagged that management is questioning why these were only found now; next shift should verify all findings are logged and follow up on required repairs before further work continues.
summary: Multiple discrepancies (tire, hydraulic leaks, flap dent, chafed line) found on out-of-service aircraft during walk-around, pending management follow-up.

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa zunguko kwenye ndege iliyokuwa nje ya huduma, hitilafu kadhaa ziligundulika baada ya ndege kukaa chini kwa zaidi ya siku tano: tairi la mbele lilikuwa limechakaa kupita kiwango, kulikuwa na uvujaji wa maji ya haidroliki kwenye actuator ya usukani, uvujaji mwingine kwenye moduli ya shinikizo ya mfumo B wa haidroliki eneo la gurudumu kuu, bapa la ndani la flap lilikuwa na bonge karibu na ukingo wa nyuma, na bomba la haidroliki la kiondoa mtikisiko wa gurudumu kuu lilikuwa limechubuka kwa sababu ya bomba jingine laini lililokuwa karibu nalo. Kiongozi wa zamu ametaarifu kuwa uongozi unahoji kwa nini hitilafu hizi hazikugunduliwa mapema; zamu inayofuata inapaswa kuhakikisha hitilafu zote zimeandikwa vizuri na kufuatilia marekebisho yanayohitajika kabla ya kazi kuendelea.
summary: Hitilafu kadhaa (tairi, uvujaji wa haidroliki, bonge la flap, bomba lililochubuka) zilipatikana kwenye ndege iliyokuwa nje ya huduma wakati wa ukaguzi, hatua zaidi zinasubiriwa kutoka kwa uongozi.

entities.text: moduli ya shinikizo ya mfumo B wa haidroliki

narrative_text: Wakati wa walk-around ya parking program kwenye aircraft iliyo out of service, tumepata discrepancies kadhaa baada ya ndege kukaa ground kwa zaidi ya siku tano: nose tire imechakaa beyond limits, kuna hydraulic leak kwenye steering actuator, pia leak kwenye hydraulic system B pressure module karibu na main wheel well, kuna dent karibu na trailing edge ya inboard flap, na hydraulic line ya main gear shimmy damper ime-chafe kwa sababu ya flexible line iliyokuwa imewekwa karibu nayo. Crew chief ame-flag kwamba management wanauliza kwa nini haya yamegunduliwa sasa hivi tu; next shift wahakikishe findings zote zime-log vizuri na wafuatilie repairs zinazohitajika kabla ya kazi kuendelea.
summary: Discrepancies kadhaa (tire, hydraulic leaks, flap dent, chafed line) zimepatikana kwenye aircraft out of service wakati wa walk-around, follow-up inahitajika kutoka management.

narrative_text: During overnight service check handover, Crew Chief signed off the Airworthiness Release and closed the remaining blocks on the logbook without properly verifying two deferral entries. The LH Pack Flow Control Valve deferral sheet number was left off the compliance page, and the flashlight/cradle deferral code block was found blank and had to be reconstructed from the job card tally before release. Next shift must double-check all deferral sheet cross-references against job card entries before signing any Airworthiness Release, as the earlier gap caused confusion for the outbound Captain and a 95-minute departure delay.
summary: Incomplete deferral entries on the logbook during shift handover led to an improperly signed Airworthiness Release and a 95-minute flight delay.

narrative_text: Wakati wa mkabidhiano wa zamu ya usiku kwenye ukaguzi wa ndege, Fundi Mkuu alisaini Airworthiness Release na kufunga sehemu zilizobaki za logbook bila kuthibitisha vizuri maingizo mawili ya kuahirisha kazi. Namba ya karatasi ya kuahirisha kazi ya LH Pack Flow Control Valve haikuandikwa kwenye ukurasa wa uzingatiaji, na sehemu ya msimbo wa kuahirisha ya flashlight na kishikilizi (cradle) ilikutwa tupu, hivyo ikabidi kutafutwa tena kwa kutumia rekodi za job card kabla ya ndege kuruhusiwa kuruka. Zamu inayofuata inatakiwa kuhakiki kwa makini maingizo yote ya kuahirisha kazi dhidi ya job card kabla ya kusaini Airworthiness Release yoyote, kwani pengo hili lilisababisha mkanganyiko kwa Kapteni wa safari na kuchelewa kwa dakika 95.
summary: Maingizo yasiyokamilika ya kuahirisha kazi kwenye logbook wakati wa mkabidhiano wa zamu yalisababisha Airworthiness Release kusainiwa vibaya na kuchelewa kwa ndege kwa dakika 95.

narrative_text: Jana usiku wakati wa handover ya service check, Crew Chief alisign Airworthiness Release na akaclose zile blocks zilizobaki bila kuverify vizuri zile deferral entries mbili. Ile deferral sheet number ya LH Pack Flow Control Valve haikuwekwa kwenye compliance page, na ile deferral code block ya flashlight na cradle ilikuwa blank, ikabidi tuitrace kutoka kwa job card tally before tunarelease aircraft. Next shift lazima wa-double check deferral sheets zote against job card entries kabla ya ku-sign Airworthiness Release yoyote, kwa sababu hii gap ilicause confusion kwa Captain wa outbound flight na delay ya 95 minutes.
summary: Deferral entries hazikukamilika kwenye logbook during shift handover, hivyo Airworthiness Release ikasainiwa vibaya na flight ika-delay kwa dakika 95.

narrative_text: A320, engine #2: VSV actuator was removed and reinstalled per AMM procedure, and idle leak check was performed with no leaks noted at the time. Verbal turnover was given to the oncoming shift, but once the aircraft was on blocks a discrepancy was noted with the installation. Next shift needs to re-verify the VSV actuator rigging and confirm proper installation before further dispatch.
summary: VSV actuator on engine #2 was reinstalled and checked with no leaks noted, but a discrepancy was later found on blocks requiring re-verification.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya A320, actuator ya VSV kwenye injini namba mbili iliondolewa na kuwekwa tena kulingana na taratibu za AMM, na ukaguzi wa uvujaji wakati wa idle ulifanyika bila kuonekana tatizo lolote wakati huo. Taarifa ilitolewa kwa mdomo kwa zamu iliyofuata, lakini ndege ilipokuwa imesimama sehemu ya maegesho, hitilafu iligundulika kwenye ufungaji huo. Zamu inayofuata inahitajika kukagua tena ufungaji wa actuator ya VSV na kuhakikisha imewekwa sawasawa kabla ya safari nyingine.
summary: Actuator ya VSV kwenye injini namba mbili ilifungwa upya bila hitilafu wakati wa ukaguzi, lakini baadaye tatizo liligunduliwa likihitaji ukaguzi zaidi.

entities.text: ukaguzi wa uvujaji wakati wa idle

narrative_text: Kwa hii A320, engine #2, tuli-remove na kuinstall VSV actuator kulingana na AMM, then tukafanya idle leak check, hakuna leaks zilizoonekana that time. Nilitoa verbal turnover kwa oncoming shift, lakini aircraft ilipokuwa on blocks tukagundua kuna discrepancy kwa installation. Next shift wanahitaji ku-recheck rigging ya VSV actuator na kuconfirm installation before dispatch.
summary: VSV actuator ya engine #2 ili-installed sawa na leak check ilipita, lakini discrepancy iligundulika later on blocks na inahitaji recheck.

narrative_text: While replacing packings on the #2 engine chip detector housing, we found the tech data and packings did not match the actual parts installed. Crew Chief was called down, and on checking #1 engine chip detector we found a different valve configuration with a missing rubber seal on the #2 engine check valve; a complete valve body assembly was ordered in. Everything was reassembled and verbally passed to Lead Crew Chief that both engines require leak checks, but no log entry was made confirming this. Next shift must verify leak checks were actually performed and documented before further dispatch.
summary: Chip detector housing rework on #2 engine revealed mismatched parts and a missing check valve seal; leak checks on both engines were verbally handed over but never logged, requiring urgent verification.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kubadilisha packings kwenye housing ya chip detector ya injini namba mbili, tuligundua kuwa tech data na packings tulizopewa hazikulingana na sehemu halisi zilizokuwepo. Crew Chief aliitwa, na baada ya kuangalia chip detector ya injini namba moja, tulikuta mfumo tofauti wa valve pamoja na seal ya mpira iliyokosekana kwenye check valve ya injini namba mbili; assembly kamili ya valve body iliagizwa. Kila kitu kilirudishwa pamoja na taarifa ilitolewa kwa mdomo kwa Lead Crew Chief kuwa injini zote mbili zinahitaji leak check, lakini hakuna kiingilio chochote kilichoandikwa kwenye logbook. Zamu inayofuata lazima ithibitishe kama leak check ilifanyika na kuandikwa kabla ndege haijaruhusiwa kuruka tena.
summary: Ukarabati wa chip detector housing kwenye injini namba mbili ulibaini sehemu zisizolingana na seal iliyokosekana kwenye check valve, na taarifa ya leak check ilitolewa kwa mdomo tu bila kuandikwa, hivyo inahitaji uthibitisho wa haraka.

narrative_text: Tulikuwa tuna-replace packings kwa #2 ENG chip detector housing, lakini tukagundua tech data na packings hazi-match na parts halisi zilizo kwa aircraft. Tulimwita Crew Chief aje aangalie, akaenda ku-check #1 ENG chip detector, tukakuta valve configuration tofauti kabisa, na rubber seal ilikuwa imekosekana kwa #2 ENG check valve, so tuka-order full valve body assembly ije. Kila kitu kili-reassemble na turnover ilitolewa verbally tu kwa Lead Crew Chief kwamba both engines zinahitaji leak check, lakini hakuna log entry iliyofanywa. Next shift wahakikishe kama leak check ilifanyika kweli na iko documented kabla ndege haija-dispatch tena.
summary: Job ya chip detector kwa #2 ENG iligundua parts mismatch na missing seal kwa check valve, na leak check turnover ilikuwa verbal tu bila log entry, hivyo inahitaji verification ASAP.

narrative_text: Completed fuel nozzle removal and replacement on the B737 MAX per Engineering Authorization step and AMM 73-11-05-000-802-G-00. Verified part numbers on the new nozzles and seals, checked bolt installation and torque, and confirmed B-nut torque and safety wiring. Next shift to double-check inspector sign-off on torque values and safety wire before engine run, as procedural steps were tight and warrant a second look.
summary: Technician completed and verified a B737 MAX fuel nozzle replacement per AMM procedure, with recommendation for inspector re-check before engine run.

narrative_text: Kazi ya kuondoa na kufunga upya fuel nozzles kwenye ndege ya B737 MAX imekamilika kufuata taratibu za Engineering Authorization na AMM 73-11-05-000-802-G-00. Nimehakiki namba za sehemu mpya, uwekaji na torque ya bolti, pamoja na torque na usalama wa B-nuts. Shift inayofuata iangalie tena sahihi ya inspector kuhusu torque na safety wire kabla ya kuwasha injini, kwa sababu hatua za taratibu zilikuwa ngumu na zinahitaji ukaguzi wa ziada.
summary: Fundi amekamilisha na kuhakiki ubadilishaji wa fuel nozzles kwenye B737 MAX kwa mujibu wa taratibu za AMM, na anapendekeza ukaguzi wa ziada na inspekta kabla ya kuwasha injini.

entities.text: kuondoa na kufunga upya fuel nozzles

narrative_text: Tumemaliza kufanya fuel nozzle removal and replacement kwa B737 MAX kufuata Engineering Authorization step na AMM 73-11-05-000-802-G-00. Nili-verify part numbers za nozzles mpya na seals, nikacheck bolt installation na torque, plus torque na safety wiring ya B-nuts, everything ilikuwa within limits. Next shift wasikie wa-double check inspector sign-off kuhusu torque values na safety wire kabla ya engine run, kwa sababu hizo steps zilikuwa tight kidogo.
summary: Technician ame-verify na kukamilisha fuel nozzle replacement kwenye B737 MAX per AMM procedure, na anapendekeza inspector a-recheck torque na safety wire kabla ya engine run.

narrative_text: Field trip crew swapped the misinstalled left/right PSU emergency oxygen generator containers on Aircraft X overnight per base manager/crew chief instructions, bypassing the agreed AMM procedure. The required safety ring PN and insertion tool pin were not available, so the swap was done without them, creating a risk of inadvertent generator activation and injury. Next shift must verify generator positions against drawing spec, confirm correct tooling is on site before any further work, and re-inspect all connections per AMM before returning aircraft to service.
summary: Oxygen generator containers were swapped without required safety tooling, creating an activation hazard that needs verification and re-inspection.

entities.text: verify generator positions against drawing spec

narrative_text: Wahandisi walioko kwenye field trip walibadilisha vyombo vya oksijeni ya dharura vya PSU vilivyowekwa vibaya upande wa kushoto na kulia wa Ndege X usiku, kufuatia maagizo ya meneja wa kituo na crew chief, bila kufuata utaratibu wa AMM uliokubaliwa awali. Vifaa muhimu vya usalama - pete ya usalama na pini ya kuingiza - havikuwepo, hivyo kazi ilifanywa bila hivyo, na kuweka hatari ya vyombo kuwaka bila kukusudia na kusababisha majeraha. Zamu inayofuata lazima ithibitishe nafasi sahihi za vyombo kulingana na mchoro rasmi, ihakikishe zana zinazohitajika zipo kabla ya kuendelea na kazi, na ikague tena miunganisho yote kwa mujibu wa AMM kabla ndege haijarudishwa kazini.
summary: Vyombo vya oksijeni ya dharura vilibadilishwa bila zana muhimu za usalama, hali inayohitaji ukaguzi wa haraka kabla ndege haijarudi kazini.

entities.text: vyombo vya oksijeni ya dharura vya PSU
meneja wa kituo na crew chief
kuthibitisha nafasi sahihi za vyombo kulingana na mchoro rasmi
kukagua tena miunganisho yote kwa mujibu wa AMM

narrative_text: Field trip crew walifanya swap ya PSU oxygen generator containers usiku kwenye Aircraft X, kufuata instructions za base manager na crew chief, badala ya kufuata AMM procedure iliyokubaliwa. Tatizo ni kwamba safety ring PN na insertion tool pin hazikuwepo site, so kazi ilifanywa bila hizo, ikileta risk ya generator ku-activate accidentally na kusababisha injury. Next shift lazima wa-verify positions za generators against drawing, wahakikishe correct tooling iko available kabla ya kuendelea, na wa-re-inspect connections zote per AMM kabla aircraft haija-return to service.
summary: Oxygen generators zilibadilishwa bila required safety tools, so kuna activation hazard inayohitaji verification na re-inspection haraka.

entities.text: verify positions za generators against drawing

narrative_text: During the time-change task on the right overwing escape slide bottle, removal and installation steps per the AMM and work card were completed, then handed over to avionics for the squib continuity check. While performing the continuity test, the avionics tech inadvertently fired the bottle, deploying the slide; supervisor was notified immediately. Investigation showed the work card did not specify which AMM subtask to use for the test, and the work card/AMM references appear to conflict. Follow-up: update the work card to reference the correct continuity-check subtask and clarify procedure before further slide bottle time changes.
summary: A right overwing slide bottle was inadvertently fired during a squib continuity check because the work card lacked clear AMM subtask guidance, causing unintended slide deployment.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kazi ya kubadilisha chupa ya slide ya dharura upande wa juu wa bawa la kulia, hatua za kuondoa na kufunga kulingana na AMM na work card zilikamilika, kisha kazi ikakabidhiwa kwa timu ya avionics kufanya continuity check ya squib. Wakati wa kupima continuity, fundi wa avionics kwa bahati mbaya alisababisha chupa kulipuka na slide kutoka; msimamizi alijulishwa mara moja. Uchunguzi ulionyesha kuwa work card haikueleza wazi subtask gani ya AMM ya kutumia, na kuna mgongano kati ya maelekezo ya work card na AMM. Ufuatiliaji unahitajika: work card isasishwe ili ionyeshe subtask sahihi ya continuity check kabla ya kazi nyingine za namna hii kufanyika.
summary: Chupa ya slide ya dharura ililipuka bila kukusudiwa wakati wa continuity check kwa sababu work card haikuonyesha wazi subtask sahihi ya AMM.

narrative_text: Tulikuwa tunafanya time change ya right overwing slide bottle, tukamaliza removal na installation steps kulingana na AMM na work card, then tukahand over kwa avionics wafanye squib continuity check. Sasa wakati wanafanya hiyo test, kwa bahati mbaya avionics tech aka-fire bottle na slide ikadeploy; tuli-notify supervisor immediately. Turns out work card haiko clear kuhusu ni subtask gani ya AMM ya kutumia, kuna conflict kati ya work card na AMM references. Follow-up: hio work card i-update ionyeshe correct subtask ya continuity check kabla ya kufanya another slide bottle time change.
summary: Slide bottle ilideploy bila kupangwa wakati wa continuity check kwa sababu work card haikuwa clear kuhusu correct AMM subtask.

narrative_text: B777-200 pax seat rework per CMM 25-62-82 (log-pages XXXXXXX/XXXXXXY) was completed this shift, but the seatbelt shackle attachment fitting (P/N 1022492-125) was not installed, leaving no attachment point for the seatbelt. Seat arrived with prior work done and several parts/hardware already missing, requiring research and reordering that delayed completion; no relief manpower came at shift change so the job was finished on overtime under fatigue, with cleaning crew activity nearby adding distraction. Next shift must verify all hardware against parts list before closing out, confirm shackle fitting is installed, and re-inspect full seat build before it is released for flight.
summary: A B777-200 passenger seat was reassembled without the required seatbelt shackle fitting due to missing parts, time pressure, and fatigue during an unsupported overtime shift.

narrative_text: Kazi ya kutengeneza kiti cha abiria cha B777-200 kwa mujibu wa CMM 25-62-82 (log-pages XXXXXXX/XXXXXXY) imekamilika kwa zamu hii, lakini kifaa cha kushikilia mkanda wa usalama (P/N 1022492-125) hakikuwekwa, hivyo kiti hakina sehemu ya kufunga mkanda. Kiti kilikuwa kimeshafanyiwa kazi kabla ya kufika hapa na vipuri kadhaa vilikuwa vimepotea, jambo lililohitaji utafiti na kuagiza vipuri vipya na kuchelewesha kazi; hakuna fundi mwingine aliyekuja kusaidia wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu, hivyo kazi ilikamilishwa kwa saa za ziada huku uchovu ukiwa umeanza kuathiri umakini, na wafanyakazi wa usafi waliokuwa karibu na eneo la kazi walisababisha vurugu ya fikra. Zamu inayofuata inatakiwa kuthibitisha vipuri vyote dhidi ya orodha ya vipuri kabla ya kufunga kazi, kuhakikisha kifaa cha kushikilia mkanda kimewekwa, na kukagua tena kiti chote kabla ya kuruhusiwa kutumika kwenye ndege.
summary: Kiti cha abiria cha B777-200 kilirudishwa bila kifaa muhimu cha kushikilia mkanda wa usalama kutokana na vipuri vilivyokosekana, shinikizo la muda, na uchovu wakati wa zamu ya saa za ziada bila msaada wa wafanyakazi wengine.

entities.text: kifaa cha kushikilia mkanda wa usalama (P/N 1022492-125)

narrative_text: Tuli-rework ile pax seat ya B777-200 kwa CMM 25-62-82 (log-pages XXXXXXX/XXXXXXY) na job ilikamilika this shift, lakini tuli-forget ku-install ile seatbelt shackle attachment fitting (P/N 1022492-125), so sasa seat haina attachment point ya seatbelt. Seat ilikuwa already worked on before kufika ZZZ, na kuna parts na hardware kadhaa zilikuwa missing, tukalazimika ku-research na ku-order zingine, hivyo ikachukua muda mrefu; hakuna relief iliyokuja during shift change so tulilazimika kufanya overtime, fatigue ikaanza kuathiri concentration, plus wale cleaning crew walikuwa working karibu na eneo la job wakatu-distract kidogo. Oncoming shift inafaa ku-verify hardware zote against parts list, confirm kwamba shackle fitting imewekwa, na ku-re-inspect full seat build before iko-released for flight.
summary: Pax seat ya B777-200 iliezekwa without ile required shackle fitting kwa sababu ya missing parts, time pressure, na fatigue during overtime bila relief manpower.

narrative_text: B737-900 #1 EDP was replaced this shift after a seal failure caused the earlier diversion; SEALOL seal and pump were installed per AMM 29-XX-XX and all lines torqued accordingly. Engine runs showed no leaks at the time, but the following flight crew logged an improperly torqued line on the EDP install. Incoming shift technicians should re-verify all torque values and connections on the #1 EDP before next dispatch, and cross-check the logbook entries tied to this job.
summary: Technician handover notes completion of #1 EDP replacement on a B737-900 following a seal failure, but flags a post-run report of a loose torque line requiring re-inspection.

narrative_text: Ndege ya B737-900 ilifanyiwa ukarabati wa #1 EDP baada ya tatizo la seal kusababisha kuelekezwa kwingine wakati wa safari. Seal ya SEALOL na pump vilibadilishwa kwa kufuata maelekezo ya AMM 29-XX-XX, na mabomba yote yalikaziwa kama inavyotakiwa. Wakati wa majaribio ya injini hakuna uvujaji ulioonekana, lakini baadaye ndege iliporuka tena, wafanyakazi waligundua bomba moja halikukaziwa vizuri. Zamu inayofuata inaombwa kukagua tena mikazo yote ya EDP na kuthibitisha maelezo yaliyoandikwa kwenye logbook.
summary: Fundi anaripoti kukamilika kwa ubadilishaji wa #1 EDP kwenye B737-900 baada ya tatizo la seal, lakini anaonya kuhusu bomba lisilokaziwa vizuri lililogunduliwa baadaye.

narrative_text: Tumemaliza ile #1 EDP replacement kwa B737-900 baada ya seal kufail iliyosababisha diversion. Seal ya SEALOL na pump ziliinstall per AMM 29-XX-XX, na lines zote zilitorqued according to spec. Engine runs hazikuonyesha leaks, lakini flight iliyofuata waliripoti kwenye logbook line moja haikuwa torqued properly. Next shift wako-verify tena torque values zote za EDP kabla ya dispatch, na wacheki logbook entries za job hii.
summary: Fundi ame-handover kuhusu #1 EDP replacement kwenye B737-900 iliyofail seal, lakini kuna concern ya line ambayo haikutorqued vizuri baada ya runs.

narrative_text: Took over the B767-300 bulk cargo door MEL job left by line maintenance from last night; found the spring tube in an unsafe condition with the rig pin wrongly installed and the end cap hardware removed. Only one partially installed screw was holding the compressed spring inside the tube, a serious risk of injury if it had released. No entry was made on the logpage and the previous shift did not properly brief what work had actually been done. Follow-up: pull the AMM before continuing, hold for correct tooling, and ensure all actions and the unsafe condition are logged and briefed at handover.
summary: Incoming technician found an unsafely rigged cargo door spring tube from the prior shift, with no logpage entry or proper handover briefing, requiring AMM reference and correct documentation before continuing.

narrative_text: Nilipokea kazi ya MEL ya mlango wa mizigo wa ndege B767-300 iliyoanzishwa na wafanyakazi wa line maintenance usiku uliopita; nikakuta spring tube katika hali hatarishi, rig pin imewekwa vibaya na vifaa vya end cap vimetolewa. Skrubu moja tu iliyowekwa nusu ndiyo ilikuwa ikizuia spring iliyobanwa kutoka ndani ya tube, hali ambayo ingeweza kusababisha jeraha kali au kifo. Hakukuwa na maelezo yoyote kwenye logpage kuhusu hatua zilizochukuliwa, na zamu iliyotangulia haikutoa taarifa sahihi wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu. Inashauriwa kurejelea Aircraft Maintenance Manual kabla ya kuendelea, kusubiri vifaa sahihi, na kuandika kwa uwazi hatua zote na hali hatarishi kwenye logpage.
summary: Fundi aliyeingia zamu alikuta mlango wa mizigo wa ndege ukiwa katika hali hatarishi bila kumbukumbu sahihi za kazi kwenye logpage, hivyo kuhitajika hatua za haraka za usalama na uandikaji bora.

narrative_text: Nilipokea ile bulk cargo door MEL job ya B767-300 ambayo line maintenance walikuwa wameanza usiku wa jana; nikakuta spring tube iko unsafe, rig pin imewekwa vibaya na end cap hardware imetolewa kabisa. Ni screw moja tu ambayo haikuwa fully installed ndiyo ilikuwa ikizuia spring compressed isitoke kwa nguvu, jambo ambalo lingeweza kusababisha serious injury. Hakuna entry kwenye logpage na handover ya zamu iliyopita haikueleza clearly nini kilifanyika. Tafadhali check AMM kabla ya kuendelea, wait for correct tooling, na uandike vizuri actions zote pamoja na hiyo unsafe condition.
summary: Fundi wa zamu aligundua cargo door spring tube iko katika unsafe condition bila proper logpage entry au handover briefing, hivyo inahitajika AMM reference na documentation kabla ya kuendelea na job.

narrative_text: During troubleshooting of the Backup Generator Blocked message on the assigned aircraft, we opened the thrust reverser and top pylon panel and found a broken wire requiring a harness change; cannon plugs were reconnected and panels closed out under time pressure before end of shift. Two circuit breakers left pulled by another technician to lock the thrust reverser panel were not tagged with the non-routine paperwork, and the colleague who pulled them had already left for a second shift. Incoming shift must verify both circuit breakers are reset and confirm the non-routine card is properly closed before releasing the aircraft to service.
summary: Thrust reverser harness repair was completed but two untagged pulled circuit breakers were missed during shift handover, requiring verification before aircraft release.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kutafuta chanzo cha tatizo la ujumbe wa Backup Generator Blocked kwenye ndege iliyopangiwa, tulifungua thrust reverser na paneli ya juu ya pylon na kugundua waya uliokatika uliohitaji kubadilishwa harness; cannon plugs zilirudishwa na paneli kufungwa tukiwa na shinikizo la muda kabla ya zamu kuisha. Circuit breakers mbili zilizotolewa na fundi mwenzangu kufunga paneli ya thrust reverser hazikuwa na lebo ya non-routine, na yule aliyezitoa alikuwa tayari ameondoka kwenda zamu nyingine. Zamu inayofuata inapaswa kuhakikisha circuit breakers zote mbili zimerudishwa na fomu ya non-routine imefungwa vizuri kabla ndege haijarudishwa kwa huduma.
summary: Ukarabati wa harness ya thrust reverser ulikamilika lakini circuit breakers mbili zilizotolewa bila lebo zilisahaulika wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu, hivyo zinahitaji uthibitisho kabla ndege haijarudishwa kazini.

narrative_text: Tulikuwa tuna-troubleshoot Backup Generator Blocked message kwa aircraft, tukafungua thrust reverser na top pylon panel, tukapata broken wire ambayo ilihitaji harness change; tuka-reconnect cannon plugs na kuclose panels tukiwa na time pressure kabla ya shift kuisha. Kuna circuit breakers mbili zilizoachwa pulled na fundi mwenzangu kulock ile thrust reverser panel, lakini hazikuwa na non-routine tag, na yeye alikuwa ameshaenda second shift terminal. Incoming crew wahakikishe zile CBs zimerudishwa na non-routine card imeclosed vizuri kabla ya kurelease aircraft to service.
summary: Harness change ya thrust reverser ilikamilika lakini kuna circuit breakers mbili zilizoachwa pulled bila tag wakati wa handover, so inabidi zithibitishwe kabla aircraft haijarudi service.

narrative_text: On the B767-300ER, crew reported the oxygen bottle pressure dropped over 200 psi during pre-departure checks, indicating the crew bottle shutoff valve was not fully open following the recent oxygen mask box replacement. Two junior technicians accessed the E/E compartment under time pressure with passengers already boarded and departure 10-20 minutes away, and confirmed by feel that the valve was open, but this was not independently verified by the lead technician given the differing feel between steel and composite bottles. Next shift must re-verify the valve position physically, review the oxygen mask box replacement task card, and ensure two-person independent confirmation is enforced for critical safety checks going forward.
summary: A crew oxygen bottle shutoff valve was not fully open after a mask box replacement, and rushed, unverified checks by junior staff under time pressure require follow-up on B767-300ER.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya B767-300ER, marubani waligundua shinikizo la oksijeni limeshuka zaidi ya psi 200 wakati wa ukaguzi kabla ya safari, jambo linaloonyesha valve ya chupa ya oksijeni ya crew haikuwa imefunguliwa kikamilifu baada ya kubadilishwa kwa boksi la barakoa za oksijeni siku chache zilizopita. Mafundi wawili wapya waliingia kwenye chumba cha vifaa vya umeme (E/E compartment) chini ya shinikizo la muda huku abiria tayari wamepanda ndani na dakika 10-20 tu kubaki kabla ya kuondoka, wakathibitisha kwa kugusa tu kwamba valve ilikuwa wazi, lakini fundi kiongozi hakuthibitisha hilo mwenyewe licha ya kujua kuwa hisia ya valve hutofautiana kati ya chupa za chuma na za composite. Zamu inayofuata inapaswa kuthibitisha tena hali halisi ya valve, kupitia upya hati ya kazi ya ubadilishaji wa boksi la oksijeni, na kuhakikisha uthibitisho wa watu wawili unafanywa kikamilifu kwa ukaguzi wa usalama muhimu.
summary: Valve ya chupa ya oksijeni ya crew haikufunguliwa kikamilifu baada ya ukarabati wa boksi la barakoa, na ukaguzi wa haraka usiothibitishwa vyema unahitaji ufuatiliaji zaidi kwenye ndege ya B767-300ER.

entities.text: chumba cha vifaa vya umeme (E/E compartment)

narrative_text: Kwa hii B767-300ER, wale pilots wame-notice pressure ya oxygen bottle imedrop na zaidi ya 200 psi wakati wa checks kabla ya departure, ikimaanisha ile crew bottle shutoff valve haikuwa fully open baada ya ile oxygen mask box kubadilishwa juzi. Wale mafundi wawili wa new guys walipanda kwa E/E compartment chini ya time pressure ikiwa pax tayari wame-board na departure ni in 10-20 minutes tu, wakaconfirm kwa feel tu kwamba valve ilikuwa open, lakini lead tech hakuverify mwenyewe ingawa anajua feel ya valve inatofautiana kati ya steel na composite bottles. Next shift wanahitaji ku-reverify valve position physically, kupitia task card ya ile mask box replacement, na kuhakikisha two-person verification inafanywa kwa hizi critical checks going forward.
summary: Crew oxygen bottle shutoff valve haikuwa fully open baada ya mask box replacement, na hizi rushed checks za mafundi wapya chini ya time pressure zinahitaji follow-up kwa B767-300ER.

narrative_text: Inspector arrived for the fan blade lube job card and found the blades already removed, cleaned, and lubed by the previous shift, with only two mechanics present who had never performed this task before and could not confirm the procedure followed. Blades on the rack and the hub/disk marks were not in sequential order, so the inspector could not verify correct reinstallation sequence and had to redo the pre-inspection from scratch. Next shift: confirm blade/hub sequencing before closing the card and verify staffing meets the minimum four-mechanic requirement for this task.
summary: Inspector found fan blade lube task completed by an unqualified, understaffed previous crew with blades out of sequence, requiring a full re-inspection.

narrative_text: Wakati inspector alipofika kwa kazi ya lube ya fan blades, aligundua blades tayari zimeondolewa, kusafishwa na kulubiwa na zamu iliyotangulia, na waliokuwepo ni mechanics wawili tu ambao hawajawahi kufanya kazi hiyo na hawakuwa na uhakika wa taratibu zilizofuatwa. Blades kwenye rack na alama za hub/disk hazikuwa katika mpangilio sahihi, hivyo inspector alilazimika kurudia ukaguzi tangu mwanzo kabla ya kuendelea. Zamu inayofuata: hakikisheni mpangilio wa blades na hub umethibitishwa kabla ya kufunga kadi, na idadi ya wafanyakazi inakidhi mahitaji ya chini ya mechanics wanne kwa kazi hii.
summary: Inspector aligundua kazi ya lube ya fan blades ilifanywa na wafanyakazi wachache wasio na uzoefu, blades zikiwa hazijapangwa vizuri, hivyo ukaguzi mzima ulilazimika kurudiwa.

narrative_text: Sasa inspector alifika for the fan blade lube card akakuta blades tayari zime-removed na kulubiwa na previous shift, lakini wale mechanics wawili waliokuwa pale walikuwa hawajawahi do this task na hawakujua exactly nini kilifanyika. Blades kwa rack pamoja na hub/disk marks zilikuwa hazijapangwa sequentially, so inspector alilazimika ku-redo pre-inspection from scratch kabla ya kusign off. Next shift ihakikishe blade na hub sequence ime-verify kabla ya kufunga card, na pia minimum ya mechanics wanne inakuwepo for this kind of job.
summary: Inspector alikuta fan blade lube imefanywa na mechanics wasio na experience na blades hazijapangwa vizuri, so ilibidi arudie inspection yote.

narrative_text: Following LMLG door uplock removal and replacement after the inbound flight's gear door failed to close, the ops check was left for the next shift to complete. During that check the skin outlet valve connector was overlooked and left disconnected, leaving the valve inoperative and locked out. Aircraft departed and failed to pressurize climbing through 2,000 feet, with vent blower and skin valve faults triggering a return to base. Next shift to verify all cannon plugs reconnected on the pressurization/vent system, confirm ops check sign-off detail, and have a second technician independently verify connector security before next dispatch.
summary: A missed cannon-plug connection on the skin outlet valve after LMLG uplock maintenance caused a pressurization failure and air turnback shortly after takeoff.

narrative_text: Baada ya kuondoa na kurudisha uplock ya mlango wa LMLG kufuatia tatizo la mlango huo kutofunga baada ya ndege iliyowasili kutua, ukaguzi wa uendeshaji (ops check) uliachwa uendelezwe na zamu inayofuata. Wakati wa ukaguzi huo, kiungo cha valve ya matundu ya nje ya ganda la ndege kilisahaulika kuunganishwa, na kuacha valve hiyo ikiwa haifanyi kazi na imefungwa. Ndege ilipaa na kushindwa kuweka shinikizo la hewa ikiwa imefika futi 2,000, hali iliyosababisha hitilafu za blower ya matundu na valve ya ganda, na hatimaye ndege kurudi kituoni. Zamu inayofuata ihakikishe viunganishi vyote vimeunganishwa vizuri kwenye mfumo wa shinikizo na matundu, isaini ukaguzi kwa undani zaidi, na fundi mwingine athibitishe kwa kujitegemea usalama wa viunganishi kabla ya safari nyingine.
summary: Kusahaulika kwa uunganishaji wa kiungo cha valve ya matundu baada ya ukarabati wa uplock ya LMLG kulisababisha kushindwa kuweka shinikizo la hewa na ndege kurudi kituoni muda mfupi baada ya kupaa.

entities.text: valve ya matundu ya nje ya ganda

narrative_text: Baada ya kutoa na ku-replace ile LMLG door uplock, kwa sababu inbound flight ilikuwa na door haifungi vizuri after gear extension, ile ops check ilibaki iendelezwe na next shift. Wakati wa ku-verify hiyo uplock, mtu alisahau kuconnect ile cannon plug ya skin outlet valve, so valve ikabaki locked out na haifanyi kazi. Aircraft ikapaa, but haiku-pressurize ikifika 2,000 feet, tukapata vent blower fault na skin valve fault, ndio ikabidi i-return to base. Next shift wa-verify connectors zote za pressurization/vent system ziko connected fiti, wa-sign ops check kwa detail zaidi, na technician mwingine a-double check hizo cannon plugs kabla ya dispatch inayofuata.
summary: Cannon plug ya skin outlet valve iliachwa disconnected baada ya LMLG uplock maintenance, na hiyo ikasababisha pressurization failure na air turnback muda mfupi baada ya takeoff.

narrative_text: Took over B777-200 from Day shift and completed the Engine 2 fire loop replacement per WDM 26-XX-XX-X and FIM 26-XX Task XXX referenced in the previous log entry; all clamps and shared attaching wires were checked and secured. After completion around 2000, the AMM Engine Fire Detection Operational Test was performed but did not pass, and the associated MEL item remains active; there was insufficient ground time before the XB:00 departure to troubleshoot further. Note that the torque and bonding meter checks under AMM 26-XX-XX-XXX-XXY (Fire Detector Assembly Removal) were not followed, as FIM 26-XX Task XXX only pointed to the Detector Element Removal procedure, which does not apply here. Next shift should re-verify the correct AMM reference, redo the torque/bonding checks, and rerun the operational test before further dispatch consideration.
summary: Engine 2 fire loop replacement on the B777-200 failed its operational test due to an incomplete torque/bonding check caused by conflicting AMM/FIM references, requiring follow-up before dispatch.

entities.text: AMM Engine Fire Detection Operational Test

narrative_text: Nilipokea ndege B777-200 kutoka kwa zamu ya mchana nikiendelea na kazi ya kubadilisha fire loop ya Injini ya Pili kwa kufuata WDM 26-XX-XX-X na FIM 26-XX Task XXX zilizotajwa kwenye logi iliyopita; clamps zote na waya zinazoshirikiana zilihakikishwa zimekazwa vizuri. Baada ya kukamilisha kazi saa saba mchana hivi, kipimo cha operational test cha mfumo wa kugundua moto kilifanywa lakini hakikupita, na tatizo la MEL bado liko wazi; muda uliobaki kabla ya ndege kuondoka haukutosha kufanya uchunguzi zaidi. Ni muhimu kuzingatia kuwa hatua za kukagua torque na bonding meter kama zinavyotakiwa na AMM 26-XX-XX-XXX-XXY hazikufuatwa kikamilifu kwa sababu FIM ilielekeza kwenye taratibu isiyohusiana na kazi iliyofanyika. Zamu inayofuata inapaswa kuthibitisha marejeleo sahihi ya AMM, kurudia ukaguzi wa torque na bonding, kisha kurudia operational test kabla ya uamuzi wowote wa kuruhusu ndege kuruka.
summary: Ubadilishaji wa fire loop ya Injini ya Pili kwenye B777-200 ulishindwa kwenye operational test kutokana na maelekezo yasiyolingana ya AMM na FIM, hivyo kuhitaji ufuatiliaji zaidi kabla ya safari.

narrative_text: Nilichukua handover ya B777-200 kutoka Day shift, nikaendelea na replacement ya Engine 2 fire loop kwa kufuata WDM 26-XX-XX-X na FIM 26-XX Task XXX kama ilivyo-note kwenye log page ya juzi; clamps zote na attaching wires za shared connections zilicheckwa ziko secure. Tukimaliza around 2000, tuka-run AMM Engine Fire Detection Operational Test lakini haikupass, na MEL bado iko active; hatukuwa na ground time ya kutosha kuendelea na troubleshooting maana departure ilikuwa XB:00. Kuna gap kwa sababu torque check na bonding meter check za AMM 26-XX-XX-XXX-XXY (Fire Detector Assembly Removal) hazikufuatwa, kwa sababu FIM ilikuwa inapoint tu kwa Detector Element Removal procedure ambayo haiapply hapa. Next shift wanahitaji ku-verify AMM reference sahihi, warudie torque/bonding checks, then wa-rerun ile operational test kabla ya kuclear ndege for dispatch.
summary: Engine 2 fire loop replacement kwenye B777-200 ime-fail operational test kwa sababu ya conflicting AMM/FIM references, so follow-up inahitajika before dispatch.

narrative_text: During base check on the Citation Longitude, we found the LH outboard split flap rubbing against the aileron panel and excessive play in the inboard actuator fairing on the same wing. This was flagged to management and the oncoming lead tech at shift turnover, with the damage physically shown to one of the incoming managers. Flap removal for evaluation is now planned given the tight ETIC, but crew is split with leading edge and fuel tank inspections also open, so follow-up on the flap actuator damage assessment is needed from the next shift.
summary: Technicians found flap rubbing and actuator fairing play on a Citation Longitude LH wing during base check, handed over for further evaluation amid time pressure.

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa msingi kwenye ndege ya Citation Longitude, tulibaini bapa la nje la flap upande wa kushoto likigusana na paneli ya aileron, pamoja na mchezo mkubwa kwenye sehemu ya ndani ya actuator ya mrengo huohuo. Hali hii iliripotiwa kwa uongozi na fundi kiongozi aliyekuwa akiingia zamu, na hata uharibifu ulionyeshwa moja kwa moja kwa mmoja wa mameneja. Kutokana na muda mfupi uliopangwa wa kukamilisha kazi, imeamuliwa flap iondolewe kwa ukaguzi zaidi, lakini kwa kuwa wafanyakazi wamegawanywa kufanya ukaguzi wa ukingo wa mbele na matangi ya mafuta, ufuatiliaji wa tathmini ya uharibifu wa actuator unahitajika kutoka kwa zamu inayofuata.
summary: Mafundi waligundua flap ikigusana na aileron pamoja na mchezo mkubwa wa actuator kwenye ndege ya Citation Longitude wakati wa ukaguzi, na kukabidhi suala hilo kwa zamu inayofuata kwa ufuatiliaji zaidi.

narrative_text: Tuko na base check ya Citation Longitude, tukapata LH outboard flap ikigusana na aileron panel, na actuator fairing ya inboard ina play mob sana. Nilitoa turnover kwa management na lead tech aliyekuwa amekuja, hata nikamuonyesha manager mmoja damage ile physically. Sasa wamesema flap iondolewe for evaluation kwa sababu ETIC ni tight, but crew imegawanyika na tuko na leading edge inspection na fuel tank checks pia, so next shift wafuatilie assessment ya actuator damage.
summary: Base check ya Citation Longitude ilipata flap rubbing na actuator play, tumeshahandover kwa management ili wafuatilie evaluation zaidi.
